controls.name: Clause 7.5 - Documented Information
controls.title: Documented Information
controls.body:
7.5.1:
The organization’s information security management system shall include:
a) documented information required by ISO 27001 document; and 
b) documented information determined by the organization as being necessary for the effectiveness of the information security management system."

7.5.2:
When creating and updating documented information, the organization shall ensure appropriate:
a) identification and description (e.g. a title, date, author, or reference number);
b) format (e.g. language, software version, graphics) and media (e.g. paper, electronic); and
c) review and approval for suitability and adequacy."

7.5.3:
Documented information required by the ISMS and by the ISO27001 document shall be controlled to ensure:
a) it is available and suitable for use, where and when it is needed; and
b) it is adequately protected (e.g. from loss of confidentiality, improper use, or loss of integrity).

For the control of documented information, the organization shall address the following activities, as applicable:
c) distribution, access, retrieval and use;
d) storage and preservation, including the preservation of legibility;
e) control of changes (e.g. version control); and
f) retention and disposition.

controls.body: Loading/delivery areas are only open to accommodate scheduled/known deliveries. Equipment, information or software shall not be taken off-site without prior authorization.

controls.name: AC-2 (3) Account management | disable inactive accounts
controls.title: AC-2 (3) Account management | disable inactive accounts
controls.body: The information system automatically disables inactive accounts after [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: D1.RM.RA.Int.1 - Adjustment of Risk Assessment Program
controls.title: Adjustment of Risk Assessment Program
controls.body: The risk assessment is adjusted to consider widely known risks or risk management practices.

controls.name: AC-2(9) - Account Management | Restrictions on Use of Shared and Group Accounts
controls.title: Account Management | Restrictions on Use of Shared and Group Accounts
controls.body: Only permit the use of shared and group accounts that meet [Assignment: organization-defined conditions for establishing shared and group accounts].

controls.name: Clause 9.3 - Management Review
controls.title: Management Review

controls.name: 8.2.3 - Physical Access controls
controls.title: Physical Access controls
controls.body: Physical access is restricted to personal information in any form (including the components of the entity’s system(s) that contain or protect personal information)

controls.name: PCI 3.2.1 - Storage of Full Track Content
controls.title: Storage of Full Track Content
controls.body:
Do not store the full contents of any track (from the magnetic stripe located on the back of a card, equivalent data contained on a chip, or elsewhere) after authorization. 

This data is alternatively called full track, track, track 1, track 2, and magnetic-stripe data.

Note:In the normal course of business, the following data elements from the magnetic stripe may need to be retained:·
- The cardholder’s name·
- Primary account number (PAN)·
- Expiration date·
- Service code 

To minimize risk, store only these data elements as needed for business.

controls.name: PCI 7.3 - Procedures for Restricting Access to Cardholder data
controls.title: PCI 7.3 - Procedures for Restricting Access to Cardholder data
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for restricting access to cardholder data are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: PCI 10.8 - Timely Detection and Reporting
controls.title: Timely Detection and Reporting
controls.body:
Additional requirement for service providers only:
Implement a process for the timely detection and reporting of failures of critical security control systems, including but not limited to failure of:
- Firewalls·IDS/IPS·FIM·Anti-virus.
- Physical access controls.
- Logical access controls.
- Audit logging mechanisms.
- Segmentation controls (if used).

controls.name: PCI 10.5.4 - Audit Logs for External Facing Systems
controls.title: Audit Logs for External Facing Systems
controls.body: Write logs for external-facing technologies onto a secure, centralized, internal log server or media device.

controls.name: MANAGE 2 - Maximizing AI Benefits and Minimizing Negative Impacts: Strategies and Actor Input
controls.title: Maximizing AI Benefits and Minimizing Negative Impacts: Strategies and Actor Input
controls.body: Strategies to maximize AI benefits and minimize negative impacts are planned, prepared, implemented, documented, and informed by input from relevant AI actors.

controls.name: Authorized Disclosure
controls.title: Authorized Disclosure
controls.body: Organization creates and maintains a record of authorized disclosures of personal information that is complete, accurate, and timely.

controls.name: SI-4 (14) Information system monitoring | wireless intrusion detection
controls.title: SI-4 (14) Information system monitoring | wireless intrusion detection
controls.body: The organization employs a wireless intrusion detection system to identify rogue wireless devices and to detect attack attempts and potential compromises/breaches to the information system.

controls.name: Art. 33(VIII) - Cross-border transfer - explicit consent
controls.title: Cross-border transfer - explicit consent
controls.body:
"International transfer of personal data is only allowed in the following cases: . . .
(VII) when the data subject has given her/his specific and highlighted consent for the
transfer, with prior information about the international nature of the operation, with this being clearly distinct from other purposes" (LGPD Art. 33(VIII), unofficial Translation)

controls.name: PCI 8.3 - Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.title: PCI 8.3 - Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.body:
Secure all individual non-console administrative access and all remote access to the CDE using multi-factor authentication.

Note: Multi-factor authentication requires that a minimum of two of the three authentication methods (see Requirement 8.2 for descriptions of authentication methods) be used for authentication. Using one factor twice (for example, using two separate passwords) is not considered multi-factor authentication.

- 8.3.1   Incorporate multi-factor authentication for all non-console access into the CDE for personnel with administrative access.
- 8.3.2   Incorporate multi-factor authentication for all remote network access (both user and administrator, and including third-party access for support or maintenance) originating from outside the entity's network.

controls.name: CP-7 (3) Alternate processing site | priority of service
controls.title: CP-7 (3) Alternate processing site | priority of service
controls.body: The organization develops alternate processing site agreements that contain priority-of-service provisions in accordance with organizational availability requirements (including recovery time objectives).

controls.name: ID.SC-1 - Supply Chain Risk management Processes
controls.title: Supply Chain Risk management Processes
controls.body: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, assessed, managed, and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

controls.name: PR.IP-4 - Backup of Data and Testing
controls.title: Backup of Data and Testing
controls.body: Backups of information are conducted, maintained, and tested

controls.name: PCI 8.5 - Use of Generic IDs
controls.title: Use of Generic IDs
controls.body:
Do not use group, shared, or generic IDs, passwords, or other authentication methods as follows:
Generic user IDs are disabled or removed.
Shared user IDs do not exist for system administration and other critical functions.
Shared and generic user IDs are not used to administer any system components.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.Int.1 - Cyber Attack Communication Strategy
controls.title: Cyber Attack Communication Strategy
controls.body: A strategy is in place to coordinate and communicate with internal and external stakeholders during or following a cyber attack.

controls.name: Art. 37 - Records of processing
controls.title: Records of processing
controls.body:
"The controller and the processor shall keep records of personal data
processing operations carried out by them, especially when based on legitimate interest" (LGPD Art. 37, unofficial translation)

controls.name: 10 - Select and develop control activities
controls.title: Select and develop control activities
controls.body: The organization selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.

controls.name: CC2.2.3 - Policy & Procedures for Reporting Incidents
controls.title: CC2.2.3 - Policy & Procedures for Reporting Incidents
controls.body: Policy and procedures documents for significant processes, which include responsibility for reporting operational failures, incidents, system problems, concerns, and customer complaints (and the process for doing so) are published and available to all personnel.

controls.name: A.14.2.3 - Technical Review of Applications after Operating Platform Changes
controls.title: Technical Review of Applications after Operating Platform Changes
controls.body: When operating platforms are changed, business critical applications shall be reviewed and tested to ensure there is no adverse impact on organizational operations or security.

controls.name: MAP.5.2 - Impact Feedback Integration
controls.title: Impact Feedback Integration
controls.body: Practices and personnel for supporting regular engagement with relevant AI actors and integrating feedback about positive, negative, and unanticipated impacts are in place and documented.

controls.name: AAC3.4 - Privileges to Install Software/Applications
controls.title: AAC3.4 - Privileges to Install Software/Applications
controls.body: The ability to install software on Corporate workstations and laptops is restricted by policy.

controls.name: Art. 14 - Parental consent
controls.title: Parental consent
controls.body: "The processing of personal data belonging to children and adolescents shall be done in their best interest, pursuant to this article and specific legislation" (LGPD Art. 14, unofficial translation)

controls.name: Documented Audit and Accountability CMMC practices
controls.title: Documented Audit and Accountability CMMC practices
controls.body:
Provide documented CMMC practices related to Audit and Accountability policy and procedures.

REPLACE THIS WITH A CONTROL.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.E.3 - Removable Media Restrictions
controls.title: Removable Media Restrictions
controls.body: Technical controls prevent unauthorized devices, including rogue wireless access devices and removable media, from connecting to the internal network(s).

controls.name: PCI 12.1.1 - Review of Card Data Security Policy
controls.title: Review of Card Data Security Policy
controls.body: Review the security policy at least annually and update the policy when the environment changes.

controls.name: ASO2.1 - Incident Response Responsibilities
controls.title: ASO2.1 - Incident Response Responsibilities
controls.body: A Core Business Continuity Plan Team exists within the organization.

controls.name: PCI 12.10.3 - Incident Response Team
controls.title: Incident Response Team
controls.body: Designate specific personnel to be available on a 24/7 basis to respond to alerts.

controls.name: CC2.3.1 - Responsibilities of Clients & End Users
controls.title: CC2.3.1 - Responsibilities of Clients & End Users
controls.body: Responsibilities of clients and end users, which include responsibility for reporting operational failures, incidents, problems, concerns, and complaints, and the process for doing so, are described on the customer-facing website, on the mobile application, and in system documentation.

controls.name: ASO3.2 - Penetration Testing
controls.title: ASO3.2 - Penetration Testing
controls.body: Externally facing network and applications shall be pen tested at least once a year.

controls.name: IC11.0 - External Network Equipment Inventory
controls.title: IC11.0 - External Network Equipment Inventory
controls.body: An equipment management list is used to track equipment outside of organization corporate networks.

controls.name: M41.15 - Planning the establishment of a test
controls.title: Planning the establishment of a test
controls.body: Planning the establishment of a test

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.Int.2 - Review of Event Detection Processes
controls.title: Review of Event Detection Processes
controls.body: Event detection processes are proven reliable.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.1 - Tools used for Test and Evaluation, Validation and verification
controls.title: Tools used for Test and Evaluation, Validation and verification
controls.body: Test sets, metrics, and details about the tools used during test, evaluation, validation, and verification (TEVV) are documented.

controls.name: ASO2.8 - Data Breach Notification
controls.title: ASO2.8 - Data Breach Notification
controls.body: The organization documents its breach assessment and notification process in the event of a breach. Knowledge gained from resolving information security incidents is used to reduce the likelihood or impact of future incidents.

controls.name: SD1.8 - Source Code Management
controls.title: SD1.8 - Source Code Management
controls.body: Access to source code and items like designs, specifications are strictly controlled and adequately protected.

controls.name: SD1.0 - Vulnerability and Misuse Reviews in Software Development
controls.title: SD1.0 - Vulnerability and Misuse Reviews in Software Development
controls.body: Vulnerability, abuse and misuse assessments (VAMAs) are conducted during the software design process.

controls.name: SD1.2 - Code Scanning
controls.title: SD1.2 - Code Scanning
controls.body: Code scanning tools are used to search for, identify and patch vulnerabilities.

controls.name: Art. 18(II) - Right of access
controls.title: Right of access
controls.body:
"The data subject, regarding the data subject’s data being processed by the
controller, at any time and by means of request, has the right to obtain the following from the controller: . . .
(II)  – access to the data" (LGPD Art. 18(II), unofficial translation)

controls.name: Art. 47 - Breach notification
controls.title: Breach notification
controls.body:
"Processing agents or any other person that intervenes in one of the processing
phases commit themselves to ensure the security of the information as provided in this Law regarding personal data, even following the conclusion of the processing in question" (LGPD Art. 47, unofficial translation)

controls.name: 10.2 - Assessing and reporting breaches
controls.title: Assessing and reporting breaches
controls.body: You have procedures to assess all security incidents and then report relevant breaches to the ICO within the statutory time frame.

controls.name: AC-22 Publicly accessible content
controls.title: AC-22 Publicly accessible content

controls.name: CC9.2.2 - NDA & Confidentiality Agreements
controls.title: CC9.2.2 - NDA & Confidentiality Agreements
controls.body: A nondisclosure or confidentiality agreement is signed by all persons with access to confidential information.

controls.name: CC3.2.3 - Risk Assessment & Risk Mitigation
controls.title: CC3.2.3 - Risk Assessment & Risk Mitigation
controls.body: On an annual basis, management documents the formal risk assessment, corporate-wide and specific to COMPANY  Pay, including risk mitigation strategies to manage the impact of identified risks.

controls.name: IA-12(5) - Identity Proofing | Address Confirmation
controls.title: Identity Proofing | Address Confirmation
controls.body: Require that a [Selection: registration code; notice of proofing] be delivered through an out-of-band channel to verify the users address (physical or digital) of record.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.3 - Measurement of AI System Performance for Deployment Settings
controls.title: Measurement of AI System Performance for Deployment Settings
controls.body: AI system performance or assurance criteria are measured qualitatively or quantitatively and demonstrated for conditions similar to deployment setting(s). Measures are documented.

controls.name: D1.1.3 - Documentation of the syntax of the data
controls.title: Documentation of the syntax of the data
controls.body: Documentation of the syntax of the data

controls.name: D1.R.St.E.2 - Management Competence
controls.title: Management Competence
controls.body: Management with appropriate knowledge and experience leads the institution's cybersecurity efforts.

controls.name: IA-12(6) - Identity Proofing | Accept Externally-proofed Identities
controls.title: Identity Proofing | Accept Externally-proofed Identities
controls.body: Accept externally-proofed identities at [Assignment: organization-defined identity assurance level].

controls.name: PS-1 Personnel security policy and procedures
controls.title: PS-1 Personnel security policy and procedures
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Develops, documents, and disseminates to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
   1. A personnel security policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
   2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the personnel security policy and associated personnel security controls; and
 b. Reviews and updates the current:
   1. Personnel security policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; and
   2. Personnel security procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: GOVERN 4 - Committed Organizational Teams Addressing AI Risk Culture
controls.title: Committed Organizational Teams Addressing AI Risk Culture
controls.body: Organizational teams are committed to a culture that considers and communicates AI risk.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.5 - AI System Validity and Reliability
controls.title: AI System Validity and Reliability
controls.body: The AI system to be deployed is demonstrated to be valid and reliable. Limitations of the generalizability beyond the conditions under which the technology was developed are documented.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.6 - AI System Safety Evaluation
controls.title: AI System Safety Evaluation
controls.body: AI system is evaluated regularly for safety risks – as identified in the MAP function. The AI system to be deployed is demonstrated to be safe, its residual negative risk does not exceed the risk tolerance, and can fail safely, particularly if made to operate beyond its knowledge limits. Safety metrics implicate system reliability and robustness, real-time monitoring, and response times for AI system failures.

controls.name: CC6.7.1 - Usage of Removable Media
controls.title: CC6.7.1 - Usage of Removable Media
controls.body: Usage of removable media for members of the Entity team is restricted to registered devices and requires approval by management. When authorized, only encrypted removable media is allowed.

controls.name: OM8.0 - Corporate Ethics Notices
controls.title: OM8.0 - Corporate Ethics Notices
controls.body: Corporate Ethics Commitment Posters are posted on organization message boards.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.7 - Security and Resilience Evaluation
controls.title: Security and Resilience Evaluation
controls.body: AI system security and resilience – as identified in the MAP function – are evaluated and documented.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.8 - Transparency and Accountability Assessment
controls.title: Transparency and Accountability Assessment
controls.body: Risks associated with transparency and accountability – as identified in the MAP function – are examined and documented.

controls.name: CC3.2.2 - Regulatory and Technological Risk
controls.title: CC3.2.2 - Regulatory and Technological Risk
controls.body:
Included in the annual risk assessment, and ongoing risk management process, risk management personnel identify environmental, regulatory, and technological changes that have occurred. 

In response to the identification of such risks, management updates its policies, procedures, processes, and controls, as needed.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (4) - Written Description of Procedures
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (4) - Written Description of Procedures
controls.body:
A written description of the procedures that a parent may use to carry out the rights enumerated under Section 33.

* #### Your school maintains a written description of the procedures that a student or parent may obtain a copy of the information your school stores concerning that student.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (3)- List of Sbcontractors
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (3)- List of Sbcontractors
controls.body:
For each operator, a list of any subcontractors to whom covered information may be disclosed or a link to a page on the operator's website that clearly lists that information, as provided by the operator to the school under paragraph (6) of Section 15.

* #### Your school has an internal list of all subcontractors that obtains your student information from an operator of an internet website. 

* ####  Your school has an internal list of all subcontractors that obtains your student information from an operator of an online services. 

* #### Your school has an internal list of all subcontractors that obtains your student information from an operator of a mobile application.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.9 - Model Explanation and Validation
controls.title: Model Explanation and Validation
controls.body: The AI model is explained, validated, and documented, and AI system output is interpreted within its context – as identified in the MAP function – and to inform responsible use and governance.

controls.name: HS - Data Integrity (R)
controls.title: Data Integrity (R)
controls.body: Data integrity policy and the procedure have been established that provides guidelines to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.5.1 - Impact of Change Documentation
controls.title: Impact of Change Documentation
controls.body: Documentation of impact.

controls.name: RM1.1 - Risk Assessment Checklist
controls.title: RM1.1 - Risk Assessment Checklist
controls.body: A risk assessment process checklist is utilized to ensure security requirements are followed.

controls.name: IR-9(3) - Information Spillage Response | Post-spill Operations
controls.title: Information Spillage Response | Post-spill Operations
controls.body: Implement the following procedures to ensure that organizational personnel impacted by information spills can continue to carry out assigned tasks while contaminated systems are undergoing corrective actions: [Assignment: organization-defined procedures].

controls.name: §164.502(e) - Contracts with Third Parties (R)
controls.title: §164.502(e) - Contracts with Third Parties (R)
controls.body: Third-party contractors or vendors working on behalf of the organization and with access to ePHI are required to sign an agreement outlining the security, confidentiality and privacy requirements for protecting ePHI.

controls.name: C1.1.2 - Director of Compliance Responsibilities
controls.title: C1.1.2 - Director of Compliance Responsibilities
controls.body: The Director of Compliance is responsible for changes to confidentiality practices and commitments.  A formal process is used to communicate these changes to impacted users through customer service.

controls.name: §164.512(k)(2) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.title: §164.512(k)(2) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.512(k)(1) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions

controls.name: MEASURE.2.11 - Fairness and Bias Evaluation
controls.title: Fairness and Bias Evaluation
controls.body: Fairness and bias – as identified in the MAP function – is evaluated and results are documented.

controls.name: §164.514(g) - Uses and disclosures of PHI
controls.title: §164.514(g) - Uses and disclosures of PHI
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.502(a)1- §164.502(a)4 - Uses and disclosures of PHI

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.Int.3 - Critical Asset Security Monitoring
controls.title: Critical Asset Security Monitoring
controls.body: Specialized security monitoring is used for critical assets throughout the infrastructure.

controls.name: AC9.12 - Server Clock Synchronization
controls.title: AC9.12 - Server Clock Synchronization
controls.body: The clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organization or security domain are synchronized to a single reference time source.

controls.category: Data Protection By Design And By Default
controls.name: Art. 49 - Data protection by design and by default
controls.title: Data protection by design and by default
controls.body: "The systems used for processing personal data shall be structured in order to meet the security requirements, standards of good practices and governance, general principles provided in this Law and other regulatory rules" (LGPD Art. 49, unofficial translation)

controls.name: AC9.14 - Server System Configuration Backups
controls.title: AC9.14 - Server System Configuration Backups
controls.body:
Servers and hosts that contain critical and sensitive information are backed up periodically. The software system settings and data backups are systematically scheduled based on backup policies and procedures. 
Alerts are configured to report to IT operations the status of completed backups.

controls.name: CP-4 (1) Contingency plan testing | coordinate with related plans
controls.title: CP-4 (1) Contingency plan testing | coordinate with related plans
controls.body: The organization coordinates contingency plan testing with organizational elements responsible for related plans.

controls.name: MEASURE.3.2 - Alternate AI Risk Tracking Approaches
controls.title: Alternate AI Risk Tracking Approaches
controls.body: Risk tracking approaches are considered for settings where AI risks are difficult to assess using currently available measurement techniques or where metrics are not yet available.

controls.name: AC-2 (12) Account management | account monitoring / atypical usage
controls.title: AC-2 (12) Account management | account monitoring / atypical usage
controls.body:
The organization:
 (a) Monitors information system accounts for [Assignment: organization-defined atypical use]; and
 (b) Reports atypical usage of information system accounts to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: PCI 8.1.1 - Assignment of Unique ID
controls.title: Assignment of Unique ID
controls.body: Assign all users a unique ID before allowing them to access system components or cardholder data.

controls.name: 10.4.3 - Reviewing and monitoring - 3
controls.title: Reviewing and monitoring - 3
controls.body: You undertake trend analysis on breach reports over time to understand themes or issues, and outputs are reviewed by groups with oversight for data protection and information governance.

controls.name: PCI 1.1 - Firewall and Router Configuration
controls.title: PCI 1.1 - Firewall and Router Configuration
controls.body:
Establish and implement firewall and router configuration standards that include the following:

- 1.1.1  A formal process for approving and testing all network connections and changes to the firewall and router configurations
- 1.1.2  Current network diagram that identifies all connections between the cardholder data environment and other networks, including any wireless networks
- 1.1.3  Current diagram that shows all cardholder data flows across systems and networks
- 1.1.4  Requirements for a firewall at each Internet connection and between any demilitarized zone (DMZ) and the internal network zone
- 1.1.5  Description of groups, roles, and responsibilities for management of network components
- 1.1.6  Documentation of business justification and approval for use of all services, protocols, and ports allowed, including documentation of security features implemented for those protocols considered to be insecure.
- 1.1.7  Requirement to review firewall and router rule sets at least every six months

controls.name: MEASURE.3.3 - Feedback Integration into AI Evaluation Metrics
controls.title: Feedback Integration into AI Evaluation Metrics
controls.body: Feedback processes for end users and impacted communities to report problems and appeal system outcomes are established and integrated into AI system evaluation metrics.

controls.name: §164.508(a)(1-3) and §164.508(b)(1-2) - Consent for Uses and Disclosure
controls.title: §164.508(a)(1-3) and §164.508(b)(1-2) - Consent for Uses and Disclosure
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.506(b) - (b)(1) and (b)(2) - Consent for Uses and Disclosure

controls.name: A.14.2.4 - Restrictions on Changes to Software Packages
controls.title: Restrictions on Changes to Software Packages
controls.body: Modifications to software packages shall be discouraged, limited to necessary changes and all changes shall be strictly controlled.

controls.name: PCI 9.6.1 - Media Classification
controls.title: Media Classification
controls.body: Classify media so the sensitivity of the data can be determined.

controls.name: CP-6 Alternate storage site
controls.title: CP-6 Alternate storage site
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Establishes an alternate storage site including necessary agreements to permit the storage and retrieval of information system backup information; and
 b. Ensures that the alternate storage site provides information security safeguards equivalent to that of the primary site.

controls.name: §164.524(d) (2) - Rights of Individuals
controls.title: §164.524(d) (2) - Rights of Individuals
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.522(a)(1) - Rights of Individuals

controls.name: SSPA36 - Mobile Device Policy
controls.title: SSPA36 - Mobile Device Policy
controls.body: The organization has defined, communicated and implemented a mobile device policy that secures and limits the use of Microsoft Personal or Confidential Data accessed or used on a mobile device.

controls.name: SA.4.173 - Indicators of Compromise (IOC)
controls.title: SA.4.173 - Indicators of Compromise (IOC)
controls.body: Design network and system security capabilities to leverage, integrate and share Indicators of Compromise (IoC).

controls.name: Art. 38 - Data protection impact assessment
controls.title: Data protection impact assessment
controls.body:
"The national authority may determine that the controller must prepare a data
protection impact assessment, which shall include personal data, sensitive data, and refer to its data processing operations, pursuant to regulations, subject to commercial and industrial secrecy" (LGPD Art. 38, unofficial translation)

controls.name: Clause 6.3 - Plan Changes to BCMS
controls.title: Clause 6.3 - Plan Changes to BCMS

controls.name: CC7.5.1 - Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery Program
controls.title: CC7.5.1 - Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery Program
controls.body: The Entity has developed a Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery program.  The business continuity program enables an appropriate level of preparedness for a disruptive incident, as well as compliance with regulatory guidelines. The Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery plan, tested annually, are updated as necessary based on testing results.

controls.name: Art. 39 - Processing instructions
controls.title: Processing instructions
controls.body: "The processor shall carry out the processing according to the instructions provided by the controller, which shall verify the obedience of her/his own instructions and of the rules applicable to the subject and the situation at hand" (LGPD Art. 39, unofficial translation)

controls.name: MEASURE.4.3 - Performance Variations Based on Community and Field Data
controls.title: Performance Variations Based on Community and Field Data
controls.body: Measurable performance improvements or declines based on consultations with relevant AI actors including affected communities, and field data about context-relevant risks and trustworthiness characteristics, are identified and documented.

controls.name: CM-10 (1) Software usage restrictions | open source software
controls.title: CM-10 (1) Software usage restrictions | open source software
controls.body: The organization establishes the following restrictions on the use of open source software: [Assignment: organization-defined restrictions].

controls.title: Risk Assessment of ePHI (R)
controls.body: Management performs a formal risk assessment to identify potential risks and vulnerabilities related to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of PHI (including electronic) on an annual basis or in the event of significant changes. Identified risks, along with mitigation strategies, are documented and implemented by the organization's management.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.4 - Audit Logs for Invalid Login Attempts
controls.title: Audit Logs for Invalid Login Attempts
controls.body: Invalid logical access attempts.

controls.name: Clause 7.2 - Competence
controls.title: Competence

controls.name: CA-7 (1) Continuous monitoring | independent assessment
controls.title: CA-7 (1) Continuous monitoring | independent assessment
controls.body: The organization employs assessors or assessment teams with [Assignment: organization-defined level of independence] to monitor the security controls in the information system on an ongoing basis.

controls.name: SI-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of System and Information Integrity Activities
controls.title: SI-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of System and Information Integrity Activities
controls.body: Review and measure System and Information Integrity (SI) activities for effectiveness.

controls.title: Clause 7.3 - Awareness

controls.title: AC-6 (5) Least privilege | privileged accounts
controls.body:
The organization restricts privileged accounts on the information system to [Assignment:
organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.B.4 - Security Awareness for Customers
controls.title: Security Awareness for Customers
controls.body: Customer awareness materials are readily available (e.g., DHS’ Cybersecurity Awareness Month materials). (FFIEC E-Banking Work Program, Objective 6-3)

controls.name: Art. 41 - Data protection officer
controls.title: Data protection officer
controls.body: "The controller shall appoint a data protection officer to be in charge of processing personal data" (LGPD Art. 41, unofficial translation)

controls.name: MANAGE.1.4 - Residual Risk Assessment
controls.title: Residual Risk Assessment
controls.body: Negative residual risks (defined as the sum of all unmitigated risks) to both downstream acquirers of AI systems and end users are documented.

controls.title: Clause 8.4.2.4 - Response structure - Team Function

controls.title: Clause 8.4.2.3 - Response Structure - Competence

controls.title: Data Flow Diagram
controls.body: Current diagram that shows all cardholder data flows across systems and networks

controls.name: 1.1 Setting purpose
controls.title: 1.1 Setting purpose
controls.body:
The company’s stated purpose, as the expression of the means by which a business proposes solutions to economic, environmental and social issues. Corporate purpose should create value for all stakeholders, including shareholders.

Rationale:
Oversight of a company’s chosen priorities in terms of economic, environmental and social issues requires a clear understanding and articulation of the firm’s purpose. The more that firms can link their purpose and core business, the better they can deliver long-term value for all stakeholders, including shareholders.

Additional commentary:
There is emerging evidence that purpose-led firms outperform their peers in terms of shareholder value32 and are better positioned to account for and deliver economic, environmental and social value.

This disclosure calls for the articulation of the output of a process to formulate and publicize a purpose, providing a useful baseline for whether firms are pursuing purpose or not. This disclosure was selected over alternatives, including measures of investment aligned to purpose and the extent to which culture is aligned to purpose, to reflect the primary need that still exists to comprehensively articulate purpose and its link to economic, environmental and social value and long-term value creation. It is fundamental to purpose-led outcomes, helps establish comparability across businesses and is the essential first step in becoming a purpose-led business.

Purpose should define how a company creates value by addressing solutions to economic, environmental and social issues, and ensures that it is not profiting from creating problems in these domains.

Sources:
The British Academy and Colin Mayer,
GRI 102-26,
Embankment Project for Inclusive Capitalism (EPIC) and others
