controls.name: AC-4(20) - Information Flow Enforcement | Approved Solutions
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Approved Solutions
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined solutions in approved configurations] to control the flow of [Assignment: organization-defined information] across security domains.

controls.name: CAN 5.5.2.3 - Password Policies
controls.title: Password Policies
controls.body: The organization shall have clear policies on password length and reuse, the use of password managers and if, when, and how users can physically write down and securely store a password.

controls.name: CAN 5.5.3.1 - Password Manager
controls.title: Password Manager
controls.body: The organization shall implement a password manager or document the business decision not to do so.

controls.name: CAN 5.6.2.2 - Backup and Recovery Requirements
controls.title: Backup and Recovery Requirements
controls.body: The organization shall determine on a case-by-case basis what systems to back up and at what frequency since every system will have different back-up and recovery requirements.

controls.name: 3.2.3 - Explicit consent for sensitive Information
controls.title: Explicit consent for sensitive Information
controls.body: Explicit consent is obtained directly from the individual when sensitive personal information is collected, used, or disclosed, unless a law or regulation specifically requires otherwise .

controls.name: 3.2.4 - Consent for online data transfers to or from an Individual’s computer or other similar electronic devices
controls.title: Consent for online data transfers to or from an Individual’s computer or other similar electronic devices
controls.body: Consent is obtained before personal information is transferred to/ from an individual’s computer or similar device

controls.name: IR-4(14) - Incident Handling | Security Operations Center
controls.title: Incident Handling | Security Operations Center
controls.body: Establish and maintain a security operations center.

controls.name: CAN 5.6.2.3 - Backup of Systems with Essential Business Information
controls.title: Backup of Systems with Essential Business Information
controls.body: The organization shall backup systems that contain essential business information and ensure that recovery mechanisms effectively and efficiently restore these systems from backups.

controls.name: CAN 5.6.2.4 - Offsite Backup Location
controls.title: Offsite Backup Location
controls.body: The organization shall store backups at a secure offsite location (either physically or via network separated cloud services) at regular intervals to provide diversity in the event of a disaster (fire, flood, earthquake or localized cyber security incident).

controls.name: 4.0.0 - Collection
controls.title: Collection
controls.body: The entity collects personal information only for the purposes identified in the notice.

controls.name: 4.1.0 - Privacy Policies
controls.title: Privacy Policies
controls.body: The entity’s privacy policies address the collection of personal information .

controls.name: CAN 5.7.3.1 - Perimeter Firewall
controls.title: Perimeter Firewall
controls.body: The organization shall have a firewall placed between two perimeters that controls the amount and kinds of traffic that may pass between the two.

controls.name: CAN 5.7.3.2 - DNS Firewall
controls.title: DNS Firewall
controls.body: The organization should consider implementing a DNS firewall for outbound DNS requests to the Internet.

controls.name: CAN 5.7.3.4 - Encrypted and VPN Connectivity
controls.title: Encrypted and VPN Connectivity
controls.body: The organization shall require encrypted connectivity to all corporate IT resources and require VPN connectivity with multi-factor authentication for all remote access into corporate networks.

controls.name: AC-11 (1) Session lock | pattern-hiding displays
controls.title: AC-11 (1) Session lock | pattern-hiding displays
controls.body: The information system conceals, via the session lock, information previously visible on the display with a publicly viewable image.

controls.name: RM.3.144 - Annual Risk Assessment and Mitigation
controls.title: RM.3.144 - Annual Risk Assessment and Mitigation
controls.body: Periodically perform risk assessments to identify and prioritize risks according to the defined risk categories, risk sources and risk measurement criteria.

controls.name: CAN 5.7.3.5 - Secure Wi-Fi Connections
controls.title: Secure Wi-Fi Connections
controls.body: The organization shall use secure Wi-Fi, at a minimum WPA2-AES, preferably WPA2-Enterprise or WPA3-Enterprise, following password requirements as defined in control # CAN 5.5.2.1, CAN 5.5.2.2, CAN 5.5.2.3 and CAN 5.5.3.1.

controls.name: CAN 5.7.3.8 - Email Filtering
controls.title: Email Filtering
controls.body: The organization shall ensure email filtering is implemented.

controls.name: IR-9(4) - Information Spillage Response | Exposure to Unauthorized Personnel
controls.title: Information Spillage Response | Exposure to Unauthorized Personnel
controls.body: Employ the following controls for personnel exposed to information not within assigned access authorizations: [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.name: A.11.1.4 - Protecting against External and Environmental Threats
controls.title: Protecting against External and Environmental Threats
controls.body: Physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attack or accidents shall be designed and applied.

controls.name: PCI 3.5 - Key Protection Procedures
controls.title: Key Protection Procedures
controls.body: Document and implement procedures to protect keys used to secure stored cardholder data against disclosure and misuse:Note:This requirement applies to keys used to encrypt stored cardholder data, and also applies to key-encrypting keys used to protect data-encrypting keys—such key- encrypting keys must be at least as strong as the data-encrypting key.

controls.name: PCI 10.5 - Secure Audit Trail
controls.title: Secure Audit Trail
controls.body: Secure audit trails so they cannot be altered.

controls.name: CAN 5.8.3.1 - Restricting Access Privileges to Minimum
controls.title: Restricting Access Privileges to Minimum
controls.body: The organization shall provision accounts with the minimum functionality necessary for tasks and shall restrict administrator privileges to an as-required basis.

controls.name: CAN 6.1.3.1 - Ownership Model for Mobile Devices
controls.title: Ownership Model for Mobile Devices
controls.body: The organization using mobility (i.e., cellphones) shall decide on an ownership model for mobile devices and document the rationale and associated risks.

controls.name: SSPA27 - Detection of Unauthorized Data Use
controls.title: SSPA27 - Detection of Unauthorized Data Use
controls.body: The organization reviews complaints about indications of any unauthorized or Unlawful Processing of Microsoft Personal Data.

controls.name: PCI 8.8 - Procedures for Identification and Authentication Management
controls.title: Procedures for Identification and Authentication Management
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for identification and authentication are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: A.17.1.3 - Verify, Review and Evaluate Information Security Continuity
controls.title: Verify, Review and Evaluate Information Security Continuity
controls.body: The organization shall verify the established and implemented information security continuity controls at regular intervals in order to ensure that they are valid and effective during adverse situations.

controls.name: CAN 6.2.2.1 - Evaluation of Risk Tolerance for IT Service Providers
controls.title: Evaluation of Risk Tolerance for IT Service Providers
controls.body: Organization using cloud applications and/or outsourcing IT services shall evaluate their risk tolerance level with how their outsourced IT providers handle and access their sensitive information.

controls.name: CAN 6.3.3.1 - OWASP Vulnerabilities
controls.title: OWASP Vulnerabilities
controls.body: The organization deploying websites shall ensure that their websites address the OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities.

controls.name: IR-7(2) - Incident Response Assistance | Coordination with External Providers
controls.title: Incident Response Assistance | Coordination with External Providers
controls.body:
a. Establish a direct, cooperative relationship between its incident response capability and external providers of system protection capability; and
b. Identify organizational incident response team members to the external providers.

controls.name: 4.1.1 - Communication to Individuals
controls.title: Communication to Individuals
controls.body: Individuals are informed that personal information is collected only for the purposes identified in the notice

controls.name: M50.27 - Cross-tenant logging of administration
controls.title: Cross-tenant logging of administration
controls.body: Cross-tenant logging of administration

controls.name: CAN 6.4.3.1 - Secure Usage of Portable Media
controls.title: Secure Usage of Portable Media
controls.body:
The organization using portable media shall:
a. have strong asset controls for these devices;
b. require the use of encryption on all of these devices; and
c. have processes for the sanitization or destruction of portable media prior to disposal.

controls.name: PCI 11.1 - Test Wireless Access Points
controls.title: Test Wireless Access Points
controls.body:
Implement processes to test for the presence of wireless access points (802.11), and detect and identify all authorized and unauthorized wireless access points on a quarterly basis.

Note:Methods that may be used in the process include but are not limited to wireless network scans, physical/logical inspections of system components and infrastructure, network access control (NAC), or wireless IDS/IPS.Whichever methods are used, they must be sufficient to detect and identify both authorized and unauthorized devices.

controls.name: CAN 6.6.3.1 - Log Management Policy
controls.title: Log Management Policy
controls.body: The organization shall ensure an appropriate understanding of their security logging capabilities and needs and ensure a corresponding log management policy is in place.

controls.name: PCI 8.7 - Access Restriction to Database
controls.title: Access Restriction to Database
controls.body:
All access to any database containing cardholder data (including access by applications, administrators, and all other users) is restricted as follows:
- All user access to, user queries of, and user actions on databases are through programmatic methods.
- Only database administrators have the ability to directly access or query databases.·Application IDs for database applications can only be used by the applications (and not by individual users or other non-application processes).

controls.name: 4.1.2 - Types of Personal Information collected and Methods of collectio
controls.title: Types of Personal Information collected and Methods of collectio
controls.body: The types of personal information collected and the methods of collection, including the use of cookies or other tracking techniques, are documented and described in the privacy notice .

controls.name: 4.2.1 - Collection limited to Identified Purpose
controls.title: Collection limited to Identified Purpose
controls.body: The collection of personal information is limited to that necessary for the purposes identified in the notice .

controls.name: GOVERN.1.2 - Trustworthy Characteristics Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Trustworthy Characteristics Policies and Procedures
controls.body: The characteristics of trustworthy AI are integrated into organizational policies, processes, and procedures.

controls.name: A.17.1.2 - Implementing Information Security Continuity
controls.title: Implementing Information Security Continuity
controls.body: The organization shall establish, document, implement and maintain processes, procedures and controls to ensure the required level of continuity for information security during an adverse situation.

controls.name: PCI 10.4.3 - Time Settings and Synchronization
controls.title: Time Settings and Synchronization
controls.body: Time settings are received from industry-accepted time sources.

controls.name: A.17.1.1 - Planning Information Security Continuity
controls.title: Planning Information Security Continuity
controls.body: The organization shall determine its requirements for information security and the continuity of information security management in adverse situations, e.g. during a crisis or disaster.

controls.name: SA-4(1) - Acquisition Process | Functional Properties of Controls
controls.title: Acquisition Process | Functional Properties of Controls
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to provide a description of the functional properties of the controls to be implemented.

controls.name: A.18.2.2 - Compliance with Security Policies and Standards
controls.title: Compliance with Security Policies and Standards
controls.body: Managers shall regularly review the compliance of information processing and procedures within their area of responsibility with the appropriate security policies, standards and any other security requirements.

controls.name: AOM3.6 - Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: AOM3.6 - Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities of key personnel with responsibility for the security of the system are defined in written job descriptions and communicated to relevant personnel.

controls.name: PCI 10.5.2 - Unauthorized Modifications of Audit Logs
controls.title: Unauthorized Modifications of Audit Logs
controls.body: Protect audit trail files from unauthorized modifications.

controls.name: D3.PC.De.E.2 - Automated Blocking of Unauthorized Network Access
controls.title: Automated Blocking of Unauthorized Network Access
controls.body: Tools automatically block attempted access by unregistered devices to internal networks.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.Inn.2 - Asset Controls Based on Risk Scores
controls.title: Asset Controls Based on Risk Scores
controls.body: Automated controls are put in place based on risk scores to infrastructure assets, including automatically disconnecting affected assets.

controls.name: PE-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] physical and environmental protection policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the physical and environmental protection policy and the associated physical and environmental protection controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the physical and environmental protection policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current physical and environmental protection:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: PCI 9.8 - Media Destruction
controls.title: Media Destruction
controls.body: Destroy media when it is no longer needed for business or legal reasons.

controls.name: PCI 7.1 - Access to Cardholder Data
controls.title: Access to Cardholder Data
controls.body: Limit access to system components and cardholder data to only those individuals whose job requires such access.

controls.name: PCI 10.5.5 - File Integrity Monitoring
controls.title: File Integrity Monitoring
controls.body: Use file-integrity monitoring or change-detection software on logs to ensure that existing log data cannot be changed without generating alerts (although new data being added should not cause an alert).

controls.name: PCI 12.11.1 - Security Compliance Reviews for Service Providers
controls.title: Security Compliance Reviews for Service Providers
controls.body:
Additional requirement for service providers only:
- Maintain documentation of quarterly review process to include:
- Documenting results of the reviews.
- Review and sign-off of results by personnel assigned responsibility for the PCI DSS compliance program.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.A.2 - Resolution of Conflicting Information
controls.title: Resolution of Conflicting Information
controls.body: Formal processes have been defined to resolve potential conflicts in information received from sharing and analysis centers or other sources.

controls.name: PR.MA-2 - Remote Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.title: Remote Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.body: Remote maintenance of organizational assets is approved, logged, and performed in a manner that prevents unauthorized access

controls.name: PL-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] planning policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the planning policy and the associated planning controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the planning policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current planning:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: A.12.1.4 - Separation of Development, Testing and Operational Environments
controls.title: Separation of Development, Testing and Operational Environments
controls.body: Development, testing, and operational environments shall be separated to reduce the risks of unauthorized access or changes to the operational environment.

controls.name: PI6 - Logging of Sensitive Information
controls.title: Logging of Sensitive Information
controls.body: The organization logs changes to sensitive data in the production environment so all modifications can be tracked and rolled back if necessary.

controls.name: Clause 6.1.2 - Information Security Risk Assessment Process
controls.title: Information Security Risk Assessment Process

controls.name: PCI A1 - Protection of the Hosted Environment and Data of Each Entity
controls.title: Protection of the Hosted Environment and Data of Each Entity
controls.body:
Protect each entity’s (that is, merchant, service provider, or other entity) hosted environment and data, per A.1.1 through A.1.4: 

A hosting provider must fulfill these requirements as well as all other relevant sections of the PCI DSS. 

Note: Even though a hosting provider may meet these requirements, the compliance of the entity that uses the 
hosting provider is not guaranteed. Each entity must comply with the PCI DSS and validate compliance as applicable.

controls.name: PM-1 - Information Security Program Plan
controls.title: Information Security Program Plan

controls.name: PCI 10.6.1 - Daily Log Review
controls.title: Daily Log Review
controls.body:
Review the following at least daily:
- All security events.
- Logs of all system components that store, process, or transmit CHD and/or SAD.
- Logs of all critical system components.
- Logs of all servers and system components that perform security functions (for example, firewalls, intrusion-detection systems/intrusion-prevention systems (IDS/IPS), authentication servers, e-commerce redirection servers, etc.).

controls.name: MA-MC-ML.2.999 - Maintenance Policy
controls.title: MA-MC-ML.2.999 - Maintenance Policy
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes Maintenance (MA).

controls.name: PCI 8.1.5 - Third Party Access IDs
controls.title: Third Party Access IDs
controls.body:
Manage IDs used by third parties to access, support, or maintain system components via remote access as follows:
- Enabled only during the time period needed and disabled when not in use.
- Monitored when in use."

controls.name: DP13 - Privacy Policy
controls.title: Privacy Policy
controls.body: The organization has a privacy policy published on its website which outlines privacy commitments in accordance with local laws and regulations and is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: D3.PC.De.E.1 - Automated Blocking of Unauthorized Devices
controls.title: Automated Blocking of Unauthorized Devices
controls.body: Tools automatically block attempted access from unpatched employee and third-party devices.

controls.name: D3.PC.De.E.4 - Access Control - Downloading Confidential Data
controls.title: Access Control - Downloading Confidential Data
controls.body: Controls are in place to prevent unauthorized individuals from copying confidential data to removable media.

controls.name: 4.2.3 - Collection from third Parties
controls.title: Collection from third Parties
controls.body: Management confirms that third parties from whom personal information is collected (that is, sources other than the individual) are reliable sources that collect information fairly and lawfully

controls.name: 4.2.4 - Information developed About Individuals
controls.title: Information developed About Individuals
controls.body: Individuals are informed if the entity develops or acquires additional information about them for its use .

controls.name: M42.04 - Decisions regarding the medium of the documentation (paper/electronic file/database)
controls.title: Decisions regarding the medium of the documentation (paper/electronic file/database)
controls.body: Decisions regarding the medium of the documentation (paper/electronic file/database)

controls.name: GOVERN 6 - AI Supply Chain Policies and Procedures
controls.title: AI Supply Chain Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Policies and procedures are in place to address AI risks and benefits arising from third-party software and data and other supply chain issues.

controls.name: MAP 1 - Established Context
controls.title: Established Context
controls.body: Context is established and understood.

controls.name: M50.28 - Tenant-specific and cross-tenant notification system
controls.title: Tenant-specific and cross-tenant notification system
controls.body: Tenant-specific and cross-tenant notification system

controls.name: ID.IM-P6 - Inventory of Data Elements
controls.title: Inventory of Data Elements
controls.body: Data elements within the data actions are inventoried.

controls.name: ID.IM-P3 - Inventory of Categories of Individuals
controls.title: Inventory of Categories of Individuals
controls.body: Categories of individuals (e.g., customers, employees or prospective employees, consumers) whose data are being processed are inventoried.

controls.name: ID.BE-P1 - Organizational Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Organizational Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: The organization’s role(s) in the data processing ecosystem are identified and communicated.

controls.name: 5.0.0 - Use, Retention and Disposal
controls.title: Use, Retention and Disposal
controls.body:
The entity limits the use of personal information to the purposes identified in the notice and for which the individual has provided implicit or explicit
 consent. The entity retains personal information for only as long as necessary to fulfill the stated purposes or as required by law or regulations and
 thereafter appropriately disposes of such information.

controls.name: 5.1.0 - Privacy Policies
controls.title: Privacy Policies
controls.body: The entity’s privacy policies address the use, retention, and disposal of personal information .

controls.name: ID.BE-P2 - Organizational Privacy Objectives
controls.title: Organizational Privacy Objectives
controls.body: Priorities for organizational mission, objectives, and activities are established and communicated.

controls.name: ID.BE-P3 - Critical Systems, Products and Services
controls.title: Critical Systems, Products and Services
controls.body: Systems/products/services that support organizational priorities are identified and key requirements communicated.

controls.name: ID.RA-P2 - Identifying and Evaluating Data Bias
controls.title: Identifying and Evaluating Data Bias
controls.body: Data analytic inputs and outputs are identified and evaluated for bias.

controls.name: M42.05 - Decisions regarding an up-to-date backup of the documentation for emergencies
controls.title: Decisions regarding an up-to-date backup of the documentation for emergencies
controls.body: Decisions regarding an up-to-date backup of the documentation that needs to be available in emergencies

controls.name: ID.DE-P2 - Data Processing Ecosystem Parties
controls.title: Data Processing Ecosystem Parties
controls.body: Data processing ecosystem parties (e.g., service providers, customers, partners, product manufacturers, application developers) are identified, prioritized, and assessed using a privacy risk assessment process.

controls.name: 5.1.1 - Communication to Individual
controls.title: Communication to Individual
controls.body: Individuals are informed that personal information is (a) used only for the purposes identified in the notice and only if the individual has provided implicit or explicit consent, unless a law or regulation specifically requires otherwise, (b) retained for no longer than necessary to fulfill the stated purposes, or for a period specifically required by law or regulation, and (c) disposed of in a manner that prevents loss, theft, misuse or unauthorized access .

controls.name: ID.DE-P3 - Contracts With Data Processing Ecosystem Parties
controls.title: Contracts With Data Processing Ecosystem Parties
controls.body: Contracts with data processing ecosystem parties are used to implement appropriate measures designed to meet the objectives of an organization’s privacy program.

controls.name: PE-4 Access control for transmission medium
controls.title: PE-4 Access control for transmission medium
controls.body: The organization controls physical access to [Assignment: organization-defined information system distribution and transmission lines] within organizational facilities using [Assignment: organization-defined security safeguards].

controls.name: MP-6 (2) Media sanitization | equipment testing
controls.title: MP-6 (2) Media sanitization | equipment testing
controls.body: The organization tests sanitization equipment and procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to verify that the intended sanitization is being achieved.

controls.name: ID.DE-P4 - Use of Interoperability Frameworks
controls.title: Use of Interoperability Frameworks
controls.body: Interoperability frameworks or similar multi-party approaches are used to manage data processing ecosystem privacy risks.

controls.name: GV.PO-P2 - Privacy Values Integration in Development and Operations
controls.title: Privacy Values Integration in Development and Operations
controls.body: Processes to instill organizational privacy values within system/product/service development and operations are established and in place.

controls.name: GV.RM-P1 - Risk Management Processes
controls.title: Risk Management Processes
controls.body: Risk management processes are established, managed, and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.

controls.name: GV.PO-P3 - Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for the workforce are established with respect to privacy.

controls.name: GV.PO-P4 - Coordination of Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Coordination of Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Privacy roles and responsibilities are coordinated and aligned with third-party stakeholders (e.g., service providers, customers, partners).

controls.name: GV.PO-P6 - Privacy Risk Governance and Management
controls.title: Privacy Risk Governance and Management
controls.body: Governance and risk management policies, processes, and procedures address privacy risks.

controls.name: GV.RM-P3 - Risk Tolerance Based on Data Processing Ecosystem
controls.title: Risk Tolerance Based on Data Processing Ecosystem
controls.body: The organization’s determination of risk tolerance is informed by its role(s) in the data processing ecosystem.

controls.name: GV.AT-P1 - Workforce Awareness Training
controls.title: Workforce Awareness Training
controls.body: The workforce is informed and trained on its roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: GV.AT-P3 - Privacy Personnel Awareness Training
controls.title: Privacy Personnel Awareness Training
controls.body: Privacy personnel understand their roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: 5.2.1 - Use of Personal Information
controls.title: Use of Personal Information
controls.body: Personal information is used only for the purposes identified in the notice and only if the individual has provided implicit or explicit consent, unless a law or regulation specifically requires otherwise .

controls.name: 3.0.0 - Choice and Consent
controls.title: Choice and Consent
controls.body:
The entity describes the choices available to the individual and obtains implicit or explicit consent with respect to the collection, use, and
 disclosure of personal information.

controls.name: 3.1.0 - Privacy Policies
controls.title: Privacy Policies
controls.body: The entity’s privacy policies address the choices to individuals and the consent to be obtained

controls.name: GV.AT-P4 - Third-party Stakeholders Responsibilities
controls.title: Third-party Stakeholders Responsibilities
controls.body: Third parties (e.g., service providers, customers, partners) understand their roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: GV.MT-P2 - Privacy Policy and Training Review and Communication
controls.title: Privacy Policy and Training Review and Communication
controls.body: Privacy values, policies, and training are reviewed and any updates are communicated.

controls.name: GV.MT-P3 - Privacy Compliance Review
controls.title: Privacy Compliance Review
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures for assessing compliance with legal requirements and privacy policies are established and in place.

controls.name: CC1.4.2 - Training Commitment
controls.title: CC1.4.2 - Training Commitment
controls.body: Management establishes requisite skillsets for personnel and provides continued training about its commitments and requirements for personnel.

controls.name: 8.8 - Management of Technical Vulnerabilities (27017)
controls.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities (27017)
controls.body: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization’s exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.

controls.name: GV.MT-P7 - Privacy Complaints Procedures
controls.title: Privacy Complaints Procedures
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures for receiving, tracking, and responding to complaints, concerns, and questions from individuals about organizational privacy practices are established and in place.

controls.name: GV.MT-P6 - Lessons Learned from Problematic Data Actions
controls.title: Lessons Learned from Problematic Data Actions
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures incorporate lessons learned from problematic data actions.

controls.name: CT.DM-P1 - Data Element Accessibility for Review
controls.title: Data Element Accessibility for Review
controls.body: Data elements can be accessed for review.

controls.category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, and Procedures
controls.name: CT.PO-P2 - Data Lifecycle Management Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Data Lifecycle Management Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures for enabling data review, transfer, sharing or disclosure, alteration, and deletion are established and in place (e.g., to maintain data quality, manage data retention).

controls.category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, and Procedures
controls.name: CT.PO-P4 - Data Lifecycle Integration with System Development
controls.title: Data Lifecycle Integration with System Development
controls.body: A data life cycle to manage data is aligned and implemented with the system development life cycle to manage systems.

controls.name: 10.1.3 - Detecting, managing and recording incidents and breaches - 3
controls.title: Detecting, managing and recording incidents and breaches - 3
controls.body: Staff know how to escalate a security incident promptly to the appropriate person or team to determine whether a breach has occurred.

controls.name: 3.1.1 - Communication to Individual
controls.title: Communication to Individual
controls.body: Individuals are informed about (a) the choices available to them with respect to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information, and (b) that implicit or explicit consent is required to collect, use, and disclose personal information, unless a law or regulation specifically requires or allows otherwise .

controls.name: 6.2.6 - Statement of disagreement
controls.title: Statement of disagreement
controls.body: Individuals are informed, in writing, about the reason a request for correction of personal information was denied, and how they may appeal .

controls.name: 7.0.0 - Disclosure to Third Parties
controls.title: Disclosure to Third Parties
controls.body:
The entity discloses personal information to third parties only for the purposes identified in the notice and with the implicit or explicit consent of the
 individual.

controls.name: CT.DM-P2 - Data Element Accessibility for Transmission or Disclosure
controls.title: Data Element Accessibility for Transmission or Disclosure
controls.body: Data elements can be accessed for transmission or disclosure.

controls.name: CT.DM-P5 - Destruction of Data
controls.title: Destruction of Data
controls.body: Data are destroyed according to policy.

controls.name: CT.DM-P6 - Transmission of Data
controls.title: Transmission of Data
controls.body: Data are transmitted using standardized formats.

controls.name: T.2.2.4 - Key Update
controls.title: Key Update
controls.body: A) The keys shall be updated in due time according to the key management policy.

controls.name: SO3.2 - Bug Bounty
controls.title: SO3.2 - Bug Bounty
controls.body: A managed bug bounty program for crowdsourced testing of your networks, applications and IoT devices is implemented.

controls.name: CT.DM-P9 - Technical Measures for Data Processing
controls.title: Technical Measures for Data Processing
controls.body: Technical measures implemented to manage data processing are tested and assessed.

controls.name: CT.DM-P10 - Privacy-Preserving Algorithmic Design
controls.title: Privacy-Preserving Algorithmic Design
controls.body: Stakeholder privacy preferences are included in algorithmic design objectives and outputs are evaluated against these preferences.

controls.name: CT.DP-P1 - Privacy-Preserving Data Processing
controls.title: Privacy-Preserving Data Processing

controls.body: Data are processed to limit the formulation of inferences about individuals’ behavior or activities (e.g., data processing is decentralized, distributed architectures).

controls.name: PCI 9.1 - Facility Entry Controls
controls.title: PCI 9.1 - Facility Entry Controls
controls.body:
Use appropriate facility entry controls to limit and monitor physical access to systems in the cardholder data environment.

- 9.1.1   Use either video cameras or access control mechanisms (or both) to monitor individual physical access to sensitive areas. Review collected data and correlate with other entries. Store for at least three months, unless otherwise restricted by law.

   Note: "Sensitive areas" refers to any data center, server room or any area that houses systems that store, process, or transmit cardholder data. This excludes public-facing areas where only point-of-sale terminals are present, such as the cashier areas in a retail store.

- 9.1.2   Implement physical and/or logical controls to restrict access to publicly accessible network jacks.
For example, network jacks located in public areas and areas accessible to visitors could be disabled and only enabled when network access is explicitly authorized. Alternatively, processes could be implemented to ensure that visitors are escorted at all times in areas with active network jacks.

- 9.1.3   Restrict physical access to wireless access points, gateways, handheld devices, networking/communications hardware, and telecommunication lines.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.A.4 - Resilience Testing Corrective Actions
controls.title: Resilience Testing Corrective Actions

controls.name: 7.1.0 - Privacy Policies

controls.name: PCI 9.2 - Visitor Access Procedure
controls.title: PCI 9.2 - Visitor Access Procedure
controls.body:
Develop procedures to easily distinguish between onsite personnel and visitors, to include:

- Changes to access requirements.
- Revoking or terminating onsite personnel and expired visitor identification (such as ID badges).

controls.name: CM.AW-P2 - Mechanisms for Feedback
controls.title: Mechanisms for Feedback

controls.title: Maintenance of Data Provenance and Lineage

controls.name: PCI 3.6 - Key Management Processes
controls.title: PCI 3.6 - Key Management Processes
controls.body:
Fully document and implement all key- management processes and procedures for cryptographic keys used for encryption of cardholder data, including the following:

Note: Numerous industry standards for key management are available from various resources including NIST, which can be found at http://csrc.nist.gov.

- 3.6.1   Generation of strong cryptographic keys
- 3.6.2   Secure cryptographic key distribution
- 3.6.3   Secure cryptographic key storage
- 3.6.4   Cryptographic key changes for keys that have reached the end of their cryptoperiod (for example, after a defined period of time has passed and/or after a certain amount of cipher-text has been produced by a given key), as defined by the associated application vendor or key owner, and based on industry best practices and guidelines (for example, NIST Special Publication 800-57).
- 3.6.5   Retirement or replacement (for example, archiving, destruction, and/or revocation) of keys as deemed necessary when the integrity of the key has been weakened (for example, departure of an employee with knowledge of a clear-text key component), or keys are suspected of being compromised.

    Note: If retired or replaced cryptographic keys need to be retained, these keys must be securely archived (for example, by using a key-encryption key). Archived cryptographic keys should only be used for decryption/verification purposes.

- 3.6.6   If manual clear-text cryptographic key-management operations are used, these operations must be managed using split knowledge and dual control.

   Note: Examples of manual key- management operations include, but are not limited to key generation, transmission, loading, storage and destruction.

- 3.6.7   Prevention of unauthorized substitution of cryptographic keys.
- 3.6.8   Requirement for cryptographic key custodians to formally acknowledge that they understand and accept their key- custodian responsibilities.

controls.name: PCI 2.2 - Configuration Standards for System Components
controls.title: PCI 2.2 - Configuration Standards for System Components
controls.body:
Develop configuration standards for all system components. Assure that these standards address all known security vulnerabilities and are consistent with industry-accepted system hardening standards.

Sources of industry-accepted system hardening standards may include, but are not limited to: 

- Center for Internet Security (CIS) 
- International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 
- SysAdmin Audit Network Security (SANS) 
- Institute National Institute of Standards Technology (NIST).
- 2.2.1  Implement only one primary function per server to prevent functions that require different security levels from co-existing on the same server. (For example, web servers, database servers, and DNS should be implemented on separate servers.)

Note: Where virtualization technologies are in use, implement only one primary function per virtual system component.

- 2.2.2  Enable only necessary services, protocols, daemons, etc., as required for the function of the system.
- 2.2.3  Implement additional security features for any required services, protocols, or daemons that are considered to be insecure.
- 2.2.4  Configure system security parameters to prevent misuse.
- 2.2.5  Remove all unnecessary functionality, such as scripts, drivers, features, subsystems, file systems, and unnecessary web servers.

controls.title: Software Integrity Checking Mechanisms

controls.title: SD1.4 - Regression Test Business Critical Applications

controls.title: Clause 8.4.2.2 - Response Structure - Roles and Responsibilities

controls.title: AIC13.3 - Error Detection and Correction

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Generation

controls.title: CP-8 (1) Telecommunications services | priority of service provisions
controls.body:
The organization:
 (a)   Develops primary and alternate telecommunications service agreements that contain priority- of-service provisions in accordance with organizational availability requirements (including recovery time objectives); and

controls.title: AIC4.24 - Authorized Disclosure

controls.title: Clause 8.4.4.1 - Business Continuity Plan and Procedure

controls.title: AAC11.6 - Authentication for Serverless Functions

controls.title: Budgeting Process for Cybersecurity Expenses
controls.body: Cybersecurity tools and staff are requested through the budget process.

controls.name: PR.PT-P1 - Protection of Removable Media
controls.title: Protection of Removable Media
controls.body: Removable media is protected and its use restricted according to policy.

controls.name: AC9.8 - Server Log Integrity
controls.title: AC9.8 - Server Log Integrity

controls.title: AU-8 (1) Time stamps | synchronization with authoritative time source
controls.body:
The information system:

 (b)   Synchronizes the internal system clocks to the authoritative time source when the time difference is greater than [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.title: CM-5 (1) Access restrictions for change | automated access enforcement / auditing

controls.title: Safeguard for Communications and Control Network

controls.title: IA-2 (2) Identification and authentication | network access to non-privileged accounts

controls.title: CP-2 Contingency plan

controls.name: PCI 7.1 - Access to Cardholder Data
controls.title: PCI 7.1 - Access to Cardholder Data
controls.body:

- 7.1.1   Define access needs for each role, including: 
   * System components and data resources that each role needs to access for their job function 
   * Level of privilege required (for example, user, administrator, etc.) for accessing resources.
- 7.1.2   Restrict access to privileged user IDs to least privileges necessary to perform job responsibilities.
- 7.1.3   Assign access based on individual personnel's job classification and function.
- 7.1.4   Require documented approval by authorized parties specifying required privileges.

a. Provide role-based security and privacy training to personnel with the following roles and responsibilities: [Assignment: organization-defined roles and responsibilities]:

1. Before authorizing access to the system, information, or performing assigned duties, and [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] thereafter; and

c. Incorporate lessons learned from internal or external security incidents or breaches into role-based training.

The organization:
 (a)   Reviews the information system [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to identify unnecessary and/or nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and services; and
 (b)   Disables [Assignment: organization-defined functions, ports, protocols, and services within the information system deemed to be unnecessary and/or nonsecure].

controls.name: OM2.8 - Consumer Services Pricing Practices
controls.title: OM2.8 - Consumer Services Pricing Practices
controls.body: Provide the same level of service and pricing to all consumers regardless of their data rights choices.

controls.name: Clause 8.4.4.3 -  Business Continuity Plan Details
controls.title: Clause 8.4.4.3 -  Business Continuity Plan Details

controls.name: §164.512(k)(6) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.title: §164.512(k)(6) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.512(k)(1) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions

controls.name: MP-8(2) - Media Downgrading | Equipment Testing
controls.title: Media Downgrading | Equipment Testing
controls.body: Test downgrading equipment and procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to ensure that downgrading actions are being achieved.

controls.name: AC8.3 - Symmetric Key Encryption Algorithms
controls.title: AC8.3 - Symmetric Key Encryption Algorithms
controls.body: Symmetric Key Encryption Algorithms used are AES 128 or Twofish.

controls.name: AC-7 Unsuccessful logon attempts
controls.title: AC-7 Unsuccessful logon attempts
controls.body:
The information system:
 a. Enforces a limit of [Assignment: organization-defined number] consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; and
 b. Automatically [Selection: locks the account/node for an [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; locks the account/node until released by an administrator; delays next logon prompt according to [Assignment: organization-defined delay algorithm]] when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.

controls.name: PS-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Personnel Security Approach
controls.title: PS-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Personnel Security Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Personnel Security (PS) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: IA-2 (11) Identification and authentication | remote access - separate device
controls.title: IA-2 (11) Identification and authentication | remote access - separate device
controls.body: The information system implements multifactor authentication for remote access to privileged and non-privileged accounts such that one of the factors is provided by a device separate from the system gaining access and the device meets [Assignment: organization-defined strength of mechanism requirements].

controls.name: PCI 9.7 - Restrict Access to Storage Media
controls.title: PCI 9.7 - Restrict Access to Storage Media
controls.body:
Maintain strict control over the storage and accessibility of media.

- 9.7.1 Properly maintain inventory logs of all media and conduct media inventories at least annually.

controls.name: OM2.4 - ISMS Scope Definition
controls.title: OM2.4 - ISMS Scope Definition
controls.body: The scope of the Information Security Management System or the Security & Privacy Program is clearly defined and documented.

controls.name: RM1.6 - Information Security Risk Treatment Plan
controls.title: RM1.6 - Information Security Risk Treatment Plan
controls.body: A Risk Mitigation Plan is established and documented. It documents the method selected for treating each risk (Avoid/Eliminate, Reduce/Mitigate, Share/Transfer, Retain/Accept), controls that are already in place, additional controls which may be needed and proposed and the time frame over which these proposed controls may be implemented.

controls.name: IC8.3 - Workstation Acceptable Use
controls.title: IC8.3 - Workstation Acceptable Use
controls.body: The organization implements workstation deployment guidelines that specify the proper functions to be performed and the manner in which those functions are to be performed.

controls.name: PCI 3.7 - Cardholder Data Protection Policies
controls.title: PCI 3.7 - Cardholder Data Protection Policies
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for protecting stored cardholder data are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: CP-10 (2) Information system recovery and reconstitution | transaction recovery
controls.title: CP-10 (2) Information system recovery and reconstitution | transaction recovery
controls.body: The information system implements transaction recovery for systems that are transaction-based.

controls.name: §164.308(a)(7)(ii)(A) - Backup Restoration (R)
controls.title: §164.308(a)(7)(ii)(A) - Backup Restoration (R)
controls.body: Backup restoration testing is performed on a quarterly basis to test the integrity and completeness of back-up data. Incident Management Process is invoked for anomalies.

controls.name: IC8.4 - Workstation Physical Security (PHI)
controls.title: IC8.4 - Workstation Physical Security (PHI)
controls.body: The organization implements guidelines that specify the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access electronic protected health information.

controls.name: IC4.13 - Limited Use and Disclosure of PHI
controls.title: IC4.13 - Limited Use and Disclosure of PHI
controls.body: The organization exercises reasonable efforts to use, disclose, and request only the minimum amount of protected health information needed to accomplish the intended purpose of the use, disclosure, or request.

controls.name: PCI 10.2 - Automated Logs for Audit Trail
controls.title: PCI 10.2 - Automated Logs for Audit Trail
controls.body:
Implement automated audit trails for all system components to reconstruct the following events:

- 10.2.1   All individual user accesses to cardholder data.
- 10.2.2   All actions taken by any individual with root or administrative privileges.
- 10.2.3   Access to all audit trails.
- 10.2.4   Invalid logical access attempts.
- 10.2.5   Use of and changes to identification and authentication mechanisms—including but not limited to creation of new accounts and elevation of privileges—and all changes, additions, or deletions to accounts with root or administrative privileges.
- 10.2.6   Initialization, stopping, or pausing of the audit logs.
- 10.2.7   Creation and deletion of system- level objects.

controls.name: PCI 9.1 - Facility Entry Controls
controls.title: Facility Entry Controls
controls.body: Use appropriate facility entry controls to limit and monitor physical access to systems in the cardholder data environment.

controls.name: IA-5 Authenticator management
controls.title: IA-5 Authenticator management

controls.category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, and Procedures
controls.name: CT.PO-P3 - Policies and Procedures for Handling Individual Requests
controls.title: Policies and Procedures for Handling Individual Requests
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures for enabling individuals’ data processing preferences and requests are established and in place.

controls.name: CM-8 (3) Information system component inventory | automated unauthorized component detection
controls.title: CM-8 (3) Information system component inventory | automated unauthorized component detection
controls.body:
The organization:
 (a)   Employs automated mechanisms [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to detect the presence of unauthorized hardware, software, and firmware components within the information system; and
 (b)   Takes the following actions when unauthorized components are detected: [Selection (one or more): disables network access by such components; isolates the components; notifies [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]].

controls.name: AC-8 System use notification
controls.title: AC-8 System use notification

controls.name: SO2.3 - PHI Breach Notification
controls.title: SO2.3 - PHI Breach Notification
controls.body: Following a validated protected health information breach, covered entities provide notification to affected individuals, the Secretary, and, where appropriate, the media. Business associates in turn, must notify covered entities if a breach occurs at or by the business associate.

controls.name: BC1.7 - BCP Evacuation Plans
controls.title: BC1.7 - BCP Evacuation Plans
controls.body: Building evacuation plans are available in all locations. Evacuation maps are posted in identified areas and include floor coordinators and muster points.

controls.name: IR-7 (1) Incident response assistance | automation support for availability of information / support
controls.title: IR-7 (1) Incident response assistance | automation support for availability of information / support
controls.body: The organization employs automated mechanisms to increase the availability of incident response- related information and support.

controls.name: CC3.2.4 - Third-Party Penetration Tests
controls.title: CC3.2.4 - Third-Party Penetration Tests
controls.body:
Internal vulnerability scans are performed quarterly. Annually, a third-party penetration test is performed against the Production the Entity environments.
Management takes action based on the results of the scans and penetration tests and necessary system changes follow the Entity change management process.

controls.name: IA-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Identification and Authentication Approach
controls.title: IA-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Identification and Authentication Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Identification and Authentication (IA) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: PCI 5.3 - Access Control for Anti-virus Management
controls.title: PCI 5.3 - Access Control for Anti-virus Management
controls.body:
Ensure that anti-virus mechanisms are actively running and cannot be disabled or altered by users, unless specifically authorized by management on a case-by-case basis for a limited time period.


Note: Anti-virus solutions may be temporarily disabled only if there is legitimate technical need, as authorized by management on a case-by-case basis. If anti-virus protection needs to be disabled for a specific purpose, it must be formally authorized. Additional security measures may also need to be implemented for the period of time during which anti-virus protection is not active.

controls.name: AU1.1 - Internal Audit Plan
controls.title: AU1.1 - Internal Audit Plan
controls.body: The organization has an approved audit plan with scheduled audit activities.

controls.name: AU-3 (1) Content of audit records | additional audit information
controls.title: AU-3 (1) Content of audit records | additional audit information
controls.body: The information system generates audit records containing the following additional information: [Assignment: organization-defined additional, more detailed information].

controls.name: CM.AW-P4 - Records of Data Disclosures
controls.title: Records of Data Disclosures
controls.body: Records of data disclosures and sharing are maintained and can be accessed for review or transmission/disclosure.

controls.name: AAC3.5 - Production System Account Management
controls.title: AAC3.5 - Production System Account Management
controls.body: Access to migrate application changes to Production is restricted to the authorized members of the Engineering team.

controls.name: HS - Restricted Access to Paper Records (A)
controls.title: Restricted Access to Paper Records (A)
controls.body: Access to paper records containing PHI is restricted and controlled.

controls.name: AC-17 (3) Remote access | managed access control points
controls.title: AC-17 (3) Remote access | managed access control points
controls.body: The information system routes all remote accesses through [Assignment: organization-defined number] managed network access control points.

controls.name: SO2.7 - Incident Response Procedure
controls.title: SO2.7 - Incident Response Procedure
controls.body: An Incident Response policy and procedure is established which is reviewed and updated on an annual basis by senior management. The document is made available to relevant internal users and includes procedures for identifying, analyzing, responding and remediating incidents or security events.

controls.name: IA-2 (1) Identification and authentication | network access to privileged accounts
controls.title: IA-2 (1) Identification and authentication | network access to privileged accounts
controls.body: The information system implements multifactor authentication for network access to privileged accounts.

controls.name: CM-3(3) - Configuration Change Control | Automated Change Implementation
controls.title: Configuration Change Control | Automated Change Implementation
controls.body: Implement changes to the current system baseline and deploy the updated baseline across the installed base using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: AC9.15 - Server Decommissioning
controls.title: AC9.15 - Server Decommissioning
controls.body: Best practices for decommissioning servers are followed.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P7 - Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.body: Response plans (Incident Response and Business Continuity) and recovery plans (Incident Recovery and Disaster Recovery) are established, in place, and managed.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.E.2 - Standardized Cybersecurity Program
controls.title: Standardized Cybersecurity Program
controls.body: The institution has a formal cybersecurity program that is based on technology and security industry standards or benchmarks.

controls.name: IC11.2 - Auditing External Network Equipment
controls.title: IC11.2 - Auditing External Network Equipment
controls.body: All external equipment is periodically audited to ensure compliance with the policy.

controls.name: IC11.3 - External Service Provider Responsibilities
controls.title: IC11.3 - External Service Provider Responsibilities
controls.body: Security responsibilities of external service providers are clearly defined.

controls.name: RM1.7 - Fraud Assessment
controls.title: RM1.7 - Fraud Assessment
controls.body: The organization performs comprehensive fraud risk assessments to identify specific fraud schemes and risks, assess their likelihood, evaluate existing fraud control activities and implement controls to mitigate them.

controls.name: AU1.3 - Change Assessment
controls.title: AU1.3 - Change Assessment
controls.body: Changes in the External Environment, business processes, Organization Management, 3rd party relationship, information processing facilities and systems that affects the Information Security posture are identified and assessed

controls.name: ID.IM-P2 - Inventory of Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Inventory of Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Owners or operators (e.g., the organization or third parties such as service providers, partners, customers, and developers) and their roles with respect to the systems/products/services and components (e.g., internal or external) that process data are inventoried.

controls.name: Clause 10.1.3 - Documented Nonconformity and Corrective Actions
controls.title: Clause 10.1.3 - Documented Nonconformity and Corrective Actions

controls.name: PS-3 (3) Personnel screening | information with special protection measures
controls.title: PS-3 (3) Personnel screening | information with special protection measures
controls.body:
The organization ensures that individuals accessing an information system processing, storing, or transmitting information requiring special protection:
 (a)   Have valid access authorizations that are demonstrated by assigned official government duties; and
 (b)   Satisfy [Assignment: organization-defined additional personnel screening criteria].

controls.name: ID.IM-P1 - Inventory of Systems/Products/Services
controls.title: Inventory of Systems/Products/Services
controls.body: Systems/products/services that process data are inventoried.

controls.name: CA-2 (3) Security assessments | external organizations
controls.title: CA-2 (3) Security assessments | external organizations
controls.body: The organization accepts the results of an assessment of [Assignment: organization-defined information system] performed by [Assignment: organization-defined external organization] when the assessment meets [Assignment: organization-defined requirements].

controls.name: CC8.1.4 - Peer Review on Changes
controls.title: CC8.1.4 - Peer Review on Changes
controls.body: System and infrastructure changes undergo peer review and are tested in the staging environment as needed.

controls.name: CC8.1.6 - Separate Environments
controls.title: CC8.1.6 - Separate Environments
controls.body: Separate environments are used for development, testing and production.

controls.name: ID.IM-P5 - Inventory of Purpose for Data Actions
controls.title: Inventory of Purpose for Data Actions
controls.body: The purposes for the data actions are inventoried.

controls.name: SO2.5 - Security Event Reporting Channel
controls.title: SO2.5 - Security Event Reporting Channel
controls.body: Security-related incidents observed which violate the security of information and organization's assets must be reported immediately in line with SO2 - Incident Response Policy.

controls.name: IC4.15 - Information in Non-Production Systems
controls.title: IC4.15 - Information in Non-Production Systems
controls.body: The organization does not permit the use and storage of confidential information (as defined in IC4 - Information Security/Sensitivity policy) in non-production systems and environments.

controls.name: PCI 10.9 - Procedures for Monitoring Network Access
controls.title: Procedures for Monitoring Network Access
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for monitoring all access to network resources and cardholder data are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: 1.3.3 - Appropriate reporting - 3
controls.title: Appropriate reporting - 3
controls.body: Your organisation follows the DPO’s advice and takes account of their knowledge about data protection obligations.

controls.name: ID.IM-P8 - Records Related to Processing Data
controls.title: Records Related to Processing Data
controls.body: Data processing is mapped, illustrating the data actions and associated data elements for systems/products/services, including components; roles of the component owners/operators; and interactions of individuals or third parties with the systems/products/services.

controls.name: SSPA34 - Data Protection Complaint Process
controls.title: SSPA34 - Data Protection Complaint Process
controls.body: Where Microsoft is a controller of Microsoft Personal Data, the organization has established a formal complaint process for responding to all data protection complaints involving Microsoft Personal Data.

controls.name: PCI 1.3 - Access Restriction between Internet and Cardholder Data Environment
controls.title: Access Restriction between Internet and Cardholder Data Environment
controls.body: Prohibit direct public access between the Internet and any system component in the cardholder data environment.

controls.name: IA-1 Identification and authentication policy and procedures
controls.title: IA-1 Identification and authentication policy and procedures
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Develops, documents, and disseminates to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
   1. An identification and authentication policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
   2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the identification and authentication policy and associated identification and authentication controls; and
 b. Reviews and updates the current:
   1. Identification and authentication policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; and
   2. Identification and authentication procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: ID.RA-P1 - Identification of Contextual Factors
controls.title: Identification of Contextual Factors
controls.body: Contextual factors related to the systems/products/services and the data actions are identified (e.g., individuals’ demographics and privacy interests or perceptions, data sensitivity and/or types, visibility of data processing to individuals and third parties).

controls.name: PCI 4.2.1 - Cryptography Protocols
controls.title: Cryptography Protocols
controls.body:
Strong cryptography and security protocols are implemented as follows to safeguard PAN during transmission over open, public networks:
- Only trusted keys and certificates are accepted.
- Certificates used to safeguard PAN during transmission over open, public networks are confirmed as valid and are not expired or revoked. This bullet is a best practice until its effective date.
- The protocol in use supports only secure versions or configurations and does not support fallback to, or use of, insecure versions, algorithms, key sizes, or implementations.
- The encryption strength is appropriate for the encryption methodology in use.

controls.name: SSPA48 - Encryption of Data In Transit
controls.title: SSPA48 - Encryption of Data In Transit
controls.body: The organization protects all data Processed in connection with its Performance in transit across networks with encryption using Transport Layer Security (TLS) or Internet Protocol Security (IPsec).

controls.name: ID.DE-P5 - Routine Assessment of Data Processing Ecosystem Parties
controls.title: Routine Assessment of Data Processing Ecosystem Parties
controls.body: Data processing ecosystem parties are routinely assessed using audits, test results, or other forms of evaluations to confirm they are meeting their contractual, interoperability framework, or other obligations.

controls.name: OM7.0 -  Equality and Diversity Notices
controls.title: OM7.0 -  Equality and Diversity Notices
controls.body: Equality and Diversity Commitment Posters are posted in organization message boards.

controls.name: PCI 7.2 - User Access Restriction
controls.title: PCI 7.2 - User Access Restriction
controls.body:
Establish an access control system(s) for systems components that restricts access based on a user's need to know, and is set to "deny all" unless specifically allowed.
This access control system(s) must include 7.2.1, 7.2.2, 7.2.3

- 7.2.1   Coverage of all system components
- 7.2.2   Assignment of privileges to individuals based on job classification and function.
- 7.2.3   Default "deny-all" setting.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.2 - Creation and Updating Documented
controls.title: Clause 7.5.2 - Creation and Updating Documented

controls.name: §164.530(j) - Maintain Documentation on Breaches and Retention
controls.title: §164.530(j) - Maintain Documentation on Breaches and Retention
controls.body: Formal policies and procedures are in place for maintaining documentation of breaches and retention of it until 6 years after the date of their creation or the last effective date.

controls.name: AC-14 Permitted actions without identification or authentication
controls.title: AC-14 Permitted actions without identification or authentication
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Identifies [Assignment: organization-defined user actions] that can be performed on the information system without identification or authentication consistent with organizational missions/business functions; and
 b. Documents and provides supporting rationale in the security plan for the information system, user actions not requiring identification or authentication.

controls.name: OM8.5 - Code of Conduct Violation
controls.title: OM8.5 - Code of Conduct Violation
controls.body: The Code of Conduct and Ethics reiterates that employees who violate Company policies or engage in other misconduct are subject to appropriate disciplinary action up to and including termination.

controls.name: PL-4 (1) Rules of behavior | social media and networking restrictions
controls.title: PL-4 (1) Rules of behavior | social media and networking restrictions
controls.body: The organization includes in the rules of behavior, explicit restrictions on the use of social media/networking sites and posting organizational information on public websites.

controls.name: CT.DM-P7 - Data Element Processing Permission Transmission Mechanisms
controls.title: Data Element Processing Permission Transmission Mechanisms
controls.body: Mechanisms for transmitting processing permissions and related data values with data elements are established and in place.

controls.name: OM2.17 - Succession Plan
controls.title: OM2.17 - Succession Plan
controls.body: An approved succession plan is utilized to address contingencies for change in employment status.

controls.name: PL-8 Information security architecture
controls.title: PL-8 Information security architecture
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Develops an information security architecture for the information system that:
   1. Describes the overall philosophy, requirements, and approach to be taken with regard to protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational information;
   2. Describes how the information security architecture is integrated into and supports the enterprise architecture; and
   3. Describes any information security assumptions about, and dependencies on, external services;
 b. Reviews and updates the information security architecture [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to reflect updates in the enterprise architecture; and
 c. Ensures that planned information security architecture changes are reflected in the security plan, the security Concept of Operations (CONOPS), and organizational procurements/acquisitions.

controls.name: CM.PO-P1 - Data Processing Transparency Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Data Processing Transparency Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Transparency policies, processes, and procedures for communicating data processing purposes, practices, and associated privacy risks are established and in place.

controls.name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets  Safeguard 1.1: Establish and maintain detailed enterprise asset inventory.
controls.title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets  Safeguard 1.1: Establish and maintain detailed enterprise asset inventory.
controls.body: x

controls.name: RM1.8 - Risk Assessment
controls.title: RM1.8 - Risk Assessment
controls.body: A formal risk assessment and risk mitigation methodology is established and reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: OM2.22 - Business Objectives
controls.title: OM2.22 - Business Objectives
controls.body: Organization has identified and documented its business objectives in regard to information security. The objectives are reviewed at least annually or whenever there are significant changes; and compliance to objectives is assessed as part of quarterly board meetings.

controls.name: PR.DS-P8 - Hardware Integrity Checking Mechanisms
controls.title: Hardware Integrity Checking Mechanisms
controls.body: Integrity checking mechanisms are used to verify hardware integrity.

controls.name: Privacy Laws and Policy
controls.title: Privacy Laws and Policy
controls.body: Organization monitors federal privacy laws and policy for changes that affect the privacy program.

controls.name: OM8.1 - Review of Ethical Standards
controls.title: OM8.1 - Review of Ethical Standards
controls.body: The board of directors shall define and create a set of standards that outline the integrity and ethical values of the organization with a review or assessment of these standards completed at annually.

controls.name: ID.RA-P3 - Identifying Problematic Data Actions
controls.title: Identifying Problematic Data Actions
controls.body: Potential problematic data actions and associated problems are identified.

controls.name: RM1.10 - Risk Analysis
controls.title: RM1.10 - Risk Analysis
controls.body:
The organization has deployed host- and network-based intrusion detection systems across system infrastructure components that collect and analyze data to identify unusual activity, potential security threats, and vulnerabilities. These systems perform a variety of functions including log analysis, file integrity checking, policy monitoring, rootkit detection, and real-time alerting. 

Alerts are generated automatically (based upon pre-defined thresholds), logged, and reviewed by IT personnel for further investigation and, if needed, resolution.

controls.name: RM1.12 - Risk Assessment Evaluation
controls.title: RM1.12 - Risk Assessment Evaluation
controls.body: The organization uses quarterly vulnerability scans and annual third-party penetration tests on relevant infrastructure to identify vulnerabilities and variances from organization standards. Results are evaluated by appropriate personnel and remediation actions are performed, where deemed appropriate.

controls.name: OM2.23 - Management Oversight
controls.title: OM2.23 - Management Oversight
controls.body: At least monthly, the Executive Team meets to monitor progress against the Company's objectives, goals, and initiatives and to discuss specific business developments, department results, and various risks and opportunities facing the Company.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.17 - Customer Authentication
controls.title: Customer Authentication
controls.body: Customer service (e.g., the call center) utilizes formal procedures to authenticate customers commensurate with the risk of the transaction or request. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 19)

controls.name: AT-2(6) - Literacy Training and Awareness | Cyber Threat Environment
controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Cyber Threat Environment
controls.body:
a. Provide literacy training on the cyber threat environment; and
b. Reflect current cyber threat information in system operations.

controls.name: ID.RA-P5 - Risk Responses
controls.title: Risk Responses
controls.body: Risk responses are identified, prioritized, and implemented.

controls.name: MA-3 (1) Maintenance tools | inspect tools
controls.title: MA-3 (1) Maintenance tools | inspect tools
controls.body: The organization inspects the maintenance tools carried into a facility by maintenance personnel for improper or unauthorized modifications.

controls.name: MA-4 (2) Nonlocal maintenance | document nonlocal maintenance
controls.title: MA-4 (2) Nonlocal maintenance | document nonlocal maintenance
controls.body: The organization documents in the security plan for the information system, the policies and procedures for the establishment and use of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic connections.

controls.name: ID.DE-P1 - Data Processing Ecosystem Risk Management Policies
controls.title: Data Processing Ecosystem Risk Management Policies
controls.body: Data processing ecosystem risk management policies, processes, and procedures are identified, established, assessed, managed, and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.

controls.name: MA-6 Timely maintenance
controls.title: MA-6 Timely maintenance
controls.body: The organization obtains maintenance support and/or spare parts for [Assignment: organization-defined information system components] within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of failure.

controls.name: M43.24 - Prüfungen von Protokollen protokollieren
controls.title: Prüfungen von Protokollen protokollieren
controls.body: Prüfungen von Protokollen protokollieren

controls.name: CM-4 Security impact analysis
controls.title: CM-4 Security impact analysis
controls.body: The organization analyzes changes to the information system to determine potential security impacts prior to change implementation.

controls.name: GV.PO-P1 - Organizational Privacy Policies
controls.title: Organizational Privacy Policies
controls.body: Organizational privacy values and policies (e.g., conditions on data processing such as data uses or retention periods, individuals’ prerogatives with respect to data processing) are established and communicated.

controls.name: SA-11 (8) Developer security testing and evaluation | dynamic code analysis
controls.title: SA-11 (8) Developer security testing and evaluation | dynamic code analysis
controls.body: The organization requires the developer of the information system, system component, or information system service to employ dynamic code analysis tools to identify common flaws and document the results of the analysis.

controls.name: CM-6 Configuration settings
controls.title: CM-6 Configuration settings

controls.name: GV.RM-P2 - Risk Tolerance Determination
controls.title: Risk Tolerance Determination
controls.body: Organizational risk tolerance is determined and clearly expressed.

controls.name: PCI 12.7 - Background Checks
controls.title: PCI 12.7 - Background Checks
controls.body:
Screen potential personnel prior to hire to minimize the risk of attacks from internal sources. (Examples of background checks include previous employment history, criminal record, credit history, and reference checks.)

Note: For those potential personnel to be hired for certain positions such as store cashiers who only have access to one card number at a time when facilitating a transaction, this requirement is a recommendation only.

controls.name: AC2.4 - Secure Area Acceptable Use
controls.title: AC2.4 - Secure Area Acceptable Use
controls.body: Procedures for working in secure areas are documented and enforced.

controls.name: AC-11 Session lock
controls.title: AC-11 Session lock
controls.body:
The information system:
 a. Prevents further access to the system by initiating a session lock after [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of inactivity or upon receiving a request from a user; and
 b. Retains the session lock until the user reestablishes access using established identification and authentication procedures.

controls.name: PE-5 Access control for output devices
controls.title: PE-5 Access control for output devices
controls.body: The organization controls physical access to information system output devices to prevent unauthorized individuals from obtaining the output.

controls.name: PCI 2.3 - Encrypt Non-Console Administrative Access
controls.title: PCI 2.3 - Encrypt Non-Console Administrative Access
controls.body: Encrypt all non-console administrative access using strong cryptography.

controls.name: A1.1.1 - Monitoring of Network Performance & System Processing
