controls.title: A1.1.1 - Monitoring of Network Performance & System Processing
controls.body: Network performance and system processing are monitored using system monitoring tools by AWS Operations 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Documented procedures exist for the escalation and resolution of performance and processing availability issues.

controls.name: PCI 11.4 - Intrusion Detection and Prevention
controls.title: PCI 11.4 - Intrusion Detection and Prevention
controls.body: Use intrusion-detection and/or intrusion-prevention techniques to detect and/or prevent intrusions into the network. Monitor all traffic at the perimeter of the cardholder data environment as well as at critical points in the cardholder data environment, and alert personnel to suspected compromises. Keep all intrusion-detection and prevention engines, baselines, and signatures up to date.

controls.name: CM-5 Access restrictions for change
controls.title: CM-5 Access restrictions for change
controls.body: The organization defines, documents, approves, and enforces physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to the information system.

controls.name: AC-20 (1) Use of external information systems | limits on authorized use
controls.title: AC-20 (1) Use of external information systems | limits on authorized use
controls.body:
The organization permits authorized individuals to use an external information system to access the information system or to process, store, or transmit organization-controlled information only when the organization:
 (a)   Verifies the implementation of required security controls on the external system as specified in the organization’s information security policy and security plan; or
 (b)   Retains approved information system connection or processing agreements with the organizational entity hosting the external information system.

controls.name: AC-20 (2) Use of external information systems | portable storage devices
controls.title: AC-20 (2) Use of external information systems | portable storage devices
controls.body: The organization [Selection: restricts; prohibits] the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices by authorized individuals on external information systems.

controls.name: SA-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] system and services acquisition policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the system and services acquisition policy and the associated system and services acquisition controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the system and services acquisition policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current system and services acquisition:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: §164.414(b) - Burden of Proof
controls.title: §164.414(b) - Burden of Proof
controls.body: In the event of a use or disclosure in violation of subpart E, the covered entity or business associate, as applicable, shall have the burden of demonstrating that all notifications were made as required by the subpart or that the use or disclosure did not constitute a breach as defined at §164.402.

controls.name: PCI 12.2 - Risk Assessment Excercise
controls.title: PCI 12.2 - Risk Assessment Excercise
controls.body:
Implement a risk-assessment process that: Is performed at least annually and upon significant changes to the environment (for example, acquisition, merger, relocation, etc.), Identifies critical assets, threats, and vulnerabilities, and results in a formal, documented analysis of risk. 
Examples of risk-assessment methodologies include but are not limited to OCTAVE, ISO 27005 and NIST SP 800-30.

controls.name: CP-9(6) - System Backup | Redundant Secondary System
controls.title: System Backup | Redundant Secondary System
controls.body: Conduct system backup by maintaining a redundant secondary system that is not collocated with the primary system and that can be activated without loss of information or disruption to operations.

controls.name: CM.PO-P2 - Roles and Responsibilities for Data Processing Communications
controls.title: Roles and Responsibilities for Data Processing Communications
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities (e.g., public relations) for communicating data processing purposes, practices, and associated privacy risks are established.

controls.name: AAC11.5 - Serverless function Logging and Monitoring
controls.title: AAC11.5 - Serverless function Logging and Monitoring
controls.body: Function logging is enabled to monitor administrative activities regarding changes to functions, security configurations, permissions and roles. Automated alerts are configured to notify IT management and issues identified are resolved in a timely manner through the incident management process.

controls.name: AC7.3 - VPN Authentication
controls.title: AC7.3 - VPN Authentication
controls.body: VPN uses either a one-time password authentication such as a token device, or a public/private key system with a strong passphrase.

controls.name: PCI 12.6.2 - Annual Personnel Acknowledgement of the Security Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Annual Personnel Acknowledgement of the Security Policy and Procedures
controls.body: Require personnel to acknowledge at least annually that they have read and understood the security policy and procedures.

controls.name: MP-7 (1) Media use | prohibit use without owner
controls.title: MP-7 (1) Media use | prohibit use without owner
controls.body: The organization prohibits the use of portable storage devices in organizational information systems when such devices have no identifiable owner.

controls.name: AIC4.19 - Information Collection Purpose
controls.title: AIC4.19 - Information Collection Purpose
controls.body: The organization describes the purpose(s) for which personal information is collected, used, maintained, and disclosed in its privacy policy/statement.

controls.name: CM-6 (1) Configuration settings | automated central management / application / verification
controls.title: CM-6 (1) Configuration settings | automated central management / application / verification
controls.body: The organization employs automated mechanisms to centrally manage, apply, and verify configuration settings for [Assignment: organization-defined information system components].

controls.name: PR.DS-P1 - Protection for Data at Rest
controls.title: Protection for Data at Rest
controls.body: Data-at-rest are protected.

controls.name: AIC4.18 - Personal Information Collection
controls.title: AIC4.18 - Personal Information Collection
controls.body: Personal information is collected consistent with the organization's privacy commitments and system requirements.

controls.name: PCI 5.1.2 - System Evaluation of Malware Threats
controls.title: System Evaluation of Malware Threats
controls.body: For systems considered to be not commonly affected by malicious software, perform periodic evaluations to identify and evaluate evolving malware threats in order to confirm whether such systems continue to not require anti-virus software.

controls.name: OM6.1 - Environmental Policy Notes in Email Signatures
controls.title: OM6.1 - Environmental Policy Notes in Email Signatures
controls.body: Environmental policy notes are appended in email signatures to remind recipients to print only if necessary.

controls.name: CM-5 (5) Access restrictions for change | limit production / operational privileges
controls.title: CM-5 (5) Access restrictions for change | limit production / operational privileges
controls.body:
The organization:
 (a)   Limits privileges to change information system components and system-related information within a production or operational environment; and
 (b)   Reviews and reevaluates privileges [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: ID.IM-P4 - Inventory of Data Actions
controls.title: Inventory of Data Actions
controls.body: Data actions of the systems/products/services are inventoried.

controls.name: ASO4.4 - Change Notification
controls.title: ASO4.4 - Change Notification
controls.body: Notify external users and stakeholders of critical changes to be made that affect the reliability of information.

controls.name: CC6.3.4 - Management Reviews of User Access Permissions
controls.title: CC6.3.4 - Management Reviews of User Access Permissions
controls.body: Management periodically reviews user access permissions for all employees across the company.

controls.name: ID.IM-P7 - Identification of Data Processing Environment
controls.title: Identification of Data Processing Environment
controls.body: The data processing environment is identified (e.g., geographic location, internal, cloud, third parties).

controls.name: ID.RA-P4 - Determination and Prioritization of Risks
controls.title: Determination and Prioritization of Risks
controls.body: Problematic data actions, likelihoods, and impacts are used to determine and prioritize risk.

controls.name: AC-1 Access control policy and procedures
controls.title: AC-1 Access control policy and procedures
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Develops, documents, and disseminates to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
   1. An access control policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
   2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the access control policy and associated access controls; and
 b. Reviews and updates the current:
   1. Access control policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; and
   2. Access control procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: PCI A3.2.3 - Changes to Organizational Structure
controls.title: Changes to Organizational Structure
controls.body:
Changes to organizational structure— for example, a company merger or acquisition, change or reassignment of personnel with responsibility for security controls—result in a formal (internal) review of the impact to PCI DSS scope and applicability of controls.
PCI DSS Reference: Requirement 12

controls.name: AAM2.0 - IT Hardware Inventory
controls.title: AAM2.0 - IT Hardware Inventory
controls.body: Assets (servers, networking hardware, storage, desktops/laptops, other devices) associated with information storage and processing are identified and an inventory of these assets are documented and maintained.

controls.name: AIC12.0 - Network Diagram
controls.title: AIC12.0 - Network Diagram
controls.body: A network diagram is maintained for all networks.

controls.name: GV.AT-P2 - Senior Executive Awareness Training
controls.title: Senior Executive Awareness Training
controls.body: Senior executives understand their roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: GV.MT-P1 - Continuous Privacy Risk Assessment
controls.title: Continuous Privacy Risk Assessment
controls.body: Privacy risk is re-evaluated on an ongoing basis and as key factors, including the organization’s business environment (e.g., introduction of new technologies), governance (e.g., legal obligations, risk tolerance), data processing, and systems/products/services change.

controls.name: GV.MT-P4 - Privacy Risk Management Progress Reporting
controls.title: Privacy Risk Management Progress Reporting
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures for communicating progress on managing privacy risks are established and in place.

controls.name: IA-MC-ML.2.998 - Identification and Authentication Implementation
controls.title: IA-MC-ML.2.998 - Identification and Authentication Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Identification and Authentication (IA) policy.

controls.name: GV.MT-P5 - Data Incident Reporting and Response
controls.title: Data Incident Reporting and Response
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures are established and in place to receive, analyze, and respond to problematic data actions disclosed to the organization from internal and external sources (e.g., internal discovery, privacy researchers, professional events).

controls.category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, and Procedures
controls.name: CT.PO-P1 - Data Processing Authorization Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Data Processing Authorization Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures for authorizing data processing (e.g., organizational decisions, individual consent), revoking authorizations, and maintaining authorizations are established and in place.

controls.name: CT.DM-P3 - Data Element Accessibility for Alteration
controls.title: Data Element Accessibility for Alteration
controls.body: Data elements can be accessed for alteration.

controls.name: IC12.3 - Network Zone Segmentation
controls.title: IC12.3 - Network Zone Segmentation
controls.body: Networks (services, information systems, users, workstations, servers, public facing) are physically segmented into zones through routers or by implementing firewalls according to defined criteria (risk exposure, business value, data flows, etc).

controls.name: AIC4.20 - Consent to Retain Information
controls.title: AIC4.20 - Consent to Retain Information
controls.body: Consents obtained from data subjects for collection, usage and disclosure of personal information is retained in accordance with privacy laws and regulations as well as objectives defined in the privacy policy.

controls.name: CT.DM-P4 - Data Element Accessibility for Deletion
controls.title: Data Element Accessibility for Deletion
controls.body: Data elements can be accessed for deletion.

controls.name: AU-5 Response to audit processing failures
controls.title: AU-5 Response to audit processing failures
controls.body:
The information system:
 a. Alerts [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] in the event of an audit processing failure; and
 b. Takes the following additional actions: [Assignment: organization-defined actions to be taken (e.g., shut down information system, overwrite oldest audit records, stop generating audit records)].

controls.name: PCI 8.2.5 - Password History
controls.title: Password History
controls.body: Do not allow an individual to submit a new password/passphrase that is the same as any of the last four passwords/passphrases he or she has used.

controls.name: D2.IS.Is.A.3 - Threat Information Network
controls.title: Threat Information Network
controls.body: A network of trust relationships (formal and/or informal) has been established to evaluate information about cyber threats.

controls.name: CT.DM-P8 - Data Audit Record Management
controls.title: Data Audit Record Management
controls.body: Audit/log records are determined, documented, implemented, and reviewed in accordance with policy and incorporating the principle of data minimization.

controls.name: AIC4.2 - Data Retention Policy
controls.title: AIC4.2 - Data Retention Policy
controls.body: The organization establishes written policies related to retention periods for the confidential information it maintains.

controls.name: CT.DP-P2 - De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.title: De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.body: Data are processed to limit the identification of individuals (e.g., de-identification privacy techniques, tokenization).

controls.name: SA-2 Allocation of resources
controls.title: SA-2 Allocation of resources
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Determines information security requirements for the information system or information system service in mission/business process planning;
 b. Determines, documents, and allocates the resources required to protect the information system or information system service as part of its capital planning and investment control process; and
 c. Establishes a discrete line item for information security in organizational programming and budgeting documentation.

controls.name: IR-9 (1) Information spillage response | responsible personnel
controls.title: IR-9 (1) Information spillage response | responsible personnel
controls.body: The organization assigns [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] with responsibility for responding to information spills.

controls.name: CT.DP-P4 - Selective Collection or Disclosure of Data Elements
controls.title: Selective Collection or Disclosure of Data Elements
controls.body: System or device configurations permit selective collection or disclosure of data elements.

controls.name: CM.AW-P3 - Data Processing Visibility
controls.title: Data Processing Visibility
controls.body: System/product/service design enables data processing visibility.

controls.name: CM.AW-P7 - Breach Notifications
controls.title: Breach Notifications
controls.body: Impacted individuals and organizations are notified about a privacy breach or event.

controls.name: AOM2.3 - Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreements
controls.title: AOM2.3 - Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreements
controls.body: A nondisclosure or confidentiality agreement is signed by all persons with access to confidential information.

controls.name: SI-4 (4) Information system monitoring | inbound and outbound communications traffic
controls.title: SI-4 (4) Information system monitoring | inbound and outbound communications traffic
controls.body: The information system monitors inbound and outbound communications traffic [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] for unusual or unauthorized activities or conditions.

controls.name: D1.4.4 - Separation in organisational / departmental boundaries
controls.title: Separation in organisational / departmental boundaries
controls.body: Separation in organisational / departmental boundaries

controls.name: CM.AW-P8 - Mitigation Mechanisms
controls.title: Mitigation Mechanisms
controls.body: Individuals are provided with mitigation mechanisms (e.g., credit monitoring, consent withdrawal, data alteration or deletion) to address impacts of problematic data actions.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P3 - Backup of Information and Testing
controls.title: Backup of Information and Testing
controls.body: Backups of information are conducted, maintained, and tested.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P8 - Testing of Response and Recovery Plans
controls.title: Testing of Response and Recovery Plans
controls.body: Response and recovery plans are tested.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P10 - Vulnerability Management Plan
controls.title: Vulnerability Management Plan
controls.body: A vulnerability management plan is developed and implemented.

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
controls.name: PR.AC-P1 - User Access Management
controls.title: User Access Management
controls.body: Identities and credentials are issued, managed, verified, revoked, and audited for authorized individuals, processes, and devices.

controls.name: AC-2 Account management
controls.title: AC-2 Account management

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
controls.name: PR.AC-P4 - Access Permissions and Authorizations
controls.title: Access Permissions and Authorizations
controls.body: Access permissions and authorizations are managed, incorporating the principles of least privilege and separation of duties.

controls.name: AOM3.4 - Employee Handbook and Code of Conduct
controls.title: AOM3.4 - Employee Handbook and Code of Conduct
controls.body: The organization has an employee handbook that organization members must read and acknowledge.

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
controls.name: PR.AC-P5 - Network Segregation
controls.title: Network Segregation
controls.body: Network integrity is protected (e.g., network segregation, network segmentation).

controls.name: PR.DS-P3 - Systems Removal, Transfer and Disposition
controls.title: Systems Removal, Transfer and Disposition
controls.body: Systems/products/services and associated data are formally managed throughout removal, transfers, and disposition.

controls.name: SI-4 (1) Information system monitoring | system-wide intrusion detection system
controls.title: SI-4 (1) Information system monitoring | system-wide intrusion detection system
controls.body: The organization connects and configures individual intrusion detection tools into an information system-wide intrusion detection system.

controls.name: PR.MA-P1 - Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.title: Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.body: Maintenance and repair of organizational assets are performed and logged, with approved and controlled tools.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.2 - Public-facing Web Applications Vulnerabilities Detection and Prevention
controls.title: Public-facing Web Applications Vulnerabilities Detection and Prevention
controls.body:
For public-facing web applications, an automated technical solution is deployed that continually detects and prevents web-based attacks, with at least the following:
- Is installed in front of public-facing web applications and is configured to detect and prevent web-based attacks.
- Actively running and up to date as applicable.
- Generating audit logs.
- Configured to either block web-based attacks or generate an alert that is immediately investigated.

controls.name: PR.MA-P2 - Remote Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.title: Remote Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.body: Remote maintenance of organizational assets is approved, logged, and performed in a manner that prevents unauthorized access.

controls.name: 1.3.5 - Appropriate reporting - 5
controls.title: Appropriate reporting - 5
controls.body: The DPO directly advises senior decision-makers and raises concerns with the highest management level.

controls.name: PR.PT-P2 - Least Functionality Access
controls.title: Least Functionality Access
controls.body: The principle of least functionality is incorporated by configuring systems to provide only essential capabilities.

controls.name: §164.316(b)(1) - Policies and Procedures (S)
controls.title: §164.316(b)(1) - Policies and Procedures (S)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under- § 164.308(a)(1)(i) - Policies and Procedures (S)

controls.name: SI-4 (16) Information system monitoring | correlate monitoring information
controls.title: SI-4 (16) Information system monitoring | correlate monitoring information
controls.body: The organization correlates information from monitoring tools employed throughout the information system.

controls.name: MANAGE.1.2 - Risk Treatment Prioritization
controls.title: Risk Treatment Prioritization
controls.body: Treatment of documented AI risks is prioritized based on impact, likelihood, or available resources or methods.

controls.name: AT-3 Role-based security training
controls.title: AT-3 Role-based security training
controls.body:
The organization provides role-based security training to personnel with assigned security roles and responsibilities:
a. Before authorizing access to the information system or performing assigned duties;
b. When required by information system changes; and
c. [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] thereafter.

controls.name: AT-4 Security training records
controls.title: AT-4 Security training records
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Documents and monitors individual information system security training activities including basic security awareness training and specific information system security training; and
 b. Retains individual training records for [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: CM.AW-P1 - Mechanisms for Data Processing Communications
controls.title: Mechanisms for Data Processing Communications
controls.body: Mechanisms (e.g., notices, internal or public reports) for communicating data processing purposes, practices, associated privacy risks, and options for enabling individuals’ data processing preferences and requests are established and in place.

controls.name: MANAGE.1.3 - Responding to High-Priority AI Risks
controls.title: Responding to High-Priority AI Risks
controls.body: Responses to the AI risks deemed high priority as identified by the Map function, are developed, planned, and documented. Risk response options can include mitigating, transferring, avoiding, or accepting.

controls.name: PE-13 Fire protection
controls.title: PE-13 Fire protection
controls.body: The organization employs and maintains fire suppression and detection devices/systems for the information system that are supported by an independent energy source.

controls.name: ARM2.1 - Third-Party Vendor Risk Level
controls.title: ARM2.1 - Third-Party Vendor Risk Level
controls.body: Third-party vendors are assigned a risk level prior to engagement and an annual review of risks associated with third-party vendors

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.Int.1
controls.title: D3.PC.Im.Int.1
controls.body: The enterprise network is segmented in multiple, separate trust/security zones with defense-in-depth strategies (e.g., logical network segmentation, hard backups, air-gapping) to mitigate attacks.

controls.name: CM.AW-P2 - Mechanisms for Feedback
controls.title: Mechanisms for Feedback
controls.body: Mechanisms for obtaining feedback from individuals (e.g., surveys or focus groups) about data processing and associated privacy risks are established and in place.

controls.name: SI-7 Software, firmware, and information integrity
controls.title: SI-7 Software, firmware, and information integrity
controls.body: The organization employs integrity verification tools to detect unauthorized changes to [Assignment: organization-defined software, firmware, and information].

controls.name: MANAGE.2.1 - Resource Assessment for AI Risk Management
controls.title: Resource Assessment for AI Risk Management
controls.body: Resources required to manage AI risks are taken into account, along with viable non-AI alternative systems, approaches, or methods – to reduce the magnitude or likelihood of potential impacts.

controls.name: IC1.0 - Email Encryption Configuration
controls.title: IC1.0 - Email Encryption Configuration
controls.body: Authentication and encryption technologies are implemented to protect data during transmission and access to resources housing confidential customer information.

controls.name: CIP-004.R5-5.2 - Revoke Access on Reassignment or Transfer
controls.title: Revoke Access on Reassignment or Transfer
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall, in the case of reassignments or transfers, revoke the individual’s authorized electronic access to individual accounts and authorized unescorted physical access that the responsible entity determines are not necessary by the end of the next calendar day following the date that the responsible entity determines that the individual no longer requires retention of that access.

controls.name: MANAGE.2.3 - Procedures for Responding to Newly Identified AI Risks
controls.title: Procedures for Responding to Newly Identified AI Risks
controls.body: Procedures are followed to respond to and recover from a previously unknown risk when it is identified.

controls.name: BC1.4 - BCP Notifications
controls.title: BC1.4 - BCP Notifications
controls.body: Notification plans are in place to ensure communication with internal and external stakeholders in the event of a disaster.

controls.name: CM.AW-P3 - Data Processing Visibility
controls.title: Data Processing Visibility
controls.body: System/product/service design enables data processing visibility.

controls.name: MANAGE.3.1 - Monitoring of Third-Party Risks
controls.title: Monitoring of Third-Party Risks
controls.body: AI risks and benefits from third-party resources are regularly monitored, and risk controls are applied and documented.

controls.name: D2.TI.Ti.E.1 - Threat Intelligence
controls.title: Threat Intelligence
controls.body: Threat information received by the institution includes analysis of tactics, patterns, and risk mitigation recommendations

controls.name: PCI 1.3 - Access Restriction between Internet and Cardholder Data Environment
controls.title: PCI 1.3 - Access Restriction between Internet and Cardholder Data Environment
controls.body:
Prohibit direct public access between the Internet and any system component in the cardholder data environment.

- 1.3.1  Implement a DMZ to limit inbound traffic to only system components that provide authorized publicly accessible services, protocols, and ports.
- 1.3.2  Limit inbound Internet traffic to IP addresses within the DMZ.
- 1.3.3  Implement anti-spoofing measures to detect and block forged source IP addresses from entering the network.(For example, block traffic originating from the Internet with an internal source address.)
- 1.3.4  Do not allow unauthorized outbound traffic from the cardholder data environment to the Internet.
- 1.3.5  Permit only "established" connections into the network.
- 1.3.6  Place system components that store cardholder data (such as a database) in an internal network zone, segregated from the DMZ and other untrusted networks.
- 1.3.7  Do not disclose private IP addresses and routing information to unauthorized parties.

controls.name: CM.AW-P4 - Records of Data Disclosures
controls.title: Records of Data Disclosures
controls.body: Records of data disclosures and sharing are maintained and can be accessed for review or transmission/disclosure.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.2 - Ethical Human Subject Evaluation
controls.title: Ethical Human Subject Evaluation
controls.body: Evaluations involving human subjects meet applicable requirements (including human subject protection) and are representative of the relevant population.

controls.name: SI-8 Spam protection
controls.title: SI-8 Spam protection
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Employs spam protection mechanisms at information system entry and exit points to detect and take action on unsolicited messages; and
 b. Updates spam protection mechanisms when new releases are available in accordance with organizational configuration management policy and procedures.

controls.name: AC-2 (7) Account management | role-based schemes
controls.title: AC-2 (7) Account management | role-based schemes
controls.body:
The organization:
(a) Establishes and administers privileged user accounts in accordance with a role-based access scheme that organizes allowed information system access and privileges into roles;
(b) Monitors privileged role assignments; and
(c) Takes [Assignment: organization-defined actions] when privileged role assignments are no longer appropriate.

controls.name: CM.AW-P5 - Communication of Data Corrections or Deletions
controls.title: Communication of Data Corrections or Deletions
controls.body: Data corrections or deletions can be communicated to individuals or organizations (e.g., data sources) in the data processing ecosystem.

controls.name: M50.29 - Specification of audit procedures for the entire system
controls.title: Specification of audit procedures for the entire system
controls.body: Specification of audit procedures for the entire system

controls.name: MAP.5.1 - AI Impact Analysis
controls.title: AI Impact Analysis
controls.body: Likelihood and magnitude of each identified impact (both potentially beneficial and harmful) based on expected use, past uses of AI systems in similar contexts, public incident reports, feedback from those external to the team that developed or deployed the AI system, or other data are identified and documented.

controls.name: AC-2 (9) Account management | restrictions on use of shared groups / accounts
controls.title: AC-2 (9) Account management | restrictions on use of shared groups / accounts
controls.body: The organization only permits the use of shared/group accounts that meet [Assignment: organization-defined conditions for establishing shared/group accounts].

controls.name: SI-2 (2) Flaw remediation | automated flaw remediation status
controls.title: SI-2 (2) Flaw remediation | automated flaw remediation status
controls.body: The organization employs automated mechanisms [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to determine the state of information system components with regard to flaw remediation.

controls.name: SI-8 (1) Spam protection | central management
controls.title: SI-8 (1) Spam protection | central management
controls.body: The organization centrally manages spam protection mechanisms.

controls.name: AC-2 (10) Account management | shared / group account credential termination
controls.title: AC-2 (10) Account management | shared / group account credential termination
controls.body: The information system terminates shared/group account credentials when members leave the group.

controls.name: AC10.0 - Password Management System
controls.title: AC10.0 - Password Management System
controls.body: A password management system is implemented to generate and manage database passwords.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.12 - Environmental Impact Assessment
controls.title: Environmental Impact Assessment
controls.body: Environmental impact and sustainability of AI model training and management activities – as identified in the MAP function – are assessed and documented.

controls.name: AC4.0 - Mobile Device Encryption
controls.title: AC4.0 - Mobile Device Encryption
controls.body: Mobile OS encryption is enabled or 3rd party storage encryption installed to secure files.

controls.name: CM.AW-P6 - Maintenance of Data Provenance and Lineage
controls.title: Maintenance of Data Provenance and Lineage
controls.body: Data provenance and lineage are maintained and can be accessed for review or transmission/disclosure.

controls.name: MEASURE.2.13 - TEVV Metrics Evaluation
controls.title: TEVV Metrics Evaluation
controls.body: Effectiveness of the employed TEVV metrics and processes in the MEASURE function are evaluated and documented.

controls.name: SI-MC-ML.2.999 - System and Information Integrity Policy
controls.title: SI-MC-ML.2.999 - System and Information Integrity Policy
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes System and Information Integrity (SI).

controls.name: CM.AW-P7 - Breach Notifications
controls.title: Breach Notifications
controls.body: Impacted individuals and organizations are notified about a privacy breach or event.

controls.name: Clause 7.4 - Communication
controls.title: Clause 7.4 - Communication

controls.name: Clause 8.2.2 - Results Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
controls.title: Clause 8.2.2 - Results Business Impact Analysis (BIA)

controls.name: MANAGE.2.4 - Decommissioning of AI Systems
controls.title: Decommissioning of AI Systems
controls.body: Mechanisms are in place and applied, responsibilities are assigned and understood to supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems that demonstrate performance or outcomes inconsistent with intended use.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.A.3 - Incident Response Testing from Attacker's Perspective
controls.title: Incident Response Testing from Attacker's Perspective
controls.body: Incident response testing evaluates the institution from an attacker's perspective to determine how the institution or its assets at critical third parties may be targeted.

controls.name: AC-MC-ML.2.999 - Access Control Policy
controls.title: AC-MC-ML.2.999 - Access Control Policy
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes Access Control (AC).

controls.name: AU-8 Time stamps
controls.title: AU-8 Time stamps
controls.body:
The information system:
 a. Uses internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records; and
 b. Records time stamps for audit records that can be mapped to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) or Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) and meets [Assignment: organization-defined granularity of time measurement].

controls.name: MANAGE.4.3 - AI Incident Management
controls.title: AI Incident Management
controls.body: Incidents and errors are communicated to relevant AI actors including affected communities. Processes for tracking, responding to, and recovering from incidents and errors are followed and documented.

controls.name: PCI 5.1 - Anti-virus Deployment
controls.title: PCI 5.1 - Anti-virus Deployment
controls.body:
Deploy anti-virus software on all systems commonly affected by malicious software (particularly personal computers and servers).

- 5.1.1   Ensure that anti-virus programs are capable of detecting, removing, and protecting against all known types of malicious software.
- 5.1.2   For systems considered to be not commonly affected by malicious software, perform periodic evaluations to identify and evaluate evolving malware threats in order to confirm whether such systems continue to not require anti-virus software.

controls.name: SC-7(20) - Boundary Protection | Dynamic Isolation and Segregation
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Dynamic Isolation and Segregation
controls.body: Provide the capability to dynamically isolate [Assignment: organization-defined system components] from other system components.

controls.name: RA-5 (8) Vulnerability scanning | review historic audit logs
controls.title: RA-5 (8) Vulnerability scanning | review historic audit logs
controls.body: The organization reviews historic audit logs to determine if a vulnerability identified in the information system has been previously exploited.

controls.name: PCI 8.2.4 - Change User Passwords
controls.title: Change User Passwords
controls.body: Change user passwords/passphrases at least once every 90 days.

controls.name: AC-3 Access enforcement
controls.title: AC-3 Access enforcement
controls.body: The information system enforces approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

controls.name: MANAGE.4.2 - AI Continuous Improvement Integration
controls.title: AI Continuous Improvement Integration
controls.body: Measurable activities for continual improvements are integrated into AI system updates and include regular engagement with interested parties, including relevant AI actors.

controls.name: AC9.2 - Firewall Security
controls.title: AC9.2 - Firewall Security
controls.body: System firewalls are configured on the application gateway and production network. Firewall rules are reviewed on an annual basis by IT management.

controls.name: APP 12.1 - Access Requests by Individuals for Organizations
controls.title: Access Requests by Individuals for Organizations
controls.body: The organization has implemented policies, procedures and/or mechanisms to meet its obligations to individuals to access their personal information. Such access requests are documented, retained, and acted upon within a reasonable period after the request is made.

controls.name: 7.1.1 - Communication to Individuals
controls.title: Communication to Individuals
controls.body: Individuals are informed that personal information is disclosed to third parties only for the purposes identified in the notice and for which the individual has provided implicit or explicit consent unless a law or regulation specifically allows or requires otherwise .

controls.name: 7.1.2 - Communication to third Parties
controls.title: Communication to third Parties
controls.body: Privacy policies or other specific instructions or requirements for handling personal information are communicated to third parties to whom personal information is disclosed .

controls.name: M42.06 - Establishment of rules regarding updating and supplementing the documentation
controls.title: Establishment of rules regarding updating and supplementing the documentation
controls.body: Establishment of rules regarding updating and supplementing the documentation

controls.name: CM.PO-P1 - Data Processing Transparency Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Data Processing Transparency Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Transparency policies, processes, and procedures for communicating data processing purposes, practices, and associated privacy risks are established and in place.

controls.name: AC-4 Information flow enforcement
controls.title: AC-4 Information flow enforcement
controls.body: The information system enforces approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between interconnected systems based on [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control policies].

controls.name: AIC4.21 - Usage of Personal Information
controls.title: AIC4.21 - Usage of Personal Information
controls.body: Usage of personal information is restricted for the purpose it was collected as specified in the consents.

controls.name: M42.07 - Access controls for the documentation
controls.title: Access controls for the documentation
controls.body: Access controls for the documentation

controls.name: CM.PO-P2 - Roles and Responsibilities for Data Processing Communications
controls.title: Roles and Responsibilities for Data Processing Communications
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities (e.g., public relations) for communicating data processing purposes, practices, and associated privacy risks are established.

controls.name: 7.2.2 - Protection of Personal Information
controls.title: Protection of Personal Information
controls.body: Personal information is disclosed only to third parties who have agreements with the entity to protect personal information in a manner consistent with the relevant aspects of the entity’s privacy policies or other specific instructions or requirements . The entity has procedures in place to evaluate that the third parties have effective controls to meet the terms of the agreement, instructions, or requirements .

controls.name: 7.2.3 - New Purposes and uses
controls.title: New Purposes and uses
controls.body: Personal information is disclosed to third parties for new purposes or uses only with the prior implicit or explicit consent of the individual .

controls.name: CT.DM-P10 - Privacy-Preserving Algorithmic Design
controls.title: Privacy-Preserving Algorithmic Design
controls.body: Stakeholder privacy preferences are included in algorithmic design objectives and outputs are evaluated against these preferences.

controls.name: C.4.1.3 - Surveillance of Customer Space
controls.title: Surveillance of Customer Space
controls.body:
IF video cameras are monitoring private spaces receiving visitors or customers THEN:
A) There shall be visible information that video surveillance is performed on the premises.

controls.name: CCPA 6.1 - Annual Cybersecurity Audit
controls.title: Annual Cybersecurity Audit
controls.body: The organization conducts an annual cybersecurity audit if their processing of personal information presents a significant risk to the consumer's privacy or security. Identified findings are tracked and remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: PCI 6.7 - Procedures for Software Development
controls.title: PCI 6.7 - Procedures for Software Development
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for developing and maintaining secure systems and applications are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: 7.2.4 - Misuse of Personal Information by a third Party
controls.title: Misuse of Personal Information by a third Party
controls.body: The entity takes remedial action in response to misuse of personal information by a third party to whom the entity has transferred such information .

controls.name: IA-12(1) - Identity Proofing | Supervisor Authorization
controls.title: Identity Proofing | Supervisor Authorization
controls.body: Require that the registration process to receive an account for logical access includes supervisor or sponsor authorization.

controls.name: CT.DM-P1 - Data Element Accessibility for Review
controls.title: Data Element Accessibility for Review
controls.body: Data elements can be accessed for review.

controls.name: CC1.3.4 - Review Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: CC1.3.4 - Review Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Reporting relationships and organizational structures are reviewed periodically by senior management as part of organizational planning and adjusted as needed.

controls.name: 6.1 - Annual Cybersecurity Audit
controls.title: Annual Cybersecurity Audit
controls.body: The organization conducts an annual cybersecurity audit if their processing of personal information presents a significant risk to the consumer's privacy or security. Identified findings are tracked and remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: §164.316(b)(2) (i) - Maintenance and Retention of Records (R)
controls.title: §164.316(b)(2) (i) - Maintenance and Retention of Records (R)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under- §164.316(b)(1)- Maintenance and Retention of Records (R)

controls.name: AU2.2 - Technical Support Guidelines
controls.title: AU2.2 - Technical Support Guidelines
controls.body: The organization provides external parties with technical support guidelines and resources relating to system operations on its website.

controls.name: AC-4 (21) Information flow enforcement | physical / logical separation of information flows
controls.title: AC-4 (21) Information flow enforcement | physical / logical separation of information flows
controls.body: The information system separates information flows logically or physically using [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms and/or techniques] to accomplish [Assignment: organization- defined required separations by types of information].

controls.name: AC-5 Separation of duties
controls.title: AC-5 Separation of duties
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Separates [Assignment: organization-defined duties of individuals];
 b. Documents separation of duties of individuals; and
 c. Defines information system access authorizations to support separation of duties.

controls.name: G.9.1.1 - Designation of the Data Protection Officer
controls.title: Designation of the Data Protection Officer
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have designated a Data Protection Officer.

controls.name: PCI 5.2 - Anti-virus Updates and Logs
controls.title: PCI 5.2 - Anti-virus Updates and Logs
controls.body:
Ensure that all anti-virus mechanisms are maintained as follows: 

- Are kept current
- Perform periodic scans 
- Generate audit logs which are retained per PCI DSS Requirement 10.7.

controls.name: 8.0.0 - Security for Privacy
controls.title: Security for Privacy
controls.body: The entity protects personal information against unauthorized access (both physical and logical).

controls.name: 8.1.0 - Privacy Policies
controls.title: Privacy Policies
controls.body: The entity’s privacy policies (including any relevant security policies) address the security of personal information .

controls.name: AIC13.5 - Access to Output Data
controls.title: AIC13.5 - Access to Output Data
controls.body: Processes have been implemented for the distribution of output data to intended users only in accordance with system commitments. The distribution of output data is tracked and logged.

controls.name: CT.DM-P3 - Data Element Accessibility for Alteration
controls.title: Data Element Accessibility for Alteration
controls.body: Data elements can be accessed for alteration.

controls.name: CA-3 (5) System interconnections | restrictions on external system connections
controls.title: CA-3 (5) System interconnections | restrictions on external system connections
controls.body: The organization employs [Selection: allow-all, deny-by-exception; deny-all, permit-by-exception] policy for allowing [Assignment: organization-defined information systems] to connect to external information systems.

controls.name: SO2.0 - Incident Response Checklist
controls.title: SO2.0 - Incident Response Checklist
controls.body: Incident Response checklist created based on the incident response policy steps to track events.

controls.name: 8.1.1 - Communication to Individuals
controls.title: Communication to Individuals
controls.body: Individuals are informed that precautions are taken to protect personal information .

controls.name: 5.2.2 - Retention of Personal Information
controls.title: Retention of Personal Information
controls.body: Personal information is retained for no longer than necessary to fulfill the stated purposes unless a law or regulation specifically requires otherwise .

controls.name: TLS.2.1.01.a - Verwendung von TLS-Protokoll-Versionen
controls.title: Verwendung von TLS-Protokoll-Versionen
controls.body: Die Einrichtung MUSS TLS in der Version TLS 1.2 und/oder TLS 1.3 einsetzen.

controls.name: AU-11 Audit record retention
controls.title: AU-11 Audit record retention
controls.body: The organization retains audit records for [Assignment: organization-defined time period consistent with records retention policy] to provide support for after-the-fact investigations of security incidents and to meet regulatory and organizational information retention requirements.

controls.name: CT.DM-P4 - Data Element Accessibility for Deletion
controls.title: Data Element Accessibility for Deletion
controls.body: Data elements can be accessed for deletion.

controls.name: §164.414(a) - Breach Administrative Requirements (S)
controls.title: §164.414(a) - Breach Administrative Requirements (S)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.530(b), (d), (e), (g), (h), (i), and (j) with respect to 45 CFR Part 164, Subpart D ("the Breach Notification Rule")

controls.name: 5.2.3 - Disposal, destruction and redaction of Personal Information
controls.title: Disposal, destruction and redaction of Personal Information
controls.body: Personal information no longer retained is anonymized, disposed of or destroyed in a manner that prevents loss, theft, misuse or unauthorized access .

controls.name: 6.0.0 - Access
controls.title: Access
controls.body: The entity provides individuals with access to their personal information for review and update.

controls.name: CT.DM-P6 - Transmission of Data
controls.title: Transmission of Data
controls.body: Data are transmitted using standardized formats.

controls.name: §164.316(b)(2) (ii) - Policies and Procedures (S)
controls.title: §164.316(b)(2) (ii) - Policies and Procedures (S)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under- § 164.308(a)(1)(i) - Policies and Procedures (S)

controls.name: AC-6 Least privilege
controls.title: AC-6 Least privilege
controls.body: The organization employs the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) which are necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational missions and business functions.

controls.name: IA-8 (2) Identification and authentication | acceptance of third-party credentials
controls.title: IA-8 (2) Identification and authentication | acceptance of third-party credentials
controls.body: The information system accepts only FICAM-approved third-party credentials.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.E.1 - User Access Change Notifications
controls.title: User Access Change Notifications
controls.body: Changes to user access permissions trigger automated notices to appropriate personnel.

controls.name: DP9 - Data Privacy Officer
controls.title: Data Privacy Officer
controls.body: The organization has appointed a Privacy Officer who is accountable for developing, implementing and maintaining organization-wide governance and privacy program to comply with applicable laws and regulations regarding the collection, use, maintenance, sharing and disclosure of personal information.

controls.name: 6.1.0 - Privacy Policies
controls.title: Privacy Policies
controls.body: The entity’s privacy policies address providing individuals with access to their personal information .

controls.name: G.9.1.2 - DPO Requirements
controls.title: DPO Requirements
controls.body: A) The data protection officer of the Applicant shall have an education in law or a certified training in data protection regulations.

controls.name: §164.316(b)(2) (iii) - Policies and Procedures (S)
controls.title: §164.316(b)(2) (iii) - Policies and Procedures (S)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under- § 164.308(a)(1)(i) - Policies and Procedures (S)

controls.name: AU-12 Audit generation
controls.title: AU-12 Audit generation
controls.body:
The information system:
 a. Provides audit record generation capability for the auditable events defined in AU-2 a. at [Assignment: organization-defined information system components];
 b. Allows [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] to select which auditable events are to be audited by specific components of the information system; and
 c. Generates audit records for the events defined in AU-2 d. with the content defined in AU-3.

controls.name: PCI 2.6 - Shared Hosting Providers
controls.title: PCI 2.6 - Shared Hosting Providers
controls.body:
Shared hosting providers must protect each entity's hosted environment and cardholder data. 

These providers must meet specific requirements as detailed in Appendix A1: Additional PCI DSS Requirements for Shared Hosting Providers.

controls.name: CT.DM-P8 - Data Audit Record Management
controls.title: Data Audit Record Management
controls.body: Audit/log records are determined, documented, implemented, and reviewed in accordance with policy and incorporating the principle of data minimization.

controls.name: G.9.2.1 - DPO Mandate Communication
controls.title: DPO Mandate Communication

controls.name: PCI 6.4 - Change Control Process
controls.title: Change Control Process
controls.body: Follow change control processes and procedures for all changes to system components.

controls.name: AC-6 (1) Least privilege | authorize access to security functions
controls.title: AC-6 (1) Least privilege | authorize access to security functions
controls.body: The organization explicitly authorizes access to [Assignment: organization-defined security functions (deployed in hardware, software, and firmware) and security-relevant information].

controls.name: IA-8 (3) Identification and authentication | use of ficam-approved products
controls.title: IA-8 (3) Identification and authentication | use of ficam-approved products
controls.body:
The organization employs only FICAM-approved information system components in [Assignment:
organization-defined information systems] to accept third-party credentials.

controls.name: CT.DM-P9 - Technical Measures for Data Processing
controls.title: Technical Measures for Data Processing
controls.body: Technical measures implemented to manage data processing are tested and assessed.

controls.name: G.9.2.3 - DPO Independence
controls.title: DPO Independence

controls.name: AC-17 (1) Remote access | automated monitoring / control
controls.title: AC-17 (1) Remote access | automated monitoring / control
controls.body: The information system monitors and controls remote access methods.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.2 - Separation of Duties in the Development and Production Environment
controls.title: Separation of Duties in the Development and Production Environment
controls.body: Separation of duties between development/test and production environments

controls.name: CT.DP-P1 - Privacy-Preserving Data Processing
controls.title: Privacy-Preserving Data Processing
controls.body: Data are processed to limit observability and linkability (e.g., data actions take place on local devices, privacy-preserving cryptography).

controls.name: G.9.2.4 - Data Subjects Access to the DPO
controls.title: Data Subjects Access to the DPO
controls.body: A) The data subjects shall be able to contact the DPO from the website of the Applicant.

controls.name: AC6.0 - Remote Access Policy Notices
controls.title: AC6.0 - Remote Access Policy Notices
controls.body: Users are sent regular notices of the remote access policy.

controls.name: CA-1 Security assessment and authorization policy and procedures
controls.title: CA-1 Security assessment and authorization policy and procedures
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Develops, documents, and disseminates to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
   1. A security assessment and authorization policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
   2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the security assessment and authorization policy and associated security assessment and authorization controls; and
 b. Reviews and updates the current:
   1. Security assessment and authorization policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; and
   2. Security assessment and authorization procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: CT.DP-P2 - De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.title: De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.body: Data are processed to limit the identification of individuals (e.g., de-identification privacy techniques, tokenization).

controls.name: IA-5 (4) Authenticator management | automated support for password strength determination
controls.title: IA-5 (4) Authenticator management | automated support for password strength determination
controls.body: The organization employs automated tools to determine if password authenticators are sufficiently strong to satisfy [Assignment: organization-defined requirements].

controls.name: AU-9 (4) Protection of audit information | access by subset of privileged users
controls.title: AU-9 (4) Protection of audit information | access by subset of privileged users
controls.body: The organization authorizes access to management of audit functionality to only [Assignment: organization-defined subset of privileged users].

controls.name: G.9.2.6 - Adequacy of DPO Work Time
controls.title: Adequacy of DPO Work Time

controls.name: IC11.1 - External Network Equipment Firewall
controls.title: IC11.1 - External Network Equipment Firewall
controls.body: Network devices are configured securely and are protected by firewalls.

controls.name: PCI 8.6 - Additional Authentication Mechanism
controls.title: PCI 8.6 - Additional Authentication Mechanism
controls.body:
Where other authentication mechanisms are used (for example, physical or logical security tokens, smart cards, certificates, etc.), use of these mechanisms must be assigned as follows:

- Authentication mechanisms must be assigned to an individual account and not shared among multiple accounts.
- Physical and/or logical controls must be in place to ensure only the intended account can use that mechanism to gain access.

controls.name: CT.DP-P3 - Behavioural Inference Limitation Measures
controls.title: Behavioural Inference Limitation Measures
controls.body: Data are processed to limit the formulation of inferences about individuals’ behavior or activities (e.g., data processing is decentralized, distributed architectures).

controls.name: G.9.3.1 - DPO Tasks and Duties
controls.title: DPO Tasks and Duties

controls.name: CP-2 (2) Contingency plan | capacity planning
controls.title: CP-2 (2) Contingency plan | capacity planning
controls.body: The organization conducts capacity planning so that necessary capacity for information processing, telecommunications, and environmental support exists during contingency operations.

controls.name: CP-2 (3) Contingency plan | resume essential missions / business functions
controls.title: CP-2 (3) Contingency plan | resume essential missions / business functions
controls.body:
The organization plans for the resumption of essential missions and business functions within
[Assignment: organization-defined time period] of contingency plan activation.

controls.name: CT.DP-P4 - Selective Collection or Disclosure of Data Elements
controls.title: Selective Collection or Disclosure of Data Elements
controls.body: System or device configurations permit selective collection or disclosure of data elements.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.5.2 - Change Approval Documentation
controls.title: Change Approval Documentation
controls.body: Documented change approval by authorized parties.

controls.name: CP-2 (8) Contingency plan | identify critical assets
controls.title: CP-2 (8) Contingency plan | identify critical assets
controls.body: The organization identifies critical information system assets supporting essential missions and business functions.

controls.name: AT2 - Information Security and Privacy Awareness Training
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Awareness Training
controls.body: Employees are required to complete an information security and privacy awareness training annually.

controls.name: AC9.4 - Production System Software Tracking
controls.title: AC9.4 - Production System Software Tracking
controls.body: Software installations/upgrades on all production systems are controlled and documented.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.B.3 - Report on Information Security and Business Continuity Programs
controls.title: Report on Information Security and Business Continuity Programs
controls.body: Management provides a written report on the overall status of the information security and business continuity programs to the board or an appropriate board committee at least annually. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 5)

controls.name: AC9.7 - Server Log Review
controls.title: AC9.7 - Server Log Review
controls.body: Logs generated from the management system are reviewed quarterly.

controls.name: CT.DP-P5 - Attribute Reference Substitution
controls.title: Attribute Reference Substitution
controls.body: Attribute references are substituted for attribute values.

controls.name: AC2.0 - Physical Security Management
controls.title: AC2.0 - Physical Security Management
controls.body: Physical security controls are designed and documented to ensure protection of areas that contain either sensitive or critical information and information processing facilities.

controls.category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, and Procedures
controls.name: CT.PO-P1 - Data Processing Authorization Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Data Processing Authorization Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures for authorizing data processing (e.g., organizational decisions, individual consent), revoking authorizations, and maintaining authorizations are established and in place.

controls.name: CIS 2.6-PR - Whitelist Authorized Libraries
controls.title: Whitelist Authorized Libraries
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard 2.6: Allowlist authorized libraries.

controls.name: BC1.9 - Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.title: BC1.9 - Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.body: Business continuity and disaster recovery plans have been developed and tested annually. Test results are reviewed and contingency plans are updated accordingly.

controls.name: BC1.3 - BCP Corporate Recovery Plans and Checklists
controls.title: BC1.3 - BCP Corporate Recovery Plans and Checklists
controls.body: Recovery plans and checklists exist for each functional area.

controls.name: CA.L2-3.12.4 - System Security Plan (NIST 800-171: 3.12.4)
controls.title: System Security Plan (NIST 800-171: 3.12.4)
controls.body: Develop, document and periodically update System Security Plans (SSPs) that describe system boundaries, system environments of operation, how security requirements are implemented and the relationships with, or connections to, other systems.

controls.name: AC-17 Remote access
controls.title: AC-17 Remote access
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Establishes and documents usage restrictions, configuration/connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed; and
 b. Authorizes remote access to the information system prior to allowing such connections.

controls.name: AC-21 Information sharing
controls.title: AC-21 Information sharing
controls.body:
The organization:
a. Facilitates information sharing by enabling authorized users to determine whether access authorizations assigned to the sharing partner match the access restrictions on the information for [Assignment: organization-defined information sharing circumstances where user discretion is required]; and
b. Employs [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms or manual processes] to assist users in making information sharing/collaboration decisions

controls.name: PCI 10.7 - Audit Trail Retention
controls.title: PCI 10.7 - Audit Trail Retention
controls.body: Retain audit trail history for at least one year, with a minimum of three months immediately available for analysis (for example, online, archived, or restorable from backup).

controls.name: CM-8(4) - System Component Inventory | Accountability Information
controls.title: System Component Inventory | Accountability Information
controls.body: Include in the system component inventory information, a means for identifying by [Selection (one or more): name; position; role], individuals responsible and accountable for administering those components.

controls.category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, And Procedures
controls.name: CT.PO-P4 - Data Lifecycle Integration with System Development
controls.title: Data Lifecycle Integration with System Development
controls.body: A data life cycle to manage data is aligned and implemented with the system development life cycle to manage systems.

controls.name: IC6.1 - Physical Media Transfer
controls.title: IC6.1 - Physical Media Transfer
controls.body: The organization protects any media containing information during transit in and out of its premises.

controls.name: RA.L3-3.11.4e - Security Solutions Rationale (NIST 800-172:3.11.4E)
controls.title: Security Solutions Rationale (NIST 800-172:3.11.4E)
controls.body: Document or reference in the system security plan the security solution selected, the rationale for the security solution, and the risk determination.

controls.name: GV.AT-P1 - Workforce Awareness Training
controls.title: Workforce Awareness Training
controls.body: The workforce is informed and trained on its roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: OM5.1 - Protect Recycling and Trash
controls.title: OM5.1 - Protect Recycling and Trash
controls.body: Recycling bins are protected.

controls.name: AC.L1-B.1.II [FCI DATA] / AC.L2-3.1.2 [CUI DATA] - Transaction & Function Control (NIST 800-171: 3.1.2)
controls.title: Transaction & Function Control (NIST 800-171: 3.1.2)
controls.body: Limit information system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

controls.name: AT-2 (2) Security awareness | insider threat
controls.title: AT-2 (2) Security awareness | insider threat
controls.body: The organization includes security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat.

controls.name: SA-4 (10) Acquisition process | use of approved piv products
controls.title: SA-4 (10) Acquisition process | use of approved piv products
controls.body: The organization employs only information technology products on the FIPS 201-approved products list for Personal Identity Verification (PIV) capability implemented within organizational information systems.

controls.name: PCI 1.4 - Firewall on Portable Computing Devices
controls.title: PCI 1.4 - Firewall on Portable Computing Devices
controls.body:
Install personal firewall software or equivalent functionality on any portable computing devices (including company and/or employee-owned) that connect to the Internet when outside the network (for example, laptops used by employees), and which are also used to access the CDE. 

Firewall (or equivalent) configurations include: 

- Specific configuration settings are defined. 
- Personal firewall (or equivalent functionality) is actively running. 
- Personal firewall (or equivalent functionality) is not alterable by users of the portable computing devices.

controls.name: AC-6 (2) Least privilege | non-privileged access for nonsecurity functions
controls.title: AC-6 (2) Least privilege | non-privileged access for nonsecurity functions
controls.body: The organization requires that users of information system accounts, or roles, with access to [Assignment: organization-defined security functions or security-relevant information], use non- privileged accounts or roles, when accessing nonsecurity functions.

controls.name: AT.L3-3.2.1e - Advanced Threat Awareness (NIST 800-172:3.2.1E)
controls.title: Advanced Threat Awareness (NIST 800-172:3.2.1E)
controls.body: Provide awareness training [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] focused on recognizing and responding to threats from social engineering, advanced persistent threat actors, breaches, and suspicious behaviors; update the training [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or when there are significant changes to the threat.

controls.name: AC8.5 - File Integrity Hashing
controls.title: AC8.5 - File Integrity Hashing
controls.body: SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 or SHA-3 are used as hashing functions.

controls.name: GV.AT-P2 - Senior Executive Awareness Training
controls.title: Senior Executive Awareness Training
controls.body: Senior executives understand their roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: AAC3.7 - User Account Reviews
controls.title: AAC3.7 - User Account Reviews
controls.body: Access rights of employees and contractors to information and systems are adjusted relevant to the changes on their employment, contract or agreement.

controls.name: AT.L3-3.2.2e - Practical Training Exercises (NIST 800-172:3.2.2E)
controls.title: Practical Training Exercises (NIST 800-172:3.2.2E)
controls.body: Include practical exercises in awareness training for [Assignment: organization-defined roles] that are aligned with current threat scenarios and provide feedback to individuals involved in the training and their supervisors.

controls.name: AIC4.22 - Personal Information Disposal
controls.title: AIC4.22 - Personal Information Disposal
controls.body: Personal information no longer required for its intended purpose is disposed of or destroyed in accordance with defined data retention and disposal procedures.

controls.name: GV.AT-P3 - Privacy Personnel Awareness Training
controls.title: Privacy Personnel Awareness Training
controls.body: Privacy personnel understand their roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: CM.L3-3.4.1e - Authoritative Repository (NIST 800-172:3.4.1E)
controls.title: Authoritative Repository (NIST 800-172:3.4.1E)
controls.body: Establish and maintain an authoritative source and repository to provide a trusted source and accountability for approved and implemented system components.

controls.name: IA.L1-B.1.VI [FCI DATA] / IA.L2-3.5.2 [CUI DATA] - Authentication (NIST 800-171: 3.5.2)

controls.name: 1.3.6 - Appropriate reporting - 6

controls.name: IA-2 (8) Identification and authentication | network access to privileged accounts - replay resistant
controls.title: IA-2 (8) Identification and authentication | network access to privileged accounts - replay resistant

controls.name: CM.L3-3.4.2e - Automated Detection & Remediation (NIST 800-172:3.4.2E)
controls.title: Automated Detection & Remediation (NIST 800-172:3.4.2E)
controls.body: Employ automated mechanisms to detect misconfigured or unauthorized system components; after detection, [Selection (one or more): remove the components; place the components in a quarantine or remediation network] to facilitate patching, reconfiguration, or other mitigations.

controls.name: MP.L1-B.1.VII [FCI DATA] / MP.L2-3.8.3 [CUI DATA] - Media Disposal (NIST 800-171: 3.8.3)
controls.title: Media Disposal (NIST 800-171: 3.8.3)

controls.name: OM2.16 - Personnel Responsibility and Accountability
controls.title: OM2.16 - Personnel Responsibility and Accountability
controls.body: The responsibility and accountability for designing, developing, implementing, operating, maintaining, monitoring, and approving relevant system controls are assigned to personnel with appropriate competency and authority to perform the related duties.

controls.name: OM2.18 - Resource Evaluation
controls.title: OM2.18 - Resource Evaluation
controls.body: As part of its ongoing efforts in business planning, budgeting, and risk assessments, senior management evaluates the need for additional tools and resources in order to achieve its business objectives.

controls.name: OM2.19 - Third-Party Evaluation
controls.title: OM2.19 - Third-Party Evaluation

Entities found to be lacking in or non-compliant with relevant commitments and requirements (e.g., security, availability, confidentiality) and other relevant policies and procedures are refused.

controls.name: SSPA20 - Personal Data in  Acceptable Formats
controls.title: SSPA20 - Personal Data in  Acceptable Formats
controls.body: The organization enables Microsoft or obtains a copy of the requested Microsoft Personal Data for the authenticated Data Subject in an appropriate printed, electronic or verbal format.

controls.name: GV.AT-P4 - Third-party Stakeholders Responsibilities
controls.title: Third-party Stakeholders Responsibilities
controls.body: Third parties (e.g., service providers, customers, partners) understand their roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: IA.L3-3.5.1e - Bidirectional Authentication (NIST 800-172:3.5.1E)
controls.title: Bidirectional Authentication (NIST 800-172:3.5.1E)

controls.name: AC2.11 - Review Compliance of Vendors/Service Providers
controls.title: AC2.11 - Review Compliance of Vendors/Service Providers

controls.name: HP - Individuals Access to PHI and Denials (R)
controls.title: Individuals Access to PHI and Denials (R)
controls.body: Access request from individuals to obtain and review their PHI is documented, retained, and acted upon within 30 days from the receipt of the request. Any denial of access is communicated to individuals and handled in accordance with the requirement 45 CFR §164.524.

controls.name: PCI 11.2 - Quarterly Internal Vulnerability Scans
controls.title: PCI 11.2 - Quarterly Internal Vulnerability Scans
controls.body: Perform quarterly internal vulnerability scans. Address vulnerabilities and perform rescans to verify all “high risk” vulnerabilities are resolved in accordance with the entity’s vulnerability ranking (per Requirement 6.1). Scans must be performed by qualified personnel.

controls.name: Documented Incident Management Process
controls.title: Documented Incident Management Process
controls.body: A formal incident management process has been established and implemented which requires incidents to be tracked, documented and resolved in a complete, accurate and timely manner. The process document is reviewed by management on an annual basis and updated as required.

controls.name: Incident Resolution and communication
controls.title: Incident Resolution and communication
controls.body: All incidents related to security are logged, tracked and communicated to affected parties. Incidents are resolved in a timely manner in accordance to formal incident management process.

controls.name: PCI 2.4 - Asset Inventory in PCI DSS Scope
controls.title: PCI 2.4 - Asset Inventory in PCI DSS Scope

controls.name: AAC11.4 - Privilege Accounts for Serverless Functions
controls.title: AAC11.4 - Privilege Accounts for Serverless Functions
controls.body: Access to generic administrator or privileged accounts to the serverless architecture function is restricted to authorized personnel.

controls.name: MAP.3.2 - AI System Cost Analysis
controls.title: AI System Cost Analysis
controls.body: Potential costs, including non-monetary costs, which result from expected or realized AI errors or system functionality and trustworthiness - as connected to organizational risk tolerance - are examined and documented.

controls.name: OM2.1 - Security Team
controls.title: OM2.1 - Security Team
controls.body: The security team is defined.

controls.name: GV.MT-P1 - Continuous Privacy Risk Assessment
controls.title: Continuous Privacy Risk Assessment
controls.body: Privacy risk is re-evaluated on an ongoing basis and as key factors, including the organization’s business environment (e.g., introduction of new technologies), governance (e.g., legal obligations, risk tolerance), data processing, and systems/products/services change.

controls.name: OM8.6 - Confidentiality Commitments with Customers
controls.title: OM8.6 - Confidentiality Commitments with Customers

controls.name: IC4.2x
controls.title: IC4.2x

individuals resulting from the collection, sharing, storing, transmitting, use, and disposal of
personally identifiable information (PII).

controls.name: IC10.2 - Internal Lab IPS
controls.title: IC10.2 - Internal Lab IPS
controls.body: Intrusion prevention systems (IPS) are installed and protect internal lab systems.

controls.name: GV.MT-P2 - Privacy Policy and Training Review and Communication
controls.title: Privacy Policy and Training Review and Communication

controls.name: IC9.0 - External Lab Firewalls
controls.title: IC9.0 - External Lab Firewalls
controls.body: Firewalls are installed and enabled on perimeter and on external lab systems.

controls.name: 6.1.1 - Communication to Individuals
controls.title: Communication to Individuals

controls.name: IA.L3-3.5.3e - Block Untrusted Assets (NIST 800-172:3.5.3E)

controls.name: GV.MT-P3 - Privacy Compliance Review
controls.title: Privacy Compliance Review
controls.body: Policies, processes, and procedures for assessing compliance with legal requirements and privacy policies are established and in place.

controls.name: AOM3.9 - Code of Conduct
controls.title: AOM3.9 - Code of Conduct

controls.name: AOM3.0 - Background Checks
controls.title: AOM3.0 - Background Checks

controls.title: IC9.1 - External Lab IDS
