controls.body: Data processing ecosystem parties are routinely assessed using audits, test results, or other forms of evaluations to confirm they are meeting their contractual, interoperability framework, or other obligations.

controls.name: AC8.6 - User Password Hashing
controls.title: AC8.6 - User Password Hashing
controls.body:
HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) with at least 1,000 rounds is used for securing user passwords.

All user passwords are salted on a per secret basis.
 1. The salt is random.
 2. The salt size is the same length as the output of the hashing function.
 3. The salt is not considered a secret.

controls.name: AC5.4 - Administrative Passwords
controls.title: AC5.4 - Administrative Passwords
controls.body:
Applicable to Administrative passwords. 
Administrative passwords carry more risk than regular user passwords due to the privileges associated with the account. Hence, enhance controls around their usage.

controls.name: AC5.2 - Corporate Password Management
controls.title: AC5.2 - Corporate Password Management
controls.body: A password management system is implemented for all organization users.

controls.name: AC9.10 - Server Log Access
controls.title: AC9.10 - Server Log Access
controls.body: Access controls are implemented to prevent unauthorized access to event logs.

controls.name: AC9.13 - System Security Standards
controls.title: AC9.13 - System Security Standards
controls.body: Configuration standards are in place and required to be utilized when deploying new systems into production.

controls.name: AC8.4 - Public Key Encryption Algorithms
controls.title: AC8.4 - Public Key Encryption Algorithms
controls.body: The Public Key Encryption Algorithm used is RSA 2048, RSA 3072, RSA 4096, DH 2048 or ECDH.

controls.name: AC8.7 - Digital Signature
controls.title: AC8.7 - Digital Signature
controls.body: ECDSA, P-384 or RSA 2048 or higher is used for digital signature.

controls.name: SO20 - Data Flow Diagram
controls.title: Data Flow Diagram
controls.body: The organization has formally documented a data flow diagram to support the design and operation of controls. The data flow diagram is reviewed and approved by appropriate management representative.

controls.name: ID.IM-P1 - Inventory of Systems/Products/Services
controls.title: Inventory of Systems/Products/Services
controls.body: Systems/products/services that process data are inventoried.

controls.name: DP17 - Contracts with Controllers
controls.title: Contracts with Controllers
controls.body: Organization maintains written contract with controllers on behalf of whom it performs processing of personal data. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by processors for the protection of personal data.

controls.name: AAC11.3 - Account Approval for Serverless Functions
controls.title: AAC11.3 - Account Approval for Serverless Functions
controls.body: Account and roles permissions are approved when deploying a new serverless function based on the least amount of privileges required to perform its task properly.

controls.name: MA-4(5) - Nonlocal Maintenance | Approvals and Notifications
controls.title: Nonlocal Maintenance | Approvals and Notifications
controls.body:
a. Require the approval of each nonlocal maintenance session by [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; and
b. Notify the following personnel or roles of the date and time of planned nonlocal maintenance: [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: AAC11.1 - Serverless Function Account Review
controls.title: AAC11.1 - Serverless Function Account Review
controls.body: Serverless functions and associated account permissions are reviewed on a quarterly basis by management to confirm that they are necessary and are configured correctly.

controls.name: AAC11.2 - Access and Authentication for Serverless Functions
controls.title: AAC11.2 - Access and Authentication for Serverless Functions
controls.body: Serverless functions that call out to a service require access control and authentication.

controls.name: CC7.2.1 - Resolving & Escalating Reported Events
controls.title: CC7.2.1 - Resolving & Escalating Reported Events
controls.body: Operations and security personnel follow defined protocols for resolving and escalating reported events. This includes root cause analysis that is escalated to management as required.

controls.name: PCI 7.3 - Procedures for Restricting Access to Cardholder Data
controls.title: Procedures for Restricting Access to Cardholder Data
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for restricting access to cardholder data are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: CC6.6.1 - Encryption Technologies
controls.title: CC6.6.1 - Encryption Technologies
controls.body: SSL, secure file transfer protocol (SFTP), and other encryption technologies are used for defined points of connectivity and to protect communications between the Company systems and end users connecting from within or external to customer networks.

controls.name: CC6.5.1 - Confidential Information Management
controls.title: CC6.5.1 - Confidential Information Management
controls.body:
The entity:
• locates and removes or redacts specified confidential information as required.
• regularly and systematically destroys, erases, or makes anonymous confidential
information that is no longer required for the purposes identified in its confidentiality commitments or system requirements.
• erases or destroys records in accordance with the retention policies, regardless of the method of storage
(for example, electronic, optical media, or paper based).
• disposes of original, archived, backup, and
ad hoc or personal copies of records in accordance with its destruction policies.
• documents the disposal of confidential information.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.2 - Logs for Privileged Account Activities
controls.title: Logs for Privileged Account Activities
controls.body: All actions taken by any individual with root or administrative privileges.

controls.name: SSPA18 - Communication of Access Procedures
controls.title: SSPA18 - Communication of Access Procedures
controls.body: The organization communicates to the Data Subject the steps that person must take to gain access to or otherwise exercise their rights in regard to their Microsoft Personal Data.

controls.name: ID.IM-P2 - Inventory of Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Inventory of Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Owners or operators (e.g., the organization or third parties such as service providers, partners, customers, and developers) and their roles with respect to the systems/products/services and components (e.g., internal or external) that process data are inventoried.

controls.name: IC8.1 - Workstation Security Notices
controls.title: IC8.1 - Workstation Security Notices
controls.body: Organization members receive regular reminders to make sure that security applications and services are installed and running.

controls.name: CC6.4.1 - Review Third-Party Audit Reports
controls.title: CC6.4.1 - Review Third-Party Audit Reports
controls.body: Annually, management reviews the third-party audit report/s for data center Subservice Providers to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of physical access and environmental controls.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (5b) - Policy for Employee Agreements
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (5b) - Policy for Employee Agreements
controls.body:
Each school must adopt a policy for designating which school employees are authorized to enter into written agreements with operators. This subsection may not be construed to limit individual school employees outside of the scope of their employment from entering into agreements with operators on their own behalf and for non-K through 12 school purposes, provided that no covered information is provided to the operators. 
Any agreement or contract entered into in violation of this Act is void and unenforceable as against public policy

* #### Your school has adopted a policy designating which school employees are authorized to enter into written agreements related to your student information.

controls.name: AU1.0 - Internal Audit
controls.title: AU1.0 - Internal Audit
controls.body: The organization implements a formalized internal audit function that oversees internal policies and procedures to ensure effective operation.

controls.name: ID.IM-P3 - Inventory of Categories of Individuals
controls.title: Inventory of Categories of Individuals
controls.body: Categories of individuals (e.g., customers, employees or prospective employees, consumers) whose data are being processed are inventoried.

controls.name: IC4.0 - Information Classification
controls.title: IC4.0 - Information Classification
controls.body: Information is classified and labelled in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification.

controls.name: IC4.6 - Data Entry Validation
controls.title: IC4.6 - Data Entry Validation
controls.body: An input validation system setting that ensures data entry fields are entered correctly

controls.name: OM5.0 - Hardcopy Document Security
controls.title: OM5.0 - Hardcopy Document Security
controls.body: Employees do not leave printed materials containing confidential information unattended in their workspaces.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (1) - Data Elements of Covered Information
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (1) - Data Elements of Covered Information
controls.body:
An explanation, that is clear and understandable by a layperson, of the data elements of covered information that the school collects, maintains, or discloses to any person, entity, third party, or governmental agency. The information must explain how the school uses, to whom or what entities it discloses, and for what purpose it discloses the covered information.# - Your school has an explanation on its website addressing all student information that your school collects.

* #### Your school has an explanation on its website addressing your student information that your school maintains and stores

* #### Your school has an explanation on its website addressing your student information that is disclosed to any person.

* #### Your school has an explanation on its website addressing your student information that is disclosed to any third party.

* #### Your school has an explanation on its website addressing your student information that is disclosed to any governmental agency.

controls.name: CA-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Security Assessment Approach
controls.title: CA-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Security Assessment Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Security Assessment (CA) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (5a) - List of Breaches
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (5a) - List of Breaches
controls.body:
The school may omit from the list required under this paragraph (5)

* (i) any breach in which, to the best of the school's knowledge at the time of updating the list, the number of students whose covered information is involved in the breach is less than 10% of the school's enrollment, 

* (ii) any breach in which, at the time of posting the list, the school is not required to notify the parent of a student under subsection (d), 

* (iii) any breach in which the date, estimated date, or estimated date range in which it occurred is earlier than July 1, 2021, or (iv) any breach previously posted on a list under this paragraph (5) no more than 5 years prior to the school updating the current list.

The school must, at a minimum, update the items under paragraphs (1), (3), (4), and (5) no later than 30 calendar days following the start of a fiscal year and no later than 30 days following the beginning of a calendar year.


  * ####  The list of breaches maintained by your school is updated within 30 days of the start of each fiscal year.

  * ####  The list of breaches maintained by your school is updated within 30 days following the beginning of a calendar year.

controls.name: OM5.3 - Clean Desk/Screen Events
controls.title: OM5.3 - Clean Desk/Screen Events
controls.body: A regular schedule is identified for organization housekeeping and awareness on keeping a clear desk and clear screen in the workplace.

controls.name: OM5.4 - Organized Workspace Reminder
controls.title: OM5.4 - Organized Workspace Reminder
controls.body: Employees are reminded to maintain an orderly workspace and ensure that unattended equipment has appropriate protection.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (5) - Breach Documentation
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (5) - Breach Documentation
controls.body:
A list of any breaches of covered information maintained by the school or breaches under Section 15 that includes, but is not limited to, all of the following information:

(A) The number of students whose covered information is involved in the breach, unless disclosing that number would violate the provisions of the Personal Information Protection Act.

(B) The date, estimated date, or estimated date range of the breach.

(C) For a breach under Section 15, the name of the operator.

   * #### Your school maintains a list of all breaches that involved or may have involved your student information.  

   * #### The list of breaches maintained by your school includes the number of students involved in a breach.

   * #### The list of breaches maintained by your school includes the date of the breach of your student information.

   * #### The list of breaches maintained by your school includes the third party that may have breached your student information.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (5d) - Data Breach Notification
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (5d) - Data Breach Notification
controls.body:
After receipt of notice of a breach under Section 15 or determination of a breach of covered information maintained by the school, a school shall notify, no later than 30 calendar days after receipt of the notice or determination that a breach has occurred, the parent of any student whose covered information is involved in the breach. The notification must include, but is not limited to, all of the following:

(1) The date, estimated date, or estimated date range of the breach.

(2) A description of the covered information that was compromised or reasonably believed to have been compromised in the breach.

(3) Information that the parent may use to contact the operator and school to inquire about the breach.

(4) The toll-free numbers, addresses, and websites for consumer reporting agencies.

(5) The toll-free number, address, and website for the Federal Trade Commission.

(6) A statement that the parent may obtain information from the Federal Trade Commission and consumer reporting agencies about fraud alerts and security freezes.
 
A notice of breach required under this subsection may be delayed if an appropriate law enforcement agency determines that the notification will interfere with a criminal investigation and provides the school with a written request for a delay of notice. A school must comply with the notification requirements as soon as the notification will no longer interfere with the investigation.

* #### Your school has a procedure in place to notify any student or parent that student information maintained by your school has been involved in a breach.

* #### Your school provides notification of a breach involving student information within 30 days of the breach.

* #### Your school has a procedure in place to provide notification of a breach involving student information including the date of the breach. 

* #### Your school has a procedure in place to provide notification of a breach involving student information including a description of the student information that was involved in the breach.

* #### Your school has a procedure in place to provide notification of a breach involving student information including information that may be used to contact the third party that breached the student information for more information concerning the breach. 

* #### Your school has a procedure in place to provide notification of a breach involving student information including information to contact consumer reporting agencies.

* #### Your school has a procedure in place to provide notification of a breach involving student information including contact information for the Federal Trade Commission.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (2) - List of Operators
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (2) - List of Operators
controls.body:
A list of operators that the school has written agreements with, a copy of each written agreement, and a business address for each operator. A copy of a written agreement posted or made available by a school under this paragraph may contain redactions, as provided under subparagraph (F) of paragraph (4) of Section 15.

* #### Your school has written agreements with the operator of an internet website for the use of your student information. 

* #### Your school has written agreements with the operator of an online services for the use of your student information. 

* #### Your school has written agreements with the operator of a mobile application for the use of your student information. 

* #### Your school maintains an internal list of all written agreements related to the use of your student information with third parties.  

* #### Your school provides public access of any lists of all written agreements related to the use of your student information with third parties.  

* #### Your school provides public access to copies all agreements related to the use of your student information.

controls.name: Sec. 33. Provision (a) and (b) - Covered Information
controls.title: Sec. 33. Provision (a) and (b) - Covered Information
controls.body:
(a) A student's covered information shall be collected only for K through 12 school purposes and not further processed in a manner that is incompatible with those purposes.

(b) A student's covered information shall only be adequate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary in relation to the K through 12 school purposes for which it is processed.

* #### Your school limits collection of student information to school purposes.

* #### Your school does not collect student information for commercial purposes.

* #### Your school limits collection of student information to information needed to educate students

controls.name: Sec. 26. Provision (2) - Access Provision
controls.title: Sec. 26. Provision (2) - Access Provision
controls.body:
Share, transfer, disclose, or provide access to a student's covered information to an entity or individual, other than the student's parent, school personnel, appointed or elected school board members or local school council members, or the State Board, without a written agreement, unless the disclosure or transfer is:

(A) To the extent permitted by State or federal law, to law enforcement officials to protect the safety of users or others or the security or integrity of the operator's service;
(B) required by court order or State or federal law; or
(C) to ensure legal or regulatory compliance.

*This paragraph (2) does not apply to nonpublic schools.*

* ####  Does your school allow third parties to have access to student information?

controls.name: OM4.0 - Organization Approved Browsers and Plugins
controls.title: OM4.0 - Organization Approved Browsers and Plugins
controls.body: Organization approved browsers are used by its members. This includes authorized browser plugins and configurations.

controls.name: OM8.2 - Whistleblower Hotline
controls.title: OM8.2 - Whistleblower Hotline
controls.body: The organization provides an internal whistle-blower hotline that allows employees to securely and anonymously report issues related to fraud, harassment, theft, corruption and other issues impacting the organization's ethical and integrity requirements.

controls.name: CC6.1.1 - Corporate Resource Restrictions
controls.title: CC6.1.1 - Corporate Resource Restrictions
controls.body: Access to corporate resources is restricted via unique user ID and password and access control lists. User IDs are not reused.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (5c) - Written Agreement
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (5c) - Written Agreement
controls.body:
A school must post on its website or, if the school does not maintain a website, make available at its administrative office for inspection by the general public each written agreement entered into under this Act, along with any information required under subsection (a), no later than 10 business days after entering into the agreement.

* #### Your school posts each written agreement related to student information on its website to be viewed by the general public.

* #### Your school posts each written agreement related to student information on its website to be viewed by the general public within 10 business days after entering into any agreement.

controls.name: ID.IM-P4 - Inventory of Data Actions
controls.title: Inventory of Data Actions
controls.body: Data actions of the systems/products/services are inventoried.

controls.name: OM2.7 - Subscribe to Alerts from Security Authorities
controls.title: OM2.7 - Subscribe to Alerts from Security Authorities
controls.body: The organization maintains contacts with relevant authorities and special interest groups. Employees and contractors adhere to the organization's established information security policies and procedures.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (5e) - Implement Security Procedures and Practices
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (5e) - Implement Security Procedures and Practices
controls.body:
Each school must implement and maintain reasonable security procedures and practices that otherwise meet or exceed industry standards designed to protect covered information from unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification, or disclosure. 
Any written agreement under which the disclosure of covered information between the school and a third party takes place must include a provision requiring the entity to whom the covered information is disclosed to implement and maintain reasonable security procedures and practices that otherwise meet or exceed industry standards designed to protect covered information from unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification, or disclosure. 

The State Board must make available on its website a guidance document for schools pertaining to reasonable security procedures and practices under this subsection.# - Your school has implemented and maintains reasonably security measures and practices to protect student information.

* #### Your school has implemented and maintains security measures that meet or exceed industry standards to protect student information.  

* #### Your school requires all third parties provided with your student information to implement and maintain reasonably security measures.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (5f) - Data Privacy Officer
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (5f) - Data Privacy Officer
controls.body:
Each school may designate an appropriate staff person as a privacy officer, who may also be an official records custodian as designated under the Illinois School Student Records Act, to carry out the duties and responsibilities assigned to schools and to ensure compliance with the requirements of this Section and Section 26.

* #### Your school has designated a staff person as a privacy officer.  

* #### Your school has designated a staff person as a privacy officer that has received training on the laws and procedures necessary to comply with SOPPA. 

* #### Your school provides routine training for your privacy officer.

controls.name: Sec. 27. Provision (5g) - Delete Covered Information
controls.title: Sec. 27. Provision (5g) - Delete Covered Information
controls.body:
A school shall make a request, pursuant to paragraph (2) of Section 15, to an operator to delete covered information on behalf of a student's parent if the parent requests from the school that the student's covered information held by the operator be deleted, so long as the deletion of the covered information is not in violation of State or federal records laws.

* #### Your school has a procedure to request to a third party storing and using student information destroy student information when the student or parent requests.

controls.name: CC5.1.1 - Configuration Management
controls.title: CC5.1.1 - Configuration Management
controls.body: COMPANY  employs a configuration management software to ensure production system components, including user endpoints are configured in compliance with corporate minimum security baselines, and that operating system patches of Production system components and user endpoints are applied in a timely manner.

controls.name: CC4.2.1 - Information Security Policies & Procedures
controls.title: CC4.2.1 - Information Security Policies & Procedures
controls.body: Policies and procedures, including those specific to Information Security, are reviewed/updated at least annually, or more frequently if required based on changes in the environment or based on results of management's risk assessment and management processes.

controls.name: CC4.1.1 - Management Review of Incidents
controls.title: CC4.1.1 - Management Review of Incidents
controls.body: Management periodically receives reports summarizing incidents, root cause of incidents, and corrective action plans. Management monitors for completion of corrective action plans.

controls.name: CC3.3.1 - Internal Phishing Campaign
controls.title: CC3.3.1 - Internal Phishing Campaign
controls.body: On an annual basis, the Security team runs a  internal email phishing campaign to determine personnel susceptibility to this attack type, reports on results, and trains/refreshes vulnerable users on email security best-practices.

controls.name: CC2.3.2 - MSA and Software License Agreements
controls.title: CC2.3.2 - MSA and Software License Agreements
controls.body: The Entity's security commitments regarding the system are included in Master Services Agreements and Software License Agreements.

controls.name: ID.IM-P5 - Inventory of Purpose for Data Actions
controls.title: Inventory of Purpose for Data Actions
controls.body: The purposes for the data actions are inventoried.

controls.name: CC2.2.2 - Annual Security Awareness Training
controls.title: CC2.2.2 - Annual Security Awareness Training
controls.body: Personnel are required to attend annual Security Awareness Training, which includes topics covering confidentiality.

controls.name: CC2.1.1 - Information Security Management Program
controls.title: CC2.1.1 - Information Security Management Program
controls.body: The Entity maintains a formal Information Security Management Program to address identified information security risks. The Information Security Policy is made available to internal users via the internal wiki.

controls.name: CC1.5.1 - Annual Performance Review
controls.title: CC1.5.1 - Annual Performance Review
controls.body: Management establishes an annual performance review process to evaluate and measure existing employees performance based on annual objectives provided by management and employee, at beginning of the year.

controls.name: CC1.4.3 - Monitor Training Compliance
controls.title: CC1.4.3 - Monitor Training Compliance
controls.body: Management monitors compliance with training requirements.

controls.name: CC1.1.2 - Code of Conduct
controls.title: CC1.1.2 - Code of Conduct
controls.body: Personnel are required to read and accept the code of conduct and the statement of confidentiality and privacy practices upon their hire and to formally reaffirm them annually thereafter.

controls.name: M60.10 - Possibility to map data and the mandated erasure deadline
controls.title: Possibility to map data and the mandated erasure deadline
controls.body: Possibility to map data and the mandated erasure deadline

controls.name: CC7.3.1 - Root Cause Analysis
controls.title: CC7.3.1 - Root Cause Analysis
controls.body: For high severity incidents, a root cause analysis is prepared and reviewed by Information Security team. Based on the root cause analysis, change requests are prepared and the entity's risk management process and relevant risk management data is updated to reflect the planned incident and problem resolution.

controls.name: C1.1.4 - Deletion of Confidential Information
controls.title: C1.1.4 - Deletion of Confidential Information
controls.body:
The Entity
• has automated system processes in place to delete confidential information in accordance with specific retention requirements.
• deletes backup information in accordance with a defined schedule.
• requires approval for confidential information to be retained beyond its retention period and
• specifically marks such information for retention.
• reviews annually information marked for retention.

controls.name: ID.IM-P7 - Identification of Data Processing Environment
controls.title: Identification of Data Processing Environment
controls.body: The data processing environment is identified (e.g., geographic location, internal, cloud, third parties).

controls.name: CC6.1.6 - Encrypted Virtual Private Network
controls.title: CC6.1.6 - Encrypted Virtual Private Network
controls.body: External access to the Corporate network by personnel is permitted only through a two-factor encrypted virtual private network (VPN) connection.

controls.name: ID.IM-P8 - Records Related to Processing Data
controls.title: Records Related to Processing Data
controls.body: Data processing is mapped, illustrating the data actions and associated data elements for systems/products/services, including components; roles of the component owners/operators; and interactions of individuals or third parties with the systems/products/services.

controls.name: §164.308(a)(5)(ii)(C) - Monitoring Log-in Attempts and Reporting (A)
controls.title: §164.308(a)(5)(ii)(C) - Monitoring Log-in Attempts and Reporting (A)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D) - Review of Information System Activities (R)

controls.name: §164.312(b) - Record and Review of Information System Activities (R)
controls.title: §164.312(b) - Record and Review of Information System Activities (R)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D) - Review of Information System Activities (R)

controls.name: AIC4.17 - Acknowledgement on Privacy Policy
controls.title: AIC4.17 - Acknowledgement on Privacy Policy
controls.body: All internal and external users are required to read and acknowledge the privacy policy describing the collection, use, maintenance, and disclosure of personal information prior to engaging with the organization or in case of any changes to the policy.

controls.name: AIC4.8 - Data Privacy Officer
controls.title: AIC4.8 - Data Privacy Officer
controls.body: The organization has appointed a Privacy Officer who is accountable for developing, implementing and maintaining organization-wide governance and privacy program to comply with applicable laws and regulations regarding the collection, use, maintenance, sharing and disclosure of personal information.

controls.name: AIC4.9 - Privacy Policy
controls.title: AIC4.9 - Privacy Policy
controls.body: The organization has a privacy policy published on its website which outlines privacy commitments in accordance with local laws and regulations and is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: SC-8(2) - Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Pre- and Post-transmission Handling
controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Pre- and Post-transmission Handling
controls.body: Maintain the [Selection (one or more): confidentiality; integrity] of information during preparation for transmission and during reception.

controls.name: AIC4.10 - Data Collection Consent
controls.title: AIC4.10 - Data Collection Consent
controls.body: The organization obtains explicit consent from data subjects (customers, consumers, website visitors, employees, etc.) prior to collecting or for any new use or disclosure of personal information. Consequences of withdrawal or refusal to consent are communicated to data subjects through privacy policy/statement.

controls.name: AIC4.11 - Choices for Collection, Use and Disclosure
controls.title: AIC4.11 - Choices for Collection, Use and Disclosure
controls.body: The organization communicates to data subjects about the choices available to them with respect to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information through its privacy policy/statement including consequences of refusal.

controls.name: AIC13.7 - Integrity Output Agreement
controls.title: AIC13.7 - Integrity Output Agreement
controls.body: The organization has formal agreements with its customers to define the completeness and accuracy of the system data outputs and the definition of the data. The agreements include procedures and responsibilities that need to be performed by the organization and the customers to ensure that the data is accurate and complete during the output. Any deviations from expected results are followed up, evaluated and resolved in a timely manner.

controls.name: ABC1.10 - Archive Processing Records
controls.title: ABC1.10 - Archive Processing Records
controls.body: Organization archives system records related to the input, processing or output processes in accordance with defined retention and archival procedures.

controls.name: AIC4.14 - Data Integrity Policy
controls.title: AIC4.14 - Data Integrity Policy
controls.body: Data integrity policy and the procedure has been established that provides guidelines with respect to data integrity and how to define data necessary to support a product or service.

controls.name: CC7.2.2 - Incident Management Policy
controls.title: CC7.2.2 - Incident Management Policy
controls.body: Management has enacted an Incident Management Policy defining roles and responsibilities, detection and reporting, incident handling, containment, remediation, recovery, forensic evidence guidelines, and information sharing guidelines.

controls.name: §164.308(a)(4)(ii)(B) - Access Control Policy and Procedure (S)
controls.title: §164.308(a)(4)(ii)(B) - Access Control Policy and Procedure (S)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.308(a)(4)(i)- Access Control Policy and Procedure (S)

controls.name: ID.RA-P2 - Identifying and Evaluating Data Bias
controls.title: Identifying and Evaluating Data Bias
controls.body: Data analytic inputs and outputs are identified and evaluated for bias.

controls.name: C1.1.1 - Data Classification Policy
controls.title: C1.1.1 - Data Classification Policy
controls.body: A Data Classification Policy is in place that defines roles and responsibilities, information classification guidelines, information handling requirements, and supporting procedures.

controls.name: HS - Access Control Policy and Procedure (R)
controls.title: Access Control Policy and Procedure (R)
controls.body: The organization has established and implemented an access control policy and procedure that governs access rules for granting access to ePHI and is reviewed by management annually.

controls.name: §164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B) - Security Measures to reduce Risks and Vulnerabilities (R)
controls.title: §164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B) - Security Measures to reduce Risks and Vulnerabilities (R)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A) - Risk Assessment of ePHI (R)

controls.name: §164.404(c)(1) - Content of Notification (S)
controls.title: §164.404(c)(1) - Content of Notification (S)
controls.body:
Formal notification of breaches provided to individuals regarding breach of their protected health information or to any other authorized parties includes: 

- Description, date and time of the breach, if known
- type of protected health information involved in the breach
- individual affected and steps the individual are required take to protect themselves from potential harm 
- brief description on investigation performed by organization
- contact procedures for individuals to ask questions or learn additional information

controls.body: Procedures are in place to notify breaches to Secretary through HHS website breach report form if a breach affects 500 or more individuals without any unreasonable delay and in no case later than 60 days following a breach, except in cases stated by law enforcement official to delay the notification.

controls.name: §164.408 - Notification to Secretary involving breach for fewer than 500 individuals (S)
controls.title: §164.408 - Notification to Secretary involving breach for fewer than 500 individuals (S)
controls.body: Procedures are in place to notify breaches to Secretary on an annual basis, if a breach affects fewer than 500 individuals. Reports of such breaches are due to the Secretary no later than 60 days after the end of the calendar year in which the breaches are discovered, except in cases stated by law enforcement official to delay the notification.

controls.name: §164.512(d) - Uses and disclosures for health oversight activities
controls.title: §164.512(d) - Uses and disclosures for health oversight activities
controls.body:

Documentation of such disclosure is maintained by the organization.

controls.name: §164.508(c)(1-4) - Core Elements and Requirements
controls.title: §164.508(c)(1-4) - Core Elements and Requirements
controls.body:
Authorizations obtained from individuals on uses or disclosures of their protected health information contains below at a minimum (in writing):

- Description of the information to be used or disclosed and its purpose
- Name or other specific identification of the person(s), or class of persons, authorized to make the requested use or disclosure
- An expiration date or an expiration event that relates to the individual or the purpose of the use or disclosure
- Signature of the individual with date and description of representative, if any.
- Statement on Notice

controls.name: §164.510(a)(3) - Emergency Circumstances
controls.title: §164.510(a)(3) - Emergency Circumstances
controls.body: Emergency circumstances in which opportunity to object on uses or disclosures of PHI cannot be obtained from Individuals, Organization may use or disclose some or all of the protected health information if such disclosure is consistent with a prior expressed preference of the individual and in individual's best interest. Individuals are informed and provided with an opportunity to object on uses or disclosures when it becomes practicable to do so.

controls.name: §164.512(b) - Uses and disclosures for public health activities.
controls.title: §164.512(b) - Uses and disclosures for public health activities.
controls.body: Organization is permitted to use or disclose an Individual's protected health information for the public health activities in accordance with the applicable requirements of 45 CFR §164.512 (b). Documentation of such disclosure is maintained by the organization.

controls.name: §164.512(e) - Disclosures for judicial and administrative proceedings
controls.title: §164.512(e) - Disclosures for judicial and administrative proceedings
controls.body:
Organization is permitted to use or disclose an Individual's protected health information in the course of any judicial or administrative proceeding in accordance with the applicable requirements of 45 CFR §164.512 (e). Only the protected health information expressly authorized by such order is disclosed and individuals are informed when such disclosures are made. 

Documentation of such disclosure is maintained by the organization.

controls.title: §164.510(b)(5) - Uses and disclosures when the individual is deceased
controls.body:
Disclosure of protected health information of a deceased individual is permitted to a representative (Individual's family member, or other person involved in individual's care before death), unless doing so is inconsistent with any prior expressed preference of the individual that is known to the organization. 

Documentation of such disclosure is maintained by the organization.
