controls.title: Dependencies for Critical Business Processes
controls.body: The critical business processes that are dependent on external connectivity have been identified. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 9)

controls.name: §164.512(i)(2)(i)-(iii) - Documentation of waiver approval
controls.title: §164.512(i)(2)(i)-(iii) - Documentation of waiver approval
controls.body:
Alternation or waiver approval on individual authorization required for use or disclosure of the protected health information is documented and retained by the organization. Such documentation is signed by the chair of privacy board and includes (but not limited to):

- A statement identifying the privacy board and date of waiver approval
- Waiver Criteria 
- Description of PHI for which access is required
- Review and approval from privacy board

controls.name: §164.514(d)(3) - Standard Minimum Necessary
controls.title: §164.514(d)(3) - Standard Minimum Necessary
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.502(b) - Standard Minimum Necessary

controls.name: §164.522(a)(2) - Terminating a restriction
controls.title: §164.522(a)(2) - Terminating a restriction
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.522(a)(1) - Rights of Individuals

controls.name: §164.512(i)(2)(iv)-(v) - Expedited review procedure on alternation or waiver of authorization
controls.title: §164.512(i)(2)(iv)-(v) - Expedited review procedure on alternation or waiver of authorization
controls.body: Organization has implemented an expedited review procedure for the privacy board if the research involves no more than minimal risk to the privacy of the individuals who are the subject of the protected health information for which use or disclosure is being sought. Review and approval for alteration or waiver of authorization is carried out by the chair of the privacy board (or designated member appointed by the Chair) in case of expedited review procedure.

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, And Access Control
controls.name: PR.AC-P1 - User Access Management
controls.title: User Access Management
controls.body: Identities and credentials are issued, managed, verified, revoked, and audited for authorized individuals, processes, and devices.

controls.name: §164.512(j) - Uses and disclosures to avert a serious threat to health or safety
controls.title: §164.512(j) - Uses and disclosures to avert a serious threat to health or safety
controls.body:
Organization is permitted to use or disclose an Individual's protected health information for the purpose of preventing or lessen a serious and imminent threat to the health or safety of a person or the public in accordance to the requirements described in CFR §164.512(j). 

Documentation of such disclosure is maintained by the organization.

controls.name: §164.512(k)(1) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.title: §164.512(k)(1) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.body:
Organization is permitted to use or disclose an Individual's protected health information for specialized government functions (including but not limited to) such as military and veterans activities, national security and intelligence, protective services for the President and others in accordance to the requirements described in CFR §164.512(k). 

Documentation of such disclosure is maintained by the organization.

controls.name: §164.512(k)(3) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.title: §164.512(k)(3) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.512(k)(1) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions

controls.name: §164.512(k)(4) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.title: §164.512(k)(4) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.512(k)(1) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions

controls.name: §164.512(k)(5) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.title: §164.512(k)(5) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.512(k)(1) - Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions

controls.name: §164.514(d)(4)-(5) - Standard Minimum Necessary
controls.title: §164.514(d)(4)-(5) - Standard Minimum Necessary
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.502(b) - Standard Minimum Necessary

controls.name: AOM3.1 - Employment Contracts Include Security Responsibilities
controls.title: AOM3.1 - Employment Contracts Include Security Responsibilities
controls.body: Information security responsibilities of employees, contractors and the organization are clearly stated in all contractual agreements.

controls.name: §164.514(f) - Uses and disclosures for fundraising
controls.title: §164.514(f) - Uses and disclosures for fundraising
controls.body:
Organization is permitted to use or disclose limited protected health information to a business associate ("contractor") or to an institutionally related foundation for the purpose of fundraising, provided communication has been made to an Individual with a right to opt out of receiving such communications.

Documentation of such disclosure is maintained by the organization.

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, And Access Control
controls.name: PR.AC-P2 - Physical Access Management
controls.title: Physical Access Management
controls.body: Physical access to data and devices is managed.

controls.name: §164.520(a) - Notice of Privacy Practices
controls.title: §164.520(a) - Notice of Privacy Practices
controls.body: Organization has established a notice of privacy practices that defines individual's rights and the Organization's legal duties with respect to protected health information. Individuals are provided with such notice of privacy practices for any uses and disclosure of protected health information.

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, And Access Control
controls.name: PR.AC-P4 - Access Permissions and Authorizations
controls.title: Access Permissions and Authorizations
controls.body: Access permissions and authorizations are managed, incorporating the principles of least privilege and separation of duties.

controls.name: §164.520 (b) - Notice of Privacy Practices
controls.title: §164.520 (b) - Notice of Privacy Practices
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.520(a) - Notice of Privacy Practices

controls.name: §164.520(c)(1) - Notice of Privacy Practices (applicable to Health Plans)
controls.title: §164.520(c)(1) - Notice of Privacy Practices (applicable to Health Plans)
controls.body: Individuals are provided with notice of privacy practices by health plans at the time of enrollment and at least once every three years thereafter.

controls.name: §164.520(c)(2) - Notice of Privacy Practices (applicable to Health Care Providers)
controls.title: §164.520(c)(2) - Notice of Privacy Practices (applicable to Health Care Providers)
controls.body: Individuals are provided with notice of privacy practices by covered health care providers at the date of first service delivery and as soon as reasonably practicable in an emergency treatment situation.

controls.name: §164.520(c)(3) - Specific requirements for electronic notice
controls.title: §164.520(c)(3) - Specific requirements for electronic notice
controls.body: Notice of privacy practices is posted on the Organization website and provided to Individuals through email if individuals are agreed to electronic notice.

controls.name: §164.520(d) - Joint notice by separate covered entities.
controls.title: §164.520(d) - Joint notice by separate covered entities.
controls.body: Joint notice of privacy practices are established by Organizations (covered entities) that participate in organized health care arrangements and provided to Individuals by any one of the covered entities included in the joint notice.

controls.name: §164.528(d) - Retention of Documentation
controls.title: §164.528(d) - Retention of Documentation
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.530(j) - Retention of Documentation

controls.name: §164.520(e) - Documentation and Retention of Notices
controls.title: §164.520(e) - Documentation and Retention of Notices
controls.body: Organization maintains and retain the notice of privacy practices issued by the organization and any written acknowledgments of receipt (if applicable) for at least six years from the date of its creation or the date when it was last in effect, whichever is later.

controls.name: §164.522(a)(3) - Documentation on restriction
controls.title: §164.522(a)(3) - Documentation on restriction
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.522(a)(1) - Rights of Individuals

controls.name: D4.C.Co.A.1 - Documented Security Architecture
controls.title: Documented Security Architecture
controls.body: The security architecture is validated and documented before network connection infrastructure changes.

controls.name: §164.522(b)(1) - Confidential communications requirements.
controls.title: §164.522(b)(1) - Confidential communications requirements.
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.522(a)(1) - Rights of Individuals

controls.name: §164.530(a) - Assigning Security & Privacy Responsibilities
controls.title: §164.530(a) - Assigning Security & Privacy Responsibilities
controls.body: Management has designated a security and privacy official to oversee the development and implementation of security and privacy policies and procedures.

controls.name: §164.524(d) (2) - Denial of Access
controls.title: §164.524(d) (2) - Denial of Access
controls.body: Formal procedures that defines conditions and actions required on denial access to protected health information are established and communicated to Individuals. Any denial of access and its justification is communicated to Individuals in a timely manner.

controls.name: §164.524(a)(2) - Denial of Access
controls.title: §164.524(a)(2) - Denial of Access
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.524(d) (2) - Denial of Access

controls.name: §164.524(a)(3) - Denial of Access
controls.title: §164.524(a)(3) - Denial of Access
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.524(d) (2) - Denial of Access

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, And Access Control
controls.name: PR.AC-P5 - Network Segregation
controls.title: Network Segregation
controls.body: Network integrity is protected (e.g., network segregation, network segmentation).

controls.name: D1.G.IT.A.3 - Automated Blocking of Unauthorized Changes
controls.title: Automated Blocking of Unauthorized Changes
controls.body: Automated processes are in place to detect and block unauthorized changes to software and hardware.

controls.name: §164.524(a)(4) & (d)(4) - Denial of Access
controls.title: §164.524(a)(4) & (d)(4) - Denial of Access
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.524(d) (2) - Denial of Access

controls.name: §164.524(e) - Documentation on access by Individuals
controls.title: §164.524(e) - Documentation on access by Individuals
controls.body: Organization maintains and retain the documentation of designated record sets that are subject to access by individuals and the titles of the persons or offices responsible for receiving and processing requests for access by individuals for at least six years from the date of its creation or the date when it was last in effect, whichever is later.

controls.name: §164.526(a)(2) - Rights of Individuals
controls.title: §164.526(a)(2) - Rights of Individuals
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.522(a)(1) - Rights of Individuals

controls.name: §164.526(c) - Rights of Individuals
controls.title: §164.526(c) - Rights of Individuals
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.522(a)(1) - Rights of Individuals

controls.name: §164.526(d) - Rights of Individuals
controls.title: §164.526(d) - Rights of Individuals
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.522(a)(1) - Rights of Individuals

controls.name: §164.528(c) - Rights of Individuals
controls.title: §164.528(c) - Rights of Individuals
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under - §164.522(a)(1) - Rights of Individuals

controls.name: §164.530(b) - Security and Privacy Awareness Training
controls.title: §164.530(b) - Security and Privacy Awareness Training
controls.body: Organization has implemented a formal security and privacy awareness training program. Employees are required to complete the awareness training as part of onboarding process and annually thereafter.

controls.name: §164.530(d)(1) - Reporting Non-compliance
controls.title: §164.530(d)(1) - Reporting Non-compliance
controls.body: The organization has established communication channels that allow employees and contractors to report compliance issues with respect to breach notification rule.

controls.name: §164.530(e)(1) - Disciplinary Process
controls.title: §164.530(e)(1) - Disciplinary Process
controls.body: Disciplinary Process- Organization has established a formal and communicated disciplinary process to take action against employees who have committed an information security or privacy breach.

controls.name: IA-7 - Cryptographic Module Authentication
controls.title: Cryptographic Module Authentication
controls.body: Implement mechanisms for authentication to a cryptographic module that meet the requirements of applicable laws, executive orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidelines for such authentication.

controls.name: §164.530(f) - Incident Management Process
controls.title: §164.530(f) - Incident Management Process
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.504(e) (1) - Incident Management Process (S)

controls.name: §164.530(g) - Incident Management Process
controls.title: §164.530(g) - Incident Management Process
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.504(e) (1) - Incident Management Process (S)

controls.name: §164.530(h) - Incident Management Process
controls.title: §164.530(h) - Incident Management Process
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.504(e) (1) - Incident Management Process (S)

controls.name: PCI 9.7 - Restrict Access to Storage Media
controls.title: Restrict Access to Storage Media
controls.body: Maintain strict control over the storage and accessibility of media.

controls.name: T.1.3.6 - Updated Antivirus
controls.title: Updated Antivirus
controls.body:
A) A security solution, containing at least an antivirus application, shall be deployed to protect  the servers and terminal devices under the control of the Applicant that are used for the processing in the Target of Evaluation.
*AND*
B) A policy, procedure or a mechanism shall be in place to ensure that the security solution is kept up-to-date.

controls.name: §164.530(i) - Policy and Procedures on Security and Privacy
controls.title: §164.530(i) - Policy and Procedures on Security and Privacy
controls.body: Policies and procedures relating to security and privacy of protected health information are maintained and made available to employees. The policies and procedure documents are reviewed and approved by management annually or during significant changes.

controls.name: §164.530(j) - Retention of Documentation
controls.title: §164.530(j) - Retention of Documentation
controls.body: Formal data retention and disposal procedures are in place to guide the secure retention and disposal of protected health information. Documents as required by HIPAA regulation are maintained for at least six years from the date of its creation or the date when it was last in effect, whichever is later.

controls.name: IC4.28 - Customer Data Deletion or Retention
controls.title: IC4.28 - Customer Data Deletion or Retention
controls.body: Data is retained or deleted in accordance with contractual obligations during and at the end of the contract term.

controls.name: IC7.0 - Wireless Device Secure Configuration
controls.title: IC7.0 - Wireless Device Secure Configuration
controls.body: All wireless devices on organization networks are securely configured.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.E.3 - Risk Profile and Policy Update
controls.title: Risk Profile and Policy Update
controls.body: A formal process is in place to update policies as the institution’s inherent risk profile changes.

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.Int.2 - Site Visits of High-Risk Vendors
controls.title: Site Visits of High-Risk Vendors
controls.body: Pre-contract, physical site visits of high-risk vendors are conducted by the institution or by a qualified third party.

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, And Access Control
controls.name: PR.AC-P6 - User Access Review
controls.title: User Access Review
controls.body: Individuals and devices are proofed and bound to credentials and authenticated commensurate with the risk of the transaction (e.g., individuals’ security and privacy risks and other organizational risks).

controls.name: DORA-17-001 Incident Management Process
controls.title: DORA-17-001 Incident Management Process
controls.body: An ICT-related incident management process is developed and implemented to detect, identify root cause, monitor, remedy, notify, and follow up on ICT-related incidents.

controls.name: ID.AM-6 - Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for the entire workforce and third-party stakeholders (e.g., suppliers, customers, partners) are established

controls.name: PR.DS-P1 - Protection for Data at Rest
controls.title: Protection for Data at Rest
controls.body: Data-at-rest are protected.

controls.name: 1.4.1 - Operational roles - 1
controls.title: Operational roles - 1
controls.body: Data protection and information governance staff have clear responsibilities for making sure that your organisation is data protection compliant.

controls.name: PR.DS-P2 - Protection for Data in Transit
controls.title: Protection for Data in Transit
controls.body: Data-in-transit are protected.

controls.name: PR.DS-P3 - Systems Removal, Transfer and Disposition
controls.title: Systems Removal, Transfer and Disposition
controls.body: Systems/products/services and associated data are formally managed throughout removal, transfers, and disposition.

controls.name: PR.DS-P4 - Capacity Management
controls.title: Capacity Management
controls.body: Adequate capacity to ensure availability is maintained.

controls.name: PR.DS-P6 - Software Integrity Checking Mechanisms
controls.title: Software Integrity Checking Mechanisms
controls.body: Integrity-checking mechanisms are used to verify software, firmware, and information integrity.

controls.name: PR.DS-P8 - Hardware Integrity Checking Mechanisms
controls.title: Hardware Integrity Checking Mechanisms
controls.body: Integrity-checking mechanisms are used to verify hardware integrity.

controls.name: PR.MA-P1 - Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.title: Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.body: Maintenance and repair of organizational assets are performed and logged, with approved and controlled tools.

controls.name: DORA-11-002 ICT Business Continuity
controls.title: DORA-11-002 ICT Business Continuity
controls.body:
a) Business Continuity plans (BCP), procedures and mechanisms are implemented to ensure continuity of all critical and important functions.

b) Business continuity plans are tested on at least annual basis and after substantive changes to the ICT systems.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.3.1 - Documentation Control
controls.title: Clause 7.5.3.1 - Documentation Control

controls.name: RM-MC-ML.2.998 - Risk Management Implementation
controls.title: RM-MC-ML.2.998 - Risk Management Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Risk Management (RM) policy.

controls.name: PR.MA-P2 - Remote Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.title: Remote Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.body: Remote maintenance of organizational assets is approved, logged, and performed in a manner that prevents unauthorized access.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.Inn.2 - Rule-Based Triggers for Automated Incident Response
controls.title: Rule-Based Triggers for Automated Incident Response
controls.body: The incident response process includes detailed actions and rulebased triggers for automated response.

controls.name: OM1.1 - Processing Integrity Scope
controls.title: OM1.1 - Processing Integrity Scope
controls.body: Define products and/or services covered under the scope of processing integrity.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, And Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P1 - Baseline Configuration
controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.body: A baseline configuration of information technology is created and maintained incorporating security principles (e.g., concept of least functionality).

controls.name: AU-9 Protection of audit information
controls.title: AU-9 Protection of audit information
controls.body: The information system protects audit information and audit tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

controls.name: AU-9 (2) Protection of audit information | audit backup on separate physical systems / components
controls.title: AU-9 (2) Protection of audit information | audit backup on separate physical systems / components
controls.body: The information system backs up audit records [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] onto a physically different system or system component than the system or component being audited.

controls.name: TBL13 - Encryption of Data in Transit
controls.title: TBL13 - Encryption of Data in Transit
controls.body: Encryption technologies are used to protect communication and transmission of data over public networks.

controls.name: 1.4.2 - Operational roles - 2
controls.title: Operational roles - 2
controls.body: Your staff manage all records effectively and they keep information secure.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, And Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P3 - Backup of Information and Testing
controls.title: Backup of Information and Testing
controls.body: Backups of information are conducted, maintained, and tested.

controls.name: Clause 5.2.2 - Communicate Business Continuity Policy
controls.title: Clause 5.2.2 - Communicate Business Continuity Policy

controls.name: SO14 - Security Events - Logging and Monitoring
controls.title: Security Events - Logging and Monitoring
controls.body: Logging is enabled to monitor activities such as administrative activities, logon attempts, changes to functions, security configurations, permissions, and roles. Automated alerts are configured to notify IT management and issues identified are resolved in a timely manner through the incident management process.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, And Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P4 - Physical Environment Policy and Regulation
controls.title: Physical Environment Policy and Regulation
controls.body: Policy and regulations regarding the physical operating environment for organizational assets are met.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, And Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P5 - Improvement of Protection Processes
controls.title: Improvement of Protection Processes
controls.body: Protection processes are improved.

controls.name: SC-51 - Hardware-based Protection
controls.title: Hardware-based Protection
controls.body:
a. Employ hardware-based, write-protect for [Assignment: organization-defined system firmware components]; and
b. Implement specific procedures for [Assignment: organization-defined authorized individuals] to manually disable hardware write-protect for firmware modifications and re-enable the write-protect prior to returning to operational mode.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, And Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P7 - Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.body: Response plans (Incident Response and Business Continuity) and recovery plans (Incident Recovery and Disaster Recovery) are established, in place, and managed.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, And Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P8 - Testing of Response and Recovery Plans
controls.title: Testing of Response and Recovery Plans
controls.body: Response and recovery plans are tested.

controls.name: TBL24 - Data Retention and Disposal Policy and Procedure
controls.title: TBL24 - Data Retention and Disposal Policy and Procedure
controls.body: Formal data retention and disposal policy and procedures are in place to guide the secure retention and disposal of information.

controls.category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, And Procedures
controls.name: PR.PO-P9 - Privacy in Human Resource Practices
controls.title: Privacy in Human Resource Practices
controls.body: Privacy procedures are included in human resources practices (e.g., de-provisioning, personnel screening).

controls.name: DP3 - Choices of Personal Information Collection, Use and Disclosure
controls.title: Choices of Personal Information Collection, Use and Disclosure
controls.body: The organization communicates to data subjects about the choices available to them with respect to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information through its privacy policy/statement including consequences of refusal.

controls.name: DORA-11-001 ICT Business Continuity Policy
controls.title: DORA-11-001 ICT Business Continuity Policy
controls.body:
a) ICT business continuity policy is developed and disseminated, forming an integral part of the financial entity's overall business continuity policy.

b) The ICT business continuity policy is reviewed and approved by authorized officials.

controls.name: AC-2(7) - Account Management | Privileged User Accounts
controls.title: Account Management | Privileged User Accounts

controls.name: PR.PT-P1 - Protection of Removable Media
controls.title: Protection of Removable Media
controls.body: Removable media is protected and its use restricted according to policy.

controls.name: T.2.1.1 - HTTPS Enabled
controls.title: HTTPS Enabled
controls.body: A) HTTPS shall be enabled by default for accessing the web interface.

controls.name: PR.PT-P2 - Least Functionality Access
controls.title: Least Functionality Access
controls.body: The principle of least functionality is incorporated by configuring systems to provide only essential capabilities.

controls.name: AU-5(4) - Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Shutdown on Failure
controls.title: Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Shutdown on Failure
controls.body: Invoke a [Selection(one): full system shutdown; partial system shutdown; degraded operational mode with limited mission or business functionality available] in the event of [Assignment: organization-defined audit logging failures], unless an alternate audit logging capability exists.

controls.name: DORA-06-003 Improvement of Risk Management Framework
controls.title: DORA-06-003 Improvement of Risk Management Framework
controls.body: The ICT risk management framework is continuously improved on the basis of lessons derived from implementation and monitoring of the framework.

controls.name: 1.4.3 - Operational roles - 3
controls.title: Operational roles - 3
controls.body: A network of support or nominated data protection leads help implement and maintain data protection policies at a local level.

controls.name: Clause 4.2.1 - List of Interested Parties and Requirements
controls.title: Clause 4.2.1 - List of Interested Parties and Requirements

controls.name: HS - Workstation Security Policy (R)
controls.title: Workstation Security Policy (R)
controls.body: Workstation security policy and the procedure have been established that specifies security measures to be implemented on workstations that store or access ePHI.

controls.name: PR.PT-P3 - Safeguard for Communications and Control Network
controls.title: Safeguard for Communications and Control Network
controls.body: Communications and control networks are protected.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.1 - Documented Information
controls.title: Clause 7.5.1 - Documented Information
controls.body:
The organization’s information security management system shall include:
a) documented information required by ISO27001 Standard; and 
b) documented information determined by the organization as being necessary for the effectiveness of the information security management system.

controls.name: DORA-09-007 Cryptographic Policies and Procedures
controls.title: DORA-09-007 Cryptographic Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Key management and cryptography policy and procedures that defines  rules for key generation, access, distribution and storage of cryptographic keys, are developed and disseminated.

controls.name: CP-2(3) - Contingency Plan | Resume Mission and Business Functions
controls.title: Contingency Plan | Resume Mission and Business Functions
controls.body: Plan for the resumption of [Selection(one): all; essential] mission and business functions within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of contingency plan activation.

controls.name: Clause 4.1 - Organizational Context
controls.title: Clause 4.1 - Organizational Context
controls.body: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcome(s) of its BCMS.

controls.name: PCI 11.1.2 - Incident Response to Detect Unauthorized Wireless Access Points
controls.title: Incident Response to Detect Unauthorized Wireless Access Points
controls.body: Implement incident response procedures in the event unauthorized wireless access points are detected.

controls.name: CP-2(8) - Contingency Plan | Identify Critical Assets
controls.title: Contingency Plan | Identify Critical Assets
controls.body: Identify critical system assets supporting [Selection(one): all; essential] mission and business functions.

controls.name: Clause 4.2.2 - Identification of Applicable Legal and Regulatory Requirements
controls.title: Clause 4.2.2 - Identification of Applicable Legal and Regulatory Requirements

controls.name: Clause 4.3.2 - BCMS Scope
controls.title: Clause 4.3.2 - BCMS Scope
controls.body:
The organization shall:
a) establish the parts of the organization to be included in the BCMS, taking into account its location(s), size, nature and complexity;
b) identify products and services to be included in the BCMS.
When defining the scope, the organization shall document and explain exclusions. They shall not affect the organization’s ability and responsibility to provide business continuity, as determined by the business impact analysis or risk assessment and applicable legal or regulatory requirements.

controls.name: Clause 4.3.1 - BCMS Boundaries and Applicability
controls.title: Clause 4.3.1 - BCMS Boundaries and Applicability

controls.name: PE-11(1) - Emergency Power | Alternate Power Supply — Minimal Operational Capability
controls.title: Emergency Power | Alternate Power Supply — Minimal Operational Capability
controls.body: Provide an alternate power supply for the system that is activated [Selection(one): manually; automatically] and that can maintain minimally required operational capability in the event of an extended loss of the primary power source.

controls.name: 8.2.5 - Transmitted Personal Information
controls.title: Transmitted Personal Information
controls.body: Personal information is protected when transmitted by mail or other physical means . Personal information collected and transmitted over the Internet, over public and other non-secure networks, and wireless networks is protected by deploying industry-standard encryption technology for transferring and receiving personal information .

controls.name: 8.2.6 - Personal Information on Portable Media
controls.title: Personal Information on Portable Media
controls.body: Personal information stored on portable media or devices is protected from unauthorized access .

controls.name: 8.2.7 - Testing security safeguards
controls.title: Testing security safeguards
controls.body: Tests of the effectiveness of the key administrative, technical, and physical safeguards protecting personal information are conducted at least annually

controls.name: PCI 2.1 - Change Vendor-Supplied Defaults
controls.title: PCI 2.1 - Change Vendor-Supplied Defaults
controls.body:
Always change vendor-supplied defaults and remove or disable unnecessary default accounts before installing a system on the network. 

This applies to ALL default passwords, including but not limited to those used by operating systems, software that provides security services, application and system accounts, point-of-sale(POS)terminals, payment applications, Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) community strings, etc.).

- 2.1.1  For wireless environments connected to the cardholder data environment or transmitting cardholder data, change ALL wireless vendor defaults at installation, including but not limited to default wireless encryption keys, passwords, and SNMP community strings.

controls.name: SC-2(1) - Separation of System and User Functionality | Interfaces for Non-privileged Users
controls.title: Separation of System and User Functionality | Interfaces for Non-privileged Users
controls.body: Prevent the presentation of system management functionality at interfaces to non-privileged users.

controls.name: IA-2 (3) Identification and authentication | local access to privileged accounts
controls.title: IA-2 (3) Identification and authentication | local access to privileged accounts
controls.body: The information system implements multifactor authentication for local access to privileged accounts.

controls.name: SC-7(29) - Boundary Protection | Separate Subnets to Isolate Functions
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Separate Subnets to Isolate Functions
controls.body: Implement [Selection(one): physically; logically] separate subnetworks to isolate the following critical system components and functions: [Assignment: organization-defined critical system components and functions].

controls.name: 9.1.0 - Privacy Policies
controls.title: Privacy Policies
controls.body: The entity’s privacy policies address the quality of personal information .

controls.name: 9.1.1 - Communication to Individuals
controls.title: Communication to Individuals
controls.body: Individuals are informed that they are responsible for providing the entity with accurate and complete personal information and for contacting the entity if correction of such information is required

controls.name: 9.2.1 - Accuracy and completeness of Personal Information
controls.title: Accuracy and completeness of Personal Information
controls.body: Personal information is accurate and complete for the purposes for which it is to be used .

controls.name: PE-11(2) - Emergency Power | Alternate Power Supply — Self-contained
controls.title: Emergency Power | Alternate Power Supply — Self-contained
controls.body:
Provide an alternate power supply for the system that is activated [Selection(one): manually; automatically] and that is:

a. Self-contained;
b. Not reliant on external power generation; and
c. Capable of maintaining [Selection(one): minimally required operational capability; full operational capability] in the event of an extended loss of the primary power source.

controls.name: SC-11 - Trusted Path
controls.title: Trusted Path
controls.body:
a. Provide a [Selection(one): physically; logically] isolated trusted communications path for communications between the user and the trusted components of the system; and
b. Permit users to invoke the trusted communications path for communications between the user and the following security functions of the system, including at a minimum, authentication and re-authentication: [Assignment: organization-defined security functions].

controls.name: AC-20 - Use of External Systems
controls.title: Use of External Systems
controls.body:
a. [Selection (one or more): Establish [Assignment: organization-defined terms and conditions]; Identify [Assignment: organization-defined controls asserted to be implemented on external systems]], consistent with the trust relationships established with other organizations owning, operating, and/or maintaining external systems, allowing authorized individuals to:

1. Access the system from external systems; and
2. Process, store, or transmit organization-controlled information using external systems; or

b. Prohibit the use of [Assignment: organizationally-defined types of external systems].

controls.name: Clause 4.4 - BCMS - Business Continuity Management System
controls.title: Clause 4.4 - BCMS - Business Continuity Management System
controls.body: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain and continually improve a BCMS, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this document.

controls.name: 9.2.2 - Relevance of Personal Information
controls.title: Relevance of Personal Information
controls.body: Personal information is relevant to the purposes for which it is to be used .

controls.name: 1.1 - Clarity
controls.title: Clarity
controls.body: Information shall be in clear and plain language, concise and intelligible.

controls.name: DORA-09-009 ICT Change Management Policies and Procedures
controls.title: DORA-09-009 ICT Change Management Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Change Management policies and procedures that define rules for changes to software, hardware, firmware components, systems, security and protocols enabled for emergency changes, are developed and disseminated.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.1 - Documented Information
controls.title: Clause 7.5.1 - Documented Information

controls.name: SA-17(4) - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Informal Correspondence
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Informal Correspondence

controls.name: SC-12(2) - Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Symmetric Keys
controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Symmetric Keys
controls.body: Produce, control, and distribute symmetric cryptographic keys using [Selection(one): NIST FIPS-validated; NSA-approved] key management technology and processes.

controls.name: Clause 5.1 - Leadership and Commitment
controls.title: Clause 5.1 - Leadership and Commitment

controls.name: 1.2 - Semantics
controls.title: Semantics
controls.body: Communication shall have a clear meaning to the audience in question.

controls.name: 1.3 - Accessibility
controls.title: Accessibility
controls.body: Information shall be easily accessible for the data subject.

controls.name: AM2.3 - Asset Tracking
controls.title: AM2.3 - Asset Tracking
controls.body:
All IT assets are processed, and asset tagged before issuing to an end user or entered into storage. 

Movement of hardware and electronic media that contain confidential information or electronic protected health information into and out of a facility and within the facility are logged and tracked and the person responsible identified.

All assets on the network of value more than $250 are tracked. Assets, which store data, regardless of cost, shall be tracked as part of a computing device or as a part of network attached storage.

controls.name: DP8 - Data Integrity of Personal Information
controls.title: Data Integrity of Personal Information
controls.body: The organization has a privacy policy in place which specifies that data subjects are responsible for providing complete and accurate personal information to the organization during collection or in case of any changes.

controls.name: Clause 6.1.1 - Determine Risks and Opportunities
controls.title: Clause 6.1.1 - Determine Risks and Opportunities

controls.name: 2.2 - Differentiation
controls.title: Differentiation
controls.body: The controller shall differentiate between the legal basis used for each processing activity.

controls.name: 2.3 - Specified Purpose
controls.title: Specified Purpose
controls.body: The appropriate legal basis must be clearly connected to the specific purpose of processing.

controls.name: 2.4 - Necessary
controls.title: Necessary
controls.body: Processing must be necessary for the purpose to be lawful. It is an objective test which involves an objective assessment of realistic alternatives of achieving the purpose.

controls.name: Clause 5.3 - Organizational Roles, Responsibilities and Authorities
controls.title: Clause 5.3 - Organizational Roles, Responsibilities and Authorities
controls.body:
Top management shall ensure that the responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned and communicated within the organization.
Top management shall assign the responsibility and authority for:
a) ensuring that the BCMS conforms to the requirements of this document;
b) reporting on the performance of the BCMS to top management.

controls.name: Clause 6.2.1 - Establish Business Continuity Objectives
controls.title: Clause 6.2.1 - Establish Business Continuity Objectives

controls.name: Clause 6.1.2 - Address Risks and Opportunities
controls.title: Clause 6.1.2 - Address Risks and Opportunities

controls.name: Clause 7.2 - Competence
controls.title: Clause 7.2 - Competence

controls.name: CP-7 (2) Alternate processing site | accessibility
controls.title: CP-7 (2) Alternate processing site | accessibility
controls.body: The organization identifies potential accessibility problems to the alternate processing site in the event of an area-wide disruption or disaster and outlines explicit mitigation actions.

controls.name: 2.5 - Autonomy
controls.title: Autonomy
controls.body: The data subject should be granted the highest degree of autonomy as possible with respect to control over personal data.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.2 - Creation and Updating Documented
controls.title: Clause 7.5.2 - Creation and Updating Documented
controls.body:
When creating and updating documented information the organization shall ensure appropriate:
a) identification and description (e.g. a title, date, author, or reference number);
b) format (e.g. language, software version, graphics) and media (e.g. paper, electronic); and
c) review and approval for suitability and adequacy.

controls.name: IA-5 (6) Authenticator management | protection of authenticators
controls.title: IA-5 (6) Authenticator management | protection of authenticators
controls.body: The organization protects authenticators commensurate with the security category of the information to which use of the authenticator permits access.

controls.name: SC-30(3) - Concealment and Misdirection | Change Processing and Storage Locations
controls.title: Concealment and Misdirection | Change Processing and Storage Locations
controls.body:
Change the location of [Assignment: organization-defined processing and/or storage]
                  [Selection(one): [Assignment: organization-defined time frequency]; at random time intervals].

controls.name: 2.6 - Consent Withdrawal
controls.title: Consent Withdrawal
controls.body: The processing shall facilitate withdrawal of consent. Withdrawal shall be as easy as giving consent. If not, any given consent is not valid.

controls.name: 2.7 - Balancing of Interests
controls.title: Balancing of Interests
controls.body: Where legitimate interests is the legal basis, the controller must carry out an objectively weighted balancing of interests. There shall be measures and safeguards to mitigate the negative impact on the data subjects, and the controller should disclose their assessment of the balancing of interests.

controls.name: 2.8 - Predetermination
controls.title: Predetermination
controls.body: The legal basis shall be established before the processing takes place.

controls.name: SC-32 - System Partitioning
controls.title: System Partitioning
controls.body: Partition the system into [Assignment: organization-defined system components] residing in separate [Selection(one): physical; logical] domains or environments based on [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances for physical or logical separation of components].

controls.name: Clause 8.4.1 - Business Continuity Plans and Procedures
controls.title: Clause 8.4.1 - Business Continuity Plans and Procedures
controls.body: The organization shall implement and maintain a response structure that will enable timely warning and communication to relevant interested parties. It shall provide plans and procedures to manage the organization during a disruption. The plans and procedures shall be used when required to activate business continuity solutions.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.Inn.1 - Update of Audit Procedures
controls.title: Update of Audit Procedures
controls.body: A formal process is in place for the independent audit function to update its procedures based on changes to the evolving threat landscape across other sectors the institution depends upon.

controls.name: Clause 8.2.1 - Business Impact Analysis and Risk Assessment
controls.title: Clause 8.2.1 - Business Impact Analysis and Risk Assessment

controls.name: Clause 8.2.3 -  Results of Risk Assessment
controls.title: Clause 8.2.3 -  Results of Risk Assessment

controls.name: CIS 17.8-RC - Post-Incident Reviews
controls.title: Post-Incident Reviews
controls.body:
Incident Response Management
Safeguard 17.8: Conduct post-incident reviews.

controls.name: SC-36 - Distributed Processing and Storage
controls.title: Distributed Processing and Storage
controls.body: Distribute the following processing and storage components across multiple [Selection(one): physical locations; logical domains]: [Assignment: organization-defined processing and storage components].

controls.name: ASO3.0 - Vulnerability Scanning and Remediation
controls.title: ASO3.0 - Vulnerability Scanning and Remediation
controls.body:
Internal vulnerability scans are performed quarterly. Annually, a third-party penetration test is performed against the Production environments.

Management takes action based on the results of the scans and penetration tests and necessary system changes follow the company change management process.

controls.name: Clause 8.3.1 - Business Continuity Strategies
controls.title: Clause 8.3.1 - Business Continuity Strategies
controls.body: Based on the outputs from the business impact analysis and risk assessment, the organization shall identify and select business continuity strategies that consider options for before, during and after disruption. The business continuity strategies shall be comprised of one or more solutions.

controls.name: Clause 8.3.2 - Identification of Strategies and Solutions
controls.title: Clause 8.3.2 - Identification of Strategies and Solutions

controls.name: SC-41 - Port and I/O Device Access
controls.title: Port and I/O Device Access
controls.body: [Selection(one): Physically; Logically] disable or remove [Assignment: organization-defined connection ports or input/output devices] on the following systems or system components: [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: IA-5 (7) Authenticator management | no embedded unencrypted static authenticators
controls.title: IA-5 (7) Authenticator management | no embedded unencrypted static authenticators
controls.body: The organization ensures that unencrypted static authenticators are not embedded in applications or access scripts or stored on function keys.

controls.name: IA-13 - Identity Providers and Authorization Servers
controls.title: Identity Providers and Authorization Servers
controls.body: Employ identity providers and authorization servers to manage user, device, and non-person entity (NPE) identities, attributes, and access rights supporting authentication and authorization decisions in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined identification and authentication policy] using [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms].

controls.name: 2.9 - Cessation
controls.title: Cessation
controls.body: If the legal basis ceases to apply, the processing shall cease accordingly.

controls.name: 1.4 - Contextual
controls.title: Contextual
controls.body: Information shall be provided at the relevant time and in the appropriate form.

controls.name: 1.5 - Relevance
controls.title: Relevance
controls.body: Information shall be relevant and applicable to the specific data subject.

controls.name: SC-46 - Cross Domain Policy Enforcement
controls.title: Cross Domain Policy Enforcement
controls.body: Implement a policy enforcement mechanism [Selection(one): physically; logically] between the physical and/or network interfaces for the connecting security domains.

controls.name: Clause 8.3.4 - Resource Requirements
controls.title: Clause 8.3.4 - Resource Requirements

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.6 - Non-Privileged Account Use (NIST 800-171: 3.1.6)
controls.title: Non-Privileged Account Use (NIST 800-171: 3.1.6)
controls.body: Use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing nonsecurity functions.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.3.2 - Documentation Lifecycle
controls.title: Clause 7.5.3.2 - Documentation Lifecycle

controls.name: IA-13(1) - Identity Providers and Authorization Servers | Protection of Cryptographic Keys
controls.title: Identity Providers and Authorization Servers | Protection of Cryptographic Keys
controls.body: Cryptographic keys that protect access tokens are generated, managed, and protected from disclosure and misuse.

controls.name: TISAX 1.1.1 - Policies for Information Security
controls.title: Policies for Information Security
controls.body: A set of policies for information security are defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external business partners. These policies are reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur.

controls.name: Clause 8.4.2.1 - Response Structure - Teams
controls.title: Clause 8.4.2.1 - Response Structure - Teams
controls.body: The organization shall implement and maintain a structure, identifying one or more teams responsible for responding to disruptions.

controls.name: Clause 8.4.3.1 - Documented Communication to Interested Parties
controls.title: Clause 8.4.3.1 - Documented Communication to Interested Parties

controls.name: SI-13(5) - Predictable Failure Prevention | Failover Capability
controls.title: Predictable Failure Prevention | Failover Capability
controls.body: Provide [Selection(one): real-time; near real-time][Assignment: organization-defined failover capability] for the system.

controls.name: Clause 8.4.4.2 - Business Continuity Plan Structure
controls.title: Clause 8.4.4.2 - Business Continuity Plan Structure

controls.name: AC-2(2) - Account Management | Automated Temporary and Emergency Account Management
controls.title: Account Management | Automated Temporary and Emergency Account Management
controls.body: Automatically [Selection (one): remove; disable] temporary and emergency accounts after [Assignment: organization-defined time period for each type of account].

controls.name: 1.6 - Universal Design
controls.title: Universal Design
controls.body: Information shall be accessible to all, include use of machine readable languages to facilitate and automate readability and clarity.

controls.name: 1.7 - Comprehensible
controls.title: Comprehensible
controls.body: Data subjects shall have a fair understanding of what they can expect with regards to the processing of their personal data, particularly when the data subjects are children or other vulnerable groups.

controls.name: 1.8 - Multi-Channel
controls.title: Multi-Channel
controls.body: Information should be provided in different channels and media, beyond the textual, to increase the probability for the information to effectively reach the data subject

controls.name: §164.504(f) - Separation between plan sponsor and group health plan (R)
controls.title: §164.504(f) - Separation between plan sponsor and group health plan (R)
controls.body: Provisions related to adequate separation between plan sponsor and group health plan (including who are authorized to access ePHI based on business need) are formally documented in the plan documents.

controls.name: PM-31 - Continuous Monitoring Strategy
controls.title: Continuous Monitoring Strategy

controls.name: Clause 8.4.3.2 - Communication to Interested Parties
controls.title: Clause 8.4.3.2 - Communication to Interested Parties
controls.body:
Where applicable, the following shall also be considered and implemented:
a) alerting interested parties potentially impacted by an actual or impending disruption;
b) ensuring appropriate coordination and communication between multiple responding organizations.
The warning and communication procedures shall be exercised as part of the organization’s exercise programme described in 8.5.

controls.name: HP - Uses and Disclosure of PHI (R)
controls.title: Uses and Disclosure of PHI (R)
controls.body: The organization has established formal policies and procedures on permitted and prohibited collection, use and disclosure of PHI. These policies and procedures are approved by management and communicated to employees and contractors.

controls.name: IA-13(2) - Identity and Authorization Servers | Verification of Identity Assertions and Access Tokens
controls.title: Identity and Authorization Servers | Verification of Identity Assertions and Access Tokens
controls.body: The source and integrity of identity assertions and access tokens are verified before granting access to system and information resources.

controls.name: Clause 8.4.5 - Recovery
controls.title: Clause 8.4.5 - Recovery
controls.body: The organization shall have documented processes to restore and return business activities from the temporary measures adopted during and after a disruption.

controls.name: Clause 9.3.1 - Management Review
controls.title: Clause 9.3.1 - Management Review
controls.body: Top management shall review the organization’s BCMS, at planned intervals, to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.B.3 - Patch Management Report
controls.title: Patch Management Report
controls.body: Patch management reports are reviewed and reflect missing security patches. (FFIEC Development and Acquisition Booklet, page 50)

controls.name: SA-4(3) - Acquisition Process | Development Methods, Techniques, and Practices
controls.title: Acquisition Process | Development Methods, Techniques, and Practices
controls.body:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to demonstrate the use of a system development life cycle process that includes:
a. [Assignment: organization-defined systems engineering methods];
b. [Selection (one or more): [Assignment: organization-defined systems security engineering methods]; [Assignment: organization-defined privacy engineering methods]] ; and 
c. [Assignment: organization-defined software development methods; testing, evaluation, assessment, verification, and validation methods; and quality control processes].

controls.name: §164.312(e)(1) - Encrypt Data in transit (S)
controls.title: §164.312(e)(1) - Encrypt Data in transit (S)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.312(a)(2)(iv)- Encryption of data in transit

controls.title: Clause 9.2.1 - Internal Audit

controls.name: 2.10 - Adjust
controls.title: Adjust
controls.body: If there is a valid change of legal basis for the processing, the actual processing must be adjusted in accordance with the new legal basis.

controls.name: Clause 8.5 - Exercise Programme and Testing
controls.title: Clause 8.5 - Exercise Programme and Testing

controls.name: SC-37 - Out-of-band Channels
controls.title: Out-of-band Channels
controls.body: Employ the following out-of-band channels for the physical delivery or electronic transmission of [Assignment: organization-defined information, system components, or devices] to [Assignment: organization-defined individuals or systems]: [Assignment: organization-defined out-of-band channels].

controls.title: Identity and Authorization Servers | Token Management

controls.name: TISAX 1.2.1 - Information Security Management System
controls.title: Information Security Management System
controls.body: The organization establishes, implements, maintains and continually improves an information security management system (ISMS).

controls.name: G.5.3.3 - Data Processing Instructions Records
controls.title: Data Processing Instructions Records
controls.body: A) There shall be a registry and/or documentation of instructions communicated by the Controller to the Processors (or where applicable by the Processor to the Subprocessors).

controls.name: IC3.1 - Internet Content Monitoring
controls.title: IC3.1 - Internet Content Monitoring
controls.body: Internet content is monitored with employee knowledge.

controls.name: TISAX 1.2.3 - Information Security in Project Management
controls.title: Information Security in Project Management
controls.body: An information security process is established and addressed in project management procedures, regardless of the type of project.

controls.name: Clause 9.2.1 - Internal Audit
controls.title: Clause 9.2.1 - Internal Audit

controls.name: HS - Key Management and Cryptographic Policy (A)
controls.title: Key Management and Cryptographic Policy (A)
controls.body: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls and key management for the protection of electronic information is developed and implemented.

controls.name: T.2.1.2 - SDNS Enabled
controls.title: SDNS Enabled
controls.body: A) Secure DNS (SDNS) shall be enabled for public domain names resolution.

controls.name: TISAX 1.3.3 - Evaluation and Approval of External IT Services
controls.title: Evaluation and Approval of External IT Services
controls.body: The organization has a process in place for assessing and evaluating risk and implementing applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements prior to the use of external IT services.

controls.name: Clause 9.3.3.2 - Documented Management Review Output
controls.title: Clause 9.3.3.2 - Documented Management Review Output

controls.name: Clause 10.1.1 - Determine Opportunities for Improvement
controls.title: Clause 10.1.1 - Determine Opportunities for Improvement
controls.body: The organization shall determine opportunities for improvement and implement necessary actions to achieve the intended outcomes of its BCMS.

controls.name: TISAX 1.4.1 - Information Security Risk Management
controls.title: Information Security Risk Management
controls.body: The organization establishes and maintains a procedure for identifying, assessing and addressing information security risks within the organization.

controls.name: Clause 9.3.3.1 - Management Review Output
controls.title: Clause 9.3.3.1 - Management Review Output

controls.name: SI-4 (23) Information system monitoring | host-based devices
controls.title: SI-4 (23) Information system monitoring | host-based devices
controls.body: The organization implements [Assignment: organization-defined host-based monitoring mechanisms] at [Assignment: organization-defined information system components].

controls.name: PCI 1.3.3 - Implement Anti-spoofing Measures
controls.title: Implement Anti-spoofing Measures
controls.body: Implement anti-spoofing measures to detect and block forged source IP addresses from entering the network.(For example, block traffic originating from the Internet with an internal source address.)

controls.name: TISAX 1.6.1 - Reporting of Information Security Events
controls.title: Reporting of Information Security Events
controls.body: The organization has adequate mechanisms in place to report potential information security events or observations through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

controls.name: TISAX 1.6.3 - Crisis Management
controls.title: Crisis Management
controls.body: The organization has procedures for crisis management with specific distribution of responsibilities and structures that enable the organization to deal with exceptional situations, e.g. during a cyber-attack or natural disaster.

controls.name: TISAX 1.6.3.1 - Crisis Management (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.title: Crisis Management (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.body: The organization has procedures for crisis management with specific distribution of responsibilities and structures that enable the organization to deal with exceptional situations, e.g. during a cyber-attack or natural disaster.

controls.name: TISAX 1.5.2 - Independent Review of ISMS
controls.title: Independent Review of ISMS
controls.body: The organization’s approach to managing information security and its implementation (i.e., control objectives, controls, policies, processes and procedures for information security) is reviewed independently at regular intervals or when fundamental changes occur.

controls.name: TISAX 1.6.2 - Management of Information Security Events
controls.title: Management of Information Security Events
controls.body: The organization has procedures in place to ensure an orderly and effective response to reported information security events and weaknesses.

controls.name: TISAX 1.6.2.1 - Management of Information Security Events  (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.title: Management of Information Security Events  (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.body: The organization has procedures in place to ensure an orderly and effective response to reported information security events and weaknesses.

controls.name: GC - Periodic Assessments
controls.title: GC - Periodic Assessments
controls.body: Periodic assessments of the systems, tools and processes are performed to identify all locations where personal information is collected, processed and distributed. Deficiencies are tracked, resolved and reported to management in a timely manner.

controls.name: §164.312(e)(2)(i) - In transit Data Encryption (A)
controls.title: §164.312(e)(2)(i) - In transit Data Encryption (A)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.312(a)(2)(iv)- Encryption of data in transit

controls.name: Clause 9.2.2 - Audit Programme(s)
controls.title: Clause 9.2.2 - Audit Programme(s)

controls.name: TISAX 2.1.2 - Compliance with Information Security Policies
controls.title: Compliance with Information Security Policies
controls.body: The contractual agreements with employees and contractors state their and the organization’s responsibilities and commitment to comply with information security policies, as well as the consequences for misconduct.

controls.name: Clause 9.3.2 - Management Review Input
controls.title: Clause 9.3.2 - Management Review Input

controls.name: Clause 10.1.2 - Nonconformity and Corrective Action
controls.title: Clause 10.1.2 - Nonconformity and Corrective Action

controls.name: HS - Clean Desk Policy (A)
controls.title: Clean Desk Policy (A)
controls.body: The organization has implemented a clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media. The policy is communicated to and acknowledged by employees and contractors.

controls.name: TBL16 - Patch Management
controls.title: TBL16 - Patch Management
controls.body: The organization maintains a patch management process to confirm the timely remediation of operating system vulnerabilities. In addition, production systems are scanned to test for patch compliance on a quarterly basis.

controls.name: Clause 5.2.1 - Establish Business Continuity Policy
controls.title: Clause 5.2.1 - Establish Business Continuity Policy

controls.name: Clause 6.2.2 - Determine Business Continuity Objectives
controls.title: Clause 6.2.2 - Determine Business Continuity Objectives

controls.name: T.2.1.6 - Backward Incompatibility
controls.title: Backward Incompatibility
controls.body: A) Backward compatibility with unsecure SSL or TLS versions shall be disabled.

controls.name: TISAX 3.1.1 - Physical Security Zones
controls.title: Physical Security Zones
controls.body: The organization has defined and implemented security zones along with the associated protective measures to provide physical protection to areas that contain sensitive information assets.

controls.name: PCI 1.5 - Policies and Procedures for Firewall Management
controls.title: Policies and Procedures for Firewall Management
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for managing firewalls are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: AC-17 (2) Remote access | protection of confidentiality / integrity using encryption
controls.title: AC-17 (2) Remote access | protection of confidentiality / integrity using encryption
controls.body: The information system implements cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality and integrity of remote access sessions.

controls.name: Clause 7.1 - Resources
controls.title: Clause 7.1 - Resources
controls.body: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the BCMS.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.Int.2 - Board Meeting Package
controls.title: Board Meeting Package
controls.body: The standard board meeting package includes reports and metrics that go beyond events and incidents to address threat intelligence trends and the institution’s security posture.

controls.name: TISAX 3.1.4 - Management of Mobile IT and Data Storage Devices
controls.title: Management of Mobile IT and Data Storage Devices
controls.body: A policy and supporting security measures are adopted to manage the risks introduced by using mobile IT devices and mobile data storage devices.

controls.name: Clause 8.1 - Operational Planning and Control
controls.title: Clause 8.1 - Operational Planning and Control

controls.name: CTRL-507 Production Server IPS
controls.title: CTRL-507 Production Server IPS
controls.body: Intrusion prevention systems (IPS) are installed and protect production servers.

controls.name: TISAX 4.1.2.1 - User Identification and Authentication (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.title: User Identification and Authentication (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.body: Users, devices, and other assets are authenticated (i.e., single-factor, multi-factor) based on the risk of the transaction (i.e., individuals' security and privacy risks and other business-related risks).

controls.name: TISAX 4.1.3 - Secure Access
controls.title: Secure Access
controls.body: Unique user IDs and secure passwords are used for identification and authentication when accessing information and IT systems. Management conducts user access reviews at regular intervals to ensure that access is appropriately restricted and access is modified or removed in a timely manner based on the results of the review.

controls.name: Sec. 33. Provision (d) - Collection and Storage Information
controls.title: Sec. 33. Provision (d) - Collection and Storage Information
controls.body:
Nothing in this Section shall be construed to limit the rights granted to parents and students under the Illinois School Student Records Act or the federal Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974

* #### Your school has a procedure in place to confirm collection and storage of student information complies with the Illinois School Student Records Act.

* #### Your school has a procedure in place to confirm collection and storage of student information complies with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974.

controls.name: TISAX 5.1.1 - Cryptographic Procedures
controls.title: Cryptographic Procedures
controls.body: The organization has determined and documented all cryptographic procedures employed and the type of cryptography required to protect information based on its classification in accordance with applicable laws.

controls.name: SA-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Situational Awareness Activities
controls.title: SA-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Situational Awareness Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Situational Awareness (SA) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: TISAX 4.2.1.1 - Access Right Management (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.title: Access Right Management (Very High Protection Needs)

controls.title: Compliance with Response Plan

controls.title: Privacy Values Integration in Development and Operations
controls.body: Processes to instill organizational privacy values within system/product/service development and operations are established and in place.

controls.title: Default Configuration

controls.name: 2.12 - Allocation of Responsibility

controls.body: Whenever joint controllership is envisaged, the parties must apportion in a clear and transparent way their respective responsibilities vis-à-vis the data subject.

controls.name: G - Transfers Based on Adequacy Decision
controls.title: G - Transfers Based on Adequacy Decision
controls.body: Any transfer of personal data to a third country or an international organization is performed based on adequacy decisions taken by the organization/commission. In addition, on an ongoing basis, the organization monitors developments in third countries and international organizations that could affect the functioning of adequacy decisions.

controls.name: MP-2 - Media Access
controls.title: Media Access

controls.name: TISAX 5.1.2.1 - Information Protection During Transfer (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.title: Information Protection During Transfer (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.body: The organization has implemented appropriate measures to protect information transmitted over public or private networks from unauthorized access.

controls.name: HP - Use and Disclosure for Facility Directories (R)
controls.title: Use and Disclosure for Facility Directories (R)
controls.body: Individuals are informed in advance and are given the opportunity to agree to or prohibit or restrict the uses or disclosures of their PHI for facility directories except during emergency circumstances where individuals can be notified thereafter.

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.2 - Segregation of Environments
controls.title: Segregation of Environments
