controls.name: 10.1.5 - Detecting, managing and recording incidents and breaches - 5
controls.title: Detecting, managing and recording incidents and breaches - 5
controls.body: Your organisation has a response plan for promptly addressing any security incidents and personal data breaches that occur.

controls.name: 9.7.1 - Rules for acceptable software use - 1
controls.title: Rules for acceptable software use - 1
controls.body: You have Acceptable Use or terms and conditions of use procedures in place.

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.5 - Vulnerability Assessment and Remediation
controls.title: Vulnerability Assessment and Remediation
controls.body: Vulnerability assessments are performed on a quarterly basis to identify threats and vulnerabilities in IT systems. Issues are identified, analyzed and addressed in a timely manner.

controls.name: M42.26 - Processing plan drafted during the planning phase
controls.title: Processing plan drafted during the planning phase
controls.body: Processing plan drafted during the planning phase (including e.g. product requirement document (PRD) and scope statement)

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.6 - Audit of IT Systems
controls.title: Audit of IT Systems
controls.body: Audits are planned and conducted at regular intervals by designated personnel to assess the effectiveness and efficiency of existing controls. The audit results are communicated and reviewed by Management, identified deficiencies are addressed in a timely manner.

controls.name: G - Procedure for International Transfer of Personal Data
controls.title: G - Procedure for International Transfer of Personal Data
controls.body: The organization has established and implemented a data transfer procedure that specifies processes and conditions on the transfer of personal data to third countries or international organizations. The procedure is approved by management and communicated to employees and contractors.

controls.name: D1.R.S.Inn.1 - Partnerships with Industry Associations and Academia
controls.title: Partnerships with Industry Associations and Academia
controls.body: The institution actively partners with industry associations and academia to inform curricula based on future cybersecurity staffing needs of the industry.

controls.name: M42.27 - Evidence of received consent, in accordance with GDPR Art. 7(1)
controls.title: Evidence of received consent, in accordance with GDPR Art. 7(1)
controls.body: Evidence of received consent, in accordance with GDPR Art. 7(1)

controls.name: D1.G.SP.B.7 - Enterprise-Wide Information Security Program
controls.title: Enterprise-Wide Information Security Program
controls.body: All elements of the information security program are coordinated enterprise-wide. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 7

controls.name: 10.1.6 - Detecting, managing and recording incidents and breaches - 6
controls.title: Detecting, managing and recording incidents and breaches - 6
controls.body: You centrally log/record/document both actual breaches and near misses (even if they do not need to be reported to the ICO or individuals).

controls.name: 10.2.1 - Assessing and reporting breaches - 1
controls.title: Assessing and reporting breaches - 1
controls.body: You have a procedure to assess the likelihood and severity of the risk to individuals as a result of a personal data breach.

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.8.1 - Business Continuity Planning (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.title: Business Continuity Planning (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.body: The organization implements Business Continuity plans (BCP) procedures and mechanisms to ensure continuity of all critical IT services. These plans are reviewed and updated at regular intervals or after substantive changes to the IT systems.

controls.name: AIC4.3 - Encryption for Data in Transit
controls.title: AIC4.3 - Encryption for Data in Transit
controls.body: Application information passing over public networks are encrypted to protect it from fraudulent activity, contract disputes and unauthorized disclosure and modification.

controls.name: 10.2.2 - Assessing and reporting breaches - 2
controls.title: Assessing and reporting breaches - 2
controls.body: You have a procedure to notify the ICO of a breach within 72 hours of becoming aware of it (even when all the information is not yet available) and you notify the ICO on time.

controls.name: TISAX 5.3.3 - Return and Secure Removal of Information Assets
controls.title: Return and Secure Removal of Information Assets
controls.body: Information assets in the possession of employees and contractors are returned upon termination of their employment or contract or securely removed upon termination of service.

controls.name: TISAX 5.3.2 - Network Services
controls.title: Network Services
controls.body: The organization identifies and includes in the network service agreement security mechanisms, service levels, and management requirements for all network services.

controls.name: TISAX 5.3.4 - Segregation of Information in Shared External Services
controls.title: Segregation of Information in Shared External Services
controls.body: System components are configured to properly segregate access for the organization and its customers from other tenant users.

controls.name: TISAX 7.1.1 - Compliance with Regulatory and Contractual Provisions
controls.title: Compliance with Regulatory and Contractual Provisions
controls.body: Organizational policies regarding compliance with legal, regulatory and contractual provisions have been developed, implemented, and communicated to relevant stakeholders. Annual reviews and updates (if applicable) of legal, regulatory and contractual provisions are performed to ensure they are relevant to information security.

controls.name: TISAX 6.1.2 - Non-disclosure Agreements
controls.title: Non-disclosure Agreements
controls.body: A confidentiality or non-disclosure agreement (NDA) reflecting the organization`s needs for information protection is identified, documented, and signed by all parties with access to confidential information. Requirements regarding the use of non-disclosure agreements and the handling of sensitive information are reviewed on a regular basis.

controls.name: TISAX 7.1.2 - Protection of Personally Identifiable Data
controls.title: Protection of Personally Identifiable Data
controls.body: A privacy policy or notice has been implemented and communicated to all relevant stakeholders regarding the protection of personally identifiable information in accordance with relevant legislation and regulations.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.B.1 - Review of Log Records
controls.title: Review of Log Records
controls.body: Audit log records and other security event logs are reviewed and retained in a secure manner. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 79)

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.1 - Physical and Environmental Security for Prototype Protection
controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security for Prototype Protection
controls.body: The organization (operator) has physical and environmental security processes maintained and implemented by the operator and at the premises and facilities of suppliers, development partners and service providers to protect the prototypes.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.4 - Viewing Protection
controls.title: Viewing Protection
controls.body: The facility has security measures in place to prevent unauthorized viewing of vehicles, components or classified parts requiring protection.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.5 - Regulated Access Control
controls.title: Regulated Access Control
controls.body: The organization has implemented adequate measures to prevent unauthorized access to security areas where vehicles, components or classified parts that require protection are manufactured, processed or stored.

controls.name: SC.2.179 - Encrypted Sessions
controls.title: SC.2.179 - Encrypted Sessions
controls.body: Use encrypted sessions for the management of network devices.

controls.name: 10.2.3 - Assessing and reporting breaches - 3
controls.title: Assessing and reporting breaches - 3
controls.body: The procedure includes details of what information must be given to the ICO about the breach.

controls.name: TISAX 8.2.1 - Internal and External Non-disclosure Agreements
controls.title: Internal and External Non-disclosure Agreements
controls.body: Non-disclosure agreements highlighting security obligations are signed by contractors and customers, as well as all organization's employees and project members, in accordance with legal provisions for data protection.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.7 - Visitor Management
controls.title: Visitor Management
controls.body: Visitor logs are used to track visitor activity at the facility and non-disclosure agreements signed prior to entering the facility in accordance with legal provisions for data protection.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.8 - On-site Client Segregation
controls.title: On-site Client Segregation
controls.body: The organization has clear client segregation measures on site to ensure unauthorized viewing and access to locations where vehicles, components and classified parts requiring protection are processed and stored.

controls.name: §164.312(e)(2)(ii) - Encryption - Data in Transit (A)
controls.title: §164.312(e)(2)(ii) - Encryption - Data in Transit (A)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.312(a)(2)(iv)- Encryption of data in transit

controls.name: TISAX 8.2.4 - Project Security Classifications
controls.title: Project Security Classifications
controls.body: A project management methodology developed and implemented emphasizing, including but not limited to, the security classification process and resulting security measures.

controls.name: SSPA23 - Microsoft Consent to Subcontract Services
controls.title: SSPA23 - Microsoft Consent to Subcontract Services
controls.body: Obtain Microsoft’s express written consent prior to subcontracting services or making any changes concerning the addition or replacement of subcontractors.

controls.name: 10.2.4 - Assessing and reporting breaches - 4
controls.title: Assessing and reporting breaches - 4
controls.body: If you consider it unnecessary to report a breach, you document the reasons why your organisation considers the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.

controls.name: 10.3 - Notifying individuals
controls.title: Notifying individuals
controls.body: You have procedures to notify affected individuals where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to their rights and freedoms.

controls.name: 10.3.1 - Notifying individuals - 1
controls.title: Notifying individuals - 1
controls.body: You have a procedure setting out how you will tell affected individuals about a breach when it is likely to result in a high risk to their rights and freedoms.

controls.name: 10.3.2 - Notifying individuals - 2
controls.title: Notifying individuals - 2
controls.body: You tell individuals about personal data breaches in clear, plain language without undue delay.

controls.name: TISAX 8.2.5 - Access to Security Areas
controls.title: Access to Security Areas
controls.body: Appropriate request documentation and authorization process are in place for individuals requiring access to security areas where vehicles, components or parts classified as requiring protection are manufactured, processed or stored.

controls.name: IR-4(1) - Incident Handling | Automated Incident Handling Processes
controls.title: Incident Handling | Automated Incident Handling Processes
controls.body: Support the incident handling process using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: TISAX 8.3.1 - Transport of Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.title: Transport of Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.body: The organization has developed and implemented a process for protecting vehicles, components, and parts against unauthorized viewing, image recording, and access during transport.

controls.name: TISAX 8.3.2 - Parking and Storage of Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.title: Parking and Storage of Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.body: The organization has a process in place for protecting vehicles, components and parts against unauthorized viewing, unauthorized photography and access during parking/storage.

controls.name: TISAX 8.4.1 - Camouflage Regulations for Trial Vehicles
controls.title: Camouflage Regulations for Trial Vehicles
controls.body: Camouflage regulations are defined, known to and followed by each project member to guarantee adequate view protection of trial vehicles.

controls.name: TISAX 8.2.7 - Device Usage in Security Areas
controls.title: Device Usage in Security Areas
controls.body: The organization has defined a process for carrying along and using mobile video and photography devices into security areas where vehicles, components or parts classified as requiring protection are manufactured, processed or stored.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.E.5 - Cryptographic Key Protection
controls.title: Cryptographic Key Protection
controls.body: Controls are in place to prevent unauthorized access to cryptographic keys.

controls.name: AOM3.5 - Organization Chart and Reporting Lines
controls.title: AOM3.5 - Organization Chart and Reporting Lines
controls.body: All organizational units and its members have defined responsibilities and authorization that would allow them to meet their organizational functions and requirements. Maintain an Organizational chart that shows the Internal structure of the organization.

controls.name: PE-9 - Power Equipment and Cabling
controls.title: Power Equipment and Cabling
controls.body: Protect power equipment and power cabling for the system from damage and destruction.

controls.name: TISAX 8.5.1 - Presentation and Events with Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.title: Presentation and Events with Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.body: The organization has described and implemented customer-specific requirements for presentations and events involving vehicles, components or parts classified as requiring protection.

controls.name: TISAX 8.5.2 - Film and Photo Shootings with Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.title: Film and Photo Shootings with Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.body: The organization has described and implemented customer-specific requirements for film and photo shootings involving vehicles, components or parts classified as requiring protection.

controls.name: DP2 - Collection of Personal Information
controls.title: Collection of Personal Information
controls.body: Personal information is collected consistent with the organization's privacy commitments and system requirements.

controls.name: TISAX 9.2.2 - Data Protection Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Data Protection Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for the workforce are established and clearly organized with respect to data protection.

controls.name: TISAX 9.4.1 - Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.body: The organization assesses the need for and implements, where appropriate, a data protection impact assessment whenever new high-risk processing of personal data or changes to existing processing is planned.

controls.name: AIC12.1 - Development and Production Network Segregation
controls.title: AIC12.1 - Development and Production Network Segregation
controls.body: Separate environments are used for development, staging and production.

controls.name: TISAX 9.6.1 - Handling Data Subject Requests
controls.title: Handling Data Subject Requests
controls.body: The organization has a procedure or mechanism in place to ensure the timely processing and fulfilment of data subject requests. All such requests must be documented, retained, and acted upon without undue days.

controls.name: SSPA13 - Data Retention
controls.title: SSPA13 - Data Retention
controls.body: Microsoft Personal and Confidential Data are retained for no longer than necessary to Perform (provide services, software licenses, cloud services) unless continued retention of the Microsoft Personal and/or Confidential Data is required by Law.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.15 - Multi-Factor Authentication for Remote Access
controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication for Remote Access
controls.body: Remote access to critical systems by employees, contractors, and third parties uses encrypted connections and multifactor authentication. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 45)

controls.name: TISAX 9.7.1 - Confidentiality Agreements
controls.title: Confidentiality Agreements
controls.body: The organization establishes and documents confidentiality obligations for employees processing personal data, ensuring compliance with applicable data protection laws and regulations.

controls.name: TISAX 9.7.2 - Data Protection Awareness Training
controls.title: Data Protection Awareness Training
controls.body: All employees of the organization and, where relevant, contractors receive appropriate data protection education and training, as relevant for their job function.

controls.name: SC.4.202 - Executable Code and Scripts
controls.title: SC.4.202 - Executable Code and Scripts
controls.body: Employ mechanisms to analyze executable code and scripts (e.g., sandbox) traversing Internet network boundaries or other organizationally defined boundaries.

controls.name: D1.G.IT.Int.1 - Baseline Configuration Change Management
controls.title: Baseline Configuration Change Management
controls.body: Baseline configurations cannot be altered without a formal change request, documented approval, and an assessment of security implications.

controls.name: TISAX 1.2.2 - Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: All information security responsibilities within the organization are clearly defined, documented, assigned and communicated.

controls.name: 1.4.4 - Operational roles - 4
controls.title: Operational roles - 4
controls.body: Data protection and information governance staff have the authority, support and resources to carry out their responsibilities effectively.

controls.name: D1.G.IT.Int.2 - Evaluation of Cyber Risk in Change Management Process
controls.title: Evaluation of Cyber Risk in Change Management Process
controls.body: A formal IT change management process requires cybersecurity risk to be evaluated during the analysis, approval, testing, and reporting of changes

controls.name: MA-5(4) - Maintenance Personnel | Foreign Nationals
controls.title: Maintenance Personnel | Foreign Nationals
controls.body:
Ensure that:

a. Foreign nationals with appropriate security clearances are used to conduct maintenance and diagnostic activities on classified systems only when the systems are jointly owned and operated by the United States and foreign allied governments, or owned and operated solely by foreign allied governments; and
b. Approvals, consents, and detailed operational conditions regarding the use of foreign nationals to conduct maintenance and diagnostic activities on classified systems are fully documented within Memoranda of Agreements.

controls.name: TISAX 1.2.4 - External Service Provider Responsibilities
controls.title: External Service Provider Responsibilities
controls.body: Information security responsibilities of external IT service providers and IT services are clearly defined and documented.

controls.name: TISAX 1.3.1 - Inventory of Assets
controls.title: Inventory of Assets
controls.body: Information and other supporting assets associated with information and information processing facilities are identified and an inventory of these assets is drawn up and maintained.

controls.name: AC-9(2) - Previous Logon Notification | Successful and Unsuccessful Logons
controls.title: Previous Logon Notification | Successful and Unsuccessful Logons
controls.body: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the number of [Selection(one): successful logons; unsuccessful logon attempts; both] during [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: TISAX 1.3.4 - Software Evaluation and Approval
controls.title: Software Evaluation and Approval
controls.body: The organization has procedures and measures in place to securely manage software installation on operational systems by ensuring appropriate evaluation and approval.

controls.name: TISAX 1.5.1 - Compliance with Security Requirements and Policies
controls.title: Compliance with Security Requirements and Policies
controls.body: Information security policies and procedures are developed and published to all employees. These policies and procedures are reviewed by appropriate management team members to ensure it is relevant and current with respect to their areas of responsibility.

controls.name: AOM2.2 - Security Awareness Program
controls.title: AOM2.2 - Security Awareness Program
controls.body: Awareness education, training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures relevant to the job functions of all employees and contractors are conducted.

controls.name: CA-3(6) - Information Exchange | Transfer Authorizations
controls.title: Information Exchange | Transfer Authorizations
controls.body: Verify that individuals or systems transferring data between interconnecting systems have the requisite authorizations (i.e., write permissions or privileges) prior to accepting such data.

controls.name: DORA-08-004 - Identification of ICT Third-Party Service Providers and Functions
controls.title: Identification of ICT Third-Party Service Providers and Functions
controls.body:
a) Identify all third-party Service Providers

b) All processes that are dependent on ICT third-party service providers are identified and documented.

c) Interconnections with ICT third-party service providers are identified.

d) The identification of ICT third-party service providers and the functions they support is reviewed regularly.

controls.name: 10.3.3 - Notifying individuals - 3
controls.title: Notifying individuals - 3
controls.body: The information you provide to individuals includes the DPO's details, a description of the likely consequences of the breach and the measures taken (including mitigating actions and any possible adverse effects).

controls.name: TISAX 2.1.1 - Screening of Employees
controls.title: Screening of Employees
controls.body: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment are carried out and are proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed, and the perceived risks.

controls.name: SC.4.197 - Physical and Logical Access Segregation
controls.title: SC.4.197 - Physical and Logical Access Segregation
controls.body: Employ physical and logical isolation techniques in the system and security architecture and/or and where deemed appropriate by the organization.

controls.name: 10.3.4 - Notifying individuals - 4
controls.title: Notifying individuals - 4
controls.body: You provide individuals with advice to protect themselves from any effects of the breach.

controls.name: 10.4 - Reviewing and monitoring
controls.title: Reviewing and monitoring
controls.body: You review and monitor personal data breaches.

controls.name: 10.4.1 - Reviewing and monitoring - 1
controls.title: Reviewing and monitoring - 1
controls.body: You analyse all personal data breach reports to prevent a recurrence.

controls.name: TISAX 2.1.3 - Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
controls.title: Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
controls.body: All employees of the organization and, where relevant, contractors receive appropriate awareness education and training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures, as relevant to their job function.

controls.name: SI-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized System and Information Integrity Approach
controls.title: SI-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized System and Information Integrity Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for System and Information Integrity (SI) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: 10.4.2 - Reviewing and monitoring - 2
controls.title: Reviewing and monitoring - 2
controls.body: Your organisation monitors the type, volume and cost of incidents.

controls.name: TISAX 2.1.4 - Teleworking
controls.title: Teleworking
controls.body: A policy and supporting security measures are implemented to protect information accessed, processed or stored at teleworking sites.

controls.name: TISAX 3.1.3 - Handling of Supporting Assets
controls.title: Handling of Supporting Assets
controls.body: Requirements for the handling (acceptable use & disposal) of supporting assets are identified, documented and implemented.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.B.6 - Disable Unused Ports and Services
controls.title: Disable Unused Ports and Services
controls.body: Ports, functions, protocols and services are prohibited if no longer needed for business purposes. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 50)

controls.name: SC.5.198 - Network Monitoring
controls.title: SC.5.198 - Network Monitoring
controls.body: Configure monitoring systems to record packets passing through the organization's Internet network boundaries and other organizationally defined boundaries.

controls.name: TISAX 4.1.1 - Handling of Identification Means
controls.title: Handling of Identification Means
controls.body: The organization has established procedures for handling the means of identification such as keys, visual IDs, other physical access devices as well as cryptographic tokens over their entire lifecycle.

controls.name: SC-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of System and Communications Protection Activities
controls.title: SC-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of System and Communications Protection Activities
controls.body: Review and measure System and Communication Protection (SC) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: TISAX 4.1.2 - User Identification and Authentication
controls.title: User Identification and Authentication
controls.body: Users, devices, and other assets are authenticated (i.e., single-factor, multi-factor) based on the risk of the transaction (i.e., individuals' security and privacy risks and other business-related risks).

controls.name: TISAX 4.2.1 - Access Right Management
controls.title: Access Right Management
controls.body: The organization has established a process for assigning and approving access rights and applying the minimum principle ("need to know"). Quarterly reviews are conducted on the assigned access rights and modified where applicable based on the review.

controls.name: PCI 11.1.1 - Inventory of Wireless Access Points
controls.title: Inventory of Wireless Access Points
controls.body: Maintain an inventory of authorized wireless access points including a documented business justification.

controls.name: 10.4.4 - Reviewing and monitoring - 4
controls.title: Reviewing and monitoring - 4
controls.body: Groups with oversight for data protection and information governance review the outputs.

controls.name: 10.5.1 - External audit or compliance check - 1
controls.title: External audit or compliance check - 1
controls.body: Your organisation completes externally-provided self-assessment tools to provide assurances on compliance with data protection and information security compliance.

controls.name: TISAX 5.1.2 - Information Protection During Transfer
controls.title: Information Protection During Transfer
controls.body: The organization has implemented appropriate measures to protect information transmitted over public or private networks from unauthorized access.

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.1 - Change Management
controls.title: Change Management
controls.body: The organization has implemented a change management process for changes to the organization, business processes and IT systems and outlines the information security requirements to prevent an uncontrolled reduction in information security.

controls.name: 10.5.3 - External audit or compliance check - 3
controls.title: External audit or compliance check - 3
controls.body: Your organisation adheres to an appropriate code of conduct or practice for your sector (if one exists).

controls.name: 1 - Demonstrate commitment to integrity and ethical values
controls.title: Demonstrate commitment to integrity and ethical values
controls.body: The organization demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

controls.title: Legal basis - credit protection
controls.body:
"Processing of personal data shall only be carried out under the following circumstances: . . .
X – for the protection of credit, including as provided in specific legislation" (LGPD Art. 7(X), unofficial translation)

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.4 - Event Logging and Analysis
controls.title: Event Logging and Analysis
controls.body: Event logs are analyzed, collected in accordance with applicable law and stored securely against tampering. Information system event logs are reviewed at regular intervals to identify and correct anomalies or suspicious activities.

controls.name: D2.IS.Is.B.2 - Contact Information of Relevant Authorities
controls.title: Contact Information of Relevant Authorities
controls.body: Contact information for law enforcement and the regulator(s) is maintained and updated regularly. (FFIEC Business Continuity Planning Work Program, Objective I: 5-1)

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.4.1 - Event Logging and Analysis  (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.title: Event Logging and Analysis  (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.body: Event logs are analyzed, collected in accordance with applicable law and stored securely against tampering. Information system event logs are reviewed at regular intervals to identify and correct anomalies or suspicious activities.

controls.name: PCI 11.3 - Penetration Test Methodology
controls.title: Penetration Test Methodology
controls.body:
Implement a methodology for penetration testing that includes the following:
Is based on industry-accepted penetration testing approaches (for example, NIST SP800-115)·Includes coverage for the entire CDE perimeter and critical systems.
- Includes testing from both inside and outside the network.
- Includes testing to validate any segmentation and scope-reduction controls.
- Defines application-layer penetration tests to include, at a minimum, the vulnerabilities listed in Requirement 6.5·Defines network-layer penetration tests to include components that support network functions as well as operating systems.
- Includes review and consideration of threats and vulnerabilities experienced in the last 12 months.
- Specifies retention of penetration testing results and remediation activities results.

controls.name: 10.5.5 - External audit or compliance check - 5
controls.title: External audit or compliance check - 5
controls.body: You have a central action plan in place to take forward the outputs from data protection and information governance audits.

controls.name: 10.6 - Internal audit programme
controls.title: Internal audit programme
controls.body: If your organisation has an internal audit programme, it covers data protection and information governance (for example security and records management) in sufficient detail.

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.6.1 - Audit of IT Systems (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.title: Audit of IT Systems (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.body: Audits are planned and conducted at regular intervals by designated personnel to assess the effectiveness and efficiency of existing controls. The audit results are communicated and reviewed by Management, identified deficiencies are addressed in a timely manner.

controls.name: AC.4.032 - Remote Network Access Restriction
controls.title: AC.4.032 - Remote Network Access Restriction
controls.body: Restrict remote network access based on organizational defined risk factors such as time of day, location of access, physical location, network connection state and measured properties of the current user and role.

controls.name: 10.6.1 - Internal audit programme - 1
controls.title: Internal audit programme - 1
controls.body: You monitor your own data protection compliance and you regularly test the effectiveness of the measures you have in place.

controls.name: TLS.2.1.03.b - Abweichungen und Risikomanagement
controls.title: Abweichungen und Risikomanagement
controls.body: Der Einsatz nicht konformer Versionen und/oder nicht konformer kryptografischer Verfahren darf nur in sachlich begründeten Ausnahmefällen und nach Rücksprache mit dem BSI erfolgen.

controls.name: CM-MC-ML.3.997 - Configuration Management Plan
controls.title: CM-MC-ML.3.997 - Configuration Management Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Configuration Management (CM).

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.8 - Business Continuity Planning
controls.title: Business Continuity Planning
controls.body: The organization implements Business Continuity plans (BCP) procedures and mechanisms to ensure continuity of all critical IT services. These plans are reviewed on at least annual basis or after substantive changes to the IT systems.

controls.name: IR-MC-ML.3.997 - Incident Response Plan
controls.title: IR-MC-ML.3.997 - Incident Response Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Incident Response (IR).

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.9 - Backup of Data and IT Services
controls.title: Backup of Data and IT Services
controls.body: Backup copies of data, software and IT services are maintained and tested in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on backup.

controls.name: MA-MC-ML.3.997 - Maintenance Plan
controls.title: MA-MC-ML.3.997 - Maintenance Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Maintenance (MA).

controls.name: 9.11 - Secure areas
controls.title: Secure areas
controls.body: You secure physical areas to prevent unauthorised access, damage, and interference to personal data.

controls.name: TISAX 5.3.1 - Information Security of IT Systems
controls.title: Information Security of IT Systems
controls.body: The organization acquires, develops and manages IT systems in accordance with its software development policy that includes information security considerations.

controls.name: AOM3.10 - Job Description
controls.title: AOM3.10 - Job Description
controls.body: All job description which documents the objectives of the role, reporting lines, responsibilities, employee qualifications and other requirements are made available to the employee.It is also reviewed and updated annually or when there is a strategic change in the organization.

controls.name: TISAX 6.1.1 - Contractors and Partners Risk Assessment
controls.title: Contractors and Partners Risk Assessment
controls.body: A supplier management process is in place, and management conducts annual risk assessments of potential and existing contractors and cooperation partners. Corrective actions are taken as needed based on the evaluation report.

controls.name: SC-MC-ML.3.997 - System and Communication Protection Plan
controls.title: SC-MC-ML.3.997 - System and Communication Protection Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes System and Communication Protection (SC).

controls.name: 1.5 - Oversight groups
controls.title: Oversight groups
controls.body: An oversight group provides direction and guidance across your organisation for data protection and information governance activites.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.2 - Property Security
controls.title: Property Security
controls.body: The organization has implemented adequate measures to prevent unauthorized access to properties where vehicles, components or classified parts that require protection are manufactured, processed or stored.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.3 - Access to Buildings and Secured Areas
controls.title: Access to Buildings and Secured Areas
controls.body: The outer skin of the buildings is protected and constructed to prevent removal or opening of the building envelope components and unauthorized access to the buildings where protected vehicles, components or classified parts are manufactured, processed or stored.

controls.name: AAU2.4 - User Guide
controls.title: AAU2.4 - User Guide
controls.body: The organization maintains contacts with relevant authorities and special interest groups. Employees and contractors adhere to the organization's established information security policies and procedures.

controls.name: SC.3.192 - Domain Name System (DNS) Filtering
controls.title: SC.3.192 - Domain Name System (DNS) Filtering
controls.body: Implement Domain Name System (DNS) filtering services.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.6 - Secure Intrusion Monitoring
controls.title: Secure Intrusion Monitoring
controls.body: The organization monitors for intrusion on its premises where vehicles, components, or classified parts that require protection are manufactured, processed, or stored. Alarm mechanisms have been installed to detect intrusions in real-time.

controls.name: SI-MC-ML.3.997 - System and Information integrity Plan
controls.title: SI-MC-ML.3.997 - System and Information integrity Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes System and Information Integrity (SI).

controls.name: TISAX 8.2.2 - Subcontractors Requirements
controls.title: Subcontractors Requirements
controls.body: Contractor approvals and non-disclosure agreements with relevant subcontractors are in place, specifying minimum requirements to be met for the protection of prototypes.

controls.name: ASO2.7 - Incident Response Procedure
controls.title: ASO2.7 - Incident Response Procedure
controls.body: Incident Response checklist created based on the incident response policy steps to track events.

controls.name: TISAX 8.2.3 - Prototype Handling Awareness Training
controls.title: Prototype Handling Awareness Training
controls.body: Employees and project members are trained annually on the safe handling of vehicles, components and classified parts that require protection.

controls.name: ARM1.8 - Risk Assessment and Mitigation
controls.title: ARM1.8 - Risk Assessment and Mitigation
controls.body:
During the annual risk assessment, and ongoing risk management process, management identifies changes to business objectives, commitments and requirements, internal operations, and external factors that threaten the achievement of business objectives and update the potential threats to system objectives. 

In response to the identification of such risks, management updates its policies, procedures, processes, and controls, as needed.

controls.name: ARM1.9 - Risk Management
controls.title: ARM1.9 - Risk Management
controls.body:
Included in the annual risk assessment, and ongoing risk management process, risk management personnel identify environmental, regulatory, and technological changes that have occurred. 

In response to the identification of such risks, management updates its policies, procedures, processes, and controls, as needed.

controls.name: SC.3.193 - Acceptable Use Policy
controls.title: SC.3.193 - Acceptable Use Policy
controls.body: Implement a policy restricting the publication of Confidential Unclassified Information (CUI) on externally-owned, publicly accessible websites (e.g., forums, LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, etc.).

controls.name: AU.5.055 - Assets without Audit Logs
controls.title: AU.5.055 - Assets without Audit Logs
controls.body: Identify assets not reporting audit logs and assure appropriate organizationally defined systems are logging.

controls.name: AOM3.8 - Review of Reporting Lines
controls.title: AOM3.8 - Review of Reporting Lines
controls.body: Reporting relationships and organizational structures are reviewed periodically by senior management as part of organizational planning and adjusted as needed based on changing entity commitments and requirements.

controls.name: DORA-09-006 - Physical Security
controls.title: Physical Security
controls.body: Controls for the protection of premises and where applicable, data centres where ICT assets and Information assets reside, are implemented.

controls.name: AAU2.7 - System Description
controls.title: AAU2.7 - System Description
controls.body: A description of the the organization system is posted on the entity's intranet and is available to authorized internal users. This description delineates the boundaries of the system and key aspects of processing.

controls.name: TISAX 8.2.6 - Image Material Protection
controls.title: Image Material Protection
controls.body: The organization defines and implements procedures to prevent the unauthorized creation or transmission of images of vehicles, components or parts classified as requiring protection.

controls.name: CA-7 - Continuous Monitoring
controls.title: Continuous Monitoring

controls.name: TISAX 8.4.2 - Protective Measures on Test/Trial Grounds
controls.title: Protective Measures on Test/Trial Grounds
controls.body: The organization has implemented protective measures in line with customer-specific requirements for maintaining an undisturbed and secured trial operation on test and trial grounds.

controls.name: SC.4.199 - Threat Intelligence
controls.title: SC.4.199 - Threat Intelligence
controls.body: Utilize threat intelligence to proactively block DNS requests from reaching malicious domains.

controls.name: TISAX 9.1.1 - Data Protection Policy
controls.title: Data Protection Policy
controls.body: Data Protection policy is established and communicated to employees and contractors within the organization. The policy is reviewed by management on an annual basis or in case of significant changes.

controls.name: AAC3.1 - Manage Account Access
controls.title: AAC3.1 - Manage Account Access
controls.body: An account management process is being followed on all production systems.

controls.name: TISAX 9.3.1 - Inventory of Processing Activities
controls.title: Inventory of Processing Activities
controls.body: The organization maintains a record/inventory of processing activities with respect to personal data collected from data subjects or processed on behalf of the controller. The documented inventory is reviewed by management on at least an annual basis to ensure it is up-to-date.

controls.name: TISAX 9.5.1 - Secure Data Transmission
controls.title: Secure Data Transmission
controls.body: The organization has mechanisms in place for secures data transmissions.

controls.name: AAC9.2 - Firewall Security
controls.title: AAC9.2 - Firewall Security
controls.body: Networks (services, information systems, users, workstations, servers, public facing) are physically segmented into zones through routers or by implementing firewalls according to defined criteria (risk exposure, business value, data flows, etc).

controls.name: DPR02 - Profile 2
controls.title: DPR02 - Profile 2
controls.body: For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to respond to all applicable Data Protection Requirements (DPR) and provide evidence of compliance. The Assurance requirement for this profile is a self-attestation of compliance to the DPR.

controls.name: TISAX 9.5.2 - Secure Data Transfers to Subcontractors
controls.title: Secure Data Transfers to Subcontractors
controls.body: The organization enforces contractual obligations on subcontractors and cooperation partners to ensure compliance with secure data protection requirements.

controls.name: TISAX 9.5.3 - Secure Data Transfers to Third Countries
controls.title: Secure Data Transfers to Third Countries
controls.body: The organization has mechanisms in place for secures data transfers to third countries.

controls.name: SC.4.229 - URL Filtering/Categorization
controls.title: SC.4.229 - URL Filtering/Categorization
controls.body: Utilize a URL categorization service and implement techniques to enforce URL filtering of websites that are not approved by the organization.

controls.name: HB - Breach Notification to Authorities (R)
controls.title: Breach Notification to Authorities (R)
controls.body: Procedures are in place to notify data breaches to appropriate authorities and media outlets. Such notifications are provided within 60 calendar days after discovery of a breach (if a breach affects 500 or more individuals) and no later than 60 days after the end of the calendar year (if a breach affects fewer than 500 individuals), except in cases stated by law enforcement official to delay the notification.

controls.name: DPR01 - Profile 1
controls.title: DPR01 - Profile 1
controls.body: For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to respond to all applicable Data Protection Requirements (DPR) and provide evidence of compliance. The Assurance requirement for this profile is a self-attestation of compliance to the DPR.

controls.name: TISAX 9.6.2 - Data Protection Incident Management
controls.title: Data Protection Incident Management
controls.body: The organization has procedures in place to ensure that data protection incidents, such as unauthorized access to personal data, are identified, reported, and processed in a timely manner.

controls.name: AIC4.1 - Information Labelling
controls.title: AIC4.1 - Information Labelling
controls.body: Information is classified and labeled in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification.

controls.name: AAU2.8 - System Description Documentation
controls.title: AAU2.8 - System Description Documentation
controls.body: Documentation of the system description is made available to authorized customers, as well as to end users via the entity's customer-facing website and mobile application.

controls.name: DPR05 - Profile 5
controls.title: DPR05 - Profile 5
controls.body: For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to respond to all applicable Data Protection Requirements (DPR) and provide evidence of compliance. The Assurance requirement for this profile is a self-attestation of compliance to the DPR.

controls.name: TISAX 9.8.1 - Data Processing Instructions
controls.title: Data Processing Instructions
controls.body: The organization has procedures in place to receive, document, and implement any instructions by the controller regarding the processing of personal data.

controls.name: TISAX 1.3.2 - Classification and Handling of Information Assets
controls.title: Classification and Handling of Information Assets
controls.body: The organization has adopted a classification scheme to classify information assets based on the protection goals of information security (confidentiality, integrity and availability) and serve as a basis for the handling of supporting assets.

controls.name: AAM2.1 - IT Asset Inventory
controls.title: AAM2.1 - IT Asset Inventory
controls.body: A software inventory is created and maintained for authorization purposes. List software for servers, workstations, laptops including OS and version.

controls.name: CM-8 (5) Information system component inventory | no duplicate accounting of components
controls.title: CM-8 (5) Information system component inventory | no duplicate accounting of components
controls.body: The organization verifies that all components within the authorization boundary of the information system are not duplicated in other information system inventories.

controls.name: PCI 10.3.2 - Event Type
controls.title: Event Type
controls.body: Type of event.

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.3 - Protection from Malware
controls.title: Protection from Malware
controls.body: The organization has defined and implemented technical and organizational measures to protect against malware.

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.7 - Network Segmentation
controls.title: Network Segmentation
controls.body: The organization's network is divided into multiple distinct zones with controlled and monitored access to detect or prevent unintended data exchange or access between IT systems.

controls.name: IA-5 (11) Authenticator management | hardware token-based authentication
controls.title: IA-5 (11) Authenticator management | hardware token-based authentication
controls.body: The information system, for hardware token-based authentication, employs mechanisms that satisfy [Assignment: organization-defined token quality requirements].

controls.name: PE-11 Emergency power
controls.title: PE-11 Emergency power
controls.body: The organization provides a short-term uninterruptible power supply to facilitate [Selection (one or more): an orderly shutdown of the information system; transition of the information system to long-term alternate power] in the event of a primary power source loss.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.B.3 - Threat Information Sharing
controls.title: Threat Information Sharing
controls.body: The institution has policies commensurate with its risk and complexity that address the concepts of threat information sharing. (FFIEC EBanking Booklet, page 28)

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.9.1 - Backup of Data and IT Services (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.title: Backup of Data and IT Services (Very High Protection Needs)
controls.body: Backup copies of data, software and IT services are maintained and tested in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on backup.

controls.name: DPR08 - Profile 8
controls.title: DPR08 - Profile 8
controls.body: For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to respond to all applicable Data Protection Requirements (DPR) and provide evidence of compliance. The Assurance requirement for this profile is a self-attestation of compliance to the DPR.

controls.name: TISAX 8.4.3 - Protective Measures on Public Roads
controls.title: Protective Measures on Public Roads
controls.body: The organization has implemented protective measures in line with customer-specific requirements for the operation of trial vehicles classified as requiring protection on public roads.

controls.name: PCI 10.3.4 - Success or Failure Indicators
controls.title: Success or Failure Indicators
controls.body: Success or failure indication.

controls.name: PCI A1.3 - Audit Log Enabled for Each Entity’s Cardholder Data Environment
controls.title: Audit Log Enabled for Each Entity’s Cardholder Data Environment
controls.body: Ensure logging and audit trails are enabled and unique to each entity’s cardholder data environment and consistent with PCI DSS Requirement 10.

controls.name: SSPA51 - Payment Card Processing
controls.title: SSPA51 - Payment Card Processing
controls.body: When processing credit cards on Microsoft’s behalf, the organization adheres to the applicable credit card handling standards per card issuer.

controls.name: AAU1.2 - Internal Control Assessment
controls.title: AAU1.2 - Internal Control Assessment
controls.body: A regular review of the effectiveness and efficiency of the internal controls, processes and policies in the organization. Observed weaknesses are communicated to responsible stakeholders for resolution.

controls.name: SC-31(2) - Covert Channel Analysis | Maximum Bandwidth
controls.title: Covert Channel Analysis | Maximum Bandwidth
controls.body: Reduce the maximum bandwidth for identified covert [Selection (one or more): storage; timing] channels to [Assignment: organization-defined values].

controls.name: IR-3 Incident response testing
controls.title: IR-3 Incident response testing
controls.body: The organization tests the incident response capability for the information system [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] using [Assignment: organization-defined tests] to determine the incident response effectiveness and documents the results.

controls.name: CM-11(2) - User-installed Software | Software Installation with Privileged Status
controls.title: User-installed Software | Software Installation with Privileged Status
controls.body: Allow user installation of software only with explicit privileged status.

controls.name: DORA-09-001 Information Security Policy
controls.title: DORA-09-001 Information Security Policy
controls.body: An information security policy, that defines rules for protection of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the ICT and information assets, is developed and disseminated.

controls.name: DPR06 - Profile 6
controls.title: DPR06 - Profile 6
controls.body: For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to respond to all applicable Data Protection Requirements (DPR) and provide evidence of compliance. The Assurance requirement for this profile is a self-attestation of compliance to the DPR.

controls.name: DORA-10-001 - Detection of Anomalous Activities
controls.title: Detection of Anomalous Activities
controls.body:
Mechanisms are deployed to promptly detect anomalous activities for ICT network performance issues and ICT-related incidents by enabling multiple layers of controls, including:

a) Defining alert thresholds 

b) Defining criteria to trigger ICT-related incident detection 

ci) Defining criteria to trigger ICT-related incident response processes

c) Having automatic alert mechanisms in place for relevant staff in charge of ICT-related incident response

controls.name: DORA-10-002 - Incident Detection and Response
controls.title: Incident Detection and Response
controls.body:
a) Detection mechanisms are deployed to identify and mitigate all potential single points of failure (SPOFs).
b) All deployed detection mechanisms are regularly tested.

controls.name: DPR03 - Profile 3
controls.title: DPR03 - Profile 3
controls.body: For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to respond to all applicable Data Protection Requirements (DPR) and provide evidence of compliance. The Assurance requirement for this profile is a self-attestation of compliance to the DPR and Independent Assurance of compliance, which could be either a completed Independent Assessment against the DPR or submit an ISO 27001 certification or submit SOC 2 with Security Trust Criteria (this option retires in December 2021).

controls.name: AC-MC-ML.3.997 - Access Control Plan
controls.title: AC-MC-ML.3.997 - Access Control Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Access Control (AC).

controls.name: AC-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Access Control Approach
controls.title: AC-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Access Control Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Access Control (AC) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: GV.OC-03 - Cybersecurity Legal, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements
controls.title: Cybersecurity Legal, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements
controls.body: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity - including privacy and civil liberties obligations - are understood and managed.

controls.name: GV.OC-05 - Organizational Dependencies
controls.title: Organizational Dependencies
controls.body: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated.

controls.name: GV.RM-01 - Risk Management Objectives
controls.title: Risk Management Objectives
controls.body: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.

controls.name: AC-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Access Control Activities
controls.title: AC-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Access Control Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Access Control (AC) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: DORA-09-014 - Logging
controls.title: Logging
controls.body: Logging procedures have been developed, documented and implemented.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.1 - Separation of Development and Production Environment
controls.title: Separation of Development and Production Environment
controls.body: Separate development/test environments from production environments, and enforce the separation with access controls.

controls.name: GV.RM-03 - Integrating Cybersecurity in Enterprise Risk Management
controls.title: Integrating Cybersecurity in Enterprise Risk Management
controls.body: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes.

controls.name: AU.2.044 - Audit Log Review
controls.title: AU.2.044 - Audit Log Review
controls.body: Review audit logs.

controls.name: DORA-09-015 - Project Management Policy
controls.title: Project Management Policy
controls.body: Project Management Policy, that defines the rules for effective management of ICT projects related to the acquisition, maintenance and development, is developed, documented, disseminated and implemented

controls.name: GV.RM-04 - Strategic Direction for Risk Response Options
controls.title: Strategic Direction for Risk Response Options
controls.body: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated.

controls.name: GV.RM-05 - Lines of Communication
controls.title: Lines of Communication
controls.body: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties.

controls.name: GV.RM-07 - Opportunities in Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
controls.title: Opportunities in Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
controls.body: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions.

controls.name: AAC8.8 - Encryption and Key Management
controls.title: AAC8.8 - Encryption and Key Management
controls.body: Cryptographic keys are protected & managed securely.

controls.name: AAC3.2 - Revoke Access on Termination
controls.title: AAC3.2 - Revoke Access on Termination
controls.body: Access rights of employees and contractors to information and systems are revoked upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

controls.name: GV.SC-03 - Supply Chain Risk Management Integrated with Enterprise Risk Management
controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Integrated with Enterprise Risk Management
controls.body: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes.

controls.name: GV.SC-04 - Prioritization of Suppliers by Criticality in Cybersecurity
controls.title: Prioritization of Suppliers by Criticality in Cybersecurity
controls.body: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality.

controls.name: GV.SC-07 - Third-Party Risk Assessment
controls.title: Third-Party Risk Assessment
controls.body: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship.

controls.name: GV.SC-08 - Integrating Third Parties in Incident Management
controls.title: Integrating Third Parties in Incident Management
controls.body: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities.

controls.name: AAC9.6 - System Log Management
controls.title: AAC9.6 - System Log Management
controls.body: A centralized event and log management system is implemented.

controls.name: GV.RR-01 - Management Responsibilities
controls.title: Management Responsibilities
controls.body: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving.

controls.name: GV.RR-02 - Cyber Security Risk Management Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Cyber Security Risk Management Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced.

controls.name: GV.SC-10 - Post-Partnership Provisions in Supply Chain Risk Plans
controls.title: Post-Partnership Provisions in Supply Chain Risk Plans
controls.body: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement.

controls.name: SS3 - Authentication for Serverless Functions
controls.title: Authentication for Serverless Functions
controls.body: Unique user IDs, strong passwords and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) are required to access the serverless architecture function.

controls.name: GV.RR-03 - Aligning Resources with Cybersecurity Risk Strategy
controls.title: Aligning Resources with Cybersecurity Risk Strategy
controls.body: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with cybersecurity risk strategy, roles and responsibilities, and policies.

controls.name: GV.PO-02 - Review of Cybersecurity Risk Management Policies
controls.title: Review of Cybersecurity Risk Management Policies
controls.body: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission.

controls.name: AU.4.053 - Audit Log Analysis
controls.title: AU.4.053 - Audit Log Analysis
controls.body: Automate the analysis of audit logs to identify and act on critical indicators (TTPs) and/or organizationally defined suspicious activity.

controls.name: GV.OV-03 - Cybersecurity Risk Management Performance Evaluation
controls.title: Cybersecurity Risk Management Performance Evaluation
controls.body: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed to confirm and adjust strategic direction.

controls.name: GV.OV-01 - Review of Cybersecurity Risk Management Strategy Outcomes
controls.title: Review of Cybersecurity Risk Management Strategy Outcomes
controls.body: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction.

controls.name: ID.AM-02 - Software, Services and Systems Inventory
controls.title: Software, Services and Systems Inventory
controls.body: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained.

controls.name: AU.4.054 - Detailed Audit Log Reviews
controls.title: AU.4.054 - Detailed Audit Log Reviews
controls.body: Review audit information for broad activity in addition to per-machine activity.

controls.name: AT-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Awareness and Training Activities
controls.title: AT-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Awareness and Training Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Awareness and Training (AT) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: ID.AM-05 - Asset Classification
controls.title: Asset Classification
controls.body: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission.

controls.name: ID.AM-07 - Data Inventory
controls.title: Data Inventory
controls.body: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained.

controls.name: ID.AM-04 - Third-Party Services Inventory
controls.title: Third-Party Services Inventory
controls.body: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained.

controls.name: ID.RA-01 - Vulnerability Identification
controls.title: Vulnerability Identification
controls.body: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded.

controls.name: A.13.1.1 - Network Controls
controls.title: Network Controls
controls.body: Networks shall be managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

controls.name: AAM1.0 - Information/Equipment Disposal and Recycling Vendor
controls.title: AAM1.0 - Information/Equipment Disposal and Recycling Vendor
controls.body:
The entity
• locates and removes or redacts specified confidential information as required.
• regularly and systematically destroys, erases, or makes anonymous confidential
information that is no longer required for the purposes identified in its confidentiality commitments or system requirements.
• erases or destroys records in accordance with the retention policies, regardless of the method of storage (for example, electronic, optical media, or paper based).
• disposes of original, archived, backup, and ad hoc or personal copies of records in accordance with its destruction policies.
• documents the disposal of
confidential information.

controls.name: ID.RA-04 - Threat Likelihood and Impact Analysis
controls.title: Threat Likelihood and Impact Analysis
controls.body: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded.

controls.name: AT-MC-ML.3.997 - Awareness and Training Plan
controls.title: AT-MC-ML.3.997 - Awareness and Training Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Awareness and Training (AT).

controls.name: ID.RA-07 - Change Management
controls.title: Change Management
controls.body: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked.

controls.name: OM8.4 - Employee Code of Conduct
controls.title: OM8.4 - Employee Code of Conduct
controls.body: The Code of Conduct and Ethics encourages open communication with employees, managers, and subordinates relating to conflict resolution. In addition, it states that Company personnel witnessing any improper behaviour should report such incidents promptly through appropriate channels.

controls.name: ID.RA-08 - Vulnerability Management
controls.title: Vulnerability Management
controls.body: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established.

controls.name: AT-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Awareness and Training Approach
controls.title: AT-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Awareness and Training Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Awareness and Training (AT) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: ID.RA-09 - Hardware and Software Due Diligence
controls.title: Hardware and Software Due Diligence
controls.body: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use.

controls.name: ID.IM-01 - Cyber Security Evaluations
controls.title: Cyber Security Evaluations
controls.body: Improvements are identified from evaluations.

controls.name: SI.5.222 - Analysis of System Behaviour
controls.title: SI.5.222 - Analysis of System Behaviour
controls.body: Analyze system behavior to detect and mitigate the execution of normal system commands and scripts that indicate malicious actions.

controls.name: ID.IM-04 - Cybersecurity Plans
controls.title: Cybersecurity Plans
controls.body: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved.

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
controls.name: PR.AA-03 - Users, services and hardware authentication
controls.title: Users, services and hardware authentication
controls.body: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated.

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
controls.name: PR.AA-05 - Access Control Management
controls.title: Access Control Management
controls.body: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties.

controls.name: AT-MC-ML.2.999 - Awareness and Training
controls.title: AT-MC-ML.2.999 - Awareness and Training
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes Awareness and Training (AT).

controls.name: PR.AT-01 - General Awareness and Training
controls.title: General Awareness and Training
controls.body: Personnel are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind.

controls.name: PCI 8.5.1 - Service Provider with Remote Access
controls.title: Service Provider with Remote Access
controls.body:
Additional requirement for service providers only: Service providers with remote access to customer premises (for example, for support of POS systems or servers) must use a unique authentication credential (such as a password/phrase) for each customer.

Note:This requirement is not intended to apply to shared hosting providers accessing their own hostingenvironment, where multiple customer environments are hosted.

Processes are in place within applications to ensure that when data is removed from the application, either explicitly by users or based on other triggers such as the age of the data, it is securely deleted.

controls.title: MP-MC-ML.3.997 - Media Protection Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Media Protection (MP).

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
controls.name: PR.AA-02 - Identity Review
controls.title: Identity Review
controls.body: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions.

controls.name: TLS.2.1.05.a - Sicherheitsanforderungen für Projekte des Bundes
controls.title: Sicherheitsanforderungen für Projekte des Bundes
controls.body: Die Vorgaben der TR-03116-4 bezüglich der Authentisierung MÜSSEN eingehalten werden (insbesondere das Kapitel 5 "Identifizierung von Kommunikationspartnern").

controls.name: 4.3 - Logging and tracking requests
controls.title: Logging and tracking requests
controls.body: Your organisation logs receipt of all verbal and written requests from individuals and updates the log to track the handling of each request.

controls.name: IR.5.110 - Unannounced Incident Test Exercises
controls.title: IR.5.110 - Unannounced Incident Test Exercises
controls.body: Perform unannounced operational exercises to demonstrate technical and procedural responses.

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
controls.name: PR.AA-04 - Identity Assertions
controls.title: Identity Assertions
controls.body: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified.

controls.name: MP-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Media Protection Activities
controls.title: MP-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Media Protection Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Media Protection (MP) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: SSK 2.2.04.b - Einsatzumgebung
controls.title: Einsatzumgebung
controls.body: Außerdem MUSS es einen zyklischen Prozess zur Erkennung, Analyse, Bewertung und Bereinigung von Schwachstellen geben (Schwachstellenmanagement).

controls.name: SSK.2.1.01.a - Vertrauenswürdiger Kanal
controls.title: Vertrauenswürdiger Kanal
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS einen gesicherten Kanal zu Administrationszwecken und zur Übertragung der Protokollierungsdaten bereitstellen.

controls.name: M42.31 - Documentation of derogations for specific situations with regard to data transfer
controls.title: Documentation of derogations for specific situations with regard to data transfer
controls.body: Documentation of derogations for specific situations with regard to data transfer, in accordance with GDPR Art. 49(6)

controls.name: PR.DS-01 - Protection of Data at Rest
controls.title: Protection of Data at Rest
controls.body: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected.

controls.name: MP-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Media Protection Approach
controls.title: MP-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Media Protection Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Media Protection (MP) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: CE.016 - Protect Against Brute-Force Attack
controls.title: Protect Against Brute-Force Attack
controls.body: Protect biometric tests, passwords and PINs against brute-force attacks.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.01.b - Vertrauenswürdiger Kanal
controls.title: Vertrauenswürdiger Kanal
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS die jeweils gültige Version des Mindeststandards des BSI „Verwendung von Transport Layer Security“ mit gegenseitiger zertifikatsbasierter Authentisierung oder Mechanismen mindestens gleicher Stärke (siehe jeweils gültige Versionen von TR-02102-1, TR-02102-3, TR-02102-4) zum Schutz der Integrität, Authentizität und Vertraulichkeit des Administrationskanals unterstützen.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.02.a - Identifikation und Authentisierung der Benutzer
controls.title: Identifikation und Authentisierung der Benutzer
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS eine Benutzeridentifikation/-authentisierung durchführen. Diese KANN auch mittels Single Sign-on, etwa über die Benutzeranmeldung am Betriebssystem umgesetzt werden.

controls.name: PR.DS-02 - Protection of Data in Transit
controls.title: Protection of Data in Transit
controls.body: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected.

controls.name: AAC8.9 - Encryption and Key Management
controls.title: AAC8.9 - Encryption and Key Management
controls.body: SSL, secure file transfer protocol (SFTP), and other encryption technologies are used for defined points of connectivity and to protect communications between the Company systems and end users connecting from within or external to customer networks.

controls.name: T.2.2.5 - Key Revocation
controls.title: Key Revocation
controls.body: A) The compromised keys shall be effectively revoked.

controls.name: §164.316(a) - Policies and Procedures (S)
controls.title: §164.316(a) - Policies and Procedures (S)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under- § 164.308(a)(1)(i) - Policies and Procedures (S)

controls.name: PR.DS-10 - Protection of Data in Use
controls.title: Protection of Data in Use
controls.body: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected.

controls.name: Test
controls.title: Test
controls.body: Test

controls.name: PR.PS-01 - Configuration Management
controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.body: Configuration management practices are established and applied.

controls.name: PR.PS-03 - Hardware Management
controls.title: Hardware Management
controls.body: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.

controls.name: AC6.1 - Remote Access Time-Out
controls.title: AC6.1 - Remote Access Time-Out
controls.body: Remote access connections include a time-out system. Set the amount of time that can pass without activity before a remote control session is disconnected.

controls.name: AC-2 (5) Account management | inactivity logout
controls.title: AC-2 (5) Account management | inactivity logout
controls.body: The organization requires that users log out when [Assignment: organization-defined time-period of expected inactivity or description of when to log out].

controls.name: PR.PS-05 - Unauthorized Software
controls.title: Unauthorized Software
controls.body: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented.

controls.name: SSPA19 - Data Subject Rights Request Records
controls.title: SSPA19 - Data Subject Rights Request Records
controls.body: The organization records the date and time of Data Subject Rights requests and the actions taken by the organization in response to such requests. If a request is denied, the Data Subject will be provided with a written letter of explanation at Microsoft's direction.

controls.name: PR.IR-01 - Networks Protection
controls.title: Networks Protection
controls.body: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage.

controls.name: CC8.1.3 - Segregation of Duties
controls.title: CC8.1.3 - Segregation of Duties
controls.body:
System change requests must be reviewed and approved by the  Engineering Lead prior to work commencing on the requested change.
Segregation of duties exists between those responsible for authorizing changes and those responsible for implementing them to Production.

controls.name: AC-17 (4) Remote access | privileged commands / access
controls.title: AC-17 (4) Remote access | privileged commands / access
controls.body:
The organization:
 (a)   Authorizes the execution of privileged commands and access to security-relevant information via remote access only for [Assignment: organization-defined needs]; and
 (b)   Documents the rationale for such access in the security plan for the information system.

controls.name: RS.AN-08 - Incident Magnitude
controls.title: Incident Magnitude
controls.body: The incident's magnitude is estimated and validated.

controls.name: AC3.5 - Production System Account Management
controls.title: AC3.5 - Production System Account Management
controls.body: An account management process is being followed on all production systems.

controls.name: PE-12 Emergency lighting
controls.title: PE-12 Emergency lighting
controls.body: The organization employs and maintains automatic emergency lighting for the information system that activates in the event of a power outage or disruption and that covers emergency exits and evacuation routes within the facility.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.B.4 - Information Security Policy
controls.title: Information Security Policy
controls.body: The institution has board-approved policies commensurate with its risk and complexity that address information security. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 16)

controls.name: GV.OC-04 - Organizational Objectives
controls.title: Organizational Objectives
controls.body: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated.

controls.name: GV.RM-06 - Standardized Cybersecurity Risk Assessment Methods
controls.title: Standardized Cybersecurity Risk Assessment Methods
controls.body: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated.

controls.name: IC2.1 - DKIM Email Authentication
controls.title: IC2.1 - DKIM Email Authentication
controls.body: DKIM records are added to the domains that the organization sends email from. Other organizations that send email on our behalf use the same key.

controls.name: PS-MC-ML.2.999 - Personnel Security Policy
controls.title: PS-MC-ML.2.999 - Personnel Security Policy
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes Personnel Security (PS).

controls.name: SSK.2.1.02.b - Identifikation und Authentisierung der Benutzer
controls.title: Identifikation und Authentisierung der Benutzer
controls.body: Nur nach erfolgreicher Benutzeridentifikation/-authentisierung des Administrators DÜRFEN Anpassungen an der Konfiguration der Schnittstellenkontrolle durch einen Administrator möglich sein.

controls.name: SSPA29 - Mitigating Harm from Unauthorized Data Processing
controls.title: SSPA29 - Mitigating Harm from Unauthorized Data Processing
controls.body: The organization promptly takes action to mitigate any actual or potential harm caused by a subcontractor’s unauthorized or Unlawful Processing of Microsoft Personal and Confidential Data.

controls.name: PS-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Personnel Security Activities
controls.title: PS-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Personnel Security Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Personnel Security (PS) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: CC8.1.2 - Change Management Requests
controls.title: CC8.1.2 - Change Management Requests
controls.body: Application changes are driven by bug reports, required security enhancements, and the planned Product Roadmap. Change Request Tickets are assigned to development team members during team planning meetings.

controls.name: AC-17 (9) Remote access | disconnect / disable access
controls.title: AC-17 (9) Remote access | disconnect / disable access
controls.body: The organization provides the capability to expeditiously disconnect or disable remote access to the information system within [Assignment: organization-defined time period].
