controls.name: IC2.2 - DMARC Email Authentication
controls.title: IC2.2 - DMARC Email Authentication
controls.body: DMARC records are added to all domains owned by the organization to protect domains that are not used to send email and to monitor SPF and DKIM implementations on domains that email messages are sent from.

controls.name: GV.OV-02 - Review of Cybersecurity Risk Management Strategy
controls.title: Review of Cybersecurity Risk Management Strategy
controls.body: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.04.a - Identifikation der Daten
controls.title: Identifikation der Daten
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS Daten auf angeschlossenen Geräten anhand ihrer Metadaten (etwa Dateiendung, Dateisignatur/Magic Number) identifizieren können.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.04.b - Identifikation der Daten
controls.title: Identifikation der Daten
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS die Identifizierung von geschachtelten bzw. eingebetteten (unverschlüsselten) Daten gewährleisten; zum Beispiel anhand von Dateisignatur und -endung.

controls.name: ID.RA-05 - Risk Identification and Prioritization
controls.title: Risk Identification and Prioritization
controls.body: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.04.c - Identifikation der Daten
controls.title: Identifikation der Daten
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS die Definition individueller Dateiformate zulassen; beispielsweise um Dateien interner Fachanwendungen in die Schnittstellenkontrolle zu integrieren.

controls.name: §164.502(j)(2) - Disclosures by whistleblowers
controls.title: §164.502(j)(2) - Disclosures by whistleblowers
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under  §164.502(j)(1) - Disclosures by whistleblowers

controls.name: PS-MC-ML.3.997 - Personnel Security Plan
controls.title: PS-MC-ML.3.997 - Personnel Security Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Personnel Security (PS).

controls.category: Identity Management, Authentication and Access Control
controls.name: PR.AA-01 - Identity Management
controls.title: Identity Management
controls.body: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization.

controls.name: PR.AT-02 - Specialized Awareness and Training
controls.title: Specialized Awareness and Training
controls.body: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind.

controls.name: OM3.3 - Personnel Phishing Awareness Testing
controls.title: OM3.3 - Personnel Phishing Awareness Testing
controls.body: Phishing tests are conducted once a year on organization personnel to measure and increase their security awareness.

controls.name: DE.AE-06 - Adverse Events Information Dissemination
controls.title: Adverse Events Information Dissemination
controls.body: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools.

controls.name: RS.AN-03 - Root Cause Analysis
controls.title: Root Cause Analysis
controls.body: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident.

controls.name: RS.CO-02 - Stakeholder Notification of Incidents
controls.title: Stakeholder Notification of Incidents
controls.body: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents.

controls.name: RC.RP-02 - Recovery Actions
controls.title: Recovery Actions
controls.body: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed.

controls.name: RC.RP-05 - Integrity of Restored Assets
controls.title: Integrity of Restored Assets
controls.body: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed.

controls.name: PCI 8.1 - User Identification Management
controls.title: User Identification Management
controls.body: Define and implement policies and procedures to ensure proper user identification management for non- consumer users and administrators on all system components.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.05.a - Autonome Arbeitsweise
controls.title: Autonome Arbeitsweise
controls.body: Wenn die Schnittstellenkontrolle ihre Konfiguration von anderen IT-Systemen (Servern) bezieht, MUSS diese auch nach Trennung von jenen IT-Systemen funktionsfähig bleiben.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.05.b - Autonome Arbeitsweise
controls.title: Autonome Arbeitsweise
controls.body: Freigaben MÜSSEN auch im Offline-Betrieb geschützter Rechner eingerichtet werden können, beispielsweise durch telefonische/schriftliche Challenge-Response-Verfahren.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.06.a - Schnittstellen
controls.title: Schnittstellen
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS die Erkennung und Behandlung der nach dem Stand der Technik offerierten Schnittstellen ermöglichen. Alle anderen SOLLTEN gesperrt werden (Whitelisting).

controls.name: SI-3(6) - Malicious Code Protection | Testing and Verification
controls.title: Malicious Code Protection | Testing and Verification
controls.body:
a. Test malicious code protection mechanisms [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] by introducing known benign code into the system; and
b. Verify that the detection of the code and the associated incident reporting occur.

controls.name: CC6.2.3 - Firewall Monitoring
controls.title: CC6.2.3 - Firewall Monitoring
controls.body: A firewall monitors incoming and outgoing traffic on the Corporate network. Firewall monitoring alerts are sent to the Corporate IT team.

controls.name: IC2.0 - SPF Email Authentication
controls.title: IC2.0 - SPF Email Authentication
controls.body: SPF records are added to domains that the organization sends emails from including other organizations that send emails on behalf of the organization.

controls.name: DORA-09-016 - Systems Acquisition, Development, and Maintenance
controls.title: Systems Acquisition, Development, and Maintenance
controls.body: ICT systems acquisition, development, and maintenance policy and procedures are developed, documented, disseminated and implemented.

controls.name: RC.RP-06 - End of Incident Criteria
controls.title: End of Incident Criteria
controls.body: The criteria for determining the end of the incident recovery is applied, and incident-related documentation is completed.

controls.name: DORA-09-002 Encryption
controls.title: DORA-09-002 Encryption
controls.body: Cryptographic mechanisms are implemented to protect the security of data at rest, in use or in transit.

controls.name: DORA-11-003 - ICT Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.title: ICT Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.body:
a) ICT Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP) associated with the entity's business continuity plan, is developed and implemented.

b) The ICT Disaster Recovery Plan undergoes periodic independent audit reviews.

c) The ICT Disaster Recovery Plan is tested at least yearly and following substantial changes to the ICT systems.

controls.name: PE-MC-ML.2.998 - Physical Protection Implementation
controls.title: PE-MC-ML.2.998 - Physical Protection Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Physical Protection (PE) policy.

controls.name: ID.RA-10 - Assessing Suppliers Prior to Acquisition
controls.title: Assessing Suppliers Prior to Acquisition
controls.body: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition.

controls.name: DORA-14-001 Communications Policy
controls.title: DORA-14-001 Communications Policy
controls.body:
a) Communication policies and procedures that define rules for responsible disclosure of ICT-related incidents or major vulnerabilities to staff, customers, partners, authorities, as well as to the public, are developed and disseminated.

b) The Communication policy is periodically reviewed and approved by the management body.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.07.a - Applikationen
controls.title: Applikationen
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS die Ausführung von Programmen und Skripten, die sich auf den angeschlossenen Geräten im Sinne dieses Standards befinden, steuern, überwachen und protokollieren.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.09.b - Management von Sicherheitsattributen
controls.title: Management von Sicherheitsattributen
controls.body: Sofern die Kontrolle des Zugriffs vom Hypervisor nicht unterstützt wird, SOLLTE auf Ebene des Virtual Machine Monitors (VMM) oder im Gastsystem eine Absicherung stattfinden.

controls.name: PE-MC-ML.3.997 - Physical Protection Plan
controls.title: PE-MC-ML.3.997 - Physical Protection Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Physical Protection (PE).

controls.name: PE-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Physical Protection Activities
controls.title: PE-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Physical Protection Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Physical Protection (PE) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.A.6 - Organizational Risk to Financial Sector
controls.title: Organizational Risk to Financial Sector
controls.body: The board or an appropriate board committee ensures that management’s actions consider the cyber risks that the institution poses to the financial sector.

controls.name: 4.3.1 - Logging and tracking requests - 1
controls.title: Logging and tracking requests - 1
controls.body: You have processes in place to make sure that the log is accurate and updated as appropriate.

controls.name: CC5.3.2 - Infrastructure and Software Hardening
controls.title: CC5.3.2 - Infrastructure and Software Hardening
controls.body: Established entity standards exist for infrastructure and software hardening and configuration that include requirements for implementation of access control software, entity configuration standards, and standardized access control lists.

controls.name: DORA-09-008 - Protection of Cryptography Keys
controls.title: Protection of Cryptography Keys
controls.body: Strong authentication mechanisms are implemented to protect cryptographic keys.

controls.name: PE-MC-ML.5.995 -  Standardized Physical Protection Approach
controls.title: PE-MC-ML.5.995 -  Standardized Physical Protection Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Physical Protection (PE) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.Inn.2 - Cyber Risks to Critical Infrastructures
controls.title: Cyber Risks to Critical Infrastructures
controls.body: The board or an appropriate board committee verifies that management’s actions consider the cyber risks that the institution poses to other critical infrastructures (e.g., telecommunications, energy).

controls.name: DORA-06-004 Audit and Remediation
controls.title: DORA-06-004 Audit and Remediation
controls.body: The ICT risk management framework is audited on a regular basis by ICT auditors and a formal follow-up process for the timely verification and remediation of critical ICT audit findings, is defined and implemented.

controls.name: DORA-09-004 Access Control Policy And Procedures
controls.title: DORA-09-004 Access Control Policy And Procedures
controls.body: Access control policy and procedures that define rules for controlling, managing and monitoring  physical and virtual access to ICT and Information assets, are developed and disseminated.

controls.name: DORA-09-013 - Data and System Security
controls.title: Data and System Security
controls.body: Data security procedures to protect against intrusions and data misuse, are developed, documented and implemented.

controls.name: M42.32 - Documentation of security incidents, in accordance with GDPR Art. 33(2)
controls.title: Documentation of security incidents, in accordance with GDPR Art. 33(2)
controls.body: Documentation of security incidents, in accordance with GDPR Art. 33(2)

controls.name: CC1.3.2 - Organization Structure and Reporting Lines
controls.title: CC1.3.2 - Organization Structure and Reporting Lines
controls.body: The Entity evaluates its organizational structure, reporting lines, authorities, and responsibilities as part of its annual business planning process and as part of its ongoing risk assessment activities.

controls.name: DORA-08-001 - Asset Identification and Classification
controls.title: Asset Identification and Classification
controls.body:
(a) Establish ICT Asset Management Policy and Procedures 

(b) ICT-related business functions are identified, classified, and adequately documented.

(c) The information and ICT assets supporting those functions, including those on remote sites, network resources, and hardware equipment, are identified, classified, documented, and those deemed critical are mapped.

(d) The adequacy of the classification of the information assets is reviewed as necessary and at least annually.

controls.name: CA.L2-3.12.2 - Plan of Action (NIST 800-171: 3.12.2)
controls.title: Plan of Action (NIST 800-171: 3.12.2)
controls.body: Develop and implement plans of action designed to correct deficiencies and reduce or eliminate vulnerabilities in organizational systems.

controls.name: AC8.2 - Cryptographic Keys Protection
controls.title: AC8.2 - Cryptographic Keys Protection
controls.body: Cryptographic keys are protected & managed securely.

controls.name: DORA-09-011 - Vulnerability and Patch Management
controls.title: Vulnerability and Patch Management
controls.body: Vulnerability and Patch Management process which defines rules for identifying vulnerabilities and evaluating, prioritizing, testing and deploying patches and updates, are developed and disseminated.

controls.name: CA.L2-3.12.3 - Security Control Monitoring (NIST 800-171: 3.12.3)
controls.title: Security Control Monitoring (NIST 800-171: 3.12.3)
controls.body: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis to ensure the continued effectiveness of the controls.

controls.name: CC1.1.3 - Background Checks
controls.title: CC1.1.3 - Background Checks
controls.body: Personnel must pass background before they may be hired.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.10.a - Generieren von Protokollierungsdaten
controls.title: Generieren von Protokollierungsdaten
controls.body:
Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS eine vollständige und unmittelbare Protokollierung der Informationsflüsse gewährleisten. Diese umfasst mindestens:
- Zeitpunkt der Aktion,
- Aktion,
- Quelle des Informationsflusses,
- Übertragungsweg (betroffene Schnittstelle),
- Ziel des Informationsflusses,
- die von dem Informationsfluss betroffene Applikationen,
- die mit dem Informationsfluss verbundene Benutzeridentität sowie deren Gruppenzugehörigkeit.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.10.b - Generieren von Protokollierungsdaten
controls.title: Generieren von Protokollierungsdaten
controls.body: Die Protokollierung MUSS sich von berechtigten Personen abschalten, pseudonymisieren und feingranular konfigurieren lassen.

controls.name: DORA-13-003 - Continuous Monitoring
controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.body: The effectiveness of the implementation of the operational resilience strategy is monitored on a continuous basis including analysis of the frequency, type, magnitude, and evolution of ICT-related incidents, particularly cyber-attacks, in order to observe patterns and understand the level of ICT risk exposure, to enhance the cyber maturity and preparedness of the entity.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.3 - Role Separation (NIST 800-171: 3.13.3)
controls.title: Role Separation (NIST 800-171: 3.13.3)
controls.body: Separate user functionality from system management functionality.

controls.name: IR.L2-3.6.3 - Incident Response Testing (NIST 800-171: 3.6.3)
controls.title: Incident Response Testing (NIST 800-171: 3.6.3)
controls.body: Test the organizational incident response capability.

controls.name: M80.14 - Performing a DPIA pre-assessment relating to risk identification
controls.title: Performing a DPIA pre-assessment relating to risk identification
controls.body: Performing a DPIA pre-assessment relating to risk identification

controls.name: DORA-05-001 Management Responsibilities
controls.title: DORA-05-001 Management Responsibilities
controls.body: The entity's management body is responsible for defining, approving, and supervising the implementation of the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) risk management framework by establishing an internal governance and control framework.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.4 - Shared Resource Control (NIST 800-171: 3.13.4)
controls.title: Shared Resource Control (NIST 800-171: 3.13.4)
controls.body: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.

controls.name: MA.L2-3.7.3 - Equipment Sanitization (NIST 800-171: 3.7.3)
controls.title: Equipment Sanitization (NIST 800-171: 3.7.3)
controls.body: Ensure equipment removed for off-site maintenance is sanitized of any Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

controls.name: CIS 17.5-RE - Incident Response Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Incident Response Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body:
Incident Response Management
Safeguard 17.5: Assign key roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: RE-MC-ML.2.999 - Recovery Policy
controls.title: RE-MC-ML.2.999 - Recovery Policy
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes Recovery (RE).

controls.name: DORA-07-001 - ICT Systems, Protocols and Tools - Capacity Management
controls.title: ICT Systems, Protocols and Tools - Capacity Management
controls.body: A comprehensive capacity plan and procedures, designed to address the capacity requirements of ICT systems, protocols, and tools, are developed, maintained and implemented.

controls.name: SC.L1-B.1.XI [FCI DATA] /SC.L2-3.13.5[CUI DATA] - Public-Access System Separation (NIST 800-171: 3.13.5)
controls.title: Public-Access System Separation (NIST 800-171: 3.13.5)
controls.body: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.E.2 - Oversight of Vendor Access
controls.title: Oversight of Vendor Access
controls.body: A formal program assigns responsibility for ongoing oversight of thirdparty access.

controls.name: AC3.3 - Adjust Access on Role Change
controls.title: AC3.3 - Adjust Access on Role Change
controls.body: Employee and contractor's access rights are adjusted as their employment, contract or role changes. Approval is required if additional access is granted.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.10.c - Generieren von Protokollierungsdaten
controls.title: Generieren von Protokollierungsdaten
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS entweder die Protokollierungsfunktionen des Betriebssystems nutzen oder die Protokolle strukturiert an einen zentralisierten Protokollierungsspeicher zur Auswertung übertragen können.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.10.d - Generieren von Protokollierungsdaten
controls.title: Generieren von Protokollierungsdaten
controls.body: Eine darüberhinausgehende Protokollierung MUSS per Konfiguration festlegbar sein.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.11.a - Zentrale Verwaltung
controls.title: Zentrale Verwaltung
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle MUSS die Möglichkeit zum Import von zentral erstellten Konfigurationen bereitstellen.

controls.name: DORA-08-002 Asset Interdependence
controls.title: DORA-08-002 Asset Interdependence
controls.body: The configuration of information and ICT assets, as well as the links and interdependencies between the different information and ICT assets, are documented.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.6 - Network Communication by Exception (NIST 800-171: 3.13.6)
controls.title: Network Communication by Exception (NIST 800-171: 3.13.6)
controls.body: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception (e.g., deny all, permit by exception).

controls.name: MA.L2-3.7.4 - Media Inspection (NIST 800-171: 3.7.4)
controls.title: Media Inspection (NIST 800-171: 3.7.4)
controls.body: Check media containing diagnostic and test programs for malicious code before the media are used in organizational systems.

controls.name: DORA-13-002 Lessons Learned From Business Continuity And Disaster Recovery Tests
controls.title: DORA-13-002 Lessons Learned From Business Continuity And Disaster Recovery Tests
controls.body: Lessons learnt from digital operational resilience testing and any ICT-related incident, are duly incorporated on a continuous basis into the ICT risk assessment process.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.7 - Split Tunneling (NIST 800-171: 3.13.7)
controls.title: Split Tunneling (NIST 800-171: 3.13.7)
controls.body: Prevent remote devices from simultaneously establishing non-remote connections with organizational systems and communicating via some other connection to resources in external networks (e.g., split tunneling).

controls.name: PCI 4.1 - Cryptography and Security Protocol
controls.title: Cryptography and Security Protocol
controls.body:
Use strong cryptography and security protocols to safeguard sensitive cardholder data during transmission over open, public networks, including the following:·
- Only trusted keys and certificates are accepted.·
- The protocol in use only supports secure versions or configurations.·
- The encryption strength is appropriate for the encryption methodology in use.


Examples of open, public networks include but are not limited to:·The Internet·Wireless technologies, including 802.11 and Bluetooth·Cellular technologies, for example, Global System for Mobile communications (GSM), Code division multiple access (CDMA)·General Packet Radio Service (GPRS)·Satellite communications

controls.name: MA.L2-3.7.5 - Nonlocal Maintenance (NIST 800-171: 3.7.5)
controls.title: Nonlocal Maintenance (NIST 800-171: 3.7.5)
controls.body: Require multifactor authentication to establish nonlocal maintenance sessions via external network connections and terminate such connections when nonlocal maintenance is complete.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.9 - Connections Termination (NIST 800-171: 3.13.9)
controls.title: Connections Termination (NIST 800-171: 3.13.9)
controls.body: Terminate network connections associated with communications sessions at the end of the sessions or after a defined period of inactivity.

controls.name: MA.L2-3.7.6 - Maintenance Personnel (NIST 800-171: 3.7.6)
controls.title: Maintenance Personnel (NIST 800-171: 3.7.6)
controls.body: Supervise the maintenance activities of personnel without required access authorization.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.10 - Management of Cryptographic Keys (NIST 800-171: 3.13.10)
controls.title: Management of Cryptographic Keys (NIST 800-171: 3.13.10)
controls.body: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for cryptography employed in organizational systems.

controls.name: MP.L2-3.8.1 - Media Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.8.1)
controls.title: Media Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.8.1)
controls.body: Protect (i.e., physically control and securely store) system media containing CUI, both paper and digital.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.4 - Separation of Duties (NIST 800-171: 3.1.4)
controls.title: Separation of Duties (NIST 800-171: 3.1.4)
controls.body: Separate the duties of individuals to reduce the risk of malevolent activity without collusion.

controls.name: CTDPA 2.1 - Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.title: Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.body: The organization has established a consumer rights procedure that specifies the process and time frames for handling consumers' requests with respect to their personal information. The procedure is communicated to all the employees and reviewed by management on at least an annual basis.

controls.name: AC3.4 - Privileges to Install Software/Applications
controls.title: AC3.4 - Privileges to Install Software/Applications
controls.body: The privileges to install applications and software on production servers is restricted to authorized IT personnel.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.11 - CUI Encryption (NIST 800-171: 3.13.11)
controls.title: CUI Encryption (NIST 800-171: 3.13.11)
controls.body: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

controls.name: MP.L2-3.8.2 - Media Access (NIST 800-171: 3.8.2)
controls.title: Media Access (NIST 800-171: 3.8.2)
controls.body: Limit access to Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) on system media to authorized users.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.5 - Least Privilege (NIST 800-171: 3.1.5)
controls.title: Least Privilege (NIST 800-171: 3.1.5)
controls.body: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.

controls.name: 2.1 - Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.title: Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.body: The organization has established a consumer’s rights procedure that specifies the process and time frames for handling consumers' requests with respect to their personal information. The procedure is communicated to all the employees and reviewed by management on at least an annual basis.

controls.name: Clause 4.1 - Organizational Context
controls.title: Organizational Context
controls.body:
The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcome(s) of its information security management system.

The organization shall determine whether climate change is a relevant issue.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.12 - Collaborative Device Control (NIST 800-171: 3.13.12)
controls.title: Collaborative Device Control (NIST 800-171: 3.13.12)
controls.body: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and provide an indication of devices in use to users present at the device.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.8 - Unsuccessful Logon Attempts (NIST 800-171: 3.1.8)
controls.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts (NIST 800-171: 3.1.8)
controls.body: Limit unsuccessful login attempts.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.Int.3 - Risk Management - Cybersecurity Strategy
controls.title: Risk Management - Cybersecurity Strategy
controls.body: The cybersecurity strategy is incorporated into or conceptually fits within the institution’s enterprise-wide risk management strategy.

controls.name: RE-MC-ML.3.997 - Recovery Plan
controls.title: RE-MC-ML.3.997 - Recovery Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Recovery (RE).

controls.name: SA-MC-ML.2.999 - Situational Awareness Policy
controls.title: SA-MC-ML.2.999 - Situational Awareness Policy
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes Situational Awareness (SA).

controls.name: RM-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Risk Management Activities
controls.title: RM-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Risk Management Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Risk Management (RM) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.14 - Voice over Internet Protocol (NIST 800-171: 3.13.14)
controls.title: Voice over Internet Protocol (NIST 800-171: 3.13.14)
controls.body: Control and monitor the use of Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) technologies.

controls.name: MP.L2-3.8.4 - Asset/Media Classification (NIST 800-171: 3.8.4)
controls.title: Asset/Media Classification (NIST 800-171: 3.8.4)
controls.body: Mark media with necessary Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) markings and distribution limitations.

controls.name: RE-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Recovery Activities
controls.title: RE-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Recovery Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Recovery (RE) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: RE-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Recovery Approach
controls.title: RE-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Recovery Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Recovery (RE) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.9 - Privacy & Security Notices (NIST 800-171: 3.1.9)
controls.title: Privacy & Security Notices (NIST 800-171: 3.1.9)
controls.body: Provide privacy and security notices consistent with applicable Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) rules.

controls.name: 4.3.2 - Logging and tracking requests - 2
controls.title: Logging and tracking requests - 2
controls.body: The log shows the due date for requests, the actual date of the final response and the action taken.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.16 - Data at Rest (NIST 800-171: 3.13.16)
controls.title: Data at Rest (NIST 800-171: 3.13.16)
controls.body: Protect the confidentiality of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) at rest.

controls.name: RE.2.137 - Backup Restoration
controls.title: RE.2.137 - Backup Restoration
controls.body: Regularly perform and test data back-ups.

controls.name: MP.L2-3.8.6 - Cryptography/Encryption of Data at Rest (NIST 800-171: 3.8.6)
controls.title: Cryptography/Encryption of Data at Rest (NIST 800-171: 3.8.6)
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) stored on digital media during transport unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.10 - Session Lock (NIST 800-171: 3.1.10)
controls.title: Session Lock (NIST 800-171: 3.1.10)
controls.body: Use session lock with pattern-hiding displays to prevent access and viewing of data after a period of inactivity.

controls.name: RM1.9 - Risk Mitigation
controls.title: RM1.9 - Risk Mitigation
controls.body: As part of the risk assessment and mitigation processes, the organization identifies, designs, develops, and implements key controls where deemed necessary. The organization uses several mediums, including customer feedback, application/system security and performance monitoring, and internal performance reviews, to monitor the overall effectiveness of its underlying control environment. Identified discrepancies are appropriately investigated and, where needed, resolved. The resolution of such discrepancies may include updating the risk assessment and related mitigation strategies, including controls.

controls.name: SI.L1-B.1.XII [FCI DATA] / SI.L2-3.14.1[CUI DATA] - Flaw Remediation (NIST 800-171: 3.14.1)
controls.title: Flaw Remediation (NIST 800-171: 3.14.1)
controls.body: Identify, report and correct information and information system flaws in a timely manner.

controls.name: IC4.2 - Information Management
controls.title: IC4.2 - Information Management
controls.body: Assets are handled in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.name: PCI 12.8.3 - Service Provider Engagement Process
controls.title: Service Provider Engagement Process
controls.body: Ensure there is an established process for engaging service providers including proper due diligence prior to engagement.

controls.name: MP.L2-3.8.7 - Removable Media (NIST 800-171: 3.8.7)
controls.title: Removable Media (NIST 800-171: 3.8.7)
controls.body: Control the use of removable media on system components.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.12 - Control Remote Access (NIST 800-171: 3.1.12)
controls.title: Control Remote Access (NIST 800-171: 3.1.12)
controls.body: Monitor and control remote access sessions.

controls.name: SI.L1-B.1.XIII[FCI DATA] / SI.L2-3.14.2[CUI DATA] - Malicious Code Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.14.2)
controls.title: Malicious Code Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.14.2)
controls.body: Provide protection from malicious code at appropriate locations within organizational information systems.

controls.name: MP.L2-3.8.8 - Shared Media (NIST 800-171: 3.8.8)
controls.title: Shared Media (NIST 800-171: 3.8.8)
controls.body: Prohibit the use of portable storage devices when such devices have no identifiable owner.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.13 - Remote Access Confidentiality (NIST 800-171: 3.1.13)
controls.title: Remote Access Confidentiality (NIST 800-171: 3.1.13)
controls.body: Employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.

controls.name: PCI 3.6.3 - Secure Cryptographic Key Storage
controls.title: Secure Cryptographic Key Storage
controls.body: Secure cryptographic key storage

controls.name: SI.L2-3.14.3 - Security Alerts & Advisories (NIST 800-171: 3.14.3)
controls.title: Security Alerts & Advisories (NIST 800-171: 3.14.3)
controls.body: Monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action in response.

controls.name: RE.3.139 - Data Backup and Monitoring
controls.title: RE.3.139 - Data Backup and Monitoring
controls.body: Regularly perform complete, comprehensive and resilient data backups as organizationally defined.

controls.name: PCI 3.6.7 - Unauthorised Replacement of Cryptographic Keys
controls.title: Unauthorised Replacement of Cryptographic Keys
controls.body: Prevention of unauthorized substitution of cryptographic keys.

controls.name: MP.L2-3.8.9 - Protect Backups (NIST 800-171: 3.8.9)
controls.title: Protect Backups (NIST 800-171: 3.8.9)
controls.body: Protect the confidentiality of backup Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) at storage locations.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.14 - Remote Access Routing (NIST 800-171: 3.1.14)
controls.title: Remote Access Routing (NIST 800-171: 3.1.14)
controls.body: Route remote access via managed access control points.

controls.name: SI.L1-B.1.XIV [FCI DATA] /SI.L2-3.14.4[CUI DATA] - Update Malicious Code Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.14.4)
controls.title: Update Malicious Code Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.14.4)
controls.body: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.

controls.name: RE.5.140 - Security Requirement for Data-Processing Facilities
controls.title: RE.5.140 - Security Requirement for Data-Processing Facilities
controls.body: Ensure information processing facilities meet organizationally defined information security continuity, redundancy and availability requirements.

controls.name: PE.L1-B.1.VIII[FCI DATA] / PE.L2-3.10.1[CUI DATA] - Limit Physical Access (NIST 800-171: 3.10.1)
controls.title: Limit Physical Access (NIST 800-171: 3.10.1)
controls.body: Limit physical access to organizational information systems, equipment and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.15 - Privileged Remote Access (NIST 800-171: 3.1.15)
controls.title: Privileged Remote Access (NIST 800-171: 3.1.15)
controls.body: Authorize remote execution of privileged commands and remote access to security-relevant information.

controls.name: SI.L1-B.1.XV [FCI DATA] /SI.L2-3.14.5[CUI DATA] - System & File Scanning (NIST 800-171: 3.14.5)
controls.title: System & File Scanning (NIST 800-171: 3.14.5)
controls.body: Perform periodic scans of the information system and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.

controls.name: PE.L1-B.1.IX [FCI DATA]/PE.L2-3.10.3 [CUI DATA] - Escort Visitors (NIST 800-171: 3.10.3)
controls.title: Escort Visitors (NIST 800-171: 3.10.3)
controls.body: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.16 - Wireless Access Authorization (NIST 800-171: 3.1.16)
controls.title: Wireless Access Authorization (NIST 800-171: 3.1.16)
controls.body: Authorize wireless access prior to allowing such connections.

controls.name: RM-MC-ML.2.999 - Risk Management Policy
controls.title: RM-MC-ML.2.999 - Risk Management Policy
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes Risk Management (RM).

controls.name: D1.R.St.E.3 - Cybersecurity Staff Competence
controls.title: Cybersecurity Staff Competence
controls.body: Staff with cybersecurity responsibilities have the requisite qualifications to perform the necessary tasks of the position.

controls.name: RM-MC-ML.3.997 - Risk Management Plan
controls.title: RM-MC-ML.3.997 - Risk Management Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Risk Management (RM). Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Risk Management (RM).

controls.name: SI.L2-3.14.6 - Monitor Communications for Attacks (NIST 800-171: 3.14.6)
controls.title: Monitor Communications for Attacks (NIST 800-171: 3.14.6)
controls.body: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.

controls.name: PE.L1-B.1.IX [FCI DATA]/PE.L2-3.10.4 [CUI DATA] - Physical Access Logs (NIST 800-171: 3.10.4)
controls.title: Physical Access Logs (NIST 800-171: 3.10.4)
controls.body: Maintain audit logs of physical access.

controls.name: OM2.24 - Security Council
controls.title: OM2.24 - Security Council
controls.body: The Company has established a Security Council, consisting of members of the Executive, IT Operations, Development, and IT Security teams. The Security Council meets monthly to evaluate whether the Company's security initiatives are aligned with operational risks, objectives, and goals.

controls.name: SI.L2-3.14.7 - Identify Unauthorized Use (NIST 800-171: 3.14.7)
controls.title: Identify Unauthorized Use (NIST 800-171: 3.14.7)
controls.body: Identify unauthorized use of organizational systems.

controls.name: PE.L1-B.1.IX [FCI DATA]/PE.L2-3.10.5 [CUI DATA] - Manage Physical Access (NIST 800-171: 3.10.5)
controls.title: Manage Physical Access (NIST 800-171: 3.10.5)
controls.body: Control and manage physical access devices.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.17 - Wireless Access Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.1.17)
controls.title: Wireless Access Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.1.17)
controls.body: Protect wireless access using authentication and encryption.

controls.name: RA.L2-3.11.1 - Risk Assessments (NIST 800-171: 3.11.1)
controls.title: Risk Assessments (NIST 800-171: 3.11.1)
controls.body: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations (including mission, functions, image, or reputation), organizational assets and individuals, resulting from the operation of organizational systems and the associated processing, storage, or transmission of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

controls.name: IC12.4 - Logical Network Security Controls
controls.title: IC12.4 - Logical Network Security Controls
controls.body: Logical security controls through subnetting, routing and use of logical access controls are implemented.

controls.name: AC.L1-B.1.III [FCI DATA] / AC.L2-3.1.20 [CUI DATA] - External Connections (NIST 800-171: 3.1.20)
controls.title: External Connections (NIST 800-171: 3.1.20)
controls.body: Verify and control/limit connections to and use of external information systems.

controls.name: PCI 11.2.3 - Vulnerability Scans After a Significant Change
controls.title: Vulnerability Scans After a Significant Change
controls.body: Perform internal and external scans, and rescans as needed, after any significant change. Scans must be performed by qualified personnel.

controls.name: RA.L2-3.11.2 - Vulnerability Scan (NIST 800-171: 3.11.2)
controls.title: Vulnerability Scan (NIST 800-171: 3.11.2)
controls.body: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems and applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities affecting those systems and applications are identified.

controls.name: IC12.6 - Network Control Documentation
controls.title: IC12.6 - Network Control Documentation
controls.body: Technical and procedural controls, service levels and management requirements of all network services are identified and documented for both in-house or outsourced services.

controls.name: IC12.7 - Network Analysis
controls.title: IC12.7 - Network Analysis
controls.body: Network analysis is conducted quarterly or whenever a new technology is implemented to ensure network segmentation and that service levels are being met.

controls.name: AC-18 (1) Wireless access | authentication and encryption
controls.title: AC-18 (1) Wireless access | authentication and encryption
controls.body:
The information system protects wireless access to the system using authentication of [Selection
(one or more): users; devices] and encryption.

controls.name: AC.L1-B.1.IV [FCI DATA] / AC.L2-3.1.22 [CUI DATA] - Control Public Information (NIST 800-171: 3.1.22)
controls.title: Control Public Information (NIST 800-171: 3.1.22)
controls.body: Control information posted or processed on publicly accessible information systems.

controls.name: RM-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Risk Management Approach
controls.title: RM-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Risk Management Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Risk Management (RM) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: RA-8 - Privacy Impact Assessments
controls.title: Privacy Impact Assessments
controls.body:
Conduct privacy impact assessments for systems, programs, or other activities before:

a. Developing or procuring information technology that processes personally identifiable information; and
b. Initiating a new collection of personally identifiable information that:

1. Will be processed using information technology; and
2. Includes personally identifiable information permitting the physical or virtual (online) contacting of a specific individual, if identical questions have been posed to, or identical reporting requirements imposed on, ten or more individuals, other than agencies, instrumentalities, or employees of the federal government.

controls.name: Clause 6.1.4 - AI System Impact Assessment Process
controls.title: AI System Impact Assessment Process
controls.body:
The organization shall define a process for assessing the potential consequences for individuals or groups of individuals, or both, and societies that can result from the development, provision or use of AI systems.

The AI system impact assessment shall determine the potential consequences an AI system’s deployment, intended use and foreseeable misuse has on individuals or groups of individuals, or both, and societies.

The AI system impact assessment shall take into account the specific technical and societal context where the AI system is deployed and applicable jurisdictions.

The result of the AI system impact assessment shall be documented. Where appropriate, the result of the system impact assessment can be made available to relevant interested parties as defined by the organization.

The organization shall consider the results of the AI system impact assessment in the risk assessment (see 6.1.2). 

Controls within section A.5 provides controls for assessing impacts of AI systems.

controls.name: RA.L2-3.11.3 - Vulnerability Remediation (NIST 800-171: 3.11.3)
controls.title: Vulnerability Remediation (NIST 800-171: 3.11.3)
controls.body: Remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with risk assessments.

controls.name: AT.L2-3.2.1 - Role-Based Risk Awareness (NIST 800-171: 3.2.1)
controls.title: Role-Based Risk Awareness (NIST 800-171: 3.2.1)
controls.body: Ensure that managers, system administrators and users of organizational systems are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities and of the applicable policies, standards and procedures related to the security of those systems.

controls.name: Clause 6.3 - AI Change Management Plan
controls.title: AI Change Management Plan
controls.body: When the organization determines the need for changes to the AI management system, the changes shall be carried out in a planned manner.

controls.name: AT.L2-3.2.2 - Role-Based Training (NIST 800-171: 3.2.2)
controls.title: Role-Based Training (NIST 800-171: 3.2.2)
controls.body: Ensure that personnel are trained to carry out their assigned information security-related duties and responsibilities.

controls.name: SSPA2 - DPR Personnel
controls.title: SSPA2 - DPR Personnel
controls.body: The organization has assigned the responsibility and accountability for compliance with the Data Protection Requirements (DPR) to a designated person or group.

controls.name: OM2.3 - Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreements Include Information Protection Language
controls.title: OM2.3 - Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreements Include Information Protection Language
controls.body: Requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements (NDA) reflecting the organization’s needs for the protection of information are identified, documented and reviewed annually.

controls.name: D4.C.Co.E.3 - Restricted Access to Network Diagram
controls.title: Restricted Access to Network Diagram
controls.body: Network and systems diagrams are stored in a secure manner with proper restrictions on access.

controls.name: OM4 - Code of Conduct and Ethics
controls.title: Code of Conduct and Ethics
controls.body: The organization has defined a Code of Conduct and Ethics and reviews them annually.

controls.name: AU.L2-3.3.1 - System Auditing (NIST 800-171: 3.3.1)
controls.title: System Auditing (NIST 800-171: 3.3.1)
controls.body: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.

controls.name: AC-20 Use of external information systems
controls.title: AC-20 Use of external information systems
controls.body:
The organization establishes terms and conditions, consistent with any trust relationships established with other organizations owning, operating, and/or maintaining external information systems, allowing authorized individuals to:
 a. Access the information system from external information systems; and
 b. Process, store, or transmit organization-controlled information using external information systems.

controls.name: HS - Maintenance and Retention of Records (R)
controls.title: Maintenance and Retention of Records (R)
controls.body: Records of assessments and activities required to be performed as per defined policies and procedures are maintained and retained for six years from the date of its creation or when it was last in effect, whichever is later.

controls.name: PCI A2.3 - Secure Service Offering
controls.title: Secure Service Offering
controls.body: All service providers must provide a secure service offering.

controls.name: AU.L2-3.3.2 - User Accountability (NIST 800-171: 3.3.2)
controls.title: User Accountability (NIST 800-171: 3.3.2)
controls.body: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be uniquely traced to those users so they can be held accountable for their actions.

controls.name: SSPA4 - Compliance with Microsoft Documented Instructions
controls.title: SSPA4 - Compliance with Microsoft Documented Instructions
controls.body: Microsoft Personal Data is only processed in accordance with Microsoft's documented instructions, including scenarios involving transfers of Microsoft Personal Data to a third country or an international organization unless otherwise required by law.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.2 - Creating and Updating Documented Information
controls.title: Creating and Updating Documented Information

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.Int.1 - Risk Mitigation Employees
controls.title: Risk Mitigation Employees
controls.body: Employees that are essential to mitigate the risk (e.g., fraud, business resilience) know their role in incident escalation.

controls.name: AU.L2-3.3.3 - Event Review (NIST 800-171: 3.3.3)
controls.title: Event Review (NIST 800-171: 3.3.3)
controls.body: Review and update logged events.

controls.name: Clause 8.1 - Operational Planning and Control
controls.title: Operational Planning and Control
controls.body:
The organization shall plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet requirements, and to implement the actions determined in Clause 6, by:
— establishing criteria for the processes;
— implementing control of the processes in accordance with the criteria.

The organization shall implement the controls determined according to 6.1.3 that are related to the operation of the AI management system (e.g. AI system development and usage life cycle related controls).

The effectiveness of these controls shall be monitored and corrective actions shall be considered if the intended results are not achieved. Annex A lists reference controls and Annex B provides implementation guidance for them.

Documented information shall be available to the extent necessary to have confidence that the processes have been carried out as planned.

The organization shall control planned changes and review the consequences of unintended changes, taking action to mitigate any adverse effects, as necessary.

The organization shall ensure that externally provided processes, products or services that are relevant to the AI management system are controlled.

controls.name: AU-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Audit and Accountability Activities
controls.title: AU-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Audit and Accountability Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Audit and Accountability (AU) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: AU-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Audit and Accountability Approach
controls.title: AU-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Audit and Accountability Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Audit and Accountability (AU) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: AU.L2-3.3.5 - Audit Correlation (NIST 800-171: 3.3.5)
controls.title: Audit Correlation (NIST 800-171: 3.3.5)
controls.body: Correlate audit record review, analysis and reporting processes for investigation and response to indications of unlawful, unauthorized, suspicious, or unusual activity.

controls.name: SSPA33 - Remediation Plan
controls.title: SSPA33 - Remediation Plan
controls.body: The organization has implemented a remediation plan and monitors the resolution of each Data Breach to ensure that appropriate corrective action is taken on a timely basis.

controls.name: AU.L2-3.3.6 - Reduction & Reporting (NIST 800-171: 3.3.6)
controls.title: Reduction & Reporting (NIST 800-171: 3.3.6)
controls.body: Provide audit record reduction and report generation to support on-demand analysis and reporting.

controls.name: Clause 9.2.2 - Internal Audit Programme
controls.title: Internal Audit Programme
controls.body:
The organization shall plan, establish, implement and maintain (an) audit programme(s), including the frequency, methods, responsibilities, planning requirements and reporting.

When establishing the internal audit programme(s), the organization shall consider the importance of the processes concerned and the results of previous audits.

The organization shall:
a) define the audit objectives, criteria and scope for each audit;
b) select auditors and conduct audits to ensure objectivity and the impartiality of the audit process;
c) ensure that the results of audits are reported to relevant managers.

Documented information shall be available as evidence of the implementation of the audit programme(s) and the audit results.

controls.name: Clause 9.3.1 - Management Review - General
controls.title: Management Review - General
controls.body: Top management shall review the organization’s AI management system, at planned intervals, to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

controls.name: 4.9 - Data portability
controls.title: Data portability
controls.body: Individuals are able to move, copy or transfer their personal data from your organisation to another securely, without affecting the data.

controls.name: AU.L2-3.3.7 - Authoritative Time Source (NIST 800-171: 3.3.7)
controls.title: Authoritative Time Source (NIST 800-171: 3.3.7)
controls.body: Provide a system capability that compares and synchronizes internal system clocks with an authoritative source to generate timestamps for audit records.

controls.name: RM.4.149 - Records of Threat Profiles
controls.title: RM.4.149 - Records of Threat Profiles
controls.body: Catalog and periodically update threat profiles and adversary Tactics, Techniques and Procedures (TTPs).

controls.name: SSPA6 - Collection of Microsoft Personal Data Over Voice Call
controls.title: SSPA6 - Collection of Microsoft Personal Data Over Voice Call
controls.body: The organization must be prepared to discuss (disclose) the applicable data collection, handling, use, and retention practices with Data Subjects when collecting Microsoft Personal Data via a live or recorded voice call.

controls.name: AU.L2-3.3.8 - Audit Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.3.8)
controls.title: Audit Protection (NIST 800-171: 3.3.8)
controls.body: Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification and deletion.

controls.name: CM-5 (3) Access restrictions for change | signed components
controls.title: CM-5 (3) Access restrictions for change | signed components
controls.body: The information system prevents the installation of [Assignment: organization-defined software and firmware components] without verification that the component has been digitally signed using a certificate that is recognized and approved by the organization.

controls.name: RM.4.150 - Threat Intelligence
controls.title: RM.4.150 - Threat Intelligence
controls.body: Employ threat intelligence to inform the development of the system and security architectures, selection of security solutions, monitoring, threat hunting and response, and recovery activities.

controls.name: Clause 10.1 - Continual Improvement
controls.title: Continual Improvement
controls.body: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the AI management system.

controls.name: CM.L2-3.4.3 - System Change Management (NIST 800-171: 3.4.3)
controls.title: System Change Management (NIST 800-171: 3.4.3)
controls.body: Track, review, approve or disapprove and log changes to organizational systems.

controls.name: A.2.2 - Artificial intelligence (AI) Policy
controls.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) Policy
controls.body: The organization should document a policy for the development or use of AI systems.

controls.name: A.2.4 - Review of the AI Policy
controls.title: Review of the AI Policy
controls.body: The AI policy should be reviewed at planned intervals or additionally as needed to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

controls.name: CM.L2-3.4.4 - Pre-Implementation Change Testing (NIST 800-171: 3.4.4)
controls.title: Pre-Implementation Change Testing (NIST 800-171: 3.4.4)
controls.body: Analyze the security impact of changes prior to implementation.

controls.name: RM.4.151 - Network Scanning and Monitoring
controls.title: RM.4.151 - Network Scanning and Monitoring
controls.body: Perform scans for unauthorized ports available across perimeter network boundaries, over the organization's Internet boundaries and other organization-defined boundaries.

controls.name: AT1 - Information Security Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Information Security Policies and Procedures
controls.body: The organization utilizes OneTrust platform to manage its Information Security policies and procedures. Internal policy and procedure documents relating to security, confidentiality, and availability are maintained and made available to employees. The policies and procedure documents are reviewed and approved by management annually or during significant changes.

controls.name: A.3.3 - Reporting of Concerns
controls.title: Reporting of Concerns
controls.body: The organization should define and put in place a process to report concerns about the organization’s role with respect to an AI system throughout its life cycle.

controls.name: CM.L2-3.4.6 - Least Functionality (NIST 800-171: 3.4.6)
controls.title: Least Functionality (NIST 800-171: 3.4.6)
controls.body: Employ the principle of least functionality by configuring organizational systems to provide only essential capabilities.

controls.name: 4.9.1 - Data portability - 1
controls.title: Data portability - 1
controls.body: When requested, you provide personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine readable format.

controls.name: A.4.4 - Tooling Resources
controls.title: Tooling Resources
controls.body: As part of resource identification, the organization should document information about the tooling resources utilized for the AI system.

controls.name: PCI 9.1.3 - Physical Access to Wireless Points
controls.title: Physical Access to Wireless Points
controls.body: Restrict physical access to wireless access points, gateways, handheld devices, networking/communications hardware, and telecommunication lines.

controls.name: CM.L2-3.4.8 - Application Execution Policy (NIST 800-171: 3.4.8)
controls.title: Application Execution Policy (NIST 800-171: 3.4.8)
controls.body: Apply deny-by-exception (blacklisting) policy to prevent the use of unauthorized software or deny-all permit-by-exception (whitelisting) policy to allow the execution of authorized software.

controls.name: 5.14 - Information Transfer
controls.title: Information Transfer
controls.body: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.

controls.name: A.5.2 - AI System Process for Impact Assessment
controls.title: AI System Process for Impact Assessment
controls.body: The organization should establish a process to assess the potential consequences for individuals or groups of individuals, or both, and societies that can result from the AI system throughout its life cycle.

controls.name: IA.L2-3.5.10 - Cryptographically-Protected Passwords (NIST 800-171: 3.5.10)
controls.title: Cryptographically-Protected Passwords (NIST 800-171: 3.5.10)
controls.body: Store and transmit only cryptographically protected passwords.

controls.name: RM.3.146 - Risk Mitigation Plans
controls.title: RM.3.146 - Risk Mitigation Plans
controls.body: Develop and implement risk mitigation plans.

controls.name: A.5.4 - Assessing AI System impact on Individuals or Group of Individuals
controls.title: Assessing AI System impact on Individuals or Group of Individuals
controls.body: The organization should assess and document the potential impacts of AI systems to individuals or groups of individuals throughout the system’s life cycle.

controls.name: A.5.5 - Assessing Societal Impacts of AI System
controls.title: Assessing Societal Impacts of AI System
controls.body: The organization should assess and document the potential societal impacts of their AI systems throughout their life cycle.

controls.name: PCI A3.2.5.1 - Effectiveness of Data Discovery Techniques
controls.title: PCI A3.2.5.1 - Effectiveness of Data Discovery Techniques
controls.body:
Ensure effectiveness of methods used for data discovery—–e.g., methods must be able to discover clear-text PAN on all types of system components (for example, on each operating system or platform) and file formats in use.
The effectiveness of data-discovery methods must be confirmed at least annually.
PCI DSS Reference: Scope of PCI DSS Requirements

controls.name: A.6.1.3 - Processes for Responsible AI Systems Design and Development
controls.title: Processes for Responsible AI Systems Design and Development
controls.body: The organization should define and document the specific processes for the responsible design and development of the AI system.

controls.name: RM.3.147 - Restricted Access to Non-Vendor-Supported Products
controls.title: RM.3.147 - Restricted Access to Non-Vendor-Supported Products
controls.body: Manage non-vendor-supported products (e.g., end of life) separately and restrict as necessary to reduce risk.

controls.name: SSPA12 - Sensitive Data Collection
controls.title: SSPA12 - Sensitive Data Collection
controls.body: Before collecting sensitive Microsoft Personal Data, the need for collecting that Microsoft Personal Data must be documented in an executed Microsoft organization's contract.

controls.name: A.6.2.4 - AI system verification and validation
controls.title: AI system verification and validation
controls.body: The organization should define and document verification and validation measures for the AI system and specify criteria for their use.

controls.name: RM.5.152 - Incident/Exception Handling and Mitigation Techniques
controls.title: RM.5.152 - Incident/Exception Handling and Mitigation Techniques
controls.body: Utilize an exception process for non-whitelisted software that includes mitigation techniques.

controls.name: A.6.2.6 - AI system operation and monitoring
controls.title: AI system operation and monitoring
controls.body: The organization should define and document the necessary elements for the ongoing operation of the AI system. At the minimum this should include system and performance monitoring, repairs, updates and support.

controls.name: MA-5(2) - Maintenance Personnel | Security Clearances for Classified Systems
controls.title: Maintenance Personnel | Security Clearances for Classified Systems
controls.body: Verify that personnel performing maintenance and diagnostic activities on a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information possess security clearances and formal access approvals for at least the highest classification level and for compartments of information on the system.

controls.name: A.6.2.7 - AI system technical documentation
controls.title: AI system technical documentation
controls.body: The organization should determine what AI system technical documentation is needed for each relevant category of interested parties, such as users, partners, supervisory authorities, and provide the technical documentation to them in the appropriate form.

controls.name: RM.5.155 - Cybersecurity Capability Assessment
controls.title: RM.5.155 - Cybersecurity Capability Assessment
controls.body: Analyze the effectiveness of security solutions at least annually to address the anticipated risk to the system and the organization based on current and accumulated threat intelligence.

controls.name: A.7.2 - Data for development and enhancement of AI system
controls.title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
controls.body: The organization should define, document and implement data management processes related to the development of AI systems.

controls.name: CC2.3.1 - Contact Information for Security Incidents
controls.title: CC2.3.1 - Contact Information for Security Incidents
controls.body: Customers are provided contact information for reporting security incidents on the customer-facing website and in customer contracts.

controls.name: AC-11(1) - Device Lock | Pattern-hiding Displays
controls.title: Device Lock | Pattern-hiding Displays
controls.body: Conceal, via the device lock, information previously visible on the display with a publicly viewable image.

controls.name: SSPA16
controls.title: SSPA16
controls.body: When responding directly to the Data Subject or when providing a self-service online mechanism, the organization has processes and procedures in place to identify the Data Subject making the request.

controls.name: A.7.4 - Quality of data for AI systems
controls.title: Quality of data for AI systems
controls.body: The organization should define and document requirements for data quality and ensure that data used to develop and operate the AI system meet those requirements.

controls.name: MA-6(2) - Timely Maintenance | Predictive Maintenance
controls.title: Timely Maintenance | Predictive Maintenance
controls.body: Perform predictive maintenance on [Assignment: organization-defined system components] at [Assignment: organization-defined time intervals].

controls.name: A.8.3 - External reporting
controls.title: External reporting
controls.body: The organization should provide capabilities for interested parties to report adverse impacts of the system.

controls.name: CA-MC-ML.3.997 - Security Assessment Plan
controls.title: CA-MC-ML.3.997 - Security Assessment Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Security Assessment (CA).

controls.name: A.9.2 - Processes for responsible use of AI systems
controls.title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
controls.body: The organization should define and document the processes for the responsible use of AI systems.

controls.name: CA-MC-ML.2.999 - Security Assessment Policy
controls.title: CA-MC-ML.2.999 - Security Assessment Policy
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes Security Assessment (CA).

controls.name: A.9.3 - Objectives for responsible use of AI system
controls.title: Objectives for responsible use of AI system
controls.body: The organization should identify and document objectives to guide the responsible use of AI systems.

controls.name: MA-6(3) - Timely Maintenance | Automated Support for Predictive Maintenance
controls.title: Timely Maintenance | Automated Support for Predictive Maintenance
controls.body: Transfer predictive maintenance data to a maintenance management system using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: A.10.4 - Customers
controls.title: Customers
controls.body: The organization should ensure that its responsible approach to the development and use of AI systems considers their customer expectations and needs.

controls.name: SSPA17 - Data Subject Rights Requests
controls.title: SSPA17 - Data Subject Rights Requests
controls.body: The organization will make a reasonable effort to locate the data requested and keep sufficient records to demonstrate that a reasonable search was done; if Microsoft makes a request to locate Microsoft Personal Data about a Data Subject that is not available through a self-service online mechanism.

controls.name: SSPA16 - Identification of Microsoft Data Subjects
controls.title: SSPA16 - Identification of Microsoft Data Subjects
controls.body: When responding directly to the Data Subject or when providing a self-service online mechanism, the organization has processes and procedures in place to identify the Data Subject making the request.

controls.name: Clause 4.2 - Interested Parties
controls.title: Interested Parties

controls.name: Clause 4.3 - AIMS Scope
controls.title: AIMS Scope
controls.body:
The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the AI management system to establish its scope.

When determining this scope, the organization shall consider: 
  — the external and internal issues referred to in 4.1;
  — the requirements referred to in 4.2.

The scope shall be available as documented information.

The scope of the AI management system shall determine the organization’s activities with respect to this document’s requirements on the AI management system, leadership, planning, support, operation, performance, evaluation, improvement, controls and objectives.

controls.name: AC1.0 - Visitor Tracking
controls.title: AC1.0 - Visitor Tracking
controls.body: Visitor logs and badges are required for organizations and offices with over 20 members.

controls.name: RM1.14 -
controls.title: RM1.14 -
controls.body: The organization uses quarterly vulnerability scans and annual third-party penetration tests on relevant infrastructure to identify vulnerabilities and variances from organization standards. Results are evaluated by appropriate personnel and remediation actions are performed, where deemed appropriate.

controls.name: CE.019 - Unsupported Software
controls.title: Unsupported Software
controls.body: Remove all unsupported software in use within the organization. Where there is a business need to use them then all devices with the unsupported software must be moved to a segregated subnet wih no internet.

controls.name: PS-3 Personnel Screening
controls.title: PS-3 Personnel Screening
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Screens individuals prior to authorizing access to the information system; and
 b. Rescreens individuals according to [Assignment: organization-defined conditions requiring rescreening and, where rescreening is so indicated, the frequency of such rescreening].

controls.name: CA-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Security Assessment Activities
controls.title: CA-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Security Assessment Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Security Assessment (CA) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: Clause 4.4 - AI Management System (AIMS)
controls.title: AI Management System (AIMS)
controls.body: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain, continually improve and document an AI management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this standard.

controls.name: SO2.4 - Breach Assessment Documentation
controls.title: SO2.4 - Breach Assessment Documentation
controls.body: The organization documents its breach assessment and notification process in the event of a breach.

controls.name: SO1.0 - Network Device Whitelist
controls.title: SO1.0 - Network Device Whitelist
controls.body: Network devices are configured to allow organization approved network traffic.

controls.name: SSPA1 - Applicable Agreement
controls.title: SSPA1 - Applicable Agreement
controls.body: The organization maintains an applicable contract with Microsoft which includes privacy and security data protection language with respect to Microsoft Confidential and Personal Data. Where the organization is operating as Processors or Subprocessors in connection with the Performance, with respect to Microsoft Personal Data, the agreement must include the subject matter and duration of the Processing, the nature and purpose of the Processing, the type of Microsoft Personal Data and categories of Data Subjects and the obligations and rights of Microsoft.

controls.name: Clause 5.1 - Leadership and Committment
controls.title: Leadership and Committment

controls.name: SC-18(3) - Mobile Code | Prevent Downloading and Execution
controls.title: Mobile Code | Prevent Downloading and Execution
controls.body: Prevent the download and execution of [Assignment: organization-defined unacceptable mobile code].

controls.name: A.10.2 - Allocating responsibilities
controls.title: Allocating responsibilities
controls.body: The organization should ensure that responsibilities within their AI system life cycle are allocated between the organization, its partners, suppliers, customers and third parties.

controls.name: OCPA 2.1 - Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.title: Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.body: The organization has established a consumers rights procedure that specifies the process and time frames for handling consumers requests with respect to their personal information. The procedure is communicated to all the employees and reviewed by management on at least annual basis.

controls.name: OCPA 1.1 - Privacy Notice
controls.title: Privacy Notice
controls.body: The organization has a privacy notice published on its website, which outlines privacy obligations and specifies individual rights in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The notice is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.5 - Changes to Identification and Authentication Mechanisms
controls.title: Changes to Identification and Authentication Mechanisms
controls.body: Use of and changes to identification and authentication mechanisms—including but not limited to creation of new accounts and elevation of privileges—and all changes, additions, or deletions to accounts with root or administrative privileges.

controls.name: Clause 5.2 - AI Policy
controls.title: AI Policy

controls.name: C1.1.5 - Confidential Information on Non-Production Environment
controls.title: C1.1.5 - Confidential Information on Non-Production Environment
controls.body: Information designated as confidential is not stored, processed, or maintained in development or test systems, or non- production environments

controls.name: OCPA 2.3 - Right to Request Correction
controls.title: Right to Request Correction
controls.body: The organization shall implement policies, procedures and mechanisms to correct inaccurate personal information it holds about a consumer upon authentication of a consumer request. All authenticated consumer requests for correction of personal information should be acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: OCPA 2.2 - Right to Request Deletion
controls.title: Right to Request Deletion
controls.body: Requests from consumers for deletion of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request.  Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: OCPA 2.4 - Right to Access/Know
controls.title: Right to Access/Know
controls.body: Requests from consumers to access/know about their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request.  Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: OCPA 2.5 - Right to Opt-out of Targeted Advertising, Profiling, or Sale of Personal Data
controls.title: Right to Opt-out of Targeted Advertising, Profiling, or Sale of Personal Data
controls.body: Requests from consumers to opt-out of targeted advertising, sale of their personal data, or profiling are retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: Clause 5.3 - Roles, Responsibilities and Authorities
controls.title: Roles, Responsibilities and Authorities
controls.body:
Top management shall ensure that the responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned and communicated within the organization.

Top management shall assign the responsibility and authority for:
a) ensuring that the AI management system conforms to the requirements of this document;
b) reporting on the performance of the AI management system to top management.

controls.name: Clause 8.4 - AI System Impact Assessment
controls.title: AI System Impact Assessment
controls.body:
The organization shall perform AI system impact assessments according to Clause 6.1.4 at planned intervals or when significant changes are proposed to occur.

The organization shall retain documented information of the results of all AI system impact assessments.

controls.name: CA.4.163 - Cybersecurity Strategy and Roadmap
controls.title: CA.4.163 - Cybersecurity Strategy and Roadmap
controls.body: Create, maintain and leverage a security strategy and roadmap for organizational cybersecurity improvement.

controls.name: C1.1.3 - Retention Period of Confidential Information
controls.title: C1.1.3 - Retention Period of Confidential Information
controls.body: The Entity establishes written policies related to retention periods for the confidential information it maintains.

controls.name: OCPA 2.6 - Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.body: The organization has established processes to prohibit discrimination against consumers who exercised their rights under the OCPA.

controls.name: SSPA22 - Corrections in Personal Data
controls.title: SSPA22 - Corrections in Personal Data
controls.body: The organization must escalate the issue to Microsoft and cooperate with Microsoft as necessary to resolve the issue if a Data Subject believes their Microsoft Personal Data is not complete and accurate.

controls.name: PI3 - Data Integrity Policy
controls.title: Data Integrity Policy
controls.body: Data integrity policy and the procedure has been established that provides guidelines with respect to data integrity and how to define data necessary to support a product or service.

controls.name: Clause 4.1 - Organizational Context
controls.title: Organizational Context
controls.body:
The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended result(s) of its AI management system.

The organization shall determine whether climate change is a relevant issue.

The organization shall consider the intended purpose of the AI systems that are developed, provided or used by the organization. The organization shall determine its roles with respect to these AI systems.

controls.name: Clause 6.1.1 - Actions to address risks and opportunities
controls.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities

controls.name: Clause 6.1.2 - AI Risk Assessment Process
controls.title: AI Risk Assessment Process

controls.name: PCI 3.2.3 - Storage of Personal Identification Number
controls.title: Storage of Personal Identification Number
controls.body: Do not store the personal identification number (PIN) or the encrypted PIN block after authorization.

controls.name: A.4.5 - System and Computing Resources
controls.title: System and Computing Resources
controls.body: As part of resource identification, the organization should document information about the system and computing resources utilized for the AI system.

controls.name: OCPA 2.8 - Right to Data-Portability
controls.title: Right to Data-Portability
controls.body: Procedures and mechanisms are in place to provide consumers with a copy of their personal data in a portable and, to the extent technically feasible, readily usable format that allows the consumer to transmit the data to another controller.

controls.name: SSPA24 - Sub-Processed Data
controls.title: SSPA24 - Sub-Processed Data
controls.body: The organization documents the nature and extent of Microsoft Personal and Confidential Data sub-Processed by subcontractors, ensuring that the information collected is required to Perform.

controls.name: A.8.4 - Communication of incidents
controls.title: Communication of incidents
controls.body: The organization should determine and document a plan for communicating incidents to users of the system.

controls.name: Clause 6.1.3 - AI Risk Treatment Process
controls.title: AI Risk Treatment Process

controls.name: SSPA25 - Use of Personal Data by Subcontractors
controls.title: SSPA25 - Use of Personal Data by Subcontractors
controls.body: Where Microsoft is a controller of Microsoft Personal Data, the organization ensures that the subcontractor uses Microsoft Personal Data in accordance with a Data Subject’s stated contact preferences.

controls.name: SSPA7 - Consent to Data Processing
controls.title: SSPA7 - Consent to Data Processing
controls.body: Where the organization relies on consent as its legal basis for processing data, it must obtain and record a Data Subject's consent for all of its Processing activities (including any new or updated Processing activities) prior to collecting that Data Subject's Personal Data.

controls.name: OCPA 3.3 - De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.title: De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.body: The organization establishes reasonable measures to ensure that de-identified data cannot be associated with a natural individual, and will not be used to re-identify the data.

controls.name: OCPA 4.1 - Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third parties
controls.title: Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third parties
controls.body: The organization maintains written contracts with service providers, contractors, or third parties that process personal data on behalf of the organization. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by the service provider for the protection of consumers' personal data.

controls.name: IR-7(1) - Incident Response Assistance | Automation Support for Availability of Information and Support
controls.title: Incident Response Assistance | Automation Support for Availability of Information and Support
