controls.body: Increase the availability of incident response information and support using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: Clause 6.2 - AI Objectives and Planning
controls.title: AI Objectives and Planning

controls.name: CA.4.227 - Periodic Red Team Activities
controls.title: CA.4.227 - Periodic Red Team Activities
controls.body: Periodically perform red teaming against organizational assets in order to validate defensive capabilities.

controls.name: IC10.0 - Internal Lab Firewalls
controls.title: IC10.0 - Internal Lab Firewalls
controls.body: Firewalls are installed and enabled on all internal lab systems.

controls.name: Clause 7.1 - Resources
controls.title: Resources
controls.body: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the AI management system.

controls.name: IC10.1 - Internal Lab IDS
controls.title: IC10.1 - Internal Lab IDS
controls.body: Intrusion detection systems (IDS) are installed and monitor internal lab systems.

controls.name: IC10.3 - Internal Lab AV/AS
controls.title: IC10.3 - Internal Lab AV/AS
controls.body: Antivirus and Antispam (AV/AS) solutions are installed on all internal lab systems.

controls.name: BC1.6 - BCP Physical Resource Recovery Plans and Checklists
controls.title: BC1.6 - BCP Physical Resource Recovery Plans and Checklists
controls.body: A recovery plan and checklist for physical resources (office, furniture, etc.) at each location.

controls.name: TDPSA 1.1 - Privacy Notice
controls.title: Privacy Notice
controls.body: The organization has a privacy notice published on its website, which outlines privacy obligations and specifies individual rights in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The notice is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.Int.2 - Incident Notification to Impacted Organizations
controls.title: Incident Notification to Impacted Organizations
controls.body: A communication plan is used to notify other organizations, including third parties, of incidents that may affect them or their customers.

controls.name: TDPSA 1.3 - Notice of Sale of Biometric Personal Data
controls.title: Notice of Sale of Biometric Personal Data
controls.body: Explicit notice is provided to consumers prior to the sale of their biometric personal data. The notice is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: Clause 7.2 - Competence
controls.title: Competence

controls.name: SSPA41 - Security-by-Design Principles
controls.title: SSPA41 - Security-by-Design Principles
controls.body: Software development incorporates security-by-design principles in the build process. (Applies to organizations developing software for Microsoft)

controls.name: TDPSA 1.4 - Notice of Targeted Advertising or  Sale of Personal Data to Third-Parties
controls.title: Notice of Targeted Advertising or  Sale of Personal Data to Third-Parties
controls.body: Explicit notice is provided to consumers prior to processing personal data for targeted advertising or the sale of personal data to third-parties. Consumers are provided with a mechanism to exercise the right to opt-out of the targeted advertising or sale of their personal information, and any such requests are handled in a timely manner.

controls.name: TDPSA 2.1 - Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.title: Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.body: The organization has established a consumers rights procedure that specifies the process and time frames for handling consumers requests with respect to their personal information. The procedure is communicated to all the employees and reviewed by management on at least annual basis.

controls.name: TDPSA 2.2 - Right to Request Deletion
controls.title: Right to Request Deletion
controls.body: Requests from consumers for deletion of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: SSPA32 - Breach Notification
controls.title: SSPA32 - Breach Notification
controls.body: The organization does not issue any press release or any other public notice that relates to a Data Breach.

controls.name: IC4.7 - Hardcopy Document Disposal
controls.title: IC4.7 - Hardcopy Document Disposal
controls.body: Printed materials containing sensitive customer information are disposed of securely.

controls.name: Clause 7.3 - Awareness
controls.title: Awareness

controls.name: TDPSA 2.5 - Right to Opt-out of Targeted Advertising, Profiling, or Sale of Personal Information
controls.title: Right to Opt-out of Targeted Advertising, Profiling, or Sale of Personal Information
controls.body: Requests from consumers to opt-out of targeted advertising, profiling, or sale of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: SSPA10 - Validation of Third-Party Data Protection
controls.title: SSPA10 - Validation of Third-Party Data Protection
controls.body: The organization validates that the third-party data protection policies and practices are consistent with the organization's contract with Microsoft and the DPR if the organization collects Personal Data from third parties on behalf of Microsoft.

controls.name: SSPA30 - Data Integrity
controls.title: SSPA30 - Data Integrity
controls.body: The organization maintains the integrity of all Microsoft Personal Data, ensuring it remains accurate, complete and relevant for the stated purposes for which it was Processed.

controls.name: Clause 7.4 - Communication
controls.title: Communication

controls.name: SA-MC-ML.3.997 - Situational Awareness Plan
controls.title: SA-MC-ML.3.997 - Situational Awareness Plan
controls.body: Establish, maintain and resource a plan that includes Situational Awareness (SA).

controls.name: T.2.2.3 - Key Length
controls.title: Key Length

controls.name: SSPA11 - Executable Software Use in Collection of Personal Data
controls.title: SSPA11 - Executable Software Use in Collection of Personal Data
controls.body: Before collecting Microsoft Personal Data through the installation or utilization of executable software on a Data Subject’s device, the need for collecting this information must be documented in an executed supplier contract with Microsoft.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.1 - Documented Information - General
controls.title: Documented Information - General
controls.body:
The organization’s AI management system shall include:
a) Documented information required by this document;
b) Documented information determined by the organization as being necessary for the effectiveness
of the AI management system.

controls.name: TDPSA 2.8 - Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.body: The organization has established processes to prohibit discrimination against consumers who exercised their rights under the TDPSA.

controls.name: SSPA15 - Response to Data Subject Rights Requests
controls.title: SSPA15 - Response to Data Subject Rights Requests
controls.body: The organization assists Microsoft, through appropriate technical and organizational measures, where possible, to fulfill its obligations to respond to requests for Data Subjects seeking to exercise their Data Subject Rights without undue delay.

controls.name: TDPSA 2.9 - Consent on Processing of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.title: Consent on Processing of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.body: Affirmative consent is obtained and maintained from consumers prior to any processing of their sensitive personal data. Consumers are provided with a mechanism to withdraw the consent, and any such requests are documented and retained in accordance with organization policies.

controls.name: 4.7.3 - Erasure - 3
controls.title: Erasure - 3
controls.body: If asked to, your organisation tells the data subject which third parties have received the personal data.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.3 - Control of Documented Information
controls.title: Control of Documented Information

controls.name: SA-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Situational Awareness Approach
controls.title: SA-MC-ML.5.995 - Standardized Situational Awareness Approach
controls.body: Standardize and optimize a documented approach for Situational Awareness (SA) across all applicable organizational units.

controls.name: DPR09 - Profile 9
controls.title: DPR09 - Profile 9
controls.body:
For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to provide evidence of a payment card industry assurance. The Assurance requirements and independence of assurance of compliance are dependent on which of the profiles 1-8 applies to your organization.

N: B - The Assurance requirements and independence of assurance of compliance are dependent on which of the profiles 1-8 applies to your organization.

controls.name: SC-MC-ML.2.999 - System and Communication Protection Policy
controls.title: SC-MC-ML.2.999 - System and Communication Protection Policy
controls.body: Establish a policy that includes System and Communication Protection (SC).

controls.name: Clause 8.2 - AI Risk Assessment
controls.title: AI Risk Assessment
controls.body:
The organization shall perform AI risk assessments in accordance with Clause 6.1.2 at planned intervals or when significant changes are proposed or occur.

The organization shall retain documented information of the results of all AI risk assessments.

controls.name: SI-8 - Spam Protection
controls.title: Spam Protection
controls.body:
a. Employ spam protection mechanisms at system entry and exit points to detect and act on unsolicited messages; and
b. Update spam protection mechanisms when new releases are available in accordance with organizational configuration management policy and procedures.

controls.name: DPR010 - Profile 10
controls.title: DPR010 - Profile 10
controls.body:
For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to provide ISO 27001 certification with functional coverage of the service(s) in addition to the Assurance requirements and independence of assurance of compliance are dependent on which of the profiles 1-9 applies to your organization.

N: B - The Assurance requirements and independence of assurance of compliance are dependent on which of the profiles 1-9 applies to your organization.

controls.name: TDPSA 3.3 - De-Identification or Pseudonymization of Personal Information
controls.title: De-Identification or Pseudonymization of Personal Information
controls.body: The organization establishes reasonable measures to ensure that de-identified data cannot be associated with a natural individual, and will not be used to re-identify the data.

controls.name: Clause 8.3 - AI Risk Treatment
controls.title: AI Risk Treatment
controls.body:
The organization shall implement the AI risk treatment plan according to Clause 6.1.3 and verify its effectiveness.

When risk assessments identify new risks that require treatment, a risk treatment process in accordance with Clause 6.1.3 shall be performed for these risks.

When risk treatment options as defined by the risk treatment plan are not effective, these treatment options shall be reviewed and revalidated following the risk treatment process according to Clause 6.1.3 and the risk treatment plan shall be updated.

The organization shall retain documented information of the results of all AI risk treatments.

controls.name: SA.4.171 - Cyber Threat Hunting Capability
controls.title: SA.4.171 - Cyber Threat Hunting Capability
controls.body: Establish and maintain a cyber threat hunting capability to search for Indicators of Compromise (IoC) in organizational systems and detect, track and disrupt threats that evade existing controls.

controls.name: AU-6(8) - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Full Text Analysis of Privileged Commands
controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Full Text Analysis of Privileged Commands
controls.body: Perform a full text analysis of logged privileged commands in a physically distinct component or subsystem of the system, or other system that is dedicated to that analysis.

controls.name: DPR04 - Profile 4
controls.title: DPR04 - Profile 4
controls.body: For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to respond to all applicable Data Protection Requirements (DPR) and provide evidence of compliance. The Assurance requirement for this profile is a self-attestation of compliance to the DPR and Independent Assurance of compliance, which could be either a completed Independent Assessment against the DPR or submit an ISO 27701 and ISO 27001 certification.

controls.name: TDPSA 4.1 - Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third parties
controls.title: Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third parties
controls.body: The organization maintains written contracts with service providers, contractors, or third parties with who it shares, sells, or discloses consumers' personal information. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by the service provider for the protection of consumer's personal information.

controls.name: DPR07 - Profile 7
controls.title: DPR07 - Profile 7
controls.body: For this data processing profile, the organization is expected to respond to all applicable Data Protection Requirements (DPR) and provide evidence of compliance. The Assurance requirement for this profile is a self-attestation of compliance to the DPR and Independent Assurance of compliance, which could be either a completed Independent Assessment against the DPR or submit an ISO 27701 and ISO 27001 certification.

controls.name: CC6.1.4 - Information Asset Owner
controls.title: CC6.1.4 - Information Asset Owner
controls.body: Information system assets are assigned owners who are responsible for evaluating access based on job roles. The owners define access rights when assets are acquired or changed and periodically evaluate access for assets under their custody or stewardship.

controls.name: MA-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Maintenance Activities
controls.title: MA-MC-ML.4.996 - Review of Maintenance Activities
controls.body: Review and measure Maintenance (MA) activities for effectiveness.

controls.name: SSPA3 - Privacy and Security Training
controls.title: SSPA3 - Privacy and Security Training
controls.body: The organization develops, maintains, and performs annual privacy and security training for employees who will have access to Personal Data Processed by the organization in Connection with Performance or Microsoft Confidential Data.

controls.name: SSPA31 - Incident Response Plan
controls.title: SSPA31 - Incident Response Plan
controls.body:
The organization has an incident response plan that requires Microsoft to be notified without undue delay upon becoming aware of a Data Breach.
At Microsoft’s request or direction, cooperate with Microsoft in any investigation, mitigation, or remediation of the Incident, including providing Microsoft with data, information, access to personnel, or hardware needed to conduct a forensic review.

controls.name: SSPA37 - Asset Management
controls.title: SSPA37 - Asset Management
controls.body: All assets used to support Performance must be accounted for and have an identified owner. The organization is accountable for maintaining an inventory of these information assets, establishing acceptable and authorized use of the assets, and providing the appropriate level of protection for the assets throughout their life cycle.

controls.name: Clause 9.1 - Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation
controls.title: Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation

controls.name: SI-7(15) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Code Authentication
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Code Authentication
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to authenticate the following software or firmware components prior to installation: [Assignment: organization-defined software or firmware components].

controls.name: TDPSA 5.1 - Security Procedures and Practices
controls.title: Security Procedures and Practices
controls.body: Reasonable administrative, technical and physical data security procedures and practices have been implemented by the organization for the security and protection of consumers' personal data. These measures are assessed by management on an annual basis, and deficiencies identified are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: Clause 9.2.1 - Internal Audit - General
controls.title: Internal Audit - General

controls.name: OCPA 2.7 - Consent on Processing of Sensitive Personal Data
controls.title: Consent on Processing of Sensitive Personal Data
controls.body: Affirmative consent is obtained and maintained from consumers prior to any processing of their sensitive personal data. Consumers are provided with a mechanism to withdraw the consent, and any such requests are documented and retained in accordance with organization policies.

controls.name: AU-3 Content of audit records
controls.title: AU-3 Content of audit records
controls.body: The information system generates audit records containing information that establishes what type of event occurred, when the event occurred, where the event occurred, the source of the event, the outcome of the event, and the identity of any individuals or subjects associated with the event.

controls.name: Clause 9.3.2 - Management Review Inputs
controls.title: Management Review Inputs

controls.name: OCPA 2.9 - Right to Opt-in (Minors)
controls.title: Right to Opt-in (Minors)
controls.body: The targeted advertising, sale of personal data, or profiling of minor consumers’ personal data is only performed based on affirmative authorization (“opt-in”) and by providing a mechanism to revoke the consent. Such authorizations are documented and retained in accordance with organization policies.

controls.name: PCI 1.1 - Firewall and Router Configuration
controls.title: Firewall and Router Configuration
controls.body: Establish and implement firewall and router configuration standards.

controls.name: Clause 9.3.3 - Management Review Results
controls.title: Management Review Results
controls.body:
The results of the management review shall include decisions related to continual improvement opportunities and any need for changes to the AI management system.

Documented information shall be available as evidence of the results of management reviews.

controls.name: OCPA 2.10 - Automated Decision-Making
controls.title: Automated Decision-Making
controls.body: The organization identifies and addresses obligations to consumers where a decision is based solely on the automated processing of their personal information.

controls.name: SI-4(23) - System Monitoring | Host-based Devices
controls.title: System Monitoring | Host-based Devices
controls.body: Implement the following host-based monitoring mechanisms at [Assignment: organization-defined system components]: [Assignment: organization-defined host-based monitoring mechanisms].

controls.name: Clause 10.2 - Nonconformity and Corrective Action
controls.title: Nonconformity and Corrective Action

controls.name: OCPA 3.2 - Data Protection Assessment
controls.title: Data Protection Assessment
controls.body: Organizations assess the need for and implements, where appropriate, Data Protection Assessment whenever new processing of personal information or changes to existing processing is planned.

controls.name: 5.1 - Privacy notice content
controls.title: Privacy notice content
controls.body: Your organisation's privacy information or notice includes all the information required under Articles 13 and 14 of the GDPR.

controls.name: A.2.3 - Alignment with other organizational policies
controls.title: Alignment with other organizational policies
controls.body: The organization should determine where other policies can be affected by or apply to, the organization’s objectives with respect to AI systems.

controls.name: AC7.2 - VPN Termination
controls.title: AC7.2 - VPN Termination
controls.body: VPN users are automatically disconnected from the network after a predetermined amount of inactivity. The users can immediately log on again to reconnect to the network.

controls.name: M42.33 - Log plan or documentation of the logs utilized
controls.title: Log plan or documentation of the logs utilized
controls.body: Log plan or documentation of the type(s) of logs utilized, including their storage locations, retention periods, and access control measures

controls.name: IC3.0 - Network Data Loss Prevention
controls.title: IC3.0 - Network Data Loss Prevention
controls.body: File Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solution protects confidential/sensitive information in the corporate environment.

controls.name: A.3.2 - AI Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: AI Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for AI should be defined and allocated according to the needs of the organization.

controls.name: A.6.2.2 - Teleworking
controls.title: Teleworking
controls.body: A policy and supporting security measures shall be implemented to protect information accessed, processed or stored at teleworking sites.

controls.name: TDPSA 1.2 - Notice of Sale of Sensitive Personal Data
controls.title: Notice of Sale of Sensitive Personal Data
controls.body: Explicit notice is provided to consumers prior to the sale of their sensitive personal data. The notice is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: A.4.2 - Resource Documentation
controls.title: Resource Documentation
controls.body: The organization should identify and document relevant resources required for the activities at given AI system life cycle stages and other AI-related activities relevant for the organization.

controls.name: SSPA46 - Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plans
controls.title: SSPA46 - Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plans
controls.body: The organization has established and tests business continuity and disaster recovery plans.

controls.name: TDPSA 2.3 - Right to Request Correction
controls.title: Right to Request Correction
controls.body: The organization shall implement policies, procedures and mechanisms to correct inaccurate personal information it holds about a consumer upon authentication of a consumer request. All authenticated consumer requests for correction of personal information should be acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: A.4.3 - Data Resources
controls.title: Data Resources
controls.body: As part of resource identification, the organization should document information about the data resources utilized for the AI system.

controls.name: TDPSA 2.4 - Right to Access/Know
controls.title: Right to Access/Know
controls.body: Requests from consumers to access/know about their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: AC7.0 - External VPN Services
controls.title: AC7.0 - External VPN Services
controls.body: Workstation and mobile device remote connections to the corporate network connect through Virtual Private Network (VPN) gateways.

controls.name: IC6.0 -  Removable Media
controls.title: IC6.0 -  Removable Media
controls.body: Removable media to be used for customer or system data is encrypted and sanitized prior to connecting such devices to the information systems.

controls.name: ARM2.6 - Third-Party Assessment Documentation
controls.title: ARM2.6 - Third-Party Assessment Documentation
controls.body: Formal documentation of third-party vendor assessments are preserved for compliance purposes.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.12.a - Patch-Management
controls.title: Patch-Management
controls.body: Der Anbieter des Produktes MUSS vertraglich zusichern, dass er nach Bekanntwerden einer kritischen Schwachstelle in einer angemessenen Frist, spätestens nach 4 Wochen, ein Software-Update zur Verfügung stellt; im Falle der aktiven Ausnutzung (Proof of Concept) binnen 7 Tagen. Die Auslieferung der Updates MUSS integritätsgesichert erfolgen. Weiterhin gelten die Anforderung der jeweils gültigen TR-02102-1.

controls.name: SSK.2.1.12.b - Patch-Management
controls.title: Patch-Management
controls.body: Der Betreiber MUSS derartige Updates unverzüglich einspielen.

controls.name: SSK.2.2.01.b - Physische Zugriffsbegrenzung
controls.title: Physische Zugriffsbegrenzung
controls.body: Alternativ wäre auch die Deaktivierung in der jeweiligen Firmware möglich, dies MUSS jedoch im Einzelfall auf Wirksamkeit überprüft werden.

controls.name: TDPSA 2.7 - Automated Decision Making
controls.title: Automated Decision Making
controls.body: The organization identifies and addresses obligations to consumers where a decision is based solely on automated processing of their personal information.

controls.name: MA-4(3) - Nonlocal Maintenance | Comparable Security and Sanitization
controls.title: Nonlocal Maintenance | Comparable Security and Sanitization
controls.body:
a. Require that nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic services be performed from a system that implements a security capability comparable to the capability implemented on the system being serviced; or
b. Remove the component to be serviced from the system prior to nonlocal maintenance or diagnostic services; sanitize the component (for organizational information); and after the service is performed, inspect and sanitize the component (for potentially malicious software) before reconnecting the component to the system.

controls.name: AAC11.8 - Function Code Scanning
controls.title: AAC11.8 - Function Code Scanning
controls.body: Code scanning is performed to identify and patch vulnerabilities in the serverless functions. Identified vulnerabilities are remediated in accordance with the patch management process.

controls.name: SSK.2.2.02.a - Fernadministration
controls.title: Fernadministration
controls.body: Die Fernadministration der Schnittstellenkontrolle DARF NUR auf einem kryptographisch abgesicherten Kanal erfolgen (vertraulich, integer, authentisch).

controls.name: A.4.6 - Human Resources
controls.title: Human Resources
controls.body: As part of resource identification, the organization should document information about the human resources and their competences utilized for the development, deployment, operation, change management, maintenance, transfer and decommissioning, as well as verification and integration of the AI system.

controls.name: AOM2.11 - Board of Directors Charter
controls.title: AOM2.11 - Board of Directors Charter
controls.body: The board of directors Charter and Corporate Governance Guidelines outlines the independence rules and number of members necessary to objectively evaluate and assist with decision making process.

controls.name: SC-16(2) - Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes | Anti-spoofing Mechanisms
controls.title: Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes | Anti-spoofing Mechanisms
controls.body: Implement anti-spoofing mechanisms to prevent adversaries from falsifying the security attributes indicating the successful application of the security process.

controls.name: CC6.7.3 - Production Access Keys
controls.title: CC6.7.3 - Production Access Keys
controls.body: Production access keys are stored in encrypted key vaults and access is restricted to authorized individuals.

controls.name: A.5.3 - Documentation of AI System Impact Assessments
controls.title: Documentation of AI System Impact Assessments
controls.body: The organization should document the results of AI system impact assessments and retain results for adefined period.

controls.name: D2.TI.Ti.Inn.1 - Threat Analysis System
controls.title: Threat Analysis System
controls.body: A threat analysis system automatically correlates threat data to specific risks and then takes risk-based automated actions while alerting management.

controls.name: SC-23(3) - Session Authenticity | Unique System-generated Session Identifiers
controls.title: Session Authenticity | Unique System-generated Session Identifiers
controls.body: Generate a unique session identifier for each session with [Assignment: organization-defined randomness requirements] and recognize only session identifiers that are system-generated.

controls.name: A.6.1.2 - Objectives for Responsible Development of AI Systems
controls.title: Objectives for Responsible Development of AI Systems
controls.body: The organization should identify and document objectives to guide the responsible development of AI systems, and take those objectives into account and integrate measures to achieve them in the development life cycle.

controls.name: TDPSA  3.2 - Data Protection Assessment
controls.title: Data Protection Assessment
controls.body: Organizations assess the need for and implements, where appropriate, Data Protection Assessment whenever new processing of personal information or changes to existing processing is planned.

controls.name: SSPA53 - Anonymized Data
controls.title: SSPA53 - Anonymized Data
controls.body: All Microsoft Personal Data used in a development or test environment is anonymized.

controls.name: OCPA 3.1 - Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.title: Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.body: The organization has established processes to limit the collection, use, and retention of consumers' personal data to the minimum that is relevant, proportional and reasonably necessary for the identified purposes.

controls.name: OCPA 5.1 - Security Procedures and Practices
controls.title: Security Procedures and Practices
controls.body: Reasonable security procedures and practices have been implemented by the organization for the security and protection of consumers' personal data. These measures are assessed by management on an annual basis, and deficiencies identified are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: A.6.2.2 - AI system requirements and specification
controls.title: AI system requirements and specification
controls.body: The organization should specify and document requirements for new AI systems or material enhancements to existing systems.

controls.name: SSK.2.2.02.b - Fernadministration
controls.title: Fernadministration
controls.body: Die Vorgaben der Technischen Richtlinie TR-02102-1 in der jeweils aktuellen Version MÜSSEN beachtet werden.

controls.name: A.6.2.3 - Documentation of AI system design and development
controls.title: Documentation of AI system design and development
controls.body: The organization should document the AI system design and development based on organizational objectives, documented requirements and specification criteria.

controls.name: A.6.2.5 - AI system deployment
controls.title: AI system deployment
controls.body: The organization should document a deployment plan and ensure that appropriate requirements are met prior to deployment.

controls.name: C.10.1.2 - Deanonymization Check
controls.title: Deanonymization Check
controls.body: A) IF Statistical Disclosure Control methodology is applied, THEN anonymized datasets shall be consistent and comply with the defined thresholds.

controls.name: AAC3.12 - Access Control Policy
controls.title: AAC3.12 - Access Control Policy
controls.body: The Entity has a documented Access Control Policy that defines user access maintenance and system security controls and procedures based on the concepts of role-based access and the principle of least privilege.

controls.name: A.6.2.8 - AI system recording of event logs
controls.title: AI system recording of event logs
controls.body: The organization should determine at which phases of the AI system life cycle, record keeping of event logs should be enabled, but at the minimum when the AI system is in use.

controls.name: SSK.2.2.03.a - Administration
controls.title: Administration
controls.body: Die Schnittstellenkontrolle DARF NUR von geschulten Administratoren oder Benutzern verwaltet werden.

controls.name: SSK.2.2.05.a - Protokolle
controls.title: Protokolle
controls.body: Bei der Auswertung der Protokolle MÜSSEN Informationssicherheit und der Datenschutz berücksichtigt werden.

controls.name: A.7.3 - Acquisition of data
controls.title: Acquisition of data
controls.body: The organization should determine and document details about the acquisition and selection of the data used in AI systems.

controls.name: SSK.2.2.06.a - Meldesystem
controls.title: Meldesystem
controls.body: Audit-/Log-Daten der Schnittstellenkontrolle MÜSSEN die Meldung sicherheitskritischer Ereignisse und Handlungsaufforderungen nach Dringlichkeitsstufen ermöglichen.

controls.name: A.7.5 - Data provenance
controls.title: Data provenance
controls.body: The organization should define and document a process for recording the provenance of data used in its AI systems over the life cycles of the data and the AI system.

controls.name: SSK.2.2.06.b - Meldesystem
controls.title: Meldesystem
controls.body: Dies KANN über softwareeigene Funktionen oder Zugriff auf Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) oder Log-Daten realisiert werden.

controls.name: A.7.6 - Data preparation
controls.title: Data preparation
controls.body: The organization shall define and document its criteria for selecting data preparations and the data preparation methods to be used.

controls.name: SSK.2.2.07.a - Auditdaten
controls.title: Auditdaten
controls.body: Beim Ausrollen MUSS die Schnittstellenkontrolle dem jeweiligen Datenschutzkonzept entsprechend so konfiguriert sein, dass die unter SSK.2.1.10 generierten Protokollierungsdaten erzeugt werden.

controls.name: 4.3 - Purpose Orientation
controls.title: Purpose Orientation
controls.body: The purpose of processing should guide the design of the processing and set processing boundaries.

controls.name: A.8.2 - System documentation and information for users
controls.title: System documentation and information for users
controls.body: The organization should determine and provide the necessary information to users of the system.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.4 - Insecure Communications
controls.title: Insecure Communications
controls.body: Insecure communications

controls.name: 4.4 - Necessity
controls.title: Necessity
controls.body: The purpose determines what personal data is necessary for the processing.

controls.name: A.8.5 - Information for interested parties
controls.title: Information for interested parties
controls.body: The organization should determine and document its obligations to reporting information about the AI system to interested parties.

controls.name: 3.1 - Autonomy
controls.title: Autonomy
controls.body: Data subjects shall be granted the highest degree of autonomy possible with respect to control over their personal data.

controls.name: 3.10 - Truthful
controls.title: Truthful
controls.body: The controller must act as they declare to do, provide account for what they do and not mislead the data subjects.

controls.name: 3.11 - Human Intervention
controls.title: Human Intervention
controls.body: The controller must incorporate qualified human intervention that is capable of recovering biases that machines may create in relation to the right to not be subject to automated individual decision making in Article 22.

controls.name: 3.12 - Fair Algorithms
controls.title: Fair Algorithms
controls.body: Information shall be provided to data subjects about processing of personal data based on algorithms that analyse or make predictions about them, such as work performance, economic situation, health, personal preferences, reliability or behaviour, location or movements.

controls.name: A.9.4 - Intended use of the AI system
controls.title: Intended use of the AI system
controls.body: The organization should ensure that the AI system is used according to the intended uses of the AI system and its accompanying documentation.

controls.name: OM5.2 - Lockable Storage
controls.title: OM5.2 - Lockable Storage
controls.body: Employees are provided with lockable pedestal/drawers and lockable filing cabinets.

controls.name: 3.2 - Interaction
controls.title: Interaction
controls.body: Data subjects must be able to communicate and exercise their rights with the controller.

controls.name: 3.3 - Expectation
controls.title: Expectation
controls.body: Processing should correspond with data subjects’ expectations.

controls.name: 3.4 - Non-Discrimination
controls.title: Non-Discrimination
controls.body: The controller shall not discriminate against data subjects.

controls.name: 3.5 - Non-Exploitation
controls.title: Non-Exploitation
controls.body: The controller shall not exploit the needs or vulnerabilities of data subjects.

controls.name: ABC1.10 - Recovery Plans and Checklists
controls.title: ABC1.10 - Recovery Plans and Checklists
controls.body: Recovery plans and checklists exist for each functional area.

controls.name: AAU1.5 - Change Assessment
controls.title: AAU1.5 - Change Assessment
controls.body: Changes in the External Environment, business processes, Organization Management, third-party relationship, information processing facilities and systems that affects the Information Security posture are identified and assessed.

controls.name: 3.6 - Consumer Choice
controls.title: Consumer Choice
controls.body: The controller should not “lock in” their users. Whenever a service or a good is personalised or proprietary, it may create a lock-in to the service or good. If it is difficult for the data subject to change controllers due to this, which may not be fair.

controls.name: RA-5 (6) Vulnerability scanning | automated trend analyses
controls.title: RA-5 (6) Vulnerability scanning | automated trend analyses
controls.body: The organization employs automated mechanisms to compare the results of vulnerability scans over time to determine trends in information system vulnerabilities.

controls.name: A.10.3 - Suppliers
controls.title: Suppliers
controls.body: The organization should establish a process to ensure that its usage of services, products or materials provided by suppliers aligns with the organization’s approach to the responsible development and use of AI systems.

controls.name: 3.7 - Power Balance
controls.title: Power Balance
controls.body: Asymmetric power balances shall be avoided or mitigated when possible. Controllers should not transfer the risks of the enterprise to the data subjects.

controls.name: 3.8 - Respect of Rights and Freedoms
controls.title: Respect of Rights and Freedoms
controls.body: The controller must respect the fundamental rights and freedoms of data subjects and implement appropriate measures and safeguards to not violate these rights and freedoms.

controls.name: 3.9 - Ethical
controls.title: Ethical
controls.body: The controller should see the processing’s wider impact on individuals’ rights and dignity.

controls.name: 4.1 - Predetermination
controls.title: Predetermination
controls.body: The legitimate purposes must be determined before the design of the processing.

controls.name: 4.2 - Specificity
controls.title: Specificity
controls.body: The purposes must be specific to the processing and make it explicitly clear why personal data is being processed.

controls.name: SSK.2.2.07.b - Auditdaten
controls.title: Auditdaten
controls.body: Es MÜSSEN Prozesse definiert und abgestimmt sein, in welchen Fällen die erweiterte Protokollierung dokumentiert aktiviert wird.

controls.name: 1.1 - Beleidsregels voor informatiebeveiliging
controls.title: Beleidsregels voor informatiebeveiliging
controls.body:
Ten behoeve van informatiebeveiliging behoort een reeks be­
leidsregels te warden gedefinieerd en goedgekeurd door het bestuur.

controls.name: 1.10 - Beleid inzake het gebruik van cryptografische beheersmaatregelen
controls.title: Beleid inzake het gebruik van cryptografische beheersmaatregelen
controls.body:
Ter bescherming van informatie zijn er tools of applicaties aanwezig waarmee het beleid voor het gebruik van crypto grafische beheersmaat­
regelen wordt ge'implementeerd.

controls.name: SR-11(3) - Component Authenticity | Anti-counterfeit Scanning
controls.title: Component Authenticity | Anti-counterfeit Scanning
controls.body: Scan for counterfeit system components [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: 1.11 - Verwijdering van bedrijfsmiddelen
controls.title: Verwijdering van bedrijfsmiddelen
controls.body:
Apparatuur, informatie en software behoren niet van de locatie te
warden meegenomen zonder voorafgaande goedkeuring.

controls.name: 1.12 - Beleid en procedures voor informatietransport
controls.title: Beleid en procedures voor informatietransport
controls.body:
Ter bescherming van het informatietransport, dat via alle
soorten communicatiefaciliteiten verloopt, behoren formele beleidsregels, procedures en beheersmaat­ regelen voor transport van kracht te zijn.

controls.name: AC-2 (1) Account management | automated system account management
controls.title: AC-2 (1) Account management | automated system account management
controls.body: The organization employs automated mechanisms to support the management of information system accounts.

controls.name: SI-4 - System Monitoring
controls.title: System Monitoring

controls.name: SA.3.169 - Cyber Threats Intelligence Forums
controls.title: SA.3.169 - Cyber Threats Intelligence Forums
controls.body: Receive and respond to cyber threat intelligence from information sharing forums and sources and communicate to stakeholders.

controls.name: PE7 - Review of Physical Access to Data Center
controls.title: Review of Physical Access to Data Center
controls.body: Physical access to data centers and other secure areas is reviewed quarterly by management.

controls.name: CIS 2.3-RE - Unauthorized Software
controls.title: Unauthorized Software
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard 2.3: Address unauthorized software.

controls.name: 5.1.2 - Privacy notice content - 2
controls.title: Privacy notice content - 2
controls.body: Privacy information includes the purposes of the processing and the lawful bases (and, if applicable, the legitimate interests for the processing).

controls.name: 1.13 - Overeenkomsten over informatietransport
controls.title: Overeenkomsten over informatietransport
controls.body:
Overeenkomsten behoren betrekking te hebben  op  het
beveiligd transporteren van bedrijfsinformatie tussen de organisatie en externe partijen.

controls.name: 1.14 - Analyse en specificatie van informatiebeveiligingseisen
controls.title: Analyse en specificatie van informatiebeveiligingseisen
controls.body:
De eisen die verband houden met informatiebe­ veiliging behoren te warden opgenomen in de eisen voor nieuwe informatiesystemen of voor uitbreidin­
gen van bestaande informatiesystemen.

controls.name: 1.15 - Opnemen van beveiligingsaspecten in leveranciersovereenkomsten
controls.title: Opnemen van beveiligingsaspecten in leveranciersovereenkomsten
controls.body:
Alie relevante informatiebeveili­ gingseisen behoren te warden vastgesteld en overeengekomen met elke leverancier die toegang heeft tot IT-infrastructuurelementen ten behoeve van de informatie van de organisatie, of deze verwerkt,
opslaat, communiceert of biedt.

controls.name: PCI 9.9 - Device Protection
controls.title: Device Protection
controls.body:
Protect devices that capture payment card data via direct physical interaction with the card from tampering and substitution.

Note: These requirements apply to card- reading devices used in card-present transactions (that is, card swipe or dip) at the point of sale. This requirement is not intended to apply to manual key-entry components such as computer keyboards and POS keypads.

controls.name: AC-2 (2) Account management | removal of temporary / emergency accounts
controls.title: AC-2 (2) Account management | removal of temporary / emergency accounts
controls.body: The information system automatically [Selection: removes; disables] temporary and emergency accounts after [Assignment: organization-defined time period for each type of account].

controls.name: M11.13 - Regelmäßiges Ersetzen von Datenträgern (Refreshment)
controls.title: Regelmäßiges Ersetzen von Datenträgern (Refreshment)
controls.body: Regelmäßiges Ersetzen von Datenträgern (Refreshment)

controls.name: PCI A3.2.1 - Quarterly Documentation of Changes to the In-scope Environment
controls.title: Quarterly Documentation of Changes to the In-scope Environment
controls.body:
Document and confirm the accuracy of PCI DSS scope at least quarterly and upon significant changes to the in-scope environment. At a minimum, the quarterly scoping validation should include:
- Identifying all in-scope networks and system components
- Identifying all out-of-scope networks and justification for networks being out of scope, including descriptions of all segmentation controls implemented
- Identifying all connected entities—e.g., third-party entities with access to the cardholder data environment (CDE)
PCI DSS Reference: Scope of PCI DSS Requirements

controls.name: M42.11 - Netzpläne
controls.title: Netzpläne
controls.body: Netzpläne

controls.name: AC3.6 - Role-based Access
controls.title: AC3.6 - Role-based Access
controls.body: A role-based access system has been defined and implemented to manage authentication and segregated access to production systems.

controls.name: AC-6 (9) Least privilege | auditing use of privileged functions
controls.title: AC-6 (9) Least privilege | auditing use of privileged functions
controls.body: The information system audits the execution of privileged functions.

controls.name: PT-4(2) - Consent | Just-in-time Consent
controls.title: Consent | Just-in-time Consent
controls.body: Present [Assignment: organization-defined consent mechanisms] to individuals at [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and in conjunction with [Assignment: organization-defined personally identifiable information processing].

controls.name: AAC11.8 - Function Code Scanning
controls.title: AAC11.8 - Function Code Scanning
controls.body: Code scanning tools are used to search for, identify and patch vulnerabilities. Vulnerabilities in third party components, unwanted dependencies, version upgrades/updates etc.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.Int.3 - Security Log Monitoring
controls.title: Security Log Monitoring
controls.body: Tools actively monitor security logs for anomalous behavior and alert within established parameters.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.Int.6 - Multifaceted Attack Prevention
controls.title: Multifaceted Attack Prevention
controls.body: Anomalous activity and other network and system alerts are correlated across business units to detect and prevent multifaceted attacks (e.g., simultaneous account takeover and DDoS attack).

controls.name: 3.14.4e - Non-Persistent Systems
controls.title: Non-Persistent Systems
controls.body: Refresh [Assignment: organization-defined systems and system components] from a known, trusted state [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: CC1.1.1 - Monitoring Code of Conduct
controls.title: CC1.1.1 - Monitoring Code of Conduct
controls.body: Management monitors personnel compliance with the code of conduct through monitoring of customer and workforce member complaints and the use of an anonymous whistleblower phone line. The Entity code of conduct includes a sanctions policy and is applied to personnel who violate the code of conduct.

controls.name: M42.12 - Dienst-/Betriebsanweisungen und -vereinbarungen
controls.title: Dienst-/Betriebsanweisungen und -vereinbarungen
controls.body: Dienst-/Betriebsanweisungen und -vereinbarungen

controls.name: AC-14 - Permitted Actions Without Identification or Authentication
controls.title: Permitted Actions Without Identification or Authentication
controls.body:
a. Identify [Assignment: organization-defined user actions] that can be performed on the system without identification or authentication consistent with organizational mission and business functions; and
b. Document and provide supporting rationale in the security plan for the system, user actions not requiring identification or authentication.

controls.name: SA-4 - Acquisition Process
controls.title: Acquisition Process

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.A.1 - Cybersecurity Metrics
controls.title: Cybersecurity Metrics
controls.body: Cybersecurity metrics are used to facilitate strategic decision-making and funding in areas of need.

controls.name: AC-16(1) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Dynamic Attribute Association
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Dynamic Attribute Association
controls.body: Dynamically associate security and privacy attributes with [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects] in accordance with the following security and privacy policies as information is created and combined: [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy policies].

controls.name: PCI 10.1 - Audit Trail Implementation
controls.title: PCI 10.1 - Audit Trail Implementation
controls.body: Implement audit trails to link all access to system components to each individual user.

controls.name: PCI 9.10 - Policies and Procedure for Physical Access Restriction
controls.title: PCI 9.10 - Policies and Procedure for Physical Access Restriction
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for restricting physical access to cardholder data are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: A.13.2.2 - Agreements on Information Transfer
controls.title: Agreements on Information Transfer
controls.body: Agreements shall address the secure transfer of business information between the organization and external parties.

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.Inn.1 - Analysis of Commonalities in Cyber Events
controls.title: Analysis of Commonalities in Cyber Events
controls.body: The risk management function identifies and analyzes commonalities in cyber events that occur both at the institution and across other sectors to enable more predictive risk management.

controls.name: AC-2 (4) Account management | automated audit actions
controls.title: AC-2 (4) Account management | automated audit actions
controls.body: The information system automatically audits account creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal actions, and notifies [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: SC-19 Voice over internet protocol
controls.title: SC-19 Voice over internet protocol
controls.body:
The organization:
 a. Establishes usage restrictions and implementation guidance for Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) technologies based on the potential to cause damage to the information system if used maliciously; and
 b. Authorizes, monitors, and controls the use of VoIP within the information system.

controls.name: RA-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] risk assessment policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the risk assessment policy and the associated risk assessment controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the risk assessment policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current risk assessment:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: PCI 9.9.2 - Periodic Inspection of Devices
controls.title: Periodic Inspection of Devices
controls.body:
Periodically inspect device surfaces to detect tampering (for example, addition of card skimmers to devices), or substitution (for example, by checking the serial number or other device characteristics to verify it has not been swapped with a fraudulent device).

Note: Examples of signs that a device might have been tampered with or substituted include unexpected attachments or cables plugged into the device, missing or changed security labels, broken or differently colored casing, or changes to the serial number or other external markings.

controls.name: MA-3 (2) Maintenance tools | inspect media
controls.title: MA-3 (2) Maintenance tools | inspect media
controls.body: The organization checks media containing diagnostic and test programs for malicious code before the media are used in the information system.

controls.name: MP-6(1) - Media Sanitization | Review, Approve, Track, Document, and Verify
controls.title: Media Sanitization | Review, Approve, Track, Document, and Verify
controls.body: Review, approve, track, document, and verify media sanitization and disposal actions.

controls.name: AC-16(5) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Displays on Objects to Be Output
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Displays on Objects to Be Output
controls.body: Display security and privacy attributes in human-readable form on each object that the system transmits to output devices to identify [Assignment: organization-defined special dissemination, handling, or distribution instructions] using [Assignment: organization-defined human-readable, standard naming conventions].

controls.name: §164.312(e)(2)(ii) - Encryption - Data at Rest (A)
controls.title: §164.312(e)(2)(ii) - Encryption - Data at Rest (A)
controls.body: The control addressing this section is covered under §164.312(a)(2)(iv)- Encryption of data at rest

controls.name: MP-6(8) - Media Sanitization | Remote Purging or Wiping of Information
controls.title: Media Sanitization | Remote Purging or Wiping of Information
controls.body:
Provide the capability to purge or wipe information from [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components]
                  [Selection: remotely; under the following conditions: [Assignment: organization-defined conditions]].

controls.name: AC7.1 - Corporate VPN
controls.title: AC7.1 - Corporate VPN
controls.body: Corporate virtual private network (VPN) services are available to employees who connect remotely from a public network.

controls.name: CIS 12.3-PR - Network Infrastructure Management
controls.title: Network Infrastructure Management
controls.body:
Network Infrastructure Management
Safeguard 12.3: Securely manage network infrastructure.

controls.name: MP-6(7) - Media Sanitization | Dual Authorization
controls.title: Media Sanitization | Dual Authorization
controls.body: Enforce dual authorization for the sanitization of [Assignment: organization-defined system media].

controls.name: CC6.6.3 - Antivirus Update
controls.title: CC6.6.3 - Antivirus Update
controls.body: Antivirus software is configured to receive an updated virus signature at least daily. A network operation receives a report of devices that have not been updated in 30 days and follows up on the devices.

controls.name: AU-6 (3) Audit review, analysis, and reporting | correlate audit repositories
controls.title: AU-6 (3) Audit review, analysis, and reporting | correlate audit repositories
controls.body: The organization analyzes and correlates audit records across different repositories to gain organization-wide situational awareness.

controls.name: 1.16 - Toeleveringsketen van informatie- en communicatietechnologie
controls.title: Toeleveringsketen van informatie- en communicatietechnologie
controls.body:
Overeenkomsten met leveranciers behoren eisen te bevatten die betrekking hebben op de informatiebeveiligingsrisico's in verband met de toeleveringsketen van de diensten en producten op het gebied van informatie- en communicatietechno­
logie.

controls.name: 4.5 - Compatibility
controls.title: Compatibility
controls.body: Any new purpose must be compatible with the original purpose for which the data was collected and guide relevant changes in design.

controls.name: 4.6 - Limit Further Processing
controls.title: Limit Further Processing
controls.body: The controller should not connect datasets or perform any further processing for new incompatible purposes.

controls.name: 4.7 - Review
controls.title: Review
controls.body: The controller must regularly review whether the processing is necessary for the purposes for which the data was collected and test the design against purpose limitation.

controls.name: 4.8 - Technical Limitations of Reuse
controls.title: Technical Limitations of Reuse
controls.body: The controller should use technical measures, including hashing and cryptography, to limit the possibility of repurposing personal data.

controls.name: 5.2 - Relevance
controls.title: Relevance
controls.body: Personal data shall be relevant to the processing in question, and the controller shall be able to demonstrate this relevance.

controls.name: D1.RM.RA.B.1 - Safeguarding Customer Information
controls.title: Safeguarding Customer Information
controls.body: A risk assessment focused on safeguarding customer information identifies reasonable and foreseeable internal and external threats, the likelihood and potential damage of threats, and the sufficiency of policies, procedures, and customer information systems. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 8)

controls.name: SA-2 - Allocation of Resources
controls.title: Allocation of Resources

controls.name: 5.3 - Necessity
controls.title: Necessity
controls.body: Each personal data element shall be necessary for the specified purposes and should only be processed if it is not possible to fulfil the purpose by other means.

controls.name: 5.4 - Limitation
controls.title: Limitation
controls.body: Limit the amount of personal data collected to what is necessary for the purpose.

controls.name: 5.6 - Pseudonymisation
controls.title: Pseudonymisation
controls.body: Pseudonymise personal data as soon as it is no longer necessary to have directly identifiable personal data, and store identification keys separately

controls.name: 5.7 - Anonymisation and Deletion
controls.title: Anonymisation and Deletion
controls.body: Where personal data is not, or no longer necessary for the purpose, personal data shall be anonymised or deleted.

controls.name: 5.8 - Data Flow
controls.title: Data Flow
controls.body: The data flow shall be made efficient enough to not create more copies, or entry points for data collection than necessary.

controls.name: 5.9 - State of the Art
controls.title: State of the Art
controls.body: The controller should apply available and suitable technologies for data avoidance and minimisation.

controls.name: 6.1 - Data Source
controls.title: Data Source
controls.body: Data sources should be reliable in terms of data accuracy.

controls.name: 1.17 - Verantwoordelijkheden en procedures
controls.title: Verantwoordelijkheden en procedures
controls.body:
Er zijn leidinggevende en -procedures vastgesteld om een snelle,
doeltreffende en ordelijke respons op informatiebeveiligingsincidenten te bewerkstelligen.

controls.name: PCI A3.2.2 - Impact of PCI DSS Scope Changes
controls.title: Impact of PCI DSS Scope Changes
controls.body:
Determine PCI DSS scope impact for all changes to systems or networks, including additions of new systems and new network connections. Processes must include:
- Performing a formal PCI DSS impact assessment
- Identifying applicable PCI DSS requirements to the system or network
- Updating PCI DSS scope as appropriate
- Documented sign-off of the results of the impact assessment by responsible personnel (as defined in A3.1.3)
PCI DSS Reference: Scope of PCI DSS Requirements; Requirements 1-12

controls.name: AC-16(8) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Association Techniques and Technologies
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Association Techniques and Technologies
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined techniques and technologies] in associating security and privacy attributes to information.

controls.name: AC2.3 - Physical Protection Upon Acquisition and Updates
controls.title: AC2.3 - Physical Protection Upon Acquisition and Updates
controls.body: Physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attack or accidents is designed and applied on site acquisition and facilities design/construction.

controls.name: 1.2 - Beleidsregels voor informatiebeveiliging
controls.title: Beleidsregels voor informatiebeveiliging
controls.body:
Het door het bestuur vastgestelde lnformatiebeveiligingsbeleid
wordt gepubliceerd en gecommuniceerd aan medewerkers en relevante externe partijen.

controls.name: 1.20 - Privacy en bescherming van persoonsgegevens
controls.title: Privacy en bescherming van persoonsgegevens
controls.body:
Privacy en bescherming van persoonsgegevens behoren, voor zover van toepassing, te warden gewaarborgd in overeenstemming met relevante wet- en regelge­
ving.

controls.name: 1.21 - Scheiding van taken
controls.title: Scheiding van taken
controls.body:
Conflicterende taken en verantwoordelijkheden behoren te warden gescheiden om de kans op onbevoegd of onbedoeld wijzigen of misbruik van de bedrijfsmiddelen van de organisatie te
verminderen.

controls.name: 6.9 - Up to Date
controls.title: Up to Date
controls.body: Personal data shall be updated if necessary for the purpose.

controls.name: 7.1 - Deletion
controls.title: Deletion
controls.body: The controller must have clear internal procedures for deletion.

controls.name: 7.2 - Automation
controls.title: Automation
controls.body: Deletion of certain personal data should be automated.

controls.name: IA.L2-3.5.5 - Identifier Reuse (NIST 800-171: 3.5.5)
controls.title: Identifier Reuse (NIST 800-171: 3.5.5)
controls.body: Prevent the reuse of identifiers for a defined period.

controls.name: PCI 4.3 - Policies and Procedures for Encryption Transmission
controls.title: PCI 4.3 - Policies and Procedures for Encryption Transmission
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for encrypting transmissions of cardholder data are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: AC5.6 - User Passwords - Infrastructure
controls.title: AC5.6 - User Passwords - Infrastructure
controls.body:
Unique user IDs and passwords are required in order to gain access to the infrastructure supporting the application (i.e. Active Directory, server and database accounts). The following password policies are enforced for user accounts:
- Minimum password length: 8 characters
- Password complexity: Enabled
- Password History - 24 Passwords 
- Maximum Password Age - 90 days
- Lockout attempts: 5-10 attempts

controls.name: AC-4(29) - Information Flow Enforcement | Filter Orchestration Engines
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Filter Orchestration Engines
controls.body:
When transferring information between different security domains, employ content filter orchestration engines to ensure that:

a. Content filtering mechanisms successfully complete execution without errors; and
b. Content filtering actions occur in the correct order and comply with [Assignment: organization-defined policy].

controls.name: AAC3.8 - Segregation of Duties
controls.title: AAC3.8 - Segregation of Duties
controls.body: Segregation of duties exists between those responsible for authorizing changes and those responsible for implementing them to Production.

controls.name: AC6.2 - VPN Authentication
controls.title: AC6.2 - VPN Authentication
controls.body: A one-time password authentication method or a public/private key system with a strong passphrase is used to authenticate remote access into the network.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.Int.3 - Database Access Control
controls.title: Database Access Control
controls.body: Access controls are in place for database administrators to prevent unauthorized downloading or transmission of confidential data.

controls.name: MP-8(1) - Media Downgrading | Documentation of Process
controls.title: Media Downgrading | Documentation of Process
controls.body: Document system media downgrading actions.

controls.name: AAC9.11 - System Performance and Capacity Monitoring
controls.title: AAC9.11 - System Performance and Capacity Monitoring
controls.body: The organization uses automated tools to monitor system performance and resource utilization. Employees with responsibility for security, availability, design and maintenance of the system receive automated electronic alerts from monitoring tools.

controls.name: CC6.3.3 - Unique User ID and Password
controls.title: CC6.3.3 - Unique User ID and Password
controls.body: Access to Production resources is restricted via unique user ID and password, SSH key and multi-factor authentication. Shared IDs are not reused and/or restricted when possible.

controls.name: MP-8(3) - Media Downgrading | Controlled Unclassified Information
controls.title: Media Downgrading | Controlled Unclassified Information
controls.body: Downgrade system media containing controlled unclassified information prior to public release.

controls.name: AAC3.10 - Restricted Access to Database Passwords
controls.title: AAC3.10 - Restricted Access to Database Passwords
controls.body: Access to database passwords follows the least privilege principle and is restricted to a need to know basis.

controls.name: CC6.1.3 - Administrative Access
controls.title: CC6.1.3 - Administrative Access
controls.body: Administrative access to in-scope Corporate and Production systems, including their logs, is restricted to authorized personnel based on the least privilege concept in accordance with the Company Information Security Policy.

controls.name: AAC9.17 - Forecasts Capacity
controls.title: AAC9.17 - Forecasts Capacity
controls.body: Future processing demand is forecasted and compared to scheduled capacity on an ongoing basis. Forecasts are reviewed and approved by IT during the periodic IT status meetings.

controls.name: Clause 7.5.3 - Documentation Control
controls.title: Clause 7.5.3 - Documentation Control
controls.body:
Documented information required by the information security management system and by the ISO27001 International Standard shall be controlled to ensure:
a) it is available and suitable for use, where and when it is needed; and
b) it is adequately protected (e.g. from loss of confidentiality, improper use, or loss of integrity).

For the control of documented information, the organization shall address the following activities, as applicable:
c) distribution, access, retrieval and use;
d) storage and preservation, including the preservation of legibility;
e) control of changes (e.g. version control); and
f) retention and disposition.
Documented information of external origin, determined by the organization to be necessary for the planning and operation of the information security management system, shall be identified as appropriate, and controlled.

controls.name: MP-8(4) - Media Downgrading | Classified Information
controls.title: Media Downgrading | Classified Information
controls.body: Downgrade system media containing classified information prior to release to individuals without required access authorizations.

controls.name: AC-6(3) - Least Privilege | Network Access to Privileged Commands
controls.title: Least Privilege | Network Access to Privileged Commands
controls.body: Authorize network access to [Assignment: organization-defined privileged commands] only for [Assignment: organization-defined compelling operational needs] and document the rationale for such access in the security plan for the system.

controls.name: CIS 8.3-PR - Audit Log Storage
controls.title: Audit Log Storage
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.3: Ensure adequate audit log storage.

controls.name: AC.4.023 - Information Flow
controls.title: AC.4.023 - Information Flow
controls.body: Control information flows between security domains on connected systems.

controls.name: D1.TC.Cu.Int.2 - Risk Culture
controls.title: Risk Culture
controls.body: The risk culture requires formal consideration of cyber risks in all business decisions.

controls.name: CC8.1.7 - Access Restriction on Production
controls.title: CC8.1.7 - Access Restriction on Production
controls.body: Access to migrate application changes to Production is restricted to the authorized members of the Engineering team.

controls.name: AC2.7 - Supporting Utilities
controls.title: AC2.7 - Supporting Utilities
controls.body: The organization installs/implements supporting utilities in the event of disruption for reliability and availability.

controls.name: HP - Individuals Request on PHI Amendment (R)
controls.title: Individuals Request on PHI Amendment (R)
controls.body: Amendment requests received from individuals to amend their PHI are documented, retained and carried out in accordance with the organization's policies and procedures. Any denial of the amendment, whole or in part, is communicated to individuals in a timely manner in accordance with the requirement 45 CFR §164.526.

controls.name: OM6.0 - Environmental Protection Notices
controls.title: OM6.0 - Environmental Protection Notices
controls.body: Environmental protection posters/reminders are posted near printers, copiers and large waste receptacles.

controls.name: AC.4.025 - User/System Access Reviews
controls.title: AC.4.025 - User/System Access Reviews
controls.body: Periodically review and update Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) program access permissions.

controls.name: IR.2.094 - Incident Resolution
controls.title: IR.2.094 - Incident Resolution
controls.body: Analyze and triage events to support event resolution and incident declaration.

controls.name: PCI 1.1.6 - Business Justification for Services and Protocols
controls.title: Business Justification for Services and Protocols
controls.body: Documentation of business justification and approval for use of all services, protocols, and ports allowed, including documentation of security features implemented for those protocols considered to be insecure.

controls.name: AC2.5 - Secure Delivery and Loading Areas
controls.title: AC2.5 - Secure Delivery and Loading Areas
controls.body: Delivery and loading areas and other access points where unauthorized persons could enter the facility shall be closed at all times and monitored.

controls.name: PCI 8.1.4 - Disable Inactive User Accounts
controls.title: Disable Inactive User Accounts
controls.body: Remove/disable inactive user accounts within 90 days.

controls.name: AM1.3 - Memory/Storage Media Disposal
controls.title: AM1.3 - Memory/Storage Media Disposal
controls.body: Prior to removal from company facilities or on reaching the end of the lifecycle for storage devices, all digital media is completely degaussed and sanitized to remove any data and software.

controls.name: AAC5.0 - User Passwords - Applications
controls.title: AAC5.0 - User Passwords - Applications
controls.body: User passwords are at least 14 characters long and use upper case, lower case characters, digits and punctuations. This includes all user passwords for all applications.

controls.name: AC5 - Segregation of Customer Data
controls.title: Segregation of Customer Data
controls.body: System components are configured such that the organization and its customers' access is appropriately segmented from other tenant users.

controls.name: PCI A3.2.5.2 - Response Procedures Initiated upon Detection of Clear-text PAN
controls.title: Response Procedures Initiated upon Detection of Clear-text PAN
controls.body:
Implement response procedures to be initiated upon the detection of clear-text PAN outside of the CDE to include:
- Procedures for determining what to do if clear-text PAN is discovered outside of the CDE, including its retrieval, secure deletion and/or migration into the currently defined CDE, as applicable
- Procedures for determining how the data ended up outside of the CDE
- Procedures for remediating data leaks or process gaps that resulted in the data being outside of the CDE
- Procedures for identifying the source of the data
- Procedures for identifying whether any track data is stored with the PANs

controls.name: 7.3 - Storage Criteria
controls.title: Storage Criteria
controls.body: The controller must determine what data and length of storage is necessary for the purpose.

controls.name: PCI 9.5.1 - Media Backups Location
controls.title: Media Backups Location
controls.body: Store media backups in a secure location, preferably an off-site facility, such as an alternate or backup site, or a commercial storage facility. Review the location’s security at least annually.

controls.name: PCI 9.1.2 - Restriction of Physical Access
controls.title: Restriction of Physical Access
controls.body:
Implement physical and/or logical controls to restrict access to publicly accessible network jacks.
For example, network jacks located in public areas and areas accessible to visitors could be disabled and only enabled when network access is explicitly authorized. Alternatively, processes could be implemented to ensure that visitors are escorted at all times in areas with active network jacks.

controls.name: 8 - Integrity and Confidentiality
controls.title: Integrity and Confidentiality
controls.body:
The principle of security includes the well-known information security properties – confidentiality, integrity and availability – which strengthen data processing resilience. The security of personal data shall both prevent data breach incidents as well as facilitate the proper execution of data processing tasks, independent of individuals, to reinforce principles and allow individuals to exercise their rights in a seamless manner.

Recital 78 states that one of the DPbDD measures could consist of enabling the controller to “create and improve security features”. Along with other DPbDD measures, Recital 78 suggests a responsibility on the controllers to continually assess whether it is using the appropriate means of processing at all times and to assess whether the chosen measures actually counter the existing vulnerabilities. Furthermore, it should be understood that controllers must conduct regular reviews of the information security measures that surround and protect the personal data, and the procedure for handling data breaches.

Example: A controller wants to extract personal data from a medical database to a server in the company. The company has assessed the risk for routing the extracts to a server that is accessible to all of the company’s employees as likely to be high for data subjects’ rights and freedoms. There is only one department in the company who needs to process these patient data. The extracts will also have a high value to the company.

To regulate access and mitigate possible damage from malware, the company decides to segregate the network, and establish access controls to the server and the directory. In addition, they put up security monitoring and an intrusion detection and prevention system. The controller activates access control on the server and isolates it from routine use. An automated auditing system is put in place to monitor access and changes. Reporting and automated alerts are generated from this when certain events related to usage are configured. This security measure will ensure that all users have access on a need to know basis and with the appropriate access level. Inappropriate use can be quickly and easily recognised.

Some of the extracts have to be compared with new extracts, and must therefore be stored for three months. The controller decides to put them into separate directories and encrypt the stored extracts.

Handling the incident makes the system more robust, and reliable, both for the controller and the data subjects. The data controller understands that preventative and effective measures and safeguards should be built into all personal data processing undertakes now and in the future, and that doing so may help prevent future such data breach incidents.

EDPB Guidelines 4/2019, pp. 23-24 https://edpb.europa.eu/sites/edpb/files/consultation/edpb_guidelines_201904_dataprotection_by_design_and_by_default.pdf

controls.name: 8.10 - Security Incident Response Management
controls.title: Security Incident Response Management
controls.body: Have in place routines and procedures to detect, handle, report and learn from data breaches.

controls.name: 6.10 - Data Design
controls.title: Data Design
controls.body: Use of technological and organisational design features to decrease inaccuracy, e.g. drop down lists with limited values, internal policies, and legal criteria.

controls.name: 6.2 - Degree of Accuracy
controls.title: Degree of Accuracy
controls.body: Each personal data element shall be as accurate as necessary for the specified purposes.

controls.name: 6.3 - Measurable Accurate
controls.title: Measurable Accurate
controls.body: Reduce the number of false positives/negatives.

controls.name: 6.4 - Verification
controls.title: Verification
controls.body: Depending on the nature of the data, in relation to how often it may change, the controller should verify the correctness of personal data with the data subject before and at different stages of the processing.

controls.name: 6.5 - Erasure/Rectification
controls.title: Erasure/Rectification
controls.body: The controller must erase or rectify inaccurate data without delay.

controls.name: SA-4(7) - Acquisition Process | Niap-approved Protection Profiles
controls.title: Acquisition Process | Niap-approved Protection Profiles
controls.body:
a. Limit the use of commercially provided information assurance and information assurance-enabled information technology products to those products that have been successfully evaluated against a National Information Assurance partnership (NIAP)-approved Protection Profile for a specific technology type, if such a profile exists; and
b. Require, if no NIAP-approved Protection Profile exists for a specific technology type but a commercially provided information technology product relies on cryptographic functionality to enforce its security policy, that the cryptographic module is FIPS-validated or NSA-approved.

controls.name: 6.6 - Accumulated Errors
controls.title: Accumulated Errors
controls.body: Controllers must mitigate the effect of an accumulated error in the processing chain.

controls.name: 6.7 - Access
controls.title: Access
controls.body: Data subjects should be given an overview and easy access to personal data in order to control accuracy and rectify as needed.
