controls.name: PCI 1.2 - Firewall and Router Restriction
controls.title: PCI 1.2 - Firewall and Router Restriction
controls.body:
Build firewall and router configurations that restrict connections between untrusted networks and any system components in the cardholder data environment.

 Note: An "untrusted network" is any network that is external to the networks belonging to the entity under review, and/or which is out of the entity's ability to control or manage.

- 1.2.1  Restrict inbound and outbound traffic to that which is necessary for the cardholder data environment, and specifically deny all other traffic.
- 1.2.2  Secure and synchronize router configuration files.
- 1.2.3  Install perimeter firewalls between all wireless networks and the cardholder data environment, and configure these firewalls to deny or, if traffic is necessary for business purposes, permit only authorized traffic between the wireless environment and the cardholder data environment.

In addition, the organization has formal agreements in place with customers that acknowledge compliance with security, confidentiality, and privacy commitments.

controls.name: Clause 4.2 - Interested Parties

The organization shall determine:
a) Interested parties that are relevant to the information security management system; 
b) The requirements of these interested parties relevant to information security.
c) The requirements of these interested parties that will be addressed through the information security management system. (Applicable under ISO 27001:2022)

Note 1 - The requirements of interested parties can include legal and regulatory requirements and contractual obligations.
Note 2 - Relevant interested parties can have requirements related to climate change.

controls.name: HS - Periodic Security Updates (A)
controls.title: Periodic Security Updates (A)

controls.title: Annual External Penetration Test

controls.title: Destruction of Data on Lost Devices

controls.title: Disclosures by Whistleblowers (R)

controls.title: Software and Application Inventory

controls.title: Non-modifiable Executable Programs | Integrity Protection on Read-only Media

controls.title: SSPA45 - Backup Planning Processes
controls.body: The organization ensures that backup planning processes protect Microsoft Personal and Confidential Data from unauthorized use, access, disclosure, alteration and destruction.

controls.title: Access Control - Confidential Data on Mobile Devices

controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Attack Surface Reduction
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to reduce attack surfaces to [Assignment: organization-defined thresholds].

controls.title: Informing and committing employees to privacy

controls.name: PCI 10.8.1 - Timely Response to Control Failures
controls.title: Timely Response to Control Failures
controls.body:
Additional requirement for service providers only:
Respond to failures of any critical security controls in a timely manner. 
Processes for responding to failures in security controls must include:
- Restoring security functions·Identifying and documenting the duration (date and time start to end) of the security failure·Identifying and documenting cause(s) of failure, including root cause, and documenting remediation required to address root cause·Identifying and addressing any security issues that arose during the failure.
- Performing a risk assessment to determine whether further actions are required as a result of the security failure·Implementing controls to prevent cause of failure from reoccurring.
- Resuming monitoring of security controls.

controls.title: TBL8 - Workstation Disk Encryption and Passwords

controls.title: TBL19 - Data Backup and Monitoring

controls.title: TBL17 - Vulnerability Assessment or Penetration Testing

controls.name: PCI 9.1.1 - Monitoring Physical Access
controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access
controls.body:
Use either video cameras or access control mechanisms (or both) to monitor individual physical access to sensitive areas. Review collected data and correlate with other entries. Store for at least three months, unless otherwise restricted by law.

Note:“Sensitive areas” refers to any data center, server room or any area that houses systems that store, process, or transmit cardholder data. This excludes public-facing areas where only point-of- sale terminals are present, such as the cashier areas in a retail store.

controls.title: Rapportage van zwakke plekken in de informatiebeveiliging
controls.body:
Van medewerkers en contractanten die gebruikmaken van de informatiesystemen en -diensten van de organisatie behoort te warden geeist dat zij de in systemen of diensten waargenomen of vermeende zwakke plekken in de informatiebeveiliging
registreren en rapporteren.

controls.name: M42.35 - Documentation of processing operations cross references in GDPR Art. 30 records
controls.title: Documentation of processing operations cross references in GDPR Art. 30 records
controls.body: Documentation of processing operations and, if applicable, cross references in GDPR Art. 30 records of processing.

controls.name: AC-MC-ML.2.998 - Access Control Implementation
controls.title: AC-MC-ML.2.998 - Access Control Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Access Control (AC) policy.

controls.name: AM-MC-ML.2.998 - Asset Management Policy Implementation
controls.title: AM-MC-ML.2.998 - Asset Management Policy Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Asset Management (AM) policy.

controls.name: ID.AM-5 - Resource Classification
controls.title: Resource Classification
controls.body: Resources (e.g., hardware, devices, data, time, personnel, and software) are prioritized based on their classification, criticality, and business value

controls.name: AC.5.024 - Risk of Unidentified Wireless Access Points
controls.title: AC.5.024 - Risk of Unidentified Wireless Access Points
controls.body: Identify and mitigate risk associated with unidentified wireless access points connected to the network.

controls.name: 2.7 - Screening
controls.title: Screening
controls.body:
Verificatie van de achtergrond van alle kandidaten voor een dienstverband behoort te warden uitgevoerd in overeenstemmingmet relevante wet- en regelgeving en ethische overwegingen en behoort in verhouding te staan tot de bedrijfseisen, de classificatie van de informatie waartoe toegang wordt
verleend en de vastgestelde risico's te zijn.

controls.name: 3.1 - Beleid voor mobiele apparatuur
controls.title: Beleid voor mobiele apparatuur
controls.body:
Er dienen beveiligingsmaatregelen te warden vastgesteld om de risico's
die het gebruik van mobiele apparatuur met zich meebrengt te beperken.

controls.name: 3.12 - Onderhoud van apparatuur
controls.title: Onderhoud van apparatuur
controls.body: Apparatuur behoort correct te warden onderhouden om de continue be­schikbaarheid en integriteit ervan te waarborgen.

controls.name: § 64(3)(13) - Verfügbarkeitskontrolle
controls.title: Verfügbarkeitskontrolle
controls.body: Gewährleistung, dass personenbezogene Daten gegen Zerstörung oder Verlust geschützt sind

controls.name: AU-MC-ML.2.998 - Audit and Accountability Policy Implementation
controls.title: AU-MC-ML.2.998 - Audit and Accountability Policy Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Audit and Accountability (AU) policy.

controls.name: AT-MC-ML.2.998 - Awareness and Training Implementation
controls.title: AT-MC-ML.2.998 - Awareness and Training Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Awareness and Training (AT) policy.

controls.name: 3.14 - Veilig verwijderen of hergebruiken van apparatuur
controls.title: Veilig verwijderen of hergebruiken van apparatuur
controls.body:
Alie onderdelen van de apparatuur die opslagmedia bevatten, behoren te warden geverifieerd om te waarborgen dat gevoelige gegevens en in licentie gege­ven software voorafgaand aan verwijdering of hergebruik zijn verwijderd of betrouwbaar veiligzijn over­
schreven.

controls.name: 3.15 - Kloksynchronisatie
controls.title: Kloksynchronisatie
controls.body: De klokken van alle relevante informatie verwerkende systemen binnen een organi­satie of beveiligingsdomein behoren te warden gesynchroniseerdmet een referentietijdbron.

controls.name: 3.2 - Verwijderen van media
controls.title: Verwijderen van media
controls.body:
Media behoren op een veilige en beveiligde manier te worden verwijderd als ze
niet langer nodig zijn, overeenkomstig formele procedures.

controls.name: AT.4.059 - Cybersecurity Training
controls.title: AT.4.059 - Cybersecurity Training
controls.body: Provide awareness training focused on recognizing and responding to threats from social engineering, advanced persistent threat actors, breaches and suspicious behaviors; update the training at least annually or when there are significant changes to the threat.

controls.name: SA-10(3) - Developer Configuration Management | Hardware Integrity Verification
controls.title: Developer Configuration Management | Hardware Integrity Verification
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to enable integrity verification of hardware components.

controls.name: CM-MC-ML.2.998 - Configuration Management Implementation
controls.title: CM-MC-ML.2.998 - Configuration Management Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Configuration Management (CM) policy.

controls.name: IR-MC-ML.2.998 - Incident Response Implementation
controls.title: IR-MC-ML.2.998 - Incident Response Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Incident Response (IR) policy.

controls.name: 3.3 - Fysieke beveiligingszone
controls.title: Fysieke beveiligingszone
controls.body:
Fysieke beveiligingszone: Beveiligingszones behoren te warden gedefinieerd en gebruikt om gebieden te
beschermen die gevoelige of essentiele informatie en informatie verwerkende faciliteiten bevatten.

controls.name: 3.4 - Fysieke toegangsbeveiliging
controls.title: Fysieke toegangsbeveiliging
controls.body: Beveiligde gebieden behoren te warden beschermd door passende toe­gangsbeveiligingom ervoor te zorgen dataIleen bevoegd personeel toegang krijgt.

controls.name: IR.4.100 - Lesson Learned from Incident Response Activities
controls.title: IR.4.100 - Lesson Learned from Incident Response Activities
controls.body: Use knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques and procedures in incident response planning and execution.

controls.name: IR.2.093 - Incident Logging and Reporting
controls.title: IR.2.093 - Incident Logging and Reporting
controls.body: Detect and report events.

controls.name: MA-MC-ML.2.998 - Maintenance Implementation
controls.title: MA-MC-ML.2.998 - Maintenance Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Maintenance (MA) policy.

controls.name: MP-8 - Media Downgrading
controls.title: Media Downgrading

controls.name: 3.5 - Kantoren, ruimten en faciliteiten beveiligen
controls.title: Kantoren, ruimten en faciliteiten beveiligen
controls.body:
Voor kantoren, ruimten en faciliteiten behoort fysieke
beveiliging te warden ontworpen en toegepast.

controls.name: PS-MC-ML.2.998 - Personnel Security Implementation
controls.title: PS-MC-ML.2.998 - Personnel Security Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Personnel Security (PS) policy.

controls.name: RE-MC-ML.2.998 - Recovery Implementation
controls.title: RE-MC-ML.2.998 - Recovery Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Recovery (RE) policy.

controls.name: 3.6 - Beschermen tegen bedreigingen van buitenaf
controls.title: Beschermen tegen bedreigingen van buitenaf
controls.body: Tegen natuurrampen, kwaadwillige aanvallen of ongeluk­ken behoort fysieke bescherming te warden ontworpen en toegepast.

controls.name: 3.7 - Werken in beveiligde gebieden
controls.title: Werken in beveiligde gebieden
controls.body:
Voor het werken in beveiligde gebieden behoren procedures te worden
ontwikkeld en toegepast.

controls.name: 3.8 - Laad- en loslocatie
controls.title: Laad- en loslocatie
controls.body:
Toegangspunten zoals laad- en loslocaties en andere punten waar onbevoegde per­sonen het terrein kunnen betreden, behoren te warden beheerst, en zo mogelijk te worden afgeschermd
van informatie verwerkende faciliteiten om onbevoegde toegang te vermijden.

controls.name: § 64(3)(14) - Trennbarkeit
controls.title: Trennbarkeit
controls.body: Gewährleistung, dass zu unterschiedlichen Zwecken erhobene personenbezogene Daten getrennt verarbeitet werden können

controls.name: RM.4.148 - Supply Chain Risk Management Processes
controls.title: RM.4.148 - Supply Chain Risk Management Processes
controls.body: Develop and update, as required, a plan for managing supply chain risks associated with the IT supply chain.

controls.name: CA-MC-ML.2.998 - Security Assessment Implementation
controls.title: CA-MC-ML.2.998 - Security Assessment Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Security Assessment (CA) policy.

controls.name: PE-2(1) - Physical Access Authorizations | Access by Position or Role
controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations | Access by Position or Role
controls.body: Authorize physical access to the facility where the system resides based on position or role.

controls.name: 3.9 - Plaatsing en bescherming van apparatuur
controls.title: Plaatsing en bescherming van apparatuur
controls.body:
Apparatuur behoort zo te warden geplaatst en beschermd dat risico's van bedreigingen en gevaren van buitenaf, alsook de kans op onbevoegde toegang worden
verkleind.

controls.name: 4.1 - Wijzigingsbeheer
controls.title: Wijzigingsbeheer
controls.body: Veranderingen in de organisatie, bedrijfsprocessen, informatie verwerkende facilitei­ten en systemen die van invloed zijn op de informatiebeveiliging behoren te warden beheerst.

controls.name: M80.36 - Creating records of processing activities
controls.title: Creating records of processing activities
controls.body: Creating records of processing activities

controls.name: CA.4.164 - Periodic Penetration Testing
controls.title: CA.4.164 - Periodic Penetration Testing
controls.body: Conduct penetration testing periodically, leveraging automated scanning tools and ad hoc tests using human experts.

controls.name: CA.3.162 - Security Assessment for Internal Enterprise Software
controls.title: CA.3.162 - Security Assessment for Internal Enterprise Software
controls.body: Employ a security assessment of enterprise software that has been developed internally, for internal use, and that has been organizationally defined as an area of risk.

controls.name: SA-MC-ML.2.998 - Situational Awareness Implementation
controls.title: SA-MC-ML.2.998 - Situational Awareness Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the Situational Awareness (SA) policy.

controls.name: 4.10 - Beveiligde ontwikkelomgeving
controls.title: Beveiligde ontwikkelomgeving
controls.body:
Organisaties behoren beveiligde ontwikkelomgevingen vast te stellen en
passend te beveiligen voor verrichtingen op het gebied van systeemontwikkeling en integratie, die be­trekking hebben op de gehele levenscyclus van de systeemontwikkeling.

controls.name: SC-MC-ML.2.998 - System and Communication Protection Implementation
controls.title: SC-MC-ML.2.998 - System and Communication Protection Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the System and Communication Protection (SC) policy.

controls.name: SC.4.228 - Network Segregation
controls.title: SC.4.228 - Network Segregation
controls.body: Isolate administration of organizationally defined high-value critical network infrastructure components and servers.

controls.name: SC.5.230 - Port and Protocol Compliance
controls.title: SC.5.230 - Port and Protocol Compliance
controls.body: Enforce port and protocol compliance.

controls.name: 4.11 - Beheer van veranderingen in dienstverlening van leveranciers
controls.title: Beheer van veranderingen in dienstverlening van leveranciers
controls.body:
Veranderingen in de dienstverleningvan leveranciers, met inbegrip van handhaving en verbetering van bestaande beleidslijnen, procedures en beheersmaatregelen voor informatiebeveiliging, behoren te warden, beheerd, rekening houdend met de
kritikaliteit van bedrijfsinformatie,betrokken systemen en processen en herbeoordeling van risico's.

controls.name: SC.5.208 - Organizational Boundary Protection System
controls.title: SC.5.208 - Organizational Boundary Protection System
controls.body: Employ organizationally defined and tailored boundary protections in addition to commercially available solutions.

controls.name: SI-MC-ML.2.998 - System and Information Integrity Implementation
controls.title: SI-MC-ML.2.998 - System and Information Integrity Implementation
controls.body: Document the CMMC practices to implement the System and Information Integrity (SI) policy.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.1 - Coding Injection Flaws
controls.title: Coding Injection Flaws
controls.body: Injection flaws, particularly SQL injection. Also consider OS Command Injection, LDAP and XPath injection flaws as well as other injection flaws.

controls.name: SI.4.221 - Intrusion Detection and Threat Hunting
controls.title: SI.4.221 - Intrusion Detection and Threat Hunting
controls.body: Use threat indicator information relevant to the information and systems being protected and effective mitigations obtained from external organizations to inform intrusion detection and threat hunting.

controls.name: PE-2(2) - Physical Access Authorizations | Two Forms of Identification
controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations | Two Forms of Identification
controls.body: Require two forms of identification from the following forms of identification for visitor access to the facility where the system resides: [Assignment: organization-defined list of acceptable forms of identification].

controls.name: SI.3.218 - Spam Protection Mechanisms
controls.title: SI.3.218 - Spam Protection Mechanisms
controls.body: Employ spam protection mechanisms at information system access entry and exit points.

controls.name: SSPA8 - Use of Cookies
controls.title: SSPA8 - Use of Cookies
controls.body: The organization provides Data Subjects with transparent notice and choice regarding the use of cookies. It also ensures that cookie use aligns with commitments in the Microsoft Privacy Statement and local legal requirements such as rules established by the EU. (Applicable to organizations that create and manage Microsoft websites and/or applications)

controls.name: SSPA44 - Security Training
controls.title: SSPA44 - Security Training
controls.body: System administrators, operations staff, management and third parties undergo annual security training.

controls.name: MP-4(2) - Media Storage | Automated Restricted Access
controls.title: Media Storage | Automated Restricted Access
controls.body: Restrict access to media storage areas and log access attempts and access granted using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: SSPA40 - Antivirus and Anti-Malware
controls.title: SSPA40 - Antivirus and Anti-Malware
controls.body: The organization has antivirus and anti-malware software installed on equipment connected to the network used to Process Microsoft Personal and Confidential Data to protect against potentially harmful viruses and malicious software applications.

controls.name: 8.16 - Monitoring Activities
controls.title: Monitoring Activities
controls.body: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behavior and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

controls.name: M43.06 - Determination of the data points needed for logging the processing operation
controls.title: Determination of the data points needed for logging the processing operation
controls.body: Determination of the data points needed for logging the processing operation

controls.name: SSPA47 - Authenticated Access to Microsoft Data
controls.title: SSPA47 - Authenticated Access to Microsoft Data
controls.body: The organization authenticates the identity of an individual before granting that individual access to Microsoft Personal or Confidential Data and ensures that the access is limited to the particular individual’s scope of activity permitted to support Performance.

controls.name: M80.07 - Appointing a project manager to build the Privacy Management System
controls.title: Appointing a project manager to build the Privacy Management System
controls.body: Appointing a project manager to build the Privacy Management System

controls.name: 4.12 - Beoordeling van en besluitvorming over informatiebeveiligingsgebeurtenissen
controls.title: Beoordeling van en besluitvorming over informatiebeveiligingsgebeurtenissen
controls.body:
lnformatiebeveiligings­
gebeurtenissen behoren te warden beoordeeld en er behoort te warden geoordeeld of zij moeten war­den geclassificeerd als informatiebeveiligingincidenten.

controls.name: 4.13 - Respons op informatiebeveiligingsincidenten
controls.title: Respons op informatiebeveiligingsincidenten
controls.body:
Op informatiebeveiligingsincidenten behoort te warden
gereageerd in overeenstemmingmet de gedocumenteerde procedures.

controls.name: M80.08 - Establish and specify the responsibilities and role of the DPO
controls.title: Establish and specify the responsibilities and role of the DPO
controls.body: Establish and specify the responsibilities and role of the DPO

controls.name: PCI 6.5.10 - Broken Authentication and Session
controls.title: Broken Authentication and Session
controls.body:
Broken authentication and session management.

Note: Requirements 6.5.7 through 6.5.10, apply to web applications and application interfaces (internal or external).

controls.name: 8.1 - User Endpoint Devices
controls.title: User Endpoint Devices
controls.body: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.

controls.name: A.15.1.3 - Information and Communications Technology Supply Chain
controls.title: Information and Communications Technology Supply Chain
controls.body: Agreements with suppliers shall include requirements to address the information security risks associated with information and communications technology services and product supply chain.

controls.name: ID.AM-4 - External Information Catalogue
controls.title: External Information Catalogue
controls.body: External information systems are catalogued

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.A.2 - Cyber Event Recovery Capability
controls.title: Cyber Event Recovery Capability
controls.body: The institution validates that it is able to recover from cyber events similar to by known sophisticated attacks at other organizations.

controls.name: TBL9 - System Performance and Capacity Monitoring
controls.title: TBL9 - System Performance and Capacity Monitoring
controls.body: The IT team in the organization continuously monitors system capacity and performance in its cloud environment(s) to identify anomalies that could compromise the systems' availability.

controls.name: PCI 7.2.1 - User Access to System Components
controls.title: User Access to System Components
controls.body: Coverage of all system components.

controls.name: APP 12.2 - Access Requests by Individuals for Agencies
controls.title: Access Requests by Individuals for Agencies
controls.body: The agency has implemented policies, procedures and/or mechanisms to meet its obligations to individuals to access their personal information. Such access requests are documented, retained, and acted upon within 30 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: PCI 7.2.2 - Assignment of Privileged Access
controls.title: Assignment of Privileged Access
controls.body: Assignment of privileges to individuals based on job classification and function.

controls.name: SA-8(24) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Failure and Recovery
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Failure and Recovery
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of secure failure and recovery in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.Int.1 - Third-Party Service Level Agreements
controls.title: Third-Party Service Level Agreements
controls.body: Third-party SLAs or similar means are in place that require timely notification of security events

controls.name: PE-15(1) - Water Damage Protection | Automation Support
controls.title: Water Damage Protection | Automation Support
controls.body: Detect the presence of water near the system and alert [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: AC-25 - Reference Monitor
controls.title: Reference Monitor
controls.body: Implement a reference monitor for [Assignment: organization-defined access control policies] that is tamperproof, always invoked, and small enough to be subject to analysis and testing, the completeness of which can be assured.

controls.name: PM-2 - Information Security Program Leadership Role
controls.title: Information Security Program Leadership Role
controls.body: Appoint a senior agency information security officer with the mission and resources to coordinate, develop, implement, and maintain an organization-wide information security program.

controls.name: § 64(3)(4) - Benutzerkontrolle
controls.title: Benutzerkontrolle
controls.body: Verhinderung der Nutzung automatisierter Verarbeitungssysteme mit Hilfe von Einrichtungen zur Datenübertragung durch Unbefugte

controls.name: M42.13 - Rahmen-Datenschutzkonzept
controls.title: Rahmen-Datenschutzkonzept
controls.body: Rahmen-Datenschutzkonzept (Handbücher, übergreifende Schutzmaßnahmen, Verantwortliche und Ansprechpartner)

controls.name: A.13.2.4 - Confidentiality or Nondisclosure Agreements
controls.title: Confidentiality or Nondisclosure Agreements
controls.body: Requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization’s needs for the protection of information shall be identified, regularly reviewed and documented.

controls.name: CC6.7.2 - Workstations and Laptops Encryption
controls.title: CC6.7.2 - Workstations and Laptops Encryption
controls.body: All corporate endpoints, workstations and laptops are configured with full disk encryption.

controls.name: M50.38 - Dokumentation von Restrisiken
controls.title: Dokumentation von Restrisiken
controls.body: Dokumentation von Restrisiken

controls.name: CP-8(1) - Telecommunications Services | Priority of Service Provisions
controls.title: Telecommunications Services | Priority of Service Provisions
controls.body:
a. Develop primary and alternate telecommunications service agreements that contain priority-of-service provisions in accordance with availability requirements (including recovery time objectives); and
b. Request Telecommunications Service Priority for all telecommunications services used for national security emergency preparedness if the primary and/or alternate telecommunications services are provided by a common carrier.

controls.name: A.14.1.3 - Protecting Application Services Transactions
controls.title: Protecting Application Services Transactions
controls.body: Information involved in application service transactions shall be protected to prevent incomplete transmission, misrouting, unauthorized message alteration, unauthorized disclosure, unauthorized message duplication or replay.

controls.name: HS - Network Diagram (R)
controls.title: Network Diagram (R)
controls.body: A formal network diagram outlining boundary protection mechanisms (e.g. firewalls, IDS, etc.) is maintained for all network connections and reviewed annually by IT management.

controls.name: PCI 8.1.7 - User Lockout Duration
controls.title: User Lockout Duration
controls.body: Set the lockout duration to a minimum of 30 minutes or until an administrator enables the user ID.

controls.name: A.14.2.5 - Secure System Engineering Principles
controls.title: Secure System Engineering Principles
controls.body: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system implementation efforts.

controls.name: D2.TI.Ti.B.2 - Threat and Vulnerability Monitoring
controls.title: Threat and Vulnerability Monitoring
controls.body: Threat information is used to monitor threats and vulnerabilities. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 83)

controls.name: ID.SC-5 - Suppliers Response and Recovery Testing
controls.title: Suppliers Response and Recovery Testing
controls.body: Response and recovery planning and testing are conducted with suppliers and third-party providers

controls.name: A.14.2.1 - Secure Development Policy
controls.title: Secure Development Policy
controls.body: Rules for the development of software and systems shall be established and applied to developments within the organization.

controls.name: A.14.2.6 - Secure Development Environment
controls.title: Secure Development Environment
controls.body: Organizations shall establish and appropriately protect secure development environments for system development and integration efforts that cover the entire system development life cycle.

controls.name: Clause 10.1 - Continual Improvement
controls.title: Continual Improvement
controls.body:
*[Note - This Clause is referred as "Clause 10.2 - Continual Improvement" under ISO27001:2013]*

The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the information security management system.

controls.name: PR.PT-5 - Resilience Mechanisms
controls.title: Resilience Mechanisms
controls.body: Mechanisms (e.g., failsafe, load balancing, hot swap) are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations

controls.name: A.15.1.1 - Information Security Policy for Supplier Relationships
controls.title: Information Security Policy for Supplier Relationships
controls.body: Information security requirements for mitigating the risks associated with supplier’s access to the organization’s assets shall be agreed with the supplier and documented.

controls.name: A.18.1.3 - Protection of Records
controls.title: Protection of Records
controls.body: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release, in accordance with legislatory, regulatory, contractual and business requirements.

controls.name: HP - Restriction on Uses and Disclosure of PHI (R)
controls.title: Restriction on Uses and Disclosure of PHI (R)
controls.body: Restriction on uses or disclosures of PHI requested by individuals is recorded, monitored and adhered to except when emergency treatment is required for the individual.

controls.name: SO13 - Penetration Testing
controls.title: Penetration Testing
controls.body: A penetration test is performed on an annual basis to identify security exploits. Issues identified are classified according to risk, analyzed and remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.E.6 - Domain Name System Security Extensions
controls.title: Domain Name System Security Extensions
controls.body: Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC) is deployed across the enterprise.

controls.name: DP1 - Acknowledgement on Privacy Policy
controls.title: Acknowledgement on Privacy Policy
controls.body: All employees and contractors are required to read and acknowledge the privacy policy describing the collection, use, maintenance, and disclosure of personal information prior to engaging with the organization or in case of any changes to the policy.

controls.name: ID.BE-5 - Resilience Requirement for Critical Services
controls.title: Resilience Requirement for Critical Services
controls.body: Resilience requirements to support delivery of critical services are established for all operating states (e.g. under duress/attack, during recovery, normal operations)

controls.name: D2.IS.Is.B.1 - Internal Sharing of Threat Information
controls.title: Internal Sharing of Threat Information
controls.body: Information security threats are gathered and shared with applicable internal employees. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 83)

controls.name: CM4 - Change Notification
controls.title: Change Notification
controls.body: Changes that affect the functionality and security of the system components are communicated to internal and external users.

controls.name: ID.RA-2 - Cyber Threats Intelligence Forums
controls.title: Cyber Threats Intelligence Forums
controls.body: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

controls.name: PR.DS-2 - Protection for Data in Transit
controls.title: Protection for Data in Transit
controls.body: Data-in-transit is protected

controls.name: A.9.2.2 - User Access Provisioning
controls.title: User Access Provisioning
controls.body: A formal user access provisioning process shall be implemented to assign or revoke access rights for all user types to all systems and services.

controls.name: RS.CO-5 - Situational Awareness
controls.title: Situational Awareness
controls.body: Voluntary information sharing occurs with external stakeholders to achieve broader cybersecurity situational awareness

controls.name: A.6.1.1 - Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: All information security responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.

controls.name: A.5.1.2 - Review of the Policies for Information Security
controls.title: Review of the Policies for Information Security
controls.body: The policies for information security shall be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur to ensure their continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

controls.name: A.6.1.2 - Segregation of Duties
controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.body: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization’s assets.

controls.name: A.12.5.1 - Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.title: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.body: Procedures shall be implemented to control the installation of software on operational systems.

controls.name: A.8.2.2 - Labelling of Information
controls.title: Labelling of Information
controls.body: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.name: A.9.2.4 - Management of Secret Authentication Information of Users
controls.title: Management of Secret Authentication Information of Users
controls.body: The allocation of secret authentication information shall be controlled through a formal management process.

controls.name: PM-29 - Risk Management Program Leadership Roles
controls.title: Risk Management Program Leadership Roles
controls.body:
a. Appoint a Senior Accountable Official for Risk Management to align organizational information security and privacy management processes with strategic, operational, and budgetary planning processes; and
b. Establish a Risk Executive (function) to view and analyze risk from an organization-wide perspective and ensure management of risk is consistent across the organization.

controls.name: PCI 7.1.2 - Privileged Accounts
controls.title: Privileged Accounts
controls.body: Restrict access to privileged user IDs to least privileges necessary to perform job responsibilities.

controls.name: A.11.1.5 - Working in Secure Areas
controls.title: Working in Secure Areas
controls.body: Procedures for working in secure areas shall be designed and applied.

controls.name: IM3 - Incident Management Process
controls.title: Incident Management Process
controls.body: A formal incident management process has been established and implemented which requires incidents to be tracked, documented and resolved in a complete, accurate and timely manner. The process document is reviewed by management on an annual basis and updated as required.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.E.2 - Dual User Accounts for Privileged Roles
controls.title: Dual User Accounts for Privileged Roles
controls.body: Administrators have two accounts: one for administrative use and one for general purpose, non-administrative tasks.

controls.name: A.12.4.2 - Protection of Log Information
controls.title: Protection of Log Information
controls.body: Logging facilities and log information shall be protected against tampering and unauthorized access.

controls.name: M50.39 - Separierte Einrichtung von IT-Verbünden und Diensten
controls.title: Separierte Einrichtung von IT-Verbünden und Diensten
controls.body: Separierte Einrichtung von IT-Verbünden und Diensten

controls.name: A.12.4.3 - Administrator and Operator Logs
controls.title: Administrator and Operator Logs
controls.body: System administrator and system operator activities shall be logged and the logs protected and regularly reviewed.

controls.name: A.11.1.1 - Physical Security Perimeter
controls.title: Physical Security Perimeter
controls.body: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain either sensitive or critical information and information processing facilities.

controls.name: A.11.1.6 - Delivery and Loading Areas
controls.title: Delivery and Loading Areas
controls.body: Access points such as delivery and loading areas and other points where unauthorized persons could enter the premises shall be controlled and, if possible, isolated from information processing facilities to avoid unauthorized access.

controls.name: A.13.2.3 - Electronic Messaging
controls.title: Electronic Messaging
controls.body: Information involved in electronic messaging shall be appropriately protected.

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.A.1 - Incident Response Metrics
controls.title: Incident Response Metrics
controls.body: The institution has established quantitative and qualitative metrics for the cybersecurity incident response process.

controls.name: A.14.2.2 - System Change Control Procedures
controls.title: System Change Control Procedures
controls.body: Changes to systems within the development lifecycle shall be controlled by the use of formal change control procedures.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.3 - Production Data and Testing
controls.title: Production Data and Testing
controls.body: Production data (live PANs) are not used for testing or development.

controls.name: A.14.3.1 - Protection of Test Data
controls.title: Protection of Test Data
controls.body: Test data shall be selected carefully, protected and controlled.

controls.name: A.16.1.3 - Reporting Information Security Weaknesses
controls.title: Reporting Information Security Weaknesses
controls.body: Employees and contractors using the organization’s information systems and services shall be required to note and report any observed or suspected information security weaknesses in systems or services.

controls.name: A.16.1.6 - Learning from Information Security Incidents
controls.title: Learning from Information Security Incidents
controls.body: Knowledge gained from analysing and resolving information security incidents shall be used to reduce the likelihood or impact of future incidents.

controls.name: A.18.1.5 - Regulation of Cryptographic Controls
controls.title: Regulation of Cryptographic Controls
controls.body: Cryptographic controls shall be used in compliance with all relevant agreements, legislation and regulations.

controls.name: PCI 9.8.1 - Shred Hard Copy Material with CHD
controls.title: Shred Hard Copy Material with CHD
controls.body: Shred, incinerate, or pulp hard- copy materials so that cardholder data cannot be reconstructed. Secure storage containers used for materials that are to be destroyed.

controls.name: A.11.2.3 - Cabling Security
controls.title: Cabling Security
controls.body: Power and telecommunications cabling carrying data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

controls.name: HB - Methods of Notification (R)
controls.title: Methods of Notification (R)
controls.body: The organization has established a formal procedure on breach notification methods for notifying an individual, an individual's next of kin, or a personal representative.

controls.name: A.14.1.1 - Information Security Requirements Analysis and Specification
controls.title: Information Security Requirements Analysis and Specification
controls.body: The information security related requirements shall be included in the requirements for new information systems or enhancements to existing information systems.

controls.name: A.16.1.1 - Responsibilities and Procedures
controls.title: Responsibilities and Procedures
controls.body: Management responsibilities and procedures shall be established to ensure a quick, effective and orderly response to information security incidents.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.Int.1 - Cybersecurity Expertise in Board Committee
controls.title: Cybersecurity Expertise in Board Committee
controls.body: The board or an appropriate board committee has cybersecurity expertise or engages experts to assist with oversight responsibilities.

controls.name: PCI A1.4 - Forensic Investigation Process
controls.title: Forensic Investigation Process
controls.body: Enable processes to provide for timely forensic investigation in the event of a compromise to any hosted merchant or service provider.

controls.name: PCI A2.1 - POS POI Terminal SSL/TLS Requirement
controls.title: POS POI Terminal SSL/TLS Requirement
controls.body:
Where POS POI terminals (at the merchant or payment acceptance location) use SSL and/or early TLS, the entity must confirm the devices are not susceptible to any known exploits for those protocols.
Note:  This requirement is intended to apply to the entity with the POS POI terminal, such as a merchant.  This requirement is not intended for service providers who serve as the termination or connection point to those POS POI terminals. Requirements A2.2 and A2.3 apply to POS POI service providers.

controls.name: DP6 - Consent to Retain Information
controls.title: Consent to Retain Information
controls.body: Consents obtained from data subjects for collection, usage and disclosure of personal information is retained in accordance with privacy laws and regulations as well as objectives defined in the privacy policy.

controls.name: PR.PT-2 - Protection of Removable Media
controls.title: Protection of Removable Media
controls.body: Removable media is protected and its use restricted according to policy

controls.name: A.6.2.1 - Mobile Device Policy
controls.title: Mobile Device Policy
controls.body: A policy and supporting security measures shall be adopted to manage the risks introduced by using mobile devices.

controls.name: A.5.1.1 - Policies for Information Security
controls.title: Policies for Information Security
controls.body: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.

controls.name: A.7.3.1 - Termination or Change of Employment Responsibilities
controls.title: Termination or Change of Employment Responsibilities
controls.body: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, communicated to the employee or contractor and enforced.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.Int.2 - Review of Cybersecurity Strategy
controls.title: Review of Cybersecurity Strategy
controls.body: Management periodically reviews the cybersecurity strategy to address evolving cyber threats and changes to the institution’s inherent risk profile.

controls.name: A.8.2.3 - Handling of Assets
controls.title: Handling of Assets
controls.body: Procedures for handling assets shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.name: A.9.4.1 - Information Access Restriction
controls.title: Information Access Restriction
controls.body: Access to information and application system functions shall be restricted in accordance with the access control policy.

controls.name: PI5 - Integrity Output Agreement
controls.title: Integrity Output Agreement
controls.body: The organization has formal agreements with its customers to define the completeness and accuracy of the system data outputs and the definition of the data. The agreements include procedures and responsibilities that need to be performed by the organization and the customers to ensure that the data is accurate and complete during the output. Any deviations from expected results are followed up, evaluated and resolved in a timely manner.

controls.name: CM3 - Software Development Life Cycle
controls.title: Software Development Life Cycle
controls.body: A formal system development life cycle (SDLC) methodology is established that governs the development, acquisition, implementation, and maintenance of application development and enhancement projects.

controls.name: SC-42(2) - Sensor Capability and Data | Authorized Use
controls.title: Sensor Capability and Data | Authorized Use
controls.body: Employ the following measures so that data or information collected by [Assignment: organization-defined sensors] is only used for authorized purposes: [Assignment: organization-defined measures].

controls.name: A.9.4.2 - Secure Log-on Procedures
controls.title: Secure Log-on Procedures
controls.body: Where required by the access control policy, access to systems and applications shall be controlled by a secure log-on procedure.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.A.2 - Industry-recognized Standards for Gap Analysis
controls.title: Industry-recognized Standards for Gap Analysis
controls.body: Industry-recognized cybersecurity standards are used as sources during the analysis of cybersecurity program gaps.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.Int.5 - Cyber Risk Management Self-Assessment
controls.title: Cyber Risk Management Self-Assessment
controls.body: The board or an appropriate board committee ensures management’s annual cybersecurity self-assessment evaluates the institution’s ability to meet its cyber risk management standards.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.Int.6 - Resource Allocation Approval
controls.title: Resource Allocation Approval
controls.body: The board or an appropriate board committee reviews and approves management’s prioritization and resource allocation decisions based on the results of the cyber assessments.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.5 - Change Control Procedures
controls.title: Change Control Procedures
controls.body: Change control procedure is in place.

controls.name: A.11.2.7 - Secure Disposal or Reuse of Equipment
controls.title: Secure Disposal or Reuse of Equipment
controls.body: All items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

controls.name: SC-35 - External Malicious Code Identification
controls.title: External Malicious Code Identification
controls.body: Include system components that proactively seek to identify network-based malicious code or malicious websites.

controls.name: A.11.2.9 - Clear Desk and Clear Screen Policy
controls.title: Clear Desk and Clear Screen Policy
controls.body: A clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media and a clear screen policy for information processing facilities shall be adopted.

controls.name: A.13.1.2 - Security of Network Services
controls.title: Security of Network Services
controls.body: Security mechanisms, service levels and management requirements of all network services shall be identified and included in network services agreements, whether these services are provided in-house or outsourced.

controls.name: A.16.1.7 - Collection of Evidence
controls.title: Collection of Evidence
controls.body: The organization shall define and apply procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of information, which can serve as evidence.

controls.name: A.16.1.5 - Response to Information Security Incidents
controls.title: Response to Information Security Incidents
controls.body: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

controls.name: PCI 8.2.6 - First Time Passwords
controls.title: First Time Passwords
controls.body: Set passwords/passphrases for first-time use and upon reset to a unique value for each user, and change immediately after the first use.

controls.name: A.16.1.2 - Reporting Information Security Events
controls.title: Reporting Information Security Events
controls.body: Information security events shall be reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.16 - Restrictions on Software Installation
controls.title: Restrictions on Software Installation
controls.body: Administrative, physical, or technical controls are in place to prevent users without administrative responsibilities from installing unauthorized software. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 25)

controls.name: A.12.1.1 - Documented Operating Procedures
controls.title: Documented Operating Procedures
controls.body: Operating procedures shall be documented and made available to all users who need them.

controls.name: HP - Confidential Communications (R)
controls.title: Confidential Communications (R)
controls.body: Formal requests from individuals to receive PHI communications by alternate means or at alternate locations are documented, retained, and acted upon by an authorized person.

controls.name: CIS 1.5-DE - Passive Asset Discovery
controls.title: Passive Asset Discovery
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
Safeguard 1.5: Use a passive asset discovery tool.

controls.name: D1.5.7 - Versionierung
controls.title: Versionierung
controls.body: Versionierung

controls.name: A.14.1.2 - Securing Application Services on Public Networks
controls.title: Securing Application Services on Public Networks
controls.body: Information involved in application services passing over public networks shall be protected from fraudulent activity, contract dispute and unauthorized disclosure and modification.

controls.name: A.12.6.2 - Restrictions on Software Installation
controls.title: Restrictions on Software Installation
controls.body: Rules governing the installation of software by users shall be established and implemented.

controls.name: D1.G.IT.B.1 - Asset Inventory
controls.title: Asset Inventory
controls.body: An inventory of organizational assets (e.g., hardware, software, data, and systems hosted externally) is maintained. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 9)

controls.name: AC-17 - Remote Access
controls.title: Remote Access
controls.body:
a. Establish and document usage restrictions, configuration/connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed; and
b. Authorize each type of remote access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

controls.name: SO3 - Baseline Configurations
controls.title: Baseline Configurations
controls.body: Baseline configurations are retained within the configuration management tool for rollback capability anytime an approved configuration change is made.

controls.name: PCI 1.2.3 - Firewall Installation between Wireless Network and CDE
controls.title: Firewall Installation between Wireless Network and CDE
controls.body: Install perimeter firewalls between all wireless networks and the cardholder data environment, and configure these firewalls to deny or, if traffic is necessary for business purposes, permit only authorized traffic between the wireless environment and the cardholder data environment.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.Inn.5 - Risk Mitigation - Risk Scoring of User Credentials
controls.title: Risk Mitigation - Risk Scoring of User Credentials
controls.body: Real-time risk mitigation is taken based on automated risk scoring of user credentials.

controls.name: D1.G.IT.B.2 - Asset Classification
controls.title: Asset Classification
controls.body: Organizational assets (e.g., hardware, systems, data, and applications) are prioritized for protection based on the data classification and business value. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 12)

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.11 - Physical Security Controls
controls.title: Physical Security Controls
controls.body: Physical security controls are used to prevent unauthorized access to information systems and telecommunication systems. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 47)

controls.name: D2.IS.Is.E.1 - Threat and Vulnerability Information Sharing Process
controls.title: Threat and Vulnerability Information Sharing Process
controls.body: A formal and secure process is in place to share threat and vulnerability information with other entities.

controls.name: A.12.4.4 - Clock Synchronisation
controls.title: Clock Synchronisation
controls.body: The clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organization or security domain shall be synchronised to a single reference time source.

controls.name: DP11 - Information Collection Purpose
controls.title: Information Collection Purpose
controls.body: The organization describes the purpose(s) for which personal information is collected, used, maintained, and disclosed in its privacy policy/statement.

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.Int.1 - Cybersecurity Reporting Line
controls.title: Cybersecurity Reporting Line
controls.body: The cybersecurity function has a clear reporting line that does not present a conflict of interest.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.B.3 - Review of Logging Practices
controls.title: Review of Logging Practices
controls.body: Logging practices are independently reviewed periodically to ensure appropriate log management (e.g., access controls, retention, and maintenance). (FFIEC Operations Booklet, page 29)

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.Int.5 - Loss and Expense Analysis
controls.title: Loss and Expense Analysis
controls.body: There is a process to analyze and assign potential losses and related expenses, by cost center, associated with cybersecurity incidents.

controls.name: PR.AC-3 - Remote Access
controls.title: Remote Access
controls.body: Remote access is managed

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.B.8 - Access Control for Privileged Utility Programs
controls.title: Access Control for Privileged Utility Programs
controls.body: Programs that can override system, object, network, virtual machine, and application controls are restricted. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 41)

controls.name: HB - Law Enforcement Delay (R)
controls.title: Law Enforcement Delay (R)
controls.body: Communication from law enforcement officials regarding delay of breach notification is retained and documented by the organization (in case of oral communication), including the identity of the official making the statement. Breach notifications are delayed for the period as specified by the official.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.Int.2 - Threat Intelligence Program Review
controls.title: Threat Intelligence Program Review
controls.body: The independent audit function validates that the institution’s threat intelligence and collaboration are commensurate with the institution’s risk and complexity.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.1 - Principles of Least Privilege
controls.title: Principles of Least Privilege
controls.body: Employee access is granted to systems and confidential data based on job responsibilities and the principles of least privilege. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 19)

controls.name: PE-3(3) - Physical Access Control | Continuous Guards
controls.title: Physical Access Control | Continuous Guards
controls.body: Employ guards to control [Assignment: organization-defined physical access points] to the facility where the system resides 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

controls.name: M43.27 - Reports aus Protokolldaten erstellen
controls.title: Reports aus Protokolldaten erstellen
controls.body: Reports aus Protokolldaten erstellen

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.Int.3 - Cyber Risk Appetite Review
controls.title: Cyber Risk Appetite Review
controls.body: The independent audit function regularly reviews management’s cyber risk appetite statement.

controls.name: PCI 2.2.3 - Configuration of Additional Security Features
controls.title: Configuration of Additional Security Features
controls.body: Implement additional security features for any required services, protocols, or daemons that are considered to be insecure.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.2 - Separation of Duties
controls.title: Separation of Duties
controls.body: Employee access to systems and confidential data provides for separation of duties. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 19)

controls.name: IM2 - Data Breach Notifications
controls.title: Data Breach Notifications
controls.body: Notifications regarding confirmed data breaches are provided to affected data subjects, regulators, and other parties (as applicable) within an acceptable timeframe to meet the organization's privacy and confidentiality commitments.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.3 - Restriction of Privileged Access Rights
controls.title: Restriction of Privileged Access Rights
controls.body: Elevated privileges (e.g., administrator privileges) are limited and tightly controlled (e.g., assigned to individuals, not shared, and require stronger password controls). (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 19)

controls.name: M42.37 - Manipulationsschutz der Dokumentation
controls.title: Manipulationsschutz der Dokumentation
controls.body: Manipulationsschutz der Dokumentation

controls.name: Clause 9.1 - Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation
controls.title: Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation

controls.name: SO9 - Log Management Process and Access to Logs
controls.title: Log Management Process and Access to Logs
controls.body: A log management process has been formalized to make sure that access to change the log configuration and access to modify logs is restricted.

controls.name: A.8.3.2 - Disposal of Media
controls.title: Disposal of Media
controls.body: Media shall be disposed of securely when no longer required, using formal procedures.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.Int.4 - Review of Security Capabilities
controls.title: Review of Security Capabilities
controls.body: Independent audits or reviews are used to identify gaps in existing security capabilities and expertise.

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.Int.1 - Incorporation of Lessons Learned in Awareness Training
controls.title: Incorporation of Lessons Learned in Awareness Training
controls.body: Management incorporates lessons learned from social engineering and phishing exercises to improve employee awareness programs.

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.Int.2 - Client Cybersecurity Awareness
controls.title: Client Cybersecurity Awareness
controls.body: Cybersecurity awareness information is provided to retail customers and commercial clients at least annually.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.10 - Segregation of Environments
controls.title: Segregation of Environments
controls.body: Production and non-production environments are segregated to prevent unauthorized access or changes to information assets. (*N/A if no production environment exists at the institution or the institution’s third party.) (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 64)

controls.name: PE6 - Physical Security Controls
controls.title: Physical Security Controls
controls.body: Physical security controls are implemented to secure organization offices, rooms and facilities from unauthorized access.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.13 - Encryption of Data Across Untrusted Networks
controls.title: Encryption of Data Across Untrusted Networks
controls.body: Confidential data are encrypted when transmitted across public or untrusted networks (e.g., the Internet). (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 51)

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.Int.3 - Business Unit-Specific Cybersecurity Training
controls.title: Business Unit-Specific Cybersecurity Training
controls.body: Business units are provided cybersecurity training relevant to their particular business risks, over and above what is required of the institution as a whole.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.18 - Data Disposal Process
controls.title: Data Disposal Process
controls.body: Data is disposed of or destroyed according to documented requirements and within expected time frames. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 66)

controls.name: AC-17(1) - Remote Access | Monitoring and Control
controls.title: Remote Access | Monitoring and Control
controls.body: Employ automated mechanisms to monitor and control remote access methods.

controls.name: IA-4(9) - Identifier Management | Attribute Maintenance and Protection
controls.title: Identifier Management | Attribute Maintenance and Protection
controls.body: Maintain the attributes for each uniquely identified individual, device, or service in [Assignment: organization-defined protected central storage].

controls.name: D1.R.St.B.1 - Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Information security roles and responsibilities have been identified. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 7)

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.Int.4 - Encrypted Wireless Networks
controls.title: Encrypted Wireless Networks
controls.body: Wireless networks use strong encryption with encryption keys that are changed frequently. (*N/A if there are no wireless networks.)

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.Int.6 - Prevention of Unauthorized Code Execution
controls.title: Prevention of Unauthorized Code Execution
controls.body: Technical measures are in place to prevent the execution of unauthorized code on institution owned or managed devices, network infrastructure, and systems components.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.Int.1 - Data Loss Prevention Tools
controls.title: Data Loss Prevention Tools
controls.body: The institution has implemented tools to prevent unauthorized access to or exfiltration of confidential data.

controls.name: PCI 11.5.1 - Change Detection Process
controls.title: Change Detection Process
controls.body: Implement a process to respond to any alerts generated by the change- detection solution.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.Int.4 - Physical and Logical Access Revocation
controls.title: Physical and Logical Access Revocation
controls.body: All physical and logical access is removed immediately upon notification of involuntary termination and within 24 hours of an employee’s voluntary departure.

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.E.5 - Effectiveness of Cybersecurity Training
controls.title: Effectiveness of Cybersecurity Training
controls.body: The institution validates the effectiveness of training (e.g., social engineering or phishing tests).

controls.name: D1.R.S.B.2 - Additional Security Expertise
controls.title: Additional Security Expertise
controls.body: Processes are in place to identify additional expertise needed to improve information security defenses. (FFIEC Information Security Work Program, Objective I: 2-8)

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.E.4 - Cybersecurity Incident Expenses
controls.title: Cybersecurity Incident Expenses
controls.body: There is a process to formally discuss and estimate potential expenses associated with cybersecurity incidents as part of the budgeting process

controls.name: D1.G.IT.E.1 - Asset Inventory Update
controls.title: Asset Inventory Update
controls.body: The asset inventory, including identification of critical assets, is updated at least annually to address new, relocated, re-purposed, and sunset assets.

controls.name: PCI 11.2.2 - Quarterly External Vulnerability Scans
controls.title: Quarterly External Vulnerability Scans
controls.body:
Perform quarterly external vulnerability scans, via an Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV) approved by the Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council (PCI SSC). Perform rescans as needed, until passing scans are achieved.

Note: Quarterly external vulnerability scans must be performed by an Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV), approved by the Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council (PCI SSC).Refer to the ASV Program Guide published on the PCI SSC website for scan customer responsibilities, scan preparation, etc.

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.Int.3 - Security Posture Benchmarks
controls.title: Security Posture Benchmarks
controls.body: Benchmarks or target performance metrics have been established for showing improvements or regressions of the security posture over time.

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.E.1 - Risk Management Program
controls.title: Risk Management Program
controls.body: The risk management program incorporates cyber risk identification, measurement, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting.

controls.name: D1.G.IT.E.2 - Asset Life Cycle Process
controls.title: Asset Life Cycle Process
controls.body: The institution has a documented asset life-cycle process that considers whether assets to be acquired have appropriate security safeguards.

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.E.2 - Management Review of Audit Results
controls.title: Management Review of Audit Results
controls.body: Management reviews and uses the results of audits to improve existing cybersecurity policies, procedures, and controls.

controls.name: D1.RM.RA.E.2 - Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment
controls.title: Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment
controls.body: The focus of the risk assessment has expanded beyond customer information to address all information assets.

controls.name: HS - Antivirus Software (A)
controls.title: Antivirus Software (A)
controls.body: Antivirus software is installed on systems containing ePHI to prevent or detect the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software, and it is configured to force updates when available.

controls.name: D3.PC.De.Int.1 - Data Loss Prevention - Communications
controls.title: Data Loss Prevention - Communications
controls.body: Data loss prevention controls or devices are implemented for inbound and outbound communications (e.g., e-mail, FTP, Telnet, prevention of large file transfers).

controls.name: D1.RM.RA.E.3 - Risk Assessment of EOL Technology
controls.title: Risk Assessment of EOL Technology
controls.body: The risk assessment considers the risk of using EOL software and hardware components.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.Int.8 - Budgeting for Additional Cybersecurity Resources
controls.title: Budgeting for Additional Cybersecurity Resources
controls.body: The budget process for requesting additional cybersecurity staff and tools is integrated into business units’ budget processes.

controls.name: M80.17 - Planung innerbetrieblicher Datenschutz-Schulungen
controls.title: Planung innerbetrieblicher Datenschutz-Schulungen
controls.body: Planung innerbetrieblicher Datenschutz-Schulungen

controls.name: HS - Physical Access Review (A)
controls.title: Physical Access Review (A)
controls.body: Physical access to facilities housing systems with ePHI is reviewed by an authorized management representative on a quarterly basis.

controls.name: D3.PC.De.Int.2 - Mobile Device Management - Integrity Scanning
controls.title: Mobile Device Management - Integrity Scanning
controls.body: Mobile device management includes integrity scanning (e.g., jailbreak/rooted detection). (*N/A if mobile devices are not used.)

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.E.2 - Audit of Threat Information Sharing
controls.title: Audit of Threat Information Sharing
controls.body: The independent audit function validates that the institution’s threat information sharing is commensurate with the institution’s risk and complexity.

controls.name: HS - Documentation of Repairs and Modifications (A)
controls.title: Documentation of Repairs and Modifications (A)
controls.body: The organization maintains documentation of repairs and modifications (i.e. maintenance record) to the facility's physical components related to security.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.E.3 - Audit of Cybersecurity Controls
controls.title: Audit of Cybersecurity Controls
controls.body: The independent audit function validates that the institution’s cybersecurity controls function is commensurate with the institution’s risk and complexity.

controls.name: HS - Data Disposal Policy (R)
controls.title: Data Disposal Policy (R)
controls.body: Data disposal policy is in place to guide secure disposal of ePHI or media containing ePHI, including guidelines on media sanitization before re-use.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.E.4 - Audit of Third-Party Relationship Management
controls.title: Audit of Third-Party Relationship Management
controls.body: The independent audit function validates that the institution’s third-party relationship management is commensurate with the institution’s risk and complexity.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.E.5 - Audit of Incident Response Program and Resilience
controls.title: Audit of Incident Response Program and Resilience
controls.body: The independent audit function validates that the institution’s incident response program and resilience are commensurate with the institution’s risk and complexity.

controls.name: DS2 - Masking Production Data
controls.title: Masking Production Data
controls.body: Production data is masked or anonymized when used outside of the production environment.

controls.name: PE-3(5) - Physical Access Control | Tamper Protection
controls.title: Physical Access Control | Tamper Protection
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined anti-tamper technologies] to [Selection (one or more): detect; prevent] physical tampering or alteration of [Assignment: organization-defined hardware components] within the system.

controls.name: D3.PC.De.B.1 - Removable Media Management
controls.title: Removable Media Management
controls.body: Controls are in place to restrict the use of removable media to authorized personnel. (FFIEC Information Security Work Program, Objective I: 4-1)

controls.name: SO1 - Antivirus Software - Production Servers
controls.title: Antivirus Software - Production Servers
controls.body: Antivirus software is in place to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.A.5 - Identifying Root Cause(s) of Cyber Attacks
controls.title: Identifying Root Cause(s) of Cyber Attacks
controls.body: Management identifies root cause(s) when cyber attacks result in material loss.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.A.4 - Role in Critical Infrastructure - Risk Appetite
controls.title: Role in Critical Infrastructure - Risk Appetite
controls.body: The risk appetite is informed by the institution’s role in critical infrastructure.

controls.name: PE-3(7) - Physical Access Control | Physical Barriers
controls.title: Physical Access Control | Physical Barriers
controls.body: Limit access using physical barriers.

controls.name: MDM.30 - Administration des MDM
controls.title: Administration des MDM
controls.body: Das MDM muss von geschulten Administratoren bedient werden.

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.E.1 - Continuous Cybersecurity Training
controls.title: Continuous Cybersecurity Training
controls.body: The institution has a program for continuing cybersecurity training and skill development for cybersecurity staff.

controls.name: HP - Personal Representatives (R)
controls.title: Personal Representatives (R)
controls.body: Formal procedures to accept or deny a personal representative's appointment on an individual's behalf with respect to their protected health information are established and implemented.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.Int.1 - Update of Audit Function - Risk Profile Changes
controls.title: Update of Audit Function - Risk Profile Changes
controls.body: A formal process is in place for the independent audit function to update its procedures based on changes to the institution’s inherent risk profile.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.B.4 - Antivirus and Anti-Malware Tools
controls.title: Antivirus and Anti-Malware Tools
controls.body: Up to date antivirus and anti-malware tools are used. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 78)

controls.name: SI-21 - Information Refresh
controls.title: Information Refresh
controls.body: Refresh [Assignment: organization-defined information] at [Assignment: organization-defined frequencies] or generate the information on demand and delete the information when no longer needed.

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.E.2 - Cybersecurity Training for Management
controls.title: Cybersecurity Training for Management
controls.body: Management is provided cybersecurity training relevant to their job responsibilities.

controls.name: PCI 6.7 - Procedures for Software Development
controls.title: Procedures for Software Development
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for developing and maintaining secure systems and applications are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: D1.G.IT.B.3 - Maintenance of Asset Inventory
controls.title: Maintenance of Asset Inventory
controls.body: Management assigns accountability for maintaining an inventory of organizational assets. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 9)

controls.name: PE4 - Physical Access Authorization to Office
controls.title: Physical Access Authorization to Office
controls.body: Physical access to the office premises requires formal authorization from management prior to access being provisioned.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.A.1 - Cybersecurity Strategy In Future Plans
controls.title: Cybersecurity Strategy In Future Plans
controls.body: The cybersecurity strategy outlines the institution’s future state of cybersecurity with short-term and long-term perspectives.

controls.name: PCI 12.6.1 - Annual Security Awareness Program
controls.title: Annual Security Awareness Program
controls.body:
Educate personnel upon hire and at least annually.

Note:Methods can vary depending on the role of the personnel and their level of access to the cardholder data.

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.E.3 - Cybersecurity Training for Privileged Roles
controls.title: Cybersecurity Training for Privileged Roles
controls.body: Employees with privileged account permissions receive additional cybersecurity training commensurate with their levels of responsibility.

controls.name: A1.1.2 - Capacity Management
controls.title: A1.1.2 - Capacity Management
controls.body: Future processing demand is forecasted and compared to scheduled capacity on an ongoing basis. Forecasts are reviewed and approved by IT during the periodic IT status meetings.

controls.name: PCI 12.10.2 - Review and Test of the Incident Response Plan
controls.title: Review and Test of the Incident Response Plan
controls.body: Review and test the plan, including all elements listed in Requirement 12.10.1, at least annually.

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.A.3 - Escalation of Discrepancies in Risk Assessment
controls.title: Escalation of Discrepancies in Risk Assessment
controls.body: Independent risk management staff escalates to management and the board or an appropriate board committee significant discrepancies from business unit’s assessments of cyber-related risk.

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.E.4 - Cybersecurity Training for Business Units
controls.title: Cybersecurity Training for Business Units
controls.body: Business units are provided cybersecurity training relevant to their particular business risks.

controls.name: D1.G.IT.E.3 - Asset Replacement Strategy
controls.title: Asset Replacement Strategy
controls.body: The institution proactively manages system EOL (e.g., replacement) to limit security risks.

controls.name: HS - Policies and Procedures at Health Care Clearinghouse (R)
controls.title: Policies and Procedures at Health Care Clearinghouse (R)
controls.body: On an annual basis, the Organization obtains and reviews policies and procedures implemented by the health care clearinghouse to protect ePHI from unauthorized access by the larger organization.

controls.name: D1.TC.Cu.E.3 - Incident Identification and Escalation Procedure
controls.title: Incident Identification and Escalation Procedure
controls.body: Employees have a clear understanding of how to identify and escalate potential cybersecurity issues

controls.name: D1.G.IT.A.4 - Change Management - Risk Assessment Threshold
controls.title: Change Management - Risk Assessment Threshold
controls.body: The change management system uses thresholds to determine when a risk assessment of the impact of the change is required.

controls.name: HS - Separation between Plan Sponsor and Group Health Plan (R)
controls.title: Separation between Plan Sponsor and Group Health Plan (R)
controls.body: Provisions related to adequate separation between the plan sponsor and group health plan (including those authorized to access ePHI based on business need) are formally documented in the plan documents.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.E.2 - Threat Analysis Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Threat Analysis Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: The threat information and analysis process is assigned to a specific group or individual.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.E.1 - Threat Information Monitoring Process
controls.title: Threat Information Monitoring Process
controls.body: A process is implemented to monitor threat information to discover emerging threats.

controls.name: D1.TC.Cu.Int.3 - Discussion of Cyber Risk Report
controls.title: Discussion of Cyber Risk Report
controls.body: Cyber risk reporting is presented and discussed at the independent risk management meetings.

controls.name: NCD.2.3.02.a.1 - Sicherheitsnachweise prüfen
controls.title: Sicherheitsnachweise prüfen
controls.body: Diese DÜRFEN über den Nutzungszeitraum KEINE zeitlichen Lücken enthalten.

controls.name: D2.TI.Ti.A.2 - Automatic Retrieval of Threat Intelligence
controls.title: Automatic Retrieval of Threat Intelligence
controls.body: Threat intelligence is automatically received from multiple sources in real time.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.E.5 - Segregation of Guest Wireless Networks
controls.title: Segregation of Guest Wireless Networks
controls.body: Guest wireless networks are fully segregated from the internal network(s). (*N/A if there are no wireless networks.)

controls.name: HR2 - Job Descriptions
controls.title: Job Descriptions
controls.body: Job descriptions that document the objectives of the role, responsibilities, reporting lines, employee qualifications and other requirements are made available to the employees. Job descriptions are reviewed and updated annually or in case of significant changes.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.Int.4 - Cyber Threat Summaries
controls.title: Cyber Threat Summaries
controls.body: Threat intelligence is analyzed to develop cyber threat summaries including risks to the institution and specific actions for the institution to consider.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.E.3 - Security Operations Center (SOC)
controls.title: Security Operations Center (SOC)
controls.body: Security processes and technology are centralized and coordinated in a Security Operations Center (SOC) or equivalent.

controls.name: D2.IS.Is.E.2 - Participation in Law Enforcement Meetings
controls.title: Participation in Law Enforcement Meetings
controls.body: A representative from the institution participates in law enforcement or information-sharing organization meetings.
