controls.name: PE-4 - Access Control for Transmission
controls.title: Access Control for Transmission
controls.body: Control physical access to [Assignment: organization-defined system distribution and transmission lines] within organizational facilities using [Assignment: organization-defined security controls].

controls.name: PE2 - Monitoring of Environmental Protections
controls.title: Monitoring of Environmental Protections
controls.body: Operational personnel monitor the status of environmental protection during each shift. Alert mechanisms have been installed to communicate any discrepancies in environmental thresholds.

controls.name: PCI 3.1 - Cardholder Data Storage and Disposal
controls.title: Cardholder Data Storage and Disposal
controls.body:
Keep cardholder data storage to a minimum by implementing data retention and disposal policies, procedures and processes that include at least the following for all cardholder data (CHD) storage:·
- Limiting data storage amount and retention time to that which is required for legal, regulatory, and/or business requirements·
- Specific retention requirements for cardholder data·
- Processes for secure deletion of data when no longer needed·
- A quarterly process for identifying and securely deleting stored cardholder data that exceeds defined retention.

controls.name: HR3 - Organization Chart and Reporting Lines
controls.title: Organization Chart and Reporting Lines
controls.body: Organization has established an organization chart that defines organizational roles, reporting lines, and authorities as it relates to development, quality assurance, and security operations of its services. The organization structure is reviewed and updated in case of significant changes.

controls.name: D2.IS.Is.Int.3 - Information-Sharing with Relevant Authorities
controls.title: Information-Sharing with Relevant Authorities
controls.body: Information is shared proactively with the industry, law enforcement, regulators, and information-sharing forums.

controls.name: D3.PC.De.E.6 - Mobile Device Management - Security Updates
controls.title: Mobile Device Management - Security Updates
controls.body: Mobile devices with access to the institution’s data are centrally managed for antivirus and patch deployment. (*N/A if mobile devices are not used.)

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.E.1 - Firewall Protection for Internet and DMZ Connections
controls.title: Firewall Protection for Internet and DMZ Connections
controls.body: There is a firewall at each Internet connection and between any Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) and internal network(s).

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.Int.3 - Network Perimeter Firewalls
controls.title: Network Perimeter Firewalls
controls.body: Wireless network environments have perimeter firewalls that are implemented and configured to restrict unauthorized traffic. (*N/A if there are no wireless networks.)

controls.name: D3.PC.De.Int.3 - Remote Software Validation for Mobile Devices
controls.title: Remote Software Validation for Mobile Devices
controls.body: Mobile devices connecting to the corporate network for storing and accessing company information allow for remote software version/patch validation. (*N/A if mobile devices are not used.)

controls.name: PCI A3.3.1 - Detection and Alerting of Security Control Failures
controls.title: Detection and Alerting of Security Control Failures
controls.body:
Implement a process to immediately detect and alert on critical security control failures. Examples of critical security controls include, but are not limited to:
- Firewalls
- IDS/IPS
- FIM
- Anti-virus
- Physical access controls
- Logical access controls
- Audit logging mechanisms
- Segmentation controls (if used)
 PCI DSS Reference: Requirements 1-12

controls.name: D1.G.IT.Inn.2 - Blocking Unauthorized Changes to Software and Hardware
controls.title: Blocking Unauthorized Changes to Software and Hardware
controls.body: Comprehensive automated enterprise tools are implemented to detect and block unauthorized changes to software and hardware.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.Int.7 - Data Encryption In-Transit
controls.title: Data Encryption In-Transit
controls.body: Confidential data are encrypted in transit across private connections (e.g., frame relay and T1) and within the institution’s trusted zones.

controls.name: 4.14 - lnformatiebeveiligingscontinuiteit implementeren
controls.title: lnformatiebeveiligingscontinuiteit implementeren
controls.body:
De organisatie behoort processen, procedures en
beheersmaatregelen vast te stellen, te documenteren, te implementeren en te handhaven om het vereis­te niveau van continurteit voor informatiebeveiligingtijdens een ongunstige situatie te waarborgen.

controls.name: PCI 2.2.5 - Removal of Unnecessary Features
controls.title: Removal of Unnecessary Features
controls.body: Remove all unnecessary functionality, such as scripts, drivers, features, subsystems, file systems, and unnecessary web servers.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.E.3 - Masking of Production Data
controls.title: Masking of Production Data
controls.body: Use of customer data in non-production environments complies with legal, regulatory, and internal policy requirements for concealing or removing of sensitive data elements.

controls.name: PCI 3.6.6 - Dual Control for Key Management
controls.title: Dual Control for Key Management
controls.body:
If manual clear-text cryptographic key-management operations are used, these operations must be managed using split knowledge and dual control.


Note: Examples of manual key- management operations include, but are not limited to: key generation, transmission, loading, storage and destruction.

controls.name: PCI 2.4 - Asset Inventory in PCI DSS Scope
controls.title: Asset Inventory in PCI DSS Scope
controls.body: Maintain an inventory of system components that are in scope for PCI DSS.

controls.name: HS - Data Backup and Restoration procedure (R)
controls.title: Data Backup and Restoration procedure (R)
controls.body: Formal procedures that outline the data backup and restoration process are documented. The procedures are reviewed by IT management annually or in case of significant changes.

controls.name: M80.09 - Developing the test processes of the Privacy Management System
controls.title: Developing the test processes of the Privacy Management System
controls.body: Developing the test processes of the Privacy Management System

controls.name: PCI 12.8 - Procedures to Manage Service Providers
controls.title: Procedures to Manage Service Providers
controls.body: Maintain and implement policies and procedures to manage service providers with whom cardholder data is shared, or that could affect the security of cardholder data.

controls.name: A.9.4.5 - Access Control to Program Source Code
controls.title: Access Control to Program Source Code
controls.body: Access to program source code shall be restricted.

controls.name: SO2 - Automatic Capacity and Performance Monitoring
controls.title: Automatic Capacity and Performance Monitoring
controls.body: Infrastructure has been configured to automatically scale the capacity and performance needs of the systems.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.A.4 - Cyber Risks Associated Business Units
controls.title: Cyber Risks Associated Business Units
controls.body: Management and the board or an appropriate board committee hold business units accountable for effectively managing all cyber risks associated with their activities.

controls.name: D3.PC.De.E.3 - Authorization for New Connections
controls.title: Authorization for New Connections
controls.body: The institution has controls to prevent the unauthorized addition of new connections.

controls.name: PCI 10.3.6 - Details of Affected System Components
controls.title: Details of Affected System Components
controls.body: Identity or name of affected data, system component, or resource.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.A.1 - Enterprise-wide Risk Appetite
controls.title: Enterprise-wide Risk Appetite
controls.body: The board or board committee approved cyber risk appetite statement is part of the enterprise-wide risk appetite statement.

controls.name: AC-17(9) - Remote Access | Disconnect or Disable Access
controls.title: Remote Access | Disconnect or Disable Access
controls.body: Provide the capability to disconnect or disable remote access to the system within [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: 4.15 - Beschikbaarheid van informatie verwerkende faciliteiten
controls.title: Beschikbaarheid van informatie verwerkende faciliteiten
controls.body:
lnformatie verwerkende faciliteiten behoren
met voldoende redundantie te warden ge'implementeerd om aan beschikbaarheidseisen te voldoen.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.A.3 - Budget Process for Additional Cybersecurity Resources
controls.title: Budget Process for Additional Cybersecurity Resources
controls.body: The budget process for requesting additional cybersecurity staff and tools maps current resources and tools to the cybersecurity strategy.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.A.3 - Role in Financial Industry
controls.title: Role in Financial Industry
controls.body: The cybersecurity strategy identifies and communicates the institution’s role as a component of critical infrastructure in the financial services industry.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.Inn.1 - Communication of the Institution's Role
controls.title: Communication of the Institution's Role
controls.body: The cybersecurity strategy identifies and communicates the institution’s role as it relates to other critical infrastructures.

controls.name: PCI 9.9.1 - Updated List of Devices
controls.title: Updated List of Devices
controls.body:
Maintain an up-to-date list of devices. 
The list should include the following:
- Make, model of device.
- Location of device (for example, the address of the site or facility where the device is located).
- Device serial number or other method of unique identification.

controls.name: PE-5(2) - Access Control for Output Devices | Link to Individual Identity
controls.title: Access Control for Output Devices | Link to Individual Identity
controls.body: Link individual identity to receipt of output from output devices.

controls.name: A.7.2.2 - Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
controls.title: Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
controls.body: All employees of the organization and, where relevant, contractors shall receive appropriate awareness education and training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.A.5 - Cyber Risk Data Aggregation and Reporting
controls.title: Cyber Risk Data Aggregation and Reporting
controls.body: The cyber risk data aggregation and real-time reporting capabilities support the institution’s ongoing reporting needs, particularly during cyber incidents.

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.A.4 - Financial Impact Analysis
controls.title: Financial Impact Analysis
controls.body: A process is in place to analyze the financial impact cyber incidents have on the institution’s capital.

controls.name: D1.RM.RA.Inn.3 - Predictive Analytics
controls.title: Predictive Analytics
controls.body: Advanced or automated analytics offer predictive information and real-time risk metrics.

controls.name: PCI 9.3 - Physical Access control to Sensitive Areas
controls.title: Physical Access control to Sensitive Areas
controls.body:
Control physical access for onsite personnel to sensitive areas as follows:
Access must be authorized and based on individual job function.
Access is revoked immediately upon termination, and all physical access mechanisms, such as keys, access cards, etc., are returned or disabled.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.A.2 - Review of Cyber Risk Appetite Statement
controls.title: Review of Cyber Risk Appetite Statement
controls.body: The independent audit function regularly reviews the institution’s cyber risk appetite statement in comparison to assessment results and incorporates gaps into the audit strategy.

controls.name: D1.R.S.A.1 - Cybersecurity Staffing Benchmarks
controls.title: Cybersecurity Staffing Benchmarks
controls.body: The institution benchmarks its cybersecurity staffing against peers to identify whether its recruitment, retention, and succession planning are commensurate.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.E.1 - Audit of Risk Management Function
controls.title: Audit of Risk Management Function
controls.body: The independent audit function validates that the risk management function is commensurate with the institution’s risk and complexity.

controls.name: D1.R.S.A.2 - Cyber Defence Strategy Development
controls.title: Cyber Defence Strategy Development
controls.body: Dedicated cybersecurity staff develops, or contributes to developing, integrated enterprise-level security and cyber defense strategies.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.A.3 - Threat Prediction
controls.title: Threat Prediction
controls.body: Emerging internal and external threat intelligence and correlated log analysis are used to predict future attacks.

controls.name: PCI A3.2.6.1 - Response Procedures Initiated upon Detection to Remove Clear-text PAN
controls.title: Response Procedures Initiated upon Detection to Remove Clear-text PAN
controls.body:
Implement response procedures to be initiated upon the detection of attempts to remove clear-text PAN from the CDE via an unauthorized channel, method, or process. Response procedures must include:
- Procedures for the timely investigation of alerts by responsible personnel
- Procedures for remediating data leaks or process gaps, as necessary, to prevent any data loss

controls.name: D2.IS.Is.A.1 - Threat Intelligence Communication
controls.title: Threat Intelligence Communication
controls.body: Management communicates threat intelligence with business risk context and specific risk management recommendations to the business units.

controls.name: 4.4 - Beheersmaatregelen tegen malware
controls.title: Beheersmaatregelen tegen malware
controls.body:
Er zijn geschikte procedures ingevoerd om het bewustzijn van de
gebruikers te vergroten ten aanzien van het gevaar van virussen en dergelijke.

controls.name: 4.5 - Back-up van informatie
controls.title: Back-up van informatie
controls.body: Regelmatig behoren back-upkopieen van informatie, software en systeemaf­beeldingen te warden gemaakt.

controls.name: 4.6 - Back-up van informatie
controls.title: Back-up van informatie
controls.body: Gemaakte back ups warden regelmatig getest conform het back-up beleid.

controls.name: PR.AC-6 - User Access Review
controls.title: User Access Review
controls.body: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials and asserted in interactions

controls.name: D2.TI.Ti.A.1 - Cyber Intelligence Model
controls.title: Cyber Intelligence Model
controls.body: A cyber intelligence model is used for gathering threat information.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.A.3 - Anti-Spoofing Measures
controls.title: Anti-Spoofing Measures
controls.body: Anti-spoofing measures are in place to detect and block forged source IP addresses from entering the network.

controls.name: D2.TI.Ti.A.3 - Geopolitical Threat Intelligence
controls.title: Geopolitical Threat Intelligence
controls.body: The institution’s threat intelligence includes information related to geopolitical events that could increase cybersecurity threat levels.

controls.name: D2.TI.Ti.Inn.2 - Investment in Threat Intelligence Development
controls.title: Investment in Threat Intelligence Development
controls.body: The institution is investing in the development of new threat intelligence and collaboration mechanisms (e.g., technologies, business processes) that will transform how information is gathered and shared.

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.Inn.2 - Secure Storage of Unstructured Confidential Data
controls.title: Secure Storage of Unstructured Confidential Data
controls.body: Unstructured confidential data are tracked and secured through an identity-aware, a cross-platform storage system that protects against internal threats, monitors user access, and tracks changes.

controls.name: PCI 9.4.4 - Visitors Log Access
controls.title: Visitors Log Access
controls.body:
A visitor log is used to maintain a physical audit trail of visitor activity to the facility as well as computer rooms and data centers where cardholder data is stored or transmitted. 
- Document the visitor’s name, the firm represented, and the onsite personnel authorizing physical access on the log. 
- Retain this log for a minimum of three months, unless otherwise restricted by law.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.A.5 - Threat Intelligence - Update Configuration Standards
controls.title: Threat Intelligence - Update Configuration Standards
controls.body: Threat intelligence is used to update architecture and configuration standards.

controls.name: D2.IS.Is.A.2 - Threat Intelligence Sharing with Peer Institutions
controls.title: Threat Intelligence Sharing with Peer Institutions
controls.body: Relationships exist with employees of peer institutions for sharing cyber threat intelligence.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.A.1 - Cyber Threat Identification and Analysis Team
controls.title: Cyber Threat Identification and Analysis Team
controls.body: A dedicated cyber threat identification and analysis committee or team exists to centralize and coordinate initiatives and communications.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.Inn.1 - Prediction of Future Attacks
controls.title: Prediction of Future Attacks
controls.body: The institution uses multiple sources of intelligence, correlated log analysis, alerts, internal traffic flows, and geopolitical events to predict potential future attacks and attack trends.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.Inn.2 - Scenario-Based Threat Prediction
controls.title: Scenario-Based Threat Prediction
controls.body: Highest risk scenarios are used to predict threats against specific business targets.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.Inn.3 - Identification of Control Gaps
controls.title: Identification of Control Gaps
controls.body: The institution proactively seeks to identify control gaps that may be used as part of a zero-day attack.

controls.name: D2.IS.Is.Inn.1 - Threat Intelligence Sharing with Business Units
controls.title: Threat Intelligence Sharing with Business Units
controls.body: A mechanism is in place for sharing cyber threat intelligence with business units in real time including the potential financial and operational impact of inaction.

controls.name: D2.MA.Ma.Inn.3 - Detection of Configuration Weaknesses
controls.title: Detection of Configuration Weaknesses
controls.body: IT systems automatically detect configuration weaknesses based on threat intelligence and alert management so actions can be prioritized.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.Inn.4 - Rotation of Public-Facing Servers
controls.title: Rotation of Public-Facing Servers
controls.body: Public-facing servers are routinely rotated and restored to a known clean state to limit the window of time a system is exposed to potential threats.

controls.name: Clause 7.4 - Communication
controls.title: Communication

controls.name: HP - Prohibition on Conditioning of Authorizations (R)
controls.title: Prohibition on Conditioning of Authorizations (R)
controls.body: Guidelines for the prohibition on the conditioning of authorizations are formally developed by the organization. Any exceptions are documented, tracked, and handled according to the requirement 45 CFR §164.508(b)(4).

controls.name: HP - Revocation of Authorizations (R)
controls.title: Revocation of Authorizations (R)
controls.body: Revocation requests received from individuals regarding authorizations on uses or disclosures of PHI are recorded, monitored and adhered to except when authorization was obtained as a condition of obtaining insurance coverage, which is handled in accordance with the insurance policy.

controls.name: PE1 - Environmental Protections
controls.title: Environmental Protections
controls.body:
Environmental protections have been installed including the following and receive maintenance on at least an annual basis.
- Cooling systems
- UPS
- Redundant communication lines
- Smoke detectors and sprinklers

controls.name: WS2 - Workstation Disk Encryption and Passwords
controls.title: Workstation Disk Encryption and Passwords
controls.body: Disk encryption and system passwords are enabled across all organization workstations.

controls.name: PCI 10.4.1 - Time Synchronization for Critical Systems
controls.title: Time Synchronization for Critical Systems
controls.body: Critical systems have the correct and consistent time.

controls.name: PR.AC-7 - User Authentication
controls.title: User Authentication
controls.body: Users, devices, and other assets are authenticated (e.g., single-factor, multi-factor) commensurate with the risk of the transaction (e.g., individuals' security and privacy risks and other organizational risks)

controls.name: CC6.1.2 - Password Requirements
controls.title: CC6.1.2 - Password Requirements
controls.body: Corporate networks, systems, and applications enforce password complexity requirements, session timeouts, and account lockouts in accordance with the Company Password Policy.

controls.name: A.18.2.1 - Independent Review of Information Security
controls.title: Independent Review of Information Security
controls.body:
The organization’s approach to managing information security and its implementation (i.e. control objectives, controls, policies, processes and procedures for information security) shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes
occur.

controls.name: PCI 12.3 - Usage Policies
controls.title: Usage Policies
controls.body:
Develop usage policies for critical technologies and define proper use of these technologies.

Note: Examples of critical technologies include, but are not limited to, remote access and wireless technologies, laptops, tablets, removable electronic media, e-mail usage and Internet usage.

controls.name: A.9.2.6 - Removal or Adjustment of Access Rights
controls.title: Removal or Adjustment of Access Rights
controls.body: The access rights of all employees and external party users to information and information processing facilities shall be removed upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement, or adjusted upon change.

controls.name: PR.AT-2 - Users Roles and Responsibilities with Privileged access
controls.title: Users Roles and Responsibilities with Privileged access
controls.body: Privileged users understand their roles and responsibilities

controls.name: PCI 9.6 - Restriction of Media Distribution
controls.title: Restriction of Media Distribution
controls.body: Maintain strict control over the internal or external distribution of any kind of media.

controls.name: SC-36(2) - Distributed Processing and Storage | Synchronization
controls.title: Distributed Processing and Storage | Synchronization
controls.body: Synchronize the following duplicate systems or system components: [Assignment: organization-defined duplicate systems or system components].

controls.name: 4.7 - Software installeren op operationele systemen
controls.title: Software installeren op operationele systemen
controls.body: Om het op operationele systemen installeren van soft­ware te beheersen behoren procedures te warden ge'implementeerd.

controls.name: PCI 9.8.2 - Render Electronic Media Unrecoverable
controls.title: Render Electronic Media Unrecoverable
controls.body: Render cardholder data on electronic media unrecoverable so that cardholder data cannot be reconstructed.

controls.name: DORA-11-007 CSD Report of Business Continuity Test Results to Competent Authorities
controls.title: DORA-11-007 CSD Report of Business Continuity Test Results to Competent Authorities
controls.body: Central Securities Depository (CSD) shall provide copies of the results of the ICT business continuity tests  to the competent authorities.

controls.name: OM8 - Internal Control Assessment
controls.title: Internal Control Assessment
controls.body: The organization uses OneTrust platform to document their internal controls and continuously monitor its effectiveness. An assessment over the effectiveness and efficiency of the internal controls, processes and policies is reviewed by management on at least an annual basis and identified deficiencies are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: OM6 - Executive Management Reviews
controls.title: Executive Management Reviews
controls.body: The executive team of the organization meets at planned intervals to discuss operations, issues relating to internal controls and delivery on key performance metrics.

controls.name: PCI 10.1 - Audit Trail Implementation
controls.title: Audit Trail Implementation
controls.body: Implement audit trails to link all access to system components to each individual user.

controls.name: 4.9 - Beperkingen voor het installeren van software
controls.title: Beperkingen voor het installeren van software
controls.body: Voor het door gebruikers installeren van software beho­ren regels te warden vastgesteld en te warden ge'implementeerd.

controls.name: D2.TI.Th.Int.1 - Subscription to Threat Intelligence Sources
controls.title: Subscription to Threat Intelligence Sources
controls.body: A formal threat intelligence program is implemented and includes subscription to threat feeds from external providers and internal sources.

controls.name: RM1 - Financial Impact - Insurance Coverage
controls.title: Financial Impact - Insurance Coverage
controls.body: Management maintains insurance coverage through an external service provider against major financial risks for the overall business.

controls.name: OM10 - Review of Customer Contracts/EULA
controls.title: Review of Customer Contracts/EULA
controls.body: New customer contracts or modifications to existing customer contracts and end-user license agreements (EULA) are reviewed annually by Management to ensure security and confidentiality commitments are met.

controls.name: A.6.1.4 - Contact with Special Interest Groups
controls.title: Contact with Special Interest Groups
controls.body: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations shall be maintained.

controls.name: A.6.1.5 - Information Security in Project Management
controls.title: Information Security in Project Management
controls.body: Information security shall be addressed in project management, regardless of the type of project.

controls.name: PCI 9.10 - Policies and Procedures for Physical Access Restriction
controls.title: Policies and Procedures for Physical Access Restriction
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for restricting physical access to cardholder data are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: 5.1 - Beleid voor toegangsbeveiliging
controls.title: Beleid voor toegangsbeveiliging
controls.body:
Een beleid voor toegangsbeveiliging behoort te worden vastgesteld,
gedocumenteerd en beoordeeld op basis van bedrijfs- en informatiebeveiligingseisen.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.1 - User Access Logs
controls.title: User Access Logs
controls.body: All individual user accesses to cardholder data.

controls.name: A.7.1.1 - Screening
controls.title: Screening
controls.body: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out in accordance with relevant laws, regulations and ethics and shall be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

controls.name: A.7.2.3 - Disciplinary Process
controls.title: Disciplinary Process
controls.body: There shall be a formal and communicated disciplinary process in place to take action against employees who have committed an information security breach.

controls.name: A.8.1.3 - Acceptable Use of Assets
controls.title: Acceptable Use of Assets
controls.body: Rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified, documented and implemented.

controls.name: PCI 3.7 - Cardholder Data Protection Policies
controls.title: Cardholder Data Protection Policies
controls.body: Ensure that security policies and operational procedures for protecting stored cardholder data are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.name: AC4 - User Access Reviews
controls.title: User Access Reviews
controls.body: Management performs a quarterly user access review for in-scope system components to ensure that access is restricted appropriately. Access is modified or removed in a timely manner based on the results of the review.

controls.name: 5.10 - Sleutelbeheer
controls.title: Sleutelbeheer
controls.body:
Met betrekking tot het gebruik, de bescherming en de levensduur van cryptografische
sleutels behoort tijdens hun gehele levenscyclus een beleid te worden ontwikkeld.

controls.name: 5.11 - Sleutelbeheer
controls.title: Sleutelbeheer
controls.body: Er wordt gebruik gemaakt van tools om cryptografische sleutels tijdens hun gehele le­venscyclus adequaat te beheren.

controls.name: A.8.2.1 - Classification of Information
controls.title: Classification of Information
controls.body: Information shall be classified in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification.

controls.name: A.17.2.1 - Availability of Information Processing Facilities
controls.title: Availability of Information Processing Facilities
controls.body: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

controls.name: PE-6(1) - Monitoring Physical Access | Intrusion Alarms and Surveillance Equipment
controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access | Intrusion Alarms and Surveillance Equipment
controls.body: Monitor physical access to the facility where the system resides using physical intrusion alarms and surveillance equipment.

controls.name: 10.1 - Identifying Risk
controls.title: Identifying Risk
controls.body: See Guidance for details

controls.name: A.9.1.1 - Access Control Policy
controls.title: Access Control Policy
controls.body: An access control policy shall be established, documented and reviewed based on business and information security requirements.

controls.name: A.18.1.1 - Identification of Applicable Legislation and Contractual Requirements
controls.title: Identification of Applicable Legislation and Contractual Requirements
controls.body: All relevant legislative statutory, regulatory, contractual requirements and the organization’s approach to meet these requirements shall be explicitly identified, documented and kept up to date for each information system and the organization.

controls.name: PE-8(1) - Visitor Access Records | Automated Records Maintenance and Review
controls.title: Visitor Access Records | Automated Records Maintenance and Review
controls.body: Maintain and review visitor access records using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: 11.4 - Assessment Approaches
controls.title: Assessment Approaches
controls.body: See Guidance for details

controls.name: PCI 12.7 - Background Checks
controls.title: Background Checks
controls.body:
Screen potential personnel prior to hire to minimize the risk of attacks from internal sources. (Examples of background checks include previous employment history, criminal record, credit history, and reference checks.)

Note:For those potential personnel to be hired for certain positions such as store cashiers who only have access to one card number at a time when facilitating a transaction, this requirement is a recommendation only.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.3 - Insecure Cryptographic Storage
controls.title: Insecure Cryptographic Storage
controls.body: Insecure cryptographic storage

controls.name: A.11.1.3 - Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
controls.title: Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
controls.body: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and applied.

controls.name: PCI 6.2 - Critical Security Patches
controls.title: Critical Security Patches
controls.body:
Ensure that all system components and software are protected from known vulnerabilities by installing applicable vendor- supplied security patches. Install critical security patches within one month of release.


Note:Critical security patches should be identified according to the risk ranking process defined in Requirement 6.1.

controls.name: SC-45(1) - System Time Synchronization | Synchronization with Authoritative Time Source
controls.title: System Time Synchronization | Synchronization with Authoritative Time Source
controls.body:
a. Compare the internal system clocks [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] with [Assignment: organization-defined authoritative time source]; and
b. Synchronize the internal system clocks to the authoritative time source when the time difference is greater than [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: 5.12 - Beschermen van informatie in logbestanden
controls.title: Beschermen van informatie in logbestanden
controls.body:
Logfaciliteiten en informatie in logbestanden behoren te
worden beschermd tegen vervalsing en onbevoegde toegang.

controls.name: 5.13 - Beheersmaatregelen voor netwerken
controls.title: Beheersmaatregelen voor netwerken
controls.body: Netwerken behoren te worden beheerd en beheerst om informa­tie in systemen en toepassingen te beschermen.

controls.name: M80.10 - Securing resources for the Privacy Management System
controls.title: Securing resources for the Privacy Management System
controls.body: Securing resources for the Privacy Management System

controls.name: ID.AM-3 - Communication and Data Flow Diagram
controls.title: Communication and Data Flow Diagram
controls.body: Organizational communication and data flows are mapped

controls.name: A.14.2.7 - Outsourced Development
controls.title: Outsourced Development
controls.body: The organization shall supervise and monitor the activity of outsourced system development.

controls.name: A.16.1.4 - Assessment of and Decision on Information Security Events
controls.title: Assessment of and Decision on Information Security Events
controls.body: Information security events shall be assessed and it shall be decided if they are to be classified as information security incidents.

controls.name: HP - Sale of PHI (R)
controls.title: Sale of PHI (R)
controls.body: Any sale of protected health information requires a documented authorization from individual permitting the use or disclosure of their protected health information prior to sale.

controls.name: A.13.2.1 - Information Transfer Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Information Transfer Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Formal transfer policies, procedures and controls shall be in place to protect the transfer of information through the use of all types of communication facilities.

controls.name: D1.R.St.E.4 - Background Checks
controls.title: Background Checks
controls.body: Employment candidates, contractors, and third parties are subject to background verification proportional to the confidentiality of the data accessed, business requirements, and acceptable risk.

controls.name: M80.11 - Establishing a concept for data protection
controls.title: Establishing a concept for data protection
controls.body: Establishing a concept for data protection

controls.name: D3.PC.De.E.5 - End-Point Antivirus and Anti-Malware Protection
controls.title: End-Point Antivirus and Anti-Malware Protection
controls.body: Antivirus and anti-malware tools are deployed on end-point devices (e.g., workstations, laptops, and mobile devices).

controls.name: PCI 10.2 - Automated Logs for Audit Trail
controls.title: Automated Logs for Audit Trail
controls.body: Implement automated audit trails for all system components to reconstruct the events in PCI 10.2.1 to PCI 10.2.7.

controls.name: D2.TI.Ti.B.1 - Subscription to Threat Information-Sharing Source
controls.title: Subscription to Threat Information-Sharing Source
controls.body: The institution belongs or subscribes to a threat and vulnerability information sharing source(s) that provides information on threats (e.g., Financial Services Information Sharing and Analysis Center [FS-ISAC], U.S. Computer Emergency Readiness Team [US-CERT]). (FFIEC EBanking Work Program, page 28)

controls.name: PR.AC-4 - Access Permissions and Authorizations
controls.title: Access Permissions and Authorizations
controls.body: Access permissions and authorizations are managed, incorporating the principles of least privilege and separation of duties

controls.name: AC-18(5) - Wireless Access | Antennas and Transmission Power Levels
controls.title: Wireless Access | Antennas and Transmission Power Levels
controls.body: Select radio antennas and calibrate transmission power levels to reduce the probability that signals from wireless access points can be received outside of organization-controlled boundaries.

controls.name: 5.14 - Beveiliging van netwerkdiensten
controls.title: Beveiliging van netwerkdiensten
controls.body:
Beveiligingsmechanismen, dienstverleningsniveaus en beheerseisen voor alle netwerkdiensten behoren te worden geidentificeerd en opgenomen in overeenkomsten betref­fende netwerkdiensten. Dit geldt zowel voor diensten die intern worden geleverd als voor uitbestede
diensten.

controls.name: 5.15 - Scheiding in netwerken
controls.title: Scheiding in netwerken
controls.body: Groepen van informatiediensten, -gebruikers en -systemen behoren in netwer­ken te worden gescheiden.

controls.name: PCI 12.8.2 - Acknowledged Card Security Agreement by Service Providers
controls.title: Acknowledged Card Security Agreement by Service Providers
controls.body:
Maintain a written agreement that includes an acknowledgement that the service providers are responsible for the security of cardholder data the service providers possess or otherwise store, process or transmit on behalf of the customer, or to the extent that they could impact the security of the customer’s cardholder data environment.

Note:The exact wording of an acknowledgement will depend on the agreement between the two parties, the details of the service being provided, and the responsibilities assigned to each party. The acknowledgement does not have to include the exact wording provided in this requirement.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.Int.3 - Cyber Risk Appetite Statement
controls.title: Cyber Risk Appetite Statement
controls.body: The institution has a cyber risk appetite statement approved by the board or an appropriate board committee.

controls.name: HP - Notice of Privacy Practices (R)
controls.title: Notice of Privacy Practices (R)
controls.body: Notice of organization's privacy practices on uses and disclosures of PHI and individuals rights are provided to individuals whenever significant changes are made and at least once every three years.

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.Inn.1 - Effectiveness of Training and Awareness Programs
controls.title: Effectiveness of Training and Awareness Programs
controls.body: Key performance indicators are used to determine whether training and awareness programs positively influence behavior.

controls.name: SS4 - Function Code Scanning
controls.title: Function Code Scanning
controls.body: Code scanning is performed to identify and patch vulnerabilities in the serverless functions. Identified vulnerabilities are remediated in accordance to the patch management process.

controls.name: PCI 12.5.1 - Documentation and Distribution of Security Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Documentation and Distribution of Security Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Establish, document, and distribute security policies and procedures.

controls.name: SC-42(4) - Sensor Capability and Data | Notice of Collection
controls.title: Sensor Capability and Data | Notice of Collection
controls.body: Employ the following measures to facilitate an individual’s awareness that personally identifiable information is being collected by [Assignment: organization-defined sensors]: [Assignment: organization-defined measures].

controls.name: DP10 - Data Subject Identity Verification
controls.title: Data Subject Identity Verification
controls.body: The organization has defined processes in place to authenticate the identity of data subjects before granting them access to their personal information. Any denial of access to personal information and its justification is formally communicated to data subjects.

controls.name: WS3 - Workstation Security Patches
controls.title: Workstation Security Patches
controls.body: A patch management process exists to confirm that operating system level vulnerabilities for workstations are remediated in a timely manner. In addition, workstations are scanned to test patch compliance on a quarterly basis.

controls.name: SS5 - Monitoring of Serverless for Injection and Malicious Attempts
controls.title: Monitoring of Serverless for Injection and Malicious Attempts
controls.body: Serverless functions, which call in external code and third-party libraries, are monitored for attempts at injection and malicious activity.

controls.name: SO6 - Encryption of Data in Transit
controls.title: Encryption of Data in Transit
controls.body: Encryption technologies are used to protect communication and transmission of data over public networks and between systems.

controls.name: PE3 - Physical Access Authorization to Data Center
controls.title: Physical Access Authorization to Data Center
controls.body: Access to data centers and other secure areas requires a formal authorization from IT management prior to access being provisioned.

controls.name: PI4 - Error Detection and Correction
controls.title: Error Detection and Correction
controls.body: Organization has implemented a system to detect errors that occur during processing. An incident management process is invoked for timely resolution of identified issues in accordance with the system commitments.

controls.name: HS - Physical Access Authorization (A)
controls.title: Physical Access Authorization (A)
controls.body: Physical access to facilities housing systems with ePHI requires formal authorization from designated management personnel prior to granting access to facilities.

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.Int.4 - Updating of Cybersecurity Training Program
controls.title: Updating of Cybersecurity Training Program
controls.body: The institution routinely updates its training to security staff to adapt to new threats.

controls.name: HP - PHI of Deceased Individuals (R)
controls.title: PHI of Deceased Individuals (R)
controls.body: The organization has developed a process to retain the PHI of deceased individuals for a period of 50 years following their death.

controls.name: D1.RM.RMP.Int.2 - Risk Impact Assessment
controls.title: Risk Impact Assessment
controls.body: The risk management program specifically addresses cyber risks beyond the boundaries of the technological impacts (e.g., financial, strategic, regulatory, compliance).

controls.name: HP - Disclosure of PHI to Individual's Representative (R)
controls.title: Disclosure of PHI to Individual's Representative (R)
controls.body: Disclosure of an individual's PHI to a representative is permitted based on the individual's agreement and the opportunity to object or agree on disclosure except during emergency circumstances. The organization maintains documentation of such disclosures.

controls.name: HS - Media Handling Policy (R)
controls.title: Media Handling Policy (R)
controls.body: A media handling policy and procedure have been established and implemented that governs any media movement containing ePHI into or out of the facility.

controls.name: A.15.2.2 - Managing Changes to Supplier Services
controls.title: Managing Changes to Supplier Services
controls.body:
Changes to the provision of services by suppliers, including maintaining and improving existing information security policies, procedures and controls, shall be managed, taking account of the
criticality of business information, systems and processes involved and re-assessment of risks.

controls.name: HP - Retention of Authorizations (R)
controls.title: Retention of Authorizations (R)
controls.body: Formal data retention and disposal procedures are in place to guide the secure retention and disposal of PHI. Documentation, as required by HIPAA regulation, are maintained and retained for at least six years from the date of its creation or the date when it was last in effect, whichever is later.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.6 - High Risk Vulnerabilities
controls.title: High Risk Vulnerabilities
controls.body: All “high risk” vulnerabilities identified in the vulnerability identification process (as defined in PCI DSS Requirement 6.1).

controls.name: PCI 6.3.2 - Review of Custom Code Prior to Release
controls.title: Review of Custom Code Prior to Release
controls.body:
Review custom code prior to release to production or customers in order to identify any potential coding vulnerability (using either manual or automated processes) to include at least the following:·
- Code changes are reviewed by individuals other than the originating code author, and by individuals knowledgeable about code-review techniques and secure coding practices.·
- Code reviews ensure code is developed according to secure coding guidelines·
- Appropriate corrections are implemented prior to release.·

Code-review results are reviewed and approved by management prior to release. 

Note: This requirement for code reviews applies to all custom code (both internal and public-facing), as part of the system development life cycle.
Code reviews can be conducted by knowledgeable internal personnel or third parties. Public-facing web applications are also subject to additional controls, to address ongoing threats and vulnerabilities after implementation, as defined at PCI DSS Requirement 6.6.

controls.name: M80.13 - Clarifying partial responsibilities
controls.title: Clarifying partial responsibilities
controls.body: Clarifying partial responsibilities

controls.name: HS - Unique IDs and Strong Passwords (R)
controls.title: Unique IDs and Strong Passwords (R)
controls.body: Unique user IDs and strong passwords are required in order to gain access to systems containing ePHI.

controls.name: HS - Disposal of Paper Records (A)
controls.title: Disposal of Paper Records (A)
controls.body: Paper records containing PHI are disposed of in accordance with the data disposal policy. Secure storage containers are used for materials that are to be destroyed.

controls.name: A.8.1.1 - Inventory of Assets
controls.title: Inventory of Assets
controls.body: Information, other assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up and maintained.

controls.name: D1.R.S.Int.1 - Cybersecurity Talent
controls.title: Cybersecurity Talent
controls.body: The institution has a program for talent recruitment, retention, and succession planning for the cybersecurity and resilience staffs.

controls.name: A.9.2.5 - Review of User Access Rights
controls.title: Review of User Access Rights
controls.body: Asset owners shall review users’ access rights at regular intervals.

controls.name: HP - Uses and Disclosures for Research Purposes (R)
controls.title: Uses and Disclosures for Research Purposes (R)
controls.body: The organization has procedures in place relating to the use and disclosure of PHI for research purposes. The organization retains documentation of such disclosures.

controls.name: DS4 - Data Retention and Disposal Policy and Procedure
controls.title: Data Retention and Disposal Policy and Procedure
controls.body: Formal data retention and disposal policy and procedure are in place to guide the secure retention and disposal of information.

controls.name: PE-8 - Visitor Access Records
controls.title: Visitor Access Records

controls.name: PCI 6.2.3 - Code Review
controls.title: Code Review
controls.body:
Bespoke and custom software is reviewed prior to being released into production or to customers, to identify and correct potential coding vulnerabilities, as follows:
- Code reviews ensure code is developed according to secure coding guidelines.
- Code reviews look for both existing and emerging software vulnerabilities.
- Appropriate corrections are implemented prior to release.

controls.name: A.18.1.2 - Intellectual Property Rights
controls.title: Intellectual Property Rights
controls.body: Appropriate procedures shall be implemented to ensure compliance with legislative, regulatory and contractual requirements related to intellectual property rights and use of proprietary software products.

controls.name: HS - Review of Access to ePHI (A)
controls.title: Review of Access to ePHI (A)
controls.body: User access to information systems containing ePHI is reviewed by management quarterly to assess appropriateness. Corrective actions are documented and resolved in a timely manner.

controls.name: DP4 - Authorized Disclosure
controls.title: Authorized Disclosure
controls.body: Organization creates and maintains a record of authorized disclosures of personal information that is complete, accurate, and timely.

controls.name: HP - Review and Approval from Privacy Board (R)
controls.title: Review and Approval from Privacy Board (R)
controls.body: Privacy board meetings are held on a periodic basis to review the proposed research and approve alteration or waiver of authorization by the majority of the privacy board members unless the privacy board elects to use an expedited review procedure.

controls.name: PE-10 - Emergency Shutoff
controls.title: Emergency Shutoff

controls.name: HP - Periodic Assessments for De-identification (A)
controls.title: Periodic Assessments for De-identification (A)
controls.body: Periodic assessments of the systems, tools and processes using de-identified PHI are performed to assess compliance with the organization's de-identification procedure. Deficiencies are tracked and resolved in a timely manner.

controls.name: A.13.1.3 - Segregation in Networks
controls.title: Segregation in Networks
controls.body: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated on networks.

controls.name: Clause 7.3 - Awareness
controls.title: Awareness
controls.body:
Persons doing work under the organization’s control shall be aware of:
a) the information security policy;
b) their contribution to the effectiveness of the information security management system, including the benefits of improved information security performance; and
c) the implications of not conforming with the information security management system requirements.

controls.name: A.11.2.6 - Security of Equipment and Assets Off-premises
controls.title: Security of Equipment and Assets Off-premises
controls.body: Security shall be applied to off-site assets taking into account the different risks of working outside the organization’s premises.

controls.name: Clause 8.2 - Information Security Risk Assessment
controls.title: Information Security Risk Assessment
controls.body:
The organization shall perform information security risk assessments at planned intervals or when significant changes are proposed or occur, taking account of the criteria established in 6.1.2 a).
The organization shall retain documented information of the results of the information security risk assessments.

controls.name: HP - Verification Requirements (R)
controls.title: Verification Requirements (R)
controls.body: The organization has defined processes to verify the identity and authority of a person requesting access to PHI. Request for access to PHI is facilitated based on verification of documentation, statements, or representations and the identity of the person requesting such access.

controls.name: SS1 - Access and Authentication for Serverless Functions
controls.title: Access and Authentication for Serverless Functions
controls.body: Serverless functions that call out to a service require access control and authentication.

controls.name: HP - Individual Rights on Restrictions (R)
controls.title: Individual Rights on Restrictions (R)
controls.body:
Restriction requests received from individuals on uses and disclosure of their PHI are adhered to by the organization except when PHI is needed to provide emergency treatment to individuals. Restrictions are terminated only based on formal acknowledgement from individuals. 

The organization maintains documentation of such requests on restrictions or terminations.

controls.name: DS1 - Information Labelling/Classification
controls.title: Information Labelling/Classification
controls.body: The organization has formalized data classification policies and procedures to identify confidential information in the system and to define instructions for handling and labelling confidential information.

controls.name: IA-5(2) - Authenticator Management | Public Key-based Authentication
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Public Key-based Authentication
controls.body:
a. For public key-based authentication:
1. Enforce authorized access to the corresponding private key; and
2. Map the authenticated identity to the account of the individual or group; and

b. When public key infrastructure (PKI) is used:
1. Validate certificates by constructing and verifying a certification path to an accepted trust anchor, including checking certificate status information; and
2. Implement a local cache of revocation data to support path discovery and validation.

controls.name: A.11.2.2 - Supporting Utilities
controls.title: Supporting Utilities
controls.body: Equipment shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

controls.name: DP5 - Retention of Personal Information
controls.title: Retention of Personal Information
controls.body: The organization retains personal information consistent with its privacy commitments and as long as it is required for its intended purpose.

controls.name: DP12 - Personal Information Disposal
controls.title: Personal Information Disposal
controls.body: Personal information no longer required for its intended purpose is disposed of or destroyed in accordance with defined data retention and disposal procedures.

controls.name: PCI 2.6 - Shared Hosting Providers
controls.title: Shared Hosting Providers
controls.body:
Shared hosting providers must protect each entity’s hosted environment and cardholder data. 

These providers must meet specific requirements as detailed in Appendix A1: Additional PCI DSS Requirements for Shared Hosting Providers.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.B.2 - IT Risk Management
controls.title: IT Risk Management
controls.body: The institution has policies commensurate with its risk and complexity that address the concepts of information technology risk management. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page, 16)

controls.name: DS5 - Equipment Disposal/Recycling
controls.title: Equipment Disposal/Recycling
controls.body: Equipment with data storage capabilities is disposed of or recycled using a certified equipment disposal vendor.

controls.name: PCI 10.3.1 - Audit Trail Entries for User Identification
controls.title: Audit Trail Entries for User Identification
controls.body: User identification.

controls.name: PR.AC-5 - Network Segregation
controls.title: Network Segregation
controls.body: Network integrity is protected (e.g., network segregation, network segmentation)

controls.name: OM9 - Reporting Code of Conduct and Ethical Issues
controls.title: Reporting Code of Conduct and Ethical Issues
controls.body: The organization has established communication channels that allow employees to securely and anonymously report issues related to fraud, harassment and other issues impacting the organization's ethical and integrity requirements.

controls.name: A.11.1.2 - Physical Entry Controls
controls.title: Physical Entry Controls
controls.body: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.

controls.name: HS - Business Impact Analysis (A)
controls.title: Business Impact Analysis (A)
controls.body: The organization has established a formal Business Impact Analysis process to assess PHI applications' criticality and data to drive business continuity requirements.

controls.name: OM3 - Board of Directors Oversight Responsibilities
controls.title: Board of Directors Oversight Responsibilities
controls.body: The Board of Directors' oversight responsibilities is defined and documented and acknowledged by the Board on an annual basis.

controls.name: HS - Disciplinary Process (R)
controls.title: Disciplinary Process (R)
controls.body: Organization has established a formal disciplinary process describing actions to be taken against employees and contractors who fail to comply with the organization's security and privacy policies and procedures. The formalized disciplinary process is communicated to and acknowledged by employees and contractors.

controls.name: HS - Business Continuity Plan (R)
controls.title: Business Continuity Plan (R)
controls.body: A business continuity plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP) have been developed and tested annually (including procedures on the protection of ePHI while operating in emergency mode). Test results are reviewed, and plans are updated, if required, based on the outcome of the test performed.

controls.name: HS - Policies and Procedures (R)
controls.title: Policies and Procedures (R)
controls.body: Organization has established security and privacy policies and procedures for protecting PHI, which is communicated to all employees and contractors. These policies and procedures are reviewed and approved by management on an annual basis or in case of significant changes.

controls.name: PCI A3.4.1 - User Accounts and Access Privilege Review
controls.title: User Accounts and Access Privilege Review
controls.body:
"Review user accounts and access privileges to in-scope system components at least every six months to ensure user accounts and access remain appropriate based on job function, and authorized.
PCI DSS Reference: Requirement 7

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.A.1 - Trusted and Untrusted Zones Traffic
controls.title: Trusted and Untrusted Zones Traffic
controls.body: Network environments and virtual instances are designed and configured to restrict and monitor traffic between trusted and untrusted zones.

controls.name: RS.MI-1 - Incident Handling
controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.body: Incidents are contained

controls.name: HS - Assigning Security & Privacy Responsibilities (R)
controls.title: Assigning Security & Privacy Responsibilities (R)
controls.body: Management has designated a security and privacy official to oversee the development and implementation of security and privacy policies and procedures.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.B.5 - Risk Assessment of External Critical Infrastructures
controls.title: Risk Assessment of External Critical Infrastructures
controls.body: Management considers the risks posed by other critical infrastructures (e.g., telecommunications, energy) to the institution. (FFIEC Business Continuity Planning Booklet, page J-12)

controls.name: A.9.4.4 - Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.title: Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.body: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

controls.name: Clause 4.4 - ISMS
controls.title: ISMS
controls.body: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain and continually improve an information security management system, including the necessary policies and processes,  in accordance with the requirements of the ISO 27001 document.

controls.name: Clause 5.1 - Leadership and Commitment
controls.title: Leadership and Commitment

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.E.1 - Review of Cybersecurity Program
controls.title: Review of Cybersecurity Program
controls.body: At least annually, the board or an appropriate board committee reviews and approves the institution’s cybersecurity program

controls.name: Clause 5.2 - Policy
controls.title: Policy

controls.name: Clause 6.2 - Information Security Objectives and Plans
controls.title: Information Security Objectives and Plans

controls.name: Clause 8.1 - Operational Planning and Control
controls.title: Operational Planning and Control
controls.body:
The organization shall plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet requirements, and to implement the actions determined in Clause 6 by:
- establishing criteria for the processes; (Applicable under ISO 27001:2022)
- implementing control of the processes in accordance with the criteria. (Applicable under ISO 27001:2022)

Documented information shall be available to the extent necessary to have confidence that the processes have been carried out as planned.
The organization shall control planned changes and review the consequences of unintended changes, taking action to mitigate any adverse effects, as necessary.
The organization shall ensure that externally provided processes, products or services that are relevant to the ISMS are controlled.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.B.2 - Audit Confidential Data At-rest/In-transit
controls.title: Audit Confidential Data At-rest/In-transit
controls.body: The independent audit function validates controls related to the storage or transmission of confidential data. (FFIEC Audit Booklet, page 1)

controls.name: PE-13 - Fire Protection
controls.title: Fire Protection
controls.body: Employ and maintain fire detection and suppression systems that are supported by an independent energy source.

controls.name: RA-5(6) - Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Automated Trend Analyses
controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Automated Trend Analyses
controls.body: Compare the results of multiple vulnerability scans using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: HS - Incident Resolution and Response (R)
controls.title: Incident Resolution and Response (R)
controls.body: Incidents related to security and privacy are logged, tracked and communicated to affected parties. Incidents are resolved in a timely manner in accordance with the formal incident management process.

controls.name: HS - Periodic assessment of Health Care Clearinghouse (R)
controls.title: Periodic assessment of Health Care Clearinghouse (R)
controls.body: On an annual basis, Organization performs an assessment of the health care clearinghouse to determine whether reasonable and appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards are in place to protect ePHI against unauthorized access by the larger organization.

controls.name: HS - Access to Workstations (R)
controls.title: Access to Workstations (R)
controls.body: Access to workstations that store or access ePHI is restricted to authorized users and provisioned based on the formal authorization process.

controls.name: HS - Incident Management Process (R)
controls.title: Incident Management Process (R)
controls.body: A formal incident management process has been established, which requires incidents (breaches) to be tracked, documented and resolved in a timely manner in accordance with the breach notification rule. The process document is reviewed and updated by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: AU-6(4) - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Central Review and Analysis
controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Central Review and Analysis
controls.body: Provide and implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system.

controls.name: M43.07 - Ensuring the integrity of the log data at the level of processing operations.
controls.title: Ensuring the integrity of the log data at the level of processing operations.
controls.body: Ensuring the integrity of the log data at the level of processing operations.

controls.name: DE.CM-8 - Vulnerability Scan
controls.title: Vulnerability Scan
controls.body: Vulnerability scans are performed

controls.name: HS - Business Associate Agreement (R)
controls.title: Business Associate Agreement (R)
controls.body: Business associates or vendors working on behalf of the organization and with access to PHI are required to sign an agreement outlining the security and privacy requirements for protecting PHI.

controls.name: HS - Firewalls and Rule Review (R)
controls.title: Firewalls and Rule Review (R)
controls.body: System firewalls are configured on the application gateway and production network to limit unnecessary ports, protocols and services. Firewall rules are reviewed on an annual basis by IT management.

controls.name: HS - Physical Access Revocation (A)
controls.title: Physical Access Revocation (A)
controls.body: Physical access to facilities housing systems with ePHI is revoked in a timely manner for terminated employees/contractors.

controls.name: DE.DP-4 - Security Incident Notification
controls.title: Security Incident Notification
controls.body: Event detection information is communicated

controls.name: DE.DP-5 - Continuously Improving Detection Processes
controls.title: Continuously Improving Detection Processes
controls.body: Detection processes are continuously improved

controls.name: HP - Consent on Uses and Disclosure (R)
controls.title: Consent on Uses and Disclosure (R)
controls.body: Explicit consent is obtained from individuals regarding the use and disclosure of their protected health information prior to collection.

controls.name: DE.CM-1 - Network Monitoring
controls.title: Network Monitoring
controls.body: The network is monitored to detect potential cybersecurity events

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.4 - User Access Reviews
controls.title: User Access Reviews
controls.body: User access reviews are performed periodically for all systems and applications based on the risk to the application or system. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 18)

controls.name: OM2 - Board of Directors Independence from Management
controls.title: Board of Directors Independence from Management
controls.body: The Board of Directors comprises of non-executive directors independent from management and meets on a quarterly basis for oversight on internal controls, operations and business objectives.

controls.name: A.12.6.1 - Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.body: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization’s exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated and appropriate measures taken to address the associated risk.

controls.name: DE.CM-4 - Detection of Malicious Code
controls.title: Detection of Malicious Code
controls.body: Malicious code is detected

controls.name: RS.IM-1 - Incorporate Lessons to Response Plans
controls.title: Incorporate Lessons to Response Plans
controls.body: Response plans incorporate lessons learned

controls.name: PR.DS-4 - Capacity Management
controls.title: Capacity Management
controls.body: Adequate capacity to ensure availability is maintained

controls.name: ID.RA-1 - Document Assets Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Document Assets Vulnerabilities
controls.body: Asset vulnerabilities are identified and documented

controls.name: SC-43 - Usage Restrictions
controls.title: Usage Restrictions
controls.body:
a. Establish usage restrictions and implementation guidelines for the following system components: [Assignment: organization-defined system components]; and
b. Authorize, monitor, and control the use of such components within the system.

controls.name: PR.AC-2 - Physical Access Management
controls.title: Physical Access Management
controls.body: Physical access to assets is managed and protected

controls.name: PR.PT-4 - Safeguard of Communications and Control Network
controls.title: Safeguard of Communications and Control Network
controls.body: Communications and control networks are protected

controls.name: PR.DS-7 - Separation of Development and Testing Environment
controls.title: Separation of Development and Testing Environment
controls.body: The development and testing environment(s) are separate from the production environment

controls.name: PR.PT-3 - Least Functionality Access
controls.title: Least Functionality Access
controls.body: The principle of least functionality is incorporated by configuring systems to provide only essential capabilities

controls.name: RS.IM-2 - Response Strategies Updated
controls.title: Response Strategies Updated
controls.body: Response strategies are updated

controls.name: RS.AN-2 - Analyzed Security Incident Impact
controls.title: Analyzed Security Incident Impact
controls.body: The impact of the incident is understood

controls.name: RS.AN-3 - Forensic Investigation
controls.title: Forensic Investigation
controls.body: Forensics are performed

controls.name: RS.AN-4 - Incident Classification
controls.title: Incident Classification
controls.body: Incidents are categorized consistent with response plans

controls.name: PCI 1.2 - Firewall and Router Restriction
controls.title: Firewall and Router Restriction
controls.body:
Build firewall and router configurations that restrict connections between untrusted networks and any system components in the cardholder data environment.

 Note: An “untrusted network” is any network that is external to the networks belonging to the entity under review, and/or which is out of the entity's ability to control or manage.

controls.name: PCI 1.4 - Firewall on Portable Computing Devices
controls.title: Firewall on Portable Computing Devices
controls.body:
Install personal firewall software or equivalent functionality on any portable computing devices (including company and/or employee-owned) that connect to the Internet when outside the network (for example, laptops used by employees), and which are also used to access the CDE. 

Firewall (or equivalent) configurations include:·
- Specific configuration settings are defined.·
- Personal firewall (or equivalent functionality) is actively running.·
- Personal firewall (or equivalent functionality) is not alterable by users of the portable computing devices.

controls.name: RS.MI-2 - Incident Mitigation
controls.title: Incident Mitigation
controls.body: Incidents are mitigated

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.A.2 - Cybersecurity Oversight Improvement
controls.title: Cybersecurity Oversight Improvement
controls.body: Management has a formal process to continuously improve cybersecurity oversight.

controls.name: PCI 5.1 - Anti-virus Deployment
controls.title: Anti-virus Deployment
controls.body: Deploy anti-virus software on all systems commonly affected by malicious software (particularly personal computers and servers).

controls.name: PCI 6.4.6 - PCI DSS Controls to New and Changed Systems
controls.title: PCI DSS Controls to New and Changed Systems
controls.body: Upon completion of a significant change, all relevant PCI DSS requirements must be implemented on all new or changed systems and networks, and documentation updated as applicable.

controls.name: PCI 6.6 - Vulnerabilities in Public Facing Web Applications
controls.title: Vulnerabilities in Public Facing Web Applications
controls.body:
For public-facing web applications, address new threats and vulnerabilities on an ongoing basis and ensure these applications are protected against known attacks by either of the following methods:·
- Reviewing public-facing web applications via manual or automated application vulnerability security assessment tools or methods, at least annually and after any changes

Note:This assessment is not the same as the vulnerability scans performed for Requirement 11.2.·

- Installing an automated technical solution that detects and prevents web- based attacks (for example, a web- application firewall) in front of public- facing web applications, to continually check all traffic.

controls.name: PCI 8.2 - User-Authentication Management
controls.title: User-Authentication Management
controls.body:
In addition to assigning a unique ID, ensure proper user-authentication management for non-consumer users and administrators on all system components by employing at least one of the following methods to authenticate all users:
Something you know, such as a password or passphrase.
Something you have, such as a token device or smart card.
Something you are, such as a biometric.

controls.name: PCI 8.3.1 - Multi-Factor Authentication for Non-console Access
controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication for Non-console Access
controls.body: Incorporate multi-factor authentication for all non-console access into the CDE for personnel with administrative access.

controls.name: PCI 8.3.2 - Multi-Factor Authentication for Remote Access
controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication for Remote Access
controls.body: Incorporate multi-factor authentication for all remote network access (both user and administrator, and including third-party access for support or maintenance) originating from outside the entity’s network.

controls.name: PCI 11.3.3 - Correction of Vulnerabilities and Retesting
controls.title: Correction of Vulnerabilities and Retesting
controls.body: Exploitable vulnerabilities found during penetration testing are corrected and testing is repeated to verify the corrections.

controls.name: PCI 11.3.4 - Penetration Test on Isolated CDE
controls.title: Penetration Test on Isolated CDE
controls.body: If segmentation is used to isolate the CDE from other networks, perform penetration tests at least annually and after any changes to segmentation controls/methods to verify that the segmentation methods are operational and effective, and isolate all out-of-scope systems from systems in the CDE.

controls.name: PCI 11.3.4.1 - Penetration Testing on Segmentation Controls
controls.title: Penetration Testing on Segmentation Controls
controls.body:
Additional requirement for service providers only:
If segmentation is used, confirm PCI DSS scope by performing penetration testing on segmentation controls at least every six months and after any changes to segmentation controls/methods.

controls.name: PCI 12.6 - Security Awareness Program
controls.title: Security Awareness Program
controls.body: Implement a formal security awareness program to make all personnel aware of the cardholder data security policy and procedures.

controls.name: PCI 11.4 - Intrusion Detection and Prevention
controls.title: Intrusion Detection and Prevention
controls.body: Use intrusion-detection and/or intrusion-prevention techniques to detect and/or prevent intrusions into the network. Monitor all traffic at the perimeter of the cardholder data environment as well as at critical points in the cardholder data environment, and alert personnel to suspected compromises. Keep all intrusion-detection and prevention engines, baselines, and signatures up to date.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.B.6 - Incident Response Policy
controls.title: Incident Response Policy
controls.body: The institution has policies commensurate with its risk and complexity that address the concepts of incident response and resilience. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 83)

controls.name: D1.G.SP.Int.1 - Threat Intelligence Policies
controls.title: Threat Intelligence Policies
controls.body: The institution has a comprehensive set of policies commensurate with its risk and complexity that address the concepts of threat intelligence.

controls.name: D1.G.SP.E.1 - Cybersecurity and Resilience Strategy
controls.title: Cybersecurity and Resilience Strategy
controls.body: The institution augmented its information security strategy to incorporate cybersecurity and resilience.

controls.name: CA-8 - Penetration Testing
controls.title: Penetration Testing
controls.body: Conduct penetration testing [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: D1.RM.RA.B.2 - Internet-based Systems and High-risk Transactions
controls.title: Internet-based Systems and High-risk Transactions
controls.body: The risk assessment identifies internet-based systems and high-risk transactions that warrant additional authentication controls. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 12)

controls.name: D1.RM.RA.A.1 - Enterprise Risk Assessment
controls.title: Enterprise Risk Assessment
controls.body: An enterprise-wide risk management function incorporates cyber threat analysis and specific risk exposure as part of the enterprise risk assessment

controls.name: D1.RM.RA.Inn.1 - Real Time Updates of Risk Assessment
controls.title: Real Time Updates of Risk Assessment
controls.body: The risk assessment is updated in real-time as changes to the risk profile occur, new applicable standards are released or updated, and new exposures are anticipated.

controls.name: D1.RM.RA.Inn.2 - Threat Prediction Based on Risk Assessment
controls.title: Threat Prediction Based on Risk Assessment
controls.body: The institution uses information from risk assessments to predict threats and drive real-time responses.

controls.name: D1.G.RM.Au.B.1 - Independent Audit
controls.title: Independent Audit
controls.body: Independent audit or review evaluates policies, procedures, and controls across the institution for significant risks and control issues associated with the institution's operations, including risks in new products, emerging technologies, and information systems. (FFIEC Audit Booklet, page 4)

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.B.2 - Information Security Training
controls.title: Information Security Training
controls.body: Annual information security training includes incident response, current cyber threats (e.g., phishing, spear phishing, social engineering, and mobile security), and emerging issues. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 66)

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.B.3 - Security Awareness for Employees
controls.title: Security Awareness for Employees
controls.body: Situational awareness materials are made available to employees when prompted by highly visible cyber events or by regulatory alerts. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 7)

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.B.1 - Network Perimeter Defense
controls.title: Network Perimeter Defense
controls.body: Network perimeter defense tools (e.g., border router and firewall) are used. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 33)

controls.name: D1.TC.Cu.Inn.1 - Promotion of Cybersecurity Culture
controls.title: Promotion of Cybersecurity Culture
controls.body: The institution leads efforts to promote cybersecurity culture across the sector and to other sectors that they depend upon.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.E.2 - Antivirus and Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems
controls.title: Antivirus and Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems
controls.body: Antivirus and intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS) detect and block actual and attempted attacks or intrusions.

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.B.9 - System Session Time Out
controls.title: System Session Time Out
controls.body: System sessions are locked after a pre-defined period of inactivity and are terminated after pre-defined conditions are met. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 23)

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.B.2 - Firewall Protection in Systems Accessed by External Parties
controls.title: Firewall Protection in Systems Accessed by External Parties
