controls.body: Systems that are accessed from the Internet or by external parties are protected by firewalls or other similar devices. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 46)

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.9 - Customer Access Authentication Requirements
controls.title: Customer Access Authentication Requirements
controls.body: Customer access to Internet-based products or services requires authentication controls (e.g., layered controls, multifactor) that are commensurate with the risk. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 21)

controls.name: M43.08 - Data points needed for logging system activities
controls.title: Data points needed for logging system activities
controls.body: Data points needed for logging system activities

controls.name: D3.PC.Am.B.14 - Mobile Device Encryption
controls.title: Mobile Device Encryption
controls.body: Mobile devices (e.g., laptops, tablets, and removable media) are encrypted if used to store confidential data. (*N/A if mobile devices are not used.) (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 51)

controls.name: A.11.2.8 - Unattended User Equipment
controls.title: Unattended User Equipment
controls.body: Users shall ensure that unattended equipment has appropriate protection.

controls.name: D1.G.IT.A.1 - Review of Supply Chain Risk
controls.title: Review of Supply Chain Risk
controls.body: Supply chain risk is reviewed before the acquisition of mission-critical information systems including system components.

controls.name: PCI 7.2.3 - User Default Configuration
controls.title: User Default Configuration
controls.body: Default “deny-all” setting.

controls.name: PCI 9.4.1 - Visitors are Authorized before Entering
controls.title: Visitors are Authorized before Entering
controls.body: Visitors are authorized before entering, and escorted at all times within, areas where cardholder data is processed or maintained.

controls.name: SC-42(5) - Sensor Capability and Data | Collection Minimization
controls.title: Sensor Capability and Data | Collection Minimization
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined sensors] that are configured to minimize the collection of information about individuals that is not needed.

controls.name: D1.G.Ov.B.1 - Information Security and Business Continuity Program Management
controls.title: Information Security and Business Continuity Program Management
controls.body: Designated members of management are held accountable by the board or an appropriate board committee for implementing and managing the information security and business continuity programs. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 3)

controls.name: PCI 8.1.8 - User Idle Session
controls.title: User Idle Session
controls.body: If a session has been idle for more than 15 minutes, require the user to re-authenticate to re-activate the terminal or session.

controls.name: A.12.1.2 - Change Management
controls.title: Change Management
controls.body: Changes to the organization, business processes, information processing facilities and systems that affect information security shall be controlled.

controls.name: D1.RM.Au.A.3 - Identification of Cybersecurity Weaknesses
controls.title: Identification of Cybersecurity Weaknesses
controls.body: Independent audits or reviews are used to identify cybersecurity weaknesses, root causes, and the potential impact to business units.

controls.name: PCI 10.4.2 - Protection of Time Data
controls.title: Protection of Time Data
controls.body: Time data is protected.

controls.name: A.14.2.9 - System Acceptance Testing
controls.title: System Acceptance Testing
controls.body: Acceptance testing programs and related criteria shall be established for new information systems, upgrades and new versions.

controls.name: PCI 12.5.2 - Personnel Responsible for Monitoring and Analyzing Security Alerts
controls.title: Personnel Responsible for Monitoring and Analyzing Security Alerts
controls.body: Monitor and analyze security alerts and information, and distribute to appropriate personnel.

controls.name: PR.IP-8 - Report on Effectiveness of Protection Technologies
controls.title: Report on Effectiveness of Protection Technologies
controls.body: Effectiveness of protection technologies is shared

controls.name: PCI 12.5.3 - Documentation of Security Incident Response Procedures
controls.title: Documentation of Security Incident Response Procedures
controls.body: Establish, document, and distribute security incident response and escalation procedures to ensure timely and effective handling of all situations.

controls.name: PCI 12.5.4 - Account Access Administrator
controls.title: Account Access Administrator
controls.body: Administer user accounts, including additions, deletions, and modifications.

controls.name: RC.IM-1 - Incorporate Lessons to Recovery Plans
controls.title: Incorporate Lessons to Recovery Plans
controls.body: Recovery plans incorporate lessons learned

controls.name: PR.IP-3 - Configuration Change Control
controls.title: Configuration Change Control
controls.body: Configuration change control processes are in place

controls.name: RC.IM-2 - Recovery Strategies Updated
controls.title: Recovery Strategies Updated
controls.body: Recovery strategies are updated

controls.name: PCI 12.8.5 - PCI DSS Requirement Managed by Service Provider
controls.title: PCI DSS Requirement Managed by Service Provider
controls.body: Maintain information about which PCI DSS requirements are managed by each service provider, and which are managed by the entity.

controls.name: PCI 1.1.1 - Testing and Changes to Firewall and Router Configurations
controls.title: Testing and Changes to Firewall and Router Configurations
controls.body: A formal process for approving and testing all network connections and changes to the firewall and router configurations

controls.name: PR.AT-3 - Third-party Stakeholders Responsibilities
controls.title: Third-party Stakeholders Responsibilities
controls.body: Third-party stakeholders (e.g., suppliers, customers, partners) understand their roles and responsibilities

controls.name: Clause 4.3 - ISMS Scope
controls.title: ISMS Scope
controls.body:
The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the information security management system to establish its scope. When determining this scope, the organization shall consider:
a) The external and internal issues referred to in 4.1
b) the requirements referred to in 4.2
c) interfaces and dependencies between activities performed by the organization, and those that are performed by other organizations.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.7 - Cross-site Scripting
controls.title: Cross-site Scripting
controls.body:
Cross-site scripting (XSS)

Note: Requirements 6.5.7 through 6.5.10, apply to web applications and application interfaces (internal or external).

controls.name: IA-5(18) - Authenticator Management | Password Managers
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Password Managers
controls.body:
a. Employ [Assignment: organization-defined password managers] to generate and manage passwords; and
b. Protect the passwords using [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.name: PCI 6.5.8 - Improper Access Control
controls.title: Improper Access Control
controls.body:
Improper access control (such as insecure direct object references, failure to restrict URL access, directory traversal, and failure to restrict user access to functions).

Note: Requirements 6.5.7 through 6.5.10, apply to web applications and application interfaces (internal or external).

controls.name: PCI 6.5.9 - Cross-site Request Forgery
controls.title: Cross-site Request Forgery
controls.body:
Cross-site request forgery (CSRF)

Note: Requirements 6.5.7 through 6.5.10, apply to web applications and application interfaces (internal or external).

controls.name: RS.CO-2 - Incident Reporting
controls.title: Incident Reporting
controls.body: Incidents are reported consistent with established criteria

controls.name: PCI 9.7.1 - Inventory logs of Storage Media
controls.title: Inventory logs of Storage Media
controls.body: Properly maintain inventory logs of all media and conduct media inventories at least annually.

controls.name: CM2 - Emergency Changes
controls.title: Emergency Changes
controls.body: Emergency change requests are documented and subject to the standard change management process but at an accelerated timeline. Prior to initiating an emergency change, appropriate approval is obtained and documented.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.5.3 - Functionality Testing
controls.title: Functionality Testing
controls.body: Functionality testing to verify that the change does not adversely impact the security of the system.

controls.name: PR.DS-5 - Data Loss Prevention
controls.title: Data Loss Prevention
controls.body: Protections against data leaks are implemented

controls.name: A.7.2.1 - Management Responsibilities
controls.title: Management Responsibilities
controls.body: Management shall require all employees and contractors to apply information security in accordance with the established policies and procedures of the organization.

controls.name: A.12.1.3 - Capacity Management
controls.title: Capacity Management
controls.body: The use of resources shall be monitored, tuned and projections made of future capacity requirements to ensure the required system performance.

controls.name: DE.AE-4 - Security Event Impact Assessment
controls.title: Security Event Impact Assessment
controls.body: Impact of events is determined

controls.name: DE.AE-5 - Incident Alert Thresholds
controls.title: Incident Alert Thresholds
controls.body: Incident alert thresholds are established

controls.name: DE.CM-5 - Detection of Unauthorized Mobile Code
controls.title: Detection of Unauthorized Mobile Code
controls.body: Unauthorized mobile code is detected

controls.name: G.6.11 - Identification
controls.title: Identification
controls.body: Attribute of G.6 Problem Management

controls.name: PR.IP-6 - Data Destruction
controls.title: Data Destruction
controls.body: Data is destroyed according to policy

controls.name: PCI A3.1.4 - Up-to-date Information Security Training
controls.title: Up-to-date Information Security Training
controls.body:
Provide up-to-date PCI DSS and/or information security training at least annually to personnel with PCI DSS compliance responsibilities (as identified in A3.1.3).
PCI DSS Reference: Requirement 12

controls.name: D1.TC.Tr.A.1 - Cyber Risk Training
controls.title: Cyber Risk Training
controls.body: Independent directors are provided with cybersecurity training that addresses how complex products, services, and lines of business affect the institution's cyber risk.

controls.name: VM3 - Vendor Management Process
controls.title: Vendor Management Process
controls.body: A vendor management process has been implemented whereby management performs risk assessments of potential new vendors and evaluates the performance of existing vendors on an annual basis. Corrective actions are taken as required based on the results of the assessments.

controls.name: A.15.2.1 - Monitoring and Review of Supplier Services
controls.title: Monitoring and Review of Supplier Services
controls.body: Organizations shall regularly monitor, review and audit supplier service delivery.

controls.name: PR.IP-7 - Improvement of Protection Processes
controls.title: Improvement of Protection Processes
controls.body: Protection processes are improved

controls.name: HS - Data Backup and Monitoring (R)
controls.title: Data Backup and Monitoring (R)
controls.body: Data backups are performed regularly in accordance with an approved backup policy. Backups are monitored for failure using an automated system, and appropriate corrective actions are taken.

controls.name: A.18.2.3 - Technical Compliance Review
controls.title: Technical Compliance Review
controls.body: Information systems shall be regularly reviewed for compliance with the organization’s information security policies and standards.

controls.name: PR.MA-1 - Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.title: Maintenance and Repair of Organizational Assets
controls.body: Maintenance and repair of organizational assets are performed and logged, with approved and controlled tools

controls.name: RC.RP-1 - Recovery Plan Execution
controls.title: Recovery Plan Execution
controls.body: Recovery plan is executed during or after a cybersecurity incident

controls.name: SI-3(4) - Malicious Code Protection | Updates Only by Privileged Users
controls.title: Malicious Code Protection | Updates Only by Privileged Users
controls.body: Update malicious code protection mechanisms only when directed by a privileged user.

controls.name: RS.CO-1 - Incident Responders
controls.title: Incident Responders
controls.body: Personnel know their roles and order of operations when a response is needed

controls.name: HS - Penetration Testing (R)
controls.title: Penetration Testing (R)
controls.body: Penetration testing is performed on an annual basis on networks and applications. Issues identified are classified according to risk, analyzed and remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: VM1 - Third-Party Code of Conduct and Confidentiality Commitments
controls.title: Third-Party Code of Conduct and Confidentiality Commitments
controls.body: Third-party contractors working on behalf of the organization are required to sign an agreement outlining the standard code of conduct, security and confidentiality requirements.

controls.name: RS.CO-4 - Coordination with Stakeholder during Incident Response
controls.title: Coordination with Stakeholder during Incident Response
controls.body: Coordination with stakeholders occurs consistent with response plans

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.Inn.1 - Risk Scoring of Infrastructure Assets
controls.title: Risk Scoring of Infrastructure Assets
controls.body: The institution risk scores all of its infrastructure assets and updates in real-time based on threats, vulnerabilities, or operational changes.

controls.name: PE-14 - Environmental Controls
controls.title: Environmental Controls
controls.body:
a. Maintain [Selection (one or more): temperature; humidity; pressure; radiation; [Assignment: organization-defined environmental control]] levels within the facility where the system resides at [Assignment: organization-defined acceptable levels]; and
b. Monitor environmental control levels [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: IM4 - Incident Resolution and Notification
controls.title: Incident Resolution and Notification
controls.body: All incidents related to security are logged, tracked and communicated to affected parties. Incidents are resolved in a timely manner in accordance with the formal incident management process

controls.name: SS8 - Serverless function Logging and Monitoring
controls.title: Serverless function Logging and Monitoring
controls.body: Function logging is enabled to monitor administrative activities regarding changes to functions, security configurations, permissions and roles. Automated alerts are configured to notify IT management and issues identified are resolved in a timely manner through the incident management process.

controls.name: DE.CM-7 - Detection of Unauthorized Systems
controls.title: Detection of Unauthorized Systems
controls.body: Monitoring for unauthorized personnel, connections, devices, and software is performed

controls.name: SS7 - Serverless Function Account Review
controls.title: Serverless Function Account Review
controls.body: Serverless functions and associated account permissions are reviewed on a quarterly basis by management to confirm that they are necessary and are configured correctly.

controls.name: H.2.3 - Password reuse policy | Password Controls
controls.title: Password reuse policy | Password Controls
controls.body: Attribute of H.2 Password Controls

controls.name: HB - Breach Notification by Business Associates (R)
controls.title: Breach Notification by Business Associates (R)
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities of business associates with respect to breach notification is communicated as part of contractual obligations requiring them to notify data breaches, without unreasonable delay and in no case later than 60 calendar days after discovery of a breach, except in cases stated by law enforcement official to delay the notification.

controls.name: RS.RP-1 - Execution of Response Plan
controls.title: Execution of Response Plan
controls.body: Response plan is executed during or after an incident

controls.name: PCI 6.1 - Identification of Security Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Identification of Security Vulnerabilities
controls.body:
Establish a process to identify security vulnerabilities, using reputable outside sources for security vulnerability information, and assign a risk ranking (for example, as “high,” “medium,” or “low”) to newly discovered security vulnerabilities.


Note: Risk rankings should be based on industry best practices as well as consideration of potential impact. For example, criteria for ranking vulnerabilities may include consideration of the CVSS base score, and/or the classification by the vendor, and/or type of systems affected.
Methods for evaluating vulnerabilities and assigning risk ratings will vary based on an organization’s environment and risk- assessment strategy. Risk rankings should, at a minimum, identify all vulnerabilities considered to be a “high risk” to the environment. In addition to the risk ranking, vulnerabilities may be considered “critical” if they pose an imminent threat to the environment, impact critical systems, and/or would result in a potential compromise if not addressed. Examples of critical systems may include security systems, public-facing devices and systems, databases, and other systems that store, process, or transmit cardholder data.

controls.name: Clause 9.2 - Internal Audit
controls.title: Internal Audit
controls.body:
9.2.1: 
The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the information security management system:
a) conforms to
     1) the organization’s own requirements for its information security management system;
     2) the requirements of the ISO 27001 document;
b) is effectively implemented and maintained.

9.2.2:
The organization shall plan, establish, implement and maintain an audit programme(s), including the frequency, methods, responsibilities, planning requirements and reporting. 

When establishing the internal audit programme(s), the organization shall consider the importance of the processes concerned and the results of previous audits.

The organization shall:
a) define the audit criteria and scope for each audit;
b) select auditors and conduct audits that ensure objectivity and the impartiality of the audit process;
c) ensure that the results of the audits are reported to relevant management.

Documented information shall be available as evidence of the implementation of the audit programme(s) and the audit results.

controls.name: AC-2(5) - Account Management | Inactivity Logout
controls.title: Account Management | Inactivity Logout
controls.body: Require that users log out when [Assignment: organization-defined time period of expected inactivity or description of when to log out].

controls.name: CA-6(1) - Authorization | Joint Authorization — Intra-organization
controls.title: Authorization | Joint Authorization — Intra-organization
controls.body: Employ a joint authorization process for the system that includes multiple authorizing officials from the same organization conducting the authorization.

controls.name: AC-3(13) - Access Enforcement | Attribute-based Access Control
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Attribute-based Access Control
controls.body: Enforce attribute-based access control policy over defined subjects and objects and control access based upon [Assignment: organization-defined attributes to assume access permissions].

controls.name: GC - Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.body: The organization assesses the need for and implements, where appropriate, a data protection impact assessment whenever new processing of personal data or changes to existing processing is planned.

controls.name: AU-6(5) - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Integrated Analysis of Audit Records
controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Integrated Analysis of Audit Records
controls.body: Integrate analysis of audit records with analysis of [Selection (one or more): vulnerability scanning information; performance data; system monitoring information; [Assignment: organization-defined data/information collected from other sources]] to further enhance the ability to identify inappropriate or unusual activity.

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.Inn.1 - Secure Isolation of User Tasks and Content
controls.title: Secure Isolation of User Tasks and Content
controls.body: User tasks and content (e.g., opening an e-mail attachment) are automatically isolated in a secure container or virtual environment so that malware can be analyzed but cannot access vital data, end-point operating systems, or applications on the institution’s network.

controls.name: PE-12 - Emergency Lighting
controls.title: Emergency Lighting
controls.body: Employ and maintain automatic emergency lighting for the system that activates in the event of a power outage or disruption and that covers emergency exits and evacuation routes within the facility.

controls.name: 5.4 - Gebruikers toegang verlenen
controls.title: Gebruikers toegang verlenen
controls.body:
Een formele gebruikerstoegangsverleningsprocedure behoort te worden
geimplementeerd om toegangsrechten voor alle typen gebruikers en voor alle systemen en diensten toe te wijzen of in te trekken.

controls.name: GC - Contracts with Processors
controls.title: Contracts with Processors
controls.body: Organization maintains written contract with processors that it uses for processing personal data collected from data subjects. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by processors for the protection of personal data.

controls.name: CP-8(4) - Telecommunications Services | Provider Contingency Plan
controls.title: Telecommunications Services | Provider Contingency Plan

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.A.2 - Identification of Interdependencies
controls.title: Identification of Interdependencies
controls.body: All interdependencies between applications and services have been identified

controls.name: CP-12 - Safe Mode
controls.title: Safe Mode
controls.body: When [Assignment: organization-defined conditions] are detected, enter a safe mode of operation with [Assignment: organization-defined restrictions of safe mode of operation].

controls.name: GP - Contracts with Controller
controls.title: Contracts with Controller
controls.body: Organization maintains written contract with controllers on behalf of whom it performs processing of personal data. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by processors for the protection of personal data.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.Int.3 - Contract with Incident Response Service Provider
controls.title: Contract with Incident Response Service Provider
controls.body: A direct cooperative or contractual agreement(s) is in place with an incident response organization(s) or provider(s) to assist rapidly with mitigation efforts.

controls.name: MP-3 - Media Marking
controls.title: Media Marking
controls.body:
a. Mark system media indicating the distribution limitations, handling caveats, and applicable security markings (if any) of the information; and
b. Exempt [Assignment: organization-defined types of system media] from marking if the media remain within [Assignment: organization-defined controlled areas].

controls.name: PS-4(1) - Personnel Termination | Post-employment Requirements
controls.title: Personnel Termination | Post-employment Requirements
controls.body:
a. Notify terminated individuals of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements for the protection of organizational information; and
b. Require terminated individuals to sign an acknowledgment of post-employment requirements as part of the organizational termination process.

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.B.3 - Review of Firewall Rules
controls.title: Review of Firewall Rules
controls.body: Firewall rules are audited or verified at least quarterly. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 82)

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.Inn.1 - Auditable Processes for Vendor Risk Monitoring
controls.title: Auditable Processes for Vendor Risk Monitoring
controls.body: The institution is leading efforts to develop new auditable processes for ongoing monitoring of cybersecurity risks posed by third parties.

controls.name: MA-3(6) - Maintenance Tools | Software Updates and Patches
controls.title: Maintenance Tools | Software Updates and Patches
controls.body: Inspect maintenance tools to ensure the latest software updates and patches are installed.

controls.name: AU-9(3) - Protection of Audit Information | Cryptographic Protection
controls.title: Protection of Audit Information | Cryptographic Protection
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of audit information and audit tools.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.A.5 - Tags on Fictitious Confidential Data
controls.title: Tags on Fictitious Confidential Data
controls.body: Tags on fictitious confidential data or files are used to provide advanced alerts of potential malicious activity when the data is accessed.

controls.name: AC-20(1) - Use of External Systems | Limits on Authorized Use
controls.title: Use of External Systems | Limits on Authorized Use
controls.body:
Permit authorized individuals to use an external system to access the system or to process, store, or transmit organization-controlled information only after:

a. Verification of the implementation of controls on the external system as specified in the organization’s security and privacy policies and security and privacy plans; or
b. Retention of approved system connection or processing agreements with the organizational entity hosting the external system.

controls.name: G - International Transfer of Personal Data
controls.title: International Transfer of Personal Data
controls.body: The organization identifies the relevant basis for the international transfer of personal data and implements a procedure that specifies processes and conditions on the transfer of personal data to third countries or international organizations. The procedure is approved by management and communicated to employees and contractors.

controls.name: AC-2 - Account Management
controls.title: Account Management

controls.name: PT-3(1) - Personally Identifiable Information Processing Purposes | Data Tagging
controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Processing Purposes | Data Tagging
controls.body: Attach data tags containing the following purposes to [Assignment: organization-defined elements of personally identifiable information]: [Assignment: organization-defined processing purposes].

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.B.1 - Independent Testing
controls.title: Independent Testing
controls.body: Independent testing (including penetration testing and vulnerability scanning) is conducted according to the risk assessment for external facing systems and the internal network. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 61)

controls.name: SA-9 - External System Services
controls.title: External System Services

controls.name: PL-8 - Security and Privacy Architectures
controls.title: Security and Privacy Architectures

controls.name: SA-9(4) - External System Services | Consistent Interests of Consumers and Providers
controls.title: External System Services | Consistent Interests of Consumers and Providers
controls.body: Take the following actions to verify that the interests of [Assignment: organization-defined external service providers] are consistent with and reflect organizational interests: [Assignment: organization-defined actions].

controls.name: D4.C.Co.E.2 - Updated Network Diagram
controls.title: Updated Network Diagram
controls.body: The network diagram is updated when connections with third parties change or at least annually.

controls.name: G - Employee Privacy Notice
controls.title: Employee Privacy Notice
controls.body: The organization has established a privacy notice for its employees and contractors which specifies their rights and the organization's privacy obligations in accordance with applicable privacy laws and regulations. The policy has been communicated and acknowledged by the employees and contractors on at least an annual basis or during significant changes.

controls.name: PS-2 - Position Risk Designation
controls.title: Position Risk Designation

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.E.2 - Integration of Incident Response into Business Continuity Plan
controls.title: Integration of Incident Response into Business Continuity Plan
controls.body: The corporate disaster recovery, business continuity, and crisis management plans have integrated consideration of cyber incidents.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.Inn.4 - Cyber Incident Scenario Stress Test
controls.title: Cyber Incident Scenario Stress Test
controls.body: Cyber incident scenarios are used to stress test potential financial losses across the sector.

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.Int.1 - Monitoring of Third-Party Privileged Access
controls.title: Monitoring of Third-Party Privileged Access
controls.body: Third-party employee access to the institution's confidential data are tracked actively based on the principles of least privilege.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.E.1 - Data Recovery Plans
controls.title: Data Recovery Plans
controls.body: Recovery scenarios include plans to recover from data destruction and impacts to data integrity, data loss, and system and data availability.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.B.2 - Monitoring of Anomalous Customer Transactions
controls.title: Monitoring of Anomalous Customer Transactions
controls.body: Customer transactions generating anomalous activity alerts are monitored and reviewed. (FFIEC Wholesale Payments Booklet, page 12)

controls.name: C - Periodic Assessments
controls.title: Periodic Assessments
controls.body: Periodic assessments of the systems, tools and processes are performed to identify all locations where personal information is collected, processed and distributed. Deficiencies are tracked, resolved and reported to management in a timely manner.

controls.name: AC-16 - Security and Privacy Attributes
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes

controls.name: CM-5(4) - Access Restrictions for Change | Dual Authorization
controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change | Dual Authorization
controls.body: Enforce dual authorization for implementing changes to [Assignment: organization-defined system components and system-level information].

controls.name: 5.5 - Beheren van speciale toegangsrechten
controls.title: Beheren van speciale toegangsrechten
controls.body:
Het toewijzen en gebruik van speciale toegangsrechten behoren
te worden beperkt en beheerst.

controls.name: PL-4 - Rules of Behavior
controls.title: Rules of Behavior

controls.name: AU-6(1) - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Automated Process Integration
controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Automated Process Integration
controls.body: Integrate audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.A.1 - Integration of Incident Response and Recovery Methods
controls.title: Integration of Incident Response and Recovery Methods
controls.body: Methods for responding to and recovering from cyber incidents are tightly woven throughout the business units’ disaster recovery, business continuity, and crisis management plans.

controls.name: G - Record of Processing Activities/Inventory
controls.title: Record of Processing Activities/Inventory
controls.body: Organization maintains a record of processing activities with respect to personal data collected from data subjects or processed on behalf of the controller. The documented inventory is reviewed by management on at least an annual basis and provided to legal authorities on request.

controls.name: PS-6(3) - Access Agreements | Post-employment Requirements
controls.title: Access Agreements | Post-employment Requirements
controls.body:
a. Notify individuals of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements for protection of organizational information; and
b. Require individuals to sign an acknowledgment of these requirements, if applicable, as part of granting initial access to covered information.

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.E.1 - Event Correlation Process
controls.title: Event Correlation Process
controls.body: A process is in place to correlate event information from multiple sources (e.g., network, application, or firewall).

controls.name: IR-4(6) - Incident Handling | Insider Threats
controls.title: Incident Handling | Insider Threats
controls.body: Implement an incident handling capability for incidents involving insider threats.

controls.name: MA-3(4) - Maintenance Tools | Restricted Tool Use
controls.title: Maintenance Tools | Restricted Tool Use
controls.body: Restrict the use of maintenance tools to authorized personnel only.

controls.name: PE-16 - Delivery and Removal
controls.title: Delivery and Removal
controls.body:
a. Authorize and control [Assignment: organization-defined types of system components] entering and exiting the facility; and
b. Maintain records of the system components.

controls.name: AU-11(1) - Audit Record Retention | Long-term Retrieval Capability
controls.title: Audit Record Retention | Long-term Retrieval Capability
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined measures] to ensure that long-term audit records generated by the system can be retrieved.

controls.name: MA-3(2) - Maintenance Tools | Inspect Media
controls.title: Maintenance Tools | Inspect Media
controls.body: Check media containing diagnostic and test programs for malicious code before the media are used in the system.

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.Inn.1 - Development of Due Diligence Mechanisms
controls.title: Development of Due Diligence Mechanisms
controls.body: The institution promotes sector-wide efforts to build due diligence mechanisms that lead to in-depth and efficient security and resilience reviews.

controls.name: MA-4(4) - Nonlocal Maintenance | Authentication and Separation of Maintenance Sessions
controls.title: Nonlocal Maintenance | Authentication and Separation of Maintenance Sessions
controls.body:
Protect nonlocal maintenance sessions by:

a. Employing [Assignment: organization-defined authenticators that are replay resistant]; and
b. Separating the maintenance sessions from other network sessions with the system by either:
1. Physically separated communications paths; or
2. Logically separated communications paths.

controls.name: CM-8(8) - System Component Inventory | Automated Location Tracking
controls.title: System Component Inventory | Automated Location Tracking
controls.body: Support the tracking of system components by geographic location using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.A.5 - Risk Management Stress Test
controls.title: Risk Management Stress Test
controls.body: Cybersecurity incident scenarios involving significant financial loss are used to stress test the institution's risk management.

controls.name: CP-2(1) - Contingency Plan | Coordinate with Related Plans
controls.title: Contingency Plan | Coordinate with Related Plans
controls.body: Coordinate contingency plan development with organizational elements responsible for related plans.

controls.name: AC-4(4) - Information Flow Enforcement | Flow Control of Encrypted Information
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Flow Control of Encrypted Information
controls.body: Prevent encrypted information from bypassing [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control mechanisms] by [Selection (one or more): decrypting the information; blocking the flow of the encrypted information; terminating communications sessions attempting to pass encrypted information; [Assignment: organization-defined procedure or method]].

controls.name: AC-4(9) - Information Flow Enforcement | Human Reviews
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Human Reviews
controls.body: Enforce the use of human reviews for [Assignment: organization-defined information flows] under the following conditions: [Assignment: organization-defined conditions].

controls.name: SC-45(2) - System Time Synchronization | Secondary Authoritative Time Source
controls.title: System Time Synchronization | Secondary Authoritative Time Source
controls.body:
a. Identify a secondary authoritative time source that is in a different geographic region than the primary authoritative time source; and
b. Synchronize the internal system clocks to the secondary authoritative time source if the primary authoritative time source is unavailable.

controls.name: PM-4 - Plan of Action and Milestones Process
controls.title: Plan of Action and Milestones Process
controls.body:
a. Implement a process to ensure that plans of action and milestones for the information security, privacy, and supply chain risk management programs and associated organizational systems:

1. Are developed and maintained;
2. Document the remedial information security, privacy, and supply chain risk management actions to adequately respond to risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation; and
3. Are reported in accordance with established reporting requirements.

b. Review plans of action and milestones for consistency with the organizational risk management strategy and organization-wide priorities for risk response actions.

controls.name: MP-5(3) - Media Transport | Custodians
controls.title: Media Transport | Custodians
controls.body: Employ an identified custodian during transport of system media outside of controlled areas.

controls.name: CP-2(6) - Contingency Plan | Alternate Processing and Storage Sites
controls.title: Contingency Plan | Alternate Processing and Storage Sites
controls.body: Plan for the transfer of [Selection: all; essential] mission and business functions to alternate processing and/or storage sites with minimal or no loss of operational continuity and sustain that continuity through system restoration to primary processing and/or storage sites.

controls.name: MA-2(2) - Controlled Maintenance | Automated Maintenance Activities
controls.title: Controlled Maintenance | Automated Maintenance Activities
controls.body:
a. Schedule, conduct, and document maintenance, repair, and replacement actions for the system using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms]; and
b. Produce up-to-date, accurate, and complete records of all maintenance, repair, and replacement actions requested, scheduled, in process, and completed.

controls.name: PE-3(8) - Physical Access Control | Access Control Vestibules
controls.title: Physical Access Control | Access Control Vestibules
controls.body: Employ access control vestibules at [Assignment: organization-defined locations within the facility].

controls.name: CP-3(2) - Contingency Training | Mechanisms Used in Training Environments
controls.title: Contingency Training | Mechanisms Used in Training Environments
controls.body: Employ mechanisms used in operations to provide a more thorough and realistic contingency training environment.

controls.name: IA-5(17) - Authenticator Management | Presentation Attack Detection for Biometric Authenticators
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Presentation Attack Detection for Biometric Authenticators
controls.body: Employ presentation attack detection mechanisms for biometric-based authentication.

controls.name: C - Incident Management Process
controls.title: Incident Management Process
controls.body: A formal incident management process has been established, which requires incidents (breaches) to be tracked, documented and resolved in a timely manner in accordance with the breach notification rule. The process document is reviewed and updated by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: AC-21(1) - Information Sharing | Automated Decision Support
controls.title: Information Sharing | Automated Decision Support
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms] to enforce information-sharing decisions by authorized users based on access authorizations of sharing partners and access restrictions on information to be shared.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.Int.4 - Reconfiguration of Restored Assets
controls.title: Reconfiguration of Restored Assets
controls.body: Processes are in place to ensure that restored assets are appropriately reconfigured and thoroughly tested before being placed back into operation.

controls.name: AC-4 - Information Flow Enforcement
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.body: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems based on [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control policies].

controls.name: IA-11 - Re-authentication
controls.title: Re-authentication
controls.body: Require users to re-authenticate when [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances or situations requiring re-authentication].

controls.name: CM-8 - System Component Inventory
controls.title: System Component Inventory

controls.name: CP-2 - Contingency Plan
controls.title: Contingency Plan

controls.name: K.6.48 - Revision history | Exercise Results and Actions | Exercising
controls.title: Revision history | Exercise Results and Actions | Exercising
controls.body: Attribute of K.6 Exercising

controls.name: PCI 11.3.1 - Annual External Penetration Test
controls.title: Annual External Penetration Test
controls.body: Perform external penetration testing at least annually and after any significant infrastructure or application upgrade or modification (such as an operating system upgrade, a sub-network added to the environment, or a web server added to the environment).

controls.name: CP-6(1) - Alternate Storage Site | Separation from Primary Site
controls.title: Alternate Storage Site | Separation from Primary Site
controls.body: Identify an alternate storage site that is sufficiently separated from the primary storage site to reduce susceptibility to the same threats.

controls.name: CP-6(2) - Alternate Storage Site | Recovery Time and Recovery Point Objectives
controls.title: Alternate Storage Site | Recovery Time and Recovery Point Objectives
controls.body: Configure the alternate storage site to facilitate recovery operations in accordance with recovery time and recovery point objectives.

controls.name: AC-4(31) - Information Flow Enforcement | Failed Content Transfer Prevention
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Failed Content Transfer Prevention
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, prevent the transfer of failed content to the receiving domain.

controls.name: IR-8 - Incident Response Plan
controls.title: Incident Response Plan

controls.name: K.8.3 - Terms/conditions of coverage | Business Insurance
controls.title: Terms/conditions of coverage | Business Insurance
controls.body: Attribute of K.8 Business Insurance

controls.name: IR-6 - Incident Reporting
controls.title: Incident Reporting
controls.body:
a. Require personnel to report suspected incidents to the organizational incident response capability within [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; and
b. Report incident information to [Assignment: organization-defined authorities].

controls.name: AU-7(1) - Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation | Automatic Processing
controls.title: Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation | Automatic Processing
controls.body: Provide and implement the capability to process, sort, and search audit records for events of interest based on the following content: [Assignment: organization-defined fields within audit records].

controls.name: D3.DC.An.A.4 - Insider Data Mining Detection
controls.title: Insider Data Mining Detection
controls.body: An automated tool(s) is in place to detect and prevent data mining by insider threats.

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.B.1 - Secure Programming Practices
controls.title: Secure Programming Practices
controls.body: Developers working for the institution follow secure program coding practices, as part of a system development life cycle (SDLC), that meet industry standards. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 56)

controls.name: CP-7(4) - Alternate Processing Site | Preparation for Use
controls.title: Alternate Processing Site | Preparation for Use
controls.body: Prepare the alternate processing site so that the site can serve as the operational site supporting essential mission and business functions.

controls.name: PE-5 - Access Control for Output Devices
controls.title: Access Control for Output Devices
controls.body: Control physical access to output from [Assignment: organization-defined output devices] to prevent unauthorized individuals from obtaining the output.

controls.name: 5.6 - Beheer van geheime authenticatie-informatie van gebruikers
controls.title: Beheer van geheime authenticatie-informatie van gebruikers
controls.body: Het toewijzen van geheime authenticatie­informatie behoort te worden beheerst via een formeel beheersproces.

controls.name: GC - Data Subject Rights Procedure
controls.title: Data Subject Rights Procedure
controls.body: Organization has established a data subject rights procedure that specifies rights granted to individuals with respect to their personal data. These procedures are approved by management and communicated to employees and contractors.

controls.name: MA-5(3) - Maintenance Personnel | Citizenship Requirements for Classified Systems
controls.title: Maintenance Personnel | Citizenship Requirements for Classified Systems
controls.body: Verify that personnel performing maintenance and diagnostic activities on a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information are U.S. citizens.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.Inn.2 - Development of Insider Threat Detection Technologies
controls.title: Development of Insider Threat Detection Technologies
controls.body: The institution is developing new technologies that will detect potential insider threats and block activity in real time.

controls.name: CM-6 - Configuration Settings
controls.title: Configuration Settings

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.B.1 - Prospective Vendor Risk Assessment
controls.title: Prospective Vendor Risk Assessment
controls.body: Risk-based due diligence is performed on prospective third parties before contracts are signed, including reviews of their background, reputation, financial condition, stability, and security controls. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 69)

controls.name: AC-11 - Device Lock
controls.title: Device Lock
controls.body:
a. Prevent further access to the system by [Selection (one or more): initiating a device lock after [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of inactivity; requiring the user to initiate a device lock before leaving the system unattended]; and
b. Retain the device lock until the user reestablishes access using established identification and authentication procedures.

controls.name: 5.7 - Geheime authenticatie-informatie gebruiken
controls.title: Geheime authenticatie-informatie gebruiken
controls.body:
Van gebruikers behoort te worden verlangd dat zij zich bij
het gebruiken van geheime authenticatie informatie houden aan de praktijk van de organisatie.

controls.name: MA-3(1) - Maintenance Tools | Inspect Tools
controls.title: Maintenance Tools | Inspect Tools
controls.body: Inspect the maintenance tools used by maintenance personnel for improper or unauthorized modifications.

controls.name: IR-4(4) - Incident Handling | Information Correlation
controls.title: Incident Handling | Information Correlation
controls.body: Correlate incident information and individual incident responses to achieve an organization-wide perspective on incident awareness and response.

controls.name: PE-14(1) - Environmental Controls | Automatic Controls
controls.title: Environmental Controls | Automatic Controls
controls.body: Employ the following automatic environmental controls in the facility to prevent fluctuations potentially harmful to the system: [Assignment: organization-defined automatic environmental controls].

controls.name: D5.DR.De.E.1 - Incident Detection and Alerts
controls.title: Incident Detection and Alerts
controls.body: The institution has processes to detect and alert the incident response team when potential insider activity manifests that could lead to data theft or destruction.

controls.name: AC-4(28) - Information Flow Enforcement | Linear Filter Pipelines
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Linear Filter Pipelines
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, implement a linear content filter pipeline that is enforced with discretionary and mandatory access controls.

controls.name: CP-7(6) - Alternate Processing Site | Inability to Return to Primary Site
controls.title: Alternate Processing Site | Inability to Return to Primary Site
controls.body: Plan and prepare for circumstances that preclude returning to the primary processing site.

controls.name: IR-6(1) - Incident Reporting | Automated Reporting
controls.title: Incident Reporting | Automated Reporting
controls.body: Report incidents using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: MA-4(7) - Nonlocal Maintenance | Disconnect Verification
controls.title: Nonlocal Maintenance | Disconnect Verification
controls.body: Verify session and network connection termination after the completion of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic sessions.

controls.name: PE-3(2) - Physical Access Control | Facility and Systems
controls.title: Physical Access Control | Facility and Systems
controls.body: Perform security checks [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] at the physical perimeter of the facility or system for exfiltration of information or removal of system components.

controls.name: AC-3(11) - Access Enforcement | Restrict Access to Specific Information Types
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Restrict Access to Specific Information Types
controls.body: Restrict access to data repositories containing [Assignment: organization-defined information types].

controls.name: CM-5(1) - Access Restrictions for Change | Automated Access Enforcement and Audit Records
controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change | Automated Access Enforcement and Audit Records
controls.body:
a. Enforce access restrictions using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms]; and
b. Automatically generate audit records of the enforcement actions.

controls.name: PE-12(1) - Emergency Lighting | Essential Mission and Business Functions
controls.title: Emergency Lighting | Essential Mission and Business Functions
controls.body: Provide emergency lighting for all areas within the facility supporting essential mission and business functions.

controls.name: AC-21(2) - Information Sharing | Information Search and Retrieval
controls.title: Information Sharing | Information Search and Retrieval
controls.body: Implement information search and retrieval services that enforce [Assignment: organization-defined information sharing restrictions].

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.A.3 - Insider Threat Identification
controls.title: Insider Threat Identification
controls.body: Automated tool(s) proactively identifies high-risk behavior signaling an employee who may pose an insider threat.

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.A.1 - Service Provider Security Policies
controls.title: Service Provider Security Policies
controls.body: Contracts require third-party service provider’s security policies meet or exceed those of the institution.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.E.2 - Widely Reported Events
controls.title: Widely Reported Events
controls.body: Widely reported events are used to evaluate and improve the institution's response.

controls.name: AU-12(1) - Audit Record Generation | System-wide and Time-correlated Audit Trail
controls.title: Audit Record Generation | System-wide and Time-correlated Audit Trail
controls.body: Compile audit records from [Assignment: organization-defined system components] into a system-wide (logical or physical) audit trail that is time-correlated to within [Assignment: organization-defined level of tolerance for the relationship between time stamps of individual records in the audit trail].

controls.name: IA-8 - Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users)
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users)
controls.body: Uniquely identify and authenticate non-organizational users or processes acting on behalf of non-organizational users.

controls.name: 6.1 - Beoordeling van toegangsrechten van gebruikers
controls.title: Beoordeling van toegangsrechten van gebruikers
controls.body: Eigenaren van bedrijfsmiddelen behoren toegangs­rechten van gebruikers regelmatig te beoordelen.

controls.name: SA-11(3) - Developer Testing and Evaluation | Independent Verification of Assessment Plans and Evidence
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation | Independent Verification of Assessment Plans and Evidence
controls.body:
a. Require an independent agent satisfying [Assignment: organization-defined independence criteria] to verify the correct implementation of the developer security and privacy assessment plans and the evidence produced during testing and evaluation; and
b. Verify that the independent agent is provided with sufficient information to complete the verification process or granted the authority to obtain such information.

controls.name: CM-7(9) - Least Functionality | Prohibiting The Use of Unauthorized Hardware
controls.title: Least Functionality | Prohibiting The Use of Unauthorized Hardware

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.E.1 - Incident Prioritization for Incident Response
controls.title: Incident Prioritization for Incident Response
controls.body: The incident response plan is designed to prioritize incidents, enabling a rapid response for significant cybersecurity incidents or vulnerabilities.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.E.2 - Incident Containment Process
controls.title: Incident Containment Process
controls.body: A process is in place to help contain incidents and restore operations with minimal service disruption.

controls.name: CM-7(7) - Least Functionality | Code Execution in Protected Environments
controls.title: Least Functionality | Code Execution in Protected Environments
controls.body:
Allow execution of binary or machine-executable code only in confined physical or virtual machine environments and with the explicit approval of [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] when such code is:

a. Obtained from sources with limited or no warranty; and/or
b. Without the provision of source code.

controls.name: SA-15(2) - Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Security and Privacy Tracking Tools
controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Security and Privacy Tracking Tools
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to select and employ security and privacy tracking tools for use during the development process.

controls.name: G - Processing Special Categories of Personal Data
controls.title: Processing Special Categories of Personal Data
controls.body: Organization maintains an inventory of special categories of personal data processed by the organization as well as its purpose. The documented inventory is reviewed by management on at least an annual basis and provided to legal authorities on request.

controls.name: D5.DR.De.B.1 - Incident Detection - Alert Threshold
controls.title: Incident Detection - Alert Threshold
controls.body: Alert parameters are set for detecting information security incidents that prompt mitigating actions. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 43)

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.E.4 - Updating of Firewall Rules
controls.title: Updating of Firewall Rules
controls.body: Firewall rules are updated routinely.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.E.3 - Containment Strategies for Multiple Incident Types
controls.title: Containment Strategies for Multiple Incident Types
controls.body: Containment and mitigation strategies are developed for multiple incident types (e.g., DDoS, malware).

controls.name: CM-8(9) - System Component Inventory | Assignment of Components to Systems
controls.title: System Component Inventory | Assignment of Components to Systems
controls.body:
a. Assign system components to a system; and
b. Receive an acknowledgement from [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] of this assignment.

controls.name: D4.C.Co.E.1 - Critical Business Processes Mapping
controls.title: Critical Business Processes Mapping
controls.body: Critical business processes have been mapped to the supporting external connections.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.A.1 - Incident Management and Threat Intelligence Functions
controls.title: Incident Management and Threat Intelligence Functions
controls.body: The incident management function collaborates effectively with the cyber threat intelligence function during an incident.

controls.name: AC-4(11) - Information Flow Enforcement | Configuration of Security or Privacy Policy Filters
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Configuration of Security or Privacy Policy Filters
controls.body: Provide the capability for privileged administrators to configure [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] to support different security or privacy policies.

controls.name: SA-8(25) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Economic Security
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Economic Security
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of economic security in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: N.10.1 - Records kept within 30 days | Network Logging
controls.title: Records kept within 30 days | Network Logging
controls.body: Attribute of N.10 Network Logging

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.E.4 - Containment Strategies and Notification
controls.title: Containment Strategies and Notification
controls.body: Procedures include containment strategies and notifying potentially impacted third parties.

controls.name: IR-3(3) - Incident Response Testing | Continuous Improvement
controls.title: Incident Response Testing | Continuous Improvement
controls.body:
Use qualitative and quantitative data from testing to:

a. Determine the effectiveness of incident response processes;
b. Continuously improve incident response processes; and
c. Provide incident response measures and metrics that are accurate, consistent, and in a reproducible format.

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.B.2 - Patch Testing
controls.title: Patch Testing
controls.body: Patches are tested before being applied to systems and/or software. (FFIEC Operations Booklet, page 22)

controls.name: AC-2(4) - Account Management | Automated Audit Actions
controls.title: Account Management | Automated Audit Actions
controls.body: Automatically audit account creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal actions.

controls.name: D5.DR.De.B.2 - Incident Detection - Performance Monitoring
controls.title: Incident Detection - Performance Monitoring
controls.body: System performance reports contain information that can be used as a risk indicator to detect information security incidents. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 86)

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.B.3 - Report on Security Incidents
controls.title: Report on Security Incidents
controls.body: The institution prepares an annual report of security incidents or violations for the board or an appropriate board committee. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 5)

controls.name: D5.ER.Is.E.1 - Incident Reporting to Board
controls.title: Incident Reporting to Board
controls.body: Criteria have been established for escalating cyber incidents or vulnerabilities to the board and senior management based on the potential impact and criticality of the risk.

controls.name: D4.C.Co.E.4 - Testing of Third-Party Connections
controls.title: Testing of Third-Party Connections
controls.body: Controls for primary and backup third-party connections are monitored and tested on a regular basis.

controls.name: AC-18(4) - Wireless Access | Restrict Configurations by Users
controls.title: Wireless Access | Restrict Configurations by Users
controls.body: Identify and explicitly authorize users allowed to independently configure wireless networking capabilities.

controls.name: AU-9(6) - Protection of Audit Information | Read-only Access
controls.title: Protection of Audit Information | Read-only Access
controls.body: Authorize read-only access to audit information to [Assignment: organization-defined subset of privileged users or roles].

controls.name: IA-8(6) - Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users) | Disassociability
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users) | Disassociability
controls.body: Implement the following measures to disassociate user attributes or identifier assertion relationships among individuals, credential service providers, and relying parties: [Assignment: organization-defined measures].

controls.name: AU-6(3) - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Correlate Audit Record Repositories
controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Correlate Audit Record Repositories
controls.body: Analyze and correlate audit records across different repositories to gain organization-wide situational awareness.

controls.name: C - Retention of Personal Information
controls.title: Retention of Personal Information
controls.body: The organization retains personal information consistent with its privacy commitments and as long as it is required for its intended purpose.

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.A.2 - Third-Party Exit Strategy
controls.title: Third-Party Exit Strategy
controls.body: A third-party termination/exit strategy has been established and validated with management.

controls.name: CM-3(8) - Configuration Change Control | Prevent or Restrict Configuration Changes
controls.title: Configuration Change Control | Prevent or Restrict Configuration Changes
controls.body: Prevent or restrict changes to the configuration of the system under the following circumstances: [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances].

controls.name: G - Retention of Personal Information
controls.title: Retention of Personal Information
controls.body: The organization retains personal information consistent with its privacy commitments and as long as it is required for its intended purpose.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.E.6 - Incident Records
controls.title: Incident Records
controls.body: Records are generated to support incident investigation and mitigation.

controls.name: C - Right to Access/Know
controls.title: Right to Access/Know
controls.body: Requests from consumers to access their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.Inn.3 - Development of Incident Test Environment
controls.title: Development of Incident Test Environment
controls.body: The institution is leading the development of more realistic test environments.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.Int.2 - Cyber Exercises
controls.title: Cyber Exercises
controls.body: The institution participates in sector-specific cyber exercises or scenarios (e.g., FS-ISAC Cyber Attack (against) Payment Processors (CAPP)).

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.Int.3 - Resilience Testing
controls.title: Resilience Testing
controls.body: Resilience testing is based on analysis and identification of realistic and highly likely threats as well as new and emerging threats facing the institution.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.A.1 - Resilience Testing of Critical Functions
controls.title: Resilience Testing of Critical Functions
controls.body: Resilience testing is comprehensive and coordinated across all critical business functions.

controls.name: D5.DR.De.A.2 - Specialized Security Monitoring
controls.title: Specialized Security Monitoring
controls.body: Automated tools are implemented to provide specialized security monitoring based on the risk of the assets to detect and alert incident response teams in real time.

controls.name: D5.DR.De.A.1 - Sophisticated and Adaptive Technologies
controls.title: Sophisticated and Adaptive Technologies
controls.body: Sophisticated and adaptive technologies are deployed that can detect and alert the incident response team of specific tasks when threat indicators across the enterprise indicate potential external and internal threats.

controls.name: AT-3(1) - Role-based Training | Environmental Controls
controls.title: Role-based Training | Environmental Controls
controls.body: Provide [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] with initial and [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] training in the employment and operation of environmental controls.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.E.5 - Incident Response to Vendor Incident
controls.title: Incident Response to Vendor Incident
controls.body: Processes are in place to trigger the incident response program when an incident occurs at a third party.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.E.7 - Third-Party Assistance for Incident Mitigation
controls.title: Third-Party Assistance for Incident Mitigation
controls.body: The institution calls upon third parties, as needed, to provide mitigation services.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.Int.4 - Testing of Critical Systems and Processes
controls.title: Testing of Critical Systems and Processes
controls.body: The critical online systems and processes are tested to withstand stresses for extended periods (e.g., DDoS).

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.Inn.2 - Limitation of Cyber Attacks on Production Environment
controls.title: Limitation of Cyber Attacks on Production Environment
controls.body: The technology infrastructure has been engineered to limit the effects of a cyber attack on the production environment from migrating to the backup environment (e.g., air-gapped environment and processes).

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.Inn.1 - Risk Management - Limited Disruption to Critical Services
controls.title: Risk Management - Limited Disruption to Critical Services
controls.body: The institution’s risk management of significant cyber incidents results in limited to no disruptions to critical services.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.E.8 - Analysis of Events for Lessons Learned
controls.title: Analysis of Events for Lessons Learned
controls.body: Analysis of events is used to improve the institution's security measures and policies.

controls.name: AC-17(2) - Remote Access | Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
controls.title: Remote Access | Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality and integrity of remote access sessions.

controls.name: AC-2(13) - Account Management | Disable Accounts for High-risk Individuals
controls.title: Account Management | Disable Accounts for High-risk Individuals
controls.body: Disable accounts of individuals within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of discovery of [Assignment: organization-defined significant risks].

controls.name: GC - Request for Erasure of Personal Information
controls.title: Request for Erasure of Personal Information
controls.body: Access requests from data subjects for the erasure of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon without undue days. Such requests are communicated to third parties that are involved in the processing of personal information in a timely manner.

controls.name: CP-2(2) - Contingency Plan | Capacity Planning
controls.title: Contingency Plan | Capacity Planning
controls.body: Conduct capacity planning so that necessary capacity for information processing, telecommunications, and environmental support exists during contingency operations.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.Int.1 - Incident Analysis in Early Stages
controls.title: Incident Analysis in Early Stages
controls.body: Analysis of security incidents is performed in the early stages of an intrusion to minimize the impact of the incident.

controls.name: AU-10(1) - Non-repudiation | Association of Identities
controls.title: Non-repudiation | Association of Identities
controls.body:
a. Bind the identity of the information producer with the information to [Assignment: organization-defined strength of binding]; and
b. Provide the means for authorized individuals to determine the identity of the producer of the information.

controls.name: AU-5(5) - Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Alternate Audit Logging Capability
controls.title: Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Alternate Audit Logging Capability
controls.body: An alternate audit logging capability is provided in the event of a failure in primary audit logging capability that implements [Assignment: organization-defined alternate audit logging functionality].

controls.name: AC-17(3) - Remote Access | Managed Access Control Points
controls.title: Remote Access | Managed Access Control Points
controls.body: Route remote accesses through authorized and managed network access control points.

controls.name: PM-5(1) - System Inventory | Inventory of Personally Identifiable Information
controls.title: System Inventory | Inventory of Personally Identifiable Information
controls.body: Establish, maintain, and update [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] an inventory of all systems, applications, and projects that process personally identifiable information.

controls.name: AU-16(1) - Cross-organizational Audit Logging | Identity Preservation
controls.title: Cross-organizational Audit Logging | Identity Preservation
controls.body: Preserve the identity of individuals in cross-organizational audit trails.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.Int.2 - Critical Function Continuity Plan
controls.title: Critical Function Continuity Plan
controls.body: Plans are in place to re-route or substitute critical functions and/or services that may be affected by a successful attack on Internet-facing systems.

controls.name: 6.10 - Beoordeling van technische naleving
controls.title: Beoordeling van technische naleving
controls.body: lnformatiesystemen behoren regelmatig te worden beoordeeld op naleving van de beleidsregels en normen van de organisatie voor informatiebeveiliging.

controls.name: GP - Breach Notifications to Controller
controls.title: Breach Notifications to Controller
controls.body: Notifications are provided to controller(s) regarding personal data breaches without unreasonable delay following the discovery of a breach. Data breaches are logged, tracked and resolved in a timely manner in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.

controls.name: C - Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.title: Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.body: The organization has established processes to limit the collection of personal information to the minimum that is relevant, proportional and necessary for the identified purposes.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.A.3 - Resilience Plan Improvement Process
controls.title: Resilience Plan Improvement Process
controls.body: A process is in place to continuously improve the resilience plan.

controls.name: GC - Request for Restriction/Objection on Processing
controls.title: Request for Restriction/Objection on Processing
controls.body: Access requests from data subjects for restriction or objection on processing of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon without undue days. Any such request is communicated to other data controllers or vendors also processing that information in a timely manner.

controls.name: IR-4(9) - Incident Handling | Dynamic Response Capability
controls.title: Incident Handling | Dynamic Response Capability
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined dynamic response capabilities] to respond to incidents.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.B.2 - Third-Party Involvement in Business Continuity Testing
controls.title: Third-Party Involvement in Business Continuity Testing
controls.body: Business continuity testing involves collaboration with critical third parties. (FFIEC Business Continuity Planning Booklet, page J-6)

controls.name: AU-6(9) - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Correlation with Information from Nontechnical Sources
controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Correlation with Information from Nontechnical Sources
controls.body: Correlate information from nontechnical sources with audit record information to enhance organization-wide situational awareness.

controls.name: CS - Right to Opt-out
controls.title: Right to Opt-out
controls.body: Requests from consumers to opt-out of their personal information from the sale are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: PM-17 - Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information on External Systems
controls.title: Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information on External Systems
controls.body:
a. Establish policy and procedures to ensure that requirements for the protection of controlled unclassified information that is processed, stored or transmitted on external systems, are implemented in accordance with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, policies, regulations, and standards; and
b. Review and update the policy and procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: RA-10 - Threat Hunting
controls.title: Threat Hunting
controls.body:
a. Establish and maintain a cyber threat hunting capability to:
1. Search for indicators of compromise in organizational systems; and
2. Detect, track, and disrupt threats that evade existing controls; and

b. Employ the threat hunting capability [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: AC-6(9) - Least Privilege | Log Use of Privileged Functions
controls.title: Least Privilege | Log Use of Privileged Functions
controls.body: Log the execution of privileged functions.

controls.name: M43.18 - Drawing up a list of critical strings needed for log data analysis
controls.title: Drawing up a list of critical strings needed for log data analysis
controls.body: Drawing up a list of critical strings needed for log data analysis

controls.name: D4.C.Co.B.2 - Third-Party Connections
controls.title: Third-Party Connections
controls.body: The institution ensures that third-party connections are authorized. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 17)

controls.name: C - Security and Privacy Responsibilities
controls.title: Security and Privacy Responsibilities
controls.body: The organization has designated a security and privacy official to oversee the development and implementation of security and privacy policies and procedures.

controls.name: MA-6 - Timely Maintenance
controls.title: Timely Maintenance
controls.body: Obtain maintenance support and/or spare parts for [Assignment: organization-defined system components] within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of failure.

controls.name: SA-4(5) - Acquisition Process | System, Component, and Service Configurations
controls.title: Acquisition Process | System, Component, and Service Configurations
controls.body:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:
a. Deliver the system, component, or service with [Assignment: organization-defined security configurations] implemented; and
b. Use the configurations as the default for any subsequent system, component, or service reinstallation or upgrade.

controls.name: AC-4(19) - Information Flow Enforcement | Validation of Metadata
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Validation of Metadata
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, implement [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] on metadata.

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.Int.3 - Incident Notification to the Media
controls.title: Incident Notification to the Media
controls.body: An external communication plan is used for notifying media regarding incidents when applicable.

controls.name: SA-4(12) - Acquisition Process | Data Ownership
controls.title: Acquisition Process | Data Ownership
controls.body:
a. Include organizational data ownership requirements in the acquisition contract; and
b. Require all data to be removed from the contractor’s system and returned to the organization within [Assignment: organization-defined time frame].

controls.name: PM-6 - Measures of Performance
controls.title: Measures of Performance
controls.body: Develop, monitor, and report on the results of information security and privacy measures of performance.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.Int.3 - Disposal of Non-Operational Assets
controls.title: Disposal of Non-Operational Assets
controls.body: Processes are in place to ensure assets affected by a security incident that cannot be returned to operational status are quarantined, removed, disposed of, and/or replaced.

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.B.4 - Email Protection Mechanisms
controls.title: Email Protection Mechanisms
controls.body: E-mail protection mechanisms are used to filter for common cyber threats (e.g., attached malware or malicious links). (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 39)

controls.name: IA-5(7) - Authenticator Management | No Embedded Unencrypted Static Authenticators
controls.title: Authenticator Management | No Embedded Unencrypted Static Authenticators
controls.body: Ensure that unencrypted static authenticators are not embedded in applications or other forms of static storage.

controls.name: CA-2 - Control Assessments
controls.title: Control Assessments

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.B.3 - Review of Vendors' Resilience Plans
controls.title: Review of Vendors' Resilience Plans
controls.body: Ongoing monitoring practices include reviewing critical third-parties’ resilience plans. (FFIEC Outsourcing Booklet, page 19)

controls.name: IA-10 - Adaptive Authentication
controls.title: Adaptive Authentication
controls.body: Require individuals accessing the system to employ [Assignment: organization-defined supplemental authentication techniques or mechanisms] under specific [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances or situations].

controls.name: C - Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.body: The organization has established processes to prohibit discrimination against consumers who exercised their rights under the CCPA.

controls.name: PR.DS-6 - Software Integrity Checking Mechanisms
controls.title: Software Integrity Checking Mechanisms
controls.body: Integrity checking mechanisms are used to verify software, firmware, and information integrity
