controls.name: G - EU Representatives
controls.title: EU Representatives
controls.body: Organization has designated a representative in the European Union to represent the organization regarding their obligations under the GDPR and to deal with any supervisory authorities or data subjects.

controls.name: C - Notice of Financial Incentive
controls.title: Notice of Financial Incentive
controls.body: Notice of financial incentives is given to consumers before any collection, retention, or sale of their personal information.

controls.name: CA-8(3) - Penetration Testing | Facility Penetration Testing
controls.title: Penetration Testing | Facility Penetration Testing
controls.body:
Employ a penetration testing process that includes [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]
                  [Selection: announced; unannounced] attempts to bypass or circumvent controls associated with physical access points to the facility.

controls.name: RA-5 - Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning

controls.name: PR.IP-11 - Cybersecurity in Human Resource Practices
controls.title: Cybersecurity in Human Resource Practices
controls.body: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices (e.g., deprovisioning, personnel screening)

controls.name: SA-5 - System Documentation
controls.title: System Documentation

controls.name: D4.C.Co.B.4 - Data Flow Diagram
controls.title: Data Flow Diagram
controls.body: Data flow diagrams are in place and document information flow to external parties. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 10)

controls.name: AC-12(1) - Session Termination | User-initiated Logouts
controls.title: Session Termination | User-initiated Logouts
controls.body: Provide a logout capability for user-initiated communications sessions whenever authentication is used to gain access to [Assignment: organization-defined information resources].

controls.name: AC-4(23) - Information Flow Enforcement | Modify Non-releasable Information
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Modify Non-releasable Information
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, modify non-releasable information by implementing [Assignment: organization-defined modification action].

controls.name: AC-4(24) - Information Flow Enforcement | Internal Normalized Format
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Internal Normalized Format
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, parse incoming data into an internal normalized format and regenerate the data to be consistent with its intended specification.

controls.name: SA-4(6) - Acquisition Process | Use of Information Assurance Products
controls.title: Acquisition Process | Use of Information Assurance Products
controls.body:
a. Employ only government off-the-shelf or commercial off-the-shelf information assurance and information assurance-enabled information technology products that compose an NSA-approved solution to protect classified information when the networks used to transmit the information are at a lower classification level than the information being transmitted; and
b. Ensure that these products have been evaluated and/or validated by NSA or in accordance with NSA-approved procedures.

controls.name: IA-12(3) - Identity Proofing | Identity Evidence Validation and Verification
controls.title: Identity Proofing | Identity Evidence Validation and Verification
controls.body: Require that the presented identity evidence be validated and verified through [Assignment: organizational defined methods of validation and verification].

controls.name: C - Personal Information Collection for Research
controls.title: Personal Information Collection for Research
controls.body: The organization has procedures in place relating to the collection of personal information for research purposes. Documentation related to applicable conditions for research-related collection is retained by the organization.

controls.name: PM-20 - Dissemination of Privacy Program Information
controls.title: Dissemination of Privacy Program Information
controls.body:
Maintain a central resource webpage on the organization’s principal public website that serves as a central source of information about the organization’s privacy program and that:

a. Ensures that the public has access to information about organizational privacy activities and can communicate with its senior agency official for privacy;
b. Ensures that organizational privacy practices and reports are publicly available; and
c. Employs publicly facing email addresses and/or phone lines to enable the public to provide feedback and/or direct questions to privacy offices regarding privacy practices.

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.E.2 - Cyber Incident Notification to Relevant Authorities
controls.title: Cyber Incident Notification to Relevant Authorities
controls.body: Regulators, law enforcement, and service providers, as appropriate, are notified when the institution is aware of any unauthorized access to systems or a cyber incident occurs that could result in degradation of services.

controls.name: CA-7(3) - Continuous Monitoring | Trend Analyses
controls.title: Continuous Monitoring | Trend Analyses
controls.body: Employ trend analyses to determine if control implementations, the frequency of continuous monitoring activities, and the types of activities used in the continuous monitoring process need to be modified based on empirical data.

controls.name: P.9.6 - Right to audit provisions | Third Party Privacy Agreements
controls.title: Right to audit provisions | Third Party Privacy Agreements
controls.body: Attribute of P.9 Third Party Privacy Agreements

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.E.3 - Cyber Incidents Trend Analysis
controls.title: Cyber Incidents Trend Analysis
controls.body: Tracked cyber incidents are correlated for trend analysis and reporting.

controls.name: PE-6 - Monitoring Physical Access
controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access

controls.name: AC-2(3) - Account Management | Disable Accounts
controls.title: Account Management | Disable Accounts

controls.name: PE-6(2) - Monitoring Physical Access | Automated Intrusion Recognition and Responses
controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access | Automated Intrusion Recognition and Responses
controls.body: Recognize [Assignment: organization-defined classes or types of intrusions] and initiate [Assignment: organization-defined response actions] using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: AC-2(1) - Account Management | Automated System Account Management
controls.title: Account Management | Automated System Account Management
controls.body: Support the management of system accounts using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.B.4 - Production Code Escrow Agreement
controls.title: Production Code Escrow Agreement
controls.body: Intellectual property and production code are held in escrow. (*N/A if there is no production code to hold in escrow.) (FFIEC Development and Acquisition Booklet, page 39)

controls.name: SC-48(1) - Sensor Relocation | Dynamic Relocation of Sensors or Monitoring Capabilities
controls.title: Sensor Relocation | Dynamic Relocation of Sensors or Monitoring Capabilities
controls.body: Dynamically relocate [Assignment: organization-defined sensors and monitoring capabilities] to [Assignment: organization-defined locations] under the following conditions or circumstances: [Assignment: organization-defined conditions or circumstances].

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.E.4 - Inclusion of Cybersecurity in Business Impact Analyses
controls.title: Inclusion of Cybersecurity in Business Impact Analyses
controls.body: Business impact analyses have been updated to include cybersecurity.

controls.name: GC - Access Requests from Data Subjects
controls.title: Access Requests from Data Subjects
controls.body: Access requests from data subjects to obtain, amend or review their personal information is documented, retained, and acted upon within 30 days from the receipt of the request. Any denial on request is communicated to data subjects and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: AC-4(15) - Information Flow Enforcement | Detection of Unsanctioned Information
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Detection of Unsanctioned Information
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, examine the information for the presence of [Assignment: organization-defined unsanctioned information] and prohibit the transfer of such information in accordance with the [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy].

controls.name: PE-11 - Emergency Power
controls.title: Emergency Power
controls.body: Provide an uninterruptible power supply to facilitate [Selection (one or more): an orderly shutdown of the system; transition of the system to long-term alternate power] in the event of a primary power source loss.

controls.name: AC-2(6) - Account Management | Dynamic Privilege Management
controls.title: Account Management | Dynamic Privilege Management
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined dynamic privilege management capabilities].

controls.name: AT-3(2) - Role-based Training | Physical Security Controls
controls.title: Role-based Training | Physical Security Controls
controls.body: Provide [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] with initial and [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] training in the employment and operation of physical security controls.

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.B.4 - Failure of Vendor to Meet Security Requirements
controls.title: Failure of Vendor to Meet Security Requirements
controls.body: Contracts identify the recourse available to the institution should the third party fail to meet defined security requirements. (FFIEC Outsourcing Booklet, page 12)

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.B.3 - Incident Response Team
controls.title: Incident Response Team
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for incident response team members are defined. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 84)

controls.name: SA-11(2) - Developer Testing and Evaluation | Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Analyses
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation | Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Analyses

controls.name: AU-9(2) - Protection of Audit Information | Store on Separate Physical Systems or Components
controls.title: Protection of Audit Information | Store on Separate Physical Systems or Components
controls.body: Store audit records [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] in a repository that is part of a physically different system or system component than the system or component being audited.

controls.name: 6.2 - Gebeurtenissen registreren
controls.title: Gebeurtenissen registreren
controls.body:
Logbestanden van gebeurtenissen die gebruikersactiviteiten, uitzonderin­gen en informatiebeveiligingsgebeurtenissen registreren, behoren te worden gemaakt, bewaard en
regelmatig te worden beoordeeld.

controls.name: C - Right to Request Deletion
controls.title: Right to Request Deletion
controls.body: Requests from consumers for deletion of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Such requests are communicated to third parties that have access to consumers' personal information in a timely manner.

controls.name: CS - Opt-in Consent
controls.title: Opt-in Consent
controls.body: Explicit consent ("opt-in") is obtained and maintained from consumers prior to the sale or sharing of their personal information. Consumers are provided with a mechanism to withdraw their opt-in consent, and any such requests on withdrawal are handled in a timely manner.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.B.1 - Incident Response - Lessons Learned
controls.title: Incident Response - Lessons Learned
controls.body: Appropriate steps are taken to contain and control an incident to prevent further unauthorized access to or use of customer information. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 84)

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.B.4 - Response Team Expertise
controls.title: Response Team Expertise
controls.body: The response team includes individuals with a wide range of backgrounds and expertise, from many different areas within the institution (e.g., management, legal, public relations, as well as information technology). (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 84)

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.B.2 - Incident Response - Communication to Customers and Relevant Authorities
controls.title: Incident Response - Communication to Customers and Relevant Authorities
controls.body: Procedures exist to notify customers, regulators, and law enforcement as required or necessary when the institution becomes aware of an incident involving the unauthorized access to or use of sensitive customer information. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 84)

controls.name: PE-13(1) - Fire Protection | Detection Systems — Automatic Activation and Notification
controls.title: Fire Protection | Detection Systems — Automatic Activation and Notification
controls.body: Employ fire detection systems that activate automatically and notify [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] and [Assignment: organization-defined emergency responders] in the event of a fire.

controls.name: AC-3(2) - Access Enforcement | Dual Authorization
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Dual Authorization
controls.body: Enforce dual authorization for [Assignment: organization-defined privileged commands and/or other organization-defined actions].

controls.name: SA-11(5) - Developer Testing and Evaluation | Penetration Testing
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation | Penetration Testing
controls.body:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to perform penetration testing:
a. At the following level of rigor: [Assignment: organization-defined breadth and depth of testing]; and
b. Under the following constraints: [Assignment: organization-defined constraints].

controls.name: PL-2 - System Security and Privacy Plans
controls.title: System Security and Privacy Plans

controls.name: AC-9 - Previous Logon Notification
controls.title: Previous Logon Notification
controls.body: Notify the user, upon successful logon to the system, of the date and time of the last logon.

controls.name: AC-9(3) - Previous Logon Notification | Notification of Account Changes
controls.title: Previous Logon Notification | Notification of Account Changes
controls.body: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of changes to [Assignment: organization-defined security-related characteristics or parameters of the user’s account] during [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: PE-2(3) - Physical Access Authorizations | Restrict Unescorted Access
controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations | Restrict Unescorted Access
controls.body: Restrict unescorted access to the facility where the system resides to personnel with [Selection (one or more): security clearances for all information contained within the system; formal access authorizations for all information contained within the system; need for access to all information contained within the system; [Assignment: organization-defined physical access authorizations]].

controls.name: PE-13(2) - Fire Protection | Suppression Systems — Automatic Activation and Notification
controls.title: Fire Protection | Suppression Systems — Automatic Activation and Notification
controls.body:
a. Employ fire suppression systems that activate automatically and notify [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] and [Assignment: organization-defined emergency responders]; and
b. Employ an automatic fire suppression capability when the facility is not staffed on a continuous basis.

controls.name: SA-15(1) - Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Quality Metrics
controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Quality Metrics
controls.body:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:

a. Define quality metrics at the beginning of the development process; and
b. Provide evidence of meeting the quality metrics [Selection (one or more): [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; [Assignment: organization-defined program review milestones]; upon delivery].

controls.name: SA-10(7) - Developer Configuration Management | Security and Privacy Representatives
controls.title: Developer Configuration Management | Security and Privacy Representatives
controls.body: Require [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy representatives] to be included in the [Assignment: organization-defined configuration change management and control process].

controls.name: IR-3(1) - Incident Response Testing | Automated Testing
controls.title: Incident Response Testing | Automated Testing
controls.body: Test the incident response capability using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: AC-12(2) - Session Termination | Termination Message
controls.title: Session Termination | Termination Message
controls.body: Display an explicit logout message to users indicating the termination of authenticated communications sessions.

controls.name: AC-16(2) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Value Changes by Authorized Individuals
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Value Changes by Authorized Individuals
controls.body: Provide authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) the capability to define or change the value of associated security and privacy attributes.

controls.name: AC-17(10) - Remote Access | Authenticate Remote Commands
controls.title: Remote Access | Authenticate Remote Commands
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms] to authenticate [Assignment: organization-defined remote commands].

controls.name: PE-17 - Alternate Work Site
controls.title: Alternate Work Site

controls.name: AC-16(6) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Maintenance of Attribute Association
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Maintenance of Attribute Association
controls.body: Require personnel to associate and maintain the association of [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] with [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects] in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy policies].

controls.name: AC-16(7) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Consistent Attribute Interpretation
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Consistent Attribute Interpretation
controls.body: Provide a consistent interpretation of security and privacy attributes transmitted between distributed system components.

controls.name: AC-16(9) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Reassignment — Regrading Mechanisms
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Reassignment — Regrading Mechanisms
controls.body: Change security and privacy attributes associated with information only via regrading mechanisms validated using [Assignment: organization-defined techniques or procedures].

controls.name: AC-20(2) - Use of External Systems | Portable Storage Devices — Restricted Use
controls.title: Use of External Systems | Portable Storage Devices — Restricted Use
controls.body: Restrict the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices by authorized individuals on external systems using [Assignment: organization-defined restrictions].

controls.name: AC-18 - Wireless Access
controls.title: Wireless Access
controls.body:
a. Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of wireless access; and
b. Authorize each type of wireless access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

controls.name: AC-18(3) - Wireless Access | Disable Wireless Networking
controls.title: Wireless Access | Disable Wireless Networking
controls.body: Disable, when not intended for use, wireless networking capabilities embedded within system components prior to issuance and deployment.

controls.name: AC-19 - Access Control for Mobile Devices
controls.title: Access Control for Mobile Devices
controls.body:
a. Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for organization-controlled mobile devices, to include when such devices are outside of controlled areas; and
b. Authorize the connection of mobile devices to organizational systems.

controls.name: IA-5(14) - Authenticator Management | Managing Content of PKI Trust Stores
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Managing Content of PKI Trust Stores
controls.body: For PKI-based authentication, employ an organization-wide methodology for managing the content of PKI trust stores installed across all platforms, including networks, operating systems, browsers, and applications.

controls.name: AU-13 - Monitoring for Information Disclosure
controls.title: Monitoring for Information Disclosure
controls.body:
a. Monitor [Assignment: organization-defined open-source information and/or information sites]
                  [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] for evidence of unauthorized disclosure of organizational information; and

b. If an information disclosure is discovered:
1. Notify [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; and
2. Take the following additional actions: [Assignment: organization-defined additional actions].

controls.name: AC-20(4) - Use of External Systems | Network Accessible Storage Devices — Prohibited Use
controls.title: Use of External Systems | Network Accessible Storage Devices — Prohibited Use
controls.body: Prohibit the use of [Assignment: organization-defined network accessible storage devices] in external systems.

controls.name: AC-20(5) - Use of External Systems | Portable Storage Devices — Prohibited Use
controls.title: Use of External Systems | Portable Storage Devices — Prohibited Use
controls.body: Prohibit the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices by authorized individuals on external systems.

controls.name: CA-3(7) - Information Exchange | Transitive Information Exchanges
controls.title: Information Exchange | Transitive Information Exchanges
controls.body:
a. Identify transitive (downstream) information exchanges with other systems through the systems identified in CA-3a; and
b. Take measures to ensure that transitive (downstream) information exchanges cease when the controls on identified transitive (downstream) systems cannot be verified or validated.

controls.name: AC-24 - Access Control Decisions
controls.title: Access Control Decisions
controls.body: [Selection(one or more) : Establish procedures; Implement mechanisms] to ensure [Assignment: organization-defined access control decisions] are applied to each access request prior to access enforcement.

controls.name: U. - Server Security
controls.title: Server Security
controls.body: Domain Objective: Organizations should ensure that a formalized process is in place for securely building, configuring, hardening and managing target systems.

controls.name: CA-6 - Authorization
controls.title: Authorization

controls.name: IA-2(10) - Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Single Sign-on
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Single Sign-on
controls.body: Provide a single sign-on capability for [Assignment: organization-defined system accounts and services].

controls.name: AT-2(1) - Literacy Training and Awareness | Practical Exercises
controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Practical Exercises
controls.body: Provide practical exercises in literacy training that simulate events and incidents.

controls.name: AT-6 - Training Feedback
controls.title: Training Feedback
controls.body: Provide feedback on organizational training results to the following personnel [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]: [Assignment: organization-defined personnel].

controls.name: AU-3(1) - Content of Audit Records | Additional Audit Information
controls.title: Content of Audit Records | Additional Audit Information
controls.body: Generate audit records containing the following additional information: [Assignment: organization-defined additional information].

controls.name: AU-3 - Content of Audit Records
controls.title: Content of Audit Records

controls.name: AC-7(3) - Unsuccessful Logon Attempts | Biometric Attempt Limiting
controls.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts | Biometric Attempt Limiting
controls.body: Limit the number of unsuccessful biometric logon attempts to [Assignment: organization-defined number].

controls.name: PL-7 - Concept of Operations
controls.title: Concept of Operations
controls.body:
a. Develop a Concept of Operations (CONOPS) for the system describing how the organization intends to operate the system from the perspective of information security and privacy; and
b. Review and update the CONOPS [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: AU-6(6) - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Correlation with Physical Monitoring
controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Correlation with Physical Monitoring
controls.body: Correlate information from audit records with information obtained from monitoring physical access to further enhance the ability to identify suspicious, inappropriate, unusual, or malevolent activity.

controls.name: AU-6(7) - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Permitted Actions
controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Permitted Actions
controls.body: Specify the permitted actions for each [Selection (one or more): system process; role; user] associated with the review, analysis, and reporting of audit record information.

controls.name: AU-11 - Audit Record Retention
controls.title: Audit Record Retention
controls.body: Retain audit records for [Assignment: organization-defined time period consistent with records retention policy] to provide support for after-the-fact investigations of incidents and to meet regulatory and organizational information retention requirements.

controls.name: AU-9(1) - Protection of Audit Information | Hardware Write-once Media
controls.title: Protection of Audit Information | Hardware Write-once Media
controls.body: Write audit trails to hardware-enforced, write-once media.

controls.name: AC-16(10) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Configuration by Authorized Individuals
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Configuration by Authorized Individuals
controls.body: Provide authorized individuals the capability to define or change the type and value of security and privacy attributes available for association with subjects and objects.

controls.name: CM-2(7) - Baseline Configuration | Configure Systems and Components for High-risk Areas
controls.title: Baseline Configuration | Configure Systems and Components for High-risk Areas
controls.body:
a. Issue [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] with [Assignment: organization-defined configurations] to individuals traveling to locations that the organization deems to be of significant risk; and
b. Apply the following controls to the systems or components when the individuals return from travel: [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.name: AU-9(4) - Protection of Audit Information | Access by Subset of Privileged Users
controls.title: Protection of Audit Information | Access by Subset of Privileged Users
controls.body: Authorize access to management of audit logging functionality to only [Assignment: organization-defined subset of privileged users or roles].

controls.name: AU-9(5) - Protection of Audit Information | Dual Authorization
controls.title: Protection of Audit Information | Dual Authorization
controls.body: Enforce dual authorization for [Selection (one or more): movement; deletion] of [Assignment: organization-defined audit information].

controls.name: SA-8(12) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Hierarchical Protection
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Hierarchical Protection
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of hierarchical protection in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: AU-9(7) - Protection of Audit Information | Store on Component with Different Operating System
controls.title: Protection of Audit Information | Store on Component with Different Operating System
controls.body: Store audit information on a component running a different operating system than the system or component being audited.

controls.name: AU-10(2) - Non-repudiation | Validate Binding of Information Producer Identity
controls.title: Non-repudiation | Validate Binding of Information Producer Identity
controls.body:
a. Validate the binding of the information producer identity to the information at [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; and
b. Perform [Assignment: organization-defined actions] in the event of a validation error.

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.E.2 - Board Review of Vendor Assessment
controls.title: Board Review of Vendor Assessment
controls.body: The board or an appropriate board committee reviews a summary of due diligence results including management’s recommendations to use third parties that will affect the institution’s inherent risk profile.

controls.name: AU-12(3) - Audit Record Generation | Changes by Authorized Individuals
controls.title: Audit Record Generation | Changes by Authorized Individuals
controls.body: Provide and implement the capability for [Assignment: organization-defined individuals or roles] to change the logging to be performed on [Assignment: organization-defined system components] based on [Assignment: organization-defined selectable event criteria] within [Assignment: organization-defined time thresholds].

controls.name: AU-13(1) - Monitoring for Information Disclosure | Use of Automated Tools
controls.title: Monitoring for Information Disclosure | Use of Automated Tools
controls.body: Monitor open-source information and information sites using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: AU-13(2) - Monitoring for Information Disclosure | Review of Monitored Sites
controls.title: Monitoring for Information Disclosure | Review of Monitored Sites
controls.body: Review the list of open-source information sites being monitored [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.B.2 - Annual Review of Internally Developed Software
controls.title: Annual Review of Internally Developed Software
controls.body: The security controls of internally developed software are periodically reviewed and tested. (*N/A if there is no software development.) (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 59)

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.E.3 - Risk-Based Vendor Monitoring
controls.title: Risk-Based Vendor Monitoring
controls.body: Monitoring of third parties is scaled, in terms of depth and frequency, according to the risk of the third parties.

controls.name: AU-12(4) - Audit Record Generation | Query Parameter Audits of Personally Identifiable Information
controls.title: Audit Record Generation | Query Parameter Audits of Personally Identifiable Information
controls.body: Provide and implement the capability for auditing the parameters of user query events for data sets containing personally identifiable information.

controls.name: CP-4(5) - Contingency Plan Testing | Self-challenge
controls.title: Contingency Plan Testing | Self-challenge
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms] to [Assignment: organization-defined system or system component] to disrupt and adversely affect the system or system component.

controls.name: AU-13(3) - Monitoring for Information Disclosure | Unauthorized Replication of Information
controls.title: Monitoring for Information Disclosure | Unauthorized Replication of Information
controls.body: Employ discovery techniques, processes, and tools to determine if external entities are replicating organizational information in an unauthorized manner.

controls.name: PM-25 - Minimization of Personally Identifiable Information Used in Testing, Training, and Research
controls.title: Minimization of Personally Identifiable Information Used in Testing, Training, and Research

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.E.4 - Reminders for Vendor Assessment
controls.title: Reminders for Vendor Assessment
controls.body: Automated reminders or ticklers are in place to identify when required third-party information needs to be obtained or analyzed.

controls.name: AU-16(2) - Cross-organizational Audit Logging | Sharing of Audit Information
controls.title: Cross-organizational Audit Logging | Sharing of Audit Information
controls.body: Provide cross-organizational audit information to [Assignment: organization-defined organizations] based on [Assignment: organization-defined cross-organizational sharing agreements].

controls.name: AU-16(3) - Cross-organizational Audit Logging | Disassociability
controls.title: Cross-organizational Audit Logging | Disassociability
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined measures] to disassociate individuals from audit information transmitted across organizational boundaries.

controls.name: CA-2(1) - Control Assessments | Independent Assessors
controls.title: Control Assessments | Independent Assessors
controls.body: Employ independent assessors or assessment teams to conduct control assessments.

controls.name: AC-2(12) - Account Management | Account Monitoring for Atypical Usage
controls.title: Account Management | Account Monitoring for Atypical Usage
controls.body:
a. Monitor system accounts for [Assignment: organization-defined atypical usage]; and
b. Report atypical usage of system accounts to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: CA-5(1) - Plan of Action and Milestones | Automation Support for Accuracy and Currency
controls.title: Plan of Action and Milestones | Automation Support for Accuracy and Currency
controls.body: Ensure the accuracy, currency, and availability of the plan of action and milestones for the system using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: CA-2(3) - Control Assessments | Leveraging Results from External Organizations
controls.title: Control Assessments | Leveraging Results from External Organizations
controls.body: Leverage the results of control assessments performed by [Assignment: organization-defined external organization(s)] on [Assignment: organization-defined system] when the assessment meets [Assignment: organization-defined requirements].

controls.name: CM-7(1) - Least Functionality | Periodic Review
controls.title: Least Functionality | Periodic Review
controls.body:
a. Review the system [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to identify unnecessary and/or nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, software, and services; and
b. Disable or remove [Assignment: organization-defined functions, ports, protocols, software, and services within the system deemed to be unnecessary and/or nonsecure].

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.B.1 - Network Activity Baseline
controls.title: Network Activity Baseline
controls.body: A normal network activity baseline is established. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 77)

controls.name: CA-6(2) - Authorization | Joint Authorization — Inter-organization
controls.title: Authorization | Joint Authorization — Inter-organization
controls.body: Employ a joint authorization process for the system that includes multiple authorizing officials with at least one authorizing official from an organization external to the organization conducting the authorization.

controls.name: AC-3(5) - Access Enforcement | Security-relevant Information
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Security-relevant Information
controls.body: Prevent access to [Assignment: organization-defined security-relevant information] except during secure, non-operable system states.

controls.name: CM-3(1) - Configuration Change Control | Automated Documentation, Notification, and Prohibition of Changes
controls.title: Configuration Change Control | Automated Documentation, Notification, and Prohibition of Changes

controls.name: AC-17(4) - Remote Access | Privileged Commands and Access
controls.title: Remote Access | Privileged Commands and Access
controls.body:
a. Authorize the execution of privileged commands and access to security-relevant information via remote access only in a format that provides assessable evidence and for the following needs: [Assignment: organization-defined needs]; and
b. Document the rationale for remote access in the security plan for the system.

controls.name: VM4 - Vendor Termination
controls.title: Vendor Termination
controls.body: Vendor management process has been implemented that includes security procedures to be followed in case of vendor terminations.

controls.name: CM-7(4) - Least Functionality | Unauthorized Software — Deny-by-exception
controls.title: Least Functionality | Unauthorized Software — Deny-by-exception

controls.name: V.1.5 - Connectivity diagrams | Service and Deployment Models
controls.title: Connectivity diagrams | Service and Deployment Models
controls.body: Attribute of V.1 Service and Deployment Models

controls.name: AC-3(7) - Access Enforcement | Role-based Access Control
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Role-based Access Control
controls.body: Enforce a role-based access control policy over defined subjects and objects and control access based upon [Assignment: organization-defined roles and users authorized to assume such roles].

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.B.5 - Physical Environment Monitoring
controls.title: Physical Environment Monitoring
controls.body: The physical environment is monitored to detect potential unauthorized access. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 47)

controls.name: AU-5(3) - Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Configurable Traffic Volume Thresholds
controls.title: Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Configurable Traffic Volume Thresholds
controls.body: Enforce configurable network communications traffic volume thresholds reflecting limits on audit log storage capacity and [Selection: reject; delay] network traffic above those thresholds.

controls.name: CA-9 - Internal System Connections
controls.title: Internal System Connections

controls.name: CA-8(1) - Penetration Testing | Independent Penetration Testing Agent or Team
controls.title: Penetration Testing | Independent Penetration Testing Agent or Team
controls.body: Employ an independent penetration testing agent or team to perform penetration testing on the system or system components.

controls.name: 6.11.2.8 - System Security Testing
controls.title: System Security Testing
controls.body: Testing of security functionality shall be carried out during development.

controls.name: CM-2(2) - Baseline Configuration | Automation Support for Accuracy and Currency
controls.title: Baseline Configuration | Automation Support for Accuracy and Currency
controls.body: Maintain the currency, completeness, accuracy, and availability of the baseline configuration of the system using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: AC-9(4) - Previous Logon Notification | Additional Logon Information
controls.title: Previous Logon Notification | Additional Logon Information
controls.body: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the following additional information: [Assignment: organization-defined additional information].

controls.name: AC-3(10) - Access Enforcement | Audited Override of Access Control Mechanisms
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Audited Override of Access Control Mechanisms
controls.body: Employ an audited override of automated access control mechanisms under [Assignment: organization-defined conditions] by [Assignment: organization-defined roles].

controls.name: CM-3 - Configuration Change Control
controls.title: Configuration Change Control

controls.name: CM-4(2) - Impact Analyses | Verification of Controls
controls.title: Impact Analyses | Verification of Controls
controls.body: After system changes, verify that the impacted controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended, and producing the desired outcome with regard to meeting the security and privacy requirements for the system.

controls.name: CM-3(4) - Configuration Change Control | Security and Privacy Representatives
controls.title: Configuration Change Control | Security and Privacy Representatives
controls.body: Require [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy representatives] to be members of the [Assignment: organization-defined configuration change control element].

controls.name: PCI 5.2 - Anti-virus Updates and Logs
controls.title: Anti-virus Updates and Logs
controls.body:
Ensure that all anti-virus mechanisms are maintained as follows:·
- Are kept current,·
- Perform periodic scans·
- Generate audit logs which are retained per PCI DSS Requirement 10.7.

controls.name: D4.C.Co.B.3 - Network Diagram
controls.title: Network Diagram
controls.body: A network diagram is in place and identifies all external connections. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 9)

controls.name: CM-4(1) - Impact Analyses | Separate Test Environments
controls.title: Impact Analyses | Separate Test Environments
controls.body: Analyze changes to the system in a separate test environment before implementation in an operational environment, looking for security and privacy impacts due to flaws, weaknesses, incompatibility, or intentional malice.

controls.name: CM-5 - Access Restrictions for Change
controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change
controls.body: Define, document, approve, and enforce physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to the system.

controls.name: CM-5(6) - Access Restrictions for Change | Limit Library Privileges
controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change | Limit Library Privileges
controls.body: Limit privileges to change software resident within software libraries.

controls.name: AU-14(1) - Session Audit | System Start-up
controls.title: Session Audit | System Start-up
controls.body: Initiate session audits automatically at system start-up.

controls.name: AU-10(3) - Non-repudiation | Chain of Custody
controls.title: Non-repudiation | Chain of Custody
controls.body: Maintain reviewer or releaser credentials within the established chain of custody for information reviewed or released.

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.B.2 - Vendor Responsibility for Security of Shared Data
controls.title: Vendor Responsibility for Security of Shared Data
controls.body: Contracts acknowledge that the third party is responsible for the security of the institution’s confidential data that it possesses, stores, processes, or transmits. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 12)

controls.name: AC-3(14) - Access Enforcement | Individual Access
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Individual Access
controls.body: Provide [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms] to enable individuals to have access to the following elements of their personally identifiable information: [Assignment: organization-defined elements].

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.B.3 - Review of Vendor Security Controls
controls.title: Review of Vendor Security Controls
controls.body: Contracts stipulate that the third-party security controls are regularly reviewed and validated by an independent party. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 12)

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.B.6 - Data Destruction Requirements
controls.title: Data Destruction Requirements
controls.body: Contracts specify the security requirements for the return or destruction of data upon contract termination. (FFIEC Outsourcing Booklet, page 15)

controls.name: CM-7(6) - Least Functionality | Confined Environments with Limited Privileges
controls.title: Least Functionality | Confined Environments with Limited Privileges
controls.body: Require that the following user-installed software execute in a confined physical or virtual machine environment with limited privileges: [Assignment: organization-defined user-installed software].

controls.name: CA-5 - Plan of Action and Milestones
controls.title: Plan of Action and Milestones
controls.body:
a. Develop a plan of action and milestones for the system to document the planned remediation actions of the organization to correct weaknesses or deficiencies noted during the assessment of the controls and to reduce or eliminate known vulnerabilities in the system; and
b. Update existing plan of action and milestones [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] based on the findings from control assessments, independent audits or reviews, and continuous monitoring activities.

controls.name: CM-7(5) - Least Functionality | Authorized Software — Allow-by-exception
controls.title: Least Functionality | Authorized Software — Allow-by-exception

controls.name: AC-3(15) - Access Enforcement | Discretionary and Mandatory Access Control
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Discretionary and Mandatory Access Control
controls.body:
a. Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined mandatory access control policy] over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy; and
b. Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined discretionary access control policy] over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy.

controls.name: CM-8(6) - System Component Inventory | Assessed Configurations and Approved Deviations
controls.title: System Component Inventory | Assessed Configurations and Approved Deviations
controls.body: Include assessed component configurations and any approved deviations to current deployed configurations in the system component inventory.

controls.name: CIS 9.1-PR - Browsers and Email Clients
controls.title: Browsers and Email Clients
controls.body:
Email and Web Browser Protections
Safeguard 9.1: Ensure use of only fully supported browsers and email clients.

controls.name: IR-2(3) - Incident Response Training | Breach
controls.title: Incident Response Training | Breach
controls.body: Provide incident response training on how to identify and respond to a breach, including the organization’s process for reporting a breach.

controls.name: CA-7(1) - Continuous Monitoring | Independent Assessment
controls.title: Continuous Monitoring | Independent Assessment
controls.body: Employ independent assessors or assessment teams to monitor the controls in the system on an ongoing basis.

controls.name: AC-3(4) - Access Enforcement | Discretionary Access Control
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Discretionary Access Control

controls.name: CM-8(1) - System Component Inventory | Updates During Installation and Removal
controls.title: System Component Inventory | Updates During Installation and Removal
controls.body: Update the inventory of system components as part of component installations, removals, and system updates.

controls.name: AU-6 - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting

controls.name: CA-7(6) - Continuous Monitoring | Automation Support for Monitoring
controls.title: Continuous Monitoring | Automation Support for Monitoring
controls.body: Ensure the accuracy, currency, and availability of monitoring results for the system using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: CM-10(1) - Software Usage Restrictions | Open-source Software
controls.title: Software Usage Restrictions | Open-source Software
controls.body: Establish the following restrictions on the use of open-source software: [Assignment: organization-defined restrictions].

controls.name: CM-11 - User-installed Software
controls.title: User-installed Software

controls.name: CM-10 - Software Usage Restrictions
controls.title: Software Usage Restrictions

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.B.2 - Internal Incident Communication Channels
controls.title: Internal Incident Communication Channels
controls.body: Communication channels exist to provide employees a means for reporting information security events in a timely manner. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 83)

controls.name: CM-2(3) - Baseline Configuration | Retention of Previous Configurations
controls.title: Baseline Configuration | Retention of Previous Configurations
controls.body: Retain [Assignment: organization-defined number] of previous versions of baseline configurations of the system to support rollback.

controls.name: CP-8(3) - Telecommunications Services | Separation of Primary and Alternate Providers
controls.title: Telecommunications Services | Separation of Primary and Alternate Providers
controls.body: Obtain alternate telecommunications services from providers that are separated from primary service providers to reduce susceptibility to the same threats.

controls.name: AC-4(1) - Information Flow Enforcement | Object Security and Privacy Attributes
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Object Security and Privacy Attributes
controls.body: Use [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] associated with [Assignment: organization-defined information, source, and destination objects] to enforce [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control policies] as a basis for flow control decisions.

controls.name: CM-12(1) - Information Location | Automated Tools to Support Information Location
controls.title: Information Location | Automated Tools to Support Information Location
controls.body: Use automated tools to identify [Assignment: organization-defined information by information type] on [Assignment: organization-defined system components] to ensure controls are in place to protect organizational information and individual privacy.

controls.name: AC-16(3) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Maintenance of Attribute Associations by System
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Maintenance of Attribute Associations by System
controls.body: Maintain the association and integrity of [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] to [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects].

controls.name: AC-4(2) - Information Flow Enforcement | Processing Domains
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Processing Domains
controls.body: Use protected processing domains to enforce [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control policies] as a basis for flow control decisions.

controls.name: AC-4(3) - Information Flow Enforcement | Dynamic Information Flow Control
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Dynamic Information Flow Control
controls.body: Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control policies].

controls.name: CP-2(5) - Contingency Plan | Continue Mission and Business Functions
controls.title: Contingency Plan | Continue Mission and Business Functions
controls.body: Plan for the continuance of [Selection(one): all; essential] mission and business functions with minimal or no loss of operational continuity and sustains that continuity until full system restoration at primary processing and/or storage sites.

controls.name: D5.ER.Is.B.1 - Incident Response - Communication to Relevant Personnel
controls.title: Incident Response - Communication to Relevant Personnel
controls.body: A process exists to contact personnel who are responsible for analyzing and responding to an incident. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 83)

controls.name: CP-2(7) - Contingency Plan | Coordinate with External Service Providers
controls.title: Contingency Plan | Coordinate with External Service Providers
controls.body: Coordinate the contingency plan with the contingency plans of external service providers to ensure that contingency requirements can be satisfied.

controls.name: CP-4(1) - Contingency Plan Testing | Coordinate with Related Plans
controls.title: Contingency Plan Testing | Coordinate with Related Plans
controls.body: Coordinate contingency plan testing with organizational elements responsible for related plans.

controls.name: CP-3(1) - Contingency Training | Simulated Events
controls.title: Contingency Training | Simulated Events
controls.body: Incorporate simulated events into contingency training to facilitate effective response by personnel in crisis situations.

controls.name: CP-4 - Contingency Plan Testing
controls.title: Contingency Plan Testing
controls.body:
a. Test the contingency plan for the system [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] using  the following tests to determine the effectiveness of the plan and the readiness to execute the plan: [Assignment: organization-defined tests].
b. Review the contingency plan test results; and
c. Initiate corrective actions, if needed.

controls.name: CP-4(3) - Contingency Plan Testing | Automated Testing
controls.title: Contingency Plan Testing | Automated Testing
controls.body: Test the contingency plan using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: CP-4(4) - Contingency Plan Testing | Full Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.title: Contingency Plan Testing | Full Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.body: Include a full recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state as part of contingency plan testing.

controls.name: AC-4(6) - Information Flow Enforcement | Metadata
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Metadata
controls.body: Enforce information flow control based on [Assignment: organization-defined metadata].

controls.name: CP-6(3) - Alternate Storage Site | Accessibility
controls.title: Alternate Storage Site | Accessibility
controls.body: Identify potential accessibility problems to the alternate storage site in the event of an area-wide disruption or disaster and outline explicit mitigation actions.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.Int.1 - Analysis of Cyber Attack Scenarios
controls.title: Analysis of Cyber Attack Scenarios
controls.body: Cyber-attack scenarios are analyzed to determine potential impact to critical business processes.

controls.name: CP-10(6) - System Recovery and Reconstitution | Component Protection
controls.title: System Recovery and Reconstitution | Component Protection
controls.body: Protect system components used for recovery and reconstitution.

controls.name: IA-4(6) - Identifier Management | Cross-organization Management
controls.title: Identifier Management | Cross-organization Management
controls.body: Coordinate with the following external organizations for cross-organization management of identifiers: [Assignment: organization-defined external organizations].

controls.name: CM-7(8) - Least Functionality | Binary or Machine Executable Code
controls.title: Least Functionality | Binary or Machine Executable Code
controls.body:
a. Prohibit the use of binary or machine-executable code from sources with limited or no warranty or without the provision of source code; and
b. Allow exceptions only for compelling mission or operational requirements and with the approval of the authorizing official.

controls.name: CP-8(5) - Telecommunications Services | Alternate Telecommunication Service Testing
controls.title: Telecommunications Services | Alternate Telecommunication Service Testing
controls.body: Test alternate telecommunication services [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: CP-7(1) - Alternate Processing Site | Separation from Primary Site
controls.title: Alternate Processing Site | Separation from Primary Site
controls.body: Identify an alternate processing site that is sufficiently separated from the primary processing site to reduce susceptibility to the same threats.

controls.name: CP-9(5) - System Backup | Transfer to Alternate Storage Site
controls.title: System Backup | Transfer to Alternate Storage Site
controls.body: Transfer system backup information to the alternate storage site [Assignment: organization-defined time period and transfer rate consistent with the recovery time and recovery point objectives].

controls.name: CP-7(2) - Alternate Processing Site | Accessibility
controls.title: Alternate Processing Site | Accessibility
controls.body: Identify potential accessibility problems to alternate processing sites in the event of an area-wide disruption or disaster and outlines explicit mitigation actions.

controls.name: CP-8(2) - Telecommunications Services | Single Points of Failure
controls.title: Telecommunications Services | Single Points of Failure
controls.body: Obtain alternate telecommunications services to reduce the likelihood of sharing a single point of failure with primary telecommunications services.

controls.name: CP-8 - Telecommunications Services
controls.title: Telecommunications Services
controls.body: Establish alternate telecommunications services, including necessary agreements to permit the resumption of [Assignment: organization-defined system operations] for essential mission and business functions within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] when the primary telecommunications capabilities are unavailable at either the primary or alternate processing or storage sites.

controls.name: CP-10(2) - System Recovery and Reconstitution | Transaction Recovery
controls.title: System Recovery and Reconstitution | Transaction Recovery
controls.body: Implement transaction recovery for systems that are transaction-based.

controls.name: AC-4(10) - Information Flow Enforcement | Enable and Disable Security or Privacy Policy Filters
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Enable and Disable Security or Privacy Policy Filters
controls.body: Provide the capability for privileged administrators to enable and disable [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] under the following conditions: [Assignment: organization-defined conditions].

controls.name: CP-11 - Alternate Communications Protocols
controls.title: Alternate Communications Protocols
controls.body: Provide the capability to employ [Assignment: organization-defined alternative communications protocols] in support of maintaining continuity of operations.

controls.name: CP-9(1) - System Backup | Testing for Reliability and Integrity
controls.title: System Backup | Testing for Reliability and Integrity
controls.body: Test backup information [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to verify media reliability and information integrity.

controls.name: M43.19 - Implementation of certified timestamps in log entries
controls.title: Implementation of certified timestamps in log entries
controls.body: Implementation of certified timestamps in log entries

controls.name: CP-9(2) - System Backup | Test Restoration Using Sampling
controls.title: System Backup | Test Restoration Using Sampling
controls.body: Use a sample of backup information in the restoration of selected system functions as part of contingency plan testing.

controls.name: AU-7 - Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation
controls.title: Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation
controls.body:
Provide and implement an audit record reduction and report generation capability that:

a. Supports on-demand audit record review, analysis, and reporting requirements and after-the-fact investigations of incidents; and
b. Does not alter the original content or time ordering of audit records.

controls.name: AC-16(4) - Security and Privacy Attributes | Association of Attributes by Authorized Individuals
controls.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Association of Attributes by Authorized Individuals
controls.body: Provide the capability to associate [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] with [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects] by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals).

controls.name: CP-10(4) - System Recovery and Reconstitution | Restore Within Time Period
controls.title: System Recovery and Reconstitution | Restore Within Time Period
controls.body: Provide the capability to restore system components within [Assignment: organization-defined restoration time periods] from configuration-controlled and integrity-protected information representing a known, operational state for the components.

controls.name: CP-9(8) - System Backup | Cryptographic Protection
controls.title: System Backup | Cryptographic Protection
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure and modification of [Assignment: organization-defined backup information].

controls.name: AU-3(3) - Content of Audit Records | Limit Personally Identifiable Information Elements
controls.title: Content of Audit Records | Limit Personally Identifiable Information Elements
controls.body: Limit personally identifiable information contained in audit records to the following elements identified in the privacy risk assessment: [Assignment: organization-defined elements].

controls.name: AC-18(1) - Wireless Access | Authentication and Encryption
controls.title: Wireless Access | Authentication and Encryption
controls.body: Protect wireless access to the system using authentication of [Selection (one or more): users; devices] and encryption.

controls.name: CIS 2.2-ID - Authorized Software
controls.title: Authorized Software
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard 2.2: Ensure authorized software is currently supported.

controls.name: AC-4(12) - Information Flow Enforcement | Data Type Identifiers
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Data Type Identifiers
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, use [Assignment: organization-defined data type identifiers] to validate data essential for information flow decisions.

controls.name: MP-4 - Media Storage
controls.title: Media Storage
controls.body:
a. Physically control and securely store [Assignment: organization-defined types of digital and/or non-digital media] within [Assignment: organization-defined controlled areas]; and
b. Protect system media types defined in MP-4a until the media are destroyed or sanitized using approved equipment, techniques, and procedures.

controls.name: AC-4(5) - Information Flow Enforcement | Embedded Data Types
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Embedded Data Types
controls.body: Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined limitations] on embedding data types within other data types.

controls.name: AU-8 - Time Stamps
controls.title: Time Stamps
controls.body:
a. Use internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records; and
b. Record time stamps for audit records that meet [Assignment: organization-defined granularity of time measurement] and that use Coordinated Universal Time, have a fixed local time offset from Coordinated Universal Time, or that include the local time offset as part of the time stamp.

controls.name: IA-2(2) - Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Multi-factor Authentication to Non-privileged Accounts
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Multi-factor Authentication to Non-privileged Accounts
controls.body: Implement multi-factor authentication for access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.name: 6.3 - Logbestanden van beheerders en operators
controls.title: Logbestanden van beheerders en operators
controls.body: Activiteiten van systeembeheerders en -operators behoren te worden vastgelegd en de logbestanden behoren te worden beschermd en regelmatig te worden be­oordeeld.

controls.name: AC-4(13) - Information Flow Enforcement | Decomposition into Policy-relevant Subcomponents
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Decomposition into Policy-relevant Subcomponents
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, decompose information into [Assignment: organization-defined policy-relevant subcomponents] for submission to policy enforcement mechanisms.

controls.name: IA-2(5) - Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Individual Authentication with Group Authentication
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Individual Authentication with Group Authentication
controls.body: When shared accounts or authenticators are employed, require users to be individually authenticated before granting access to the shared accounts or resources.

controls.name: IA-2(8) - Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Access to Accounts — Replay Resistant
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Access to Accounts — Replay Resistant
controls.body: Implement replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for access to [Selection (one or more): privileged accounts; non-privileged accounts].

controls.name: AU-10 - Non-repudiation
controls.title: Non-repudiation
controls.body: Provide irrefutable evidence that an individual (or process acting on behalf of an individual) has performed [Assignment: organization-defined actions to be covered by non-repudiation].

controls.name: IA-2(12) - Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Acceptance of PIV Credentials
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Acceptance of PIV Credentials
controls.body: Accept and electronically verify Personal Identity Verification-compliant credentials.

controls.name: WS1 - Antivirus Software and Firewall - Workstation
controls.title: Antivirus Software and Firewall - Workstation
controls.body: Security software (firewall, anti-virus and anti-spam) is installed and enabled on all workstations.

controls.name: IA-3(1) - Device Identification and Authentication | Cryptographic Bidirectional Authentication
controls.title: Device Identification and Authentication | Cryptographic Bidirectional Authentication
controls.body: Authenticate [Assignment: organization-defined devices and/or types of devices] before establishing [Selection (one or more): local; remote; network] connection using bidirectional authentication that is cryptographically based.

controls.name: IA-3(4) - Device Identification and Authentication | Device Attestation
controls.title: Device Identification and Authentication | Device Attestation
controls.body: Handle device identification and authentication based on attestation by [Assignment: organization-defined configuration management process].

controls.name: 6.4 - Uitbestede softwareontwikkeling
controls.title: Uitbestede softwareontwikkeling
controls.body: Uitbestede systeemontwikkeling behoort ender supervisie te staan van en te worden gemonitord door de organisatie.

controls.name: PCI A3.2.4 - Penetration Testing on Segmented Controls
controls.title: Penetration Testing on Segmented Controls
controls.body:
If segmentation is used, confirm PCI DSS scope by performing penetration testing on segmentation controls at least every six months and after any changes to segmentation controls/methods.
PCI DSS Reference: Requirement 11

controls.name: HS - Vulnerability Scanning (R)
controls.title: Vulnerability Scanning (R)
controls.body: A vulnerability scan (external and internal) is performed on a quarterly basis to identify system vulnerabilities containing PHI. Issues identified are analyzed and remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: AC-4(7) - Information Flow Enforcement | One-way Flow Mechanisms
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | One-way Flow Mechanisms
controls.body: Enforce one-way information flows through hardware-based flow control mechanisms.

controls.name: A.15.1.2 - Addressing Security within Supplier Agreements
controls.title: Addressing Security within Supplier Agreements
controls.body: All relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier that may access, process, store, communicate, or provide IT infrastructure components for, the organization’s information.

controls.name: CP-7(3) - Alternate Processing Site | Priority of Service
controls.title: Alternate Processing Site | Priority of Service
controls.body: Develop alternate processing site agreements that contain priority-of-service provisions in accordance with availability requirements (including recovery time objectives).

controls.name: 6.5 - Testen van systeembeveiliging
controls.title: Testen van systeembeveiliging
controls.body: Tijdens ontwikkelactiviteiten behoort de beveiligingsfunctionaliteit te warden getest.

controls.name: IM6 - Lesson Learned from Incident Response Activities
controls.title: Lesson Learned from Incident Response Activities
controls.body: Management incorporates lessons learned from ongoing incident response activities into incident response procedures on an ongoing basis.

controls.name: SI-7(9) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Verify Boot Process
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Verify Boot Process
controls.body: Verify the integrity of the boot process of the following system components: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.name: 6.6 - Systeemacceptatietests
controls.title: Systeemacceptatietests
controls.body: Voor nieuwe informatiesystemen, upgrades en nieuwe versies behoren pro­gramma's voor het uitvoeren van acceptatietests en gerelateerde criteria te warden vastgesteld.

controls.name: SO8 - Intrusion Detection and Prevention System
controls.title: Intrusion Detection and Prevention System
controls.body: Intrusion detection or prevention systems are used to provide continuous monitoring of the company's network and to protect potential security breaches.

controls.name: DORA-45-002 Reporting Information Sharing To Competent Authorities
controls.title: DORA-45-002 Reporting Information Sharing To Competent Authorities
controls.body: Procedures for notifying competent authorities of data-sharing arrangements with participating entities, validation of their membership, as well as cessation of their membership are established and implemented.

controls.name: SS6 - Privileged Accounts for Serverless Functions
controls.title: Privileged Accounts for Serverless Functions
controls.body: The generic administrator or privileged account access to a serverless architecture function is restricted to authorized personnel.

controls.name: AC-4(14) - Information Flow Enforcement | Security or Privacy Policy Filter Constraints
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Security or Privacy Policy Filter Constraints
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, implement [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] requiring fully enumerated formats that restrict data structure and content.

controls.name: IA-4(4) - Identifier Management | Identify User Status
controls.title: Identifier Management | Identify User Status
controls.body: Manage individual identifiers by uniquely identifying each individual as [Assignment: organization-defined characteristic identifying individual status].

controls.name: IA-4(5) - Identifier Management | Dynamic Management
controls.title: Identifier Management | Dynamic Management
controls.body: Manage individual identifiers dynamically in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined dynamic identifier policy].

controls.name: ID.GV-2 - Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities are coordinated and aligned with internal roles and external partners

controls.name: ID.GV-3 - Cybersecurity Legal and Regulatory Requirements
controls.title: Cybersecurity Legal and Regulatory Requirements
controls.body: Legal and regulatory requirements regarding cybersecurity, including privacy and civil liberties obligations, are understood and managed

controls.name: IA-4(1) - Identifier Management | Prohibit Account Identifiers as Public Identifiers
controls.title: Identifier Management | Prohibit Account Identifiers as Public Identifiers
controls.body: Prohibit the use of system account identifiers that are the same as public identifiers for individual accounts.

controls.name: IA-5(5) - Authenticator Management | Change Authenticators Prior to Delivery
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Change Authenticators Prior to Delivery
controls.body: Require developers and installers of system components to provide unique authenticators or change default authenticators prior to delivery and installation.

controls.name: AC-4(22) - Information Flow Enforcement | Access Only
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Access Only
controls.body: Provide access from a single device to computing platforms, applications, or data residing in multiple different security domains, while preventing information flow between the different security domains.

controls.name: IA-5(8) - Authenticator Management | Multiple System Accounts
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Multiple System Accounts
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined security controls] to manage the risk of compromise due to individuals having accounts on multiple systems.

controls.name: HP - Uses and Disclosure of PHI by Business Associate (R)
controls.title: Uses and Disclosure of PHI by Business Associate (R)
controls.body: Permitted and required uses or disclosures of protected health information by a business associate is defined in the business associate agreement/contract and implemented accordingly.

controls.name: IR-4 - Incident Handling
controls.title: Incident Handling

controls.name: IR-4(3) - Incident Handling | Continuity of Operations
controls.title: Incident Handling | Continuity of Operations
controls.body: Identify [Assignment: organization-defined classes of incidents] and take the following actions in response to those incidents to ensure continuation of organizational mission and business functions: [Assignment: organization-defined actions to take in response to classes of incidents].

controls.name: IA-5(16) - Authenticator Management | In-person or Trusted External Party Authenticator Issuance
controls.title: Authenticator Management | In-person or Trusted External Party Authenticator Issuance
controls.body: Require that the issuance of [Assignment: organization-defined types of and/or specific authenticators] be conducted [Selection(one): in person; by a trusted external party] before [Assignment: organization-defined registration authority] with authorization by [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: AA3 - Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
controls.body: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enforced for user accounts with administrative access to the organization's production platform.

controls.name: IA-5(15) - Authenticator Management | Gsa-approved Products and Services
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Gsa-approved Products and Services
controls.body: Use only General Services Administration-approved products and services for identity, credential, and access management.

controls.name: AC-4(26) - Information Flow Enforcement | Audit Filtering Actions
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Audit Filtering Actions
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, record and audit content filtering actions and results for the information being filtered.

controls.name: IA-5(9) - Authenticator Management | Federated Credential Management
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Federated Credential Management
controls.body: Use the following external organizations to federate credentials: [Assignment: organization-defined external organizations].

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.Int.1 - Testing of Patches for High-Risk Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Testing of Patches for High-Risk Vulnerabilities
controls.body: Patches for high-risk vulnerabilities are tested and applied when released or the risk is accepted and accountability assigned.

controls.name: AU-4(1) - Audit Log Storage Capacity | Transfer to Alternate Storage
controls.title: Audit Log Storage Capacity | Transfer to Alternate Storage
controls.body: Transfer audit logs [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to a different system, system component, or media other than the system or system component conducting the logging.

controls.name: IA-8(4) - Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users) | Use of Defined Profiles
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users) | Use of Defined Profiles
controls.body: Conform to the following profiles for identity management [Assignment: organization-defined identity management profiles].

controls.name: IR-4(8) - Incident Handling | Correlation with External Organizations
controls.title: Incident Handling | Correlation with External Organizations
controls.body: Coordinate with [Assignment: organization-defined external organizations] to correlate and share [Assignment: organization-defined incident information] to achieve a cross-organization perspective on incident awareness and more effective incident responses.

controls.name: IA-8(1) - Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users) | Acceptance of PIV Credentials from Other Agencies
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users) | Acceptance of PIV Credentials from Other Agencies
controls.body: Accept and electronically verify Personal Identity Verification-compliant credentials from other federal agencies.

controls.name: D3.CC.Re.Int.3 - Forensic Investigation
controls.title: Forensic Investigation
controls.body: Security investigations, forensic analysis, and remediation are performed by qualified staff or third parties.

controls.name: TBL5 - Vendor Management
controls.title: TBL5 - Vendor Management
controls.body: The organization has a formalized process for assessing vendor risk and evaluating vendor performance on an annual basis. Corrective actions are taken as required based on the results of the assessments.

controls.name: SA-4(10) - Acquisition Process | Use of Approved PIV Products
controls.title: Acquisition Process | Use of Approved PIV Products
controls.body: Employ only information technology products on the FIPS 201-approved products list for Personal Identity Verification (PIV) capability implemented within organizational systems.

controls.name: §164.530(c) - Implementation of Safeguards
controls.title: §164.530(c) - Implementation of Safeguards
controls.body: Organization has implemented applicable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect the privacy of protected health information. An assessment over the effectiveness and efficiency of implemented safeguards is reviewed by management on at least an annual basis and identified deficiencies are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: SSPA42 - Data Loss Prevention Program
controls.title: SSPA42 - Data Loss Prevention Program
controls.body: The organization has employed a Data Loss Prevention (“DLP”) program to prevent intrusions, loss, and other unauthorized activity.

controls.name: CC3.1.1 - Risk Assessment Procedures
controls.title: CC3.1.1 - Risk Assessment Procedures
controls.body: The Entity maintains a formal Risk Assessment and Management program, including policies and procedures governing the periodic and ongoing Risk Assessment procedures.

controls.name: CC2.3.3 - System Description
controls.title: CC2.3.3 - System Description
controls.body:
