System descriptions are made available to authorized external users that delineate the boundaries of the system and describe relevant system components as well as the purpose and design of the system.
Documentation of the system description is made available to authorized customers, as well as to end users via the entity's customer-facing website and mobile application.

controls.name: 6.7 - Monitoring en beoordeling van dienstverlening van leveranciers
controls.title: Monitoring en beoordeling van dienstverlening van leveranciers
controls.body: Organisaties behoren regelmatig de dienstverlening van leveranciers te monitoren, te beoordelen en te auditen.

controls.name: CC1.2.2 - Board of Directors Charter
controls.title: CC1.2.2 - Board of Directors Charter
controls.body: The board of directors Charter and Corporate Governance Guidelines outlines the independence rules and number of members necessary to objectively evaluate and assist with decision making process.

controls.name: CC6.2.1 - Documented Access Control Policy
controls.title: CC6.2.1 - Documented Access Control Policy
controls.body: The Entity has a documented Access Control Policy that defines user access maintenance and system security controls and procedures based on the concepts of role-based access and the principle of least privilege.

controls.name: CC7.3.2 - Incident Management
controls.title: CC7.3.2 - Incident Management
controls.body: Internal and external users are informed of incidents in a timely manner and advised of corrective measure to be taken on their part.

controls.name: CC9.2.1 - Vendor Management Process
controls.title: CC9.2.1 - Vendor Management Process
controls.body: As part of the third-party vendor management process, management periodically reviews the performance of vendor entities by verifying that they maintain their relevant certifications [SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001:2013, PCI-DSS, and E.U.-U.S. and Swiss-U.S. Privacy Shield, Etc.] by reviewing security and privacy control documentation captured in SOC 1 reports, SOC 2 reports, or other system and organizational documents, to validate the design and operating effectiveness of vendor controls. Vendor reviews are completed by the Information Security team, and instances of vendor non-compliance are reported to the management team as they are discovered.

controls.name: CC6.2.2 - New Employee Access
controls.title: CC6.2.2 - New Employee Access
controls.body: New employee access to the Entity systems are initiated through the new hire process. Requests are reviewed for proper approval and appropriateness then completed by IT.

controls.name: CC9.2.3 - Third-Party Vendor Assessments
controls.title: CC9.2.3 - Third-Party Vendor Assessments
controls.body: Formal documentation of third-party vendor assessments are preserved for compliance purposes.

controls.name: DORA-19-01 Incident and Threat Reporting
controls.title: DORA-19-01 Incident and Threat Reporting
controls.body:
a) Major ICT-related incidents are reported to relevant competent authorities in a timely manner. 

b) Voluntary notification, on significant cyber threats, are sent to relevant competent authorities.

c) An estimation of aggregated annual costs and losses caused by major ICT-related incidents are reported to competent authorities upon their request

d) Changes implemented based on post ICT-related incident reviews, are communicated to competent authorities, upon their request.

controls.name: PCI 9.9 - Device Protection
controls.title: PCI 9.9 - Device Protection
controls.body:
Protect devices that capture payment card data via direct physical interaction with the card from tampering and substitution.

Note: These requirements apply to card-reading devices used in card-present transactions (that is, card swipe or dip) at the point of sale. This requirement is not intended to apply to manual key-entry components such as computer keyboards and POS keypads.

- 9.9.1   Maintain an up-to-date list of devices. 
The list should include the following:

    * Make, model of device.
    * Location of device (for example, the address of the site or facility where the device is located).
    * Device serial number or other method of unique identification.

- 9.9.2   Periodically inspect device surfaces to detect tampering (for example, addition of card skimmers to devices), or substitution (for example, by checking the serial number or other device characteristics to verify it has not been swapped with a fraudulent device).

     Note: Examples of signs that a device might have been tampered with or substituted include unexpected attachments or cables plugged into the device, missing or changed security labels, broken or differently coloured casing, or changes to the serial number or other external markings.

- 9.9.3   Provide training for personnel to be aware of attempted tampering or replacement of devices. 
   Training should include the following:

  * Verify the identity of any third-party persons claiming to be repair or maintenance personnel, prior to granting them access to modify or troubleshoot devices.
  * Do not install, replace, or return devices without verification.
  * Be aware of suspicious behavior around devices (for example, attempts by unknown persons to unplug or open devices).
  * Report suspicious behavior and indications of device tampering or substitution to appropriate personnel (for example, to a manager or security officer).

controls.name: § 64(3)(10) - Zuverlässigkeit
controls.title: Zuverlässigkeit
controls.body: Gewährleistung, dass alle Funktionen des Systems zur Verfügung stehen und auftretende Fehlfunktionen gemeldet werden

controls.name: § 64(3)(5) - Zugriffskontrolle
controls.title: Zugriffskontrolle
controls.body: Gewährleistung, dass die zur Benutzung eines automatisierten Verarbeitungssystems Berechtigten ausschließlich zu den von ihrer Zugangsberechtigung umfassten personenbezogenen Daten Zugang haben

controls.name: § 64(3)(6) - Übertragungskontrolle
controls.title: Übertragungskontrolle
controls.body: Gewährleistung, dass überprüft und festgestellt werden kann, an welche Stellen personenbezogene Daten mit Hilfe von Einrichtungen zur Datenübertragung übermittelt oder zur Verfügung gestellt wurden oder werden können

controls.name: § 64(3)(7) - Eingabekontrolle
controls.title: Eingabekontrolle
controls.body: Gewährleistung, dass nachträglich überprüft und festgestellt werden kann, welche personenbezogenen Daten zu welcher Zeit und von wem in automatisierte Verarbeitungssysteme eingegeben oder verändert worden sind

controls.name: § 64(3)(8) - Transportkontrolle
controls.title: Transportkontrolle
controls.body: Gewährleistung, dass bei der Übermittlung personenbezogener Daten sowie beim Transport von Datenträgern die Vertraulichkeit und Integrität der Daten geschützt werden

controls.name: § 64(3)(9) - Wiederherstellbarkeit
controls.title: Wiederherstellbarkeit
controls.body: Gewährleistung, dass eingesetzte Systeme im Störungsfall wiederhergestellt werden können

controls.name: D1.5 - Transparency
controls.title: Transparency
controls.body:
Documentation in the sense of an inventory of all processing activities according to Art. 30 GDPR.
 Documentation of components of processing activities, in particular business processes, databases, data flows and networks, IT systems used, operating procedures, descriptions of processing activities, interaction with other processing activities.
 Documentation of tests, release and, where appropriate, data protection -Following new or modified processing activities.
 Documenting the factors used for profiling, scoring or semi-automated decision-making. Documentation of testing, approval and, where appropriate, prior checking of new or modified procedures.
 Documentation of the contracts with internal employees; contracts with externalservice providers and third parties, from which data are collected or transferred to;business distribution plans and and jurisdiction rules
 Documentation of consent, objections, and revokations
 Documentation of the processing activities by means of protocols on the basis of logging and evaluation
 Documentation of the sources of data, for example, the implementation of the obligations ot inform the data subjects, where their data was collected and the handling of data breaches
 Notifying data subjects of data breaches or further processing for another purpose
 Traceability of the activities of the responsible body for the granting of data subjects' rights
 Version control
 Consideration of the data subject's rights in the logging and evaluation concept
 Rules to control processes for the change or modification of procedures

controls.title: Strip Invisible Metadata
controls.body:
