controls.name: SA-3(3) - System Development Life Cycle | Technology Refresh
controls.title: System Development Life Cycle | Technology Refresh
controls.body: Plan for and implement a technology refresh schedule for the system throughout the system development life cycle.

controls.name: CA-2(2) - Control Assessments | Specialized Assessments
controls.title: Control Assessments | Specialized Assessments
controls.body: Include as part of control assessments, [Assignment: organization-defined frequency], [Selection: announced; unannounced], [Selection (one or more): in-depth monitoring; security instrumentation; automated security test cases; vulnerability scanning; malicious user testing; insider threat assessment; performance and load testing; data leakage or data loss assessment; [Assignment: organization-defined other forms of assessment]].

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.Int.1 - Data Transmission Detection Tools
controls.title: Data Transmission Detection Tools
controls.body: Controls or tools (e.g., data loss prevention) are in place to detect potential unauthorized or unintentional transmissions of confidential data.

controls.name: SA-4(11) - Acquisition Process | System of Records
controls.title: Acquisition Process | System of Records
controls.body: Include [Assignment: organization-defined Privacy Act requirements] in the acquisition contract for the operation of a system of records on behalf of an organization to accomplish an organizational mission or function.

controls.name: SA-8(1) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Clear Abstractions
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Clear Abstractions
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of clear abstractions.

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.E.1 - Patch Management Process
controls.title: Patch Management Process
controls.body: A formal process is in place to acquire, test, and deploy software patches based on criticality.

controls.name: SA-8 - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles
controls.body: Apply the following systems security and privacy engineering principles in the specification, design, development, implementation, and modification of the system and system components: [Assignment: organization-defined systems security and privacy engineering principles].

controls.name: PT-7(1) - Specific Categories of Personally Identifiable Information | Social Security Numbers
controls.title: Specific Categories of Personally Identifiable Information | Social Security Numbers
controls.body:
When a system processes Social Security numbers:

a. Eliminate unnecessary collection, maintenance, and use of Social Security numbers, and explore alternatives to their use as a personal identifier;
b. Do not deny any individual any right, benefit, or privilege provided by law because of such individual’s refusal to disclose his or her Social Security number; and
c. Inform any individual who is asked to disclose his or her Social Security number whether that disclosure is mandatory or voluntary, by what statutory or other authority such number is solicited, and what uses will be made of it.

controls.name: SA-8(17) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Distributed Composition
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Distributed Composition
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of secure distributed composition in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(15) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Predicate Permission
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Predicate Permission
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of predicate permission in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: CM-3(5) - Configuration Change Control | Automated Security Response
controls.title: Configuration Change Control | Automated Security Response
controls.body: Implement the following security responses automatically if baseline configurations are changed in an unauthorized manner: [Assignment: organization-defined security responses].

controls.name: SA-8(7) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Reduced Complexity
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Reduced Complexity
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of reduced complexity in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(9) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Trusted Components
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Trusted Components
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of trusted components in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: PS-6(2) - Access Agreements | Classified Information Requiring Special Protection
controls.title: Access Agreements | Classified Information Requiring Special Protection
controls.body:
Verify that access to classified information requiring special protection is granted only to individuals who:

a. Have a valid access authorization that is demonstrated by assigned official government duties;
b. Satisfy associated personnel security criteria; and
c. Have read, understood, and signed a nondisclosure agreement.

controls.name: CM-7(2) - Least Functionality | Prevent Program Execution
controls.title: Least Functionality | Prevent Program Execution
controls.body: Prevent program execution in accordance with [Selection (one or more): [Assignment: organization-defined policies, rules of behavior, and/or access agreements regarding software program usage and restrictions]; rules authorizing the terms and conditions of software program usage].

controls.name: CM-11(3) - User-installed Software | Automated Enforcement and Monitoring
controls.title: User-installed Software | Automated Enforcement and Monitoring
controls.body: Enforce and monitor compliance with software installation policies using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: SA-8(11) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Inverse Modification Threshold
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Inverse Modification Threshold
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of inverse modification threshold in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: CA-3 - Information Exchange
controls.title: Information Exchange

controls.name: SA-10(5) - Developer Configuration Management | Mapping Integrity for Version Control
controls.title: Developer Configuration Management | Mapping Integrity for Version Control
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to maintain the integrity of the mapping between the master build data describing the current version of security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware and the on-site master copy of the data for the current version.

controls.name: RA-5(10) - Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Correlate Scanning Information
controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Correlate Scanning Information
controls.body: Correlate the output from vulnerability scanning tools to determine the presence of multi-vulnerability and multi-hop attack vectors.

controls.name: SA-8(18) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Trusted Communications Channels
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Trusted Communications Channels
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of trusted communications channels in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.E.4 - Identification of Missing Patches
controls.title: Identification of Missing Patches
controls.body: An automated tool(s) is used to identify missing security patches as well as the number of days since each patch became available.

controls.name: CA-7(5) - Continuous Monitoring | Consistency Analysis
controls.title: Continuous Monitoring | Consistency Analysis
controls.body: Employ the following actions to validate that policies are established and implemented controls are operating in a consistent manner: [Assignment: organization-defined actions].

controls.name: MP-5 - Media Transport
controls.title: Media Transport

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.E.5 - Tracking of Missing Patches
controls.title: Tracking of Missing Patches
controls.body: Missing patches across all environments are prioritized and tracked.

controls.name: D3.PC.De.A.1 - Quarantine of Vulnerable Devices
controls.title: Quarantine of Vulnerable Devices
controls.body: Employees’ and third parties’ devices (including mobile) without the latest security patches are quarantined and patched before the device is granted access to the network.

controls.name: SA-8(28) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Acceptable Security
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Acceptable Security
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of acceptable security in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(27) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Human Factored Security
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Human Factored Security
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of human factored security in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-10(6) - Developer Configuration Management | Trusted Distribution
controls.title: Developer Configuration Management | Trusted Distribution
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to execute procedures for ensuring that security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware updates distributed to the organization are exactly as specified by the master copies.

controls.name: PM-18 - Privacy Program Plan
controls.title: Privacy Program Plan

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.Inn.2 - Development of New Auditable Processes
controls.title: Development of New Auditable Processes
controls.body: The institution is leading efforts to develop new auditable processes and for conducting due diligence and ongoing monitoring of cybersecurity risks posed by third parties.

controls.name: PM-20(1) - Dissemination of Privacy Program Information | Privacy Policies on Websites, Applications, and Digital Services
controls.title: Dissemination of Privacy Program Information | Privacy Policies on Websites, Applications, and Digital Services
controls.body:
Develop and post privacy policies on all external-facing websites, mobile applications, and other digital services, that:

a. Are written in plain language and organized in a way that is easy to understand and navigate;
b. Provide information needed by the public to make an informed decision about whether and how to interact with the organization; and
c. Are updated whenever the organization makes a substantive change to the practices it describes and includes a time/date stamp to inform the public of the date of the most recent changes.

controls.name: CA-9(1) - Internal System Connections | Compliance Checks
controls.title: Internal System Connections | Compliance Checks
controls.body: Perform security and privacy compliance checks on constituent system components prior to the establishment of the internal connection.

controls.name: SA-9(7) - External System Services | Organization-controlled Integrity Checking
controls.title: External System Services | Organization-controlled Integrity Checking
controls.body: Provide the capability to check the integrity of information while it resides in the external system.

controls.name: D3.CC.Re.Int.4 - Evidence Collection in Forensic Investigations
controls.title: Evidence Collection in Forensic Investigations
controls.body: Generally accepted and appropriate forensic procedures, including chain of custody, are used to gather and present evidence to support potential legal action.

controls.name: RA-6 - Technical Surveillance Countermeasures Survey
controls.title: Technical Surveillance Countermeasures Survey
controls.body:
Employ a technical surveillance countermeasures survey at [Assignment: organization-defined locations]
               [Selection (one or more): [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; when the following events or indicators occur: [Assignment: organization-defined events or indicators]].

controls.name: SA-9(6) - External System Services | Organization-controlled Cryptographic Keys
controls.title: External System Services | Organization-controlled Cryptographic Keys
controls.body: Maintain exclusive control of cryptographic keys for encrypted material stored or transmitted through an external system.

controls.name: SA-10(2) - Developer Configuration Management | Alternative Configuration Management Processes
controls.title: Developer Configuration Management | Alternative Configuration Management Processes
controls.body: Provide an alternate configuration management process using organizational personnel in the absence of a dedicated developer configuration management team.

controls.name: D3.CC.Re.Int.5 - Asset Maintenance
controls.title: Asset Maintenance
controls.body: The maintenance and repair of organizational assets are performed by authorized individuals with approved and controlled tools.

controls.name: SA-10(1) - Developer Configuration Management | Software and Firmware Integrity Verification
controls.title: Developer Configuration Management | Software and Firmware Integrity Verification
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to enable integrity verification of software and firmware components.

controls.name: SA-11 - Developer Testing and Evaluation
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation

controls.name: SA-11(1) - Developer Testing and Evaluation | Static Code Analysis
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation | Static Code Analysis
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to employ static code analysis tools to identify common flaws and document the results of the analysis.

controls.name: D3.CC.Re.Int.6 - Logging of Asset Maintenance
controls.title: Logging of Asset Maintenance
controls.body: The maintenance and repair of organizational assets are logged in a timely manner.

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.A.2 - Penetration Testing - Detection of Control Gaps
controls.title: Penetration Testing - Detection of Control Gaps
controls.body: Penetration tests include cyber attack simulations and/or real-world tactics and techniques such as red team testing to detect control gaps in employee behavior, security defenses, policies, and resources.

controls.name: CA-8(2) - Penetration Testing | Red Team Exercises
controls.title: Penetration Testing | Red Team Exercises
controls.body: Employ the following red-team exercises to simulate attempts by adversaries to compromise organizational systems in accordance with applicable rules of engagement: [Assignment: organization-defined red team exercises].

controls.name: PL-9 - Central Management
controls.title: Central Management
controls.body: Centrally manage [Assignment: organization-defined controls and related processes].

controls.name: PM-21 - Accounting of Disclosures
controls.title: Accounting of Disclosures
controls.body:
a. Develop and maintain an accurate accounting of disclosures of personally identifiable information, including:

1. Date, nature, and purpose of each disclosure; and
2. Name and address, or other contact information of the individual or organization to which the disclosure was made;

b. Retain the accounting of disclosures for the length of the time the personally identifiable information is maintained or five years after the disclosure is made, whichever is longer; and
c. Make the accounting of disclosures available to the individual to whom the personally identifiable information relates upon request.

controls.name: SA-11(6) - Developer Testing and Evaluation | Attack Surface Reviews
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation | Attack Surface Reviews
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to perform attack surface reviews.

controls.name: SA-11(7) - Developer Testing and Evaluation | Verify Scope of Testing and Evaluation
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation | Verify Scope of Testing and Evaluation
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to verify that the scope of testing and evaluation provides complete coverage of the required controls at the following level of rigor: [Assignment: organization-defined breadth and depth of testing and evaluation].

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.Inn.1 - Promotion of Sector-wide Effort
controls.title: Promotion of Sector-wide Effort
controls.body: The institution promotes a sector-wide effort to influence contractual requirements for critical third parties to the industry.

controls.name: SA-11(9) - Developer Testing and Evaluation | Interactive Application Security Testing
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation | Interactive Application Security Testing
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to employ interactive application security testing tools to identify flaws and document the results.

controls.name: D4.C.Co.Int.1 - Data Diagrams
controls.title: Data Diagrams
controls.body: A validated asset inventory is used to create comprehensive diagrams depicting data repositories, data flow, infrastructure, and connectivity.

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.A.1 - Tracking of Third-Party Access on Third-Party Systems
controls.title: Tracking of Third-Party Access on Third-Party Systems
controls.body: Third-party employee access to confidential data on third-party hosted systems is tracked actively via automated reports and alerts.

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.A.2 - Proactive Incident Response
controls.title: Proactive Incident Response
controls.body: Links between threat intelligence, network operations, and incident response allow for proactive response to potential incidents.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.Inn.1 - Incident Response - Recovery and Data Integrity
controls.title: Incident Response - Recovery and Data Integrity
controls.body: The incident response plan is designed to ensure recovery from disruption of services, assurance of data integrity, and recovery of lost or corrupted data following a cybersecurity incident.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.A.1 - Alerts for Anomalous Customer Logins
controls.title: Alerts for Anomalous Customer Logins
controls.body: An automated tool triggers system and/or fraud alerts when customer logins occur within a short period of time but from physically distant IP locations.

controls.name: D4.C.Co.Int.3 - External Connection Monitoring
controls.title: External Connection Monitoring
controls.body: Monitoring controls cover all external connections (e.g., third-party service providers, business partners, customers).

controls.name: PE-3(1) - Physical Access Control | System Access
controls.title: Physical Access Control | System Access
controls.body: Enforce physical access authorizations to the system in addition to the physical access controls for the facility at [Assignment: organization-defined physical spaces containing one or more components of the system].

controls.name: D3.DC.An.A.2 - Monitoring of External Transfers
controls.title: Monitoring of External Transfers
controls.body: External transfers from customer accounts generate alerts and require review and authorization if anomalous behavior is detected.

controls.name: PM-27 - Privacy Reporting
controls.title: Privacy Reporting
controls.body:
a. Develop [Assignment: organization-defined privacy reports] and disseminate to:

1. [Assignment: organization-defined oversight bodies] to demonstrate accountability with statutory, regulatory, and policy privacy mandates; and
2. [Assignment: organization-defined officials] and other personnel with responsibility for monitoring privacy program compliance; and

b. Review and update privacy reports [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: D3.DC.An.A.3 - Employee Behavior Monitoring
controls.title: Employee Behavior Monitoring
controls.body: A system is in place to monitor and analyze employee behavior (network use patterns, work hours, and known devices) to alert on anomalous activities.

controls.name: PM-28 - Risk Framing
controls.title: Risk Framing

controls.name: SA-4(8) - Acquisition Process | Continuous Monitoring Plan for Controls
controls.title: Acquisition Process | Continuous Monitoring Plan for Controls
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to produce a plan for continuous monitoring of control effectiveness that is consistent with the continuous monitoring program of the organization.

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.E.1 - Evaluation of Vendor Cybersecurity Controls
controls.title: Evaluation of Vendor Cybersecurity Controls
controls.body: A formal process exists to analyze assessments of third-party cybersecurity controls.

controls.name: APP 4.1 - Collection, Use, Disclosure, Retention and Destruction of Unsolicited Personal Information (PI)
controls.title: Collection, Use, Disclosure, Retention and Destruction of Unsolicited Personal Information (PI)
controls.body:
The organization or agency has developed a process for receiving and handling unsolicited personal information, that includes:
a. Determining whether the information could have otherwise been collected;
b. Destroying or de-identifying the information in certain circumstances; and 
c. Dealing with the information in accordance with the APPs 5-13.

controls.name: CM-2 - Baseline Configuration
controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and maintain under configuration control, a current baseline configuration of the system; and
b. Review and update the baseline configuration of the system:

1. [Assignment: organization-defined frequency];
2. When required due to [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances]; and
3. When system components are installed or upgraded.

controls.name: PL-4(1) - Rules of Behavior | Social Media and External Site/Application Usage Restrictions
controls.title: Rules of Behavior | Social Media and External Site/Application Usage Restrictions
controls.body:
Include in the rules of behavior, restrictions on:

a. Use of social media, social networking sites, and external sites/applications;
b. Posting organizational information on public websites; and
c. Use of organization-provided identifiers (e.g., email addresses) and authentication secrets (e.g., passwords) for creating accounts on external sites/applications.

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.E.1 - Documented Contract for Device Management
controls.title: Documented Contract for Device Management
controls.body: Responsibilities for managing devices (e.g., firewalls, routers) that secure connections with third parties are formally documented in the contract.

controls.name: CM-2(6) - Baseline Configuration | Development and Test Environments
controls.title: Baseline Configuration | Development and Test Environments
controls.body: Maintain a baseline configuration for system development and test environments that is managed separately from the operational baseline configuration.

controls.name: PE-6(3) - Monitoring Physical Access | Video Surveillance
controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access | Video Surveillance

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.E.2 - Security Incident Notification in Vendor Contracts
controls.title: Security Incident Notification in Vendor Contracts
controls.body: Responsibility for notification of direct and indirect security incidents and vulnerabilities is documented in contracts or service-level agreements (SLAs).

controls.name: PL-8(1) - Security and Privacy Architectures | Defense in Depth
controls.title: Security and Privacy Architectures | Defense in Depth
controls.body:
Design the security and privacy architectures for the system using a defense-in-depth approach that:

a. Allocates [Assignment: organization-defined controls] to [Assignment: organization-defined locations and architectural layers]; and
b. Ensures that the allocated controls operate in a coordinated and mutually reinforcing manner.

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.E.3 - Data Storage and Transmission Restrictions in Vendor Contracts
controls.title: Data Storage and Transmission Restrictions in Vendor Contracts
controls.body: Contracts stipulate geographic limits on where data can be stored or transmitted.

controls.name: CM-3(7) - Configuration Change Control | Review System Changes
controls.title: Configuration Change Control | Review System Changes
controls.body: Review changes to the system [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or when [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances] to determine whether unauthorized changes have occurred.

controls.name: PE-3 - Physical Access Control
controls.title: Physical Access Control

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.Int.2 - Periodic On-Site Vendor Assessments
controls.title: Periodic On-Site Vendor Assessments
controls.body: Periodic on-site assessments of high-risk vendors are conducted to ensure appropriate security controls are in place.

controls.name: CM-3(6) - Configuration Change Control | Cryptography Management
controls.title: Configuration Change Control | Cryptography Management
controls.body: Ensure that cryptographic mechanisms used to provide the following controls are under configuration management: [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.A.1 - Patch Monitoring Software
controls.title: Patch Monitoring Software
controls.body: Patch monitoring software is installed on all servers to identify any missing patches for the operating system software, middleware, database, and other key software.

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.E.1 - Identification of New Vendor Relationships
controls.title: Identification of New Vendor Relationships
controls.body: A process to identify new third-party relationships is in place, including identifying new relationships that were established without formal approval.

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.Inn.2 - Leading Development of Insider Threat Detection Technologies
controls.title: Leading Development of Insider Threat Detection Technologies
controls.body: The institution is leading the development effort to design new technologies that will detect potential insider threats and block activity in real time.

controls.name: CM-4 - Impact Analyses
controls.title: Impact Analyses
controls.body: Analyze changes to the system to determine potential security and privacy impacts prior to change implementation.

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.A.2 - Monitoring of Patch Management Reports
controls.title: Monitoring of Patch Management Reports
controls.body: The institution monitors patch management reports to ensure security patches are tested and implemented within aggressive time frames (e.g., 0-30 days).

controls.name: CM-6(1) - Configuration Settings | Automated Management, Application, and Verification
controls.title: Configuration Settings | Automated Management, Application, and Verification
controls.body: Manage, apply, and verify configuration settings for [Assignment: organization-defined system components] using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: CM-7 - Least Functionality
controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.body:
a. Configure the system to provide only [Assignment: organization-defined mission essential capabilities]; and
b. Prohibit or restrict the use of the following functions, ports, protocols, software, and/or services: [Assignment: organization-defined prohibited or restricted functions, system ports, protocols, software, and/or services].

controls.name: AC-3(9) - Access Enforcement | Controlled Release
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Controlled Release
controls.body:
Release information outside of the system only if:

a. The receiving [Assignment: organization-defined system or system component] provides [Assignment: organization-defined controls]; and
b. [Assignment: organization-defined controls] are used to validate the appropriateness of the information designated for release.

controls.name: AC-3(12) - Access Enforcement | Assert and Enforce Application Access
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Assert and Enforce Application Access

controls.name: CM-8(2) - System Component Inventory | Automated Maintenance
controls.title: System Component Inventory | Automated Maintenance
controls.body: Maintain the currency, completeness, accuracy, and availability of the inventory of system components using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: MP-6 - Media Sanitization
controls.title: Media Sanitization
controls.body:
a. Sanitize [Assignment: organization-defined system media] prior to disposal, release out of organizational control, or release for reuse using [Assignment: organization-defined sanitization techniques and procedures]; and
b. Employ sanitization mechanisms with the strength and integrity commensurate with the security category or classification of the information.

controls.name: SI-2(6) - Flaw Remediation | Removal of Previous Versions of Software and Firmware
controls.title: Flaw Remediation | Removal of Previous Versions of Software and Firmware
controls.body: Remove previous versions of [Assignment: organization-defined software and firmware components] after updated versions have been installed.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.Int.4 - Lessons Learned from Cyber Incidents
controls.title: Lessons Learned from Cyber Incidents
controls.body: Lessons learned from real-life cyber incidents and attacks on the institution and other organizations are used to improve the institution’s risk mitigation capabilities and response plan.

controls.name: MP-6(3) - Media Sanitization | Nondestructive Techniques
controls.title: Media Sanitization | Nondestructive Techniques
controls.body: Apply nondestructive sanitization techniques to portable storage devices prior to connecting such devices to the system under the following circumstances: [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances requiring sanitization of portable storage devices].

controls.name: CM-8(7) - System Component Inventory | Centralized Repository
controls.title: System Component Inventory | Centralized Repository
controls.body: Provide a centralized repository for the inventory of system components.

controls.name: PS-3(3) - Personnel Screening | Information Requiring Special Protective Measures
controls.title: Personnel Screening | Information Requiring Special Protective Measures
controls.body:
Verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting information requiring special protection:

a. Have valid access authorizations that are demonstrated by assigned official government duties; and
b. Satisfy [Assignment: organization-defined additional personnel screening criteria].

controls.name: D5.DR.De.Int.5 - Incident Detection - Event Correlation
controls.title: Incident Detection - Event Correlation
controls.body: Incident detection processes are capable of correlating events across the enterprise.

controls.name: CM-9(1) - Configuration Management Plan | Assignment of Responsibility
controls.title: Configuration Management Plan | Assignment of Responsibility
controls.body: Assign responsibility for developing the configuration management process to organizational personnel that are not directly involved in system development.

controls.name: CIS 9.7-PR - Email Server Anti-malware
controls.title: Email Server Anti-malware
controls.body:
Email and Web Browser Protections
Safeguard 9.7: Deploy and maintain email server anti-malware protections.

controls.name: CM-12 - Information Location
controls.title: Information Location

controls.name: CM-13 - Data Action Mapping
controls.title: Data Action Mapping
controls.body: Develop and document a map of system data actions.

controls.name: D5.DR.De.Inn.1 - Zero-Day Attack Protection
controls.title: Zero-Day Attack Protection
controls.body: The institution is able to detect and block zero-day attempts and inform management and the incident response team in real time.

controls.name: AC-4(8) - Information Flow Enforcement | Security and Privacy Policy Filters
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Security and Privacy Policy Filters
controls.body:
a. Enforce information flow control using [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] as a basis for flow control decisions for [Assignment: organization-defined information flows]; and
b. [Selection (one or more): Block; Strip; Modify; Quarantine] data after a filter processing failure in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy].

controls.name: CM-14 - Signed Components
controls.title: Signed Components
controls.body: Prevent the installation of [Assignment: organization-defined software and firmware components] without verification that the component has been digitally signed using a certificate that is recognized and approved by the organization.

controls.name: AC-4(32) - Information Flow Enforcement | Process Requirements for Information Transfer
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Process Requirements for Information Transfer

controls.name: MP-7(2) - Media Use | Prohibit Use of Sanitization-resistant Media
controls.title: Media Use | Prohibit Use of Sanitization-resistant Media
controls.body: Prohibit the use of sanitization-resistant media in organizational systems.

controls.name: CP-3 - Contingency Training
controls.title: Contingency Training
controls.body:
a. Provide contingency training to system users consistent with assigned roles and responsibilities:

1. Within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of assuming a contingency role or responsibility;
2. When required by system changes; and
3. [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] thereafter; and

b. Review and update contingency training content [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: AC-8 - System Use Notification
controls.title: System Use Notification

controls.name: MP-7 - Media Use
controls.title: Media Use
controls.body:
a. [Selection(one): Restrict; Prohibit] the use of [Assignment: organization-defined types of system media] on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] using [Assignment: organization-defined controls]; and
b. Prohibit the use of portable storage devices in organizational systems when such devices have no identifiable owner.

controls.name: CP-6 - Alternate Storage Site
controls.title: Alternate Storage Site
controls.body:
a. Establish an alternate storage site, including necessary agreements to permit the storage and retrieval of system backup information; and
b. Ensure that the alternate storage site provides controls equivalent to that of the primary site.

controls.name: CP-7 - Alternate Processing Site
controls.title: Alternate Processing Site

controls.name: AC-19(4) - Access Control for Mobile Devices | Restrictions for Classified Information
controls.title: Access Control for Mobile Devices | Restrictions for Classified Information
controls.body:
a. Prohibit the use of unclassified mobile devices in facilities containing systems processing, storing, or transmitting classified information unless specifically permitted by the authorizing official; and

b. Enforce the following restrictions on individuals permitted by the authorizing official to use unclassified mobile devices in facilities containing systems processing, storing, or transmitting classified information:
1. Connection of unclassified mobile devices to classified systems is prohibited;
2. Connection of unclassified mobile devices to unclassified systems requires approval from the authorizing official;
3. Use of internal or external modems or wireless interfaces within the unclassified mobile devices is prohibited; and
4. Unclassified mobile devices and the information stored on those devices are subject to random reviews and inspections by [Assignment: organization-defined security officials], and if classified inform

c. Restrict the connection of classified mobile devices to classified systems in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined security policies].

controls.name: D4.RM.Co.B.5 - Incident Response Responsibilities in Contracts
controls.title: Incident Response Responsibilities in Contracts
controls.body: Contracts establish responsibilities for responding to security incidents. (FFIEC E-Banking Booklet, page 22)

controls.name: PE-19 - Information Leakage
controls.title: Information Leakage
controls.body: Protect the system from information leakage due to electromagnetic signals emanations.

controls.name: IR-9 - Information Spillage Response
controls.title: Information Spillage Response

controls.name: PE-2 - Physical Access Authorizations
controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations

controls.name: CP-9(3) - System Backup | Separate Storage for Critical Information
controls.title: System Backup | Separate Storage for Critical Information
controls.body: Store backup copies of [Assignment: organization-defined critical system software and other security-related information] in a separate facility or in a fire rated container that is not collocated with the operational system.

controls.name: CP-9(7) - System Backup | Dual Authorization for Deletion or Destruction
controls.title: System Backup | Dual Authorization for Deletion or Destruction
controls.body: Enforce dual authorization for the deletion or destruction of [Assignment: organization-defined backup information].

controls.name: SA-4(9) - Acquisition Process | Functions, Ports, Protocols, and Services in Use
controls.title: Acquisition Process | Functions, Ports, Protocols, and Services in Use
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to identify the functions, ports, protocols, and services intended for organizational use.

controls.name: CP-10 - System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.title: System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.body: Provide for the recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state within [Assignment: organization-defined time period consistent with recovery time and recovery point objectives] after a disruption, compromise, or failure.

controls.name: MA-5(1) - Maintenance Personnel | Individuals Without Appropriate Access
controls.title: Maintenance Personnel | Individuals Without Appropriate Access
controls.body:
a. Implement procedures for the use of maintenance personnel that lack appropriate security clearances or are not U.S. citizens, that include the following requirements:
1. Maintenance personnel who do not have needed access authorizations, clearances, or formal access approvals are escorted and supervised during the performance of maintenance and diagnostic activities on the system by approved organizational personnel who are fully cleared, have appropriate access authorizations, and are technically qualified; and
2. Prior to initiating maintenance or diagnostic activities by personnel who do not have needed access authorizations, clearances or formal access approvals, all volatile information storage components within the system are sanitized and all nonvolatile storage media are removed or physically disconnected from the system and secured; and

b. Develop and implement [Assignment: organization-defined alternate controls] in the event a system component cannot be sanitized, removed, or disconnected from the system.

controls.name: CP-13 - Alternative Security Mechanisms
controls.title: Alternative Security Mechanisms
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined alternative or supplemental security mechanisms] for satisfying [Assignment: organization-defined security functions] when the primary means of implementing the security function is unavailable or compromised.

controls.name: MA-2 - Controlled Maintenance
controls.title: Controlled Maintenance

controls.name: IA-12 - Identity Proofing
controls.title: Identity Proofing

controls.name: MA-3 - Maintenance Tools
controls.title: Maintenance Tools
controls.body:
a. Approve, control, and monitor the use of system maintenance tools; and
b. Review previously approved system maintenance tools [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: IA-2 - Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.body: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate that unique identification with processes acting on behalf of those users.

controls.name: SA-8(2) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Least Common Mechanism
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Least Common Mechanism
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of least common mechanism in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: IA-2(6) - Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Access to Accounts —separate Device
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Access to Accounts —separate Device
controls.body:
Implement multi-factor authentication for [Selection (one or more): local; network; remote] access to [Selection (one or more): privileged accounts; non-privileged accounts] such that:

a. One of the factors is provided by a device separate from the system gaining access; and
b. The device meets [Assignment: organization-defined strength of mechanism requirements].

controls.name: IA-4 - Identifier Management
controls.title: Identifier Management

controls.name: C - Breach Notifications
controls.title: Breach Notifications
controls.body: Procedures are in place to notify impacted consumers of the personal information breach. Such notifications are documented and provided without unreasonable delay.

controls.name: SA-8(10) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Hierarchical Trust
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Hierarchical Trust
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of hierarchical trust in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: C - Awareness Training
controls.title: Awareness Training
controls.body: Employees and contractors are required to complete an information security and privacy awareness training as part of the onboarding process and annually thereafter.

controls.name: D5.DR.De.Int.1 - Triggering of Incident Response Program
controls.title: Triggering of Incident Response Program
controls.body: The incident response program is triggered when anomalous behaviors and attack patterns or signatures are detected.

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.Int.4 - Information Assurance Function
controls.title: Information Assurance Function
controls.body: A risk-based, independent information assurance function evaluates the security of internal applications.

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.E.3 - Impact Assessment of Security Patches
controls.title: Impact Assessment of Security Patches
controls.body: Operational impact is evaluated before deploying security patches.

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.E.2 - Automated Patch Retrieval
controls.title: Automated Patch Retrieval
controls.body: Systems are configured to retrieve patches automatically.

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.B.1 - Patch Management Program
controls.title: Patch Management Program
controls.body: A patch management program is implemented and ensures that software and firmware patches are applied in a timely manner. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 62)

controls.name: IA-4(8) - Identifier Management | Pairwise Pseudonymous Identifiers
controls.title: Identifier Management | Pairwise Pseudonymous Identifiers
controls.body: Generate pairwise pseudonymous identifiers.

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.A.2 - Board Meeting Package - Cyber Incident Information
controls.title: Board Meeting Package - Cyber Incident Information
controls.body: Detailed metrics, dashboards, and/or scorecards outlining cyber incidents and events are provided to management and are part of the board meeting package.

controls.name: IA-2(13) - Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Out-of-band Authentication
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Out-of-band Authentication
controls.body: Implement the following out-of-band authentication mechanisms under [Assignment: organization-defined conditions]: [Assignment: organization-defined out-of-band authentication].

controls.name: IA-3 - Device Identification and Authentication
controls.title: Device Identification and Authentication
controls.body: Uniquely identify and authenticate [Assignment: organization-defined devices and/or types of devices] before establishing a [Selection (one or more): local; remote; network] connection.

controls.name: MA-4 - Nonlocal Maintenance
controls.title: Nonlocal Maintenance

controls.name: SA-8(4) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Partially Ordered Dependencies
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Partially Ordered Dependencies
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of partially ordered dependencies in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: AC-3(3) - Access Enforcement | Mandatory Access Control
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Mandatory Access Control

controls.name: MA-5 - Maintenance Personnel
controls.title: Maintenance Personnel

controls.name: PM-5 - System Inventory
controls.title: System Inventory
controls.body: Develop and update [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] an inventory of organizational systems.

controls.name: IA-5 - Authenticator Management
controls.title: Authenticator Management

controls.name: AC-2(8) - Account Management | Dynamic Account Management
controls.title: Account Management | Dynamic Account Management
controls.body: Create, activate, manage, and deactivate [Assignment: organization-defined system accounts] dynamically.

controls.name: RA-3(4) - Risk Assessment | Predictive Cyber Analytics
controls.title: Risk Assessment | Predictive Cyber Analytics
controls.body: Employ the following advanced automation and analytics capabilities to predict and identify risks to [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components]: [Assignment: organization-defined advanced automation and analytics capabilities].

controls.name: AC-2(11) - Account Management | Usage Conditions
controls.title: Account Management | Usage Conditions
controls.body: Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances and/or usage conditions] for  [Assignment: organization-defined system accounts].

controls.name: AC-4(21) - Information Flow Enforcement | Physical or Logical Separation of Information Flows
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Physical or Logical Separation of Information Flows
controls.body: Separate information flows logically or physically using [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms and/or techniques] to accomplish [Assignment: organization-defined required separations by types of information].

controls.name: MA-6(1) - Timely Maintenance | Preventive Maintenance
controls.title: Timely Maintenance | Preventive Maintenance
controls.body: Perform preventive maintenance on [Assignment: organization-defined system components] at [Assignment: organization-defined time intervals].

controls.name: MA-7 - Field Maintenance
controls.title: Field Maintenance
controls.body: Restrict or prohibit field maintenance on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] to [Assignment: organization-defined trusted maintenance facilities].

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.E.5 - Vulnerability Scanning of New and Existing Devices
controls.title: Vulnerability Scanning of New and Existing Devices
controls.body: Vulnerability scanning is conducted and analyzed before deployment/redeployment of new/existing devices.

controls.name: IR-2(2) - Incident Response Training | Automated Training Environments
controls.title: Incident Response Training | Automated Training Environments
controls.body: Provide an incident response training environment using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: AC-4(30) - Information Flow Enforcement | Filter Mechanisms Using Multiple Processes
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Filter Mechanisms Using Multiple Processes
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, implement content filtering mechanisms using multiple processes.

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.B.3 - Monitoring Processes
controls.title: Monitoring Processes
controls.body: Processes are in place to monitor for the presence of unauthorized users, devices, connections, and software. (FFIEC Information Security Work Program, Objective II: M-9)

controls.name: SA-23 - Specialization
controls.title: Specialization
controls.body: Employ [Selection (one or more): design; modification; augmentation; reconfiguration] on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] supporting mission essential services or functions to increase the trustworthiness in those systems or components.

controls.name: CM-9 - Configuration Management Plan
controls.title: Configuration Management Plan

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.A.1 - Vulnerability Scanning of Environments
controls.title: Vulnerability Scanning of Environments
controls.body: Weekly vulnerability scanning is rotated among environments to scan all environments throughout the year.

controls.name: IA-5(6) - Authenticator Management | Protection of Authenticators
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Protection of Authenticators
controls.body: Protect authenticators commensurate with the security category of the information to which use of the authenticator permits access.

controls.name: IA-5(10) - Authenticator Management | Dynamic Credential Binding
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Dynamic Credential Binding
controls.body: Bind identities and authenticators dynamically using the following rules: [Assignment: organization-defined binding rules].

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.A.2 - Network Monitoring and Detection
controls.title: Network Monitoring and Detection
controls.body: Real-time network monitoring and detection is implemented and incorporates sector-wide event information.

controls.name: IA-5(12) - Authenticator Management | Biometric Authentication Performance
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Biometric Authentication Performance
controls.body: For biometric-based authentication, employ mechanisms that satisfy the following biometric quality requirements [Assignment: organization-defined biometric quality requirements].

controls.name: PE-3(4) - Physical Access Control | Lockable Casings
controls.title: Physical Access Control | Lockable Casings
controls.body: Use lockable physical casings to protect [Assignment: organization-defined system components] from unauthorized physical access.

controls.name: GC - Lawfulness of Processing
controls.title: Lawfulness of Processing
controls.body: Organization determines, documents, and complies with the relevant lawful basis for the processing of personal data for the identified purposes in accordance with applicable privacy obligations.

controls.name: PE-22 - Component Marking
controls.title: Component Marking
controls.body: Mark [Assignment: organization-defined system hardware components] indicating the impact level or classification level of the information permitted to be processed, stored, or transmitted by the hardware component.

controls.name: PL-11 - Baseline Tailoring
controls.title: Baseline Tailoring
controls.body: Tailor the selected control baseline by applying specified tailoring actions.

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.A.3 - Alerts for Unauthorized Changes
controls.title: Alerts for Unauthorized Changes
controls.body: Real-time alerts are automatically sent when unauthorized software, hardware, or changes occur.

controls.name: PM-7 - Enterprise Architecture
controls.title: Enterprise Architecture
controls.body: Develop and maintain an enterprise architecture with consideration for information security, privacy, and the resulting risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation.

controls.name: PT-5(1) - Privacy Notice | Just-in-time Notice
controls.title: Privacy Notice | Just-in-time Notice
controls.body: Present notice of personally identifiable information processing to individuals at a time and location where the individual provides personally identifiable information or in conjunction with a data action, or [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: PM-12 - Insider Threat Program
controls.title: Insider Threat Program
controls.body: Implement an insider threat program that includes a cross-discipline insider threat incident handling team.

controls.name: SR-4(2) - Provenance | Track and Trace
controls.title: Provenance | Track and Trace
controls.body: Establish and maintain unique identification of the following systems and critical system components for tracking through the supply chain: [Assignment: organization-defined systems and critical system components].

controls.name: PM-22 - Personally Identifiable Information Quality Management
controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Quality Management

controls.name: PM-30 - Supply Chain Risk Management Strategy
controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Strategy

controls.name: AC-6(6) - Least Privilege | Privileged Access by Non-organizational Users
controls.title: Least Privilege | Privileged Access by Non-organizational Users
controls.body: Prohibit privileged access to the system by non-organizational users.

controls.name: PT-6 - System of Records Notice
controls.title: System of Records Notice
controls.body:
For systems that process information that will be maintained in a Privacy Act system of records:

a. Draft system of records notices in accordance with OMB guidance and submit new and significantly modified system of records notices to the OMB and appropriate congressional committees for advance review;
b. Publish system of records notices in the Federal Register; and
c. Keep system of records notices accurate, up-to-date, and scoped in accordance with policy.

controls.name: PS-7 - External Personnel Security
controls.title: External Personnel Security

controls.name: PT-2 - Authority to Process Personally Identifiable Information
controls.title: Authority to Process Personally Identifiable Information
controls.body:
a. Determine and document the [Assignment: organization-defined authority] that permits the [Assignment: organization-defined processing] of personally identifiable information; and
b. Restrict the [Assignment: organization-defined processing] of personally identifiable information to only that which is authorized.

controls.name: PT-3 - Personally Identifiable Information Processing Purposes
controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Processing Purposes

controls.name: PT-5 - Privacy Notice
controls.title: Privacy Notice

controls.name: PT-8 - Computer Matching Requirements
controls.title: Computer Matching Requirements

controls.name: RA-2(1) - Security Categorization | Impact-level Prioritization
controls.title: Security Categorization | Impact-level Prioritization
controls.body: Conduct an impact-level prioritization of organizational systems to obtain additional granularity on system impact levels.

controls.name: RA-9 - Criticality Analysis
controls.title: Criticality Analysis
controls.body: Identify critical system components and functions by performing a criticality analysis for [Assignment: organization-defined systems, system components, or system services] at [Assignment: organization-defined decision points in the system development life cycle].

controls.name: SA-8(5) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Efficiently Mediated Access
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Efficiently Mediated Access
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of efficiently mediated access in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: AC-17(6) - Remote Access | Protection of Mechanism Information
controls.title: Remote Access | Protection of Mechanism Information
controls.body: Protect information about remote access mechanisms from unauthorized use and disclosure.

controls.name: SA-3 - System Development Life Cycle
controls.title: System Development Life Cycle

controls.name: SA-4(2) - Acquisition Process | Design and Implementation Information for Controls
controls.title: Acquisition Process | Design and Implementation Information for Controls
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to provide design and implementation information for the controls that includes: [Selection (one or more): security-relevant external system interfaces; high-level design; low-level design; source code or hardware schematics; [Assignment: organization-defined design and implementation information]] at [Assignment: organization-defined level of detail].

controls.name: SA-8(3) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Modularity and Layering
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Modularity and Layering
controls.body: Implement the security design principles of modularity and layering in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(6) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Minimized Sharing
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Minimized Sharing
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of minimized sharing in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(8) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Evolvability
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Evolvability
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of secure evolvability in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(13) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Minimized Security Elements
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Minimized Security Elements
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of minimized security elements in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(14) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Least Privilege
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Least Privilege
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of least privilege in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(23) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Defaults
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Defaults
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of secure defaults in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: CIS 17.9-RC - Security Incident Thresholds
controls.title: Security Incident Thresholds
controls.body:
Incident Response Management
Safeguard 17.9: Establish and maintain security incident thresholds.

controls.name: SA-8(26) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Performance Security
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Performance Security
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of performance security in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: D4.C.Co.Inn.1 - Adaptive Diagram of External Connections
controls.title: Adaptive Diagram of External Connections
controls.body: Diagram(s) of external connections is interactive, shows real-time changes to the network connection infrastructure, new connections, and volume fluctuations, and alerts when risks arise.

controls.name: SA-8(19) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Continuous Protection
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Continuous Protection
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of continuous protection in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(20) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Metadata Management
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Secure Metadata Management
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of secure metadata management in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(32) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Sufficient Documentation
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Sufficient Documentation
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of sufficient documentation in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(21) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Self-analysis
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Self-analysis
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of self-analysis in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(22) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Accountability and Traceability
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Accountability and Traceability
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of accountability and traceability in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(29) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Repeatable and Documented Procedures
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Repeatable and Documented Procedures
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of repeatable and documented procedures in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-8(30) - Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Procedural Rigor
controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles | Procedural Rigor
controls.body: Implement the security design principle of procedural rigor in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SA-10(4) - Developer Configuration Management | Trusted Generation
controls.title: Developer Configuration Management | Trusted Generation
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to employ tools for comparing newly generated versions of security-relevant hardware descriptions, source code, and object code with previous versions.

controls.name: SA-9(5) - External System Services | Processing, Storage, and Service Location
controls.title: External System Services | Processing, Storage, and Service Location
controls.body: Restrict the location of [Selection (one or more): information processing; information or data; system services] to [Assignment: organization-defined locations] based on [Assignment: organization-defined requirements or conditions].

controls.name: SA-15 - Development Process, Standards, and Tools
controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools

controls.name: AC-6(2) - Least Privilege | Non-privileged Access for Nonsecurity Functions
controls.title: Least Privilege | Non-privileged Access for Nonsecurity Functions
controls.body: Require that users of system accounts (or roles) with access to [Assignment: organization-defined security functions or security-relevant information] use non-privileged accounts or roles, when accessing nonsecurity functions.

controls.name: SA-10 - Developer Configuration Management
controls.title: Developer Configuration Management

controls.name: AC-6 - Least Privilege
controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.body: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

controls.name: SA-11(8) - Developer Testing and Evaluation | Dynamic Code Analysis
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation | Dynamic Code Analysis
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to employ dynamic code analysis tools to identify common flaws and document the results of the analysis.

controls.name: SA-15(3) - Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Criticality Analysis
controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Criticality Analysis
controls.body:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to perform a criticality analysis:

a. At the following decision points in the system development life cycle: [Assignment: organization-defined decision points in the system development life cycle]; and
b. At the following level of rigor: [Assignment: organization-defined breadth and depth of criticality analysis].

controls.name: PS-3 - Personnel Screening
controls.title: Personnel Screening
controls.body:
a. Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to the system; and
b. Rescreen individuals in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined conditions requiring rescreening and, where rescreening is so indicated, the frequency of rescreening].

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.Inn.2 - Weekly Vulnerability Scanning
controls.title: Weekly Vulnerability Scanning
controls.body: Vulnerability scanning is performed on a weekly basis across all environments.

controls.name: D3.CC.Re.Int.1 - Review of Remediation Status
controls.title: Review of Remediation Status
controls.body: Remediation efforts are confirmed by conducting a follow-up vulnerability scan.

controls.name: RA-5(3) - Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Breadth and Depth of Coverage
controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Breadth and Depth of Coverage
controls.body: Define the breadth and depth of vulnerability scanning coverage.

controls.name: GP - Request on Data Subject Rights
controls.title: Request on Data Subject Rights
controls.body: Requests received from controllers regarding exercising rights of data subjects are documented, retained, and acted upon without undue days.

controls.name: AC-4(25) - Information Flow Enforcement | Data Sanitization
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Data Sanitization
controls.body: When transferring information between different security domains, sanitize data to minimize [Selection (one or more): delivery of malicious content, command and control of malicious code, malicious code augmentation, and steganography encoded data; spillage of sensitive information] in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined policy].

controls.name: PM-13 - Security and Privacy Workforce
controls.title: Security and Privacy Workforce
controls.body: Establish a security and privacy workforce development and improvement program.

controls.name: AC-3(8) - Access Enforcement | Revocation of Access Authorizations
controls.title: Access Enforcement | Revocation of Access Authorizations
controls.body: Enforce the revocation of access authorizations resulting from changes to the security attributes of subjects and objects based on [Assignment: organization-defined rules governing the timing of revocations of access authorizations].

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.A.1 - Third-Party Due Diligence Activity
controls.title: Third-Party Due Diligence Activity
controls.body: A continuous process improvement program is in place for third-party due diligence activity.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.B.4 - Monitoring of Third-Party Access
controls.title: Monitoring of Third-Party Access
controls.body: Access to critical systems by third parties is monitored for unauthorized or unusual activity. (FFIEC Outsourcing Booklet, page 26)

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.E.2 - Penetration Testing of Updated and New Systems
controls.title: Penetration Testing of Updated and New Systems
controls.body: Independent penetration testing is performed on Internet-facing applications or systems before they are launched or undergo significant change.

controls.name: GC - Breach Notifications to Supervisory Authority
controls.title: Breach Notifications to Supervisory Authority
controls.body: Notifications are provided to supervisory authorities regarding personal data breaches without unreasonable delay and in no case later than 72 hours after the discovery of a breach.

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.Int.1 - Assessment of Vendors' Subcontractors
controls.title: Assessment of Vendors' Subcontractors
controls.body: A process is in place to confirm that the institution’s third-party service providers conduct due diligence of their third parties (e.g., subcontractors).

controls.name: D5.DR.De.Int.2 - Detection of Potential Threats
controls.title: Detection of Potential Threats
controls.body: The institution has the ability to discover infiltration, before the attacker traverses across systems, establishes a foothold, steals information, or causes damage to data and systems.

controls.name: AC-6(7) - Least Privilege | Review of User Privileges
controls.title: Least Privilege | Review of User Privileges
controls.body:
a. Review [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] the privileges assigned to [Assignment: organization-defined roles or classes of users] to validate the need for such privileges; and
b. Reassign or remove privileges, if necessary, to correctly reflect organizational mission and business needs.

controls.name: CM-5(5) - Access Restrictions for Change | Privilege Limitation for Production and Operation
controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change | Privilege Limitation for Production and Operation
controls.body:
a. Limit privileges to change system components and system-related information within a production or operational environment; and
b. Review and reevaluate privileges [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: D3.DC.An.Int.2 - Data Mining Detection Tools
controls.title: Data Mining Detection Tools
controls.body: Tools to detect unauthorized data mining are used.

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.E.1 - Security Testing of Applications
controls.title: Security Testing of Applications
controls.body: Security testing occurs at all post-design phases of the SDLC for all applications, including mobile applications. (*N/A if there is no software development.)

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.B.3 - Independent Review of Internally Developed Software
controls.title: Independent Review of Internally Developed Software
controls.body: The security controls in internally developed software code are independently reviewed before migrating the code to production. (*N/A if there is no software development.) (FFIEC Development and Acquisition Booklet, page 2)

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.Int.1 - Vulnerability Mitigation in Software Development
controls.title: Vulnerability Mitigation in Software Development
controls.body: Processes are in place to mitigate vulnerabilities identified as part of the secure development of systems and applications.

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.Int.2 - Testing of Application Security
controls.title: Testing of Application Security
controls.body: The security of applications, including Web-based applications connected to the Internet, is tested against known types of cyber attacks (e.g., SQL injection, cross-site scripting, buffer overflow) before implementation or following significant changes.

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.B.2 - Alert Mechanisms
controls.title: Alert Mechanisms
controls.body: Mechanisms (e.g., antivirus alerts, log event alerts) are in place to alert management to potential attacks. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 78)

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.Int.3 - Digital Signatures for Software
controls.title: Digital Signatures for Software
controls.body: Software code executables and scripts are digitally signed to confirm the software author and guarantee that the code has not been altered or corrupted.

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.A.1 - Static Code Analysis Corrective Actions
controls.title: Static Code Analysis Corrective Actions
controls.body: Vulnerabilities identified through a static code analysis are remediated before implementing newly developed or changed applications into production.

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.A.3 - Independent Code Reviews
controls.title: Independent Code Reviews
controls.body: Independent code reviews are completed on internally developed or vendor-provided custom applications to ensure there are no security gaps.

controls.name: D3.PC.Se.Inn.1 - Code Scanning in Development Environment
controls.title: Code Scanning in Development Environment
controls.body: Software code is actively scanned by automated tools in the development environment so that security weaknesses can be resolved immediately during the design phase.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.E.2 - Review of Security Logs
controls.title: Review of Security Logs
controls.body: Security logs are reviewed regularly.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.B.5 - Monitoring of Privileged Access
controls.title: Monitoring of Privileged Access
controls.body: Elevated privileges are monitored. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 19)

controls.name: D3.DC.An.Int.1 - Monitoring of Online Transactions
controls.title: Monitoring of Online Transactions
controls.body: Online customer transactions are actively monitored for anomalous behavior.

controls.name: D3.DC.Ev.A.1 - Unauthorized Change Detection
controls.title: Unauthorized Change Detection
controls.body: Automated tools detect unauthorized changes to critical system files, firewalls, IPS, IDS, or other security devices.

controls.name: D3.CC.Re.B.1 - Remediation of Identified Issues
controls.title: Remediation of Identified Issues
controls.body: Issues identified in assessments are prioritized and resolved based on criticality and within the time frames established in the response to the assessment report. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 87)

controls.name: D3.CC.Re.Int.2 - Repeating Penetration Test
controls.title: Repeating Penetration Test
controls.body: Penetration testing is repeated to confirm that medium- and high-risk, exploitable vulnerabilities have been resolved.

controls.name: D3.CC.Re.A.1 - Escalation of Identified Issues
controls.title: Escalation of Identified Issues
controls.body: All medium and high risk issues identified in penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, and other independent testing are escalated to the board or an appropriate board committee for risk acceptance if not resolved in a timely manner.

controls.name: D3.CC.Pa.Inn.2 - Testing Production Environment
controls.title: Testing Production Environment
controls.body: Segregated or separate systems are in place that mirror production systems allowing for rapid testing and implementation of patches and provide for rapid fallback when needed.

controls.name: D4.C.Co.Inn.2 - Prevention of Cyber Attack Contagion
controls.title: Prevention of Cyber Attack Contagion
controls.body: The institution's connections can be segmented or severed instantaneously to prevent contagion from cyber attacks.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.B.1 - Documented Incident Response Plan
controls.title: Documented Incident Response Plan
controls.body: The institution has documented how it will react and respond to cyber incidents. (FFIEC Business Continuity Planning Booklet, page 4)

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.E.3 - Business Continuity for Critical Functions
controls.title: Business Continuity for Critical Functions
controls.body: Alternative processes have been established to continue critical activity within a reasonable time period.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.E.1 - Remediation Plan and Process
controls.title: Remediation Plan and Process
controls.body: The remediation plan and process outlines the mitigating actions, resources, and time parameters.

controls.name: D5.DR.De.Int.3 - Automated Incident Detection
controls.title: Automated Incident Detection
controls.body: Incidents are detected in real time through automated processes that include instant alerts to appropriate personnel who can respond.

controls.name: G - Data Protection Policy
controls.title: Data Protection Policy
controls.body: Data Protection policy is established and communicated to employees and contractors within the organization. The policy is reviewed by management on an annual basis or in case of significant changes.

controls.name: SA-11(4) - Developer Testing and Evaluation | Manual Code Reviews
controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation | Manual Code Reviews
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to perform a manual code review of [Assignment: organization-defined specific code] using the following processes, procedures, and/or techniques: [Assignment: organization-defined processes, procedures, and/or techniques].

controls.name: G - Privacy Policy
controls.title: Privacy Policy
controls.body: Organization has a privacy policy published on its website which outlines privacy obligations and specifies data subject rights in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The policy is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: D5.DR.De.Int.4 - Correlation of Network and System Alerts
controls.title: Correlation of Network and System Alerts
controls.body: Network and system alerts are correlated across business units to better detect and prevent multifaceted attacks (e.g., simultaneous DDoS attack and account takeover).

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.Inn.1 - Instantaneous Incident Notifications
controls.title: Instantaneous Incident Notifications
controls.body: A mechanism is in place to provide instantaneous notification of incidents to management and essential employees through multiple communication channels with tracking and verification of receipt.

controls.name: GC - Withdrawal of Consents
controls.title: Withdrawal of Consents
controls.body: The organization responds promptly to data subjects' requests to modify or withdraw their consent at any time. Records of such requests are documented and retained in accordance with organizational policies.

controls.name: G - Data Protection Officer
controls.title: Data Protection Officer
controls.body: Organization has designated a Data Protection Officer (DPO) to oversee the development and implementation of privacy policies and procedures in compliance with applicable privacy laws.

controls.name: C - Privacy Notice
controls.title: Privacy Notice
controls.body: The organization has a privacy policy published on its website, which outlines privacy obligations and specifies individual rights in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The policy is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: G - Vendor Management Process
controls.title: Vendor Management Process
controls.body: A vendor management process has been implemented whereby management performs risk assessments of potential new vendors/ processors and evaluates the compliance of existing vendors (including processors) on an annual basis. Corrective actions are taken as required based on the results of the assessments.

controls.name: C - Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.title: Consumers Rights Procedure
