controls.body: The organization has established Consumers rights procedure that specifies rights granted to consumers with respect to their personal data. These procedures are approved by management and communicated to employees and contractors.

controls.name: C - Employee Privacy Notice
controls.title: Employee Privacy Notice
controls.body: The organization has established a privacy notice for its employee and contractors which specifies their rights, purpose of their personal information collection and organization's privacy obligations in accordance with applicable privacy laws and regulations. The policy has been communicated and acknowledged by the employees and contractors.

controls.name: AU-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] audit and accountability policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the audit and accountability policy and the associated audit and accountability controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the audit and accountability policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current audit and accountability:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: CS - Right to Opt-in (Minors)
controls.title: Right to Opt-in (Minors)
controls.body: The sale of minor consumer's personal information is only performed based on affirmative authorization (“opt-in”) and by providing a mechanism to modify or withdraw the consents. Such authorizations are documented and retained in accordance with organization policies.

controls.name: C - Contracts with Service Providers
controls.title: Contracts with Service Providers
controls.body: The organization maintains written contracts with service providers who process the personal information of consumers on behalf of the organization. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by the service provider for the protection of consumer's personal information.

controls.name: AU-2 - Event Logging
controls.title: Event Logging

controls.name: C - Data Protection Policy
controls.title: Data Protection Policy
controls.body: Data Protection policy is established and communicated to employees and contractors within the organization. The policy is reviewed by management on an annual basis or in case of significant changes.

controls.name: AU-5(1) - Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Storage Capacity Warning
controls.title: Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Storage Capacity Warning
controls.body: Provide a warning to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel, roles, and/or locations] within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] when allocated audit log storage volume reaches [Assignment: organization-defined percentage] of repository maximum audit log storage capacity.

controls.name: CA-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] assessment, authorization, and monitoring policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the assessment, authorization, and monitoring policy and the associated assessment, authorization, and monitoring controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the assessment, authorization, and monitoring policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current assessment, authorization, and monitoring:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: IA-2(1) - Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Multi-factor Authentication to Privileged Accounts
controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) | Multi-factor Authentication to Privileged Accounts
controls.body: Implement multi-factor authentication for access to privileged accounts.

controls.name: CM-3(2) - Configuration Change Control | Testing, Validation, and Documentation of Changes
controls.title: Configuration Change Control | Testing, Validation, and Documentation of Changes
controls.body: Test, validate, and document changes to the system before finalizing the implementation of the changes.

controls.name: CP-9 - System Backup
controls.title: System Backup

controls.name: IR-7 - Incident Response Assistance
controls.title: Incident Response Assistance
controls.body: Provide an incident response support resource, integral to the organizational incident response capability, that offers advice and assistance to users of the system for the handling and reporting of incidents.

controls.name: RA-3 - Risk Assessment
controls.title: Risk Assessment

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.E.1 - Annual Penetration Testing of Critical Systems
controls.title: Annual Penetration Testing of Critical Systems
controls.body: Independent penetration testing of network boundary and critical Webfacing applications is performed routinely to identify security control gaps.

controls.name: AC-4(17) - Information Flow Enforcement | Domain Authentication
controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Domain Authentication
controls.body: Uniquely identify and authenticate source and destination points by [Selection (one or more): organization; system; application; service; individual] for information transfer.

controls.name: AC-7 - Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.body:
a. Enforce a limit of [Assignment: organization-defined number] consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; and
b. Automatically [Selection (one or more): lock the account or node for an [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; lock the account or node until released by an administrator; delay next logon prompt per [Assignment: organization-defined delay algorithm]; notify system administrator; take other [Assignment: organization-defined action]] when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.

controls.name: IR-5 - Incident Monitoring
controls.title: Incident Monitoring
controls.body: Track and document incidents.

controls.name: AU-5 - Response to Audit Logging Process Failures
controls.title: Response to Audit Logging Process Failures
controls.body:
a. Alert [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] in the event of an audit logging process failure; and
b. Take the following additional actions: [Assignment: organization-defined additional actions].

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.A.2 - High-Risk Vendor Audits
controls.title: High-Risk Vendor Audits
controls.body: Audits of high-risk vendors are conducted on an annual basis.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.B.3 - Data Recovery Testing
controls.title: Data Recovery Testing
controls.body: Systems, applications, and data recovery is tested at least annually. (FFIEC Business Continuity Planning Booklet, page J-7)

controls.name: AT-2(2) - Literacy Training and Awareness | Insider Threat
controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Insider Threat
controls.body: Provide literacy training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat.

controls.name: IA-5(1) - Authenticator Management | Password-based Authentication
controls.title: Authenticator Management | Password-based Authentication

controls.name: AU-5(2) - Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Real-time Alerts
controls.title: Response to Audit Logging Process Failures | Real-time Alerts
controls.body: Provide an alert within [Assignment: organization-defined real-time period] to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel, roles, and/or locations] when the following audit failure events occur: [Assignment: organization-defined audit logging failure events requiring real-time alerts].

controls.name: AU-9 - Protection of Audit Information
controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.body:
a. Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion; and
b. Alert [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] upon detection of unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of audit information.

controls.name: AU-12 - Audit Record Generation
controls.title: Audit Record Generation

controls.name: AT-3(3) - Role-based Training | Practical Exercises
controls.title: Role-based Training | Practical Exercises
controls.body: Provide practical exercises in security and privacy training that reinforce training objectives.

controls.name: AT-3(5) - Role-based Training | Processing Personally Identifiable Information
controls.title: Role-based Training | Processing Personally Identifiable Information
controls.body: Provide [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] with initial and [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] training in the employment and operation of personally identifiable information processing and transparency controls.

controls.name: D3.DC.An.Int.4 - Backup of Audit Logs
controls.title: Backup of Audit Logs
controls.body: Audit logs are backed up to a centralized log server or media that is difficult to alter.

controls.name: AT-4 - Training Records
controls.title: Training Records
controls.body:
a. Document and monitor information security and privacy training activities, including security and privacy awareness training and specific role-based security and privacy training; and
b. Retain individual training records for [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: AU-12(2) - Audit Record Generation | Standardized Formats
controls.title: Audit Record Generation | Standardized Formats
controls.body: Produce a system-wide (logical or physical) audit trail composed of audit records in a standardized format.

controls.name: CP-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] contingency planning policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the contingency planning policy and the associated contingency planning controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the contingency planning policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current contingency planning:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.B.6 - Incident Recovery Plans
controls.title: Incident Recovery Plans
controls.body: The institution plans to use business continuity, disaster recovery, and data backup programs to recover operations following an incident. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 71)

controls.name: MA-3(5) - Maintenance Tools | Execution with Privilege
controls.title: Maintenance Tools | Execution with Privilege
controls.body: Monitor the use of maintenance tools that execute with increased privilege.

controls.name: PE-6(4) - Monitoring Physical Access | Monitoring Physical Access to Systems
controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access | Monitoring Physical Access to Systems
controls.body: Monitor physical access to the system in addition to the physical access monitoring of the facility at [Assignment: organization-defined physical spaces containing one or more components of the system].

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.A.2 - Cyber Resilience Program
controls.title: Cyber Resilience Program
controls.body: Multiple systems, programs, or processes are implemented into a comprehensive cyber resilience program to sustain, minimize, and recover operations from an array of potentially disruptive and destructive cyber incidents.

controls.name: D5.IR.Te.E.3 - Periodic Testing of Information Backups
controls.title: Periodic Testing of Information Backups
controls.body: Information backups are tested periodically to verify they are accessible and readable.

controls.name: PM-14 - Testing, Training, and Monitoring
controls.title: Testing, Training, and Monitoring
controls.body:
a. Implement a process for ensuring that organizational plans for conducting security and privacy testing, training, and monitoring activities associated with organizational systems:

1. Are developed and maintained; and
2. Continue to be executed; and

b. Review testing, training, and monitoring plans for consistency with the organizational risk management strategy and organization-wide priorities for risk response actions.

controls.name: GP - Authorization from Controller for Sub-Processing
controls.title: Authorization from Controller for Sub-Processing
controls.body: Organization obtains formal authorization from the controller prior to engaging another processor (sub-processor) to support its processing activities. Arrangements between processor and sub-processors are supported by written contracts outlining the same data protection obligations as it has with the controller.

controls.name: PE-23 - Facility Location
controls.title: Facility Location
controls.body:
a. Plan the location or site of the facility where the system resides considering physical and environmental hazards; and
b. For existing facilities, consider the physical and environmental hazards in the organizational risk management strategy.

controls.name: D3.DC.Th.B.2 - Attack Detection
controls.title: Attack Detection
controls.body: Antivirus and anti-malware tools are used to detect attacks. (FFIEC Information Security Booklet, page 55)

controls.name: PM-9 - Risk Management Strategy
controls.title: Risk Management Strategy
controls.body:
a. Develops a comprehensive strategy to manage:

1. Security risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation associated with the operation and use of organizational systems; and
2. Privacy risk to individuals resulting from the authorized processing of personally identifiable information;

b. Implement the risk management strategy consistently across the organization; and
c. Review and update the risk management strategy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or as required, to address organizational changes.

controls.name: C - Vendor Management Process
controls.title: Vendor Management Process
controls.body: A vendor management process has been implemented whereby management performs risk assessments of potential new vendors/ service providers and evaluates the compliance of existing vendors on an annual basis. Corrective actions are taken as required based on the results of the assessments.

controls.name: CM-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:

     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and

controls.name: RA-7 - Risk Response
controls.title: Risk Response
controls.body: Respond to findings from security and privacy assessments, monitoring, and audits in accordance with organizational risk tolerance.

controls.name: SA-9(1) - External System Services | Risk Assessments and Organizational Approvals
controls.title: External System Services | Risk Assessments and Organizational Approvals
controls.body:
a. Conduct an organizational assessment of risk prior to the acquisition or outsourcing of information security services; and
b. Verify that the acquisition or outsourcing of dedicated information security services is approved by [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: D3.PC.De.Inn.1 - Endpoint Management Tool
controls.title: Endpoint Management Tool
controls.body: A centralized end-point management tool provides fully integrated patch, configuration, and vulnerability management, while also being able to detect malware upon arrival to prevent an exploit.

controls.name: AC-12 - Session Termination
controls.title: Session Termination
controls.body: Automatically terminate a user session after [Assignment: organization-defined conditions or trigger events requiring session disconnect].

controls.name: PM-30(1) - Supply Chain Risk Management Strategy | Suppliers of Critical or Mission-essential Items
controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Strategy | Suppliers of Critical or Mission-essential Items
controls.body: Identify, prioritize, and assess suppliers of critical or mission-essential technologies, products, and services.

controls.name: AC-12(3) - Session Termination | Timeout Warning Message
controls.title: Session Termination | Timeout Warning Message
controls.body: Display an explicit message to users indicating that the session will end in [Assignment: organization-defined time until end of session].

controls.name: D4.C.Co.Int.2 - Intrusion Detection and Prevention
controls.title: Intrusion Detection and Prevention
controls.body: Security controls are designed and verified to detect and prevent intrusions from third-party connections.

controls.name: AT-2 - Literacy Training and Awareness
controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness

controls.title: Least Privilege | Prohibit Non-privileged Users from Executing Privileged Functions

controls.name: AT-2(4) - Literacy Training and Awareness | Suspicious Communications and Anomalous System Behavior
controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Suspicious Communications and Anomalous System Behavior
controls.body: Provide literacy training on recognizing suspicious communications and anomalous behavior in organizational systems using [Assignment: organization-defined indicators of malicious code].

controls.name: SI-4(9) - System Monitoring | Testing of Monitoring Tools and Mechanisms
controls.title: System Monitoring | Testing of Monitoring Tools and Mechanisms
controls.body: Test intrusion-monitoring tools and mechanisms [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: C - Security Procedures and Practices
controls.title: Security Procedures and Practices
controls.body: Appropriate security procedures and practices have been implemented by the organization for the security and protection of consumers' personal information. These measures are assessed by management on an annual basis, and deficiencies identified are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.B.5 - Backup and Recovery Plan
controls.title: Backup and Recovery Plan
controls.body: A formal backup and recovery plan exists for all critical business lines. (FFIEC Business Continuity Planning Booklet, page 4)

controls.name: PS-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] personnel security policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the personnel security policy and the associated personnel security controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the personnel security policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current personnel security:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: D5.DR.Re.Int.2 - Review and Approval of Changes
controls.title: Review and Approval of Changes
controls.body: Any changes to systems/applications or to access entitlements necessary for incident management are reviewed by management for formal approval before implementation.

controls.name: IA-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] identification and authentication policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the identification and authentication policy and the associated identification and authentication controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the identification and authentication policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current identification and authentication:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: IR-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] incident response policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the incident response policy and the associated incident response controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the incident response policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current incident response:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: D3.CC.Re.Ev.2 - Penetration Test Corrective Actions
controls.title: Penetration Test Corrective Actions
controls.body: Formal processes are in place to resolve weaknesses identified during penetration testing.

controls.name: AT-2(3) - Literacy Training and Awareness | Social Engineering and Mining
controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Social Engineering and Mining
controls.body: Provide literacy training on recognizing and reporting potential and actual instances of social engineering and social mining.

controls.name: AT-2(5) - Literacy Training and Awareness | Advanced Persistent Threat
controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Advanced Persistent Threat
controls.body: Provide literacy training on the advanced persistent threat.

controls.name: AC-3 - Access Enforcement
controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.body: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

controls.name: SI-4(13) - System Monitoring | Analyze Traffic and Event Patterns
controls.title: System Monitoring | Analyze Traffic and Event Patterns

controls.name: PT-4 - Consent
controls.title: Consent
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined tools or mechanisms] for individuals to consent to the processing of their personally identifiable information prior to its collection that facilitate individuals’ informed decision-making.

controls.name: AC-6(1) - Least Privilege | Authorize Access to Security Functions
controls.title: Least Privilege | Authorize Access to Security Functions
controls.body:
Authorize access for [Assignment: organization-defined individuals or roles] to:

a. [Assignment: organization-defined security functions (deployed in hardware, software, and firmware)]; and
b. [Assignment: organization-defined security-relevant information].

controls.name: AC-6(5) - Least Privilege | Privileged Accounts
controls.title: Least Privilege | Privileged Accounts
controls.body: Restrict privileged accounts on the system to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: G - Awareness Training
controls.title: Awareness Training
controls.body: Employees and contractors are required to complete an information security and privacy awareness training as part of the onboarding process and annually thereafter.

controls.name: GC - Consent on Collection and Processing
controls.title: Consent on Collection and Processing
controls.body: Explicit consent is obtained and maintained from data subjects prior to collection and for any new uses or disclosure of their personal information. Data subjects are provided with a mechanism to modify or withdraw their consent.

controls.name: C - Data Inventory
controls.title: Data Inventory
controls.body: Organizations identify and maintain an inventory of categories of personal information collected along with its usage, sources and specific purposes for collection. The documented inventory is reviewed by management on at least an annual basis or during significant changes to ensure it aligns with the organization's privacy notice.

controls.name: SA-9(3) - External System Services | Establish and Maintain Trust Relationship with Providers
controls.title: External System Services | Establish and Maintain Trust Relationship with Providers
controls.body: Establish, document, and maintain trust relationships with external service providers based on the following requirements, properties, factors, or conditions: [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy requirements, properties, factors, or conditions defining acceptable trust relationships].

controls.name: G - Breach Risk Assessments
controls.title: Breach Risk Assessments
controls.body: Data breach risk assessment is performed on the identified incidents following the discovery of a breach to determine the probability that personal data has been compromised and whether notifications are required.

controls.name: D4.RM.Dd.B.3 - Risk Assessment of Service Providers
controls.title: Risk Assessment of Service Providers
controls.body: A risk assessment is conducted to identify criticality of service providers. (FFIEC Outsourcing Booklet, page 6)

controls.name: D4.RM.Om.B.1 - Review of Vendor Risk Assessment
controls.title: Review of Vendor Risk Assessment
controls.body: The third-party risk assessment is updated regularly. (FFIEC Outsourcing Booklet, page 3)

controls.name: CIS 16.4-PR - Third-Party Software Components Inventory
controls.title: Third-Party Software Components Inventory
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.4: Establish and manage an inventory of third-party software components.

controls.name: D5.IR.Pl.E.5 - Due Diligence for Consultants
controls.title: Due Diligence for Consultants
controls.body: Due diligence has been performed on technical sources, consultants, or forensic service firms that could be called to assist the institution during or following an incident.

controls.name: PS-4 - Personnel Termination
controls.title: Personnel Termination

controls.name: G - Security Measures and Assessments
controls.title: Security Measures and Assessments
controls.body: Appropriate technical and organizational measures have been implemented by the organization for the security and protection of personal information. These measures are assessed by management on an annual basis and deficiencies identified are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: CCPA 2.4 - Right to Access/Know
controls.title: Right to Access/Know
controls.body: Requests from consumers to access/know about their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon no later than 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: 6.7.1.1 - Policy on the Use of Cryptographic Controls
controls.title: Policy on the Use of Cryptographic Controls
controls.body: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls for the protection of information shall be developed and implemented.

controls.name: SC-49 - Hardware-enforced Separation and Policy Enforcement
controls.title: Hardware-enforced Separation and Policy Enforcement
controls.body: Implement hardware-enforced separation and policy enforcement mechanisms between [Assignment: organization-defined security domains].

controls.name: CIS 4.1-PR - Secure Configuration Process
controls.title: Secure Configuration Process
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.1: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process.

controls.name: CIS 7.1-PR - Vulnerability Management Process
controls.title: Vulnerability Management Process
controls.body:
Continuous Vulnerability Management
Safeguard 7.1: Establish and maintain a vulnerability management process.

controls.name: SC-7(19) - Boundary Protection | Block Communication from Non-organizationally Configured Hosts
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Block Communication from Non-organizationally Configured Hosts
controls.body: Block inbound and outbound communications traffic between [Assignment: organization-defined communication clients] that are independently configured by end users and external service providers.

controls.name: SC-7(12) - Boundary Protection | Host-based Protection
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Host-based Protection
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined host-based boundary protection mechanisms] at [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.name: CCPA 2.7 - Right to Opt-in (Minors)
controls.title: Right to Opt-in (Minors)
controls.body: The sale or sharing of minor consumers' personal information is only performed based on affirmative authorization (“opt-in”) and by providing a mechanism to modify or withdraw the consent. Such authorizations are documented and retained in accordance with organization policies.

controls.name: APP 7.2 - Opt-Out Options for Individuals (Direct Marketing)
controls.title: Opt-Out Options for Individuals (Direct Marketing)
controls.body: Requests from individuals to opt out of direct marketing communication are documented, retained and acted upon within a reasonable period.

controls.name: CIS 9.2-PR - DNS Filtering
controls.title: DNS Filtering
controls.body:
Email and Web Browser Protections
Safeguard 9.2: Use DNS filtering services.

controls.name: 8.24 - Use of Cryptography
controls.title: Use of Cryptography
controls.body: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.

controls.name: SR-5(2) - Acquisition Strategies, Tools, and Methods | Assessments Prior to Selection, Acceptance, Modification, or Update
controls.title: Acquisition Strategies, Tools, and Methods | Assessments Prior to Selection, Acceptance, Modification, or Update
controls.body: Assess the system, system component, or system service prior to selection, acceptance, modification, or update.

controls.name: A.7.3.3 - Providing Information to PII Principals
controls.title: Providing Information to PII Principals
controls.body: The organization shall provide PII principals with clear and easily accessible information identifying the PII controller and describing the processing of their PII.

controls.name: 5.13 - Labelling of Information
controls.title: Labelling of Information
controls.body: An appropriate set of procedures for information labeling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.name: A.7.4.1 - Limit Collection
controls.title: Limit Collection
controls.body: The organization shall limit the collection of PII to the minimum that is relevant, proportional and necessary for the identified purposes.

controls.name: CIS 10.3-PR - Restrictions on Removable Media
controls.title: Restrictions on Removable Media
controls.body:
Malware Defenses
Safeguard 10.3: Disable autorun and autoplay for removable media.

controls.name: 5.3 - Segregation of Duties
controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.body: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated.

controls.name: ITGC - Errors in Production Processing
controls.title: Errors in Production Processing
controls.body: Errors in production processing are identified and resolved.

controls.name: 6.11.2.3 - Technical Review of Applications after Operating Platform Changes
controls.title: Technical Review of Applications after Operating Platform Changes
controls.body: When operating platforms are changed, business-critical applications shall be reviewed and tested to ensure there is no adverse impact on organizational operations or security.

controls.name: CIS 3.6-PR - End-User Device Data Encryption
controls.title: End-User Device Data Encryption
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.6: Encrypt data on end-user devices.

controls.name: SA-15(6) - Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Continuous Improvement
controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Continuous Improvement
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to implement an explicit process to continuously improve the development process.

controls.name: CIS 14.6-PR - Security Incidents Reporting Training
controls.title: Security Incidents Reporting Training
controls.body:
Security Awareness and Skills Training
Safeguard 14.6: Train workforce members on recognizing and reporting security incidents.

controls.name: 5.26 - Response to Information Security Incidents
controls.title: Response to Information Security Incidents
controls.body: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

controls.name: CCPA 5.1 - Breach Notifications
controls.title: Breach Notifications
controls.body: Procedures are in place to notify impacted consumers of the personal information breach. Such notifications are documented and provided to consumers and, where applicable, the supervisory authority without unreasonable delay.

controls.name: CIS 3.2-ID - Data Inventory
controls.title: Data Inventory
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.2: Establish and maintain a data inventory.

controls.name: SI-19(8) - De-identification | Motivated Intruder
controls.title: De-identification | Motivated Intruder
controls.body: Perform a motivated intruder test on the de-identified dataset to determine if the identified data remains or if the de-identified data can be re-identified.

controls.name: 6.2 - Terms and Conditions of Employment
controls.title: Terms and Conditions of Employment
controls.body: The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel’s and the organization’s responsibilities for information security.

controls.name: 5.17 - Authentication Information
controls.title: Authentication Information
controls.body: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on the appropriate handling of authentication information.

controls.name: 6.9.5.1 - Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.title: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.body: Procedures shall be implemented to control the installation of software on operational systems.

controls.name: CIS 8.6-DE - DNS Query Audit Logs
controls.title: DNS Query Audit Logs
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.6: Collect Domain Name System (DNS) query audit logs.

controls.name: SC-18 - Mobile Code
controls.title: Mobile Code
controls.body:
a. Define acceptable and unacceptable mobile code and mobile code technologies; and
b. Authorize, monitor, and control the use of mobile code within the system.

controls.name: CCPA 2.5 - Notice of Sale or Sharing of Personal Information
controls.title: Notice of Sale or Sharing of Personal Information
controls.body: Explicit notice is provided to consumers prior to the sale or sharing of their personal information. Consumers are provided with a mechanism to exercise the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information, and any such requests are handled in a timely manner.

controls.name: PCI 1.3.1 - Restriction to Inbound Traffic
controls.title: Restriction to Inbound Traffic
controls.body:
Inbound traffic to the CDE is restricted as follows:
- To only traffic that is necessary.
- All other traffic is specifically denied.

controls.name: SR-2 - Supply Chain Risk Management Plan
controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Plan

controls.name: CIS 5.6-PR - Account Management
controls.title: Account Management
controls.body:
Account Management
Safeguard 5.6: Centralize account management.

controls.name: CCPA 2.1 - Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.title: Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.body: The organization has established a consumers rights procedure that specifies the process and time frames for handling consumers' requests with respect to their personal information. The procedure is communicated to all the employees and reviewed by management on at least an annual basis.

controls.name: CCPA 2.8 - Right to Limit Use and Disclosure of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.title: Right to Limit Use and Disclosure of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.body: The organization has mechanisms in place to allow consumers to exercise their right to limit the use and disclosure of their sensitive personal information. Requests from consumers to limit the use or disclosure of their sensitive personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon as soon as feasibly possible, but no later than 15 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: CCPA 3.3 - Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.title: Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.body: The organization has established processes to limit the collection, use, retention, and sharing of a consumer's personal information to the minimum that is relevant, proportional and reasonably necessary for the identified purposes.

controls.name: SC-32(1) - System Partitioning | Separate Physical Domains for Privileged Functions
controls.title: System Partitioning | Separate Physical Domains for Privileged Functions
controls.body: Partition privileged functions into separate physical domains.

controls.name: 6.9.1.3 - Capacity Management
controls.title: Capacity Management
controls.body: The use of resources shall be monitored, tuned and projections made of future capacity requirements to ensure the required system performance.

controls.name: CIS 5.4-PR - Administrator Privileges
controls.title: Administrator Privileges
controls.body:
Account Management
Safeguard 5.4: Restrict administrator privileges to dedicated administrator accounts.

controls.name: 6.8.2.6 - Security of Equipment and Assets Off-premises
controls.title: Security of Equipment and Assets Off-premises
controls.body: Security shall be applied to off-site assets taking into account the different risks of working outside the organization’s premises.

controls.name: APP 11.1 - Security of Personal Information (PI)
controls.title: Security of Personal Information (PI)
controls.body: The organization or agency must have appropriate safeguards in place to protect personal information from misuse, interference and loss and from unauthorized access, modification or disclosure.

controls.name: CIS 12.5-PR - Network AAA
controls.title: Network AAA
controls.body:
Network Infrastructure Management
Safeguard 12.5: Centralize network Authentication, Authorization and Accounting (AAA).

controls.name: CCPA 2.2 - Right to Request Deletion
controls.title: Right to Request Deletion
controls.body: Requests from consumers for deletion of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon no later than 45 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: CIS 16.9-PR - Application Security and Secure Coding Practices
controls.title: Application Security and Secure Coding Practices
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.9: Train developers in application security concepts and secure coding.

controls.name: CIS 3.11-PR - Encryption of Data At Rest
controls.title: Encryption of Data At Rest
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.11: Encrypt sensitive data at rest.

controls.name: B.8.5.5 - Legally Binding PII Disclosures
controls.title: Legally Binding PII Disclosures
controls.body: The organization shall reject any requests for PII disclosures that are not legally binding, consult the corresponding customer before making any PII disclosures and accepting any contractually agreed requests for PII disclosures that are authorized by the corresponding customer.

controls.name: SI-10(5) - Information Input Validation | Restrict Inputs to Trusted Sources and Approved Formats
controls.title: Information Input Validation | Restrict Inputs to Trusted Sources and Approved Formats
controls.body: Restrict the use of information inputs to [Assignment: organization-defined trusted sources] and/or [Assignment: organization-defined formats].

controls.name: CIS 6.5-PR - MFA for Administrative Access
controls.title: MFA for Administrative Access
controls.body:
Access Control Management
Safeguard 6.5: Enforce MFA for administrative access.

controls.name: A.7.2.4 - Obtain and Record Consent
controls.title: Obtain and Record Consent
controls.body: The organization shall obtain and record consent from PII principals according to the documented processes.

controls.name: CCPA 4.2 - Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.title: Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.body: The organization maintains written contracts with service providers, contractors, or third parties with who it shares, sells, or discloses consumers' personal information. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by the service provider for the protection of consumers' personal information.

controls.name: CIS 11.1-RC - Data Recovery Process
controls.title: Data Recovery Process
controls.body:
Data Recovery
Safeguard 11.1: Establish and maintain a data recovery process.

controls.name: SC-31 - Covert Channel Analysis
controls.title: Covert Channel Analysis
controls.body:
a. Perform a covert channel analysis to identify those aspects of communications within the system that are potential avenues for covert [Selection (one or more): storage; timing] channels; and
b. Estimate the maximum bandwidth of those channels.

controls.name: 7.9 - Security of Assets Off-Premises
controls.title: Security of Assets Off-Premises
controls.body: Off-site assets shall be protected.

controls.name: 5.22 - Monitoring, Review and Change Management of Supplier Services
controls.title: Monitoring, Review and Change Management of Supplier Services
controls.body: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage changes in supplier information security practices and service delivery.

controls.name: CIS 15.5-ID - Service Provider Assessment
controls.title: Service Provider Assessment
controls.body:
Service Provider Management
Safeguard 15.5: Assess service providers.

controls.name: CIS 15.1-ID - Service Providers Inventory
controls.title: Service Providers Inventory
controls.body:
Service Provider Management
Safeguard 15.1: Establish and maintain an inventory of service providers.

controls.name: CIS 15.6-DE - Monitoring of Service Providers
controls.title: Monitoring of Service Providers
controls.body:
Service Provider Management
Safeguard 15.6: Monitor service providers.

controls.name: 6.9.1.2 - Change Management
controls.title: Change Management
controls.body: Changes to the organization, business processes, information processing facilities and systems that affect information security shall be controlled.

controls.name: 5.20 - Addressing Information Security within Supplier Agreements
controls.title: Addressing Information Security within Supplier Agreements
controls.body: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed upon with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.

controls.name: A.7.2.5 - Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.title: Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.body: The organization shall assess the need for, and implement where appropriate, a privacy impact assessment whenever new processing of PII or changes to existing processing of PII is planned.

controls.name: PCI 1.1.1 - Network Security Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Network Security Policies and Procedures
controls.body:
All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 1 are:
- Documented.
- Kept up to date.
- In use.
- Known to all affected parties.

controls.name: ITGC - Data Backup
controls.title: Data Backup
controls.body: Data is appropriately backed up and recoverable according to data backup policy. Backups are monitored for failure using an automated system.

controls.name: ITGC - Change Authorization
controls.title: Change Authorization
controls.body: Changes to the application(s) and supporting infrastructure are documented, tested and approved by authorized personnel prior to implementation into the production environment in accordance with the change management process.

controls.name: 8.32 - Change Management
controls.title: Change Management
controls.body: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

controls.name: CIS 1.2-RE - Unauthorized Assets
controls.title: Unauthorized Assets
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
Safeguard 1.2: Address unauthorized assets.

controls.name: 6.8.2.5 - Removal of Assets
controls.title: Removal of Assets
controls.body: Equipment, information or software shall not be taken off-site without prior authorization.

controls.name: CIS 8.7-DE - URL Request Audit Logs
controls.title: URL Request Audit Logs
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.7: Collect URL request audit logs.

controls.name: CIS 4.7-PR - Management of Default Accounts
controls.title: Management of Default Accounts
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.7: Manage default accounts on enterprise assets and software.

controls.name: CIS 16.14-PR - Threat Modeling
controls.title: Threat Modeling
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.14: Conduct threat modeling.

controls.name: SI-7(17) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Runtime Application Self-protection
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Runtime Application Self-protection
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined controls] for application self-protection at runtime.

controls.name: CIS 8.9-DE - Centralized Audit Logs
controls.title: Centralized Audit Logs
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.9: Centralize audit logs.

controls.name: SC-5(2) - Denial-of-service Protection | Capacity, Bandwidth, and Redundancy
controls.title: Denial-of-service Protection | Capacity, Bandwidth, and Redundancy
controls.body: Manage capacity, bandwidth, or other redundancy to limit the effects of information flooding denial-of-service attacks.

controls.name: SC-7(22) - Boundary Protection | Separate Subnets for Connecting to Different Security Domains
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Separate Subnets for Connecting to Different Security Domains
controls.body: Implement separate network addresses to connect to systems in different security domains.

controls.name: SI-12 - Information Management and Retention
controls.title: Information Management and Retention
controls.body: Manage and retain information within the system and information output from the system in accordance with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, guidelines and operational requirements.

controls.name: SI-10 - Information Input Validation
controls.title: Information Input Validation
controls.body: Check the validity of the following information inputs: [Assignment: organization-defined information inputs to the system].

controls.name: SC-12(6) - Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Physical Control of Keys
controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Physical Control of Keys
controls.body: Maintain physical control of cryptographic keys when stored information is encrypted by external service providers.

controls.name: SC-30(4) - Concealment and Misdirection | Misleading Information
controls.title: Concealment and Misdirection | Misleading Information
controls.body: Employ realistic, but misleading information in [Assignment: organization-defined system components] about its security state or posture.

controls.name: SI-10(1) - Information Input Validation | Manual Override Capability
controls.title: Information Input Validation | Manual Override Capability

controls.name: CIS 5.5-ID - Inventory of Service Accounts
controls.title: Inventory of Service Accounts
controls.body:
Account Management
Safeguard 5.5: Establish and maintain an inventory of service accounts.

controls.name: SR-11(2) - Component Authenticity | Configuration Control for Component Service and Repair
controls.title: Component Authenticity | Configuration Control for Component Service and Repair
controls.body: Maintain configuration control over the following system components awaiting service or repair and serviced or repaired components awaiting return to service: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.name: CIS 3.5-ID - Data Disposal
controls.title: Data Disposal
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.5: Securely dispose of data.

controls.name: A.7.3.1 - Determining and Fulfilling Obligations to PII Principals
controls.title: Determining and Fulfilling Obligations to PII Principals
controls.body: The organization shall determine and document their legal, regulatory and business obligations to PII principals related to the processing of their PII and provide the means to meet these obligations.

controls.name: SI-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] system and information integrity policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the system and information integrity policy and the associated system and information integrity controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the system and information integrity policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current system and information integrity:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: CIS 12.7-PR - Remote Access Control
controls.title: Remote Access Control
controls.body:
Network Infrastructure Management
Safeguard 12.7: Ensure remote devices utilize a VPN and are connecting to an enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.name: SI-13 - Predictable Failure Prevention
controls.title: Predictable Failure Prevention
controls.body:
a. Determine mean time to failure (MTTF) for the following system components in specific environments of operation: [Assignment: organization-defined system components]; and
b. Provide substitute system components and a means to exchange active and standby components in accordance with the following criteria: [Assignment: organization-defined MTTF substitution criteria].

controls.name: 6.6.4.4 - Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.title: Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.body: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

controls.name: Clause 5.5.2 - Competence
controls.title: Competence

controls.name: CCPA 2.6 - Right to Opt-out of Sale or Sharing
controls.title: Right to Opt-out of Sale or Sharing
controls.body: Requests from consumers to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon as soon as feasibly possible, but no later than 15 business days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: 3.14.7e - Correctness of Security-Critical and Essential Software
controls.title: Correctness of Security-Critical and Essential Software
controls.body: Verify the correctness of [Assignment: organization-defined security critical or essential software] using [Assignment: organization-defined verification methods or techniques].

controls.name: CIS 8.5-DE - Detailed Audit Logs
controls.title: Detailed Audit Logs
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.5: Collect detailed audit logs.

controls.name: 6.5.1.2 - Ownership of Assets
controls.title: Ownership of Assets
controls.body: Assets maintained in the inventory shall be owned.

controls.name: 8.14 - Redundancy of Information Processing Facilities
controls.title: Redundancy of Information Processing Facilities
controls.body: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet the availability requirements.

controls.name: 6.4.3.1 - Termination or Change of Employment Responsibilities
controls.title: Termination or Change of Employment Responsibilities
controls.body: Information security and privacy responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, communicated to the employee or contractor and enforced.

controls.name: 6.3.1.3 - Contact with Authorities
controls.title: Contact with Authorities
controls.body: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.

controls.name: Clause 5.3.3 - Organizational Roles, Responsibilities and Authorities
controls.title: Organizational Roles, Responsibilities and Authorities
controls.body:
Top management shall ensure that the responsibilities and authorities for roles relevant to information security and privacy are assigned and communicated.

Top management shall assign the responsibility and authority for:
a) ensuring that the information security and privacy management systems conform to the requirements of this International Standard; and
b) reporting on the performance of the information security and privacy management systems to top management.

controls.name: PCI 1.1.2 - Network Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Network Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 1 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.name: 5.6 - Contact with Special Interest Groups
controls.title: Contact with Special Interest Groups
controls.body: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.

controls.name: SI-4(3) - System Monitoring | Automated Tool and Mechanism Integration
controls.title: System Monitoring | Automated Tool and Mechanism Integration
controls.body: Employ automated tools and mechanisms to integrate intrusion detection tools and mechanisms into access control and flow control mechanisms.

controls.name: 6.11.2.9 - System Acceptance Testing
controls.title: System Acceptance Testing
controls.body: Acceptance testing programs and related criteria shall be established for new information systems, upgrades and new versions.

controls.name: Clause 5.5.4 - Communication
controls.title: Communication

controls.name: SC-7(14) - Boundary Protection | Protect Against Unauthorized Physical Connections
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Protect Against Unauthorized Physical Connections
controls.body: Protect against unauthorized physical connections at [Assignment: organization-defined managed interfaces].

controls.name: SI-14 - Non-persistence
controls.title: Non-persistence
controls.body: Implement non-persistent [Assignment: organization-defined system components and services] that are initiated in a known state and terminated [Selection (one or more): upon end of session of use; periodically at [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]].

controls.name: CIS 9.4-PR - Restriction of Browser and Email Extensions
controls.title: Restriction of Browser and Email Extensions
controls.body:
Email and Web Browser Protections
Safeguard 9.4: Restrict unnecessary or unauthorized browser and email client extensions.

controls.name: PCI 1.2.1 - Network Security Controls (NSCs) Configuration
controls.title: Network Security Controls (NSCs) Configuration
controls.body:
Configuration standards for NSC rulesets are:
- Defined.
- Implemented.
- Maintained.

controls.name: CIS 16.3-PR - Root Analysis on Security Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Root Analysis on Security Vulnerabilities
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.3: Perform root cause analysis on security vulnerabilities.

controls.name: SI-15 - Information Output Filtering
controls.title: Information Output Filtering
controls.body: Validate information output from the following software programs and/or applications to ensure that the information is consistent with the expected content: [Assignment: organization-defined software programs and/or applications].

controls.name: SI-18 - Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations
controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations
controls.body:
a. Check the accuracy, relevance, timeliness, and completeness of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; and
b. Correct or delete inaccurate or outdated personally identifiable information.

controls.name: APP 1.1 - Personal Information (PI) Management
controls.title: Personal Information (PI) Management
controls.body: The organization or agency has developed and implemented appropriate practices, procedures, and systems to deal with inquiries or complaints in compliance with the APPs and relevant binding APP codes. These practices and procedures are reviewed and approved by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: SA-15(10) - Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Incident Response Plan
controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Incident Response Plan
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to provide, implement, and test an incident response plan.

controls.name: PCI 1.2.2 - Testing and Changes to NSCs
controls.title: Testing and Changes to NSCs
controls.body: All changes to network connections and to configurations of NSCs are approved and managed in accordance with the change control process defined in Requirement 6.5.1.

controls.name: CIS 10.6-PR - Anti-malware Management
controls.title: Anti-malware Management
controls.body:
Malware Defenses
Safeguard 10.6: Centrally manage anti-malware software.

controls.name: A.7.3.6 - Access, Correction and/or Erasure
controls.title: Access, Correction and/or Erasure
controls.body: The organization shall implement policies, procedures and/or mechanisms to meet their obligations to PII principals to access, correct and/or erase their PII.

controls.name: SC-28(3) - Protection of Information at Rest | Cryptographic Keys
controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest | Cryptographic Keys
controls.body: Provide protected storage for cryptographic keys [Selection: [Assignment: organization-defined safeguards]; hardware-protected key store].

controls.name: PCI 1.2.3 - Network Diagram
controls.title: Network Diagram
controls.body: An accurate network diagram(s) is maintained that shows all connections between the CDE and other networks, including any wireless networks.

controls.name: 5.18 - Access Rights
controls.title: Access Rights
controls.body: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization’s topic-specific policy on and rules for access control.

controls.name: 6.9.3.1 - Information Backup
controls.title: Information Backup
controls.body: Backup copies of information, software and system images shall be taken and tested regularly in accordance with an agreed backup policy.

controls.name: PCI 1.2.4 - Data Flow Diagram
controls.title: Data Flow Diagram
controls.body:
An accurate data-flow diagram(s) is maintained that meets the following:
- Shows all account data flows across systems and networks.
- Updated as needed upon changes to the environment.

controls.name: PCI 1.2.6 - Configuration of Security Features
controls.title: Configuration of Security Features
controls.body: Security features are defined and implemented for all services, protocols, and ports that are in use and considered to be insecure, such that the risk is mitigated.

controls.name: APP 6.2 - De-identification of Health Information before Disclosure
controls.title: De-identification of Health Information before Disclosure
controls.body: The organization must have mechanisms in place to de-identify personal health information before it is disclosed for a secondary purpose.

controls.name: Clause 5.4.2 - Information Security and Privacy Objectives and Plans
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Objectives and Plans

controls.name: 3.14.2e - Continuous System Monitoring
controls.title: Continuous System Monitoring
controls.body: Monitor organizational systems and system components on an ongoing basis for anomalous or suspicious behavior.

controls.name: 5.7 - Threat Intelligence
controls.title: Threat Intelligence
controls.body: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analyzed to produce threat intelligence.

controls.name: PCI 3.2.1 - Cardholder Data Storage and Disposal
controls.title: Cardholder Data Storage and Disposal
controls.body:
Account data storage is kept to a minimum through the implementation of data retention and disposal policies, procedures, and processes that include at least the following:
- Coverage for all locations of stored account data.
- Coverage for any sensitive authentication data (SAD) stored prior to completion of authorization. This bullet is a best practice until its effective date; refer to Applicability Notes below for details.
- Limiting data storage amount and retention time to that which is required for legal or regulatory, and/or business requirements.
- Specific retention requirements for stored account data that define the length of the retention period and include a documented business justification.
- Processes for the secure deletion or rendering account data unrecoverable when no longer needed per the retention policy.
- A process for verifying, at least once every three months, that stored account data exceeding the defined retention period has been securely deleted or rendered unrecoverable.

controls.name: PCI 1.2.7 - Review of Configurations of NSCs
controls.title: Review of Configurations of NSCs
controls.body: Configurations of NSCs are reviewed at least once every six months to confirm they are relevant and effective.

controls.name: 8.8 - Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.body: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization’s exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.

controls.name: SC-23(1) - Session Authenticity | Invalidate Session Identifiers at Logout
controls.title: Session Authenticity | Invalidate Session Identifiers at Logout
controls.body: Invalidate session identifiers upon user logout or other session termination.

controls.name: 6.15.1.1 - Identification of Applicable Legislation and Contractual Requirements
controls.title: Identification of Applicable Legislation and Contractual Requirements
controls.body: All relevant legislative statutory, regulatory, contractual requirements and the organization’s approach to meet these requirements shall be explicitly identified, documented and kept up to date for each information system and the organization.

controls.name: PCI 1.2.8 - Secure NSCs Configuration Files
controls.title: Secure NSCs Configuration Files
controls.body:
Configuration files for NSCs are:
- Secured from unauthorized access.
- Kept consistent with active network configurations.

controls.name: SI-18(1) - Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Automation Support
controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Automation Support
controls.body: Correct or delete personally identifiable information that is inaccurate or outdated, incorrectly determined regarding impact, or incorrectly de-identified using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: SC-6 - Resource Availability
controls.title: Resource Availability
controls.body: Protect the availability of resources by allocating [Assignment: organization-defined resources] by [Selection (one or more): priority; quota; [Assignment: organization-defined controls]].

controls.name: 5.36 - Compliance with Policies, Rules and Standards for Information Security
controls.title: Compliance with Policies, Rules and Standards for Information Security
controls.body: Compliance with the organization’s information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards shall be regularly reviewed.

controls.name: SI-7(7) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Integration of Detection and Response
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Integration of Detection and Response
controls.body: Incorporate the detection of the following unauthorized changes into the organizational incident response capability: [Assignment: organization-defined security-relevant changes to the system].

controls.name: PCI 1.3.3 - NSCs Installation between Wireless Network and CDE
controls.title: NSCs Installation between Wireless Network and CDE
controls.body:
NSCs are installed between all wireless networks and the CDE, regardless of whether the wireless network is a CDE, such that:
- All wireless traffic from wireless networks into the CDE is denied by default.
- Only wireless traffic with an authorized business purpose is allowed into the CDE.

controls.name: CIS 8.8-DE - Command-Line Audit Logs
controls.title: Command-Line Audit Logs
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.8: Collect command-line audit logs.

controls.name: PCI 1.4.1 - Installation of NSCs between Trusted and Untrusted Networks
controls.title: Installation of NSCs between Trusted and Untrusted Networks
controls.body: NSCs are implemented between trusted and untrusted networks.

controls.name: PCI 1.2.5 - Business Justification for Services, Protocols and Ports
controls.title: Business Justification for Services, Protocols and Ports
controls.body: All services, protocols, and ports allowed are identified, approved, and have a defined business need.

controls.name: PCI 1.4.3 - Anti-Spoofing Measures
controls.title: Anti-Spoofing Measures
controls.body: Anti-spoofing measures are implemented to detect and block forged source IP addresses from entering the trusted network.

controls.name: 5.19 - Information Security in Supplier Relationships
controls.title: Information Security in Supplier Relationships
controls.body: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of suppliers’ products or services.

controls.name: 5.4 - Management Responsibilities
controls.title: Management Responsibilities
controls.body: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.

controls.name: SI-5 - Security Alerts, Advisories, and Directives
controls.title: Security Alerts, Advisories, and Directives

controls.name: APP 13.1 - Correction of Personal Information (PI)
controls.title: Correction of Personal Information (PI)
controls.body: The organization or agency must implement policies, procedures and/or mechanisms to correct personal information it holds about an individual when a request is made or when the entity believes that the personal information is inaccurate.

controls.name: 5.5 - Contact with Authorities
controls.title: Contact with Authorities
controls.body: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

controls.name: CIS 17.6-RE - Incident Response Communication Mechanisms
controls.title: Incident Response Communication Mechanisms
controls.body:
Incident Response Management
Safeguard 17.6: Define mechanisms for communicating during incident response.

controls.name: CIS 12.1-PR - Updated Network Infrastructure
controls.title: Updated Network Infrastructure
controls.body:
Network Infrastructure Management
Safeguard 12.1: Ensure network infrastructure is up-to-date.

controls.name: SC-7(25) - Boundary Protection | Unclassified National Security System Connections
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Unclassified National Security System Connections
controls.body: Prohibit the direct connection of [Assignment: organization-defined unclassified national security system] to an external network without the use of [Assignment: organization-defined boundary protection device].

controls.name: PCI 1.4.5 - Disclosure of IP Addresses and Routing Information
controls.title: Disclosure of IP Addresses and Routing Information
controls.body: The disclosure of internal IP addresses and routing information is limited to only authorized parties.

controls.name: 6.13.1.5 - Response to Information Security and Privacy Incidents
controls.title: Response to Information Security and Privacy Incidents
controls.body: Information security and privacy incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

controls.name: 6.9.7.1 - Information Systems Audit Controls
controls.title: Information Systems Audit Controls
controls.body: Audit requirements and activities involving verification of operational systems shall be carefully planned and agreed to minimize disruptions to business processes.

controls.name: SC-39(1) - Process Isolation | Hardware Separation
controls.title: Process Isolation | Hardware Separation
controls.body: Implement hardware separation mechanisms to facilitate process isolation.

controls.name: Clause 5.2.3 - ISMS and PIMS Scope
controls.title: ISMS and PIMS Scope
controls.body:
The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the information security management system and the privacy information management system to establish the scope. When determining this scope, the organization shall consider:
a) the external and internal issues referred to in ISO27701 5.2.1
b) the requirements referred to in ISO27701 5.2.2
c) interfaces and dependencies between activities performed by the organization and those that are performed by other organizations.

When determining the scope of the PIMS, the organization shall include the processing of PII.

controls.name: CIS 8.10-PR - Audit Log Retention
controls.title: Audit Log Retention
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.10: Retain audit logs.

controls.name: 8.31 - Separation Of Development, Test and Production Environments
controls.title: Separation Of Development, Test and Production Environments
controls.body: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.

controls.name: 5.8 - Information Security in Project Management
controls.title: Information Security in Project Management
controls.body: Information security shall be integrated into project management.

controls.name: CIS 9.3-PR - Network-based URL Filters
controls.title: Network-based URL Filters
controls.body:
Email and Web Browser Protections
Safeguard 9.3: Maintain and enforce network-based URL filters.

controls.name: PCI 1.5.1 - Security Controls for Computing Device
controls.title: Security Controls for Computing Device
controls.body:
Security controls are implemented on any computing devices, including company- and employee-owned devices, that connect to both untrusted networks (including the Internet) and the CDE as follows:
- Specific configuration settings are defined to prevent threats being introduced into the entity’s network.
- Security controls are actively running.
- Security controls are not alterable by users of the computing devices unless specifically documented and authorized by management on a case-by-case basis for a limited period.

controls.name: 6.5.3.1 - Management of Removable Media
controls.title: Management of Removable Media
controls.body: Procedures shall be implemented for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.name: SC-37(1) - Out-of-band Channels | Ensure Delivery and Transmission
controls.title: Out-of-band Channels | Ensure Delivery and Transmission
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined controls] to ensure that only [Assignment: organization-defined individuals or systems] receive the following information, system components, or devices: [Assignment: organization-defined information, system components, or devices].

controls.name: D3.PC.Im.Int.1 - Network Zone Segmentation
controls.title: Network Zone Segmentation
controls.body: The enterprise network is segmented into multiple, separate trust/security zones with defense-in-depth strategies (e.g., logical network segmentation, hard backups, air-gapping) to mitigate attacks.

controls.name: SC-7(11) - Boundary Protection | Restrict Incoming Communications Traffic
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Restrict Incoming Communications Traffic
controls.body: Only allow incoming communications from [Assignment: organization-defined authorized sources] to be routed to [Assignment: organization-defined authorized destinations].

controls.name: CIS 13.11-DE - Security Event Alerting Thresholds
controls.title: Security Event Alerting Thresholds
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.11: Tune security event alerting thresholds.

controls.name: SC-2(2) - Separation of System and User Functionality | Disassociability
controls.title: Separation of System and User Functionality | Disassociability
controls.body: Store state information from applications and software separately.

controls.name: CIS 4.8-PR - Restriction of Unnecessary Services
controls.title: Restriction of Unnecessary Services
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.8: Uninstall or disable unnecessary services on enterprise assets and software.

controls.name: SI-18(4) - Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Individual Requests
controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Individual Requests
controls.body: Correct or delete personally identifiable information upon request by individuals or their designated representatives.

controls.name: CCPA 1.1 - Privacy Notice
controls.title: Privacy Notice
controls.body: The organization has a privacy notice published on its website, which outlines privacy obligations and specifies individual rights in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The notice is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: 6.11.2.1 - Secure Development Policy
controls.title: Secure Development Policy
controls.body: Rules for the development of software and systems shall be established and applied to developments within the organization.

controls.name: SI-19(6) - De-identification | Differential Privacy
controls.title: De-identification | Differential Privacy
controls.body: Prevent disclosure of personally identifiable information by adding non-deterministic noise to the results of mathematical operations before the results are reported.

controls.name: ITGC - Reports
controls.title: Reports
controls.body: Reports generated from the financially relevant system(s) are complete and accurate.

controls.name: 6.6.4.5 - Access Control to Program Source Code
controls.title: Access Control to Program Source Code
controls.body: Access to program source code shall be restricted.

controls.name: SI-19(7) - De-identification | Validated Algorithms and Software
controls.title: De-identification | Validated Algorithms and Software
