controls.body: Perform de-identification using validated algorithms and software that is validated to implement the algorithms.

controls.name: CIS 14.9-PR - Role-Based Training
controls.title: Role-Based Training
controls.body:
Security Awareness and Skills Training
Safeguard 14.9: Conduct role-specific security awareness and skills training.

controls.name: 6.8.1.4 - Protecting against External and Environmental Threats
controls.title: Protecting against External and Environmental Threats
controls.body: Physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attacks or accidents shall be designed and applied.

controls.name: SC-17 - Public Key Infrastructure Certificates
controls.title: Public Key Infrastructure Certificates
controls.body:
a. Issue public key certificates under an [Assignment: organization-defined certificate policy] or obtain public key certificates from an approved service provider; and
b. Include only approved trust anchors in trust stores or certificate stores managed by the organization.

controls.name: 6.8.2.4 - Equipment Maintenance
controls.title: Equipment Maintenance
controls.body: Equipment shall be correctly maintained to ensure its continued availability and integrity.

controls.name: CIS 17.3-RE - Incident Reporting Process
controls.title: Incident Reporting Process
controls.body:
Incident Response Management
Safeguard 17.3: Establish and maintain an enterprise process for reporting incidents.

controls.name: CIS 4.11-PR - Remote Wipe Capability
controls.title: Remote Wipe Capability
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.11: Enforce remote wipe capability on portable end-user devices.

controls.name: PCI 2.1.1 - Network Security Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Network Security Policies and Procedures
controls.body:
All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 2 are:
- Documented.
- Kept up to date.
- In use.
- Known to all affected parties.

controls.name: SC-16(1) - Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes | Integrity Verification
controls.title: Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes | Integrity Verification
controls.body: Verify the integrity of transmitted security and privacy attributes.

controls.name: SC-21 - Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Recursive or Caching Resolver)
controls.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Recursive or Caching Resolver)
controls.body: Request and perform data origin authentication and data integrity verification on the name/address resolution responses the system receives from authoritative sources.

controls.name: SC-7(27) - Boundary Protection | Unclassified Non-national Security System Connections
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Unclassified Non-national Security System Connections
controls.body: Prohibit the direct connection of [Assignment: organization-defined unclassified non-national security system] to an external network without the use of [Assignment: organization-defined boundary protection device].

controls.name: CIS 18.5-ID - Internal Penetration Tests
controls.title: Internal Penetration Tests
controls.body:
Penetration Testing
Safeguard 18.5: Perform periodic internal penetration tests.

controls.name: SI-23 - Information Fragmentation
controls.title: Information Fragmentation
controls.body:
Based on [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances]:

a. Fragment the following information: [Assignment: organization-defined information]; and
b. Distribute the fragmented information across the following systems or system components: [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: SI-20 - Tainting
controls.title: Tainting
controls.body: Embed data or capabilities in the following systems or system components to determine if organizational data has been exfiltrated or improperly removed from the organization: [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: CIS 4.12-PR - Organization Workspace Separation
controls.title: Organization Workspace Separation
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.12: Separate enterprise workspaces on mobile end-user devices.

controls.name: IA.L2-3.5.9 - Temporary Passwords (NIST 800-171: 3.5.9)
controls.title: Temporary Passwords (NIST 800-171: 3.5.9)
controls.body: Allow temporary password use for system logins with an immediate change to a permanent password.

controls.name: IA.L2-3.5.8 - Password Reuse (NIST 800-171: 3.5.8)
controls.title: Password Reuse (NIST 800-171: 3.5.8)
controls.body: Prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations.

controls.name: PCI 2.1.2 - Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 2 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.name: PCI 2.2.1 - Configuration Standards
controls.title: Configuration Standards
controls.body:
Configuration standards are developed, implemented, and maintained to:
- Cover all system components.
- Address all known security vulnerabilities.
- Be consistent with industry-accepted system hardening standards or vendor hardening recommendations.
- Be updated as new vulnerability issues are identified, as defined in Requirement 6.3.1.
- Be applied when new systems are configured and verified as in place before or immediately after a system component is connected to a production environment.

controls.name: SC-27 - Platform-independent Applications
controls.title: Platform-independent Applications
controls.body: Include within organizational systems the following platform independent applications: [Assignment: organization-defined platform-independent applications].

controls.name: CIS 13.5-PR - Remote Asset Access Control
controls.title: Remote Asset Access Control
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.5: Manage access control for remote assets.

controls.name: 5.10 - Acceptable Use of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.title: Acceptable Use of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.body: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.

controls.name: PCI 3.4.2 - Restrict Copy/Relocation of PAN
controls.title: Restrict Copy/Relocation of PAN
controls.body: When using remote-access technologies, technical controls prevent copy and/or relocation of PAN for all personnel, except for those with documented, explicit authorization and a legitimate, defined business need.

controls.name: PE.L2-3.10.2 - Monitor Facility (NIST 800-171: 3.10.2)
controls.title: Monitor Facility (NIST 800-171: 3.10.2)
controls.body: Protect and monitor the physical facility and support infrastructure for organizational systems.

controls.name: SR-3 - Supply Chain Controls and Processes
controls.title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes

controls.name: SI-4(10) - System Monitoring | Visibility of Encrypted Communications
controls.title: System Monitoring | Visibility of Encrypted Communications
controls.body: Make provisions so that [Assignment: organization-defined encrypted communications traffic] is visible to [Assignment: organization-defined system monitoring tools and mechanisms].

controls.name: SR-4 - Provenance
controls.title: Provenance
controls.body: Document, monitor, and maintain valid provenance of the following systems, system components, and associated data: [Assignment: organization-defined systems, system components, and associated data].

controls.name: CIS 15.2-ID - Service Provider Management Policy
controls.title: Service Provider Management Policy
controls.body:
Service Provider Management
Safeguard 15.2: Establish and maintain a service provider management policy.

controls.name: APP 10.1 - Accuracy and Quality of Personal Information (PI)
controls.title: Accuracy and Quality of Personal Information (PI)
controls.body: The organization or agency must implement policies, procedures, or mechanisms to ensure that the personal information it collects, uses, discloses or holds is accurate, up-to-date, complete and relevant.

controls.name: CIS 4.6-PR - Secure Management of Assets and Software
controls.title: Secure Management of Assets and Software
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.6: Securely manage enterprise assets and software.

controls.name: CIS 15.4-PR - Service Provider Contracts
controls.title: Service Provider Contracts
controls.body:
Service Provider Management
Safeguard 15.4: Ensure service provider contracts include security requirements.

controls.name: Clause 5.7.3 - Management Review
controls.title: Management Review

controls.name: CIS 9.5-PR - DMARC Policy
controls.title: DMARC Policy
controls.body:
Email and Web Browser Protections
Safeguard 9.5: Implement domain-based message authentication, reporting and conformance (DMARC).

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.19 - Encrypt CUI on Mobile (NIST 800-171: 3.1.19)
controls.title: Encrypt CUI on Mobile (NIST 800-171: 3.1.19)
controls.body: Encrypt Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) on mobile devices and mobile computing platforms.

controls.name: AU.L2-3.3.4 - Audit Failure Alerting (NIST 800-171: 3.3.4)
controls.title: Audit Failure Alerting (NIST 800-171: 3.3.4)
controls.body: Alert in the event of an audit logging process failure.

controls.name: PCI 2.2.2 - Vendor Default Accounts
controls.title: Vendor Default Accounts
controls.body:
Vendor default accounts are managed as follows:
- If the vendor default account(s) will be used, the default password is changed per Requirement 8.3.6.
- If the vendor default account(s) will not be used, the account is removed or disabled.

controls.name: SR-4(4) - Provenance | Supply Chain Integrity — Pedigree
controls.title: Provenance | Supply Chain Integrity — Pedigree
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined controls] and conduct [Assignment: organization-defined analysis] to ensure the integrity of the system and system components by validating the internal composition and provenance of critical or mission-essential technologies, products, and services.

controls.name: CIS 9.6-PR - Blocking of File Types
controls.title: Blocking of File Types
controls.body:
Email and Web Browser Protections
Safeguard 9.6: Block unnecessary file types.

controls.name: CM.L2-3.4.7 - Nonessential Functionality (NIST 800-171: 3.4.7)
controls.title: Nonessential Functionality (NIST 800-171: 3.4.7)
controls.body: Restrict, disable or prevent the use of nonessential programs, functions, ports, protocols and services.

controls.name: 5.12 - Classification of Information
controls.title: Classification of Information
controls.body: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.

controls.name: A.7.3.2 - Determining Information for PII Principals
controls.title: Determining Information for PII Principals
controls.body: The organization shall determine and document the information to be provided to PII principals regarding the processing of their PII and the timing of such a provision.

controls.name: 6.8.1.2 - Physical Entry Controls
controls.title: Physical Entry Controls
controls.body: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.

controls.name: IR.L2-3.6.2 - Incident Reporting (NIST 800-171: 3.6.2)
controls.title: Incident Reporting (NIST 800-171: 3.6.2)
controls.body: Track, document and report incidents to designated officials and/or authorities both internal and external to the organization.

controls.name: PCI 2.2.3 - Configuration of Primary Functions
controls.title: Configuration of Primary Functions
controls.body:
Primary functions requiring different security levels are managed as follows:
- Only one primary function exists on a system component,
OR
- Primary functions with differing security levels that exist on the same system component are isolated from each other,
OR
- Primary functions with differing security levels on the same system component are all secured to the level required by the function with the highest security need.

controls.name: 6.8.2.2 - Supporting Utilities
controls.title: Supporting Utilities
controls.body: Equipment shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

controls.name: PCI 2.2.4 - Allow Required Services and Protocols
controls.title: Allow Required Services and Protocols
controls.body: Only necessary services, protocols, daemons, and functions are enabled, and all unnecessary functionality is removed or disabled.

controls.name: A.7.3.9 - Handling Requests
controls.title: Handling Requests
controls.body: The organization shall define and document policies and procedures for handling and responding to legitimate requests from PII principals.

controls.name: PCI 2.2.5 - Insecure Services, Protocols, or Daemons
controls.title: Insecure Services, Protocols, or Daemons
controls.body:
If any insecure services, protocols, or daemons are present:
- Business justification is documented.
- Additional security features are documented and implemented that reduce the risk of using insecure services, protocols, or daemons.

controls.name: CIS 10.2-PR - Update of Anti-malware Signatures
controls.title: Update of Anti-malware Signatures
controls.body:
Malware Defenses
Safeguard 10.2: Configure automatic anti-malware signature updates.

controls.name: A.7.3.10 - Automated Decision Making
controls.title: Automated Decision Making
controls.body: The organization shall identify and address obligations, including legal obligations, to the PII principals resulting from decisions made by the organization which are related to the PII principal based solely on automated processing of PII.

controls.name: AU.L2-3.3.9 - Audit Management (NIST 800-171: 3.3.9)
controls.title: Audit Management (NIST 800-171: 3.3.9)
controls.body: Limit management of audit logging functionality to a subset of privileged users.

controls.name: A.7.4.2 - Limit Processing
controls.title: Limit Processing
controls.body: The organization shall limit the processing of PII to that which is adequate, relevant and necessary for the identified purposes.

controls.name: CIS 1.1-ID - Asset Inventory
controls.title: Asset Inventory
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets 
Safeguard 1.1: Establish and maintain detailed enterprise asset inventory.

controls.name: CIS 10.7-DE - Behaviour-based Anti-malware
controls.title: Behaviour-based Anti-malware
controls.body:
Malware Defenses
Safeguard 10.7: Use behavior-based anti-malware software.

controls.name: SR-6(1) - Supplier Assessments and Reviews | Testing and Analysis
controls.title: Supplier Assessments and Reviews | Testing and Analysis
controls.body: Employ [Selection (one or more): organizational analysis; independent third-party analysis; organizational testing; independent third-party testing] of the following supply chain elements, processes, and actors associated with the system, system component, or system service: [Assignment: organization-defined supply chain elements, processes, and actors].

controls.name: APP 13.2 - Notification of Correction to Third-Parties
controls.title: Notification of Correction to Third-Parties
controls.body: The organization or agency shall, on request, reasonably notify another APP entity when a correction is made to personal information that was previously provided to that entity.

controls.name: A.7.4.3 - Accuracy and Quality
controls.title: Accuracy and Quality
controls.body: The organization shall ensure and document that PII is as accurate, complete and up-to-date as is necessary for the purposes for which it is processed, throughout the life-cycle of the PII.

controls.name: 6.8.2.7 - Secure Disposal or Reuse of Equipment
controls.title: Secure Disposal or Reuse of Equipment
controls.body: All items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

controls.name: 5.31 - Legal, Statutory, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements
controls.title: Legal, Statutory, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements
controls.body: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization’s approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date.

controls.name: A.7.2.8 - Records Related to Processing PII
controls.title: Records Related to Processing PII
controls.body: The organization shall determine and securely maintain the necessary records in support of its obligations for the processing of PII.

controls.name: SC-23(5) - Session Authenticity | Allowed Certificate Authorities
controls.title: Session Authenticity | Allowed Certificate Authorities
controls.body: Only allow the use of [Assignment: organization-defined certificate authorities] for verification of the establishment of protected sessions.

controls.name: A.7.4.7 - Retention
controls.title: Retention
controls.body: The organization shall not retain PII for longer than is necessary for the purposes for which the PII is processed.

controls.name: SC-31(1) - Covert Channel Analysis | Test Covert Channels for Exploitability
controls.title: Covert Channel Analysis | Test Covert Channels for Exploitability
controls.body: Test a subset of the identified covert channels to determine the channels that are exploitable.

controls.name: A.7.5.2 - Countries and International Organizations to which PII can be Transferred
controls.title: Countries and International Organizations to which PII can be Transferred
controls.body: The organization shall specify and document the countries and international organizations to which PII can possibly be transferred.

controls.name: Clause 5.8.2 - Continual Improvement
controls.title: Continual Improvement
controls.body: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the information security and privacy management systems.

controls.name: A.7.5.3 - Records of Transfer of PII
controls.title: Records of Transfer of PII
controls.body: The organization shall record transfers of PII to or from third parties and ensure cooperation with those parties to support future requests related to obligations to the PII principals.

controls.name: B.8.5.2 - Countries and International Organizations to which PII can be Transferred
controls.title: Countries and International Organizations to which PII can be Transferred
controls.body: The organization shall specify and document the countries and international organizations to which PII can possibly be transferred.

controls.name: CIS 10.4-DE - Automated Scanning of Removable Media
controls.title: Automated Scanning of Removable Media
controls.body:
Malware Defenses
Safeguard 10.4: Configure automatic anti-malware scanning of removable media.

controls.name: SA-17(1) - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Formal Policy Model
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Formal Policy Model
controls.body:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:

a. Produce, as an integral part of the development process, a formal policy model describing the [Assignment: organization-defined elements of organizational security and privacy policy] to be enforced; and
b. Prove that the formal policy model is internally consistent and sufficient to enforce the defined elements of the organizational security and privacy policy when implemented.

controls.name: PCI 2.2.6 - Configuration of Security Parameters
controls.title: Configuration of Security Parameters
controls.body: System security parameters are configured to prevent misuse.

controls.name: APP 5.1 - Notification to Individuals of Personal Information (PI) Collected
controls.title: Notification to Individuals of Personal Information (PI) Collected
controls.body: The organization or agency has established a process for providing notifications to individuals (or making them aware) regarding the collection of their personal information. These notifications must contain certain prescribed matters and must be made at or before the time of collection or as soon as practicable afterward.

controls.name: CIS 15.7-PR - Service Providers Decommissioning
controls.title: Service Providers Decommissioning
controls.body:
Service Provider Management
Safeguard 15.7: Securely decommission service providers.

controls.name: SC-24 - Fail in Known State
controls.title: Fail in Known State
controls.body: Fail to a [Assignment: organization-defined known system state] for the following failures on the indicated components while preserving [Assignment: organization-defined system state information] in failure: [Assignment: list of organization-defined types of system failures on organization-defined system components].

controls.name: SI-4(16) - System Monitoring | Correlate Monitoring Information
controls.title: System Monitoring | Correlate Monitoring Information
controls.body: Correlate information from monitoring tools and mechanisms employed throughout the system.

controls.name: DEI1 - Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Policy
controls.title: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Policy
controls.body: The organization has established a diversity, equity and inclusion policy which is reviewed on an annual basis by executive management. All employees and contractors are required to read and acknowledge the policy as part of onboarding and annually thereafter.

controls.name: ITGC - Batch Scheduler
controls.title: Batch Scheduler
controls.body: Only approved and tested changes are made to the batch scheduler.

controls.name: CIS 16.1-PR - Secure Application Development Process
controls.title: Secure Application Development Process
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.1: Establish and maintain a secure application development process.

controls.name: PCI 2.2.7 - Non-console Administrative Access
controls.title: Non-console Administrative Access
controls.body: All non-console administrative access is encrypted using strong cryptography.

controls.name: ITGC - Physical Access
controls.title: Physical Access
controls.body: Physical security controls are implemented to secure organization offices, rooms and facilities from unauthorized access.

controls.name: PCI 2.3.1 - Change Wireless Vendor Supplied Defaults
controls.title: Change Wireless Vendor Supplied Defaults
controls.body:
For wireless environments connected to the CDE or transmitting account data, all wireless vendor defaults are changed at installation or are confirmed to be secure, including but not limited to:
- Default wireless encryption keys.
- Passwords on wireless access points.
- SNMP defaults.
- Any other security-related wireless vendor defaults.

controls.name: Clause 5.5.1 - Resources
controls.title: Resources
controls.body: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the information security and privacy management systems.

controls.name: B.8.4.1 - Temporary Files
controls.title: Temporary Files
controls.body: The organization shall ensure that temporary files created as a result of the processing of PII are disposed of (e.g. erased or destroyed) following documented procedures within a specified, documented period.

controls.name: ITGC - Program Development/Upgrades
controls.title: Program Development/Upgrades
controls.body: New systems/major enhancements are adequately tested and authorized. Only properly approved new systems/major enhancements are migrated into production.

controls.name: PCI 2.3.2 - Change Wireless Vendor Supplied Configurations
controls.title: Change Wireless Vendor Supplied Configurations
controls.body:
For wireless environments connected to the CDE or transmitting account data, wireless encryption keys are changed as follows:
- Whenever personnel with knowledge of the key leave the company or the role for which the knowledge was necessary.
- Whenever a key is suspected of or known to be compromised.

controls.name: ITGC - Data Migration
controls.title: Data Migration
controls.body: Data is properly migrated/converted in an accurate and complete manner.

controls.name: ITGC - Monitoring of Program Developments
controls.title: Monitoring of Program Developments
controls.body: Problems during program development are monitored and resolved.

controls.name: CIS 16.8-PR - Environment Separation
controls.title: Environment Separation
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.8: Separate production and non-production systems.

controls.name: A.7.5.1 - Identify Basis for PII Transfer Between Jurisdictions
controls.title: Identify Basis for PII Transfer Between Jurisdictions
controls.body: The organization shall identify and document the relevant basis for transfers of PII between jurisdictions.

controls.name: 7.2 - Physical Entry
controls.title: Physical Entry
controls.body: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.

controls.name: ITGC - Interfaces
controls.title: Interfaces
controls.body: The information transferred between applications through interfaces (manual and automated) is complete and accurate.

controls.name: CIS 10.5-PR - Anti-exploitation Features
controls.title: Anti-exploitation Features
controls.body:
Malware Defenses
Safeguard 10.5: Enable anti-exploitation features.

controls.name: ITGC - Automated Application Controls
controls.title: Automated Application Controls
controls.body: Automated application controls that impact the financially relevant systems are executed in a complete and accurate manner.

controls.name: SI-5(1) - Security Alerts, Advisories, and Directives | Automated Alerts and Advisories
controls.title: Security Alerts, Advisories, and Directives | Automated Alerts and Advisories
controls.body: Broadcast security alert and advisory information throughout the organization using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.name: PCI 3.1.2 - Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 3 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.name: SC-29 - Heterogeneity
controls.title: Heterogeneity
controls.body: Employ a diverse set of information technologies for the following system components in the implementation of the system: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.name: SC-30(2) - Concealment and Misdirection | Randomness
controls.title: Concealment and Misdirection | Randomness
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined techniques] to introduce randomness into organizational operations and assets.

controls.name: SC-34(1) - Non-modifiable Executable Programs | No Writable Storage
controls.title: Non-modifiable Executable Programs | No Writable Storage
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined system components] with no writeable storage that is persistent across component restart or power on/off.

controls.name: SI-10(3) - Information Input Validation | Predictable Behavior
controls.title: Information Input Validation | Predictable Behavior
controls.body: Verify that the system behaves in a predictable and documented manner when invalid inputs are received.

controls.name: DEI2 - Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Awareness
controls.title: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Awareness
controls.body: The organization has implemented a formal diversity, equity and inclusion awareness training program. Employees and contractors are required to complete the training as part of the onboarding process and annually thereafter.

controls.name: B.8.4.2 - Return, Transfer or Disposal of PII
controls.title: Return, Transfer or Disposal of PII
controls.body: The organization shall provide the ability to return, transfer and/or disposal of PII in a secure manner. It should also make its policy available to the customer.

controls.name: DEI3 - Communication on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Values
controls.title: Communication on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Values
controls.body: All internal and external users are informed on the organization's commitment and initiatives towards diversity, equity and inclusion values on a regular basis.

controls.name: A.11.7 - Secure Disposal of Hardcopy Materials
controls.title: Secure Disposal of Hardcopy Materials
controls.body: Where hardcopy materials are destroyed, they should be destroyed securely using mechanisms such as cross-cutting, shredding, incinerating, pulping, etc.

controls.name: 3.13.2e - Attack Surface Disruption
controls.title: Attack Surface Disruption
controls.body: Disrupt the attack surface of organizational systems and system components.

controls.name: B.8.4.3 - PII Transmission Controls
controls.title: PII Transmission Controls
controls.body: The organization shall subject PII transmitted over a data-transmission network to appropriate controls designed to ensure that the data reaches its intended destination.

controls.name: ITGC - Passwords
controls.title: Passwords
controls.body: Unique IDs and strong passwords are implemented for application(s) and supporting infrastructure.

controls.name: DEI4 - Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Officer
controls.title: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Officer
controls.body: The organization has appointed a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) officer who is accountable for defining and implementing diversity, equity and inclusion strategies in order to ensure alignment between DEI principles and business strategy.

controls.name: DEI6 - Budget and Resource Allocation
controls.title: Budget and Resource Allocation
controls.body: The organization determines, documents, and allocates the appropriate resources and budget required to address diversity, equity and inclusion practices as part of its capital planning process.

controls.name: C.9.1.2 - Compliance with Effective Exercise of Data Subject Rights
controls.title: Compliance with Effective Exercise of Data Subject Rights
controls.body: A) The use of Blockchain / Distributed Ledger Technology shall not limit the exercise of the Data Subjects rights to object, rectify and delete their personal data.

controls.name: A.7.5.4 - Records of PII Disclosure to Third Parties
controls.title: Records of PII Disclosure to Third Parties
controls.body: The organization shall record disclosures of PII to third parties, including what PII has been disclosed, to whom and at what time.

controls.name: CIS 16.5-PR - Third-Party Software Component Usage
controls.title: Third-Party Software Component Usage
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.5: Use up-to-date and trusted third-party software components.

controls.name: 5.23 - Information Security for Use of Cloud Services
controls.title: Information Security for Use of Cloud Services
controls.body: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization’s information security requirements.

controls.name: SI-4(20) - System Monitoring | Privileged Users
controls.title: System Monitoring | Privileged Users
controls.body: Implement the following additional monitoring of privileged users: [Assignment: organization-defined additional monitoring].

controls.name: DEI9 - Equitable Compensation and Benefits Program
controls.title: Equitable Compensation and Benefits Program
controls.body: The organization has established an equitable compensation and benefits program to attract and support diverse talent through fair compensation and inclusive benefits offerings.

controls.name: SI-11 - Error Handling
controls.title: Error Handling
controls.body:
a. Generate error messages that provide information necessary for corrective actions without revealing information that could be exploited; and
b. Reveal error messages only to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: 3.13.5e - Moving Target Defense
controls.title: Moving Target Defense
controls.body: Distribute and relocate the following system functions or resources [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]: [Assignment: organization-defined system functions or resources].

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.21 - Portable Storage Use (NIST 800-171: 3.1.21)
controls.title: Portable Storage Use (NIST 800-171: 3.1.21)
controls.body: Limit the use of portable storage devices on external systems.

controls.name: DEI10 - Clear Career Paths
controls.title: Clear Career Paths
controls.body: The organization has developed and communicated clear career paths that provide all employees with equal growth and development opportunities.

controls.name: CIS 16.7-PR - Application Infrastructure Hardening
controls.title: Application Infrastructure Hardening
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.7: Use standard hardening configuration templates for application infrastructure.

controls.name: PCI 3.3.3 - Storage of SAD
controls.title: Storage of SAD
controls.body:
Additional requirement for issuers and companies that support issuing services and store sensitive authentication data: Any storage of sensitive authentication data is:
- Limited to that which is needed for a legitimate issuing business need and is secured.
- Encrypted using strong cryptography.

controls.name: PCI 3.1.1 - Network Security Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Network Security Policies and Procedures
controls.body:
All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 3 are:
- Documented.
- Kept up to date.
- In use.
- Known to all affected parties.

controls.name: 6.8.2.9 - Clear Desk and Clear Screen Policy
controls.title: Clear Desk and Clear Screen Policy
controls.body: A clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media and a clear screen policy for information processing facilities shall be adopted.

controls.name: PCI 3.5.1 - Render PAN Unreadable
controls.title: Render PAN Unreadable
controls.body:
PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored by using any of the following approaches:
- One-way hashes based on strong cryptography of the entire PAN.
- Truncation (hashing cannot be used to replace the truncated segment of PAN).
- If hashed and truncated versions of the same PAN, or different truncation formats of the same PAN, are present in an environment, additional controls are in place such that the different versions cannot be correlated to reconstruct the original PAN.
- Index tokens.
- Strong cryptography with associated key- management processes and procedures.

controls.name: PCI 3.5.1.1 - Hashing PAN
controls.title: Hashing PAN
controls.body: Hashes used to render PAN unreadable (per the first bullet of Requirement 3.5.1) are keyed cryptographic hashes of the entire PAN, with associated key-management processes and procedures in accordance with Requirements 3.6 and 3.7.

controls.name: CIS 16.11-PR - Vetted Modules for Application Security
controls.title: Vetted Modules for Application Security
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.11: Leverage vetted modules or services for application security components.

controls.name: SI.L3-3.14.3e - Specialized Asset Security (NIST 800-172:3.14.3E)
controls.title: Specialized Asset Security (NIST 800-172:3.14.3E)
controls.body: Ensure that [Assignment: organization-defined systems and system components] are included in the scope of the specified enhanced security requirements or are segregated in purpose- specific networks.

controls.name: PCI 3.5.1.2 - Encryption of PAN
controls.title: Encryption of PAN
controls.body:
If disk-level or partition-level encryption (rather than file-, column-, or field-level database encryption) is used to render PAN unreadable, it is implemented only as follows:
- On removable electronic media
OR
- If used for non-removable electronic media, PAN is also rendered unreadable via another mechanism that meets Requirement 3.5.1.

controls.name: 6.8.1.5 - Working in Secure Areas
controls.title: Working in Secure Areas
controls.body: Procedures for working in secure areas shall be designed and applied.

controls.name: 7.3 - Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
controls.title: Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
controls.body: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and implemented.

controls.name: CIS 16.10-PR - Secure Design Principles
controls.title: Secure Design Principles
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.10: Apply secure design principles in application architectures.

controls.name: CIS 16.12-PR - Secure Code Practices Verification
controls.title: Secure Code Practices Verification
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.12: Implement code-level security checks.

controls.name: PCI 3.5.1.3 - Disk Encryption
controls.title: Disk Encryption
controls.body:
If disk-level or partition-level encryption is used (rather than file-, column-, or field--level database encryption) to render PAN unreadable, it is managed as follows:
- Logical access is managed separately and independently of native operating system authentication and access control mechanisms.
- Decryption keys are not associated with user accounts.
- Authentication factors (passwords, passphrases, or cryptographic keys) that allow access to unencrypted data are stored securely.

controls.name: PCI 3.6.1 - Protection of Cryptographic Keys
controls.title: Protection of Cryptographic Keys
controls.body:
Procedures are defined and implemented to protect cryptographic keys used to protect stored account data against disclosure and misuse that include:
- Access to keys is restricted to the fewest number of custodians necessary.
- Key-encrypting keys are at least as strong as the data-encrypting keys they protect.
- Key-encrypting keys are stored separately from data-encrypting keys.
- Keys are stored securely in the fewest possible locations and forms.

controls.name: PCI 3.3.1 - Retention of SAD
controls.title: Retention of SAD
controls.body: SAD is not retained after authorization, even if encrypted. All sensitive authentication data received is rendered unrecoverable upon completion of the authorization process.

controls.name: PCI 3.6.1.1 - Documented Description of the Cryptographic Architecture
controls.title: Documented Description of the Cryptographic Architecture
controls.body:
Additional requirement for service providers only: A documented description of the cryptographic architecture is maintained that includes:
- Details of all algorithms, protocols, and keys used for the protection of stored account data, including key strength and expiry date.
- Preventing the use of the same cryptographic keys in production and test environments. This bullet is a best practice until its effective date; refer to Applicability Notes below for details.
- Description of the key usage for each key.
- Inventory of any hardware security modules (HSMs), key management systems (KMS), and other secure cryptographic devices (SCDs) used for key management, including type and location of devices, as outlined in Requirement 12.3.4.

controls.name: 5.31 - Legal, Statutory, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements (27017)
controls.title: Legal, Statutory, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements (27017)
controls.body: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization’s approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date.

controls.name: 6.10.2.1 - Information Transfer Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Information Transfer Policies and Procedures
controls.body: Formal transfer policies, procedures and controls shall be in place to protect the transfer of information through the use of all types of communication facilities.

controls.name: CIS 5.3-RE - Inactive Accounts
controls.title: Inactive Accounts
controls.body:
Account Management
Safeguard 5.3: Disable dormant accounts.

controls.name: PCI 3.3.1.2 - Retention of CVC
controls.title: Retention of CVC
controls.body: The card verification code is not retained upon completion of the authorization process.

controls.name: 6.10.2.2 - Agreements for Information Transfer
controls.title: Agreements for Information Transfer
controls.body: Agreements shall address the secure transfer of business information between the organization and external parties.

controls.name: Clause 5.4.1.1 - Actions to Address Risks and Opportunities
controls.title: Actions to Address Risks and Opportunities
controls.body:
When planning for the information security and privacy management systems, the organization shall consider the issues referred to in ISO27701 5.2.1 and the requirements referred to in ISO27701 5.2.2 and determine the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed to:
a) ensure the information security and privacy management systems can achieve their intended outcome(s);
b) prevent, or reduce, undesired effects; and
c) achieve continual improvement.
The organization shall plan:
d) actions to address these risks and opportunities; and
e) how to
1. integrate and implement the actions into its information security and privacy management systems
processes; and
2. evaluate the effectiveness of these actions.

controls.name: Clause 5.2.2 - Interested Parties
controls.title: Interested Parties
controls.body:
The organization shall determine:
a) Interested parties that are relevant to the information security management system and the privacy information management system;
b) The requirements of these interested parties relevant to information security and privacy

The organization shall include among its interested parties, those parties having interests or responsibilities associated with the processing of PII, including the PII principals.

controls.name: APP 11.3 - Breach Notifications to Supervisory Authority and Individuals
controls.title: Breach Notifications to Supervisory Authority and Individuals
controls.body: The organization or agency has implemented practices, procedures and systems to comply with the notification requirements to the Commissioner and affected individuals in the event of an eligible data breach.

controls.name: DEI11 - Community Involvement and Social Impact
controls.title: Community Involvement and Social Impact
controls.body: The organization has established a policy for employees to engage in programmes that promote and improve social well-being, including employee resource groups and community volunteering initiatives. Time spent by each employee is tracked and documented.

controls.name: 6.10.2.4 - Confidentiality or Nondisclosure Agreements
controls.title: Confidentiality or Nondisclosure Agreements
controls.body: Requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization’s needs for the protection of information shall be identified, regularly reviewed and documented.

controls.name: DEI15 - Collection and Processing of Diversity Data
controls.title: Collection and Processing of Diversity Data
controls.body: The organization has established a process for collecting and processing diversity data in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

controls.name: DEI13 - Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Report and Feedback
controls.title: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Report and Feedback
controls.body: On an annual basis, the organization conducts surveys and collates feedback to measure its progress on diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives and performs reporting to relevant stakeholders. Issues identified are documented, tracked and resolved in a timely way.

controls.name: 6.4.2.3 - Disciplinary Process
controls.title: Disciplinary Process
controls.body: There shall be a formal and communicated disciplinary process in place to take action against employees who have committed an information security and privacy breach.

controls.name: 8.17 - Clock Synchronization
controls.title: Clock Synchronization
controls.body: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.

controls.name: 8.18 - Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.title: Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.body: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

controls.name: B.8.5.4 - Notification of PII Disclosure Requests
controls.title: Notification of PII Disclosure Requests
controls.body: The organization shall notify the customer of any legally binding requests for disclosure of PII.

controls.name: 5.1 - Policies for Information Security
controls.title: Policies for Information Security
controls.body: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management,  published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties,  and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.

controls.name: CIS 17.1-RE - Incident Handling Management
controls.title: Incident Handling Management
controls.body:
Incident Response Management
Safeguard 17.1: Designate personnel to manage incident handling.

controls.name: A.7.3.4 - Providing Mechanism to Modify or Withdraw Consent
controls.title: Providing Mechanism to Modify or Withdraw Consent
controls.body: The organization shall provide a mechanism for PII principals to modify or withdraw their consent.

controls.name: 6.5.1.3 - Acceptable Use of Assets
controls.title: Acceptable Use of Assets
controls.body: Rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified, documented and implemented.

controls.name: 6.8.1.6 - Delivery and Loading Areas
controls.title: Delivery and Loading Areas
controls.body: Access points such as delivery and loading areas and other points where unauthorized persons could enter the premises shall be controlled and, if possible, isolated from information processing facilities to avoid unauthorized access.

controls.name: CIS 17.2-RE - Contact Information for Reporting Security Incidents
controls.title: Contact Information for Reporting Security Incidents
controls.body:
Incident Response Management
Safeguard 17.2: Establish and maintain contact information for reporting security incidents.

controls.name: SI-7(1) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Integrity Checks
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Integrity Checks
controls.body: Perform an integrity check of [Assignment: organization-defined software, firmware, and information] [Selection (one or more): at startup; at [Assignment: organization-defined transitional states or security-relevant events]; [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]].

controls.name: SI-3(10) - Malicious Code Protection | Malicious Code Analysis
controls.title: Malicious Code Protection | Malicious Code Analysis
controls.body:
a. Employ the following tools and techniques to analyze the characteristics and behavior of malicious code: [Assignment: organization-defined tools and techniques]; and
b. Incorporate the results from malicious code analysis into organizational incident response and flaw remediation processes.

controls.name: DEI5 - Executive Oversight on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
controls.title: Executive Oversight on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
controls.body: The executive team meets on a quarterly basis to oversee the implementation of diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives in alignment with the organization's business strategy.

controls.name: SI-19(5) - De-identification | Statistical Disclosure Control
controls.title: De-identification | Statistical Disclosure Control
controls.body: Manipulate numerical data, contingency tables, and statistical findings so that no individual or organization is identifiable in the results of the analysis.

controls.name: SI-4(4) - System Monitoring | Inbound and Outbound Communications Traffic
controls.title: System Monitoring | Inbound and Outbound Communications Traffic
controls.body:
a. Determine criteria for unusual or unauthorized activities or conditions for inbound and outbound communications traffic;
b. Monitor inbound and outbound communications traffic [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] for [Assignment: organization-defined unusual or unauthorized activities or conditions].

controls.name: CIS 17.4-RE - Incident Response Process
controls.title: Incident Response Process
controls.body:
Incident Response Management
Safeguard 17.4: Establish and maintain an incident response process.

controls.name: 8.30 - Outsourced Development
controls.title: Outsourced Development
controls.body: The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

controls.name: SA-16 - Developer-provided Training
controls.title: Developer-provided Training
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to provide the following training on the correct use and operation of the implemented security and privacy functions, controls, and/or mechanisms: [Assignment: organization-defined training].

controls.name: SA-17(2) - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Security-relevant Components
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Security-relevant Components
controls.body:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:
a. Define security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware; and
b. Provide a rationale that the definition for security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware is complete.

controls.name: CIS 17.7-RC - Incident Response Exercises
controls.title: Incident Response Exercises
controls.body:
Incident Response Management
Safeguard 17.7: Conduct routine incident response exercises.

controls.name: SA-17(8) - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Orchestration
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Orchestration
controls.body: Design [Assignment: organization-defined critical systems or system components] with coordinated behavior to implement the following capabilities: [Assignment: organization-defined capabilities, by system or component].

controls.name: 8.26 - Application Security Requirements
controls.title: Application Security Requirements
controls.body: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

controls.name: 6.13.1.7 - Collection of Evidence
controls.title: Collection of Evidence
controls.body: The organization shall define and apply procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of information, which can serve as evidence.

controls.name: DEI7 - Inclusive Job Descriptions
controls.title: Inclusive Job Descriptions
controls.body: The organization provides candidates with an inclusive job description that documents key roles and responsibilities and required skill sets while using gender-neutral language. Job descriptions are reviewed and updated annually or in case of significant changes.

controls.name: SC-39(2) - Process Isolation | Separate Execution Domain Per Thread
controls.title: Process Isolation | Separate Execution Domain Per Thread
controls.body: Maintain a separate execution domain for each thread in [Assignment: organization-defined multi-threaded processing].

controls.name: SA-15(7) - Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Automated Vulnerability Analysis
controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Automated Vulnerability Analysis

controls.name: SC-3(4) - Security Function Isolation | Module Coupling and Cohesiveness
controls.title: Security Function Isolation | Module Coupling and Cohesiveness
controls.body: Implement security functions as largely independent modules that maximize internal cohesiveness within modules and minimize coupling between modules.

controls.name: CIS 4.9-PR - DNS Servers Configuration
controls.title: DNS Servers Configuration
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.9: Configure trusted DNS servers on enterprise assets.

controls.name: SC-3(2) - Security Function Isolation | Access and Flow Control Functions
controls.title: Security Function Isolation | Access and Flow Control Functions
controls.body: Isolate security functions enforcing access and information flow control from nonsecurity functions and from other security functions.

controls.name: SA-15(11) - Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Archive System or Component
controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Archive System or Component
controls.body: Require the developer of the system or system component to archive the system or component to be released or delivered together with the corresponding evidence supporting the final security and privacy review.

controls.name: SA-15(8) - Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Reuse of Threat and Vulnerability Information
controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Reuse of Threat and Vulnerability Information
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to use threat modeling and vulnerability analyses from similar systems, components, or services to inform the current development process.

controls.name: SC-4(2) - Information in Shared System Resources | Multilevel or Periods Processing
controls.title: Information in Shared System Resources | Multilevel or Periods Processing
controls.body: Prevent unauthorized information transfer via shared resources in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined procedures] when system processing explicitly switches between different information classification levels or security categories.

controls.name: 5.24 - Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
controls.title: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
controls.body: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining,  establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: SA-17(7) - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Structure for Least Privilege
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Structure for Least Privilege
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to structure security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to facilitate controlling access with least privilege.

controls.name: PCI 3.3.1.1 - Retention of Track Data
controls.title: Retention of Track Data
controls.body: The full contents of any track are not retained upon completion of the authorization process.

controls.name: SA-20 - Customized Development of Critical Components
controls.title: Customized Development of Critical Components
controls.body: Reimplement or custom develop the following critical system components: [Assignment: organization-defined critical system components].

controls.name: SC-7(3) - Boundary Protection | Access Points
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Access Points
controls.body: Limit the number of external network connections to the system.

controls.name: SA-17(5) - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Conceptually Simple Design
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Conceptually Simple Design
controls.body:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:

a. Design and structure the security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to use a complete, conceptually simple protection mechanism with precisely defined semantics; and
b. Internally structure the security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware with specific regard for this mechanism.

controls.name: SA-17(6) - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Structure for Testing
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Structure for Testing
controls.body: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to structure security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to facilitate testing.

controls.name: SC-7(28) - Boundary Protection | Connections to Public Networks
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Connections to Public Networks
controls.body: Prohibit the direct connection of [Assignment: organization-defined system] to a public network.

controls.name: SI-7 - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.body:
a. Employ integrity verification tools to detect unauthorized changes to the following software, firmware, and information: [Assignment: organization-defined software, firmware, and information]; and
b. Take the following actions when unauthorized changes to the software, firmware, and information are detected: [Assignment: organization-defined actions].

controls.name: SA-22 - Unsupported System Components
controls.title: Unsupported System Components
controls.body:
a. Replace system components when support for the components is no longer available from the developer, vendor, or manufacturer; or
b. Provide the following options for alternative sources for continued support for unsupported components [Selection (one or more): in-house support; [Assignment: organization-defined support from external providers]].

controls.name: DEI8 - Equitable Hiring Process
controls.title: Equitable Hiring Process
controls.body: The organization has established guidelines for integrating diversity, equity and inclusion goals into the hiring process and systematically helping reduce unconscious bias.

controls.name: SC-5(1) - Denial-of-service Protection | Restrict Ability to Attack Other Systems
controls.title: Denial-of-service Protection | Restrict Ability to Attack Other Systems
controls.body: Restrict the ability of individuals to launch the following denial-of-service attacks against other systems: [Assignment: organization-defined denial-of-service attacks].

controls.name: Clause 5.2.4 - ISMS and PIMS
controls.title: ISMS and PIMS
controls.body: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain and continually improve an information security management system and a privacy information management system.

controls.name: SI-7(8) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Auditing Capability for Significant Events
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Auditing Capability for Significant Events
controls.body: Upon detection of a potential integrity violation, provide the capability to audit the event and initiate the following actions: [Selection (one or more): generate an audit record; alert current user; alert [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; [Assignment: organization-defined other actions]].

controls.name: SC-7(18) - Boundary Protection | Fail Secure
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Fail Secure
controls.body: Prevent systems from entering unsecure states in the event of an operational failure of a boundary protection device.

controls.name: SC-40 - Wireless Link Protection
controls.title: Wireless Link Protection
controls.body: Protect external and internal [Assignment: organization-defined wireless links] from the following signal parameter attacks: [Assignment: organization-defined types of signal parameter attacks or references to sources for such attacks].

controls.name: SI-7(10) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Protection of Boot Firmware
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Protection of Boot Firmware
controls.body: Implement the following mechanisms to protect the integrity of boot firmware in [Assignment: organization-defined system components]: [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms].

controls.name: SC-7(5) - Boundary Protection | Deny by Default — Allow by Exception
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Deny by Default — Allow by Exception
controls.body: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception [Selection (one or more): at managed interfaces; for [Assignment: organization-defined systems]].

controls.name: CIS 8.11-DE - Audit Log Review
controls.title: Audit Log Review
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.11: Conduct audit log reviews.

controls.name: SC-7(13) - Boundary Protection | Isolation of Security Tools, Mechanisms, and Support Components
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Isolation of Security Tools, Mechanisms, and Support Components
controls.body: Isolate [Assignment: organization-defined information security tools, mechanisms, and support components] from other internal system components by implementing physically separate subnetworks with managed interfaces to other components of the system.

controls.name: SC-7(16) - Boundary Protection | Prevent Discovery of System Components
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Prevent Discovery of System Components
controls.body: Prevent the discovery of specific system components that represent a managed interface.

controls.name: SC-7(17) - Boundary Protection | Automated Enforcement of Protocol Formats
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Automated Enforcement of Protocol Formats
controls.body: Enforce adherence to protocol formats.

controls.name: SC-7(15) - Boundary Protection | Networked Privileged Accesses
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Networked Privileged Accesses
controls.body: Route networked, privileged accesses through a dedicated, managed interface for purposes of access control and auditing.

controls.name: SC-7(23) - Boundary Protection | Disable Sender Feedback on Protocol Validation Failure
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Disable Sender Feedback on Protocol Validation Failure
controls.body: Disable feedback to senders on protocol format validation failure.

controls.name: SC-7(26) - Boundary Protection | Classified National Security System Connections
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Classified National Security System Connections
controls.body: Prohibit the direct connection of a classified national security system to an external network without the use of [Assignment: organization-defined boundary protection device].

controls.name: PCI 3.3.1.3 - Retention of PIN
controls.title: Retention of PIN
controls.body: The personal identification number (PIN) and the PIN block are not retained upon completion of the authorization process.

controls.name: SC-40(1) - Wireless Link Protection | Electromagnetic Interference
controls.title: Wireless Link Protection | Electromagnetic Interference
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms that achieve [Assignment: organization-defined level of protection] against the effects of intentional electromagnetic interference.

controls.name: SC-8(1) - Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Cryptographic Protection
controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Cryptographic Protection
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to [Selection (one or more): prevent unauthorized disclosure of information; detect changes to information] during transmission.

controls.name: D5.ER.Es.E.1 - Cyber Incident Escalation Criteria
controls.title: Cyber Incident Escalation Criteria
controls.body: Criteria have been established for escalating cyber incidents or vulnerabilities to the board and senior management based on the potential impact and criticality of the risk.

controls.name: PCI 3.4.1 - Masking PAN
controls.title: Masking PAN
controls.body: PAN is masked when displayed (the BIN and last four digits are the maximum number of digits to be displayed), such that only personnel with a legitimate business need can see more than the BIN and last four digits of the PAN.

controls.name: SC-26 - Decoys
controls.title: Decoys
controls.body: Include components within organizational systems specifically designed to be the target of malicious attacks for detecting, deflecting, and analyzing such attacks.

controls.name: SC-16(3) - Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes | Cryptographic Binding
controls.title: Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes | Cryptographic Binding
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms or techniques] to bind security and privacy attributes to transmitted information.

controls.name: CIS 1.3-DE - Active Asset Discovery
controls.title: Active Asset Discovery
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
Safeguard 1.3: Utilize an active discovery tool.

controls.name: SC-15(3) - Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications | Disabling and Removal in Secure Work Areas
controls.title: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications | Disabling and Removal in Secure Work Areas
controls.body: Disable or remove collaborative computing devices and applications from [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] in [Assignment: organization-defined secure work areas].

controls.name: SC-15(4) - Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications | Explicitly Indicate Current Participants
controls.title: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications | Explicitly Indicate Current Participants
controls.body: Provide an explicit indication of current participants in [Assignment: organization-defined online meetings and teleconferences].

controls.name: SC-15(1) - Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications | Physical or Logical Disconnect
controls.title: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications | Physical or Logical Disconnect
controls.body: Provide [Selection (one or more): physical; logical] disconnect of collaborative computing devices in a manner that supports ease of use.

controls.name: SC-40(4) - Wireless Link Protection | Signal Parameter Identification
controls.title: Wireless Link Protection | Signal Parameter Identification
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent the identification of [Assignment: organization-defined wireless transmitters] by using the transmitter signal parameters.

controls.name: SC-18(4) - Mobile Code | Prevent Automatic Execution
controls.title: Mobile Code | Prevent Automatic Execution
controls.body: Prevent the automatic execution of mobile code in [Assignment: organization-defined software applications] and enforce [Assignment: organization-defined actions] prior to executing the code.

controls.name: SC-18(1) - Mobile Code | Identify Unacceptable Code and Take Corrective Actions
controls.title: Mobile Code | Identify Unacceptable Code and Take Corrective Actions
controls.body: Identify [Assignment: organization-defined unacceptable mobile code] and take [Assignment: organization-defined corrective actions].

controls.name: SC-18(5) - Mobile Code | Allow Execution Only in Confined Environments
controls.title: Mobile Code | Allow Execution Only in Confined Environments
controls.body: Allow execution of permitted mobile code only in confined virtual machine environments.

controls.name: 6.5.2.3 - Handling of Assets
controls.title: Handling of Assets
controls.body: Procedures for handling assets shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.name: SC-25 - Thin Nodes
controls.title: Thin Nodes
controls.body: Employ minimal functionality and information storage on the following system components: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.name: IA.L2-3.5.11 - Obscure Feedback (NIST 800-171: 3.5.11)
controls.title: Obscure Feedback (NIST 800-171: 3.5.11)
controls.body: Obscure feedback of authentication information.

controls.name: SI-19(4) - De-identification | Removal, Masking, Encryption, Hashing, or Replacement of Direct Identifiers
controls.title: De-identification | Removal, Masking, Encryption, Hashing, or Replacement of Direct Identifiers
controls.body: Remove, mask, encrypt, hash, or replace direct identifiers in a dataset.

controls.name: SC-29(1) - Heterogeneity | Virtualization Techniques
controls.title: Heterogeneity | Virtualization Techniques
controls.body: Employ virtualization techniques to support the deployment of a diversity of operating systems and applications that are changed [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: CIS 1.4-ID - DHCP Logging
controls.title: DHCP Logging
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
Safeguard 1.4: Use Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) logging to update enterprise asset inventory.

controls.name: SC-31(3) - Covert Channel Analysis | Measure Bandwidth in Operational Environments
controls.title: Covert Channel Analysis | Measure Bandwidth in Operational Environments
controls.body: Measure the bandwidth of [Assignment: organization-defined subset of identified covert channels] in the operational environment of the system.

controls.name: Clause 5.6.3 - Information Security and Privacy Risk Treatment
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Risk Treatment
controls.body:
The organization shall implement the information security and privacy risk treatment plan.

The organization shall retain documented information of the results of the information security and privacy risk treatment.

controls.name: CIS 2.1-PR - Software Inventory
controls.title: Software Inventory
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard 2.1: Establish and maintain a software inventory.

controls.name: SC-39 - Process Isolation
controls.title: Process Isolation
controls.body: Maintain a separate execution domain for each executing system process.

controls.name: SC-40(2) - Wireless Link Protection | Reduce Detection Potential
controls.title: Wireless Link Protection | Reduce Detection Potential
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to reduce the detection potential of wireless links to [Assignment: organization-defined level of reduction].

controls.name: 8.33 - Test Information
controls.title: Test Information
controls.body: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed.

controls.name: SC-40(3) - Wireless Link Protection | Imitative or Manipulative Communications Deception
controls.title: Wireless Link Protection | Imitative or Manipulative Communications Deception
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to identify and reject wireless transmissions that are deliberate attempts to achieve imitative or manipulative communications deception based on signal parameters.

controls.name: SI-7(16) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Time Limit on Process Execution Without Supervision
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Time Limit on Process Execution Without Supervision
controls.body: Prohibit processes from executing without supervision for more than [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: SI-19(3) - De-identification | Release
controls.title: De-identification | Release
controls.body: Remove personally identifiable information elements from a dataset prior to its release if those elements in the dataset do not need to be part of the data release.

controls.name: SC-47 - Alternate Communications Paths
controls.title: Alternate Communications Paths
controls.body: Establish [Assignment: organization-defined alternate communications paths] for system operations organizational command and control.

controls.name: SC-48 - Sensor Relocation
controls.title: Sensor Relocation
controls.body: Relocate [Assignment: organization-defined sensors and monitoring capabilities] to [Assignment: organization-defined locations] under the following conditions or circumstances: [Assignment: organization-defined conditions or circumstances].

controls.name: SI-2(2) - Flaw Remediation | Automated Flaw Remediation Status
controls.title: Flaw Remediation | Automated Flaw Remediation Status
controls.body:
Determine if system components have applicable security-relevant software and firmware updates installed using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms]
                  [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: SI-2(5) - Flaw Remediation | Automatic Software and Firmware Updates
controls.title: Flaw Remediation | Automatic Software and Firmware Updates
controls.body: Install [Assignment: organization-defined security-relevant software and firmware updates] automatically to [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.name: 6.15.1.2 - Intellectual Property Rights
controls.title: Intellectual Property Rights
controls.body: Appropriate procedures shall be implemented to ensure compliance with legislative, regulatory and contractual requirements related to intellectual property rights and use of proprietary software products.

controls.name: SI-4(1) - System Monitoring | System-wide Intrusion Detection System
controls.title: System Monitoring | System-wide Intrusion Detection System
controls.body: Connect and configure individual intrusion detection tools into a system-wide intrusion detection system.

controls.name: SI-2(4) - Flaw Remediation | Automated Patch Management Tools
controls.title: Flaw Remediation | Automated Patch Management Tools
controls.body: Employ automated patch management tools to facilitate flaw remediation to the following system components: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.name: PCI 3.3.2 - Encryption of SAD
controls.title: Encryption of SAD
controls.body: SAD that is stored electronically prior to completion of authorization is encrypted using strong cryptography.

controls.name: SI-4(17) - System Monitoring | Integrated Situational Awareness
controls.title: System Monitoring | Integrated Situational Awareness
controls.body: Correlate information from monitoring physical, cyber, and supply chain activities to achieve integrated, organization-wide situational awareness.

controls.name: SI-4(22) - System Monitoring | Unauthorized Network Services
controls.title: System Monitoring | Unauthorized Network Services
controls.body:
a. Detect network services that have not been authorized or approved by [Assignment: organization-defined authorization or approval processes]; and
b. [Selection (one or more): Audit; Alert [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]] when detected.

controls.name: SI-4(21) - System Monitoring | Probationary Periods
controls.title: System Monitoring | Probationary Periods
controls.body: Implement the following additional monitoring of individuals during [Assignment: organization-defined probationary period]: [Assignment: organization-defined additional monitoring].

controls.name: 8.34 - Protection of Information Systems During Audit Testing
controls.title: Protection of Information Systems During Audit Testing
controls.body: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving the assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed upon between the tester and appropriate management.

controls.name: SI-7(6) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Cryptographic Protection
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Cryptographic Protection
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware, and information.

controls.name: DS7 - File Integrity Monitoring System
controls.title: File Integrity Monitoring System
controls.body: A file integrity monitoring tool is implemented that notifies management of modifications or changes to critical system files, configuration files, or content files.

controls.name: SC-7(4) - Boundary Protection | External Telecommunications Services
controls.title: Boundary Protection | External Telecommunications Services

controls.name: Clause 5.3.2 - Policy
controls.title: Policy

controls.name: SI-8(2) - Spam Protection | Automatic Updates
controls.title: Spam Protection | Automatic Updates
controls.body: Automatically update spam protection mechanisms [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: SI-4(25) - System Monitoring | Optimize Network Traffic Analysis
controls.title: System Monitoring | Optimize Network Traffic Analysis
controls.body: Provide visibility into network traffic at external and key internal system interfaces to optimize the effectiveness of monitoring devices.

controls.name: SC-7(9) - Boundary Protection | Restrict Threatening Outgoing Communications Traffic
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Restrict Threatening Outgoing Communications Traffic
controls.body:
a. Detect and deny outgoing communications traffic posing a threat to external systems; and
b. Audit the identity of internal users associated with denied communications.

controls.name: SI-6 - Security and Privacy Function Verification
controls.title: Security and Privacy Function Verification

controls.name: SI-6(2) - Security and Privacy Function Verification | Automation Support for Distributed Testing
controls.title: Security and Privacy Function Verification | Automation Support for Distributed Testing
controls.body: Implement automated mechanisms to support the management of distributed security and privacy function testing.

controls.name: SI-6(3) - Security and Privacy Function Verification | Report Verification Results
controls.title: Security and Privacy Function Verification | Report Verification Results
controls.body: Report the results of security and privacy function verification to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.name: SI-7(5) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Automated Response to Integrity Violations
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Automated Response to Integrity Violations
controls.body: Automatically [Selection (one or more): shut the system down; restart the system; implement [Assignment: organization-defined controls]] when integrity violations are discovered.

controls.name: SI-8(3) - Spam Protection | Continuous Learning Capability
controls.title: Spam Protection | Continuous Learning Capability
controls.body: Implement spam protection mechanisms with a learning capability to more effectively identify legitimate communications traffic.

controls.name: SI-7(3) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Centrally Managed Integrity Tools
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Centrally Managed Integrity Tools
controls.body: Employ centrally managed integrity verification tools.

controls.name: SC-7(24) - Boundary Protection | Personally Identifiable Information
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Personally Identifiable Information

controls.name: SI-7(12) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Integrity Verification
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Integrity Verification
controls.body: Require that the integrity of the following user-installed software be verified prior to execution: [Assignment: organization-defined user-installed software].

controls.name: 5.25 - Assessment and Decision on Information Security Events
controls.title: Assessment and Decision on Information Security Events
