controls.body: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.

controls.name: WS4 - USB Ports or External Storage Device Restriction
controls.title: USB Ports or External Storage Device Restriction
controls.body: USB ports or external storage devices are restricted in the organization unless necessary for business purposes. Business justification and approval for the use of USB ports or external storage devices are documented.

controls.name: SC-11(1) - Trusted Path | Irrefutable Communications Path
controls.title: Trusted Path | Irrefutable Communications Path
controls.body:
a. Provide a trusted communications path that is irrefutably distinguishable from other communications paths; and
b. Initiate the trusted communications path for communications between the [Assignment: organization-defined security functions] of the system and the user.

controls.name: CIS 2.5-PR - Whitelist Authorized Software
controls.title: Whitelist Authorized Software
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard 2.5: Allowlist authorized software.

controls.name: SI-10(2) - Information Input Validation | Review and Resolve Errors
controls.title: Information Input Validation | Review and Resolve Errors
controls.body: Review and resolve input validation errors within [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: SC-36(1) - Distributed Processing and Storage | Polling Techniques
controls.title: Distributed Processing and Storage | Polling Techniques
controls.body:
a. Employ polling techniques to identify potential faults, errors, or compromises to the following processing and storage components: [Assignment: organization-defined distributed processing and storage components]; and
b. Take the following actions in response to identified faults, errors, or compromises: [Assignment: organization-defined actions].

controls.name: SC-8(4) - Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Conceal or Randomize Communications
controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Conceal or Randomize Communications
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to conceal or randomize communication patterns unless otherwise protected by [Assignment: organization-defined alternative physical controls].

controls.name: SI-10(6) - Information Input Validation | Injection Prevention
controls.title: Information Input Validation | Injection Prevention
controls.body: Prevent untrusted data injections.

controls.name: CIS 11.5-RC - Test Data Recovery
controls.title: Test Data Recovery
controls.body:
Data Recovery
Safeguard 11.5: Test data recovery.

controls.name: SI-12(1) - Information Management and Retention | Limit Personally Identifiable Information Elements
controls.title: Information Management and Retention | Limit Personally Identifiable Information Elements
controls.body: Limit personally identifiable information being processed in the information life cycle to the following elements of personally identifiable information: [Assignment: organization-defined elements of personally identifiable information].

controls.name: SI-12(2) - Information Management and Retention | Minimize PII in Testing, Training, and Research
controls.title: Information Management and Retention | Minimize PII in Testing, Training, and Research
controls.body: Use the following techniques to minimize the use of personally identifiable information for research, testing, or training: [Assignment: organization-defined techniques].

controls.name: SI-12(3) - Information Management and Retention | Information Disposal
controls.title: Information Management and Retention | Information Disposal
controls.body: Use the following techniques to dispose of, destroy, or erase information following the retention period: [Assignment: organization-defined techniques].

controls.name: SI-13(4) - Predictable Failure Prevention | Standby Component Installation and Notification
controls.title: Predictable Failure Prevention | Standby Component Installation and Notification
controls.body:
If system component failures are detected:

a. Ensure that the standby components are successfully and transparently installed within [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; and
b. [Selection (one or more): Activate [Assignment: organization-defined alarm]; Automatically shut down the system; [Assignment: organization-defined action]].

controls.name: SI-13(1) - Predictable Failure Prevention | Transferring Component Responsibilities
controls.title: Predictable Failure Prevention | Transferring Component Responsibilities
controls.body: Take system components out of service by transferring component responsibilities to substitute components no later than [Assignment: organization-defined fraction or percentage] of mean time to failure.

controls.name: CIS 6.6-ID - Inventory of Authentication and Authorization Systems
controls.title: Inventory of Authentication and Authorization Systems
controls.body:
Access Control Management
Safeguard 6.6: Establish and maintain an inventory of authentication and authorization systems.

controls.name: SC-12(1) - Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Availability
controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Availability
controls.body: Maintain availability of information in the event of the loss of cryptographic keys by users.

controls.name: CIS 12.6-PR - Secure Network Protocols
controls.title: Secure Network Protocols
controls.body:
Network Infrastructure Management
Safeguard 12.6: Use of secure network management and communication protocols.

controls.name: SI-13(3) - Predictable Failure Prevention | Manual Transfer Between Components
controls.title: Predictable Failure Prevention | Manual Transfer Between Components
controls.body: Manually initiate transfers between active and standby system components when the use of the active component reaches [Assignment: organization-defined percentage] of the mean time to failure.

controls.name: CIS 2.7-PR - Whitelist Authorized Scripts
controls.title: Whitelist Authorized Scripts
controls.body:
Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard 2.7: Allowlist authorized scripts.

controls.name: SI-14(2) - Non-persistence | Non-persistent Information
controls.title: Non-persistence | Non-persistent Information
controls.body:
a. [Selection: Refresh [Assignment: organization-defined information][Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; Generate [Assignment: organization-defined information] on demand]; and
b. Delete information when no longer needed.

controls.name: SI-14(1) - Non-persistence | Refresh from Trusted Sources
controls.title: Non-persistence | Refresh from Trusted Sources
controls.body: Obtain software and data employed during system component and service refreshes from the following trusted sources: [Assignment: organization-defined trusted sources].

controls.name: SI-17 - Fail-safe Procedures
controls.title: Fail-safe Procedures
controls.body: Implement the indicated fail-safe procedures when the indicated failures occur: [Assignment: organization-defined list of failure conditions and associated fail-safe procedures].

controls.name: 5.2 - Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization's needs.

controls.name: SI-14(3) - Non-persistence | Non-persistent Connectivity
controls.title: Non-persistence | Non-persistent Connectivity
controls.body: Establish connections to the system on demand and terminate connections after [Selection: completion of a request; a period of non-use].

controls.name: CIS 3.1-ID - Data Management Process
controls.title: Data Management Process
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.1: Establish and maintain a data management process.

controls.name: SI-16 - Memory Protection
controls.title: Memory Protection
controls.body: Implement the following controls to protect the system memory from unauthorized code execution: [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.name: CIS 6.7-PR - Centralized Access Control
controls.title: Centralized Access Control
controls.body:
Access Control Management
Safeguard 6.7: Centralize access control.

controls.name: 6.6.4.3 - Password Management System
controls.title: Password Management System
controls.body: Password management systems shall be interactive and shall ensure quality passwords.

controls.name: SI-18(3) - Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Collection
controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Collection
controls.body: Collect personally identifiable information directly from the individual.

controls.name: SI-19(1) - De-identification | Collection
controls.title: De-identification | Collection
controls.body: De-identify the dataset upon collection by not collecting personally identifiable information.

controls.name: DEI12 - Employee Well-being
controls.title: Employee Well-being
controls.body: The organization has implemented a default enrollment program for the physical and mental well-being of employees to encourage a diverse and inclusive culture within the organization.

controls.name: SI-18(5) - Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Notice of Correction or Deletion
controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Notice of Correction or Deletion
controls.body: Notify [Assignment: organization-defined recipients of personally identifiable information] and individuals that the personally identifiable information has been corrected or deleted.

controls.name: SR-3(3) - Supply Chain Controls and Processes | Sub-tier Flow Down
controls.title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes | Sub-tier Flow Down
controls.body: Ensure that the controls included in the contracts of prime contractors are also included in the contracts of subcontractors.

controls.name: SC-12(3) - Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Asymmetric Keys
controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Asymmetric Keys
controls.body: Produce, control, and distribute asymmetric cryptographic keys using [Selection(one): NSA-approved key management technology and processes; prepositioned keying material; DoD-approved or DoD-issued Medium Assurance PKI certificates; DoD-approved or DoD-issued Medium Hardware Assurance PKI certificates and hardware security tokens that protect the user’s private key; certificates issued in accordance with organization-defined requirements].

controls.name: SR-3(1) - Supply Chain Controls and Processes | Diverse Supply Base
controls.title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes | Diverse Supply Base
controls.body: Employ a diverse set of sources for the following system components and services:  [Assignment: organization-defined system components and services].

controls.name: SI-4(19) - System Monitoring | Risk for Individuals
controls.title: System Monitoring | Risk for Individuals
controls.body: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined additional monitoring] of individuals who have been identified by [Assignment: organization-defined sources] as posing an increased level of risk.

controls.name: CIS 6.8-PR - Role-Based Access Control
controls.title: Role-Based Access Control
controls.body:
Access Control Management
Safeguard 6.8: Define and maintain role-based access control.

controls.name: SR-9(1) - Tamper Resistance and Detection | Multiple Stages of System Development Life Cycle
controls.title: Tamper Resistance and Detection | Multiple Stages of System Development Life Cycle
controls.body: Employ anti-tamper technologies, tools, and techniques throughout the system development life cycle.

controls.name: SC-15 - Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications
controls.title: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications
controls.body:
a. Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and applications with the following exceptions: [Assignment: organization-defined exceptions where remote activation is to be allowed]; and
b. Provide an explicit indication of use to users physically present at the devices.

controls.name: SI-7(2) - Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Automated Notifications of Integrity Violations
controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Automated Notifications of Integrity Violations
controls.body: Employ automated tools that provide notification to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] upon discovering discrepancies during integrity verification.

controls.name: SR-2(1) - Supply Chain Risk Management Plan | Establish Scrm Team
controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Plan | Establish Scrm Team
controls.body: Establish a supply chain risk management team consisting of [Assignment: organization-defined personnel, roles, and responsibilities] to lead and support the following SCRM activities: [Assignment: organization-defined supply chain risk management activities].

controls.name: 5.28 - Collection of Evidence
controls.title: Collection of Evidence
controls.body: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.

controls.name: SR-3(2) - Supply Chain Controls and Processes | Limitation of Harm
controls.title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes | Limitation of Harm
controls.body: Employ the following controls to limit harm from potential adversaries identifying and targeting the organizational supply chain: [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.name: SR-4(1) - Provenance | Identity
controls.title: Provenance | Identity
controls.body: Establish and maintain unique identification of the following supply chain elements, processes, and personnel associated with the identified system and critical system components: [Assignment: organization-defined supply chain elements, processes, and personnel associated with organization-defined systems and critical system components].

controls.name: 5.29 - Information Security during Disruption
controls.title: Information Security during Disruption
controls.body: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

controls.name: SR-4(3) - Provenance | Validate as Genuine and Not Altered
controls.title: Provenance | Validate as Genuine and Not Altered
controls.body: Employ the following controls to validate that the system or system component received is genuine and has not been altered: [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.name: 6.9.1.1 - Documented Operating Procedures
controls.title: Documented Operating Procedures
controls.body: Operating procedures shall be documented and made available to all users who need them.

controls.name: DEI14 - Anonymous Reporting
controls.title: Anonymous Reporting
controls.body: The organization has established channels for anonymous reporting and tracking that allow employees to report issues related to discriminatory actions and other issues impacting the organization's diversity, equity and inclusion requirements.

controls.name: SR-9 - Tamper Resistance and Detection
controls.title: Tamper Resistance and Detection
controls.body: Implement a tamper protection program for the system, system component, or system service.

controls.name: SR-5 - Acquisition Strategies, Tools, and Methods
controls.title: Acquisition Strategies, Tools, and Methods
controls.body: Employ the following acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods to protect against, identify, and mitigate supply chain risks: [Assignment: organization-defined acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods].

controls.name: SR-5(1) - Acquisition Strategies, Tools, and Methods | Adequate Supply
controls.title: Acquisition Strategies, Tools, and Methods | Adequate Supply
controls.body: Employ the following controls to ensure an adequate supply of [Assignment: organization-defined critical system components]: [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.name: SR-6 - Supplier Assessments and Reviews
controls.title: Supplier Assessments and Reviews
controls.body: Assess and review the supply chain-related risks associated with suppliers or contractors and the system, system component, or system service they provide [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: SR-11(1) - Component Authenticity | Anti-counterfeit Training
controls.title: Component Authenticity | Anti-counterfeit Training
controls.body: Train [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] to detect counterfeit system components (including hardware, software, and firmware).

controls.name: 6.5.3.2 - Disposal of Media
controls.title: Disposal of Media
controls.body: Media shall be disposed of securely when no longer required, using formal procedures.

controls.name: SR-8 - Notification Agreements
controls.title: Notification Agreements
controls.body: Establish agreements and procedures with entities involved in the supply chain for the system, system component, or system service for the [Selection (one or more): notification of supply chain compromises; results of assessments or audits; [Assignment: organization-defined information]].

controls.name: SR-7 - Supply Chain Operations Security
controls.title: Supply Chain Operations Security
controls.body: Employ the following Operations Security (OPSEC) controls to protect supply chain-related information for the system, system component, or system service: [Assignment: organization-defined Operations Security (OPSEC) controls].

controls.name: SR-12 - Component Disposal
controls.title: Component Disposal
controls.body: Dispose of [Assignment: organization-defined data, documentation, tools, or system components] using the following techniques and methods: [Assignment: organization-defined techniques and methods].

controls.name: SR-11 - Component Authenticity
controls.title: Component Authenticity
controls.body:
a. Develop and implement anti-counterfeit policy and procedures that include the means to detect and prevent counterfeit components from entering the system; and
b. Report counterfeit system components to [Selection (one or more): source of counterfeit component; [Assignment: organization-defined external reporting organizations]; [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]].

controls.name: SR-10 - Inspection of Systems or Components
controls.title: Inspection of Systems or Components
controls.body: Inspect the following systems or system components [Selection (one or more): at random; at [Assignment: organization-defined frequency], upon [Assignment: organization-defined indications of need for inspection]] to detect tampering: [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.name: 6.14.1.1 - Planning Information Security and Privacy Continuity
controls.title: Planning Information Security and Privacy Continuity
controls.body: The organization shall determine its requirements for information security and privacy and the continuity of information security and privacy management in adverse situations, e.g. during a crisis or disaster.

controls.name: SI-18(2) - Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Data Tags
controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Quality Operations | Data Tags
controls.body: Employ data tags to automate the correction or deletion of personally identifiable information across the information life cycle within organizational systems.

controls.name: CIS 3.3-PR - Data Access Control Lists
controls.title: Data Access Control Lists
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.3: Configure data access control lists.

controls.name: CIS 8.1-PR - Audit Log Management Process
controls.title: Audit Log Management Process
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.1: Establish and maintain an audit log management process.

controls.name: 5.30 - ICT Readiness for Business Continuity
controls.title: ICT Readiness for Business Continuity
controls.body: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

controls.name: 5.32 - Intellectual Property Rights
controls.title: Intellectual Property Rights
controls.body: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.18 - Mobile Device Connection (NIST 800-171: 3.1.18)
controls.title: Mobile Device Connection (NIST 800-171: 3.1.18)
controls.body: Control connection of mobile devices.

controls.name: CIS 3.4-PR - Data Retention
controls.title: Data Retention
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.4: Enforce data retention.

controls.name: CM.L2-3.4.1 - System Baselining (NIST 800-171: 3.4.1)
controls.title: System Baselining (NIST 800-171: 3.4.1)
controls.body: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems (including hardware, software, firmware and documentation) throughout the respective system development life cycles.

controls.name: CM.L2-3.4.2 - Security Configuration Enforcement (NIST 800-171: 3.4.2)
controls.title: Security Configuration Enforcement (NIST 800-171: 3.4.2)
controls.body: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for information technology products employed in organizational systems.

controls.name: IA.L2-3.5.6 - Identifier Handling (NIST 800-171: 3.5.6)
controls.title: Identifier Handling (NIST 800-171: 3.5.6)
controls.body: Disable identifiers after a defined period of inactivity.

controls.name: 6.3.1.5 - Information Security and Privacy in Project Management
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy in Project Management
controls.body: Information security and privacy shall be addressed in project management, regardless of the type of project.

controls.name: AC.L3-3.1.3e - Secured Information Transfer (NIST 800-172:3.1.3E)
controls.title: Secured Information Transfer (NIST 800-172:3.1.3E)
controls.body: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined secure information transfer solutions] to control information flows between security domains on connected systems.

controls.name: PE.L2-3.10.6 - Alternative Work Sites (NIST 800-171: 3.10.6)
controls.title: Alternative Work Sites (NIST 800-171: 3.10.6)
controls.body: Enforce safeguarding measures for Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) at alternate work sites.

controls.name: 6.12.1.3 - Information and Communications Technology Supply Chain
controls.title: Information and Communications Technology Supply Chain
controls.body: Agreements with suppliers shall include requirements to address the information security and privacy risks associated with information and communications technology services and product supply chain.

controls.name: SI-22 - Information Diversity
controls.title: Information Diversity
controls.body:
a. Identify the following alternative sources of information for [Assignment: organization-defined essential functions and services]: [Assignment: organization-defined alternative information sources]; and
b. Use an alternative information source for the execution of essential functions or services on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] when the primary source of information is corrupted or unavailable.

controls.name: 6.4.2.2 - Information Security and Privacy Awareness, Education and Training
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Awareness, Education and Training
controls.body: All employees of the organization and, where relevant, contractors shall receive appropriate awareness education and training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

controls.name: C.10.2.3 - Rectification Compliance
controls.title: Rectification Compliance

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.15 - Communications Authenticity (NIST 800-171: 3.13.15)
controls.title: Communications Authenticity (NIST 800-171: 3.13.15)
controls.body: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

controls.name: 6.15.2.1 - Independent Review of Information Security and Privacy
controls.title: Independent Review of Information Security and Privacy
controls.body: The organization’s approach to managing information security and privacy and its implementation (i.e. control objectives, controls, policies, processes and procedures for information security) shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.

controls.name: 5.26 - Information Security Incident Response and Notifications
controls.title: Information Security Incident Response and Notifications
controls.body: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

controls.name: CM.L3-3.4.3e - Automated Inventory (NIST 800-172:3.4.3E)
controls.title: Automated Inventory (NIST 800-172:3.4.3E)
controls.body: Employ automated discovery and management tools to maintain an up-to-date, complete, accurate, and readily available inventory of system components.

controls.name: SI.L3-3.14.6e - Threat-Guided Intrusion Detection (NIST 800-172:3.14.6E)
controls.title: Threat-Guided Intrusion Detection (NIST 800-172:3.14.6E)
controls.body: Use threat indicator information and effective mitigations obtained from [Assignment: organization-defined external organizations] to guide and inform intrusion detection and threat hunting.

controls.name: 6.6.2.4 - Management of Secret Authentication Information of Users
controls.title: Management of Secret Authentication Information of Users
controls.body: The allocation of secret authentication information shall be controlled through a formal management process.

controls.name: CIS 3.7-ID - Data Classification
controls.title: Data Classification
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.7: Establish and maintain a data classification scheme.

controls.name: IR.L3-3.6.1e - Security Operations Center (NIST 800-172:3.6.1E)
controls.title: Security Operations Center (NIST 800-172:3.6.1E)
controls.body: Establish and maintain a security operations center capability that operates [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.name: CA.L2-3.12.1 - Security Control Assessment (NIST 800-171: 3.12.1)
controls.title: Security Control Assessment (NIST 800-171: 3.12.1)
controls.body: Periodically assess the security controls in organizational systems to determine if the controls are effective in their application.

controls.name: 6.13.1.1 - Responsibilities and Procedures
controls.title: Responsibilities and Procedures
controls.body: Management responsibilities and procedures shall be established to ensure a quick, effective and orderly response to information security and privacy incidents.

controls.name: 3.9.1e - Enhanced Personnel Screening
controls.title: Enhanced Personnel Screening
controls.body: Conduct [Assignment: organization-defined enhanced personnel screening] for individuals and reassess individual positions and access on an ongoing basis.

controls.name: 3.1.1e - Dual Authorization
controls.title: Dual Authorization
controls.body: Employ dual authorization to execute critical or sensitive system and organizational operations.

controls.name: CM.L2-3.4.9 - User-Installed Software (NIST 800-171: 3.4.9)
controls.title: User-Installed Software (NIST 800-171: 3.4.9)
controls.body: Control and monitor user-installed software.

controls.name: 5.21 - Managing Information Security in the ICT Supply Chain
controls.title: Managing Information Security in the ICT Supply Chain
controls.body: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

controls.name: 6.9.4.4 - Clock Synchronisation
controls.title: Clock Synchronisation
controls.body: The clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organization or security domain shall be synchronised to a single reference time source.

controls.name: PS.L2-3.9.1 - Screen Individuals (NIST 800-171: 3.9.1)
controls.title: Screen Individuals (NIST 800-171: 3.9.1)
controls.body: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to organizational systems containing Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

controls.name: IA.L2-3.5.4 - Replay-Resistant Authentication (NIST 800-171: 3.5.4)
controls.title: Replay-Resistant Authentication (NIST 800-171: 3.5.4)
controls.body: Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to privileged and non-privileged accounts.

controls.name: 3.14.5e - Storage Reviews
controls.title: Storage Reviews
controls.body: Conduct reviews of persistent organizational storage locations [Assignment: organization- defined frequency] and remove CUI that is no longer needed.

controls.name: MA.L2-3.7.1 - Perform Maintenance (NIST 800-171: 3.7.1)
controls.title: Perform Maintenance (NIST 800-171: 3.7.1)
controls.body: Perform maintenance on organizational systems.

controls.name: MP.L2-3.8.5 - Media Accountability (NIST 800-171: 3.8.5)
controls.title: Media Accountability (NIST 800-171: 3.8.5)
controls.body: Control access to media containing Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and maintain accountability for media during transport outside of controlled areas.

controls.name: IA.L2-3.5.7 - Password Complexity (NIST 800-171: 3.5.7)
controls.title: Password Complexity (NIST 800-171: 3.5.7)
controls.body: Enforce a minimum password complexity and change of characters when new passwords are created.

controls.name: 6.6.3.1 - Use of Secret Authentication Information
controls.title: Use of Secret Authentication Information
controls.body: Users shall be required to follow the organization’s practices in the use of secret authentication information.

controls.name: 8.20 - Networks Security
controls.title: Networks Security
controls.body: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect the information in systems and applications.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.2 - Security Engineering (NIST 800-171: 3.13.2)
controls.title: Security Engineering (NIST 800-171: 3.13.2)
controls.body: Employ architectural designs, software development techniques and systems engineering principles that promote effective information security within organizational systems.

controls.name: MA.L2-3.7.2 - System Maintenance Control (NIST 800-171: 3.7.2)
controls.title: System Maintenance Control (NIST 800-171: 3.7.2)
controls.body: Provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms and personnel used to conduct system maintenance.

controls.name: ITGC - Vendor Management
controls.title: Vendor Management
controls.body: Use of a service organization or vendors in IT is appropriately considered through risk assessment of potential vendors and evaluation of existing vendors on an annual basis.

controls.name: SC-50 - Software-enforced Separation and Policy Enforcement
controls.title: Software-enforced Separation and Policy Enforcement
controls.body: Implement software-enforced separation and policy enforcement mechanisms between [Assignment: organization-defined security domains].

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.8 - Data in Transit (NIST 800-171: 3.13.8)
controls.title: Data in Transit (NIST 800-171: 3.13.8)
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

controls.name: 3.5.2e - Automated Password Management
controls.title: Automated Password Management
controls.body: Employ automated mechanisms for the generation, protection, rotation, and management of passwords for systems and system components that do not support multifactor authentication or complex account management.

controls.name: 3.13.3e - Concealment and Misdirection Techniques
controls.title: Concealment and Misdirection Techniques
controls.body: Employ technical and procedural means to confuse and mislead adversaries.

controls.name: 6.14.1.2 - Implementing Information Security and Privacy Continuity
controls.title: Implementing Information Security and Privacy Continuity
controls.body: The organization shall establish, document, implement and maintain processes, procedures and controls to ensure the required level of continuity for information security and privacy during an adverse situation.

controls.name: APP 9.1 - Adoption of Government Related Identifiers
controls.title: Adoption of Government Related Identifiers
controls.body: The organization has processes in place to ensure individuals' government-related identifiers are not adopted unless authorized by law or prescribed by applicable regulations.

controls.name: 5.33 - Protection of Records
controls.title: Protection of Records
controls.body: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release.

controls.name: 6.10.1.1 - Network Controls
controls.title: Network Controls
controls.body: Networks shall be managed and controlled to protect the information in systems and applications.

controls.name: SC-7(10) - Boundary Protection | Prevent Exfiltration
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Prevent Exfiltration
controls.body:
a. Prevent the exfiltration of information; and
b. Conduct exfiltration tests [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.name: 8.23 - Web Filtering
controls.title: Web Filtering
controls.body: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.name: SC-7(7) - Boundary Protection | Split Tunneling for Remote Devices
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Split Tunneling for Remote Devices
controls.body: Prevent split tunneling for remote devices connecting to organizational systems unless the split tunnel is securely provisioned using [Assignment: organization-defined safeguards].

controls.name: SC-7(21) - Boundary Protection | Isolation of System Components
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Isolation of System Components
controls.body: Employ boundary protection mechanisms to isolate [Assignment: organization-defined system components] supporting [Assignment: organization-defined missions and/or business functions].

controls.name: 6.6.4.1 - Information Access Restriction
controls.title: Information Access Restriction
controls.body: Access to information and application system functions shall be restricted in accordance with the access control policy.

controls.name: SC-8(3) - Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Cryptographic Protection for Message Externals
controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Cryptographic Protection for Message Externals
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect message externals unless otherwise protected by [Assignment: organization-defined alternative physical controls].

controls.name: SC-12 - Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.body: Establish and manage cryptographic keys when cryptography is employed within the system in accordance with the following key management requirements: [Assignment: organization-defined requirements for key generation, distribution, storage, access, and destruction].

controls.name: SC-13 - Cryptographic Protection
controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.body:
a. Determine the [Assignment: organization-defined cryptographic uses]; and
b. Implement the following types of cryptography required for each specified cryptographic use: [Assignment: organization-defined types of cryptography for each specified cryptographic use].

controls.name: SI-4(11) - System Monitoring | Analyze Communications Traffic Anomalies
controls.title: System Monitoring | Analyze Communications Traffic Anomalies
controls.body: Analyze outbound communications traffic at the external interfaces to the system and selected [Assignment: organization-defined interior points within the system] to discover anomalies.

controls.name: SC-44 - Detonation Chambers
controls.title: Detonation Chambers
controls.body: Employ a detonation chamber capability within [Assignment: organization-defined system, system component, or location].

controls.name: SI-10(4) - Information Input Validation | Timing Interactions
controls.title: Information Input Validation | Timing Interactions
controls.body: Account for timing interactions among system components in determining appropriate responses for invalid inputs.

controls.name: SI-19 - De-identification
controls.title: De-identification
controls.body:
a. Remove the following elements of personally identifiable information from datasets: [Assignment: organization-defined elements of personally identifiable information]; and
b. Evaluate [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] for effectiveness of de-identification.

controls.name: 2.11 - Right to Limit Use and Disclosure of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.title: Right to Limit Use and Disclosure of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.body: The organization has mechanisms in place to allow consumers to exercise their right to limit the use and disclosure of their sensitive personal information. Requests from consumers to limit the use or disclosure of their sensitive personal information are documented, retained, and acted on as soon as feasibly possible, but no later than 15 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: 5.35 - Independent Review of Information Security
controls.title: Independent Review of Information Security
controls.body: The organization’s approach to managing information security and its implementation including people,  processes and technologies shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes occur.

controls.name: 5.37 - Documented Operating Procedures
controls.title: Documented Operating Procedures
controls.body: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.

controls.name: 7.13 - Equipment Maintenance
controls.title: Equipment Maintenance
controls.body: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.

controls.name: CIS 7.4-PR - Application Patch Management
controls.title: Application Patch Management
controls.body:
Continuous Vulnerability Management
Safeguard 7.4: Perform automated application patch management.

controls.name: Clause 5.2.1 - Organizational Context
controls.title: Organizational Context

controls.name: CIS 13.1-DE - Security Event Alerting
controls.title: Security Event Alerting
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.1: Centralize security event alerting.

controls.name: Clause 5.3.1 - Leadership and Commitment
controls.title: Leadership and Commitment

controls.name: CIS 3.8-ID - Data Flows
controls.title: Data Flows
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.8: Document data flows.

controls.name: 6.4 - Disciplinary Process
controls.title: Disciplinary Process
controls.body: A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation.

controls.name: Clause 5.5.3 - Awareness
controls.title: Awareness
controls.body:
Persons doing work under the organization’s control shall be aware of:
a) the information security and privacy policy;
b) their contribution to the effectiveness of the information security and privacy management systems, including the benefits of improved information security and privacy performance; and
c) the implications of not conforming with the information security and privacy management systems requirements.

controls.name: Clause 5.4.1.2 - Information Security and Privacy Risk Assessment Process
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Risk Assessment Process

controls.name: Clause 5.5.5 - Documented Information
controls.title: Documented Information
controls.body:
The organization’s information security and privacy management systems shall include:
a) documented information required by ISO27701 Standard; and
b) documented information determined by the organization as being necessary for the effectiveness of the information security and privacy management systems.

When creating and updating documented information, the organization shall ensure appropriate:
a) identification and description (e.g., a title, date, author, or reference number);
b) format (e.g., language, software version, graphics) and media (e.g., paper, electronic); and
c) review and approval for suitability and adequacy.

Documented information required by the ISMS, the PIMS and by the ISO27701 International Standard shall be controlled to ensure:
a) it is available and suitable for use, where and when it is needed; and
b) it is adequately protected (e.g., from loss of confidentiality, improper use, or loss of integrity).

For the control of documented information, the organization shall address the following activities, as applicable:
c) distribution, access, retrieval and use;
d) storage and preservation, including the preservation of legibility;
e) control of changes (e.g., version control); and
f) retention and disposition.

controls.name: CIS 12.2-PR - Secure Network Architecture
controls.title: Secure Network Architecture
controls.body:
Network Infrastructure Management
Safeguard 12.2: Establish and maintain a secure network architecture.

controls.name: Clause 5.6.1 - Operational Planning and Control
controls.title: Operational Planning and Control
controls.body:
The organization shall plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet information security and privacy requirements, and to implement the actions determined in ISO27701 5.4.1. The organization shall also implement plans to achieve information security and privacy objectives determined in ISO27701 5.4.2.

The organization shall keep documented information to the extent necessary to have confidence that the processes have been carried out as planned.

The organization shall control planned changes and review the consequences of unintended changes, taking action to mitigate any adverse effects, as necessary.

The organization shall ensure that outsourced processes are determined and controlled.

controls.name: 8.12 - Data Leakage Prevention
controls.title: Data Leakage Prevention
controls.body: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

controls.name: Clause 5.7.1 - Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation
controls.title: Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation

controls.name: 8.5 - Secure Authentication
controls.title: Secure Authentication
controls.body: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.name: 6.5 - Responsibilities after Termination or Change of Employment
controls.title: Responsibilities after Termination or Change of Employment
controls.body: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties.

controls.name: 6.10.1.2 - Security of Network Services
controls.title: Security of Network Services
controls.body: Security mechanisms, service levels and management requirements of all network services shall be identified and included in-network services agreements, whether these services are provided in-house or outsourced.

controls.name: CIS 8.4-PR - Standardized Time Synchronization
controls.title: Standardized Time Synchronization
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.4: Standardize time synchronization.

controls.name: 3.3 - Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.title: Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.body: Organizations assess the need for and implement, where appropriate, a privacy impact assessment whenever new processing of personal information or changes to existing processing is planned.

controls.name: 6.6 - Confidentiality or Non-Disclosure Agreements
controls.title: Confidentiality or Non-Disclosure Agreements
controls.body:
Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization’s needs for the protection of
information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and other
relevant interested parties.

controls.name: 6.9.1.4 - Separation of Development, Testing and Operational Environments
controls.title: Separation of Development, Testing and Operational Environments
controls.body: Development, testing, and operational environments shall be separated to reduce the risks of unauthorized access or changes to the operational environment.

controls.name: 6.7 - Remote Working
controls.title: Remote Working
controls.body: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization’s premises.

controls.name: 6.8 - Information Security Event Reporting
controls.title: Information Security Event Reporting
controls.body: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.

controls.name: 6.11.2.7 - Outsourced Development
controls.title: Outsourced Development
controls.body: The organization shall supervise and monitor the activity of outsourced system development.

controls.name: 8.19 - Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.title: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.body: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

controls.name: 6.4.1.2 - Terms and Conditions of Employment
controls.title: Terms and Conditions of Employment
controls.body: The contractual agreements with employees and contractors shall state their and the organization’s responsibilities for information security and privacy.

controls.name: APP 8.1 - Protection of and Exceptions for Cross-Border Disclosure of PI
controls.title: Protection of and Exceptions for Cross-Border Disclosure of PI
controls.body: The organization or agency has developed and implemented processes to protect and prevent breaches arising from cross-border disclosure of PI.

controls.name: 7.4 - Physical Security Monitoring
controls.title: Physical Security Monitoring
controls.body: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.

controls.name: CM.L2-3.4.5 - Access Restrictions for Change (NIST 800-171: 3.4.5)
controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change (NIST 800-171: 3.4.5)
controls.body: Define, document, approve and enforce physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to organizational systems.

controls.name: 6.15.2.2 - Compliance with Security Policies and Standards
controls.title: Compliance with Security Policies and Standards
controls.body: Managers shall regularly review the compliance of information processing and procedures within their area of responsibility with the appropriate security policies, standards and any other security requirements.

controls.name: 6.3.2.1 - Mobile Device Policy
controls.title: Mobile Device Policy
controls.body: A policy and supporting security measures shall be adopted to manage the risks introduced by using mobile devices.

controls.name: SC-5 - Denial-of-service Protection
controls.title: Denial-of-service Protection
controls.body:
a. [Selection: Protect against; Limit] the effects of the following types of denial-of-service events: [Assignment: organization-defined types of denial-of-service events]; and
b. Employ the following controls to achieve the denial-of-service objective: [Assignment: organization-defined controls by type of denial-of-service event].

controls.name: SA-17 - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design
controls.body:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to produce a design specification and security and privacy architecture that:

a. Is consistent with the organization’s security and privacy architecture that is an integral part the organization’s enterprise architecture;
b. Accurately and completely describes the required security and privacy functionality, and the allocation of controls among physical and logical components; and
c. Expresses how individual security and privacy functions, mechanisms, and services work together to provide required security and privacy capabilities and a unified approach to protection.

controls.name: Clause 5.6.2 - Information Security and Privacy Risk Assessment
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Risk Assessment
controls.body:
The organization shall perform information security and privacy risk assessments at planned intervals or when significant changes are proposed or occur, taking account of the criteria established in ISO27701 5.4.1.2 a).

The organization shall retain documented information of the results of the information security and privacy risk assessments.

controls.name: SA-17(3) - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Formal Correspondence
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Formal Correspondence

controls.name: SC-3(3) - Security Function Isolation | Minimize Nonsecurity Functionality
controls.title: Security Function Isolation | Minimize Nonsecurity Functionality
controls.body: Minimize the number of nonsecurity functions included within the isolation boundary containing security functions.

controls.name: SA-17(9) - Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Design Diversity
controls.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Design Diversity
controls.body: Use different designs for [Assignment: organization-defined critical systems or system components] to satisfy a common set of requirements or to provide equivalent functionality.

controls.name: SC-5(3) - Denial-of-service Protection | Detection and Monitoring
controls.title: Denial-of-service Protection | Detection and Monitoring
controls.body:
a. Employ the following monitoring tools to detect indicators of denial-of-service attacks against, or launched from, the system: [Assignment: organization-defined monitoring tools]; and
b. Monitor the following system resources to determine if sufficient resources exist to prevent effective denial-of-service attacks: [Assignment: organization-defined system resources].

controls.name: A.7.3.5 - Providing Mechanism to Object to PII Processing
controls.title: Providing Mechanism to Object to PII Processing
controls.body: The organization shall provide a mechanism for PII principals to object to the processing of their PII.

controls.name: SA-21 - Developer Screening
controls.title: Developer Screening
controls.body:
Require that the developer of [Assignment: organization-defined system, system component, or system service]:

a. Has appropriate access authorizations as determined by assigned [Assignment: organization-defined official government duties]; and
b. Satisfies the following additional personnel screening criteria: [Assignment: organization-defined additional personnel screening criteria].

controls.name: SC-2 - Separation of System and User Functionality
controls.title: Separation of System and User Functionality
controls.body: Separate user functionality, including user interface services, from system management functionality.

controls.name: SC-3 - Security Function Isolation
controls.title: Security Function Isolation
controls.body: Isolate security functions from nonsecurity functions.

controls.name: SC-4 - Information in Shared System Resources
controls.title: Information in Shared System Resources
controls.body: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.

controls.name: B.8.2.5 - Customer Obligations
controls.title: Customer Obligations
controls.body: The organization shall provide the customer with the appropriate information such that the customer can demonstrate compliance with their obligations.

controls.name: SC-7(8) - Boundary Protection | Route Traffic to Authenticated Proxy Servers
controls.title: Boundary Protection | Route Traffic to Authenticated Proxy Servers
controls.body: Route [Assignment: organization-defined internal communications traffic] to [Assignment: organization-defined external networks] through authenticated proxy servers at managed interfaces.

controls.name: SC-16 - Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes
controls.title: Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes
controls.body: Associate [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] with information exchanged between systems and between system components.

controls.name: 6.14.1.3 - Verify, Review and Evaluate Information Security and Privacy Continuity
controls.title: Verify, Review and Evaluate Information Security and Privacy Continuity
controls.body: The organization shall verify the established and implemented information security and privacy continuity controls at regular intervals in order to ensure that they are valid and effective during adverse situations.

controls.name: 6.2.1.2 - Review of the Policies for Information Security and Privacy
controls.title: Review of the Policies for Information Security and Privacy
controls.body: The policies for information security and privacy shall be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur to ensure their continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

controls.name: SC-20 - Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Authoritative Source)
controls.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Authoritative Source)
controls.body:
a. Provide additional data origin authentication and integrity verification artifacts along with the authoritative name resolution data the system returns in response to external name/address resolution queries; and
b. Provide the means to indicate the security status of child zones and (if the child supports secure resolution services) to enable verification of a chain of trust among parent and child domains, when operating as part of a distributed, hierarchical namespace.

controls.name: SC-22 - Architecture and Provisioning for Name/Address Resolution Service
controls.title: Architecture and Provisioning for Name/Address Resolution Service
controls.body: Ensure the systems that collectively provide name/address resolution service for an organization are fault-tolerant and implement internal and external role separation.

controls.name: SC-30 - Concealment and Misdirection
controls.title: Concealment and Misdirection
controls.body: Employ the following concealment and misdirection techniques for [Assignment: organization-defined systems] at [Assignment: organization-defined time periods] to confuse and mislead adversaries: [Assignment: organization-defined concealment and misdirection techniques].

controls.name: SC-34 - Non-modifiable Executable Programs
controls.title: Non-modifiable Executable Programs
controls.body:
For [Assignment: organization-defined system components], load and execute:

a. The operating environment from hardware-enforced, read-only media; and
b. The following applications from hardware-enforced, read-only media: [Assignment: organization-defined applications].

controls.name: SC-38 - Operations Security
controls.title: Operations Security
controls.body: Employ the following operations security controls to protect key organizational information throughout the system development life cycle: [Assignment: organization-defined operations security controls].

controls.name: SC-42 - Sensor Capability and Data
controls.title: Sensor Capability and Data
controls.body:
a. Prohibit [Selection (one or more): the use of devices possessing [Assignment: organization-defined environmental sensing capabilities] in [Assignment: organization-defined facilities, areas, or systems]; the remote activation of environmental sensing capabilities on organizational systems or system components with the following exceptions: [Assignment: organization-defined exceptions where remote activation of sensors is allowed]]; and
b. Provide an explicit indication of sensor use to [Assignment: organization-defined group of users].

controls.name: SC-45 - System Time Synchronization
controls.title: System Time Synchronization
controls.body: Synchronize system clocks within and between systems and system components.

controls.name: A.7.4.5 - PII De-Identification and Deletion at the End of Processing
controls.title: PII De-Identification and Deletion at the End of Processing
controls.body: The organization shall either delete PII or render it in a form which does not permit identification or re-identification of PII principals, as soon as the original PII is no longer necessary for the identified purpose(s).

controls.name: SI-2 - Flaw Remediation
controls.title: Flaw Remediation

controls.name: SI-3(8) - Malicious Code Protection | Detect Unauthorized Commands
controls.title: Malicious Code Protection | Detect Unauthorized Commands
controls.body:
a. Detect the following unauthorized operating system commands through the kernel application programming interface on [Assignment: organization-defined system hardware components]: [Assignment: organization-defined unauthorized operating system commands]; and
b. [Selection (one or more): issue a warning; audit the command execution; prevent the execution of the command].

controls.name: 5.27 - Learning from Information Security Incidents
controls.title: Learning from Information Security Incidents
controls.body: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.

controls.name: 6.14.2.1 - Availability of Information Processing Facilities
controls.title: Availability of Information Processing Facilities
controls.body: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

controls.name: 7.8 - Equipment Siting and Protection
controls.title: Equipment Siting and Protection
controls.body: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected.

controls.name: 6.3.1.1 - Information Security and Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: All information security and privacy responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.

controls.name: 6.5.1.1 - Inventory of Assets
controls.title: Inventory of Assets
controls.body: Information, other assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up and maintained.

controls.name: 7.10 - Storage Media
controls.title: Storage Media
controls.body: Storage media shall be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the organization’s classification scheme and handling requirements.

controls.name: CIS 3.10-PR - Encryption of Data In Transit
controls.title: Encryption of Data In Transit
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.10: Encrypt sensitive data in transit.

controls.name: 6.5.2.2 - Labelling of Information
controls.title: Labelling of Information
controls.body: An appropriate set of procedures for information labeling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.name: SI-4(24) - System Monitoring | Indicators of Compromise
controls.title: System Monitoring | Indicators of Compromise
controls.body: Discover, collect, and distribute to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles], indicators of compromise provided by [Assignment: organization-defined sources].

controls.name: SI-19(2) - De-identification | Archiving
controls.title: De-identification | Archiving
controls.body: Prohibit archiving of personally identifiable information elements if those elements in a dataset will not be needed after the dataset is archived.

controls.name: 7.14 - Secure Disposal or Re-Use of Equipment
controls.title: Secure Disposal or Re-Use of Equipment
controls.body: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software have been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

controls.name: CIS 3.12-PR - Data Processing and Storage Segmentation
controls.title: Data Processing and Storage Segmentation
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.12: Segment data processing and storage based on sensitivity.

controls.name: CIS 11.3-PR - Recovery Data Protection
controls.title: Recovery Data Protection
controls.body:
Data Recovery
Safeguard 11.3: Protect recovery data.

controls.name: APP 3.1 - Collection of Solicited Personal Information (PI)
controls.title: Collection of Solicited Personal Information (PI)
controls.body: The organization or agency must solicit and collect personal information only where reasonably necessary for one or more of its legitimate functions or activities.

controls.name: CIS 3.13-PR - DLP Solution
controls.title: DLP Solution
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.13: Deploy a data loss prevention solution.

controls.name: CIS 12.4-ID - Architecture Diagram
controls.title: Architecture Diagram
controls.body:
Network Infrastructure Management
Safeguard 12.4: Establish and maintain architecture diagram(s).

controls.name: SC-20(2) - Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Authoritative Source) | Data Origin and Integrity
controls.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Authoritative Source) | Data Origin and Integrity
controls.body: Provide data origin and integrity protection artifacts for internal name/address resolution queries.

controls.name: CIS 11.4-RC - Isolated Instance of Recovery Data
controls.title: Isolated Instance of Recovery Data
controls.body:
Data Recovery
Safeguard 11.4: Establish and maintain an isolated instance of recovery data.

controls.name: CIS 18.4-PR - Security Measures Validation
controls.title: Security Measures Validation
controls.body:
Penetration Testing
Safeguard 18.4: Validate security measures.

controls.name: A.7.4.9 - PII Transmission Controls
controls.title: PII Transmission Controls
controls.body: The organization shall subject PII transmitted (e.g. sent to another organization) over a data-transmission network to appropriate controls designed to ensure that the data reaches its intended destination.

controls.name: APP 7.1 - Use or Disclosure of Sensitive/Personal Information (PI) for Direct Marketing
controls.title: Use or Disclosure of Sensitive/Personal Information (PI) for Direct Marketing
controls.body:
The organization has developed a process that prohibits the use or disclosure of sensitive/personal information for direct marketing, unless:
a. Exceptions apply
b. They are a contracted service provider

controls.name: APP 11.2 - Destroying or De-identifying Personal Information (PI)
controls.title: Destroying or De-identifying Personal Information (PI)
controls.body: The organization or agency must have appropriate mechanisms in place to destroy or de-identify personal information when it is no longer needed for any purpose for which it may be used and disclosed (unless otherwise required to retain it by law).

controls.name: APP 9.2 - Use or Disclosure of Government Related Identifiers
controls.title: Use or Disclosure of Government Related Identifiers
controls.body: The organization has a process in place to ensure individuals' government-related identifiers are not used or disclosed unless authorized by law or prescribed by applicable regulations.

controls.name: 8.9 - Configuration Management
controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.body: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

controls.name: 8.10 - Information Deletion
controls.title: Information Deletion
controls.body: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.

controls.name: CIS 12.8-PR - Dedicated Resources for Administrative Work
controls.title: Dedicated Resources for Administrative Work
controls.body:
Network Infrastructure Management
Safeguard 12.8: Establish and maintain dedicated computing resources for all administrative work.

controls.name: B.8.2.6 - Records Related to Processing PII for Customers
controls.title: Records Related to Processing PII for Customers
controls.body: The organization shall determine and maintain the necessary records in support of demonstrating compliance with its obligations (as specified in the applicable contract) for the processing of PII carried out on behalf of a customer.

controls.name: 8.11 - Data Masking
controls.title: Data Masking
controls.body: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization’s topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

controls.name: 8.25 - Secure Development Life Cycle
controls.title: Secure Development Life Cycle
controls.body: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.

controls.name: 8.28 - Secure Coding
controls.title: Secure Coding
controls.body: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

controls.name: 6.2.1.1 - Policies for Information Security and Privacy
controls.title: Policies for Information Security and Privacy
controls.body: A set of policies for information security and privacy shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.

controls.name: B.8.3.1 - Obligations to PII Principals
controls.title: Obligations to PII Principals
controls.body: The organization shall provide the customer with the means to comply with its obligations related to PII principals.

controls.name: 6.3.1.2 - Segregation of Duties
controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.body: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization’s assets.

controls.name: 6.3.1.4 - Contact with Special Interest Groups
controls.title: Contact with Special Interest Groups
controls.body: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations shall be maintained.

controls.name: 6.3.2.2 - Teleworking
controls.title: Teleworking
controls.body: A policy and supporting security measures shall be implemented to protect information accessed, processed or stored at teleworking sites.

controls.name: 6.4.2.1 - Management Responsibilities
controls.title: Management Responsibilities
controls.body: Management shall require all employees and contractors to apply information security and privacy in accordance with the established policies and procedures of the organization.

controls.name: 6.5.2.1 - Classification of Information
controls.title: Classification of Information
controls.body: Information shall be classified in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification.

controls.name: 6.5.3.3 - Physical Media Transfer
controls.title: Physical Media Transfer
controls.body: Media containing information shall be protected against unauthorized access, misuse or corruption during transportation.

controls.name: 6.6.1.1 - Access Control Policy
controls.title: Access Control Policy
controls.body: An access control policy shall be established, documented and reviewed based on business and information security requirements.

controls.name: 6.6.4.2 - Secure Log-on Procedures
controls.title: Secure Log-on Procedures
controls.body: Where required by the access control policy, access to systems and applications shall be controlled by a secure log-on procedure.

controls.name: 6.9.6.2 - Restriction on Software Installation
controls.title: Restriction on Software Installation
controls.body: Rules governing the installation of software by users shall be established and implemented.

controls.name: 6.3 - Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
controls.title: Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
controls.body: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures as relevant for their job function.

controls.name: 6.7.1.2 - Key Management
controls.title: Key Management
controls.body: A policy on the use, protection and lifetime of cryptographic keys shall be developed and implemented through their whole lifecycle.

controls.name: 6.8.1.1 - Physical Security Perimeter
controls.title: Physical Security Perimeter
controls.body: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain either sensitive or critical information and information processing facilities.

controls.name: 6.8.1.3 - Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
controls.title: Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
controls.body: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and applied.

controls.name: 6.9.4.2 - Protection of Log Information
controls.title: Protection of Log Information
controls.body: Logging facilities and log information shall be protected against tampering and unauthorized access.

controls.name: 6.9.4.3 - Administrator and Operator Logs
controls.title: Administrator and Operator Logs
controls.body: System administrator and system operator activities shall be logged and the logs protected and regularly reviewed.

controls.name: 6.10.2.3 - Electronic Messaging
controls.title: Electronic Messaging
controls.body: Information involved in electronic messaging shall be appropriately protected.

controls.name: 6.9.6.1 - Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.body: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization’s exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated and appropriate measures taken to address the associated risk.

controls.name: 6.11.1.1 - Information Security and Privacy Requirements Analysis and Specification
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Requirements Analysis and Specification
controls.body: The information security and privacy-related requirements shall be included in the requirements for new information systems or enhancements to existing information systems.

controls.name: 6.11.1.2 - Securing Application Services on Public Networks
controls.title: Securing Application Services on Public Networks
controls.body: Information involved in application services passing over public networks shall be protected from fraudulent activity, contract dispute and unauthorized disclosure and modification.

controls.name: ITGC - IT Policies
controls.title: IT Policies
controls.body: Policies are maintained to support the IT environment and segregation of duties. The policies are reviewed and approved by management annually or during significant changes.

controls.name: 6.11.1.3 - Protecting Application Services Transactions
controls.title: Protecting Application Services Transactions
controls.body: Information involved in application service transactions shall be protected to prevent incomplete transmission, misrouting, unauthorized message alteration, unauthorized disclosure, unauthorized message duplication or replay.

controls.name: 6.11.2.2 - System Change Control Procedures
controls.title: System Change Control Procedures
controls.body: Changes to systems within the development lifecycle shall be controlled by the use of formal change control procedures.

controls.name: 6.11.2.5 - Secure System Engineering Principles
controls.title: Secure System Engineering Principles
controls.body: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system implementation efforts.

controls.name: 6.11.2.6 - Secure Development Environment
controls.title: Secure Development Environment
controls.body: Organizations shall establish and appropriately protect secure development environments for system development and integration efforts that cover the entire system development life cycle.

controls.name: SC-10 - Network Disconnect
controls.title: Network Disconnect
controls.body: Terminate the network connection associated with a communications session at the end of the session or after [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of inactivity.

controls.name: 6.11.3.1 - Protection of Test Data
controls.title: Protection of Test Data
controls.body: Test data shall be selected carefully, protected and controlled.

controls.name: 6.13.1.2 - Reporting Information Security and Privacy Events
controls.title: Reporting Information Security and Privacy Events
controls.body: Information security and privacy events shall be reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

controls.name: 6.13.1.3 - Reporting Information Security and Privacy Weaknesses
controls.title: Reporting Information Security and Privacy Weaknesses
controls.body: Employees and contractors using the organization’s information systems and services shall be required to note and report any observed or suspected information security and privacy weaknesses in systems or services.

controls.name: 6.13.1.4 - Assessment of and Decision on Information Security and Privacy Events
controls.title: Assessment of and Decision on Information Security and Privacy Events
controls.body: Information security and privacy events shall be assessed and it shall be decided if they are to be classified as information security and/or privacy incidents.

controls.name: 6.13.1.6 - Learning from Information Security and Privacy Incidents
controls.title: Learning from Information Security and Privacy Incidents
controls.body: Knowledge gained from analysing and resolving information security and privacy incidents shall be used to reduce the likelihood or impact of future incidents.

controls.name: 6.15.1.3 - Protection of Records
controls.title: Protection of Records
controls.body: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release, in accordance with legislatory, regulatory, contractual and business requirements.

controls.name: 6.15.1.5 - Regulation of Cryptographic Controls
controls.title: Regulation of Cryptographic Controls
controls.body: Cryptographic controls shall be used in compliance with all relevant agreements, legislation and regulations.

controls.name: A.7.2.2 - Identify Lawful Basis
controls.title: Identify Lawful Basis
controls.body: The organization shall determine, document and comply with the relevant lawful basis for the processing of PII for the identified purposes.

controls.name: A.7.2.3 - Determine when and how consent is to be obtained
controls.title: Determine when and how consent is to be obtained
controls.body: The organization shall determine and document a process by which it can demonstrate if, when and how consent for the processing of PII was obtained from PII principals.

controls.name: 3.5 - De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.title: De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.body: The organization establishes reasonable measures to ensure that de-identified data cannot be associated with a natural individual, and will not be used to re-identify the data.

controls.name: A.7.3.8 - Providing Copy of PII Processed
controls.title: Providing Copy of PII Processed
controls.body: The organization shall be able to provide a copy of the PII that is processed when requested by the PII principal.

controls.name: A.7.4.4 - PII Minimization Objectives
controls.title: PII Minimization Objectives
controls.body: The organization shall define and document data minimization objectives and what mechanisms (such as de-identification) are used to meet those objectives.

controls.name: A.7.4.6 - Temporary Files
controls.title: Temporary Files
controls.body: The organization shall ensure that temporary files created as a result of the processing of PII are disposed of (e.g. erased or destroyed) following documented procedures within a specified, documented period.

controls.name: A.7.4.8 - Disposal
controls.title: Disposal
controls.body: The organization shall have documented policies, procedures and/or mechanisms for the disposal of PII.

controls.name: B.8.5.1 - Basis for PII Transfer Between Jurisdictions
controls.title: Basis for PII Transfer Between Jurisdictions
controls.body: The organization shall inform the customer in a timely manner of the basis for PII transfers between jurisdictions and of any intended changes in this regard, so that the customer has the ability to object to such changes or to terminate the contract.

controls.name: 7.6 - Working in Secure Areas
controls.title: Working in Secure Areas
controls.body: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.

controls.name: 6.8.2.1 - Equipment Siting and Protection
controls.title: Equipment Siting and Protection
controls.body: Equipment shall be sited and protected to reduce the risks from environmental threats and hazards and opportunities for unauthorized access.

controls.name: SC.L2-3.13.13 - Mobile Code (NIST 800-171: 3.13.13)
controls.title: Mobile Code (NIST 800-171: 3.13.13)
controls.body: Control and monitor the use of mobile code.

controls.name: 6.8.2.3 - Cabling Security
controls.title: Cabling Security
controls.body: Power and telecommunications cabling carrying data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

controls.name: 7.1 - Physical Security Perimeters
controls.title: Physical Security Perimeters
controls.body: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.

controls.name: 7.5 - Protecting Against Physical and Environmental Threats
controls.title: Protecting Against Physical and Environmental Threats
controls.body: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure shall be designed and implemented.

controls.name: 7.7 - Clear Desk and Clear Screen
controls.title: Clear Desk and Clear Screen
controls.body: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.

controls.name: 8.27 - Secure System Architecture and Engineering Principles
controls.title: Secure System Architecture and Engineering Principles
controls.body: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.

controls.name: 7.11 - Supporting Utilities
controls.title: Supporting Utilities
