controls.body: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

controls.name: 7.12 - Cabling Security
controls.title: Cabling Security
controls.body: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

controls.name: 8.4 - Access to Source Code
controls.title: Access to Source Code
controls.body: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.

controls.name: 8.21 - Security of Network Services
controls.title: Security of Network Services
controls.body: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.

controls.name: 8.7 - Protection against Malware
controls.title: Protection against Malware
controls.body: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

controls.name: CIS 8.2-DE - Audit Log Collection
controls.title: Audit Log Collection
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.2: Collect audit logs.

controls.name: CIS 15.3-ID - Service Provider Classification
controls.title: Service Provider Classification
controls.body:
Service Provider Management
Safeguard 15.3: Classify service providers.

controls.name: SI-2(3) - Flaw Remediation | Time to Remediate Flaws and Benchmarks for Corrective Actions
controls.title: Flaw Remediation | Time to Remediate Flaws and Benchmarks for Corrective Actions
controls.body:
a. Measure the time between flaw identification and flaw remediation; and
b. Establish the following benchmarks for taking corrective actions: [Assignment: organization-defined benchmarks].

controls.name: ITGC - Access Reviews
controls.title: Access Reviews
controls.body: Access rights to the application(s) and supporting infrastructure are periodically reviewed for appropriateness.

controls.name: CIS 18.2-ID - External Penetration Tests
controls.title: External Penetration Tests
controls.body:
Penetration Testing
Safeguard 18.2: Perform periodic external penetration tests.

controls.name: ITGC - Administrative Access
controls.title: Administrative Access
controls.body: Super-user/administrative access to the application(s) and supporting infrastructure is restricted to authorized personnel based on a role-based access scheme and monitored.

controls.name: CIS 13.9-PR - Port-Level Access Control
controls.title: Port-Level Access Control
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.9: Deploy a port-level access control.

controls.name: CIS 7.2-RE - Remediation Process
controls.title: Remediation Process
controls.body:
Continuous Vulnerability Management
Safeguard 7.2: Establish and maintain a remediation process.

controls.name: SC-7 - Boundary Protection
controls.title: Boundary Protection

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.7 - Privileged Functions (NIST 800-171: 3.1.7)
controls.title: Privileged Functions (NIST 800-171: 3.1.7)
controls.body: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and capture the execution of such functions in audit logs.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.11 - Session Termination (NIST 800-171: 3.1.11)
controls.title: Session Termination (NIST 800-171: 3.1.11)
controls.body: Terminate (automatically) user sessions after a defined condition.

controls.name: SI-4(15) - System Monitoring | Wireless to Wireline Communications
controls.title: System Monitoring | Wireless to Wireline Communications
controls.body: Employ an intrusion detection system to monitor wireless communications traffic as the traffic passes from wireless to wireline networks.

controls.name: ITGC - Segregation of Environments
controls.title: Segregation of Environments
controls.body: Development, testing and production environments are segregated for changes to the application(s) and supporting infrastructure.

controls.name: ITGC - Change Reviews
controls.title: Change Reviews
controls.body: Changes to the application(s) and supporting infrastructure are periodically monitored for appropriateness through post-implementation reviews.

controls.name: AC.L2-3.1.3 - Control CUI Flow (NIST 800-171: 3.1.3)
controls.title: Control CUI Flow (NIST 800-171: 3.1.3)
controls.body: Control the flow of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) in accordance with approved authorizations.

controls.name: B.8.5.8 - Change of Subcontractor to Process PII
controls.title: Change of Subcontractor to Process PII
controls.body: The organization shall, in the case of having general written authorization, inform the customer of any intended changes concerning the addition or replacement of subcontractors to process PII, thereby giving the customer the opportunity to object to such changes.

controls.name: AT.L2-3.2.3 - Insider Threat Awareness (NIST 800-171: 3.2.3)
controls.title: Insider Threat Awareness (NIST 800-171: 3.2.3)
controls.body: Provide security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat.

controls.name: IA.L2-3.5.3 - Multifactor Authentication (NIST 800-171: 3.5.3)
controls.title: Multifactor Authentication (NIST 800-171: 3.5.3)
controls.body: Use multi-factor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.name: 6.4.1.1 - Screening
controls.title: Screening
controls.body: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out in accordance with relevant laws, regulations and ethics and shall be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

controls.name: PS.L2-3.9.2 - Personnel Actions (NIST 800-171: 3.9.2)
controls.title: Personnel Actions (NIST 800-171: 3.9.2)
controls.body: Ensure that organizational systems containing Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) are protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers.

controls.name: D1.G.IT.B.13 - Identification of Confidential Data
controls.title: Identification of Confidential Data
controls.body: Confidential data is identified on the institution's network.

controls.name: PCI 1.4.2 - Restriction of Traffic from Untrusted to Trusted Networks
controls.title: Restriction of Traffic from Untrusted to Trusted Networks
controls.body:
Inbound traffic from untrusted networks to trusted networks is restricted to:
- Communications with system components that are authorized to provide publicly accessible services, protocols, and ports.
- Stateful responses to communications initiated by system components in a trusted network.
- All other traffic is denied.

controls.name: 6.10.1.3 - Segregation in Networks
controls.title: Segregation in Networks
controls.body: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated on networks.

controls.name: RA.L3-3.11.5e - Security Solution Effectiveness (NIST 800-172:3.11.5E)
controls.title: Security Solution Effectiveness (NIST 800-172:3.11.5E)
controls.body: Assess the effectiveness of security solutions [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to address anticipated risk to organizational systems and the organization based on current and accumulated threat intelligence.

controls.name: CA.L3-3.12.1e - Penetration Testing (NIST 800-172:3.12.1E)
controls.title: Penetration Testing (NIST 800-172:3.12.1E)
controls.body: Conduct penetration testing [Assignment: organization-defined frequency], leveraging automated scanning tools and ad hoc tests using human experts.

controls.name: GC - Joint Controller Arrangements
controls.title: Joint Controller Arrangements
controls.body: The organization should determine and document the roles and responsibilities for the purpose and processing of PII with any joint controllers.

controls.name: 6.5.1.4 - Return of Assets
controls.title: Return of Assets
controls.body: All employees and external party users shall return all of the organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

controls.name: CIS 7.5-ID - Internal Asset Vulnerability Scans
controls.title: Internal Asset Vulnerability Scans
controls.body:
Continuous Vulnerability Management
Safeguard 7.5: Perform automated vulnerability scans of internal enterprise assets.

controls.name: 6.6.2.5 - Review of User Access Rights
controls.title: Review of User Access Rights
controls.body: Asset owners shall review users’ access rights at regular intervals.

controls.name: 6.6.2.3 - Management of Privileged Access Rights
controls.title: Management of Privileged Access Rights
controls.body: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and controlled.

controls.name: 6.6.2.6 - Removal or Adjustment of Access Rights
controls.title: Removal or Adjustment of Access Rights
controls.body: The access rights of all employees and external party users to information and information processing facilities shall be removed upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement, or adjusted upon change.

controls.name: A.7.2.1 - Identify and Document Purpose
controls.title: Identify and Document Purpose
controls.body: The organization shall identify and document the specific purposes for which the PII will be collected and processed.

controls.name: A.7.2.6 - Contracts with PII Processors
controls.title: Contracts with PII Processors
controls.body: The organization shall have a written contract with any PII processor that it uses and should ensure that their contracts with PII processors address the implementation of the appropriate controls in Annex B.

controls.name: A.7.2.7 - Joint PII Controller
controls.title: Joint PII Controller
controls.body: The organization shall determine respective roles and responsibilities for the processing of PII (including PII protection and security requirements) with any joint PII controller.

controls.name: CIS 6.1-PR - Access Provisioning Process
controls.title: Access Provisioning Process
controls.body:
Access Control Management
Safeguard 6.1: Establish an access granting process.

controls.name: A.7.3.7 - PII Controllers' Obligations to Inform Third Parties
controls.title: PII Controllers' Obligations to Inform Third Parties
controls.body: The organization shall inform third parties with whom PII has been shared of any modification, withdrawal or objections pertaining to the shared PII, and implement appropriate policies, procedures and/or mechanisms to do so.

controls.name: B.8.2.3 - Marketing and Advertising Use
controls.title: Marketing and Advertising Use
controls.body: The organization shall not use PII processed under a contract for the purposes of marketing and advertising without establishing that prior consent was obtained from the appropriate PII principal. The organization should not make providing such consent a condition for receiving the service.

controls.name: B.8.2.2 - Organization's Purposes
controls.title: Organization's Purposes
controls.body: The organization shall ensure that PII processed on behalf of a customer are only processed for the purposes expressed in the documented instructions of the customer.

controls.name: B.8.2.4 - Infringing Instruction
controls.title: Infringing Instruction
controls.body: The organization shall inform the customer if, in its opinion, a processing instruction infringes applicable legislation and/or regulation.

controls.name: 6.12.1.2 - Addressing Security and Privacy within Supplier Agreements
controls.title: Addressing Security and Privacy within Supplier Agreements
controls.body: All relevant information security and privacy requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier that may access, process, store, communicate, or provide IT infrastructure components for, the organization’s information.

controls.name: B.8.5.3 - Records of PII Disclosure to Third Parties
controls.title: Records of PII Disclosure to Third Parties
controls.body: The organization shall record disclosures of PII to third parties, including what PII has been disclosed, to whom and when.

controls.name: 6.9.2.1 - Controls against Malware
controls.title: Controls against Malware
controls.body: Detection, prevention and recovery controls to protect against malware shall be implemented, combined with appropriate user awareness.

controls.name: 6.12.2.1 - Monitoring and Review of Supplier Services
controls.title: Monitoring and Review of Supplier Services
controls.body: Organizations shall regularly monitor, review and audit supplier service delivery.

controls.name: CIS 7.7-RE - Vulnerability Remediation
controls.title: Vulnerability Remediation
controls.body:
Continuous Vulnerability Management
Safeguard 7.7: Remediate detected vulnerabilities.

controls.name: 5.16 - Identity Management
controls.title: Identity Management
controls.body: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.

controls.name: 8.2 - Privileged Access Rights
controls.title: Privileged Access Rights
controls.body: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

controls.name: 8.3 - Information Access Restriction
controls.title: Information Access Restriction
controls.body: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.name: 6.1 - Screening
controls.title: Screening
controls.body: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations and ethics and be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

controls.name: CIS 16.2-PR - Addressing Software Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Addressing Software Vulnerabilities
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.2: Establish and maintain a process to accept and address reports of software vulnerabilities.

controls.name: APP 1.2 - Privacy Policy
controls.title: Privacy Policy
controls.body: The organization or agency has a clearly expressed and up-to-date privacy policy published on its website, which outlines privacy obligations and specifies the rights of individuals in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The policy is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: 8.13 - Information Backup
controls.title: Information Backup
controls.body: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

controls.name: 8.22 - Segregation of Networks
controls.title: Segregation of Networks
controls.body: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated in the organization’s networks.

controls.name: CIS 13.10-PR - Application Layer Filtering
controls.title: Application Layer Filtering
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.10: Perform application-layer filtering.

controls.name: APP 2.1 - Providing Anonymous and Pseudonymous Options
controls.title: Providing Anonymous and Pseudonymous Options
controls.body: The organization or agency must provide individuals the option of anonymity or using a pseudonym when dealing with the organization or agency, except where impracticable or another prescribed exception applies.

controls.name: CIS 10.1-PR - Anti-malware Software
controls.title: Anti-malware Software
controls.body:
Malware Defenses
Safeguard 10.1: Deploy and maintain anti-malware software.

controls.name: CIS 13.3-DE - Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.title: Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.3: Deploy a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.name: 8.29 - Security Testing in Development and Acceptance
controls.title: Security Testing in Development and Acceptance
controls.body: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.

controls.name: CIS 14.1-PR - Security Awareness Program
controls.title: Security Awareness Program
controls.body:
Security Awareness and Skills Training
Safeguard 14.1: Establish and maintain a security awareness program.

controls.name: CIS 3.9-PR - Removable Media Data Encryption
controls.title: Removable Media Data Encryption
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.9: Encrypt data on removable media.

controls.name: CIS 4.2-PR - Secure Configuration Process for Network Infrastructure
controls.title: Secure Configuration Process for Network Infrastructure
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.2: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process for network infrastructure.

controls.name: CIS 4.4-PR - Servers Firewall
controls.title: Servers Firewall
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.4: Implement and manage a firewall on servers.

controls.name: CIS 4.5-PR - Firewall on End-User Devices
controls.title: Firewall on End-User Devices
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.5: Implement and manage a firewall on end-user devices.

controls.name: CIS 13.6-DE - Network Traffic Logs
controls.title: Network Traffic Logs
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.6: Collect network traffic flow logs.

controls.name: CIS 4.10-RE - Automated Device Lockout
controls.title: Automated Device Lockout
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.10: Enforce automatic device lockout on portable end-user devices.

controls.name: CIS 5.1-ID - Inventory of Accounts
controls.title: Inventory of Accounts
controls.body:
Account Management
Safeguard 5.1: Establish and maintain an inventory of accounts.

controls.name: CIS 6.3-PR - MFA for Externally-Exposed Applications
controls.title: MFA for Externally-Exposed Applications
controls.body:
Access Control Management
Safeguard 6.3: Require MFA for externally-exposed applications.

controls.name: CIS 6.4-PR - MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.title: MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.body:
Access Control Management
Safeguard 6.4: Require MFA for remote network access.

controls.name: CIS 6.2-PR - Access Deprovisioning Process
controls.title: Access Deprovisioning Process
controls.body:
Access Control Management
Safeguard 6.2: Establish an access revoking process.

controls.name: CIS 13.4-PR - Network Segments Filtering
controls.title: Network Segments Filtering
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.4: Perform traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.name: CIS 13.8-PR - Network Intrusion Prevention
controls.title: Network Intrusion Prevention
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.8: Deploy a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.name: CIS 14.5-PR - Data Exposure Prevention Training
controls.title: Data Exposure Prevention Training
controls.body:
Security Awareness and Skills Training
Safeguard 14.5: Train workforce members on causes of unintentional data exposure.

controls.name: CIS 14.8-PR - Insecure Networks Awareness Training
controls.title: Insecure Networks Awareness Training
controls.body:
Security Awareness and Skills Training
Safeguard 14.8: Train workforce on the dangers of connecting to and transmitting enterprise data over insecure networks.

controls.name: CIS 16.13-PR - Application Penetration Testing
controls.title: Application Penetration Testing
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.13: Conduct application penetration testing.

controls.name: CIS 18.1-ID - Penetration Testing Program
controls.title: Penetration Testing Program
controls.body:
Penetration Testing
Safeguard 18.1: Establish and maintain a penetration testing program.

controls.name: MAP 4.2 - Identifying and Documenting Internal Risk Controls for AI Components
controls.title: Identifying and Documenting Internal Risk Controls for AI Components
controls.body: Internal risk controls for components of the AI system, including third-party AI technologies, are identified and documented.

controls.name: 6.8.2.8 - Unattended User Equipment
controls.title: Unattended User Equipment
controls.body: Users shall ensure that unattended equipment has appropriate protection.

controls.name: PCI 1.3.2 - Restriction to Outbound Traffic
controls.title: Restriction to Outbound Traffic
controls.body:
Outbound traffic from the CDE is restricted as follows:
- To only traffic that is necessary.
- All other traffic is specifically denied.

controls.name: PCI 1.4.4 - Protection of System Components
controls.title: Protection of System Components
controls.body: System components that store cardholder data are not directly accessible from untrusted networks.

controls.name: CIS 4.3-PR - Automatic Session Locking
controls.title: Automatic Session Locking
controls.body:
Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard 4.3: Configure automatic session locking on enterprise assets.

controls.name: CIS 16.6-PR - Application Vulnerabilities Severity Rating
controls.title: Application Vulnerabilities Severity Rating
controls.body:
Application Software Security
Safeguard 16.6: Establish and maintain a severity rating system and process for application vulnerabilities.

controls.name: 8.6 - Capacity Management
controls.title: Capacity Management
controls.body: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

controls.name: ITGC - Emergency Changes
controls.title: Emergency Changes
controls.body: Emergency changes are documented and subject to the standard change management process but at an accelerated timeline. Prior to initiating an emergency change, appropriate approval is obtained and documented.

controls.name: CIS 5.2-PR - Unique Passwords
controls.title: Unique Passwords
controls.body:
Account Management
Safeguard 5.2: Use unique passwords.

controls.name: CCPA 3.2 - Awareness Training
controls.title: Awareness Training
controls.body: Employees and contractors are required to complete information security and privacy awareness training as part of the onboarding process and annually thereafter.

controls.name: IR.L2-3.6.1 - Incident Handling (NIST 800-171: 3.6.1)
controls.title: Incident Handling (NIST 800-171: 3.6.1)
controls.body: Establish an operational incident-handling capability for organizational systems that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery and user response activities.

controls.name: CIS 14.3-PR - Authentication Practices Training
controls.title: Authentication Practices Training
controls.body:
Security Awareness and Skills Training
Safeguard 14.3: Train workforce members on authentication best practices.

controls.name: CIS 14.7-PR - Reporting Security Updates Training
controls.title: Reporting Security Updates Training
controls.body:
Security Awareness and Skills Training
Safeguard 14.7: Train workforce on how to identify and report if their enterprise assets are missing security updates.

controls.name: Clause 5.4.1.3 - Information Security and Privacy Risk Treatment Process
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Risk Treatment Process

controls.name: SC-8 - Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.body: Protect the [Selection (one or more): confidentiality; integrity] of transmitted information.

controls.name: SI-4(7) - System Monitoring | Automated Response to Suspicious Events
controls.title: System Monitoring | Automated Response to Suspicious Events
controls.body:
a. Notify [Assignment: organization-defined incident response personnel (identified by name and/or by role)] of detected suspicious events; and
b. Take the following actions upon detection: [Assignment: organization-defined least-disruptive actions to terminate suspicious events].

controls.name: SI-4(2) - System Monitoring | Automated Tools and Mechanisms for Real-time Analysis
controls.title: System Monitoring | Automated Tools and Mechanisms for Real-time Analysis
controls.body: Employ automated tools and mechanisms to support near real-time analysis of events.

controls.name: CIP-010.R4-1.5 - Unauthorized Use Mitigation
controls.title: Unauthorized Use Mitigation

controls.name: SC-28 - Protection of Information at Rest
controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.body: Protect the [Selection (one or more): confidentiality; integrity] of the following information at rest: [Assignment: organization-defined information at rest].

controls.name: SI-4(5) - System Monitoring | System-generated Alerts
controls.title: System Monitoring | System-generated Alerts
controls.body: Alert [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] when the following system-generated indications of compromise or potential compromise occur: [Assignment: organization-defined compromise indicators].

controls.name: SC-28(1) - Protection of Information at Rest | Cryptographic Protection
controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest | Cryptographic Protection
controls.body: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure and modification of the following information at rest on [Assignment: organization-defined system components or media]: [Assignment: organization-defined information].

controls.name: SI-4(12) - System Monitoring | Automated Organization-generated Alerts
controls.title: System Monitoring | Automated Organization-generated Alerts
controls.body: Alert [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms] when the following indications of inappropriate or unusual activities with security or privacy implications occur: [Assignment: organization-defined activities that trigger alerts].

controls.name: CIS 7.3-PR - Operating System Patch Management
controls.title: Operating System Patch Management
controls.body:
Continuous Vulnerability Management
Safeguard 7.3: Perform automated operating system patch management.

controls.name: 6.9.4.1 - Event Logging
controls.title: Event Logging
controls.body: Event logs recording user activities, exceptions, faults and information security and privacy events shall be produced, kept and regularly reviewed.

controls.name: 8.15 - Logging
controls.title: Logging
controls.body: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analyzed.

controls.name: SI-4(14) - System Monitoring | Wireless Intrusion Detection
controls.title: System Monitoring | Wireless Intrusion Detection
controls.body: Employ a wireless intrusion detection system to identify rogue wireless devices and to detect attack attempts and potential compromises or breaches to the system.

controls.name: CIS 3.14-DE - Sensitive Data Access Logging
controls.title: Sensitive Data Access Logging
controls.body:
Data Protection
Safeguard 3.14: Log sensitive data access.

controls.name: APP 6.1 - Use or Disclosure of Personal Information (PI) for Secondary Purpose
controls.title: Use or Disclosure of Personal Information (PI) for Secondary Purpose
controls.body: The organization or agency has procedures in place for prohibiting the use or disclosure of personal information for a secondary purpose unless the individual consents, the use or disclosure is of government identifiers or for direct marketing, or another prescribed exception applies.

controls.name: C.5.2.1 - IoT Area Signage
controls.title: IoT Area Signage
controls.body: A) Areas where IoT devices are collecting personal data in public space shall be signalled to the public.

controls.name: CIS 11.2-RC - Automated Backups
controls.title: Automated Backups
controls.body:
Data Recovery
Safeguard 11.2: Perform automated backups.

controls.name: CIS 14.4-PR - Data Handling Practices Training
controls.title: Data Handling Practices Training
controls.body:
Security Awareness and Skills Training
Safeguard 14.4: Train workforce on data handling best practices.

controls.name: Clause 5.7.2 - Internal Audit
controls.title: Internal Audit

controls.name: CIS 14.2-PR - Social Engineering Awareness Training
controls.title: Social Engineering Awareness Training
controls.body:
Security Awareness and Skills Training
Safeguard 14.2: Train workforce members to recognize social engineering attacks.

controls.name: SC-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] system and communications protection policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the system and communications protection policy and the associated system and communications protection controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the system and communications protection policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current system and communications protection:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: SR-1 - Policy and Procedures
controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.body:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): Organization-level; Mission/business process-level; System-level] supply chain risk management policy that:
     (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
     (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the supply chain risk management policy and the associated supply chain risk management controls;

b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the supply chain risk management policy and procedures; and

c. Review and update the current supply chain risk management:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.name: CIS 13.7-PR - Host-Based Intrusion Prevention
controls.title: Host-Based Intrusion Prevention
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.7: Deploy a host-based intrusion prevention solution on enterprise assets.

controls.name: CCPA 2.10 - Notice of Financial Incentive
controls.title: Notice of Financial Incentive
controls.body: Notice of financial incentives is provided to consumers before any collection, retention, sale or sharing of their personal information. Opt-in consent is obtained from consumers prior to enrolling them into financial incentive programs, along with a mechanism provided to modify or withdraw this consent.

controls.name: CCPA 2.11 - Automated Decision-Making
controls.title: Automated Decision-Making
controls.body: The organization identifies and addresses obligations to consumers where a decision is based solely on automated processing of their personal information.

controls.name: CCPA 2.3 - Right to Request Rectification
controls.title: Right to Request Rectification
controls.body: The organization shall implement policies, procedures and mechanisms to correct inaccurate personal information it holds about a consumer when it receives a verifiable consumer request. All verifiable consumer requests for rectification of personal information should be acted upon no later than 45 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: CCPA 2.9 - Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.body: The organization has established processes to prohibit discrimination against consumers who exercised their rights under the CCPA.

controls.name: CCPA 3.1 - Personal Information Collection for Research
controls.title: Personal Information Collection for Research
controls.body: The organization has procedures in place relating to the collection of personal information for research purposes. Documentation related to applicable conditions for research-related collection is retained by the organization.

controls.name: CCPA 4.1 - Notification of Deletion to Third-Parties, Service Providers and Contractors
controls.title: Notification of Deletion to Third-Parties, Service Providers and Contractors
controls.body: The organization shall notify all third parties, service providers or contractors with whom personal information has been shared to delete consumers' personal information upon receiving a verifiable consumer request.

controls.name: CCPA 6.2 - Security Procedures and Practices
controls.title: Security Procedures and Practices
controls.body: Reasonable security procedures and practices have been implemented by the organization for the security and protection of consumers' personal information. These measures are assessed by management on an annual basis, and deficiencies identified are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: CIS 13.2-DE - Host-Based Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.title: Host-Based Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.body:
Network Monitoring and Defense
Safeguard 13.2: Deploy a host-based intrusion detection solution.

controls.name: CIS 8.12-DE - Service Provider Logs
controls.title: Service Provider Logs
controls.body:
Audit Log Management
Safeguard 8.12: Collect service provider logs.

controls.name: CIS 7.6-ID - Externally-Exposed Asset Vulnerability Scans
controls.title: Externally-Exposed Asset Vulnerability Scans
controls.body:
Continuous Vulnerability Management
Safeguard 7.6: Perform automated vulnerability scans of externally-exposed enterprise assets.

controls.name: 5.11 - Return of Assets
controls.title: Return of Assets
controls.body: Personnel and other interested parties, as appropriate, shall return all the organization’s assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

controls.name: APP 3.2 - Collection of Sensitive Information
controls.title: Collection of Sensitive Information
controls.body: The organization or agency must obtain and record consent from individuals for the collection of their sensitive information unless other prescribed exceptions apply.

controls.name: ITGC - Access Authorization
controls.title: Access Authorization
controls.body: Access to the application(s) and supporting infrastructure requires a documented access request and approval from management prior to access provisioning.

controls.name: 6.15.1.4 - Privacy and Protection of Personally Identifiable Information
controls.title: Privacy and Protection of Personally Identifiable Information
controls.body: Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information shall be ensured as required in relevant legislation and regulation where applicable.

controls.name: 5.34 - Privacy and Protection of PII
controls.title: Privacy and Protection of PII
controls.body: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws and regulations and contractual requirements.

controls.name: APP 3.3 - Lawfulness of Collection
controls.title: Lawfulness of Collection
controls.body: The organization or agency has procedures in place for collecting personal information by lawful and fair means and directly from the individual unless impracticable or other prescribed exceptions apply.

controls.name: 6.6.1.2 - Access to Networks and Network Services
controls.title: Access to Networks and Network Services
controls.body: Users shall only be provided with access to the network and network services that they have been specifically authorized to use.

controls.name: 6.6.2.1 - User Registration and De-Registration
controls.title: User Registration and De-Registration
controls.body: A formal user registration and de-registration process shall be implemented to enable the assignment of access rights.

controls.name: 6.6.2.2 - User Access Provisioning
controls.title: User Access Provisioning
controls.body: A formal user access provisioning process shall be implemented to assign or revoke access rights for all user types to all systems and services.

controls.name: 5.15 - Access Control
controls.title: Access Control
controls.body: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.

controls.name: 6.12.2.2 - Managing Changes to Supplier Services
controls.title: Managing Changes to Supplier Services
controls.body: Changes to the provision of services by suppliers, including maintaining and improving existing information security and privacy policies, procedures and controls, shall be managed, taking account of the criticality of business information, systems and processes involved and re-assessment of risks.

controls.name: 6.11.2.4 - Restrictions on Changes to Software Packages
controls.title: Restrictions on Changes to Software Packages
controls.body: Modifications to software packages shall be discouraged, limited to necessary changes and all changes shall be strictly controlled.

controls.name: 6.15.2.3 - Technical Compliance Review
controls.title: Technical Compliance Review
controls.body: Information systems shall be regularly reviewed for compliance with the organization’s information security and privacy policies and standards.

controls.name: ITGC - Access Revocation
controls.title: Access Revocation
controls.body: Access to the application(s) and supporting infrastructure is revoked in a timely manner for terminated or transferred users.

controls.name: B.8.2.1 - Customer Agreement
controls.title: Customer Agreement
controls.body: The organization shall ensure, where relevant, that the contract to process PII addresses the organization’s role in providing assistance with the customer’s obligations (taking into account the nature of processing and the information available to the organization).

controls.name: B.8.5.6 - Disclosure of Subcontractors Used to Process PII
controls.title: Disclosure of Subcontractors Used to Process PII
controls.body: The organization shall disclose any use of subcontractors to process PII to the customer before use.

controls.name: B.8.5.7 - Engagement of a Subcontractor to Process PII
controls.title: Engagement of a Subcontractor to Process PII
controls.body: The organization shall only engage a subcontractor to process PII according to the customer contract.

controls.name: 6.12.1.1 - Information Security and Privacy Policy for Supplier Relationships
controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Policy for Supplier Relationships
controls.body: Information security and privacy requirements for mitigating the risks associated with supplier’s access to the organization’s assets shall be agreed upon with the supplier and documented.

controls.name: RM3 - Cyber Security Insurance
controls.title: Cyber Security Insurance
controls.body: Management maintains insurance coverage through an external service provider against cyber risks for the business.

controls.name: T.1.3.5 - Firewalling with Least Privilege Port Policy
controls.title: Firewalling with Least Privilege Port Policy
controls.body:
A) A firewall shall be in place and configured to protect remotely accessible servers that store personal data.
AND
B) The firewall configuration shall block all ports that are not needed.

controls.name: Clause 5.8.1 - Nonconformity and Corrective Action
controls.title: Nonconformity and Corrective Action
controls.body:
When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall:
a) react to the nonconformity, and as applicable:
1) take action to control and correct it; and
2) deal with the consequences;

b) evaluate the need for action to eliminate the causes of nonconformity, in order that it does not recur or occur elsewhere, by:
1) reviewing the nonconformity;
2) determining the causes of the nonconformity; and
3) determining if similar nonconformities exist or could potentially occur;

c) implement any action needed;
d) review the effectiveness of any corrective action taken; and
e) make changes to the information security and privacy management systems, if necessary.

Corrective actions shall be appropriate to the effects of the nonconformities encountered.
The organization shall retain documented information as evidence of:
f) the nature of the nonconformities and any subsequent actions taken, and
g) the results of any corrective action.

controls.name: 5.24 - Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation (27017)
controls.title: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation (27017)
controls.body: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: 5.33 - Protection of Records (27017)
controls.title: Protection of Records (27017)
controls.body: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release.

controls.name: T.1.1.7 - Multi-factor Authentication
controls.title: Multi-factor Authentication
controls.body: A) Access to stored data by the employees and agents of the Applicant shall require multi-factor authentication.

controls.name: G.9.2.2 - DPO Support
controls.title: DPO Support
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have allocated resources to support continuous training and capacity building of the DPO.

controls.name: G.9.2.5 - DPO Contractual Clauses
controls.title: DPO Contractual Clauses

controls.name: CLD.13.1.4 - Alignment of Security Management for Virtual and Physical Networks
controls.title: Alignment of Security Management for Virtual and Physical Networks
controls.body: Upon configuration of virtual networks, consistency of configurations between virtual and physical networks shall be verified based on the cloud service provider's network security policy.

controls.name: T.2.3.2 - Intrusion Detection
controls.title: Intrusion Detection
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have rules, procedures or mechanisms in place to detect and report intrusions.

controls.name: C.5.1.6 - IoT Access Authentication
controls.title: IoT Access Authentication
controls.body: A) IoT nodes shall use passwords or other authentication mechanism.

controls.name: C.14.1.2 - Vehicle Usage Data Communication
controls.title: Vehicle Usage Data Communication
controls.body:
IF usage data are communicated or remotely collected from the vehicle THEN:
A) There shall be a mechanism or a procedure in place to ensure that prior informed consent of the owner of the vehicle is collected before the transmission of such usage data.

controls.name: CE.022 - Least Privilege
controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.body: Assign the least privileges to user accounts that are required to perform their current job.

controls.name: CE.023 - Restriction On Admin Accounts Usage
controls.title: Restriction On Admin Accounts Usage
controls.body: Prevent users from using admin accounts to perform non-admin tasks.

controls.name: C.7.1.3 - Multi-factor Authentication
controls.title: Multi-factor Authentication
controls.body: A) Human access to the biometric, medical and health related data shall require a multi-factor authentication mechanism.

controls.name: C.9.1.4 - Complementary Check and Clarification of Responsibilities
controls.title: Complementary Check and Clarification of Responsibilities

controls.name: CE.008 - Quality Of Passwords
controls.title: Quality Of Passwords
controls.body: Enforce usage of strong and complex passwords for information systems.

controls.name: VCDPA 3.2 - Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.title: Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.body: Organizations assess the need for and implement, where appropriate, a privacy impact assessment whenever new processing of personal information or changes to existing processing is planned.

controls.name: GOVERN 1 - AI Risk Management Policies and Processes in Place and Implemented Effectively
controls.title: AI Risk Management Policies and Processes in Place and Implemented Effectively
controls.body: Policies, processes, procedures, and practices across the organization related to the mapping, measuring, and managing of AI risks are in place, transparent, and implemented effectively

controls.name: GOVERN 1.7 - AI Decommissioning and Phasing Out Processes and Procedures
controls.title: AI Decommissioning and Phasing Out Processes and Procedures
controls.body: Processes and procedures are in place for decommissioning and phasing out AI systems safely and in a manner that does not increase risks or decrease the organization’s trustworthiness.

controls.name: MEASURE 2 - Evaluation of AI for Trustworthiness
controls.title: Evaluation of AI for Trustworthiness
controls.body: AI systems are evaluated for trustworthy characteristics.

controls.name: MEASURE 3.3 - Establishing Feedback Processes for End Users and Impacted Communities in AI Systems
controls.title: Establishing Feedback Processes for End Users and Impacted Communities in AI Systems
controls.body: Feedback processes for end users and impacted communities to report problems and appeal system outcomes are established and integrated into AI system evaluation metrics.

controls.name: MEASURE 3 - AI Risk Tracking Mechanisms in Place
controls.title: AI Risk Tracking Mechanisms in Place
controls.body: Mechanisms for tracking identified AI risks over time are in place.

controls.name: MEASURE 4 - Efficacy of Measurement Feedback Assessment
controls.title: Efficacy of Measurement Feedback Assessment
controls.body: Feedback about efficacy of measurement is gathered and assessed.

controls.name: C.8.1.1 - Test and Analysis
controls.title: Test and Analysis
controls.body: A) The algorithm used for the automated decision-making shall have been analysed and tested in order to ensure that it is not producing discriminatory, erroneous or unjustified results.

controls.name: CIP-011.R2-2.1 - Protection of BES Cyber System Information in Reused Cyber Assets
controls.title: Protection of BES Cyber System Information in Reused Cyber Assets
controls.body: Prior to the release for reuse of applicable cyber assets that contain BES cyber system information (except for reuse within other systems identified in the “Applicable Systems” section of the Implementation Guidance), the responsible entity shall take action to prevent the unauthorized retrieval of BES cyber system information from the cyber asset data storage media.

controls.name: MANAGE 2.1 - Managing AI Risks with Resources and Non-AI Alternatives
controls.title: Managing AI Risks with Resources and Non-AI Alternatives
controls.body: Resources required to manage AI risks are taken into account – along with viable non-AI alternative systems, approaches, or methods – to reduce the magnitude or likelihood of potential impacts.

controls.name: CIP-011-3.R1-1.2 - Protection of BCSI
controls.title: Protection of BCSI
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement one or more information protection program(s) that includes method(s) to protect and securely handle BES cyber system information (BCSI) to mitigate risks of compromising confidentiality.

controls.name: MANAGE 2.3 - Responding to Previously Unknown Risks
controls.title: Responding to Previously Unknown Risks
controls.body: Procedures are followed to respond to and recover from a previously unknown risk when it is identified.

controls.name: MANAGE 3 - Managing Third-Party AI Risks and Benefits
controls.title: Managing Third-Party AI Risks and Benefits
controls.body: AI risks and benefits from third-party entities are managed.

controls.name: MANAGE 3.1 - Monitoring AI Risks and Benefits from Third-Party Resources
controls.title: Monitoring AI Risks and Benefits from Third-Party Resources
controls.body: AI risks and benefits from third-party resources are regularly monitored, and risk controls are applied and documented.

controls.name: GOVERN 1.6 - Inventory and Resource Allocation of AI Systems
controls.title: Inventory and Resource Allocation of AI Systems
controls.body: Mechanisms are in place to inventory AI systems and are resourced according to organizational risk priorities.

controls.name: GOVERN 2 - Empowered Teams for Managing AI Risks
controls.title: Empowered Teams for Managing AI Risks
controls.body: Accountability structures are in place so that the appropriate teams and individuals are empowered, responsible, and trained for mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks.

controls.name: GOVERN 2.1 - Clear Documentation of AI Risk Management Roles and Communication Lines
controls.title: Clear Documentation of AI Risk Management Roles and Communication Lines
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities and lines of communication related to mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks are documented and are clear to individuals and teams throughout the organization.

controls.name: GOVERN 2.3 - Executive Leadership Takes Responsibility for AI Risks
controls.title: Executive Leadership Takes Responsibility for AI Risks
controls.body: Executive leadership of the organization takes responsibility for decisions about risks associated with AI system development and deployment.

controls.name: GOVERN 3 - Prioritizing DEIA Processes in AI Risk Management
controls.title: Prioritizing DEIA Processes in AI Risk Management
controls.body: Workforce diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility processes are prioritized in the mapping, measuring, and managing of AI risks throughout the lifecycle.

controls.name: GOVERN 3.2 - Policies and Procedures for Human-AI Roles and Oversight
controls.title: Policies and Procedures for Human-AI Roles and Oversight
controls.body: Policies and procedures are in place to define and differentiate roles and responsibilities for human-AI configurations and oversight of AI systems.

controls.name: GOVERN 5 - Robust Engagement with Relevant AI Actors In-Place
controls.title: Robust Engagement with Relevant AI Actors In-Place
controls.body: Processes are in place for robust engagement with relevant AI actors.

controls.name: MANAGE 3.2 - Monitoring Pre-Trained Models in AI System Maintenance
controls.title: Monitoring Pre-Trained Models in AI System Maintenance
controls.body: Pre-trained models which are used for development are monitored as part of AI system regular monitoring and maintenance.

controls.name: MANAGE 4 - Risk, Response, Recovery, and Communication Plans for AI Risks
controls.title: Risk, Response, Recovery, and Communication Plans for AI Risks
controls.body: Risk treatments, including response and recovery, and communication plans for the identified and measured AI risks are documented and monitored regularly.

controls.name: MANAGE 4.1 - Post-Deployment AI System Monitoring with User Input and Incident Response
controls.title: Post-Deployment AI System Monitoring with User Input and Incident Response
controls.body: Post-deployment AI system monitoring plans are implemented, including mechanisms for capturing and evaluating input from users and other relevant AI actors, appeal and override, decommissioning, incident response, recovery, and change management.

controls.name: PCI 9.4.1.1 - Offline Media Backups
controls.title: Offline Media Backups
controls.body: Offline media backups with cardholder data are stored in a secure location.

controls.name: MANAGE 4.2 - Measurable activities for AI continual improvement with stakeholder engagement
controls.title: Measurable activities for AI continual improvement with stakeholder engagement
controls.body: Measurable activities for continual improvements are integrated into AI system updates and include regular engagement with interested parties, including relevant AI actors.

controls.name: MANAGE 4.3 - AI Incident Management and Recovery
controls.title: AI Incident Management and Recovery
controls.body: Incidents and errors are communicated to relevant AI actors, including affected communities. Processes for tracking, responding to, and recovering from incidents and errors are followed and documented.

controls.name: CIP-008.R2-2.3 - Incident Response Records
controls.title: Incident Response Records
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall retain records related to reportable cyber security incidents and cyber security incidents that attempted to compromise a system identified in the “applicable systems” column for this control as per the cyber security incident response plan(s) under CIP-008.R1-1.2 - Incident Management Plan.

controls.name: CIP-011-3.R2-2.1 - Protection of BCSI in Reused Cyber Assets
controls.title: Protection of BCSI in Reused Cyber Assets
controls.body: Prior to the release for reuse of applicable cyber assets that contain BES cyber system information (BCSI) (except for reuse within other systems identified in the “Applicable Systems” column), the responsible entity shall take action to prevent the unauthorized retrieval of BCSI from the cyber asset data storage media.

controls.name: CIP-012.R1 - Security Plan for Communications between Control Centers
controls.title: Security Plan for Communications between Control Centers
controls.body:
The responsible entity shall implement, except under CIP exceptional circumstances, one or more documented plan(s) to mitigate the risks posed by unauthorized disclosure and unauthorized modification of real-time assessment and real-time monitoring data while being transmitted between any applicable control centers. The responsible entity is not required to include oral communications in its plan. The plan shall include:

1.1. identification of security protection used to mitigate the risks posed by unauthorized disclosure and unauthorized modification of real-time assessment and real-time monitoring data while being transmitted between control centers;

1.2. identification of where the responsible entity applied security protection for transmitting real-time assessment and real-time monitoring data between control centers; and

1.3. if the control centers are owned or operated by different responsible entities, identification of the responsibilities of each responsible entity for applying security protection to the transmission of real-time assessment and real-time monitoring data between those control centers.

controls.name: GOVERN 1.2 - Trustworthy AI Integrated into Organizational Policies and Practices
controls.title: Trustworthy AI Integrated into Organizational Policies and Practices
controls.body: The characteristics of trustworthy AI are integrated into organizational policies, processes, procedures, and practices.

controls.name: GOVERN 1.5 - Organizational Roles and Responsibilities for Risk Management Review
controls.title: Organizational Roles and Responsibilities for Risk Management Review
controls.body: Ongoing monitoring and periodic review of the risk management process and its outcomes are planned and organizational roles and responsibilities clearly defined, including determining the frequency of periodic review.

controls.name: MAP 4.1 - Mapping AI Technology and Legal Risks: Approaches and Documentation
controls.title: Mapping AI Technology and Legal Risks: Approaches and Documentation
controls.body: Approaches for mapping AI technology and legal risks of its components – including the use of third-party data or software – are in place, followed, and documented, as are risks of infringement of a third party’s intellectual property or other rights.

controls.name: TISAX 1.6.1 - Processing of Information Security Events
controls.title: Processing of Information Security Events
controls.body: The organization has developed and implemented Incident Response Plan to ensure quick, effective, and orderly response to information security events/vulnerabilities.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.5 - Data in Pre-Production
controls.title: Data in Pre-Production
controls.body: Live PANs are not used in pre-production environments, except where those environments are included in the CDE and protected in accordance with all applicable PCI DSS requirements.

controls.name: PCI 9.3.2 - Identify and Authorize Visitors
controls.title: Identify and Authorize Visitors
controls.body:
Procedures are implemented for authorizing and managing visitor access to the CDE, including:
- Visitors are authorized before entering.
- Visitors are escorted at all times.
- Visitors are clearly identified and given a badge or other identification that expires.
- Visitor badges or other identification visibly distinguishes visitors from personnel.

controls.name: PCI A3.4.1 - User Accounts and Access Privilege Review
controls.title: User Accounts and Access Privilege Review
controls.body:
User accounts and access privileges to in-scope system components are reviewed at least once every six months to ensure user accounts and access privileges remain appropriate based on job function, and that all access is authorized.

PCI DSS Reference: Requirement 7

controls.name: CIP-010.R4-3.2 - Malicious Code Mitigation
controls.title: Malicious Code Mitigation
controls.body:
To achieve the objective of mitigating the threat of introducing malicious code to high impact or medium impact BES cyber systems and their associated protected cyber assets (PCAs), each responsible entity shall:
3.2.1. Use method(s) to detect malicious code on removable media using a cyber asset other than a BES cyber system or protected cyber assets; and
3.2.2. Mitigate the threat of detected malicious code on removable media prior to connecting the removable media to a high-impact or medium-impact BES cyber system or associated protected cyber assets.

controls.name: PCI 7.3.3 - Deny-all by Default
controls.title: Deny-all by Default
controls.body: The access control system(s) is set to “deny all” by default.

controls.name: PCI 12.10.4 - Incident Response Training
controls.title: Incident Response Training
controls.body: Personnel responsible for responding to suspected and confirmed security incidents are appropriately and periodically trained on their incident response responsibilities.

controls.name: T.2.1.7 - WiFi
controls.title: WiFi
controls.body:
IF the Target of Evaluation processes personal data through WiFi, THEN:
A) The WiFi access shall be configured to use:
    a.1) WPA2 or higher;
    a.2) (OR) WPA2-PSK or higher;
    a.3) (OR) a solution as secure as WPA2.
*AND*
B) The WiFi network accessible to visitors shall be separated from the WiFi used for internal purpose.

controls.name: PCI 10.6.1 - Time Synchronization
controls.title: Time Synchronization
controls.body: System clocks and time are synchronized using time-synchronization technology.

controls.name: PCI 12.5.2 - Annual Validation of PCI DSS Scope
controls.title: Annual Validation of PCI DSS Scope
controls.body:
PCI DSS scope is documented and confirmed by the entity at least once every 12 months and upon significant change to the in-scope environment. At a minimum, the scoping validation includes:
- Identifying all data flows for the various payment stages (for example, authorization, capture settlement, chargebacks, and refunds) and acceptance channels (for example, card-present, card-not-present, and e-commerce).
- Updating all data-flow diagrams per Requirement 1.2.4.
- Identifying all locations where account data is stored, processed, and transmitted, including but not limited to: 1) any locations outside of the currently defined CDE, 2) applications that process CHD, 3) transmissions between systems and networks, and 4) file backups.
- Identifying all system components in the CDE, connected to the CDE, or that could impact security of the CDE.
- Identifying all segmentation controls in use and the environment(s) from which the CDE is segmented, including justification for environments being out of scope.
- Identifying all connections from third-party entities with access to the CDE.
- Confirming that all identified data flows, account data, system components, segmentation controls, and connections from third parties with access to the CDE are included in scope.

controls.name: PCI 12.5.2.1 - Validation of PCI DSS Scope for Service Providers
controls.title: Validation of PCI DSS Scope for Service Providers
controls.body: Additional requirement for service providers only: PCI DSS scope is documented and confirmed by the entity at least once every six months and upon significant change to the in-scope environment. At a minimum, the scoping validation includes all the elements specified in Requirement 12.5.2.

controls.name: C.1.1.1 - HTTPS Enabled
controls.title: HTTPS Enabled
controls.body: A) HTTPS shall be enabled by default for accessing the web interface.

controls.name: 5.1 - Policies for Information Security (27017)
controls.title: Policies for Information Security (27017)
controls.body: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.

controls.name: A.5.1 - Secure Erasure of Temporary Files
controls.title: Secure Erasure of Temporary Files
controls.body: Temporary files and documents should be erased or destroyed within a specified, documented period.

controls.name: A.6.2 - Record of PII Disclosures
controls.title: Record of PII Disclosures
controls.body: Disclosures of PII to third parties should be recorded, including what PII has been disclosed, to whom and at what time.

controls.name: 5.2 - Information Security Roles and Responsibilities (27017)
controls.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities (27017)
controls.body: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization's needs.

controls.name: 5.5 - Contact with Authorities (27017)
controls.title: Contact with Authorities (27017)
controls.body: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

controls.name: 5.8 - Information Security in Project Management (27017)
controls.title: Information Security in Project Management (27017)
controls.body: Information security shall be integrated into project management.

controls.name: G.3.2.3 - Tolerated Exemption
controls.title: Tolerated Exemption
controls.body: In order to derogate to the criteria G.3.2.1 and G.3.2.2, the Applicant shall demonstrate that the data subject already has been informed.

controls.name: A.10.2 - Retention of Security Policies and Guidelines
controls.title: Retention of Security Policies and Guidelines
controls.body: Copies of security policies and operating procedures should be retained for a specified, documented period of replacement (including updating).

controls.name: A.11.5 - Use of Unencrypted Portable Storage Media
controls.title: Use of Unencrypted Portable Storage Media
controls.body: Portable physical media and portable devices that do not permit encryption should not be used except where it is unavoidable, and any use of such portable media and devices should be documented.

controls.name: A.10.3 - PII Return, Transfer and Disposal
controls.title: PII Return, Transfer and Disposal
controls.body: The public cloud PII processor should have a policy in respect of the return, transfer and/or disposal of PII and should make this policy available to the cloud service customer.

controls.name: A.11.2 - Restriction on the Creation of Hardcopy Material
controls.title: Restriction on the Creation of Hardcopy Material
controls.body: The creation of hardcopy material displaying PII should be restricted.

controls.name: A.11.3 - Control and Logging of Data Restoration
controls.title: Control and Logging of Data Restoration
controls.body: There should be a procedure for, and a log of, data restoration efforts.

controls.name: A.11.4 - Protecting Data During Media Transfer
controls.title: Protecting Data During Media Transfer
controls.body: PII on media leaving the organization's premises should be subject to an authorization procedure and should not be accessible to anyone other than authorized personnel (e.g., by encrypting the data concerned).

controls.name: 5.16 - Identity Management (27017)
controls.title: Identity Management (27017)
controls.body: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.

controls.name: 5.19 - Information Security in Supplier Relationships (27017)
controls.title: Information Security in Supplier Relationships (27017)
controls.body: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of suppliers’ products or services.

controls.name: 5.21 - Managing Information Security in the ICT Supply Chain (27017)
controls.title: Managing Information Security in the ICT Supply Chain (27017)
controls.body: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

controls.name: A.11.6 - Encryption of PII Transmitted over Public Networks
controls.title: Encryption of PII Transmitted over Public Networks
controls.body: PII that is transmitted over public data-transmission networks should be encrypted prior to transmission.

controls.name: PCI 3.7.8 - Cryptographic Key Custodians
controls.title: Cryptographic Key Custodians
controls.body: Key management policies and procedures are implemented to include that cryptographic key custodians formally acknowledge (in writing or electronically) that they understand and accept their key-custodian responsibilities.

controls.name: 5.28 - Collection of Evidence (27017)
controls.title: Collection of Evidence (27017)
controls.body: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.

controls.name: 5.32 - Intellectual Property Rights (27017)
controls.title: Intellectual Property Rights (27017)
controls.body: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

controls.name: A.11.9 - Records of Authorized Users
controls.title: Records of Authorized Users
controls.body: An up-to-date record of the users or profiles of users who have authorized access to the information system should be maintained.

controls.name: PCI 11.1.2 - Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 11 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.name: C.5.2.2 - IoT Transparent Information
controls.title: IoT Transparent Information
controls.body: A) Data subjects shall have easy access to specific information on deployed IoT devices collecting personal data in public space, including information to contact the DPO.

controls.name: PCI 12.8.4 - TPSP PCI DSS Compliance Status
controls.title: TPSP PCI DSS Compliance Status
controls.body: A program is implemented to monitor TPSPs’ PCI DSS compliance status at least once every 12 months.

controls.name: PCI 12.8.5 - PCI DSS Requirements Managed by TPSPs
controls.title: PCI DSS Requirements Managed by TPSPs
controls.body: Information is maintained about which PCI DSS requirements are managed by each TPSP, which are managed by the entity, and any that are shared between the TPSP and the entity.

controls.name: G.10.1.4 - Cross-border Transfer Based on Derogations for Specific Situations
controls.title: Cross-border Transfer Based on Derogations for Specific Situations

controls.name: 6.8 - Information Security Event Reporting (27017)
controls.title: Information Security Event Reporting (27017)
controls.body: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.

controls.name: 7.14 - Secure Disposal or Re-use of Equipment (27017)
controls.title: Secure Disposal or Re-use of Equipment (27017)
controls.body: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software have been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

controls.name: T.1.1.3 - Password Policy
controls.title: Password Policy
controls.body:
A) There shall be a password policy in place that specifies a minimum length, complexity requirements, and renewal frequency for the passwords.
*AND*
B) Where applicable, the password policy to access stored data shall be compliant with the national laws and regulations.

controls.name: CE.013 - Remove/Disable Unnecessary Software And Services
controls.title: Remove/Disable Unnecessary Software And Services
controls.body: Remove or disable unnecessary software (including applications, system utilities and network services) from all devices managed by the organization as well as any auto-run feature which allows file execution without user authorization.

controls.name: A.11.11 - Contract Measures
controls.title: Contract Measures
controls.body: Contracts between the cloud service customer and the public cloud PII processor should specify minimum technical and organizational measures to ensure that the contracted security arrangements are in place and that data is not processed for any purpose independent of the instructions of the controller. Such measures should not be subject to unilateral reduction by the public cloud PII processor.

controls.name: A.11.13 - Access to Data on Pre-used Storage Space
controls.title: Access to Data on Pre-used Storage Space
controls.body: The public cloud PII processor should ensure that whenever data storage space is assigned to a cloud service customer, any data previously residing on that storage space is not visible to that cloud service customer.

controls.name: 8.2 - Privileged Access Rights (27017)
controls.title: Privileged Access Rights (27017)
controls.body: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

controls.name: T.1.3.2 - Regular Server Updates
controls.title: Regular Server Updates
controls.body:
A) There shall be a procedure, configuration or a mechanism in place to ensure that the servers are patched on a regular basis and any time there is a critical security patch required. 
AND
B) The servers shall be effectively updated and patched as needed on a regular basis.

controls.name: A.12.2 - Intended Destination of PII
controls.title: Intended Destination of PII
controls.body: PII transmitted using a data-transmission network should be subject to appropriate controls designed to ensure that data reaches its intended destination.

controls.name: C.10.2.1 - Dissociation
controls.title: Dissociation
controls.body: A) The information required to link the data subjects with their pseudonymized data shall be protected and securely stored with distinct access rights than those for the pseudonymized datasets.

controls.name: 8.17 - Clock Synchronization (27017)
controls.title: Clock Synchronization (27017)
controls.body: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.

controls.name: CPA 5.1 - Security Procedures and Practices
controls.title: Security Procedures and Practices
controls.body: Reasonable security procedures and practices have been implemented by the organization for the security and protection of consumers' personal information. These measures are assessed by management on an annual basis, and deficiencies identified are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: C.10.1.1 - Algorithm Assessment
controls.title: Algorithm Assessment

controls.name: CIP-010.R4-1.2 - Transient Cyber Asset Authorization
controls.title: Transient Cyber Asset Authorization
controls.body:
For each individual or group of transient cyber asset(s) (TCA), each responsible entity shall authorize:
1.2.1. Users, either individually or by group or role;
1.2.2. Locations, either individually or by group; and
1.2.3. Uses, which shall be limited to what is necessary to perform business functions.

controls.name: 8.24 - Use of Cryptography (27017)
controls.title: Use of Cryptography (27017)
controls.body: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.

controls.name: TISAX 5.1.1 - Cryptographic Procedures
controls.title: Cryptographic Procedures
controls.body: The organization has determined and documented all cryptographic procedures employed and the type of cryptography required to protect information based on its classification in accordance with applicable laws.

controls.name: 5.2 - Information Security Roles and Responsibilities (27018)
controls.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities (27018)
controls.body: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization's needs.

controls.name: PCI 12.6.3.1 - Awareness Training of Threats to CDE
controls.title: Awareness Training of Threats to CDE
controls.body:
Security awareness training includes awareness of threats and vulnerabilities that could impact the security of the CDE, including but not limited to:
- Phishing and related attacks.
- Social engineering.

controls.name: CIP-011.R1-1.2 - Protection of BES Cyber System Information
controls.title: Protection of BES Cyber System Information
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement one or more information protection program(s) that includes procedure(s) for protecting and securely handling BES cyber system information, including storage, transit, and use.

controls.name: 5.17 - Authentication Information (27018)
controls.title: Authentication Information (27018)
controls.body: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on the appropriate handling of authentication information.

controls.name: CE.011 - Non-Console Admin Interface
controls.title: Non-Console Admin Interface
controls.body: Prevent access to the administrative interface (used to manage firewall configuration) from the Internet unless there is a clear and documented business need and the interface is protected.

controls.name: 5.26 - Response to Information Security Incidents (27018)
controls.title: Response to Information Security Incidents (27018)
controls.body: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

controls.name: CE.002 - Server Inventory
controls.title: Server Inventory
controls.body: Maintain an inventory of servers, virtual servers and virtual server hosts (hypervisor).

controls.name: C.12.2.1 - DPO Access and Validation
controls.title: DPO Access and Validation
controls.body:
A) The Applicant shall have written rules, policies, procedures or mechanisms in place to enable employees to easily contact the DPO for an question related to the processing of the personal data.
AND
B) The DPO or an expert with adequate legal expertise shall have assessed and validated the lawfulness, proportionality and adequacy of the employees' data processed in the Target of Evaluation.

controls.name: 5.27 - Learning from Information Security Incidents (27018)
controls.title: Learning from Information Security Incidents (27018)
controls.body: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve information security controls.

controls.name: CE.003 - Network Inventory
controls.title: Network Inventory
controls.body:
Maintain an inventory of the following:
- Networks that are in the scope of the assessment.
- Networking equipment (such as routers, firewalls, etc.) along with the make and model of each device.

controls.name: 5.28 - Collection of Evidence (27018)
controls.title: Collection of Evidence (27018)
controls.body: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.

controls.name: CE.004 - Cloud Services
controls.title: Cloud Services
controls.body: Maintain a list of all cloud services that are provided by a third party and used by your organization.

controls.name: 6.8 - Information Security Event Reporting (27018)
controls.title: Information Security Event Reporting (27018)
controls.body: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.

controls.name: CIP-008.R3-3.1 - Lessons Learnt from Incident Response
controls.title: Lessons Learnt from Incident Response
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall no later than 90 calendar days after completion of a cyber security Incident response plan(s) test or actual reportable cyber security incident response: 
3.1.1. Document any lessons learned or document the absence of any lessons learned; 
3.1.2. Update the cyber security incident response plan based on any documented lessons learned associated with the plan; and
3.1.3. Notify each person or group with a defined role in the cyber security incident response plan of the updates to the cyber security incident response plan based on any documented lessons learned.

controls.name: C.10.2.2 - Access Limitation
controls.title: Access Limitation
controls.body:
A) IF pseudo-identifiers are generated using encryption, THEN private keys shall be secured. 
AND
B) IF pseudo-identifiers are generated using hashing function, THEN complementary measures shall be taken such as salted-hash function or keyed-hash  function.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.2 - Change Analysis
controls.title: Change Analysis
controls.body: Upon completion of a significant change, all applicable PCI DSS requirements are confirmed to be in place on all new or changed systems and networks, and documentation is updated as applicable.

controls.name: 7.14 - Secure Disposal or Re-use of Equipment (27018)
controls.title: Secure Disposal or Re-use of Equipment (27018)
controls.body: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software have been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

controls.name: CE.015 - Device Locking
controls.title: Device Locking
controls.body: Prevent access to systems and data by initiating a device lock when the system starts up and/or after a period of inactivity. The device lock must be retained until the user establishes/reestablishes access using established identification and authentication procedures.

controls.name: CE.007 - Change Default Passwords
controls.title: Change Default Passwords
