Each transmission owner that identified a transmission station, transmission substation, or primary control center in CIP-014.R1 and verified according to CIP-014.R2, and each transmission operator notified by a transmission owner according to CIP-014.R3, shall develop and implement a documented physical security plan(s) that covers their respective transmission station(s), transmission substation(s), and primary control center(s). The physical security plan(s) shall be developed within 120 calendar days following the completion of CIP-014.R2 and executed according to the timeline specified in the physical security plan(s).

The physical security plan(s) shall include law enforcement contact and coordination information.

controls.name: VCDPA 2.9 - Automated Decision-Making
controls.title: Automated Decision-Making
controls.body: The organization identifies and addresses obligations to consumers where a decision is based solely on the automated processing of their personal information.

controls.name: T.1.1.2 - Access Rights Registry Updates
controls.title: Access Rights Registry Updates
controls.body: A) There shall be a procedure or a mechanism in place to systematically adapt the access rights in case an employee leaves the company or changes activity within the company.

controls.name: CIP-003.R1 - Cyber Security Policy Review and Approval
controls.title: Cyber Security Policy Review and Approval

controls.name: VCDPA 3.1 - Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.title: Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.body: The organization has established processes to limit the collection, use, retention, and sharing of a consumer's personal information to the minimum that is relevant, proportional and reasonably necessary for the identified purposes.

controls.name: G.5.2.1 - Process on Instruction Only
controls.title: Process on Instruction Only
controls.body:
IF the Applicant acts as Processor THEN:
A) The Applicant shall have rules, a procedure or a mechanism in place to:
      a.1) prevent data processing without instructions from the Controller;
      a.2) (AND) receive and record instructions from the Controller.
*AND*
B) The Applicant shall have record of:
    b.1) the processing instructions received from the Controller;
    b.2) (AND) the processing activities.
*AND*
C) The processing activities shall comply with the instructions received from the Controller.

controls.name: PCI 6.1.1 - Security Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Security Policies and Procedures
controls.body:
All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 6 are:
- Documented.
- Kept up to date.
- In use.
- Known to all affected parties.

controls.name: CIP-014.R5-5.3 - Physical Security Plan Timeline
controls.title: Physical Security Plan Timeline
controls.body:
Each transmission owner that identified a transmission station, transmission substation, or primary control center in CIP-014.R1 and verified according to CIP-014.R2, and each transmission operator notified by a transmission owner according to CIP-014.R3, shall develop and implement a documented physical security plan(s) that covers their respective transmission station(s), transmission substation(s), and primary control center(s).  The physical security plan(s) shall be developed within 120 calendar days following the completion of CIP-014.R2 and executed according to the timeline specified in the physical security plan(s).

The physical security plan(s) shall include a timeline for executing the physical security enhancements and modifications specified in the physical security plan.

controls.name: PCI 6.2.4 - Software Vulnerabilities Detection and Prevention
controls.title: Software Vulnerabilities Detection and Prevention
controls.body:
Software engineering techniques or other methods are defined and in use by software development personnel to prevent or mitigate common software attacks and related vulnerabilities in bespoke and custom software, including but not limited to the following:
- Injection attacks, including SQL, LDAP, XPath, or other commands, parameters, objects, faults, or injection-type flaws.
- Attacks on data and data structures, including attempts to manipulate buffers, pointers, input data, or shared data.
- Attacks on cryptography usage, including attempts to exploit weak, insecure, or inappropriate cryptographic implementations, algorithms, cipher suites, or modes of operation.
- Attacks on business logic, including attempts to abuse or bypass application features and functionalities through the manipulation of APIs, communication protocols and channels, client-side functionality, or other system/application functions and resources. This includes cross-site scripting (XSS) and cross-site request forgery (CSRF).
- Attacks on access control mechanisms, including attempts to bypass or abuse identification, authentication, or authorization mechanisms, or attempts to exploit weaknesses in the implementation of such mechanisms.
- Attacks via any “high-risk” vulnerabilities identified in the vulnerability identification process, as defined in Requirement 6.3.1.

controls.name: Clause 6.3 - Planning of Changes
controls.title: Planning of Changes
controls.body: When the organization identifies the need for changes to the information security management system, the changes shall be carried out in a planned manner.

controls.name: CIP-003.R3 - CIP Senior Manager
controls.title: CIP Senior Manager
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall identify a CIP senior manager by name and document any change within 30 calendar days of the change.

controls.name: G.3.1.8 - Machine-readability of Icons
controls.title: Machine-readability of Icons
controls.body:
IF the Applicant uses icons to inform data subjects on its data protection policy by electronic means THEN:
A) The Applicant shall demonstrate that its icons used to inform data subjects on its data protection policy are machine readable.

controls.name: PCI 6.3.2 - Bespoke and Custom Software Inventory
controls.title: Bespoke and Custom Software Inventory
controls.body: An inventory of bespoke and custom software, and third-party software components incorporated into bespoke and custom software is maintained to facilitate vulnerability and patch management.

controls.name: CIP-014.R5-5.4 - Physical Security Plan - Evolving Threats
controls.title: Physical Security Plan - Evolving Threats
controls.body:
Each transmission owner that identified a transmission station, transmission substation, or primary control center in CIP-014.R1 and verified according to CIP-014.R2, and each transmission operator notified by a transmission owner according to CIP-014.R3, shall develop and implement a documented physical security plan(s) that covers their respective transmission station(s), transmission substation(s), and primary control center(s).  The physical security plan(s) shall be developed within 120 calendar days following the completion of CIP-014.R2 and executed according to the timeline specified in the physical security plan(s).

The physical security plan(s) shall include provisions to evaluate evolving physical threats, and their corresponding security measures, to the transmission station(s), transmission substation(s), or primary control center(s).

controls.name: CIP-003.R4 - Delegation of Authority
controls.title: Delegation of Authority
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement a documented process to delegate authority unless no delegations are used. Where allowed by the CIP standards, the CIP senior manager may delegate authority for specific actions to a delegate or delegates. These delegations shall be documented, including the name or title of the delegate, the specific actions delegated, and the date of the delegation; approved by the CIP senior manager; and updated within 30 days of any change to the delegation. Delegation changes do not need to be reinstated with a change to the delegator.

controls.name: CIP-008.R1-1.1 - Incident Management Policy and Procedure
controls.title: Incident Management Policy and Procedure
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall document one or more cyber security incident response plan(s) that include processes to identify, classify, and respond to cyber security incidents.

controls.name: VCDPA 3.3 - De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.title: De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.body: The organization establishes reasonable measures to ensure that de-identified data cannot be associated with a natural individual, and will not be used to re-identify the data.

controls.name: G.3.2.2 - Further Processing
controls.title: Further Processing

controls.name: CIP-008.R1-1.2 - Incident Management Plan
controls.title: Incident Management Plan
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall document one or more cyber security incident response plan(s) for one or more processes:
1.2.1 That include criteria to evaluate and define attempts to compromise;
1.2.2 To determine if an identified cyber security incident is:
* a reportable cyber security incident; or
* an attempt to compromise, as determined by applying the criteria from part 1.2.1, one or more systems identified in the “applicable systems” column for this part; and

1.2.3 To provide notification per requirement CIP-008.R4.

controls.name: CIP-004.R1 - Documented Cyber Security Awareness Program
controls.title: Documented Cyber Security Awareness Program
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop a documented security awareness program for its personnel.

controls.name: CIP-008.R1-1.3 - Incident Response Groups
controls.title: Incident Response Groups
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall document one or more cyber security incident response plan(s) that include the roles and responsibilities of cyber security incident response groups or individuals.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.2 - Property Security
controls.title: Property Security
controls.body: The organization has implemented adequate measures to prevent unauthorized access to properties where vehicles, components or classified parts that require protection are manufactured, processed or stored.

controls.name: PCI 9.4.2 - Media Classification
controls.title: Media Classification
controls.body: All media with cardholder data is classified in accordance with the sensitivity of the data.

controls.name: CIP-008.R1-1.4 - Incident Response Plan
controls.title: Incident Response Plan
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall document one or more cyber security incident response plan(s) that include incident handling procedures for cyber security incidents.

controls.name: CIP-014.R6-6.4 - Procedures for Sensitive/Confidential Information Protection from Third Party Reviewer
controls.title: Procedures for Sensitive/Confidential Information Protection from Third Party Reviewer
controls.body: Each transmission owner and transmission operator shall implement procedures, such as the use of non-disclosure agreements, for protecting sensitive or confidential information made available to the unaffiliated third-party reviewer and to protect or exempt sensitive or confidential information developed pursuant to this Reliability Standard from public disclosure.

controls.name: CIP-004.R2 - Documented Cyber Security Training Program
controls.title: Documented Cyber Security Training Program
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop a documented security training program for its personnel. The cybersecurity training program must be appropriate to individual roles, functions, or responsibilities.

controls.name: CIP-008.R2-2.1 - Incident Response Testing
controls.title: Incident Response Testing
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall test each cyber security incident response plan(s) at least once every 15 calendar months:
* by responding to an actual reportable cyber security incident;
* with a paper drill or tabletop exercise of a reportable cyber security incident; or
* With an operational exercise of a reportable cyber security incident.

controls.name: PCI 9.4.3 - Media Transportation
controls.title: Media Transportation
controls.body:
Media with cardholder data sent outside the facility is secured as follows:
- Media sent outside the facility is logged.
- Media is sent by secured courier or another delivery method that can be accurately tracked.
- Offsite tracking logs include details about media location.

controls.name: T.1.1.4 - Physical Access Restriction
controls.title: Physical Access Restriction
controls.body: A) Access to the rooms where personal data are stored on servers shall be restricted and protected by effective access control mechanisms.

controls.name: T.1.1.5 - Bring Your Own Device Restriction Policy
controls.title: Bring Your Own Device Restriction Policy

controls.name: CE.021 - Remove/Disable Unnecessary User Accounts
controls.title: Remove/Disable Unnecessary User Accounts
controls.body: Remove or disable user accounts when no longer required.

controls.name: CIP-004.R3 - Personnel Risk Management Process
controls.title: Personnel Risk Management Process
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop a documented process to conduct background checks for all personnel before granting them authorized access to BES systems.

controls.name: PCI 9.4.6 - Disposal of Hardcopy Materials
controls.title: Disposal of Hardcopy Materials
controls.body:
Hard-copy materials with cardholder data are destroyed when no longer needed for business or legal reasons, as follows:
- Materials are cross-cut shredded, incinerated, or pulped so that cardholder data cannot be reconstructed.
- Materials are stored in secure storage containers prior to destruction.

controls.name: TISAX 1.4.1 - Information Security Risk Management
controls.title: Information Security Risk Management
controls.body: The organization establishes and maintains a procedure for identifying, assessing and addressing information security risks within the organization.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.3 - Access to Buildings and Secured Areas
controls.title: Access to Buildings and Secured Areas
controls.body: The outer skin of the buildings is protected and constructed to prevent removal or opening of the building envelope components and unauthorized access to the buildings where protected vehicles, components or classified parts are manufactured, processed or stored.

controls.name: T.1.3.3 - Denial of Service Mitigation
controls.title: Denial of Service Mitigation
controls.body:
IF the personal data are intended to be accessed online by the Data Subjects THEN:
A) Measures shall be in place to mitigate the risk of Denial of Service attacks.

controls.name: CIP-008.R4-4.1 - Cyber Security Incidents Initial Notifications and Reporting
controls.title: Cyber Security Incidents Initial Notifications and Reporting
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall notify the Electricity Information Sharing and Analysis Center (E-ISAC) and, if subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, the United States National Cybersecurity and Communications Integration Center (NCCIC), or their successors, of a reportable cyber security incident and a cyber security incident that was an attempt to compromise, as determined by applying the criteria from CIP-008.R1-1.2 - Incident Management Plan, part 1.2.1, a system identified in the “applicable systems” column, unless prohibited by law, in accordance with the following applicable requirement parts in CIP-008-6 – Notifications and Reporting for Cyber Security Incidents.

Initial notifications and updates shall include the following attributes, at a minimum, to the extent known:
4.1.1 The functional impact;
4.1.2 The attack vector used; and
4.1.3 The level of intrusion that was achieved or attempted.

controls.name: CIP-008.R4-4.2 - Cyber Security Incidents Notifications and Reporting
controls.title: Cyber Security Incidents Notifications and Reporting
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall notify the Electricity Information Sharing and Analysis Center (E-ISAC) and, if subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, the United States National Cybersecurity and Communications Integration Center (NCCIC), or their successors, of a reportable cyber security incident and a cyber security incident that was an attempt to compromise, as determined by applying the criteria from CIP-008.R1-1.2 - Incident Management Plan, part 1.2.1, a system identified in the “applicable systems” column, unless prohibited by law, in accordance with the following applicable requirement parts in CIP-008-6 – Notifications and Reporting for Cyber Security Incidents.

After the responsible entity’s determination made pursuant to documented process(es) in CIP-008.R1-1.2 - Incident Management Plan, Part 1.2, provide initial notification within the following timelines:
* One hour after the determination of a reportable cyber security incident.
* By the end of the next calendar day after the determination that a cyber security incident was an attempt to compromise a system identified in the “applicable systems” column for this part.

controls.name: CTDPA 3.3 - De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.title: De-Identification of Personal Information
controls.body: The organization establishes reasonable measures to ensure that de-identified data cannot be associated with a natural individual, and will not be used to re-identify the data.

controls.name: TISAX 8.5.1 - Presentation and Events with Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.title: Presentation and Events with Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.body: The organization has described and implemented customer-specific requirements for presentations and events involving vehicles, components or parts classified as requiring protection.

controls.name: CTDPA 2.5 - Notice of Targeted Advertising or Sale of Personal Information
controls.title: Notice of Targeted Advertising or Sale of Personal Information
controls.body: Explicit notice is provided to consumers prior to processing personal data for targeted advertising or the sale of their personal information. Consumers are provided with a mechanism to exercise the right to opt out of the targeted advertising or sale of their personal information, and any such requests are handled in a timely manner.

controls.name: TISAX 8.4.3 - Protective Measures on Public Roads
controls.title: Protective Measures on Public Roads
controls.body: The organization has implemented protective measures in line with customer-specific requirements for the operation of trial vehicles classified as requiring protection on public roads.

controls.name: CPA 2.8 - Automated Decision-Making
controls.title: Automated Decision-Making
controls.body: The organization identifies and addresses obligations to consumers where a decision is based solely on the automated processing of their personal information.

controls.name: CIP-010.R4-1.3 - Software Vulnerability Mitigation
controls.title: Software Vulnerability Mitigation

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.4 - Viewing Protection
controls.title: Viewing Protection
controls.body: The facility has security measures in place to prevent unauthorized viewing of vehicles, components or classified parts requiring protection.

controls.name: CIP-008.R4-4.3 - Cyber Security Incidents Updated Reporting
controls.title: Cyber Security Incidents Updated Reporting
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall notify the Electricity Information Sharing and Analysis Center (E-ISAC) and, if subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, the United States National Cybersecurity and Communications Integration Center (NCCIC), or their successors, of a Reportable Cyber Security Incident and a Cyber Security Incident that was an attempt to compromise, as determined by applying the criteria from CIP-008.R1-1.2 - Incident Management Plan, Part 1.2.1, a system identified in the “applicable systems” column, unless prohibited by law, in accordance with the following applicable requirement parts in CIP-008-6 – Notifications and Reporting for Cyber Security Incidents.

Provide updates, if any, within 7 calendar days of the determination of new or changed attribute information required in CIP-008.R4-4.1 - Cyber Security Incidents Notifications and Initial Reporting.

controls.name: CIP-004.R4 - Access Management Process
controls.title: Access Management Process
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop a documented process to authorize electronic and unescorted physical access to BES cyber system.

controls.name: CTDPA 2.6 - Right to Opt-out of Targeted Advertising, Profiling, or Sale of Personal Information
controls.title: Right to Opt-out of Targeted Advertising, Profiling, or Sale of Personal Information
controls.body: Requests from consumers to opt out of targeted advertising, profiling, or sale of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: PCI 4.1.2 - Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 4 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.name: CTDPA 2.9 - Automated Decision-Making
controls.title: Automated Decision-Making
controls.body: The organization identifies and addresses obligations to consumers where a decision is based solely on the automated processing of their personal information.

controls.name: CIP-004.R4-4.1 - Need-Based User Authorization
controls.title: Need-Based User Authorization
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall authorize users based on need, as determined by the responsible entity, except for CIP exceptional circumstances:
4.1.1. Electronic access;
4.1.2. Unescorted physical access into a physical security perimeter; and 
4.1.3. Access to designated storage locations, whether physical or electronic, for BES cyber system information.

controls.name: PCI 4.2.1.1 - Inventory of Keys and Certificates
controls.title: Inventory of Keys and Certificates
controls.body: An inventory of the entity’s trusted keys and certificates used to protect PAN during transmission is maintained.

controls.name: CIP-009.R1-1.2 - Recovery Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Recovery Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented recovery plan(s) that include the roles and responsibilities of responders.

controls.name: CPA 3.1 - Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.title: Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.body: The organization has established processes to limit the collection, use, retention, and sharing of a consumer's personal information to the minimum that is relevant, proportional and reasonably necessary for the identified purposes.

controls.name: PCI 5.1.1 - Security Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Security Policies and Procedures
controls.body:
All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 5 are:
- Documented.
- Kept up to date.
- In use.
- Known to all affected parties.

controls.name: PCI 5.2.1 - Anti-malware Deployment
controls.title: Anti-malware Deployment
controls.body: An anti-malware solution(s) is deployed on all system components, except for those system components identified in periodic evaluations per Requirement 5.2.3 that concludes the system components are not at risk from malware.

controls.name: CTDPA 2.7 - Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.body: The organization has established processes to prohibit discrimination against consumers who exercised their rights under the CTDPA.

controls.name: TISAX 8.4.2 - Protective Measures on Test/Trial Grounds
controls.title: Protective Measures on Test/Trial Grounds
controls.body: The organization has implemented protective measures in line with customer-specific requirements for maintaining an undisturbed and secured trial operation on test and trial grounds.

controls.name: CIP-009.R1-1.3 - Backup and Recovery Process
controls.title: Backup and Recovery Process
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented recovery plan(s) that include one or more processes for the backup and storage of information required to recover BES cyber system functionality.

controls.name: CTDPA 2.8 - Right to Data-Portability
controls.title: Right to Data-Portability
controls.body: Procedures and mechanisms are in place to provide consumers with a copy of their personal data in a portable and, to the extent technically feasible, readily usable format that allows the consumer to transmit the data to another controller.

controls.name: TISAX 8.5.2 - Film and Photo Shootings with Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.title: Film and Photo Shootings with Vehicles, Components and Parts
controls.body: The organization has described and implemented customer-specific requirements for film and photo shootings involving vehicles, components or parts classified as requiring protection.

controls.name: PCI 5.2.3.1 - Malware Risk Analysis
controls.title: Malware Risk Analysis
controls.body: The frequency of periodic evaluations of system components identified as not at risk for malware is defined in the entity’s targeted risk analysis, which is performed according to all elements specified in Requirement 12.3.1.

controls.name: CIP-004.R5 - Access Revocation Process
controls.title: Access Revocation Process
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall establish a documented process to revoke electronic and unescorted physical access to BES cyber system.

controls.name: TISAX 8.1.5 - Regulated Access Control
controls.title: Regulated Access Control
controls.body: The organization has implemented adequate measures to prevent unauthorized access to security areas where vehicles, components or classified parts that require protection are manufactured, processed or stored.

controls.name: T.2.1.4 - TLS
controls.title: TLS
controls.body: A) Unsecure TLS shall NOT be used.

controls.name: CIP-009.R1-1.5 - Procedures to Preserve Data
controls.title: Procedures to Preserve Data
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented recovery plan(s) that include one or more processes to preserve data, per cyber asset capability, for determining the cause of a cyber security incident that triggers activation of the recovery plan(s). Data preservation should not impede or restrict recovery.

controls.name: CTDPA 3.1 - Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.title: Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.body: The organization has established processes to limit the collection, use, retention, and sharing of a consumer's personal information to the minimum that is relevant, proportional and reasonably necessary for the identified purposes.

controls.name: PCI 5.3.5 - Access Control to Anti-malware Software
controls.title: Access Control to Anti-malware Software
controls.body: Anti-malware mechanisms cannot be disabled or altered by users, unless specifically documented, and authorized by management on a case-by-case basis for a limited time period.

controls.name: CIP-009.R2-2.1 - Testing of Recovery Plan
controls.title: Testing of Recovery Plan
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall test each of the recovery plans referenced in requirement R1 at least once every 15 calendar months:
* By recovering from an actual incident;
* With a paper drill or tabletop exercise; or
* With an operational exercise.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.3 - Payment Page Script Security
controls.title: Payment Page Script Security
controls.body:
All payment page scripts that are loaded and executed in the consumer’s browser are managed as follows:
- A method is implemented to confirm that each script is authorized.
- A method is implemented to assure the integrity of each script.
- An inventory of all scripts is maintained with written justification as to why each is necessary.

controls.name: TISAX 9.3 - Review of Data Protection Management System
controls.title: Review of Data Protection Management System
controls.body: Internal processes or workflows are reviewed on a regular basis to ensure they are carried out in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

controls.name: CIP-009.R2-2.2 - Testing of Recovery Information using Sample Information
controls.title: Testing of Recovery Information using Sample Information
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall test a representative sample of information used to recover BES cyber system functionality at least once every 15 calendar months to ensure that the information is useable and compatible with current configurations. An actual recovery that incorporates the information used to recover BES cyber system functionality substitutes for this test.

controls.name: TISAX 9.4 - Documentation of Data Privacy Procedures
controls.title: Documentation of Data Privacy Procedures
controls.body: The organization maintains documentation of policies and procedures associated with the processing of personally identifiable data in accordance with legal requirements. The policies and procedure documents are reviewed and approved by management regularly or during significant changes.

controls.name: PCI 8.3.10.1 - Service Provider Password Requirement
controls.title: Service Provider Password Requirement
controls.body:
Additional requirement for service providers only: If passwords/passphrases are used as the only authentication factor for customer user access (i.e., in any single-factor authentication implementation) then either:
- Passwords/passphrases are changed at least once every 90 days,
OR
- The security posture of accounts is dynamically analyzed, and real-time access to resources is automatically determined accordingly.

controls.name: CIP-009.R2-2.3 - Operational Testing of Recovery Plan
controls.title: Operational Testing of Recovery Plan
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall test each of the recovery plans referenced in CIP-009.R1 at least once every 36 calendar months through an operational exercise of the recovery plans in an environment representative of the production environment. An actual recovery response may substitute for an operational exercise.

controls.name: A.11.10 - User ID Management
controls.title: User ID Management
controls.body: De-activated or expired user IDs should not be granted to other individuals.

controls.name: TISAX 1.2.4 - External Service Provider Responsibilities
controls.title: External Service Provider Responsibilities
controls.body: Information security responsibilities of external IT service providers and IT services are clearly defined and documented.

controls.name: CIP-009.R3-3.1 - Lessons Learnt from Recovery Plan
controls.title: Lessons Learnt from Recovery Plan
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall no later than 90 calendar days after completion of a recovery plan test or actual recovery:
3.1.1. Document any lessons learned associated with a recovery plantest or actual recovery or document the absence of any lessons learned;
3.1.2. Update the recovery plan based on any documented lessons learned associated with the plan; and
3.1.3. Notify each person or group with a defined role in the recovery plan of the updates to the recovery plan based on any documented lessons learned.

controls.name: PCI 6.1.2 - Roles and Responsibilities
controls.title: Roles and Responsibilities
controls.body: Roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 6 are documented, assigned, and understood.

controls.name: TISAX 3.1.3 - Handling of Supporting Assets
controls.title: Handling of Supporting Assets
controls.body: Requirements for the handling (acceptable use & disposal) of supporting assets are identified, documented and implemented.

controls.name: CIP-009.R3-3.2 - Recovery Plan Review, Update and Communication
controls.title: Recovery Plan Review, Update and Communication
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall no later than 60 calendar days after a change to the roles or responsibilities, responders, or technology that the responsible entity determines would impact the ability to execute the recovery plan: 
3.2.1. Update the recovery plan; and 
3.2.2. Notify each person or group with a defined role in the recovery plan of the updates.

controls.name: CIP-010.R1 - Configuration Change Management Processes
controls.title: Configuration Change Management Processes
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall establish one or more documented process(es) for configuration change management.

controls.name: PCI 6.4.1 - Public-facing Web Applications Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Public-facing Web Applications Vulnerabilities
controls.body:
For public-facing web applications, new threats and vulnerabilities are addressed on an ongoing basis and these applications are protected against known attacks as follows:
- Reviewing public-facing web applications via manual or automated application vulnerability security assessment tools or methods as follows:
    * At least once every 12 months and after significant changes.
    * By an entity that specializes in application security.
    * Including, at a minimum, all common software attacks in Requirement 6.2.4.
    * All vulnerabilities are ranked in accordance with requirement 6.3.1.
    * All vulnerabilities are corrected.
    * The application is re-evaluated after the corrections

OR
- Installing an automated technical solution(s) that continually detects and prevents web-based attacks as follows:
    * Installed in front of public-facing web applications to detect and prevent web-based attacks.
    * Actively running and up to date as applicable.
    * Generating audit logs.
    * Configured to either block web-based attacks or generate an alert that is immediately investigated.

controls.name: CIP-010.R1-1.1 - Baseline Configuration
controls.title: Baseline Configuration

controls.name: PCI 3.6.1.4 - Storage of Cryptographic Keys
controls.title: Storage of Cryptographic Keys
controls.body: Cryptographic keys are stored in the fewest possible locations.

controls.name: TISAX 4.1.1 - Handling of Identification Means
controls.title: Handling of Identification Means
controls.body: The organization has established procedures for handling the means of identification such as keys, visual IDs or cryptographic tokens over their entire lifecycle.

controls.name: G.3.8.2 - Duty to inform Data Subjects on Recipients if Requested
controls.title: Duty to inform Data Subjects on Recipients if Requested
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have rules, a procedure, or a mechanism in place to effectively comply with the requests of data subjects to be informed on the recipients of their personal data.

controls.name: CIP-010.R1-1.3 - Baseline Configuration Update
controls.title: Baseline Configuration Update
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall ensure that, for a change that deviates from the existing baseline configuration, they update the baseline configuration as necessary within 30 calendar days of completing the change.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.6 - Removal of Test Data and Accounts Prior to Production
controls.title: Removal of Test Data and Accounts Prior to Production
controls.body: Test data and test accounts are removed from system components before the system goes into production.

controls.name: CIP-004-7.R6 - BCSI Access Management
controls.title: BCSI Access Management
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented access management program(s) to authorize, verify, and revoke provisioned access to BES Cyber Security Information (BCSI) pertaining to the “Applicable Systems”.

controls.name: CIP-007.R5-5.5 - Password Configuration
controls.title: Password Configuration
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall implement and enforce the following password parameters:
For password-only authentication for interactive user access, either technically or procedurally enforce the following password parameters:
5.5.1. Password length that is, at least, the lesser of eight characters or the maximum length supported by the cyber asset; and 
5.5.2. Minimum password complexity that is the lesser of three or more different types of characters (e.g., uppercase alphabetic, lowercase alphabetic, numeric, non-alphanumeric) or the maximum complexity supported by the cyber asset.

controls.name: CIP-005.R2-2.2 - Implement Encryption for Remote Access
controls.title: Implement Encryption for Remote Access
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall utilize encryption, for all interactive remote access, that terminates at an intermediate system.

controls.name: PCI 3.7.6 - Cleartext Cryptographic Key Management
controls.title: Cleartext Cryptographic Key Management
controls.body: Where manual cleartext cryptographic key-management operations are performed by personnel, key-management policies and procedures are implemented including managing these operations using split knowledge and dual control.

controls.name: CIP-005.R1 - Process for Network Security
controls.title: Process for Network Security
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall establish a documented process for the management of electronic access to BES cyber systems by specifying a controlled electronic security perimeter in support of protecting BES cyber systems.

controls.name: CIP-010.R1-1.6 - Software Integrity Verification
controls.title: Software Integrity Verification
controls.body:
Prior to a change that deviates from the existing baseline configuration associated with baseline items in CIP-010-4.R1-1.1 (1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.1.5), and when the method to do so is available to the responsible entity from the software source:
1.6.1 Verify the identity of the software source; and
1.6.2 Verify the integrity of the software obtained from the software source.

controls.name: CIP-007.R5-5.6 - Password Change
controls.title: Password Change
controls.body: Each responsible entity, where technically feasible, shall enforce password changes or an obligation to change the password at least once every 15 calendar months, for password-only authentication for interactive user access, either technically or procedurally.

controls.name: PCI 4.2.2 - PAN Cryptography
controls.title: PAN Cryptography
controls.body: PAN is secured with strong cryptography whenever it is sent via end-user messaging technologies.

controls.name: PCI 3.7.9 - Sharing Cryptographic Keys
controls.title: Sharing Cryptographic Keys
controls.body: Additional requirement for service providers only: Where a service provider shares cryptographic keys with its customers for transmission or storage of account data, guidance on secure transmission, storage and updating of such keys is documented and distributed to the service provider’s customers.

controls.name: 5.9 - Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets (27017)
controls.title: Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets (27017)
controls.body: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.

controls.name: CIP-005.R1-1.1 - Implement Electronic Perimeter for Cyber Assets
controls.title: Implement Electronic Perimeter for Cyber Assets
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall ensure all applicable cyber assets connected to a network via a routable protocol shall reside within a defined Electronic Security Perimeter (ESP).

controls.name: CIP-010.R2 - Configuration Monitoring Processes
controls.title: Configuration Monitoring Processes
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented process(es) for configuration monitoring.

controls.name: CIP-010.R4-1.4 - Introduction of Malicious Code Mitigation
controls.title: Introduction of Malicious Code Mitigation
controls.body:
Use one or a combination of the following methods to achieve the objective of mitigating the introduction of malicious code (per transient cyber asset (TCA) capability):
* Antivirus software, including manual or managed updates of signatures or patterns;
* Application whitelisting; or
* Other method(s) to mitigate the introduction of malicious code.

controls.name: PCI 4.2.1.2 - Wireless Cryptography and Authentication
controls.title: Wireless Cryptography and Authentication
controls.body: Wireless networks transmitting PAN or connected to the CDE use industry best practices to implement strong cryptography for authentication and transmission.

controls.name: CIP-005.R1-1.2 - Implement Electronic Access Points for External Routable Connectivity
controls.title: Implement Electronic Access Points for External Routable Connectivity
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall ensure all external routable connectivity must be through an identified Electronic Access Point (EAP).

controls.name: PCI 6.2.3.1 - Pre-Production Code Review
controls.title: Pre-Production Code Review
controls.body:
If manual code reviews are performed for bespoke and custom software prior to release to production, code changes are:
- Reviewed by individuals other than the originating code author, and who are knowledgeable about code-review techniques and secure coding practices.
- Reviewed and approved by management prior to release.

controls.name: CIP-010.R3 - Vulnerability Assessment Processes
controls.title: Vulnerability Assessment Processes
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented process(es) for vulnerability assessments.

controls.name: CIP-005.R1-1.4 - Authentication of Dial-up Connectivity
controls.title: Authentication of Dial-up Connectivity
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall perform, where technically feasible, authentication when establishing dialup connectivity with applicable cyber assets.

controls.name: CIP-005.R1-1.3 - Access Permission for All Inbound and Outbound Traffic
controls.title: Access Permission for All Inbound and Outbound Traffic
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall require inbound and outbound access permissions for inbound and outbound traffic, including the reason for granting such access, and deny all other access by default.

controls.name: 5.13 - Labelling of Information (27017)
controls.title: Labelling of Information (27017)
controls.body: An appropriate set of procedures for information labeling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.name: PCI 5.2.2 - Malware Detection
controls.title: Malware Detection
controls.body:
The deployed anti-malware solution(s):
- Detects all known types of malware.
- Removes, blocks, or contains all known types of malware.

controls.name: CIP-005.R1-1.5 - Detect Malicious Communication
controls.title: Detect Malicious Communication
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement one or more methods for detecting known or suspected malicious communications for both inbound and outbound communications.

controls.name: PCI 10.6.3 - Protection of Time Data
controls.title: Protection of Time Data
controls.body:
Time synchronization settings and data are protected as follows:
- Access to time data is restricted to only personnel with a business need.
- Any changes to time settings on critical systems are logged, monitored, and reviewed.

controls.name: PCI 8.3.9 - Change User Passwords
controls.title: Change User Passwords
controls.body:
If passwords/passphrases are used as the only authentication factor for user access (i.e., in any single-factor authentication implementation) then either:
- Passwords/passphrases are changed at least once every 90 days,
OR
- The security posture of accounts is dynamically analyzed, and real-time access to resources is automatically determined accordingly.

controls.name: PCI 6.2.2 - Software Development Personnel Training
controls.title: Software Development Personnel Training
controls.body:
Software development personnel working on bespoke and custom software are trained at least once every 12 months as follows:
- On software security relevant to their job function and development languages.
- Including secure software design and secure coding techniques.
- Including, if security testing tools are used, how to use the tools for detecting vulnerabilities in software.

controls.name: CIP-005.R2 - Remote Access Management
controls.title: Remote Access Management
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall establish a documented process for the management of remote access.

controls.name: PCI 5.2.3 - Periodic Malware Evaluation
controls.title: Periodic Malware Evaluation
controls.body:
Any system components that are not at risk for malware are evaluated periodically to include the following:
- A documented list of all system components not at risk for malware.
- Identification and evaluation of evolving malware threats for those system components.
- Confirmation whether such system components continue to not require anti-malware protection.

controls.name: CIP-010.R3-3.2 - Active Vulnerability Assessment
controls.title: Active Vulnerability Assessment
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall, where technically feasible, at least once every 36 calendar months:
3.2.1 Perform an active vulnerability assessment in a test environment, or perform an active vulnerability assessment in a production environment where the test is performed in a manner that minimizes adverse effects, that models the baseline configuration of the BES cyber system in a production environment; and
3.2.2 Document the results of the testing and, if a test environment was used, the differences between the test environment and the production environment, including a description of the measures used to account for any differences in operation between the test and production environments.

controls.name: C.5.3.1 - Authentication Reliability
controls.title: Authentication Reliability

controls.name: PCI 8.3.11 - Additional Authentication Mechanism
controls.title: Additional Authentication Mechanism
controls.body:
Where authentication factors such as physical or logical security tokens, smart cards, or certificates are used:
- Factors are assigned to an individual user and not shared among multiple users.
- Physical and/or logical controls ensure only the intended user can use that factor to gain access.

controls.name: CIP-005.R2-2.1 - Implement Intermediate Proxy System for Remote Access
controls.title: Implement Intermediate Proxy System for Remote Access
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall utilize an intermediate system, for all interactive remote access, such that the cyber asset initiating interactive remote access does not directly access an applicable cyber asset.

controls.name: PCI 5.3.2 - Malware Periodic Scans
controls.title: Malware Periodic Scans
controls.body:
The anti-malware solution(s):
- Performs periodic scans and active or real-time scans.
OR
- Performs continuous behavioral analysis of systems or processes.

controls.name: PCI 9.2.3 - Physical Access to Wireless Points
controls.title: Physical Access to Wireless Points
controls.body: Physical access to wireless access points, gateways, networking/communications hardware, and telecommunication lines within the facility is restricted.

controls.name: PCI 5.3.1 - Anti-malware Updates
controls.title: Anti-malware Updates
controls.body: The anti-malware solution(s) is kept current via automatic updates.

controls.name: PCI 5.3.3 - Removable Media Scan
controls.title: Removable Media Scan
controls.body:
For removable electronic media, the anti-malware solution(s):
- Performs automatic scans of when the media is inserted, connected, or logically mounted,
OR
- Performs continuous behavioral analysis of systems or processes when the media is inserted, connected, or logically mounted.

controls.name: PCI 5.3.4 - Anti-Malware Audit Logs
controls.title: Anti-Malware Audit Logs
controls.body: Audit logs for the anti-malware solution(s) are enabled and retained in accordance with Requirement 10.5.1.

controls.name: CIP-010.R4-1.1 - Transient Cyber Asset Management
controls.title: Transient Cyber Asset Management
controls.body:
Each responsible entity, for its high impact and medium impact BES cyber systems and associated protected cyber assets, shall implement, except under CIP exceptional circumstances, one or more documented plan(s) for transient cyber assets and removable media that includes transient cyber asset management and all sections in CIP-010-4.R4.

Responsible entities shall manage transient cyber asset(s), individually or by group: (1) in an ongoing manner to ensure compliance with applicable requirements at all times, (2) in an on-demand manner applying the applicable requirements before connection to a BES cyber system, or (3) a combination of both (1) and (2) above.

controls.name: PCI 5.4.1 - Phishing Attack
controls.title: Phishing Attack
controls.body: Processes and automated mechanisms are in place to detect and protect personnel against phishing attacks.

controls.name: PCI 8.6.1 - Interactive Login System Accounts
controls.title: Interactive Login System Accounts
controls.body:
If accounts used by systems or applications can be used for interactive login, they are managed as follows:
- Interactive use is prevented unless needed for an exceptional circumstance.
- Interactive use is limited to the time needed for the exceptional circumstance.
- Business justification for interactive use is documented.
- Interactive use is explicitly approved by management.
- Individual user identity is confirmed before access to account is granted.
- Every action taken is attributable to an individual user.

controls.name: C.6.1.1 - Involvement of Data Subjects in the DPIA
controls.title: Involvement of Data Subjects in the DPIA
controls.body: The Applicant shall have involved and consulted the data subjects in the DPIA process.

controls.name: PCI 9.2.1 - Facility Entry Controls
controls.title: Facility Entry Controls
controls.body: Appropriate facility entry controls are in place to restrict physical access to systems in the CDE.

controls.name: CIP-005.R3 - Vendor Remote Access Management
controls.title: Vendor Remote Access Management
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall establish a documented process for monitoring and control of vendor initiated remote access

controls.name: PCI 9.2.1.1 - Monitoring Physical Access
controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access
controls.body:
Individual physical access to sensitive areas within the CDE is monitored with either video cameras or physical access control mechanisms (or both) as follows:
- Entry and exit points to/from sensitive areas within the CDE are monitored.
- Monitoring devices or mechanisms are protected from tampering or disabling.
- Collected data is reviewed and correlated with other entries.
- Collected data is stored for at least three months, unless otherwise restricted by law.

controls.name: TISAX 5.3.2 - Network Services
controls.title: Network Services
controls.body: The organization identifies and includes in the network service agreement security mechanisms, service levels, and management requirements for all network services.

controls.name: PCI 9.3.3 - Visitor Badges
controls.title: Visitor Badges
controls.body: Visitor badges or identification are surrendered or deactivated before visitors leave the facility or at the date of expiration.

controls.name: PCI 6.3.3 - Protection against Vulnerabilities
controls.title: Protection against Vulnerabilities
controls.body:
All system components are protected from known vulnerabilities by installing applicable security patches/updates as follows:
- Critical or high-security patches/updates (identified according to the risk ranking process at Requirement 6.3.1) are installed within one month of release.
- All other applicable security patches/updates are installed within an appropriate time frame as determined by the entity (for example, within three months of release).

controls.name: CIP-005.R3-3.1 - Determine Authenticated Vendor-Initiated Remote  Connections
controls.title: Determine Authenticated Vendor-Initiated Remote  Connections
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement one or more method(s) to determine authenticated vendor-initiated remote connections.

controls.name: PCI 9.2.2 - Restriction of Physical Access
controls.title: Restriction of Physical Access
controls.body: Physical and/or logical controls are implemented to restrict use of publicly accessible network jacks within the facility.

controls.name: PCI 9.2.4 - Access to Consoles
controls.title: Access to Consoles
controls.body: Access to consoles in sensitive areas is restricted via locking when not in use.

controls.name: PCI 8.6.3 - Protection of Passwords
controls.title: Protection of Passwords
controls.body:
Passwords/passphrases for any application and system accounts are protected against misuse as follows:
- Passwords/passphrases are changed periodically (at the frequency defined in the entity’s targeted risk analysis, which is performed according to all elements specified in Requirement 12.3.1) and upon suspicion or confirmation of compromise.
- Passwords/passphrases are constructed with sufficient complexity appropriate for how frequently the entity changes the passwords/passphrases.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.1.5 - Logs for Changes to Identification and Authentication Mechanisms
controls.title: Logs for Changes to Identification and Authentication Mechanisms
controls.body:
Audit logs capture all changes to identification and authentication credentials including, but not limited to:
- Creation of new accounts.
- Elevation of privileges.
- All changes, additions, or deletions to accounts with administrative access.

controls.name: C.6.1.2 - Information of Data Subjects
controls.title: Information of Data Subjects
controls.body: The Applicant shall have communicated the purpose and plans related to the the smart city data processing to local data subjects.

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.1 - Documented Physical Security Plan
controls.title: Documented Physical Security Plan
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall define and implement operational or procedural controls to restrict physical access.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.1.7 - Logs of Created or Deleted System-level Objects
controls.title: Logs of Created or Deleted System-level Objects
controls.body: Audit logs capture all creation and deletion of system-level objects.

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.2 - Unescorted Physical Access
controls.title: Unescorted Physical Access
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall utilize at least one physical access control to allow unescorted physical access into each applicable physical security perimeter to only those individuals who have authorized unescorted physical access.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.3 - Separation of Production and Pre-Production Environments
controls.title: Separation of Production and Pre-Production Environments
controls.body: Pre-production environments are separated from production environments and the separation is enforced with access controls.

controls.name: TISAX 1.2.3 - Information Security in Project Management
controls.title: Information Security in Project Management
controls.body: An information security process is established and addressed in project management procedures, regardless of the type of project.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.4 - Segregation of Duties
controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.body: Roles and functions are separated between production and pre-production environments to provide accountability such that only reviewed and approved changes are deployed.

controls.name: PCI 10.3.2 - Protection of Audit Logs
controls.title: Protection of Audit Logs
controls.body: Audit log files are protected to prevent modifications by individuals.

controls.name: PCI 11.2.2 - Inventory of Wireless Access Points
controls.title: Inventory of Wireless Access Points
controls.body: An inventory of authorized wireless access points is maintained, including a documented business justification.

controls.name: PCI 7.2.1 - Access Control Model
controls.title: Access Control Model
controls.body:
An access control model is defined and includes granting access as follows:
- Appropriate access depending on the entity’s business and access needs.
- Access to system components and data resources that is based on users’ job classification and functions.
- The least privileges required (for example, user, administrator) to perform a job function.

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.3 - Collective Unescorted Physical Access
controls.title: Collective Unescorted Physical Access
controls.body: Each responsible entity where technically feasible shall utilize two or more different physical access controls (this does not require two completely independent physical access control systems) to collectively allow unescorted physical access into physical security perimeters to only those individuals who have authorized unescorted physical access.

controls.name: CIP-011.R1 - Information Protection Program
controls.title: Information Protection Program
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented information protection program(s) that includes method(s) for identification and procedures for the protection of BES cyber system information.

controls.name: PCI 7.2.5 - Assigning Application and System Accounts
controls.title: Assigning Application and System Accounts
controls.body:
All application and system accounts and related access privileges are assigned and managed as follows:
- Based on the least privileges necessary for the operability of the system or application.
- Access is limited to the systems, applications, or processes that specifically require their use.

controls.name: PCI 10.3.3 - Backup of Audit Logs
controls.title: Backup of Audit Logs
controls.body: Audit log files, including those for external- facing technologies, are promptly backed up to a secure, central, internal log server(s) or other media that is difficult to modify.

controls.name: PCI 7.2.6 - Access Restriction to Queries
controls.title: Access Restriction to Queries
controls.body:
All user access to query repositories of stored cardholder data is restricted as follows:
- Via applications or other programmatic methods, with access and allowed actions based on user roles and least privileges.
- Only the responsible administrator(s) can directly access or query repositories of stored CHD.

controls.name: PCI 9.4.5.1 - Inventories of Electronic Media
controls.title: Inventories of Electronic Media
controls.body: Inventories of electronic media with cardholder data are conducted at least once every 12 months.

controls.name: PCI 11.3.1.3 - Internal Vulnerability Scans After a Significant Change
controls.title: Internal Vulnerability Scans After a Significant Change
controls.body:
Internal vulnerability scans are performed after any significant change as follows:
-High-risk and critical vulnerabilities (per the entity’s vulnerability risk rankings defined at Requirement 6.3.1) are resolved.
- Rescans are conducted as needed.
- Scans are performed by qualified personnel and organizational independence of the tester exists (not required to be a QSA or ASV).

controls.name: PCI 7.2.5.1 - Review Application and System Accounts
controls.title: Review Application and System Accounts
controls.body:
All access by application and system accounts and related access privileges are reviewed as follows:
- Periodically (at the frequency defined in the entity’s targeted risk analysis, which is performed according to all elements specified in Requirement 12.3.1).
- The application/system access remains appropriate for the function being performed.
- Any inappropriate access is addressed.
- Management acknowledges that access remains appropriate.

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.4 - Monitoring Physical Access to Security Perimeter
controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access to Security Perimeter
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall monitor for unauthorized access through a physical access point into a physical security perimeter.

controls.name: PCI 8.2.6 - Disable Inactive User Accounts
controls.title: Disable Inactive User Accounts
controls.body: Inactive user accounts are removed or disabled within 90 days of inactivity.

controls.name: TISAX 5.1.2.1 - Encrypted Information During Transfer
controls.title: Encrypted Information During Transfer
controls.body: Information is encrypted or technical security measures are applied to protect the information in transit against unauthorized access.

controls.name: PCI 7.3.2 - Access Control System(s) Enforce Permissions
controls.title: Access Control System(s) Enforce Permissions
controls.body: The access control system(s) is configured to enforce permissions assigned to individuals, applications, and systems based on job classification and function.

controls.name: PCI 9.4.7 - Media Destruction
controls.title: Media Destruction
controls.body:
Electronic media with cardholder data is destroyed when no longer needed for business or legal reasons via one of the following:
- The electronic media is destroyed.
- The cardholder data is rendered unrecoverable so that it cannot be reconstructed.

controls.name: PCI 10.3.1 - Read Access to Logs
controls.title: Read Access to Logs
controls.body: Read access to audit logs files is limited to those with a job-related need.

controls.name: PCI 8.1.1 - Authentication Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Authentication Policies and Procedures
controls.body:
All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 8 are:
- Documented.
- Kept up to date.
- In use.
- Known to all affected parties.

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.5 - Physical Intrusion Alarms and Alerts to Security Perimeter
controls.title: Physical Intrusion Alarms and Alerts to Security Perimeter
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall issue an alarm or alert in response to detected unauthorized access through a physical access point into a physical security perimeter to the personnel identified in the BES cyber security incident response plan within 15 minutes of detection.

controls.name: CIP-011-3.R1 - Information Protection Program
controls.title: Information Protection Program
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented information protection program(s) that includes method(s) for identification, protection and secure handling of BES cyber system information (BCSI).

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.6 - Monitoring Physical Access Control System
controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access Control System
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall monitor each physical access control system for unauthorized physical access to a physical access control system.

controls.name: 8.22 - Segregation of Networks (27017)
controls.title: Segregation of Networks (27017)
controls.body: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated in the organization’s networks.

controls.name: PCI 11.3.1 - Quarterly Internal Vulnerability Scans
controls.title: Quarterly Internal Vulnerability Scans
controls.body:
Internal vulnerability scans are performed as follows:
- At least once every three months.
- High-risk and critical vulnerabilities (per the entity’s vulnerability risk rankings defined at Requirement 6.3.1) are resolved.
- Rescans are performed that confirm all high-risk and critical vulnerabilities (as noted above) have been resolved.
- Scan tool is kept up to date with latest vulnerability information.
- Scans are performed by qualified personnel and organizational independence of the tester exists.

controls.name: PCI 10.4.1 - Log Review
controls.title: Log Review
controls.body:
The following audit logs are reviewed at least once daily:
- All security events.
- Logs of all system components that store, process, or transmit CHD and/or SAD.
- Logs of all critical system components.
- Logs of all servers and system components that perform security functions (for example, network security controls, intrusion-detection systems/intrusion-prevention systems (IDS/IPS), authentication servers).

controls.name: CIP-011-3.R1-1.1 - Identification of BCSI
controls.title: Identification of BCSI
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement one or more information protection program(s) that includes method(s) to identify BES cyber system information (BCSI).

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.7 - Physical Intrusion Alarms and Alerts to Access Control System
controls.title: Physical Intrusion Alarms and Alerts to Access Control System
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall issue an alarm or alert in response to detected unauthorized physical access to a physical access control system to the personnel identified in the BES cyber security Incident response plan within 15 minutes of the detection.

controls.name: CIP-003.R2 - Cyber Security Plan
controls.title: Cyber Security Plan

controls.name: CIP-011.R2 - BES Cyber Asset Reuse and Disposal Processes
controls.title: BES Cyber Asset Reuse and Disposal Processes
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented process(es) for BES cyber asset reuse and disposal.

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.8 - Logging Physical Access
controls.title: Logging Physical Access
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall log (through automated means or by personnel who control entry) entry of each individual with authorized unescorted physical access into each physical security perimeter, with information to identify the individual and date and time of entry.

controls.name: PCI 11.3.2.1 - External Vulnerability Scans After a Significant Change
controls.title: External Vulnerability Scans After a Significant Change
controls.body:
External vulnerability scans are performed after any significant change as follows:
- Vulnerabilities that are scored 4.0 or higher by the CVSS are resolved.
- Rescans are conducted as needed.
- Scans are performed by qualified personnel and organizational independence of the tester exists (not required to be a QSA or ASV).

controls.name: PCI 9.5.1.2 - Periodic Inspection of Devices
controls.title: Periodic Inspection of Devices
controls.body: POI device surfaces are periodically inspected to detect tampering and unauthorized substitution.

controls.name: PCI 10.4.3 - Exceptions from Log Review
controls.title: Exceptions from Log Review
controls.body: Exceptions and anomalies identified during the review process are addressed.

controls.name: PCI 9.5.1.2.1 - Periodic Inspection of Devices
controls.title: Periodic Inspection of Devices
controls.body: The frequency of periodic POI device inspections and the type of inspections performed is defined in the entity’s targeted risk analysis, which is performed according to all elements specified in Requirement 12.3.1.

controls.name: CIP-004.R3-3.3 - Evaluation of Criminal History Check
controls.title: Evaluation of Criminal History Check
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement a process to evaluate criminal history records checks for authorizing access.

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.9 - Retention of Physical Access Logs
controls.title: Retention of Physical Access Logs
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall retain physical access logs of entry of individuals with authorized unescorted physical access into each physical security perimeter for at least ninety calendar days.

controls.name: PCI 9.5.1.3 - Personnel Training on Device Protection
controls.title: Personnel Training on Device Protection
controls.body:
Training is provided for personnel in POI environments to be aware of attempted tampering or replacement of POI devices, and includes:
- Verifying the identity of any third-party persons claiming to be repair or maintenance personnel, before granting them access to modify or troubleshoot devices.
- Procedures to ensure devices are not installed, replaced, or returned without verification.
- Being aware of suspicious behavior around devices.
- Reporting suspicious behavior and indications of device tampering or substitution to appropriate personnel.

controls.name: PCI 10.1.1 - Logging and Monitoring Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Logging and Monitoring Policies and Procedures
controls.body:
All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 10 are:
- Documented.
- Kept up to date.
- In use.
- Known to all affected parties.

controls.name: PCI 10.5.1 - Audit Log Retention
controls.title: Audit Log Retention
controls.body: Retain audit log history for at least 12 months, with at least the most recent three months immediately available for analysis.

controls.name: PCI 10.6.2 - Time Settings and Synchronization
controls.title: Time Settings and Synchronization
controls.body:
Systems are configured to the correct and consistent time as follows:
- One or more designated time servers are in use.
- Only the designated central time server(s) receives time from external sources.
- Time received from external sources is based on International Atomic Time or Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
- The designated time server(s) accept time updates only from specific industry-accepted external sources.
- Where there is more than one designated time server, the time servers peer with one another to keep accurate time.
- Internal systems receive time information only from designated central time server(s).

controls.name: PCI 10.2.1.3 - Access Restriction to Audit Log
controls.title: Access Restriction to Audit Log
controls.body: Audit logs capture all access to audit logs.

controls.name: CIP-006.R1-1.10 - Restricting Physical Access
controls.title: Restricting Physical Access
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall restrict physical access to cabling and other non-programmable communication components used for connection between applicable cyber assets within the same electronic security perimeter in those instances when such cabling and components are located outside of a physical security perimeter. Where physical access restrictions to such cabling and components are not implemented, the responsible entity shall implement one or more of the following:
* encryption of data that transit such cabling and components; or
* monitoring the status of the communication link composed of such cabling and components and issuing an alarm or alert in response to detected communication failures to the personnel identified in the BES cyber security incident response plan within 15 minutes of detection; or
* an equally effective logical protection.

controls.name: CIP-004.R4-4.4 - Verification of Access to Storage Locations
controls.title: Verification of Access to Storage Locations
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall verify at least once every 15 calendar months that access to the designated storage locations for BES cyber system information, whether physical or electronic, are correct and are those that the responsible entity determines are necessary for performing assigned work functions.

controls.name: CIP-011.R2-2.2 - BES Cyber System Information Disposal and Destruction
controls.title: BES Cyber System Information Disposal and Destruction
controls.body: Prior to the disposal of applicable cyber assets that contain BES cyber system information, the responsible entity shall take action to prevent the unauthorized retrieval of BES cyber system information from the cyber asset or destroy the data storage media.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.1 - Audit Log Implementation
controls.title: Audit Log Implementation
controls.body: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.1.1 - User Access Logs
controls.title: User Access Logs
controls.body: Audit logs capture all individual user access to cardholder data.

controls.name: CIP-007.R5-5.7 - Authentication Attempts
controls.title: Authentication Attempts
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall, where technically feasible, either:
* limit the number of unsuccessful authentication attempts; or
* generate alerts after a threshold of unsuccessful authentication attempts.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.1.4 - Audit Logs for Invalid Login Attempts
controls.title: Audit Logs for Invalid Login Attempts
controls.body: Audit logs capture all invalid logical access attempts.

controls.name: PCI 10.2.1.6 - Logs for Initialization, Stopping or Pausing of Audit Logs
controls.title: Logs for Initialization, Stopping or Pausing of Audit Logs
controls.body:
Audit logs capture the following:
- All initialization of new audit logs, and
- All starting, stopping, or pausing of the existing audit logs.

controls.name: PCI 11.6.1 - Change-and-Tamper-Detection Mechanism
controls.title: Change-and-Tamper-Detection Mechanism
controls.body:
A change-and tamper-detection mechanism is deployed as follows:
- To alert personnel to unauthorized modification (including indicators of compromise, changes, additions, and deletions) to the HTTP headers and the contents of payment pages as received by the consumer browser.
- The mechanism is configured to evaluate the received HTTP header and payment page.
- The mechanism functions are performed as follows:
    * At least once every seven days
OR
    * Periodically (at the frequency defined in the entity’s targeted risk analysis, which is performed according to all elements specified in Requirement 12.3.1).

controls.name: PCI 10.2.2 - Audit Log Entries
controls.title: Audit Log Entries
controls.body:
Audit logs record the following details for each auditable event:
- User identification.
- Type of event.
- Date and time.
- Success and failure indication.
- Origination of event.
- Identity or name of affected data, system component, resource, or service (for example, name and protocol).

controls.name: 8.15 - Logging (27017)
controls.title: Logging (27017)
controls.body: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analyzed.

controls.name: C.6.1.3 - Online Information on IoT Data Processing
controls.title: Online Information on IoT Data Processing
controls.body: There shall be online information available to the data subjects about the smart city deployment strategy, the purpose(s) and measures set in place to protect personal data.

controls.name: PCI 10.7.1 - Timely Detection and Reporting for Service Providers
controls.title: Timely Detection and Reporting for Service Providers
controls.body:
Additional requirement for service providers only: Failures of critical security control systems are detected, alerted, and addressed promptly, including but not limited to failure of the following critical security control systems:
- Network security controls.
- IDS/IPS.
- FIM.
- Anti-malware solutions.
- Physical access controls.
- Logical access controls.
- Audit logging mechanisms.
- Segmentation controls (if used).

controls.name: PCI 10.3.4 - File Integrity Monitoring
controls.title: File Integrity Monitoring
controls.body: File integrity monitoring or change-detection mechanisms is used on audit logs to ensure that existing log data cannot be changed without generating alerts.

controls.name: PCI 10.4.1.1 - Automated Log Review
controls.title: Automated Log Review
controls.body: Automated mechanisms are used to perform audit log reviews.

controls.name: PCI 10.4.2 - Other System Components Log Review
controls.title: Other System Components Log Review
controls.body: Logs of all other system components (those not specified in Requirement 10.4.1) are reviewed periodically.

controls.name: PCI 10.4.2.1 - Risk-Based Log Review
controls.title: Risk-Based Log Review
controls.body: The frequency of periodic log reviews for all other system components (not defined in Requirement 10.4.1) is defined in the entity’s targeted risk analysis, which is performed according to all elements specified in Requirement 12.3.1.

controls.name: C.6.1.5 - Website Information Ease of Access
controls.title: Website Information Ease of Access
controls.body: The privacy policy and DPO contact details shall be accessible in no more than three clicks from the Applicant's website home page.

controls.name: PCI 10.7.2 - Timely Detection and Reporting
controls.title: Timely Detection and Reporting
controls.body:
Failures of critical security control systems are detected, alerted, and addressed promptly, including but not limited to failure of the following critical security control systems:
- Network security controls.
- IDS/IPS.
- Change-detection mechanisms.
- Anti-malware solutions.
- Physical access controls.
- Logical access controls.
- Audit logging mechanisms.
- Segmentation controls (if used).
- Audit log review mechanisms.
- Automated security testing tools (if used).

controls.name: PCI 12.9.2 - TPSP Support for Customers' PCI DSS Compliance
controls.title: TPSP Support for Customers' PCI DSS Compliance
controls.body:
Additional requirement for service providers only: TPSPs support their customers’ requests for information to meet Requirements
12.8.4 and 12.8.5 by providing the following upon customer request:
- PCI DSS compliance status information for any service the TPSP performs on behalf of customers (Requirement 12.8.4).
- Information about which PCI DSS requirements are the responsibility of the TPSP and which are the responsibility of the customer, including any shared responsibilities (Requirement 12.8.5).""12.9.2 Additional requirement for service providers only: TPSPs support their customers’ requests for information to meet Requirements
12.8.4 and 12.8.5 by providing the following upon customer request:
- PCI DSS compliance status information for any service the TPSP performs on behalf of customers (Requirement 12.8.4).
- Information about which PCI DSS requirements are the responsibility of the TPSP and which are the responsibility of the customer, including any shared responsibilities (Requirement 12.8.5).

controls.name: PCI 12.10.4.1 - Risk Analysis for Frequency of Incident Response Training
controls.title: Risk Analysis for Frequency of Incident Response Training
controls.body: The frequency of periodic training for incident response personnel is defined in the entity’s targeted risk analysis, which is performed according to all elements specified in Requirement 12.3.1.

controls.name: CIP-006.R2 - Documented Visitor Control Program
controls.title: Documented Visitor Control Program
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop a documented one or more documented visitor control program(s).

controls.name: PCI 11.1.1 - Vulnerability and Penetration Testing Policies and Procedures
controls.title: Vulnerability and Penetration Testing Policies and Procedures
controls.body:
All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 11 are:
- Documented.
- Kept up to date.
- In use.
- Known to all affected parties.

controls.name: PCI 12.10.5 - Incident Response to Alerts from Security Monitoring System
controls.title: Incident Response to Alerts from Security Monitoring System
controls.body:
The security incident response plan includes monitoring and responding to alerts from security monitoring systems, including but not limited to:
- Intrusion-detection and intrusion-prevention systems.
- Network security controls.
- Change-detection mechanisms for critical files.
- The change-and tamper-detection mechanism for payment pages.
- Detection of unauthorized wireless access points.

controls.name: PCI A1.2.1 - Audit Log Enabled for Each Customer's Cardholder Data Environment
