controls.body: All media with cardholder data is physically secured.

controls.name: C.14.1.1 - Data Processing Information or Documentation
controls.title: Data Processing Information or Documentation

controls.name: CPA 4.1 - Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.title: Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.body: The organization maintains written contracts with service providers, contractors, or third parties who process personal information on their behalf. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by the service provider for the protection of consumers' personal information.

controls.name: VCDPA 2.3 - Right to Request Rectification
controls.title: Right to Request Rectification
controls.body: The organization shall implement policies, procedures and mechanisms to correct inaccurate personal information it holds about a consumer when it receives a verifiable consumer request. All verifiable consumer requests for rectification of personal information should be acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: 4.2 - Notification of Deletion to Third-Parties, Service Providers and Contractors
controls.title: Notification of Deletion to Third-Parties, Service Providers and Contractors
controls.body: The organization shall notify all third parties, service providers or contractors with whom personal information has been shared to delete consumers' personal information upon receiving a verifiable consumer request.

controls.name: CTDPA 1.1 - Privacy Notice
controls.title: Privacy Notice
controls.body: The organization has a privacy notice published on its website, which outlines privacy obligations and specifies individual rights in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The notice is reviewed by management on an annual basis.

controls.name: G.3.2.1 - Duty to Inform
controls.title: Duty to Inform

controls.name: CTDPA 2.3 - Right to Request Rectification
controls.title: Right to Request Rectification
controls.body: The organization shall implement policies, procedures and mechanisms to correct inaccurate personal information it holds about a consumer when it receives a verifiable consumer request. All verifiable consumer requests for rectification of personal information should be acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: TISAX 5.2.4 - Event Logging and Analysis
controls.title: Event Logging and Analysis
controls.body: Event logs are analyzed, collected in accordance with applicable law and stored securely against tampering. Information system event logs are reviewed at regular intervals to identify and correct anomalies or suspicious activities.

controls.name: CTDPA 3.2 - Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.title: Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.body: Organizations assess the need for and implement, where appropriate, a privacy impact assessment whenever new processing of personal information or changes to existing processing is planned.

controls.name: CTDPA 4.1 - Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.title: Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.body: The organization maintains written contracts with service providers, contractors, or third parties with who it shares, sells, or discloses consumers' personal information. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by the service provider for the protection of consumers' personal information.

controls.name: G.3.9.1 - Right to Data Portability
controls.title: Right to Data Portability

controls.name: CTDPA 5.1 - Security Procedures and Practices
controls.title: Security Procedures and Practices
controls.body: Reasonable security procedures and practices have been implemented by the organization for the security and protection of consumers' personal information. These measures are assessed by management on an annual basis, and deficiencies identified are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: 2.10 - Automated Decision Making
controls.title: Automated Decision Making
controls.body: The organization identifies and addresses obligations to consumers where a decision is based solely on the automated processing of their personal information.

controls.name: UCPA 2.4 - Notice of Targeted Advertising or Sale of Personal Information
controls.title: Notice of Targeted Advertising or Sale of Personal Information
controls.body: Explicit notice is provided to consumers prior to processing personal data for targeted advertising or the sale of their personal information. Consumers are provided with a mechanism to exercise the right to opt out of the targeted advertising or sale of their personal information, and any such requests are handled in a timely manner.

controls.name: UCPA 2.5 - Right to Opt-out of Targeted Advertising or Sale of Personal Information
controls.title: Right to Opt-out of Targeted Advertising or Sale of Personal Information
controls.body: Requests from consumers to opt-out of targeted advertising or the sale of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: UCPA 2.3 - Right to Access/Know
controls.title: Right to Access/Know
controls.body: Requests from consumers to access/know about their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request. Any delay or denial on request is communicated to consumers and handled in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.name: 3.1 - Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.title: Personal Information Collection Limit
controls.body: The organization has established processes to limit the collection, use, retention, and sharing of a consumer's personal information to the minimum that is relevant, proportional and reasonably necessary for the identified purposes.

controls.name: UCPA 2.6 - Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.body: The organization has established processes to prohibit discrimination against consumers who exercised their rights under the UCPA.

controls.name: UCPA 2.7 - Right to Data-Portability
controls.title: Right to Data-Portability
controls.body: Procedures and mechanisms are in place to provide consumers with a copy of their personal data in a portable and, to the extent technically feasible, readily usable format that allows the consumer to transmit the data to another controller.

controls.name: UCPA 4.1 - Security Procedures and Practices
controls.title: Security Procedures and Practices
controls.body: Reasonable security procedures and practices have been implemented by the organization for the security and protection of consumers' personal information. These measures are assessed by management on an annual basis, and deficiencies identified are remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: G.3.10.1 - Effectiveness of the Right to Object
controls.title: Effectiveness of the Right to Object
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have rules, a procedure, or a mechanism in place to effectively comply with the requests of data subjects to object to the processing of their personal data.

controls.name: CIP-007.R4-4.2 - Log Monitoring
controls.title: Log Monitoring
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall generate alerts for security events that the Responsible Entity determines necessitates an alert that includes, as a minimum, each of the following types of events (per cyber asset or BES cyber system capability):
4.2.1. Detected malicious code from "CIP-007.R4-4.1 - Log Configuration"; and
4.2.2. Detected failure of "CIP-007.R4-4.1 - Log Configuration" event logging.

controls.name: UCPA 2.1 - Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.title: Consumers Rights Procedure
controls.body: The organization has established a consumer rights procedure that specifies the process and time frames for handling consumers' requests with respect to their personal information. The procedure is communicated to all the employees and reviewed by management on at least an annual basis.

controls.name: VCDPA 2.2 - Right to Request Deletion
controls.title: Right to Request Deletion
controls.body: Requests from consumers for the deletion of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: G.3.10.2 - Clear Information on the Right to Object
controls.title: Clear Information on the Right to Object

controls.name: CPA 2.2 - Right to Request Deletion
controls.title: Right to Request Deletion
controls.body: Requests from consumers for the deletion of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request

controls.name: UCPA 2.2 - Right to Request Deletion
controls.title: Right to Request Deletion
controls.body: Requests from consumers for the deletion of their personal information are documented, retained, and acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: 2.12 - Notice of Financial Incentive
controls.title: Notice of Financial Incentive
controls.body: Notice of financial incentives is provided to consumers before any collection, retention, sale or sharing of their personal information. Opt-in consent is obtained from consumers prior to enrolling them into financial incentive programs, along with a mechanism provided to modify or withdraw this consent.

controls.name: 2.4 - Right to Request Rectification
controls.title: Right to Request Rectification
controls.body: The organization shall implement policies, procedures and mechanisms to correct inaccurate personal information it holds about a consumer when it receives a verifiable consumer request. All verifiable consumer requests for rectification of personal information should be acted upon within 45 days from the receipt of the request.

controls.name: 2.9 - Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.body: The organization has established processes to prohibit discrimination against consumers who exercised their rights under the US state privacy laws.

controls.name: 3.2 - Personal Information Collection for Research
controls.title: Personal Information Collection for Research
controls.body: The organization has procedures in place relating to the collection of personal information for research purposes. Documentation related to applicable conditions for research-related collection is retained by the organization.

controls.name: PCI 11.5.1 - Intrusion Detection and Prevention
controls.title: Intrusion Detection and Prevention
controls.body:
Intrusion-detection and/or intrusion-prevention techniques are used to detect and/or prevent intrusions into the network as follows:
- All traffic is monitored at the perimeter of the CDE.
- All traffic is monitored at critical points in the CDE.
- Personnel are alerted to suspected compromises.
- All intrusion-detection and prevention engines, baselines, and signatures are kept up to date.

controls.name: 1.2 - Employee Privacy Notice
controls.title: Employee Privacy Notice
controls.body: The organization has established a privacy notice for its employee and contractors which specifies their rights, the purpose of their personal information collection and organization's privacy obligations in accordance with applicable privacy laws and regulations. The policy has been communicated and acknowledged by the employees and contractors.

controls.name: CCPA 1.2 - Employee Privacy Notice
controls.title: Employee Privacy Notice
controls.body: The organization has established a privacy notice for its employee and contractors which specifies their rights, the purpose of their personal information collection and the organization's privacy obligations in accordance with applicable privacy laws and regulations. The policy has been communicated and acknowledged by the employees and contractors.

controls.name: CPA 3.2 - Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.title: Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.body: Organizations assess the need for and implement, where appropriate, a privacy impact assessment whenever new processing of personal information or changes to existing processing is planned.

controls.name: 5.15 - Access Control (27017)
controls.title: Access Control (27017)
controls.body: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.

controls.name: G.3.1.4 - Information Without Undue Delay
controls.title: Information Without Undue Delay

controls.name: PCI 10.7.3 - Timely Response to Security Control Failures
controls.title: Timely Response to Security Control Failures
controls.body:
Failures of any critical security controls systems are responded to promptly, including but not limited to:
- Restoring security functions.
- Identifying and documenting the duration (date and time from start to end) of the security failure.
- Identifying and documenting the cause(s) of failure and documenting required remediation.
- Identifying and addressing any security issues that arose during the failure.
- Determining whether further actions are required as a result of the security failure.
- Implementing controls to prevent the cause of failure from reoccurring.
- Resuming monitoring of security controls.

controls.name: PCI 11.3.1.1 - Lower-Risk Vulnerability Remediation
controls.title: Lower-Risk Vulnerability Remediation
controls.body:
All other applicable vulnerabilities (those not ranked as high-risk or critical per the entity’s vulnerability risk rankings defined at Requirement
6.3.1) are managed as follows:
- Addressed based on the risk defined in the entity’s targeted risk analysis, which is performed according to all elements specified in Requirement 12.3.1.
- Rescans are conducted as needed.

controls.name: G.3.1.5 - Electronic Response
controls.title: Electronic Response
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have rules, procedures, or a mechanism in place to ensure that where the data subject makes the request by electronic means, the information is provided  by default through electronic means too.

controls.name: G.3.8.1 - Duty to Inform Recipients
controls.title: Duty to Inform Recipients
controls.body:
A) The Applicant shall have a procedure or mechanism in place to communicate any rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing carried out to each recipient to whom the personal data have been disclosed.
*OR*
B) The Applicant shall demonstrate that the duty to inform the recipient is impossible or involves disproportionate effort.

controls.name: PCI A3.3.1.2 - Response to Failures of Any Critical Security Control Systems
controls.title: Response to Failures of Any Critical Security Control Systems
controls.body:
Failures of any critical security control systems are responded to promptly. Processes for responding to failures in security control systems include:
- Restoring security functions.
- Identifying and documenting the duration (date and time from start to end) of the security failure.
- Identifying and documenting the cause(s) of failure, including root cause, and documenting remediation required to address the root cause.
- Identifying and addressing any security issues that arose during the failure.
- Determining whether further actions are required as a result of the security failure.
- Implementing controls to prevent the cause of failure from reoccurring.
- Resuming monitoring of security controls.

PCI DSS Reference: Requirements 1-12

controls.name: CIP-010.R3-3.1 - Vulnerability Assessment
controls.title: Vulnerability Assessment
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall, at least once every 15 calendar months, conduct a paper or active vulnerability assessment.

controls.name: CIP-010.R3-3.3 - Active Vulnerability Assessments of New Cyber Assets
controls.title: Active Vulnerability Assessments of New Cyber Assets
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall, prior to adding a new applicable cyber asset to a production environment, perform an active vulnerability assessment of the new cyber asset, except for CIP exceptional circumstances and like replacements of the same type of cyber asset with a baseline configuration that models an existing baseline configuration of the previous or other existing cyber asset.

controls.name: 2.14 - Consent on Processing of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.title: Consent on Processing of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.body: Affirmative consent is obtained and maintained from individuals prior to any processing of their sensitive personal information. Individuals are provided with a mechanism to withdraw their consent, and any such requests are documented and retained in accordance with organization policies.

controls.name: 8.32 - Change Management (27017)
controls.title: Change Management (27017)
controls.body: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

controls.name: G.6.2.6 - Access and Transfer Logs
controls.title: Access and Transfer Logs

controls.name: C.50.1.1 - Legitimate Interest Restriction
controls.title: Legitimate Interest Restriction
controls.body: A) The lawfulness of the data processing shall not rely on a claim of legitimate interest mentioned in GDPR Art. 6 in the performance of the Applicant's tasks.

controls.name: G.4.1.2 - Duty to Review and Update
controls.title: Duty to Review and Update
controls.body:
A) The Applicant shall have a procedure in place to review on a regular basis (at least yearly) the adequacy of the technical and organizational measures in place. 
*AND*
B) The Applicant shall keep documented records of:
    b.1) the review of the technical and organizational measures;
    b.2) the identified vulnerabilities and actions taken to address these vulnerabilities.

controls.name: C.13.1.2 - Restriction of Data Processing
controls.title: Restriction of Data Processing
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have policies, processes or mechanisms in place to limit the data and information processed when assessing financial soundness and creditworthiness of data subjects.

controls.name: CIP-004.R5-5.1 - Removal of Access on Termination
controls.title: Removal of Access on Termination
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall initiate the removal of an individual’s ability for unescorted physical access and interactive remote access upon a termination action, and complete the removals within 24 hours of the termination action (removal of the ability for access may be different than deletion, disabling, revocation, or removal of all access rights).

controls.name: G.2.1.1 - Special Categories of Data - DPO Validation
controls.title: Special Categories of Data - DPO Validation

controls.name: CIP-004.R5-5.3 - Revoke Access to Storage Locations on Termination
controls.title: Revoke Access to Storage Locations on Termination
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall, in the case of termination actions, revoke the individual’s access to the designated storage locations for BES cyber system Information, whether physical or electronic (unless already revoked according to CIP-004.R5-5.1), by the end of the next calendar day following the effective date of the termination action.

controls.name: CIP-004.R5-5.4 - Revoke Access to Non-shared User Accounts on Termination
controls.title: Revoke Access to Non-shared User Accounts on Termination
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall, in the case of termination actions, revoke the individual’s non-shared user accounts (unless already revoked according to CIP-004.R5-5.1 or CIP-004.R5-5.3) within 30 calendar days of the effective date of the termination action.

controls.name: CIP-004.R5-5.5 - Password Change for Shared Accounts on Termination
controls.title: Password Change for Shared Accounts on Termination
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall, in the case of termination actions, change passwords for a shared account(s) known to the user within 30 calendar days of the termination action. 

For reassignments or transfers, change passwords for a shared account(s) known to the user within 30 calendar days following the date that the responsible entity determines that the individual no longer requires retention of that access.

If the responsible entity determines and documents that extenuating operating circumstances require a longer time period, change the password(s) within 10 calendar days following the end of the operating circumstances.

controls.name: CIP-004-7.R5-5.3 - Revoke Access to Non-shared User Accounts
controls.title: Revoke Access to Non-shared User Accounts
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall, in the case of termination actions, revoke the individual’s non-shared user accounts (unless already revoked according to CIP-004.R5-5.1) within 30 calendar days of the effective date of the termination action.

controls.name: G.3.1.2 - Duty to Facilitate Data Subject Rights Exercise
controls.title: Duty to Facilitate Data Subject Rights Exercise

controls.name: CIP-004-7.R5-5.4 - Change of Password for Shared Accounts
controls.title: Change of Password for Shared Accounts
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall, in the case of termination actions, change passwords for a shared account(s) known to the user within 30 calendar days of the termination action. For reassignments or transfers, change passwords for a shared account(s) known to the user within 30 calendar days following the date that the responsible entity determines that the individual no longer requires retention of that
access.

If the responsible entity determines and documents that extenuating operating circumstances require a longer time period, change the password(s) within 10 calendar days following the end of the operating
circumstances.

controls.name: PCI 7.2.2 - Privileged Access
controls.title: Privileged Access
controls.body:
Access is assigned to users, including privileged users, based on:
- Job classification and function.
- Least privileges necessary to perform job responsibilities.

controls.name: G.6.2.2 - Process on Instruction Only
controls.title: Process on Instruction Only
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have rules, policies, contractual clauses, guidelines or mechanisms in place to ensure that any natural person acting under its authority does not process personal data except if instructed by the Controller (unless he or she is required to do so by law).

controls.name: CIP-010.R4-3.1 - Removable Media Authorization
controls.title: Removable Media Authorization
controls.body:
For each individual or group of removable media, each responsible entity shall authorize:
3.1.1. Users, either individually or by group or role; and
3.1.2. Locations, either individually or by group.

controls.name: PCI 9.3.1.1 - Physical Access Control to Sensitive Areas
controls.title: Physical Access Control to Sensitive Areas
controls.body:
Physical access to sensitive areas within the CDE for personnel is controlled as follows:
- Access is authorized and based on individual job function.
- Access is revoked immediately upon termination.
- All physical access mechanisms, such as keys, access cards, etc., are returned or disabled upon termination.

controls.name: CIP-004.R2-2.2 - Training Completion
controls.title: Training Completion
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall ensure completion of the training specified in Part 2.1 (CIP-004.R2-2.1) prior to granting authorized electronic access and authorized unescorted physical access to applicable cyber assets, except during CIP exceptional circumstances.

controls.name: CIP-004.R2-2.3 - Training Completion Frequency
controls.title: Training Completion Frequency
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall require completion of the training specified in Part 2.1 (CIP-004.R2-2.1) at least once every 15 calendar months.

controls.name: CIP-004.R3-3.1 - Identity Confirmation
controls.title: Identity Confirmation
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement a documented process to confirm the identity of users before granting them authorized access.

controls.name: CIP-004.R3-3.2 - Criminal History Check
controls.title: Criminal History Check
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall implement a process to perform a seven-year criminal history records check as part of each personnel risk assessment prior to granting authorized access. This should include:
3.2.1. Current residence, regardless of duration; and 
3.2.2. Other locations where, during the seven years immediately prior to the date of the criminal history records check, the subject has resided for six consecutive months or more. 

If it is not possible to perform a full seven-year criminal history records check, conduct as much of the seven-year criminal history records check as possible and document the reason the full seven-year criminal history records check could not be performed.

controls.name: T.2.3.1 - PEN Test
controls.title: PEN Test

controls.name: CIP-004.R3-3.4 - Verification of Personnel Risk Assessment for Contractors
controls.title: Verification of Personnel Risk Assessment for Contractors
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement a documented process to verify that personnel risk assessments performed for contractors or service providers are conducted according to parts 3.1 through 3.3 (CIP-004.R3-3.1 to CIP-004.R3-3.3).

controls.name: 4.1 - Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.title: Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.body: The organization maintains written contracts with service providers, contractors, or third parties with who it shares, sells, or discloses consumers' personal information. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by the service provider for the protection of consumers' personal information.

controls.name: CIP-004.R3-3.5 - Personnel Risk Assessment Frequency
controls.title: Personnel Risk Assessment Frequency
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement a process to ensure that individuals with authorized electronic or authorized unescorted physical access have had a personnel risk assessment completed according to parts 3.1 to 3.4 (CIP-004.R3-3.1 to CIP-004.R3-3.4) within the last seven years.

controls.name: CIP-007.R5-5.2 - Inventory of Accounts
controls.title: Inventory of Accounts
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall identify and inventory all known enabled default or other generic account types, either by system, by groups of systems, by location, or by system type(s).

controls.name: CIP-010.R2-2.1 - Baseline Configuration Monitoring
controls.title: Baseline Configuration Monitoring
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall monitor at least once every 35 calendar days for changes to the baseline configuration (as described in CIP-010-4.R1-1.1). Document and investigate detected unauthorized changes.

controls.name: CIP-010.R1-1.5 - Testing of Baseline Changes
controls.title: Testing of Baseline Changes
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall ensure that, where technically feasible, for each change that deviates from the existing baseline configuration:
1.5.1 Prior to implementing any change in the production environment, test the changes in a test environment or test the changes in a production environment where the test is performed in a manner that minimizes adverse effects, that models the baseline configuration to ensure that required cyber security controls in CIP-005 and CIP-007 are not adversely affected; and
1.5.2 Document the results of the testing and, if a test environment was used, the differences between the test environment and the production environment, including a description of the measures used to account for any differences in operation between the test and production environments.

controls.name: CIP-010.R1-1.4 - Verification of Cyber Security Controls Following Changes
controls.title: Verification of Cyber Security Controls Following Changes
controls.body:
Each responsible entity shall ensure that for a change that deviates from the existing baseline configuration:
1.4.1 Prior to the change, determine required cyber security controls in CIP-005 and CIP-007 that could be impacted by the change;
1.4.2 Following the change, verify that the required cyber security controls determined in 1.4.1 are not adversely affected; and
1.4.3 Document the results of the verification.

controls.name: A.12.1 - Geographical Location of PII
controls.title: Geographical Location of PII
controls.body: The public cloud PII processor should specify and document the countries in which PII can possibly be stored.

controls.name: A.10.1 - Notification of a Data Breach Involving PII
controls.title: Notification of a Data Breach Involving PII
controls.body: The public cloud PII processor should promptly notify the relevant cloud service customer in the event of any unauthorized access to PII or unauthorized access to processing equipment or facilities resulting in loss, disclosure or alteration of PII.

controls.name: A.8.1 - Disclosure of Sub-contracted PII Processing
controls.title: Disclosure of Sub-contracted PII Processing
controls.body: The use of sub-contractors by the public cloud PII processor to process PII should be disclosed to the relevant cloud service customers before their use.

controls.name: A.3.1 - Public Cloud PII Processor’s Purpose
controls.title: Public Cloud PII Processor’s Purpose
controls.body: PII to be processed under a contract should not be processed for any purpose independent of the instructions of the cloud service customer.

controls.name: PCI 12.8.1 - List of TPSPs
controls.title: List of TPSPs
controls.body: A list of all third-party service providers (TPSPs) with which account data is shared or that could affect the security of account data is maintained, including a description for each of the services provided.

controls.name: CLD.6.3.1 - Shared Roles and Responsibilities in Cloud Computing
controls.title: Shared Roles and Responsibilities in Cloud Computing
controls.body: Shared roles and responsibilities for information security in the use of the cloud service shall be allocated to identified parties, documented, communicated and implemented by both the cloud service customer and the cloud service provider.

controls.name: TISAX 9.2.1 - Contracts with Processors
controls.title: Contracts with Processors
controls.body: The organization maintains written contracts with subcontracting processors for processing personally identifiable data collected from data subjects. These contracts must specify and subject the processor to the same data protection obligations defined in the contract between the responsible person and the processor.

controls.name: CIP-005.R2-2.3 - Implement Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) for all Remote Access
controls.title: Implement Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) for all Remote Access
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall require multi-factor authentication for all interactive remote access sessions.

controls.name: CIP-005.R2-2.5 - Disable Remote Vendor Connections
controls.title: Disable Remote Vendor Connections
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement one or more method(s) to disable active vendor remote access (including interactive remote access and system-to-system remote access).

controls.name: UCPA 3.1 - Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.title: Contracts with Service Providers, Contractors or Third Parties
controls.body: The organization maintains written contracts with service providers, contractors, or third parties with who it shares, sells, or discloses consumers' personal information. These contracts outline the security and privacy requirements that are required to be implemented by the service provider for the protection of consumers' personal information.

controls.name: CIP-005.R3-3.2 - Terminate Authenticated Vendor Initiated Remote  Connections
controls.title: Terminate Authenticated Vendor Initiated Remote  Connections
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall implement one or more method(s) to terminate authenticated vendor-initiated remote connections and control the ability to reconnect.

controls.name: G.5.1.5 - Complementary Demonstration of Processors' Compliance
controls.title: Complementary Demonstration of Processors' Compliance
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall collect information and keep record for each data Processor of their certification, approved code of conduct, and publicly binding commitments to respect the applicable data protection regulations.

controls.name: CIP-014.R2-2.2 - Third-Party Verification of Risk Assessment
controls.title: Third-Party Verification of Risk Assessment
controls.body: The unaffiliated third-party verification shall verify the transmission owner’s risk assessment performed under CIP-014.R1, which may include recommendations for the addition or deletion of a transmission station(s) or transmission substation(s). The transmission owner shall ensure the verification is completed within 90 calendar days following the completion of the CIP-014.R1 risk assessment.

controls.name: CIP-014.R6-6.3 - Modification to Evaluation and Security Plans
controls.title: Modification to Evaluation and Security Plans
controls.body:
If the unaffiliated third party reviewer recommends changes to the evaluation performed under CIP-014.R4 or security plan(s) developed under CIP-014.R5, the transmission owner or transmission operator shall, within 60 calendar days of the completion of the unaffiliated third party review, for each recommendation:
* Modify its evaluation or security plan(s) consistent with the recommendation; or
* Document the reason(s) for not modifying the evaluation or security plan(s) consistent with the recommendation.

controls.name: CIP-014.R2-2.3 - Modification to Risk Assessment
controls.title: Modification to Risk Assessment
controls.body:
If the unaffiliated verifying entity of the risk assessment recommends that the transmission owner add a transmission station(s) or transmission substation(s) to, or remove a transmission station(s) or transmission substation(s) from, its identification under CIP-014.R1, the transmission owner shall either, within 60 calendar days of completion of the verification, for each recommended addition or removal of a transmission station or transmission substation:
* Modify its identification under CIP-014.R1 consistent with the recommendation; or
* Document the technical basis for not modifying the identification in accordance with the recommendation.

controls.name: CIP-014.R6-6.2 - Third Party Review of Evaluation and Security Plans Timeframe
controls.title: Third Party Review of Evaluation and Security Plans Timeframe
controls.body: The transmission owner or transmission operator, respectively, shall ensure that the unaffiliated third-party review is completed within 90 calendar days of completing the security plan(s) developed in CIP-014.R5. The unaffiliated third-party review may, but is not required to, include recommended changes to the evaluation performed under CIP-014.R4 or the security plan(s) developed under CIP-014.R5.

controls.name: PCI 6.5.1 - System Component Changes
controls.title: System Component Changes
controls.body:
Changes to all system components in the production environment are made according to established procedures that include:
- Reason for, and description of, the change.
- Documentation of security impact.
- Documented change approval by authorized parties.
- Testing to verify that the change does not adversely impact system security.
- For bespoke and custom software changes, all updates are tested for compliance with Requirement 6.2.4 before being deployed into production.
- Procedures to address failures and return to a secure state.

controls.name: G.3.1.3 - Data subject Rights Management and Recording
controls.title: Data subject Rights Management and Recording

controls.name: G.3.1.6 - Duty to Inform and Justify Non Action
controls.title: Duty to Inform and Justify Non Action
controls.body:
A) The Applicant shall have rules, procedures or a mechanism in place to inform and justify non-action to data subjects. 
*AND*
B) When the Applicant decides not to take action on a request for information from a data subject, it shall inform the data subject within no more than 30 days after receiving the request about:
    b.1) the reasons for not taking action;
    b.2) (AND) the possibility of lodging a complaint with a Supervisory Authority and the possibility of seeking a judicial remedy.

controls.name: G.6.2.3 - Contractual Obligation to Confidentiality
controls.title: Contractual Obligation to Confidentiality
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have rules, policies or procedures in place to ensure that all the natural persons who come in contact with personal data shall be bound by confidentiality obligations which extend beyond the end of their activities.

controls.name: G.6.2.11 - Complementary Technical and Organization Measures
controls.title: Complementary Technical and Organization Measures
controls.body:
A) The Applicant shall have:
    a.1) assessed the adequacy of its Technical and Organisational Measures (TOM);
    a.2) (OR) a complementary certification of the Technical and Organizational Measures in place to secure and protect the data processed in the Target of Evaluation.
AND
B) The assessment of the TOM shall have been validated by the DPO as being sufficient and adequate to protect the rights and freedoms of the data subjects.

controls.name: G.6.1.2 - Data Minimization by Default
controls.title: Data Minimization by Default

controls.name: G.1.2.3 - Right to Withdraw Consent
controls.title: Right to Withdraw Consent
controls.body:
A) The Applicant shall demonstrate that the procedure or mechanism in place to comply with the right of a data subject to withdraw consent enables to effectively implement the request.
*AND*
B) The procedure to withdraw consent shall be:
    b.1) as simple as the one used for collecting consent;
    b.2) (AND) accessible through the user interface(s) used to collect consent.

controls.name: G.3.6.1 - Right to Erasure
controls.title: Right to Erasure
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have rules, a procedure, or a mechanism in place to effectively erase the personal data that are no longer necessary (in relation with the purpose for which they were collected or processed).

controls.name: G.4.1.1 - Documentation on Technical and Organization Measures
controls.title: Documentation on Technical and Organization Measures
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have a written documentation of its technical and organizational measures implemented for protecting the processed data.

controls.name: CIP-009.R1-1.4 - Backup and Monitoring
controls.title: Backup and Monitoring
controls.body: Each responsible entity shall develop one or more documented recovery plan(s) that include one or more processes to verify the successful completion of the backup processes in CIP-009.R1-1.3 - Backup and Recovery Process and to address any backup failures.

controls.name: G.1.1.4 - Adequate Qualification of the Expert
controls.title: Adequate Qualification of the Expert

controls.name: G.1.2.2 - Absence of Unnecessary Constraints for Consent
controls.title: Absence of Unnecessary Constraints for Consent
controls.body: A) IF the Target of Evaluation encompasses several distinct purposes of data processing, THEN the Applicant shall provide a granular consent mechanism enabling the data subject to freely select which purpose to consent with.

controls.name: G.5.3.4 - Completeness of the Registry
controls.title: Completeness of the Registry
controls.body: A) All processing activities in the scope of the Target of Evaluation shall be recorded in the Record of processing activities.

controls.name: G.1.1.2 - Lawfulness Justification
controls.title: Lawfulness Justification
controls.body:
The  data processing shall comply with at least one of the following justifications:
A) **Consent:** The data processing shall be based on the prior informed consent of the data subjects that:
    a.1) shall be collected before processing their personal data; 
    a.2) (AND) shall be given by the data subjects in a clear and express manner (with a clear affirmative action). 
*OR*
B) **Contractual Necessity:** The data processing shall be required for the performance of the services specified in the contract.
*OR*
C) **Legal Obligation:** The Applicant shall demonstrate the existence of a legal obligation for the data processing.
*OR*
D) **Vital Interests:** The data processing shall be required to protect vital interests of data subjects (i.e. life, health);
*OR*
E) **Public interest or official authority:** The Applicant shall demonstrate that the data processing:
    e.1) is based on public interest or official authority;
    e.2) (AND) with the documentation on the legal basis for such public interest or official authority.
*OR*
F) **Legitimate interests:** The data processing shall be based on legitimate interests for which the Applicant shall demonstrate:
    f.1) the written description of the claimed legitimate interest;
    f.2) (AND) the DPO or a legal expert with adequate expertise has assessed in writing the impact of the data processing on the rights and freedoms of the data subjects;
    f.3) (AND) the DPO or a legal expert with adequate expertise has concluded in writing that the legitimate interest is not overridden by the rights and freedoms of the data subjects.

controls.name: G.3.6.2 - Duty to Relay the Request to Other Data Controllers
controls.title: Duty to Relay the Request to Other Data Controllers
controls.body:
IF the Applicant has made personal data of the Target of Evaluation publicly available to other controllers THEN:
A) The Applicant shall have rules, a procedure, or a mechanism in place to inform other Controllers about the request for erasure by the data subjects, except if the Applicant has evaluated the potential measures to inform the other data Controllers and has demonstrated that the identified measures would have been disproportionate.

controls.name: C.14.1.7 - Behavioural Monitoring
controls.title: Behavioural Monitoring
controls.body:
IF behavioural data are collected from the vehicle (i.e. through a telematics box), THEN:
A) The driver shall be specifically informed about:
    a.1) the presence of behavioural monitoring;
    a.2) (AND) the purpose and scope of behavioural monitoring.
AND
B) The raw data of the driving behaviour shall be processed or pre-processed locally (in the vehicle or on the driver's personal device) in order to minimize data exposure.

controls.name: G.3.6.3 - Tolerated Exemption
controls.title: Tolerated Exemption
controls.body:
The right to erasure is subject to restrictions in the following cases:
- **Exercising the right of freedom of expression and information:** A) Evidence shall demonstrate that the retained data are used in the context of public information or expression.
*(OR)* 
- **Legal obligation:** A) Evidence shall demonstrate that the Applicant is bound by the obligation to comply with such a legal obligation.
*(OR)*
- **Public interest:** A) Evidence shall demonstrate that there is a public interest in the area of public health.
*(OR)* 
- **Archiving, research or statistics:** A) Evidence shall demonstrate that the data retention is related to:
     a.1)  archiving purposes in the public interest;
     a.2) (OR) scientific purposes;
     a.3) (OR) historical research purposes;
     a.4) (OR) statistical purposes.
*(OR)* 
- **Legal procedure:** A) Evidence shall demonstrate that the data retention is related to the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

controls.name: G.3.7.1 - Right to Restriction of Processing
controls.title: Right to Restriction of Processing

controls.name: G.3.4.2 - Duty to Provide a Copy
controls.title: Duty to Provide a Copy
controls.body: A) The personal data processed in the Target of Evaluation shall be extractable and transferable to the Data Subject who has made the request  in a commonly used electronic format.

controls.name: G.3.4.3 - Duty to Protect the Rights of Others
controls.title: Duty to Protect the Rights of Others
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have a procedure or a mechanism in place to prevent adverse effect on other data subjects' rights and freedoms when complying with a data subject request to transfer a copy of its personal data.

controls.name: G.3.5.1 - Right to Rectification
controls.title: Right to Rectification
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall demonstrate that the procedure or mechanism in place to comply with the right of a data subject to rectify or complete his personal data enables to effectively implement the request.

controls.name: G.5.1.1 - Restriction on use of Processors
controls.title: Restriction on use of Processors

controls.name: G.3.11.2 - Rights to Obtain Human Intervention and to Contest
controls.title: Rights to Obtain Human Intervention and to Contest
controls.body:
IF automated decision are based on the processing of personal data THEN:
A) The Applicant shall have procedure or mechanism in place that enables the data subjects:
    a.1) to obtain human intervention on the part of the Controller;
    a.2) (AND) to express their points of view and to contest the decision.

controls.name: G.6.1.1 - Data protection by Design and by Default
controls.title: Data protection by Design and by Default

controls.name: G.6.2.7 - Continuity, Integrity and Availability
controls.title: Continuity, Integrity and Availability

controls.name: G.6.2.8 - Communication  Encryption
controls.title: Communication  Encryption
controls.body: A) Where communications of personal data across public networks can be encrypted, they shall be encrypted.

controls.name: G.6.2.9 - Duty to Backup
controls.title: Duty to Backup
controls.body: A) The personal data stored by the Applicant shall be backed up.

controls.name: G.6.2.10 - Complementary Contextual Requirements
controls.title: Complementary Contextual Requirements
controls.body: A) The data processing activities of the Target of Evaluation shall comply with the applicable Complementary Contextual Checks and Controls specified by Europrivacy.

controls.name: G.8.1.2 - Tolerated Exemption
controls.title: Tolerated Exemption
controls.body:
DPIA is not required (except if required by Member State) if:
A) Processing has a legal basis in Union or Member State law and the Controller is subject to such law AND an impact assessment has already been carried out on similar data processing that are:
    b.1) involving similar Data subjects;
    b.2) (AND) for similar purpose.
*OR*
B) The Target of Evaluation is covered by the list or data processing activities that are exempted of DPIA by the national supervisory authority.

controls.name: G.10.1.6 - Commitment of the Data Receiver
controls.title: Commitment of the Data Receiver
controls.body:
IF any personal data processed in the Target of Evaluation is transferred to any third country or international organization without adequacy decision THEN:
A) The recipient of the personal data shall have made binding and enforceable commitments to apply appropriate safeguards to protect the processed data with regards to the rights of the data subjects.

controls.name: C.14.1.11 - Biometric Data Restrictions
controls.title: Biometric Data Restrictions
controls.body:
IF biometric data is used in connected vehicles THEN:
A) The data subject shall be able to use a non-biometric alternative.
AND
B) The biometric data:
    b.1) shall not be transmitted to a remote server;
    b.2) (AND) shall not be stored in clear format.
AND
C) The risk related to the use of biometric data in the processing shall have been assessed in the context of a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA).

controls.name: G.1.1.3 - National Regulation Compliance
controls.title: National Regulation Compliance

controls.name: G.7.1.3 - Duty of the Processor to Communicate Data Breaches
controls.title: Duty of the Processor to Communicate Data Breaches

controls.name: G.3.3.2 - Duty to inform in Due Time
controls.title: Duty to inform in Due Time

controls.name: G.3.3.3 - Duty to Inform on Purpose Extension
controls.title: Duty to Inform on Purpose Extension
controls.body:
A) The Applicant shall have a procedure in place to inform the data subjects on any further processing of their personal data envisaged for other purpose than the declared purpose for which the data were initially collected.
*AND*
B) The Applicant shall demonstrate the effectiveness of the procedure.

controls.name: G.3.11.1 - Automated Individual Decision-making, Including Profiling
controls.title: Automated Individual Decision-making, Including Profiling

controls.name: G.3.1.7 - Free of Charge
controls.title: Free of Charge

controls.name: G.3.3.4 - Tolerated Exemption
controls.title: Tolerated Exemption
controls.body:
IF the information listed in G.3.3.1 is already provided by the Applicant to the data subjects, THEN G.3.3.1 can be skipped.
- **Already informed:** A) The Applicant shall demonstrate that the data subjects are already in possession of the information listed in G.3.3.1.
(OR)
- **Impossible or disproportionate:** 
      A) The Applicant shall demonstrate that the provision of such information:
     a.1) proves impossible;
     a.2) (OR) would involve a disproportionate effort;
     a.3) (OR) is likely to render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing.
*AND*
      B) The Controller shall have taken appropriate measures to protect data subject's rights, freedoms and interests, including by making the information publicly available.
(OR) 
- **Legal basis:** A) The Applicant shall demonstrate that it is bound by a specific legal obligation which expressly requires the obtention or disclosure of personal data.
(OR) 
- **Secrecy:** A) The Applicant shall demonstrate that it is subject to an obligation of secrecy regulated by law, including a statutory obligation of secrecy.

controls.name: G.5.3.2 - Record of Data Processing by Processor
controls.title: Record of Data Processing by Processor

controls.name: G.6.2.1 - Security Policy
controls.title: Security Policy

controls.name: G.5.1.2 - Contractual Necessity for Controllers
controls.title: Contractual Necessity for Controllers

controls.name: G.7.2.2 - Tolerated Exemptions
controls.title: Tolerated Exemptions
controls.body:
IF the following conditions are met, THEN direct communication to the data subject is not required:
A) The communication was not carried out due to one of the following exceptions:
     a.1) the Applicant has implemented appropriate technical and organisational measures (such as encryption) to render the personal data that have been breached unintelligible to any person who is not authorised to access it.
     a.2) (OR) the Controller has taken subsequent measures which ensure that the high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects is no longer likely to materialise;
    a.3) (OR) direct information would have requested a disproportionate effort AND was replaced by a public communication (or similar measure whereby the data subjects are informed in an equally effective manner).
*AND*
B) The data breach cannot result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects.

controls.name: G.7.1.1 - Duty to Document Data Breaches
controls.title: Duty to Document Data Breaches

controls.name: G.7.2.1 - Breach Communication Requirements
controls.title: Breach Communication Requirements

controls.name: G.8.2.4 - DPIA Review in Case of Change of Risks
controls.title: DPIA Review in Case of Change of Risks
controls.body: A) The Applicant shall have rules or procedures in place to review the DPIA, or its decision to not perform a DPIA, whenever the scope or purpose of the data processing of the Target of Evaluation is substantially modified or exposed to new risks.

controls.name: G.8.2.5 - Duty to Consult the Supervisory Authority
controls.title: Duty to Consult the Supervisory Authority

controls.name: C.5.1.3 - IoT Deployment Documentation
controls.title: IoT Deployment Documentation

controls.name: C.14.1.9 - Securing Vehicle's Communications
controls.title: Securing Vehicle's Communications

controls.name: C.14.1.10 - Other Security Measures
controls.title: Other Security Measures

controls.name: G.9.1.3 - DPO Contact Details Communication
controls.title: DPO Contact Details Communication

controls.name: C.14.1.8 - Utilization Requirements of eCall System
controls.title: Utilization Requirements of eCall System

controls.name: C.15.1.1 - DPIA Extension
controls.title: DPIA Extension

controls.name: C.15.1.2 - Data Minimization by Design
controls.title: Data Minimization by Design

controls.name: C.15.1.6 - Smart Meters Decommissioning
controls.title: Smart Meters Decommissioning
controls.body:
IF smart meters store records of consumption data, THEN: 
A) The Applicant shall have a procedure or a mechanism in place to ensure that stored data are systematically deleted in smart meters that are decommissioned.

controls.name: C.15.1.4 - Edge Processing by Default
controls.title: Edge Processing by Default
controls.body: A) Where applicable, the smart meters shall avoid transmitting data that can be processed or aggregated locally.

controls.name: C.15.1.5 - Smart Grid Complementary Security Requirements
controls.title: Smart Grid Complementary Security Requirements

controls.name: C.50.1.2 - Cross-border Data Transfer Restrictions
controls.title: Cross-border Data Transfer Restrictions
controls.body:
IF the Target of Evaluation includes potential transfer of personal data to third countries that do not have an adequacy decision and do not provide adequate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of the data subjects, THEN:
A) The Applicant shall have policies, rules, or mechanisms in place to prevent such transfer in the performance of its task on the basis of:
    a.1) the consent of the data subject;
    a.2) (AND) the execution of a contract with or to the benefit of the Data Subject.

controls.name: C.15.1.3 - Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PET)
controls.title: Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PET)

controls.name: C.12.1.2 - Professional Devices
controls.title: Professional Devices

controls.name: C.11.1.3 - Record Keeping
controls.title: Record Keeping
controls.body:
IF the Applicant provides the Artificial Intelligence solution used in the Target of Evaluation, THEN:
A) The Applicant shall keep records of documentation related to the selection and/or development of the algorithm used by its Artificial Intelligence.

controls.name: C.11.1.4 - Continuous Risk Assessment
controls.title: Continuous Risk Assessment
controls.body:
A) The Applicant shall have rules, policies, procedures or mechanisms in place to ensure that the risks related to the use of artificial intelligence techniques are monitored and regularly reassessed. 
AND
B) In addition to the usual risks, the risk analysis shall take into account the risk of data or algorithm manipulation.

controls.name: C.11.2.1 - Complementary Conformity Check by the DPO
controls.title: Complementary Conformity Check by the DPO
controls.body:
A) The DPO or an expert with adequate expertise shall have assessed the risks of extracting or generating any categories of personal data that would exceed the declared purpose. 
AND
B) Where mitigation measures have been identified, the Applicant shall have taken action to implement these measures.

controls.name: C.14.1.6 - In-car Applications and Processing
controls.title: In-car Applications and Processing
controls.body:
IF the Applicant uses an in-car application platform THEN:
A) There should be a mechanism in place:
    a.1) to inform the drivers on the personal data processed by the in-car applications;
    a.2) (AND)  to enable the drivers to activate and deactivate the processing of personal data by the in-car applications.
AND
B) Personal data collected by the in-car applications shall not be transmitted to any third parties, except if a specific informed consent has been given by the driver.
AND
C) There shall be a mechanism in place enabling the owner of the car:
    c.1) to have access to the personal data generated by the in-car applications;
    c.2) (AND) to delete the personal data collected by the vehicle before the vehicle is put up to sale.

controls.name: C.14.1.13 - Protection of V2X Traffic and Communications Data
controls.title: Protection of V2X Traffic and Communications Data

controls.name: C.14.1.3 - Regular Processing of Geolocation Data
controls.title: Regular Processing of Geolocation Data
controls.body:
IF geolocation data are communicated or remotely collected from the vehicle THEN:
A) The DPO or a qualified expert shall have assessed and validated that:
    a.1) the granularity of retrieved geolocation data is not more detailed than necessary to achieve the purpose of the processing;
    a.2) (AND) the retention period of the geolocation data is no longer than necessary to achieve the purpose of the processing.
AND
B) There shall be a mechanism or process in place:
    b.1) to ensure that the purpose of geolocation data processing is communicated to the driver;
    b.2) (AND) to enable the driver to deactivate the processing of geolocation data.
AND
C) The user interface of the vehicle shall display an icon to inform the data subject when geolocation data are processed.

controls.name: G.3.4.1 - Right of access by the Data Subject
controls.title: Right of access by the Data Subject

controls.name: G.10.1.2 - Cross-border Transfer Legal Basis
controls.title: Cross-border Transfer Legal Basis
controls.body:
IF personal data are transferred to third countries or to international organisations, THEN it shall comply with at least one of the following options:
A) The third country to which the data are transferred shall benefit from an adequacy decision.
OR
B) The transfer to a third country shall be based on appropriate safeguards and comply with the complementary criterion G.10.1.3.
OR
C) The data are transferred on the basis of binding corporate rules (BCR) that have been approved by the Supervisory Authority of the Applicant.
OR
D) The data transfer shall be based on derogations for specific situations  and comply with the complementary criterion G.10.1.4.

controls.title: Formal Requirements for Consent

controls.title: Data to Criminal Convictions and Offences

controls.name: G.4.1.3 - Data Protection Policies
controls.title: Data Protection Policies

controls.name: G.1.1.1 - Lawfulness Assessment of the Processing
controls.title: Lawfulness Assessment of the Processing

controls.name: G.5.1.3 - Contractual Necessity for Processors
controls.title: Contractual Necessity for Processors

controls.name: G.5.1.4 - Contractual Obligations of Processors
controls.title: Contractual Obligations of Processors

controls.name: G.5.3.1 - Record of Data Processing by Controller
controls.title: Record of Data Processing by Controller

controls.name: G.6.2.4 - Risk Assessment for the Data Processing
controls.title: Risk Assessment for the Data Processing

controls.name: G.6.2.5 - Access Rights Policy and Registry
controls.title: Access Rights Policy and Registry
controls.body:
A) The Applicant shall have established an access control policy that is defined around roles and responsibilities.
AND
B) The Applicant shall keep an updated registry of access rights of its employees and agents who can access the personal data.
AND
C) The Applicant shall have procedure, policy or mechanism in place to regularly review the registry of access rights.
AND
D) The access right policy shall be enforced and verifiable for both:
     d.1) physical access to the place where the data are stored;
     d.2) electronic access to the personal datasets.

controls.title: Notification Requirements

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)
